rows: The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Horrible massage. We came here looking for a great massage and all we got was good decor. The cafe was good (between the two of us, we had coffee, tea, and oatmeal - oatmeal was good but nothing special). 

We had Lizzie who was supposed to "the best" massage therapist, but she definitely wasn't:
-The oil she used was cold - not a pleasant surprise to start off the massage.
-I got "deep tissue" ...I had to tell her twice for more pressure - shouldn't have to ask for that for a deep tissue massage. Even after asking for more pressure, she didn't do it. Come to find out, the person I came with who got a Swedish massage said Lizzie's pressure was weak and limp as well! From the way she timidly handled my head and neck to how I could uncomfortably feel her nails in my skin, everything screamed that Lizzie had either never given a massage before or was extremely inexperienced. 

SUCH a disappointment considering we were looking forward to a great massage AND considering we paid $135 EACH. Big disappointment.

I purchased a special from Axxess for a massage and a floatation pod session for my wife. She thoroughly enjoyed her two hours there. After her massage, we ordered a tasty, healthy green drink from the cafe.
Alchemy is gorgeous inside. They really pamper you there. Go now!

Pretty décor and great staff!

This is a lovely little gem. It's a peaceful place with attention to detail in the general décor. It has a moroccan/indian feel.

I had a travelzoo voucher, and was treated as if I was a regular paying client. YAY! I noticed that each staff member devoted personal attention to each client equally.

I didn't rate this place 5 stars for the following reasons:
  *  It's not a soundproof environment, outside noise (especially during a massage) can be distracting.
  *  The changing area feels cramped if two women are in there at the same time and there is only 1 sink.
  *  The massage room I was in was a little too new-age for me. (I'm Christian)

The café is close quarters but the food is a delight. It's well prepared food with amazing flavors while being fresh and healthy. 

I don't think I'd visit the spa again, I'm a spoiled Los Angeles gal, but I'd definitely go back for the food. I'm not familiar with spas of Santa Barbara, so if you live there it's worth a visit for sure.

I discovered this wonderful destination yesterday- I've traveled far for this this kind of "peace" & "escape". Finding such a lovely space in my area is bliss.
Eye-candy throughout, Emily, the founder & owner has paid every attention to detail, with it's high beams, hanging doors from Bali, colorful tinctures & oils, & playful light.  
Even the towels smell amazing-  The staff was caring & attentive.  Alchemy Arts Center is a must try for Santa Barbara- 
I was famished after a treatment & then napping in the float tank-  I wanted to literally try everything in their cafe.  The kale salad was the BEST salad I've ever had, anywhere!  I can't wait to go back-  Thank you Emily for creating such a magical space for us to enjoy!
Cheers,
Suze

I'm a native Santa Barbarian and I have to say...

Alchemy Cafe is hands down, the healthiest and freshest restaurant in the area! (organic fruit and vegetables bought bi-weekly from the local farmers market).

Very hip and trendy, yet relaxing and zen vibe.

I'd recommend it to anyone!

P.S.

I love the NEW Summer menu!!!! Try the portobello mushroom steak with kale and parsnip mash... was to die for!

This is how superstars do extended lunch, period. Style and class, get you a smoothie, a latte, some salad, lunch just because or get your nails done or get a message or whatever else you fancy all in the same place. I love, love, love this place. Multi tasking never felt so relaxing. You will never think of lunch the same my friends! Step up your game, get it all, settle for nothing less than the best!!

I keep going back because I love the concept behind the place and have been a health foodie for a very long time. I work at the farmers market and appreciate high quality organic places. Like I said, I keep join back hoping that it is going to be better, 'The next time.' All I can say is maybe this time will finally be my last waste of money. Food costs too much for the ingredients and service, also takes forever to make. I even called in the order for juice this morning, so I wouldn't have to wait the extensive amount of time it takes the fully staffed kitchen to blend my drink. I go over there, giving them ten minutes extra of how long they told me it would take to make and its still not made! Then proceeded to have to remake it because of a mistake notices, thank god, by one of the other servers when paying.

Brenda and Kaya are amazing massage therapists. Alchemy is very warm and inviting- very accomodating to large parties and better value than local hotels. Ambiance is above average, also warm and relaxing, especially in the meditation room. Thank you Brenda and Kaya for an a special treat on our family vacation!

I had three meals in this restaurant (breakfast and two lunches) primarily because the food was outstanding the first time I tried it. For breakfast the buckwheat crepes and the frittata are delicious. For lunch the soups, bowls and portabello stake  are filling and superbly seasoned. All ingredients taste fresh and dishes are nicely decorated with edible flowers. Juices and cold coffee are also tasty. Service is friendly and the atmosphere incredibly relaxing.
-1 star for the receptionist that tried to charge me and extra $100 because she doesn't know the prices of the spa. Aside from that everything was great!
Very good food and much healthier than it's vegan neighbor....I frequent this place but the one and only knock with them are the portions, very very small.....I always leave this palce hungry.....

What can I say?  When your first experience as your food arrives is profound gratitude and awe for how obvious it is how much careful,  loving and meticulous attention was applied in the preparation of your meal - you just know you're in for a special treat!  Very clean, nourishing, and incredibly delicious!!!  Service incredible!  Ambience vet gentle, soothing and light.  An experience where you know your entire body/mind/spirit complex is being thoroughly and completely nourished every moment you remain here!  Highly recommend!  So bummed I'm leaving town!

Great vegan cuisine.  Amazing array of flavors coming together.  Many vegetarian restaurants are way too heavy with oil, but this cuisine was light and fresh.  I put it as high as any vegan restaurant I've been too.

This place is a treat! My husband booked me a prenatal massage followed by a foot reflexology treatment and I was beyond satisfied with both. Alexandra was who did my treatment or at least I think that was her name, anyhow she was fabulous! She really took her time and her touch was just right.  
The location is really nice, very zen:-) They have a woman's locker room with complimentary lockers, flip flops, bathrobes, showers, etc.  it's not a huge facility but it has everything it needs. 
The massage rooms have tubs in them too so I imagine they offer a variety of services besides massage. 

After the treatments you can walk down it their cafe where they serve organic 99% vegan menu which is a small menu but everything looked amazing. I had the Nori hand rolls which were delicious.  It was a perfect way to end a relaxing morning. 

This place needs to start a chain and open one in San Diego!

Came here for the food only. It was very expensive. I know you pay for quality food and I'm okay with that. The portions are quite large and that certainly makes you feel better. Not sure what to think about all the drinks/elixirs/potions/etc. I tried one. Can't say whether or not it made a difference. None the less, the staff here is super friendly.

So excited to have finally experienced this local treasure.  Have driven by and thought of trying for what seems like years.  Finally booked a morning full of treatments for myself and my daughter for her 18th birthday.  We both absolutely loved it.  All of our treatments were exceptional.  In addition, it was a joy to book with their help.  The facility is impeccable from cleanliness to decor and I found the prices to be fair.  We can't wait to go back  for more spa as well as try some of the other specialized services they offer.

One of the most amazing, healing, experiences ever. I had the Chi Nei Tsang, massage with Rose. But Massage is such a poor description of what this modality entails. It's so much more powerful, intuitive, life changing. Don't go another day of life without having a Chi Nei Tsang session with Rose.  So powerful was this experience that I, an agnostic, found myself in the most beautiful state of Samadhi.

Years of digestive issues, untwined, and worked out in one session.  If only I lived closer.. Thank you Rose, you are truly talented.

After eating my fair share of BBQ/seafood over the fourth of July weekend, my tummy was extra sensitive and picky to what I was able to eat. After regaining my appetite back I decided to try out Alchemy Arts Cafe for something light and easy. They have an array of fruit and veggie coolers that all sound amazing. I had the Alchemy Cooler made from coconut water, pineapple and basil - so refreshing. My friend and I ordered the quinoa roll and it was just as filling and flavorful as your typical sushi roll. It tasted even better in the fact that there wasn't a ton of rice but lots of crunchy veggies and the nori seaweed was just the right amount of saltiness to balance the roll out. My friend had the Cucumber Avocado Gazpacho, a raw soup with huge portions. I could eat that everyday. I had the Mung Bean Glass Noodles - tamarind wasn't too spicy, just the right amount of seasoning for the noodles, loved the veggies - lots of green happiness on a plate. Speaking of plates - their dishware is beautiful. The space is beautiful - I call it Restoration Hardware meets modern India - that probably doesn't make any sense, but it does to me! I felt calm, happy and a content fullness when I left. Go treat yourself!

Heaven on earth 
So peaceful & tranquil & amazing 
LOVE
Very relaxing and rejuvenating experience.  Zoe was incredible (thank you!) The cafe is bright and cozy, with terrific high quality organic vegetarian food.  Thank you!

I love this type of food and am an avid raw vegan chef at home and for friends so I was excited to support and also try the cafe at Alchemy, but this place is NOT worth the money they are charging.  I'm shocked it has 5 stars by anyone? The negative reviews I'm reading match my experience much better, so I'm wondering if the good reviews are just for the spa or maybe people who are friends with those that work there?  Anyways, the atmosphere was great, the place is truly zen and beautiful, but that's about it.  While our server was lovely, our food took a long time and we pretty much never got our check even after two reminders. They serve room temperature tap water in these teeny tiny glasses, so it was hard to feel hydrated (plus at room temp you to taste the impurities in water more). Their "juices" are made in a blender so they are between 50-90% thick foam.  It was terrible and I felt forced to drink it to get my money's worth. For the exorbitant fees, I was expecting precision cooking and elegant presentations, but the flavors were far from that and the presentation was lacking.  I felt like I was eating something my friend whipped up quickly and all the sauces we got had the same flavor notes. We got the cabbage rolls (probably the best thing) and the zucchini pasta with hummus and tahini.  While everything was good, I was mostly just eating because I was hungry, not because the flavors beckoned me to keep eating.  The zucchini pasta had no presentation whatsoever and the sauce that came on it was thin with gritty bits of garbanzo and cashew, it was not sumptuous and the basil was just sort of torn into the bowl and mixed around (didn't affect flavor, but for $15 I expect something cut more nicely!).  I have no desire to go back here, but I might just to give it another chance.  I really don't want to spend the money because I regularly make fancier raw food and juices at home.  Sigh, I just want one good vegan restaurant!

Awesome place.
chilling atmosphere, vitalizing smoothies and great food.
Everthing tastes so healthy and you just feel good, eating it. 
Staff is very friendly and the food was served pretty quick.

We Had an amazing massage, an isotonic float in warm water, and a beautiful lunch on a Friday afternoon. The food was over-the-top scrumptious. No other restaurant has food like this in Santa Barbara. We shared an amazing bottle of wine--and they only have fine wines.... Alchemy arts is a great way kick off your weekend

My girlfriends and I purchased a recent Travelzoo deal here for a one hour massage, soak in the flotation isopod, and lunch. For the price we paid, I'd say it was a great deal, but compared to other spa experiences I have had, I feel that this place is disorganized and just average.

Massage was alright. The lights were left on in the room the entire time and the room was on a busy street so it wasn't very relaxing. 

I enjoyed the isopod experience, but I do not think it is for everyone. They advertise it as a soundproof tank, however, with the door completely closed I could hear people walking down the hall and doors creaking/closing. Somehow the cleaning/jet cycle got turned on when two of my girlfriends were in the tub so that was a bit of a scary experience for them! Another awkward thing is you have to walk past the front desk and people eating at the restaurant in your robe to get to the isopod room. 

The food at the restaurant was really wonderful, nutritious, and presented well, but very slow service. We had to ask for food items repeatedly. 

I'd go back for the food, but not the spa experience.

For clean, healthy food that is tasty, this place is great. Fresh produce and a friendly staff make it enjoyable. Make sure you are not in a hurry, though. I like the spice burgers and Alchemy Salad. They also accommodate requests if you have food allergies like I do. Jose, one of the chefs, is a doll!

This review is on the cafe, not the spa. Stopped by here while waiting for my car to get detailed and ordered a Al-Chacinno coffee. The coffee was made quickly, tasted fresh, and was ice cold. Loved it and will recommend this place to friends. 

The atmosphere and decor has Morrocan feel and the stafd is friendly.

First time here today and so far I love it! I had some of the elixirs at the cafe. I would've had more , but I had already eaten. I had the green elixir and the detox elixir. $2 each for a shot. Then I decided to check out the spa area. After the receptionist showed me the set up of the Floatation Isopod/epson salt water tank. I decided to give it a try. I would have preferred slightly warmer water, and I had a little trouble getting the lights off inside the tank, but I felt amazing afterwards! Don't worry if you feel a tad restless in the isopod or like not much is happening. Just try to relax. When you get out you will feel amazing! It relieves so much tension. I went in feeling yucky, & crampy with that time of the month and came out tension free. ps...you will get your hair wet even with a cap. They have shampoo and conditioner but if you need hair products for after, bring them. I will definitely do it again, and go back to the cafe soon! Hopefully, try some of the other treatments as well.

Great lunch. Unique, fresh and tasty menu. Took my vegan friend from out of town to lunch here. She was happy with lots of options to choose from. Service was friendly. Maybe a tad slow. But great overall experience.

I would highly recommend Danielle for facials to everyone I know. She did a phenomenal job and I came out looking much younger. The entire experience was fabulous from the front counter to the beautiful environment. Great job all thank you very much.

This review is for the spa. I enjoyed an absolutely fantastic facial and prenatal massage here recently. The staff were really warm and pleasant overall. I highly recommend booking evening treatments. There was just something about the energy that was really soothing. The space is super cozy and quiet, beautifully decorated and furnished with nice amenities and textiles. My facial was very relaxing and I love the DNA products that were used. My massage was in an airy and bright room with an open window and it was nice to see the light change and the sun go down. The masseuse was a young mother herself and I could really feel her intention in helping me relax and enjoy. I can't wait to return.

Good, healthy choices. A little pricey. I had the kitchari and kombucha and it came to $28 with tax and tip. The strawberry smoothie it so good. I love the people and atmosphere. A couple of the folks in my lunch group said they wouldn't come back because the price and the portions were small.
Beautiful! I enjoy coming here, the ambiance is very soothing and the food is exceptional. I drive from Ventura to have lunch here. Thank you AAcafe for a great job.

We really liked it their until  now. A few days ago we went to an event their  and purchased some items after bringing home they were expired  and rancid. Since we left the premises their is no exchange policy so we are screwed. I can't believe an establishment can or does this type of horrible service.. HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE
I came back for a second time, my experience here is always amazing..... My go to Spa now, the service and food are excellent

I am giving this place three stars because while the food was delicious, the waiter tried to scam us into ordering more than what we actually wanted. It was ridiculous.

The majority of the menu was vegan, which is always nice. The Ayurvedic Elixir was the BEST!!! Would come back in a heart beat just to have that drink again. My boyfriend and I then split the half salad half soup. We chose the the Rainbow Kale salad, which was some of the freshest, moist kale I've ever eaten. It was quite good. We chose a special shiitake soup, which was also quite delicious.

However, the problem arose when we ordered. We like to share meals because it's cheaper, and you leave just as full. So when we clearly explained to the waiter that we wanted to split a the soup/salad combo he tried to reiterate our choices quickly and say we wanted a soup and two side salads. We agreed because we thought maybe he meant he would split the half salad, and give us each 1/4. He didn't. A few minutes later my boyfriend went up and clearly pointed to our choice on the menu, saying that we only wanted the $12 option that included HALF OF ONE SALAD, AND HALF OF ONE SOUP. He then tried to explain that getting two side salads for $12, plus a full bowl of soup for $9 would be cheaper than 2 half salad/soup combos. Well, yeah, because the latter is two meals! Clearly not what we ordered. He said he would change our order, but it was weird and awkward after that. Just bad service, that genuinely felt like a scam.

Overall, I'd come back for the good food, but MAKE SURE you clearly say what you want, and the waiter understands.

Gorgeous setting for treatments and a cup of tea ~ if you've never tried a float tank before, I highly recommend it! Great way to meditate and relax. I was particularly impressed, however, with the lovely, heart-centered service. When I needed a place to nurse and change my infant I was beyond accommodated and made to feel very welcome. What a lovely experience!

Thought it would be a good idea to book a massage for my boyfriend and I during our recent trip to Santa Barbara. Ever since our amazing spa experience at the Palazzo in Vegas, we're always looking for spas that offer more services or amenities other than massages. Apparently these places are hard to come by, so we were lucky enough to stumble upon Alchemy, who provides hydrating spa services as well! 

Signed up for massages and a therapeutic soak, both of which were extremely relaxing. I highly recommend Ty for your massage therapist. My boyfriend was a little disappointed to find out he didn't get the warm towels placed under his neck and around his feet like I did. 

If you're looking for that extra spa experience, I highly recommend paying a little extra for that therapeutic soak. Super relaxing. The lady that rang us up even gave us a first timer discount I think.

The only thing about my experience at Alchemy that was not up to par with me was the locker rooms. While I understand they are not trying to market themselves as a full on spa with full amenities, having access to more than one toilet and shower would be nice. And for all my shy guys and gals out there, there isn't an area sectioned off for you to change into and out of your robes in there. You'd have to wait for the bathroom or the shower area to be available. It also wasn't made clear whether or not the basket with the flip-flops were used. My boyfriend mentioned the basket in the men's locker room had a label that said 'dirty' for those slippers, but there was no label similar to theirs in the women's locker room. I was a little horrified to learn that I may have been wearing dirty/used slippers that had not been washed yet.

4 stars for the experience, 2 stars for the locker room/slipper incident.

I'm not exactly sure what the aim of this cafe. The atmosphere was great, very pleasant with waterfalls to relax you and fill a calming type type of setting. The service was great, very pleasant waitress. Where it starts going down hill is the food. First off they didn't have anything from their menu. It was a 'FIXED' menu at the time we came in. $15 for a soup and salad. Both were very bland. The soup was described as an Indian type soup, but it didn't have any flavor what so ever. The salad looked great, but the ingredients were bland as well. I'm flabbergasted that people are giving it 5 stars...
Absolutely awful service. Delicious but only come in here if you have all day to wait. Ordered soup and bread and waited over 45 minutes before deciding to walk out

The food was amazing!   The people are very sweet and friendly, great energy, beautifully decorated (lots of wood), food really really good.  I have not come across a place like this in a long time.  ...a peaceful, nurturing oasis.

I've been a vegetarian for quite a few years now. I enjoy good healthy meals. However, this particular place is only for those who can handle a joke! This place is seriously out of an SNL skit. And clearly I lack a sense of humor! Stopping by a McDonalds, ordering a bun, some lettuce and tomato, would have provided equal disappointment. But at a fraction of the price and time. Personally, I usually do not enjoy my water served at room temperature and in a shot glass. This is the kind of place that could only exist in California. It's perfect for tourists!

I was in the area looking for food and just stumbled across this place. I'm so glad I did! It's beautiful inside, peaceful and sunny. It's a great place to sit and read while having one of their amazing teas or a french press coffee. I tried the buckwheat pancake with fruit compote and it smelled SO good that the woman at the next table had to ask me what it was so she could order it. It tasted incredible too and was a nice big portion so I was properly full afterwards. The staff are friendly and personable and the smoothies and juices are out of this world good. This is the kind of food that makes you feel great all day! I'm going to be a regular.
Acupucture with Elisa is absolutely amazing! I am seeing incredible results, and love coming to Alchemy for my session! I am addicted to the Kale Salad! Love Love Love Alchemy Arts!
If this place were a woman, she'd be a healthy-hot-positive-artistic-worldly-petite yogi that I'd be totally sprung on. I'd be eating out every night...

I stumbled into the cafe after the day got away from me exploring Santa Barbara.  Had forgotten to eat and was looking for something vegan and wholesome.

Delighted to find this cafe, had their house salad which was amazing, and a huge portion as well as a lemon/ginger elixir.  

Left feeling satisfied, not only would I go back, but would definitely recommend.

Wish I had more time to try out some of the services.

Note: this gets 4 stars after only a couple visits (detailed below) in which I'd actually give 3.5 stars for, but I have hopes I just didn't try everything that would warrant 4 stars or higher. 

I stumbled upon this after eating next door at Adama's vegan restaurant. I was stuffed already but wanted to try a fresh juice at least. I opted for one with strawberries, mint, and I think pineapple juice. Was pretty tasty. 

The menu was exciting: organic, mostly vegan, clean and pure food. My kind of stuff. So I was eager to return. 

The next day I ordered the Iron Fist drink (wheatgrass, kale, spinach, lettuce, spirulina, pineapple, broccoli, and a couple other greens I think). I expected a fresh pressed or juiced (they had a green star juicer there) beverage but I think they blended part of it. I don't like my juices blended because they oxidize more (so the experts say). Therefore my husband's had about 1/2 of it as foam (mine about 1/3 foam) which, again, I don't care for. Not cool since it's over 10 bucks (each) and couldn't even drink it all. The non-foam part tasted fine as far as taste goes (it's green in flavor but I expected that). 

Also ordered nori rolls for husband and he liked but would've preferred a spicier sauce, maybe with wasabi in it. I had the kale salad minus parmesan and wasn't thrilled but ate it anyway because I know it's healthy. I love massaged kale salads but this one was on the bitter side and could've used more flavor or something to tone down the bitter. It had avocado in it but not enough in my opinion. I think they should've added more avo for mine since I left the parm off (I'm presuming the parm helped the overall flavor).

I love the atmosphere and have hopes that other items would be better. They had a few things I wanted to try in my short stay in Santa Barbara, but honestly, I opted for Adama's again because it's a sure thing. Next time I'm in town though, I'll give this place another try. 

The service was fine although takes a little a little long.

Delicious and healthy. Friendly server. Sampled tonics, tea, eggs, hummus, butternut squash soup, spring rolls, frittata, veggie juice, buckwheat crepes and Greek yogurt bowl. All were excellent. There were 6 of us!

This review is for the spa. I enjoyed an absolutely fantastic facial and prenatal massage here recently. The staff were really warm and pleasant overall. I highly recommend booking evening treatments (they are open until 8 on a Saturday!). There was just something about the energy that was really soothing. The space is super cozy and quiet, beautifully decorated and furnished with nice amenities and textiles. My facial was very relaxing and I love the DNA products that were used. My massage was in an airy and bright room with an open window and it was nice to see the light change and the sun go down. The masseuse was a young mother herself and I could really feel her intention in helping me relax and enjoy. I can't wait to return.

There's something kind of missing with this place. 

On the surface, it seems warm and interesting and the people certainly seem pretty friendly and it appears very clean .But something is just...off. 

I know their selections change frequently, but the few times I've been here, the menus have been really a mashup of stuff that doesn't go well together or that is very heavy on one or two faddish ingredients without enough variety.

I also felt like, for a place that is supposedly healthy and super natural, they had a LOT of foods that were prepared with honey and other types of sugar. It seemed like they were touting these foods as low carb, which....isn't the case. 

I got a massage here and that was a bit off, too. The person seemed rushed and kept stopping and looking at either her phone or a clock, I can't be sure because I kept my eyes closed. It was very distracting. 

Bottom line: Seems to be all talk and no delivery with this place. Beautiful, healthful and tranquil seeming in decor and in theory, but not quite up to it's own description in reality.

With the closure of Adama Vegan in November 2014 (located next door to Alchemy), Alchemy now becomes the best game in town for vegan/vegetarian food. 

This is a bright, friendly, cozy spot with an unusual and thoughtful menu.

That said, it's expensive and not fully vegan, which made navigating the menu a bit of a hassle.

I had a cordyceps latte ($6) which was a tasty drink---it's powdered mushroom with a bunch of spices and other ingredients. For $6 it's pricey, but it's hard to find drinks like this pretty much anywhere, so I applaud Alchemy for taking risks.

I had the ayurvedic spice burgers for my main dish ($14). The burgers are small round patties that mixed well with the citrus-fennel salad they sat upon. While this dish was tasty and creative, at $14 I still felt hungry. Again, kudos for the creativity, but deep sixes for the price.

For dessert I had a lemon delight pudding ($6). This was a bright yellow soup, basically---the menu describes it has having a "pinch" of turmeric, but it seemed more like a massive load of it, given the neon-yellow color. It was supposed to be a pudding, but the consistency was that of a liquid; they should have used a thick coconut cream, added more thickener (more cashews?) and maybe chilled it longer. While it tasted good, the color and texture were off-putting.

The service was friendly, fast and informative. 

I like Alchemy, but it has room to improve on pricing, portion size and preparation.

Sally Spork (local SB foodie) reviews Alchemy 

Atmosphere: located off the beaten path on Chapala, the sign for the place is large however it's very unassuming, meaning you wouldn't know what is in there until you venture in. I was taken back at the large. airiness of the space and the abundant light. Love that. Rustic tables and chairs scattered throughout and wooden lattice work on the walls giving a Morroccan-isque feel. Also there are shelves with loads of skin products. Hmm.The bathroom is gorgeous and features a shower as well. 

Service: We sat ourselves and the waitress came and gave us menus and water quickly. While it took a bit to get our food, she did come in and check in on us, however forgot the dessert we ordered.

Food/drink: We ordered 2 smoothies that were delish and served in glass bottles. Also a salad and some veggie rolls. They both were tasty, however I have to say as there was no protein (besides my smoothie) I didn't find myself very satiated.

Summary: Alchemy is a beautiful, unique space. To be honest I'm not sure what all goes on there: my friend used to teach yoga there, do they offer classes? Spa treatments? Not sure. Would I go back? I wish I could give a half star to this rating. I do like the space itself, and perhaps go back for a cup of tea.

The food here is good if you want a fresh, raw healthy meal. But be prepared to wait a long time and tolerate an ineffiecient, goofy wait staff. Also, the original innovative chef is no longer there (!) so it's basically a food prep guy trying to emulate someone who is long gone...the owner has a good thing going and I think we will start seeing alot of these wellness places popping up ~  let's hope management trains her people better and they learn how to run a good kitchen...it's a joke at present.

This Place is awsome, I got the Travel Zoo deal it was well worth it, I got a Swedish Massage, ISO Pod.... If you get a massage I recommend Jessica she's amazing a really nice person and very knowledgeable.  The food was amazing lots of different flavors and textures, very healthy.  They also had fresh juice/ veg that came in Mason jars excellent,  I highly recommend the Spa, I will be returning very soon. Ohh also State St is within walking distance after your treatment take a nice stroll along State St

I just love,love,love the food at Alchemy Arts Cafe. Everything the uber talented Chef Kai creates has a bit of a Asian flair. ( Must be the 5 years he spent as head chef at a wellness center in Thailand ). It's so fresh and light and his seasoning is perfection, and the portions are really generous so I always leave fully satisfied. 
I have done a 2 week cleanse with them so I know the entire menu and them some. My favorite things for breakfast are the Bircher Muesli, and Quinoa Conchee. Lunch and dinner fav's are Raw Pad Tai, Mung Bean Glass Noodle, and Vegetable Curry....ALL the smoothies are incredible but the Alchemy Cooler is addicting.
As delicious as the food is, it's the environment of the Cafe that keep's me going about 2-3 times a week. It's so cozy to either sit alone, or go with a group of friends. I can't imagine life in Santa Barbara could have improved but with Alchemy Center Cafe it's perfect !!!!!

Had lunch at the Cafe.  The food was amazing!!!  The Alchemy Arts Center is a very unique place.  I toured the spa and yoga rooms - they were beautiful.  I dream about this place and can't wait to come back.

Being a total food snob (and a non-vegan) I recluctantly but open-mindedly tried this cafe. The food is very very good and finally, a restaurant where I can get truly healthy, wholesome food without additives. My digestive system is very grateful to the person bright and capable enough to create and open this kind of eatery. 
The ambiance is also charming and hip. One bit of advice to the owner: please educate your wait staff-they are very nice but need training in ingredients and customer interaction. Thank you!

Alchemy is truly an urban oasis. Their menu of services is extensive, while offering services not found anywhere else in Santa Barbara. Being a frequent spa visitor, at spas all over the world, I continue to be beyond thrilled this gem is blocks from my house. 

Not only do they offer an amazing array of services, their restaurant (all vegan) and fresh juices are all delicious and refreshing.
Float!!  Great customer service, top notch. The tank isn't the best but WOW what an experience!

I am so excited to have found this place- such a hidden treasure in downtown SB. I had heard about their vegetarian cafe as well as a juice and elixer menu... I had their coconut almond coffee- homemade almond milk sweetened with dates! and the low-acid coffee- so good, I dare say I may be hooked.... I ordered the kale salad :). My friend got the green soup and a b-shot.. All the food felt really clean, delicious and I appreciated that it was local and organic- makes a difference.

The atmosphere is beautiful- really unique.. We felt like we had been transported to another destination- far away form busy downtown.. I checked out the spa- really beautiful as well. I think its so special that they offer yoga, spa services, energy work and acupuncture in one place! I liked that they had a Far Infared Sauna as well- my friends have been raving about them- very detoxifying. 

On our way out we grabbed a raw almond butter goji ball and a coconut macaroon... Perfection!!

Can't wait to come back- I'm telling everyone :)

Alchemy has such a great vibe. The services are unparalleled, and I love that you can just go and spend a whole day there. Start off with some yoga, grab a vegetarian bite at their cafe, head in for a facial or cranio sacral treatment, and end with a massage or a end with a "float" in the sensory deprivation chamber.

If you happen to find yourself leaving a nightclub in the wee hours of the night in Santa Barbara and are feeling abit hungry, do yourself a favor, head to Blue Owl and get a delicious sandwich from their menu. You cannot possibly go wrong with anything in this place, ask for Cindy and ask her to make it super special for you, trust me! :)
The Bahn Mi with beef, Thai Basil burger, and fried rice are delicious. This is my favorite restaurant in Santa Barbara!

These people rock! Get the wake n'bacon!!! Or the turkey thyme. And go for the excellent customer service!!! They were very kind and gracious to us, even with our more more complicated order. (Hence the 5 stars) I will be going here every time I am in the area
The salads are amazing! The sandwiches are delicious and really indulgent, with super flavorful mayo and cheese and pickled veggies...Splitting a sandwich and salad with a friend is perfect.

All about the peanut butter burger! ..and it's not like they marinate it in PB or something, they don't even use PB somehow the burger as a whole just taste like PB..

Also suggest the Fried rice with poached Egg!

Granted I have only been here for the late night menu

..because it's basically the best place in SB for late night machines or if your drunk on state, they even got chunks of bread and water waiting to help you with your spins;)

A small hidden treasure in downtown. Pleasant staff, quick service and great food! I had the eggplant sandwich without the cheese and it was still extremely flavorful. Great place for veggie lovers. :-)

It's pretty cool that they serve drunk food here into the late hours, so that is definitely plus...unfortunately, maybe I wasn't drunk enough to fully appreciate it.  

Had the tri-tip sandwich and the fried rice topped with an egg.  The tri tip sandwich was decent, not bad for a late night snack.  The fried rice was another story though, basically a pile of mushy rice with greens and sriracha.  

Having said that, I do appreciate that they're open super late and if I was drunk and hungry, I'd stop in again to grab a bite.

This venue has good sandwiches, is in a good location.  Counter ordering and very casual dining.

The artwork (for sale) is in an unusual format and doesn't do much for your appetite, however this didn't seem to affect the crowd.

I'd give it a C

This is my favorite lunch spot! I always get the BLTA and have never been disappointed. The baguette it is made with is perfection. My husband loves the blue beef sandwich. The night menu looks super yummy, however, we are never up late/early enough...someday I've got to try the peanut butter burger. You will not be disappointed. We go there frequently and it is perfect every time!

My wife and I stopped in here because of the good reviews we read on yelp. Yelp did NOT let us down. The staff was very friendly and even remembered my name when we left. It's not very big inside but it only adds to its cute one of a kind atmosphere. I had the egg sandwich and subbed the meat for the eggplant salad to make it vegetarian and no joke it was the best breakfast sandwich I have ever had! So good I may have went back and ordered a second one before I left. Highly recommend this place and will absolutely return.

Best late night food in Santa Barbara! We went there last night and tried everything on the menu there was nothing I didn't like, I would recommend it to everyone and anyone go there when you're craving delicious food after 11:30 PM at night! You won't be disappointed!!
The food and service is amazing. We had the basil burger and the peanut butter butter burger for dessert and both were the best things in the world. Also, the beers are solid.

Pork Bahn Mi is wonderful. Too many nasty people hover at the entrance smoking. Can't stand be trapped in a small restaurant filled with cigarette smoke. Owner should really take care of the issue....
The shrimp sandwich is insanely good, and the location is perfect for a late night snack. Not to mention, the staff is cool and very helpful.

I've always loved the blue owl and most things about it. Last night, I had friends in town and we decided to walk the downtown area and stuff. Afterwards, I took them into the owl and I was pleasantly shocked with everything that is now different about it. Between the renovations that have been made and the new dinner menu that has been rolled out, this place deserves a ten! I had the chicken and biscuits, and my friends had pork bohn mi and hand pulled noodles and every bite of every dish was delicious!! 
I'd highly reccomend this place for either lunch, dinner or late night food!
Also, they now serve beer which is also a plus
This place is a godsend when the bars close. It's like an oasis of deliciousness when you're in a drunken desert.

We stopped by for lunch yesterday and once again asked ourselves, "Why don't we come here more often?". We both had the spectacular banh mi sandwiches. The bread was excellent, the beef was savory and the overall spiciness hit the spot. We love the friendly atmosphere and know what a gem The Blue Owl is. Provecho!
What a wonderful find! The kale salad was extremely fresh with flavorful dressing.  The beef Bahn Mi was the best we ever had, explosion of flavors, and very crunchy bread.  Excellent!

Try the Pork Baha Mi! The Chefs wife described it accurately.. It's amazing, like love in your mouth!!" Stopped by here after seeing CRB at the Lorbero Theater. Great service, nice people, open Til 2:30am, quick and delicious!!!! Looking forward to my next visit.

I don't like the term "asian fusion".  Sounds dynamic in an 80s-90s sort of way, like shortening '"cellular phone" to "cell".  Asian-inspired maybe? Asian-American?  Anyway, the savory, home-made vibe was great.  Their take on banh-mi with freshly baked bread and pork belly blew my Rainbow sandals off.  The service was so helpful without being solicitous.  Like they really, really wanted you to enjoy their food.  And we did.  Can't wait to come back.
The Thai Basil Burger comes with cheese, despite not saying so on the menu.

Stopped in on our way home from vacation and after eating here I wish I lived closer. Yum! The turkey sandwich was amazing and the bahn mi to die for. We also had the fried rice which was really good but we felt needed more soy sauce or something a little dry nothing we couldn't have asked for... We will definitely come back next time on our way to the central coast absolutely delicious they are doing an amazing job!

This spot is one of very few places for late night food, so it's always packed after the bars close. Any food is usually better than no food after a late night of drinking, but I'm gonna review the food anyway. I've gotten the fried rice many times and the tri-tip is not worth it. It's chewy and the fried rice is usually mushy, but the flavors have always been good (can't go wrong with fresh cilantro). Last night it was packed and I was the second out of my group of friends to order. There were five or six of us and everyone got their food before I did. My friend asked about my food about halfway through when everyone else was eating theirs and they told him a big batch of food was coming out. Several other people continued to get their food, my friends finished theirs, so I went up to ask about mine and was pretty set on just getting my money back. When I inquired about my food and told the girl at the counter that I all of my friends got their food, finished it and I still hadn't gotten mine, she says, she didn't work in the back so it wasn't her problem...Excuse me?! You work here! Of course it's your problem. She continued to be rude to me and I simply got my money back. My friend tried to politely argue with them (I'm not kidding, he's a super nice guy), but they refused to do anything but let him buy my food again. I'm giving one star not because my food took a long time, but because they were so rude about it. I understand dealing with a bunch of drunk people late at night is not fun, but that isn't an excuse for poor customer service. I will never be spending money there again, day or night.
Great late night restaurant in Santa Barbara. Stays open really late (if not all night). Lots of delicious food opens including basil burgers, grilled cheese, banh mi, and more.

Visited for a late dinner. The menu is modest in size, as is the restaurant itself. We ordered the fried rice with tri tip and the Thai basil burger. Both were very flavorful. The fried rice portion was quite large, not easy for one person to finish.  I would definitely go back.
Fking amazing. Looks simple but the bread, the goodness, the magic is undeniably 5-stars. Had the egg sandwich. I recommend.
Love blue owl, such flavorful food. They are also very accommodating and helpful and offer great suggestions. Also love the new extended space. You won't be disappointed!

Yuuuum!
Reminds me of being in a city n getting amazingly bomb food in a tiny little dive. Try anything here!

The customer service here is unparalleled. I felt awful before I came. My stomach hurt and I had a long morning. The ladies here were so patient and nice. They help me decide what to eat, and even provided a comfortable shirt  at a great price. I can't rave enough about the customer service and the food, drink and clothing. This place needs to grow and come closer to my home in O.C.

Delicious Thai food. We discovered this little place when visiting Santa Barbara, we walked in and were seated immediately. This was lucky as it is fairly small and it filled up quickly soon after we arrived. We ordered the veggie red curry and the zen noodles. The food came out quickly. The red curry flavor was very tasty and included lots of veggies and tofu. The noodles were also fantastic, my two year old finished off more then half the plate!
I sprayed ketchup all over my shirt, and I'd do it all over again.  Best carnitas torta. Also had a bite of the eggplant sandwich and it was amazing. The bread, oh the bread, just so delicious.

These are some of the tastiest sandwiches available in Santa Barbara; and if you want something sustainable, organic, and local, this is the place to get it. The staff was very friendly, and they are able to do so much within the little space they have.

I have a check in here, but I have no recollection of being here. I was blacked out in Santa Barbara for a few days (reliving the glory days), and I'm sure I was hungry at some point. All I know is that I didn't wake up in jail, I have all of my teeth, and I'm not in the hospital. I'm sure the food here was good, but I couldn't tell ya. Cheers! 'TIL WE MEET AGAIN!
Late night Bahn Mi was the BOMB!  Much faster than other late night orders.  Would definitely come here again and get the same thing.  Highly recommended!

A little restaurant off the beaten path located on Canon Perdido with the weirdest hours. But don't let the size fool you - it's filled with LOTS of flavor. I'm currently obsessed with the fried rice. You can only get it Friday and Saturday nights off their late night menu from 8pm-2am. It's a little something to look forward to all week! The staff is friendly and down to earth. There is also some interesting artwork inside that awaits.

Perfect lunch spot (I'm not much of a night owl).  The food is made with care, and the salads are transcendant.  I'm vegetarian, but even the meat items look good.  They make their own bread and the eggplant sandwich is fabulous.

Their bahn mi is my favorite late night treat to myself on the weekends, whether I'm getting off work at midnight or need a bite while going out with friends. The staff is good humored and sweet with fast delivery time and that sandwich is AMAZING. Thank you Blue Owl!!!!!!

BAHN MI & TURKEY THYME...I MEAN COME ONNNNNNN!

I could eat Blue Owl everyday of my life. Their food is JUST SUPERB, so well put together, with such an eclectic menu! There is something for everyone. I love their Turkey Thyme sandwich, warm focaccia bread, and roasted turkey, with thyme mayo, arugula. Perfect with a thai iced tea, or rosemary lemonade.

And don't forget their desserts! They have an amazing brown sugar short bread cookie something or other, that is to die for. I am seriously going to go over there for lunch today.

First time here. Love that it's open late on Friday & weekends! Service was good. Food came out pretty fast. Thai basil burger did not disappoint! I don't like cheese so I ordered one without it and it was still really flavorful! The grilled sandwich bread it comes with is pretty yummy. My friend ordered the peanut butter burger and said it was good. I will be back!
Everything I've had from Blue Owl has been great. Just found out that they also have gluten-free bread for their amazing sandwiches. The bahn mi sandwich is my favorite!
Eggplant sandwich, fried rice and Cindy. Love them all. Farmers market fresh and homemade. Foodies will love it here.
Ordered a Thai Basil Cheeseburger, gluten free vegan fried rice and a beet salad. Food was real good and the staff was friendly.

The name "The Blue Owl" is no give-away to the type of cuisine the serve....so I'll tell you.  It is an awesome Hipster American-Asian Fusion!! Crazy hours, but it always has a steady customer flow.  Try it out and you'll soon be going back to try the rest of their menu.
I just like the vibe this place gives off. The pork wasn't the best and Korean chicken wings just tasted like American Barbecue but nice place with fun fusion in general
This place is awesome! We all had the Bahn Mi and it was SOOOO good! It is tiny, so go a little early to grab a table for lunch. I can't wait to go back to try other sandwiches.

Was driving through and Yelped this place. It had great reviews so we stopped by. Lunch was DELICIOUS! I'm so happy to have found this little gem. Really fun ingredients in unexpected combinations. It's a tiny place and you mostly sit right next to strangers but we like that.

When I first moved here, Blue Owl was chilling in Zen Yai Thai. My bf noticed the Blue Owl sign and that it was open late. After checking on yelp, we were really excited about giving this place a try.

Our first opportunity was New Year's Eve when a friend was visiting (in the Zen Yai location). He got the Thai Basil Burger, my friend got the dessert special (I think it was a crepe at the time) and I got the Fried Rice with Tri Tip. 

Holy cow, this place is GOOD! The cheeseburger had so many flavors that may not seem to work at first thought, but melded together very well. The fried rice was delicious, even without the additional tri tip. However, the tri tip was excellent. My friend really enjoyed her dessert as well. 

After this, the bf and I were just waiting for a chance to try it again. Luckily not too long ago, another friend came up late, which meant, just in time for another Blue Owl trip.

This time I got the Tri Tip while the boys got the burger. I have to say it again... DE.LI.CIOUS...

Since then, they have relocated to Canon Perdido. Initially they were only open for breakfast, which I will try one of these days. But, they recently have reopened their late night dining. WOO HOO!! Looking forward to another excuse to come back.

My only complaint about the Blue Owl is that it made me feel like a fatty because I ate all of my lunch and then half of my boyfriend's lunch, too. Ordering is quick and painless, at the counter. When we came at prime lunching time on a Friday, our order took less than 10 minutes to arrive. Staff were friendly and there was someone selling artisan bread, which I was eyeing.

We got their housemade soda, which was a really great and not overly sweet concoction that even a non-soda-drinker could appreciate. 

Then came the goods. I got the banh mi sandwich. Since it was lunch, I thought that only the roast beef one was available, but the cashier gave me the option of trying the spicy pork one (normally only available at dinner/late). It was incredible - the pork was spicy but not burning, veggies were a great texture contrast, amazing bread, and love that aioli stuff. Since I'm an incorrigible glutton and my boyfriend doesn't like eggs, I stole the poached egg that came with his wake-n-bacon and put it on my banh mi, which therefore was EXTRA delicious and I think they should make that option widely available.

Back to my bf's wake-n-bacon, he basically only ate the bacon and the parts of the waffle that didn't touch the creme brulee (how COULD he? That was the best part!). So then it came down to me to be the responsible one and finish his meal, too. Which I did. Who thinks of using the waffle as an edible container for creme brulee? The Blue Owl, those geniuses. I'm still in awe.

If I ever stay longer in Santa Barbara, I will be sure to come back for the late night menu.

Their Crab Melt is to die for!
It's my best friend's and my favorite spot for breakfast when we are out and about downtown. Customer service is great too :)

I love this place.  The fried rice is my favorite with poached egg and sprouts it is AMAZING.  The shrimp role is also a must try, perfectly seasoned shrimp and fried tofu with a kick on a cibatta roll. The only downside for me is that I have to wait for them to open at 11pm...but that's no longer an issue since they've started opening at 8 pm Fri/Sat
Apart from the long line, this place is amazball good. Fried rice FTW. Their Thai basil burger is also freakin amazing.
So amazing and tasty!!!!! The best late night food hands down!!! Thai inspired! Love the fried rice and steak and shrimp sandwiches the best!

Came here because of the good yelp reviews and was very happy with our meal. We asked for their recommendations and was immediately suggested their pork banh mi. It's their most popular item.  I'm a huge fan of vietnamese banh mi and was pretty skeptical about trying the Americanized version, but ordered that plus the Turkey thyme.

Though it tasted nothing like an original banh mi, it was delicious!! I preferred this sandwich over the turkey thyme, though I thought both were very good. The oyster sauce flavored the tender pork just so, it was sweet, juicy and delicious. The cilantro and herbs made the sandwich light and refreshing.

Turkey thyme was amazing as well. My husband liked this one best.  The focaccia bread made the sandwich. Good bread = good sandwich! 

Hope to try the Wake B Bacon next time we're in town.

*Something to improve upon, the serving of side of chips. Very small and not very tasty.  To each their own, I didn't care for them but my husband seemed to enjoy it.

Another place I love to come after late night studies during college. And a place I eat every time I visit SB.

My favorite is a tie between the Bahn Mi Sandwich and their fried rice with poached egg.

If it's you're first time here, GET BOTH!!!!!

During the late nights I use to go, beyond the food, my favorite memories are the staff. Extremely funny and very welcoming.

My relationship with the Blue Owl is a little Ladyhawk stylee - we can't seem to meet up at the same time. But those few times it works out there's an instant connection between the delicious food and my tummy. We were meant to be together.

The dishes remind me of cool eats in Portland: innovative comfort food that's fresh and vibrant. It tastes great, is creative and fun, and is locally sourced.

The owner, Cindy, wears the crown for SB pop-up mistress. The first time I tried her food was a true pop-up, I can't even say where, but word got sent around, we showed up, we paid cash, and we were happy. No, it wasn't at Zen Yai, but I've had her food there too and it was perfect late night nosh for the post club crowd rolling out onto the streets in search of nibbles and water. Porducken, all the way.

This gal is also involved with the supper club scene, pairing up with good people and making good food that's affordable, approachable and very delicious. Again, not hugely advertised, and probably not a viable option for out-of-towners, but this is more to cite another example of her commitment to good food and building community. And if the supper club menu involves local uni, I'm a fan.

I'm still working my way through the Blue Owl's menu, but friends who eat at the Blue Owl more often claim the whole menu as being good. I've had the Wake n' Bacon and yes, it's awesome. Custardy waffle crusted with burnt sugar, sandwiching a poached egg and crispy bacon, yolk oozing out onto the plate with the first stab. 
I've also had the crabmelt, which is great for those seeking something more savory. Or try the savory scones. Or the lemon verbena cookies. And definitely try the house-made sodas, or the Thai iced tea. 

Update: I went back, with friends, and got the duck croissant, berry and basil sodas, and the salami sandwich (WINNER). 

This is honest food crack, and I'm hooked.

If you're hungry and near The Blue Owl, don't hesitate to go here!  My wife and I stopped in here for a quick lunch after some shopping in Santa Barbara.  This local eatery delivered two delicious homemade sandwiches in a quirky, no-frills environment.

There are two menus: one for lunch and one for late(ish)-night.  We ordered the pork Bahn Mi and the Bleu Beef sandwiches off the lunch menu.  Both were delivered piping hot and smelled of heaven.  The Bleu Beef had the perfect mix of sharp stilton and tender beef served on a perfect focaccia.  However, we both thought the Bahn Mi was even better.  The Blue Owl uses a great blend of cabbage and spices to accent the pork in the sandwich.  I wish I had room for a second serving!

There's no reason to look around.  The food is the star here.  However, if you get a chance, you'll notice some funny paintings and appropriately tacky owl statues.  It adds the perfect amount of charm to this little place.

Bottom line: You should eat here.  Come hungry and leave happy.

Creme Brule waffle with bacon and poached egg. Amazing! 
Pay close attention to their hours - they close for a few hours during the day.
Great food and friendly staff. Excellent

Definitely not 4.5 stars. Deceptive for the price, not to mention our food was served in tin foil and a paper carton. My bahn mi was OK  but tasted like a $5 sandwich, not $11!! Have no idea how this place has a one $ symbol. Should be $$. Bf had fried rice. Said it was nothing special, not worth $13. Other than that it's open late and it looks like a chill hangout but I wouldn't go solely for the food.

I like The Blue Owl. A decent spot for nocturnal people to eat at last. (Although I just discovered it's been open for over a year! New to me, anyway.) Just had a yummy red curry shrimp and tofu sandwich. I forgot my anxiety about possible radiation contamination and cast my vegetarian/vegan aspirations aside, because I was overcome by the good smells emanating from the kitchen and of course because I was faint with hunger by the time I got there. They're open until 2am. No pretentions, just good, fresh food.
Badass fried rice w/ poached egg!  Both the pork and tri-tip was delicious and portions were good.  Can't wait to try the banhmi next time!

Food so good it upsets me that most of it is waisted on drunk people.  Let me first say that they support the late night drinkers by supplying bread and water upon entrance...nice touch!  The menu is separate for day and night food.  Day time visitors miss out on the fired rice.  We ordered the Breakfast crab-melt, an egg sandwich with plenty of crab with an obvious but pleasant seafood taste.  Next, we had the pork and tri-tip bahn mi. Although tri-tip always sounds like the obvious choice, do yourself a favor and go with the pork.  The pork is very tasteful and is complemented well by the soft, yet perfectly crusty French bread.  I couldn't imagine anything on this menu going wrong.  Well done!
After a night of drinking and dancing we decided to go since they are open late. I got the thai basil burger and my husband got the fried rice. Both were surprisingly good. Really good.

I love The Blue Owl!!  I mostly go here Late Night and grub down on the Porducken and the Fried Rice... SO SO SO good. I recently tried the shrimp roll and it was to die for- it had so much flavor. The inside is very cute and the service is pretty good for having to deal with annoying drunk people during there Late Night service! I highly recommend this spot.

Amazing food at 2 am when you walk (well, "stumble" is probably more accurate) out of the bars on State street. At night the menu is perfect, I usually get the poached egg fried rice/spring salad and a tri-tip sandwich. Both are excellent, and so is the shrimp roll. My only complaint is that they don't have any of those three items on the lunch menu. The food served at lunch is a little more "eccentric," and I almost get a feeling that they're trying too hard with it. But at night, they go back to their classics and absolutely hit a home run with them.

Wanted to really like this place. But their menu is a bit confusing and complicated. There's a special menu for weekends/evening and a separate menu for daytime weekdays, etc. Everything i wanted to try was on the other menu they didn't serve at the time we were there. So a little frustrating I must say. Anyway, service was so-so. Quick taking orders. But it took about 40-45 mins until serving. It was pretty tasty though, but not sure i'll be coming back.

Sorry for this review but the first impression was not good.
The waitress was not polite and the food tasted strange. Another thing: They should write notes on the menu that everything is served with different types of bred.
So if I order a sandwich, I will not receive a burger. Please.
Maybe it will be better next time.

If you go for lunch order the salad. They are little sleeper items under the big chalkboard menu. One sweet and one savory. Both options are 1. huge and 2. super-tasty. Seasonal, quality ingredients every time. 

The sandwiches are good too, but right now I'm hooked on the salads.Someday maybe I'll make it in to try out the late-night food, but it's one of my top lunch spots to grab something yummy and healthy.
Great food and friendly service. I mean, right?
Great food!  Get the KimCheeser - but everything else is amazing as well.

I was very disappointed... I always order Thai basil beef sandwich and fry rice when I eat here. Last Sat me and my husband went there again and our whole meal was horrible!!! Horrible! I ordered the kimchezzer which was 8 dollars plus tax and what I got was two peace of the grill bread and four slices of kimchi and one peace of the cheese... it's ridiculous! And as usual we ordered fry-rice, the rice was not cooked through so it's really hard!! It's just terrible! We probably won't be back again...

Blue Owl is the Santa Barbara late night scene.  Cyndy Black is a bad ass chef providing us with delicious sustenance.  I always have the fried rice with tri-tip and an egg, I love it so much I order it again and again.

I waited in line for twenty minutes only to be told I had to move to another line. I come here three nights a week and I don't appreciate the lack of customer service. The food here is amazingly, but the service is severely subpar. The food is very good and unique, but customer service is terrible

One of my friends recomended this place!!! They have really great food and reasonable price. The staff was really friendly and gave great suggestions. My boyfriend and I got the vegetarian coconut curry with tomato basil grilled cheese. The food was amazing and they served us salad on the side. You need to come early for the fresh spring roles. Can't wait to come next time and try something else.

We went to this place at around 12.30 am and they were open! It's a really good place to come to after a late night party when all the restaurants are closed and you want a quick bite. Full marks for that! 

I ordered an eggplant sandwich and my husband order fried rice with chicken. Both were delicious. The eggplant sandwich was a tad bit salty but it still tasted really good. 

They have a limited menu for their late night service. Would live to check out their day menu and explore more sandwiches.

Oh My Gosh!!! We ate there over a week ago and I can't stop thinking about how amazing breakfast was!!!!!!!!! We both had the bacon waffles.... Filled with crème brûlée .... Need I say more?? Hella ya!!! The bacon was scrumptious flavorful divine... The waffle its self unbelievable!!!!! Crisp! Well done! Glazed! I thought where is the syrup??? NONE needed!! Just the right amount of sweet and not to much. I hate to sweet and this was just right! Topped off with a poached egg... Never had one and it's now my fave. I must say I'm a small eater... Never Finnish any meal BUT when I go there again I'm going to get a double... It was small in size and I usually prefer that but OM gosh!!! I can't stop thinking about my next trip

This place is probably one of my favorites. It's got consistently fantastic food. The food is delicious. I usually have fried rice or bahn mi. All of the staff are genuinely friendly. The place is clean and welcoming. If you cruising through Santa Barbara, and don't stop by, you're missing out on the awesome.
Would love to give a review on the food, but can't. The hours of operation posted on the website were wrong. Had to go elsewhere. Probably won't chance that again.

I Yelped this restaurant as I was driving up from LA. I chose it because the food looked interesting....and it was!!!

I had the handmade pulled noodles with pork and it came with just the right amount of chili paste on top. I stumbled upon their tofu spring roll that was not only delicious with their peanut sauce, but it was about as big as a small burrito!  I was so full that I had to take home a slice of the chocolate pecan pie, which will probably only last about an hour or two. The entire staff was friendly, knowledgeable and made me feel very welcomed. 5 stars fits them perfectly!!!

Of all the restaurants I went to on my recent Santa Barbara vacation.  This happened to be my favorite spot. I had the thank basil burger and it was absolutely amazing. Super flavorful, moist, juicy.  Just a joy to eat.  I'm definitely coming back here the next time I'm in town
Cool place if you want to eat at 2 am with a lot of drunks! lol  Food is very creative.  I had the fried rice with tri tip.  Very different but excellent.

GOOD: We occasionally make the trip up to S.B. to get some Peanut Butter Burgers! We have been coming here since they were a smaller restaurant and we are so happy that they are growing! The prices are average but the food is WORTH the trip from LA! Everything on their menu is really good! Try the Jasmine Kombucha! This is our go to when we are in S.B. 


BAD: NONE!! =)

Ordered the Thai Basil Cheeseburger and got a hamburger patty sandwiched between two pieces of toasted white bread with some spicy mayo. No mushrooms, onions, or peppers as advertised. Wtf?? And it cost $8.00! 
I'll give it one more chance and order something else next time. Seriously disappointed given all the hype though.
This place is amazing - Cindy is a food genius.  I'd get the KimCheeser, but the Wakin' Bacon is great as well.

Delicious food, but kind of pricey! As to be expected from the menu, it's a bit on the foodie side of things... Hence the price and the hipster looking dudes behind the counter. Their food really hits the spot after a night DT, but it can be pretty crowded.

The pork banh mi was delicious as was the crab melt. Our hands down favorite, however,  was the tri- tip fried rice! We enjoyed great take out on the cusp of the dinner/late night menu and though we would have liked to have tried options from the finner menu, our options did not disappoint.  Service was a bit slow on the ordering side of things thus the missed opportunity for the fuller menu options. Other than that we, fully enjoyed our meal!

Ok so they redeemed themselves from my Bhan Mi incident and slooooow service.  I was having one of those days where I  wanted something sweet and salty at the same time so  I  decided to give this place another shot . I am so glad i did because I absolutly loved the Wake N Bacon. super soft waffle with creme on it and a perfectly poached egg and bacon. Thank God i did not have two or i would have   eaten them both . The calorie count was not listed so i cant  feel too guilty . The food were pretty small which is both good and bad . 

I also took another look at the menu and place and decided I  thought it was cute and unique and reminded me of SF a bit. So I am modifying  this review , or maybe i just did so much more yoga I am more tolerant now.  I will  just will remind myself not to order the Bhan Mi again, i guess I am used to the more traditional Vietnamese sandwich . Yelp forgiveness feels good. 

Also , I wish they would serve the late night menu during the day, some of those items looks delicious and i would love to order them for lunch  
.
Fried rice salad with kimchi, very good, a bit pricey for the meal, but quick and convenient
Umm a little disappointed in this place. The fried rice was just rice with condiments and the sandwiches were just that a patty on bread

So good its worth waiting for dinner. They open shortly after 10pm and it is the go to place for after hours food. There are other options in SB, but nothing else comes close to the quality or flavor. I've tried the entire menu and it's all good, or better. My personal favorite is the peanut butter burger. Don't knock it until you've tried it! I always get a fried rice to take home for breakfast the morning after. My ex is a huge fan of the eggplant roll. If you come any time after 11, expect lines out the door. It's worth it.

A must go for late night food! My friends and I always hit up The Blue Owl after partying downtown when everything else is already closed. The pork bahnmi is a must, along with the fried rice. I'm getting hungry just writing this review! The blue owl is a must!
Tri tip sandwhich is pretty good, still nothing beats it fresh off the BBQ but this is very good for a restaurant tritip. I've heard great things about the shrimp so thats next on my list.

This place had a great ambiance with great food! I got the fried rice with poached egg on top. It is a great choice for gluten free peeps who don't wanna eat a sandwhich! The service as a bit slow because it was busy, but it was lunch hour and everyone seemed to pick this as the place to eat. Great hole in the wall for lunch

What??!! Are you kidding me? This is the kind of food you would normally only find in NY or LA. Late night grub here will blow your mind. You're lucky if you are there on a night when they have Porducken. Buy an extra steak fried rice and heat it up for breakfast - you'll be glad you did!
Went for lunch while in town and we were not disappointed!  The sandwiches and salad were amazing. Everything was fresh and delicious,  we were sad when it was all gone.

Omg, so good!!! Stopped by in Santa Barbara to tour around on my way from SF to LA and it's lunch time and we're hungry. Actually walked by this place during my touristy ventures and thought it was cute, then saw the pictures and good reviews on yelp and had to try it! It definitely lived up to its good reviews. This little eatery is small but cozy with surprisingly adequate seating (at least for a Thursday lunchtime crowd) and really cute decor! I sat in an adorable stool and bar seat with a window that looked out on the entrance. I also got the bacon lettuce tomato avocado (blta) - a special of the day and boy was it amazing!!! Honestly the best rendition of a BLT I have ever had. Everything about it was perfection - the bread perfectly toasted, the bacon perfectly crispy, and the avocado and veggies super fresh. And the arugula had a vinagrette dressing that really topped it off. Yum.

Go get an Egg Sammy!  You wont regret it ;)
MMMMmmmmm! Im kind of addicted.
The service was fast and prompt and no wait on a Saturday night.  I had the noodle bowl with tofu and the flavors in this dish were delicious.  I will definitely be back for more!

The service can be a tad on the slow side however the food is delicious. I appreciate the care they take in shopping at the farmer's market and the fact they use such local, organic, quality ingredients.

THAI BASIL BURGER!!!

OOOOOOOOMG this burger was sooo freaking delicious at 1am when I was wasted and needed something to eat.  Of course, as much as I loved it my foodie/fat ass self felt that it would be way better if it had sriracha... and I'm not 100% sure, but I feel like a fried egg (a runny egg) would've made it awesome. I think it might've had an egg in it? My memory was compromised...

Dollar for dollar the best meal I've had in Santa Barbara. 

It was midnight on Thursday and I was hungry (yeah, so what?!) Popped into Blue Owl for the best dining experience I've had in SB in recent history. The owner was at the register (she's a hoot! get it?) and had a team of three young chefs - they were all awesome. Diverse and delightful menu: I had the fried rice which was heaven for a vegetarian. Boyf had the burger with an egg on top and wouldn't shut up about how good it was. Our appetizer was a slice of the pecan pie which was insanely good. The place is a mix of Portland food trucks meets hole in the wall diner meets heavenly fresh food and flavors.

I'm sad to read the bad reviews about the food and have a hard time believing any of them could be true simply because of how good our experience was. The *only* bit of advice I have to the owner would be to clarify your hours because I agree with other reviewers that it's difficult to pinpoint their late night open hours.

EAT HERE!
Turkey Thyme sandwich was $9 with basic ingredients. It was good, but far too expensive for what I got. If it was $2-3 cheaper, I'd give this place 5 stars.

While taking the 10 hour drive between LA and San Francisco at night, I decided to stop by this place since they were open til 2:30 am. Their sandwiches are very unique and delicious. My boyfriend and I split the Pork Banh Mi and the Crab Melt. (I recommend trying the Crab Melt first, then the Banh Mi since the Banh Mi has a stronger flavor.)

It's a very small and relaxed place and our sandwiches came quickly as well.  Definitely worth a stop for anyone who is in Santa Barbara.
DopeAF LOVE this place such delicious fresh food with endless combos of mains sides and salads available. Atmosphere is chill, service is good. I love blue owl!

Great food - fresh and always hits the spot. Service is great too. I find the homemade bread to always be a hit. I have eaten their burger and it was a perfect size for me - not too much and not too heavy
The Mango Salad was phenomenal! There are plenty of vegetarian/vegan options. The staff was also very helpful/friendly.
I recommend the eggplant sandwich at lunch. This place is great late night, but even better for lunch during the day.

Passed by Santa Barbara for lunch. Naturally I yelped for places to grab a quick bite. This place rocks!!! Everything was so fresh and soooo good. creme brulee waffles?? how can you not be amazed!! if i'm ever in SB, will def come back for more yumminess.

Context: picking up my sister from UCSB, heard good things about this place, decided to stop by. Didn't disappoint.

Parking: 75 minute street parking a little ways down from where Blue Owl is. 

Atmosphere: The place itself is a bit small, but even with most of the tables being occupied, it didn't feel cramped. I liked the detail of the lights strung across the ceiling. And the menu board. And the tables. Just an overall pleasant place. 

Service: The man behind the register was so sweet. He patiently gave us recommendations and a rundown of what was in the sandwiches. 

Food: I got the Thai Basil Burger, which was ah-mazing. The green curry infusion in the meat is an awesome idea. However, I was expecting the runny goodness of a poached egg in the burger but got a thoroughly cooked egg instead :(( hence the minus star. 

Definitely would recommend this place to anyone who's in the area. I want to come back for their late night menu!
Omg!! Had this last night... Can't stop thinking about the place. The staff was quick even though they were busy. They also followed up after we ate!!! Thumbs up!!

I came here based on the reviews and I was greatly disappointed.  It wasn't that busy during lunch time today but the 2 sandwiches took almost 20 minutes to prepare( prolly because they only have 1 small oven toaster to use on all the bread). The portions were very small for the price.  

The crab melt was very greasy.  It didn't taste that fresh either.  The banh mi tasted pretty plain, did not have that Vietnamese banh mi taste to it.  

I'm not exactly sure where all the good reviews came from.

The food is absolute unique and delectable. The Wake N'Bacon is worth savoring every bite. And their homemade drinks are all perfect! Customer service is too notch and the atmosphere is delightful. Haven't ever been here during a busy time so the small seating hasn't ever been a bother. Cute place do a weekend date!

The food is delicious as always! One of my personal favorites is the crabmeat! Depending on the time of the day, the speed of service varies. Now they have an app where you can choose your items and place an order and pick up at the time that works best. My only suggestion is that I wish that there were more items available through out the day and not just available exclusively for lunch or dinner.

This place is so amazing and the workers are super friendly.  Since it was our first time, the worker gave us an egg on our sandwich for free.  We also ordered two Mexican cokes and she gave us an extra one because one of them splashed a little when she popped it open (according to her, we didn't notice).

We tried the Thai Curry Cheeseburger which was delicious (even though I don't like curry) and the tri tip steak sandwich which was a special that day.  The tri tip sandwich was AMAZING and I still think about it and drool, months later.  The only thing was, the bread was a bit too crusty and hurt the roof of my mouth at times, but it was so delicious I didn't care.  They should definitely add it to the regular menu!!

Wish I lived in Santa Barbara, I would come here all the time!
Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi ! Bahn Mi !

You can call this the "shoot me now" sandwich because after you taste this there is no other sandwich worth living for. Blue owl has mastered the craft of the simplistic yet well versed gourmet sandwich and features a late night menu to serve the lucky locals. I ordered the bahn mi aka the best decision of my entire trip to Santa Barbara. The bread alone was too good to be true but then you add on the perfect portion of tender pork, slaw, cilantro and oyster mayo and alas I am a man who has eaten an 8 inch porky slice of Vietnamese heaven.
Quick, clean, scrumptious, with nice employees and interior design.

Nice Asian fusion restaurant in downtown SB. Informal dining with eat in, take out or delivery options.

I had the pulled pork noodles and my wife had the fried rice with chicken. Both were single bowl meals - slightly spicy (nice) - and very flavoursome with super fresh ingredients.

I used to crave their Bahn Mi sandwich but when I got it yesterday it was flavorless, mushy and so small.  Even the portion of chips was tiny.  I used to love their salads but yesterday I got pistachio dust and a snail in my salad.  Yes, a whole snail, shell and all!!  When I confronted the cashier about the snail he brought it back to the kitchen, then returned with not an apology or refund, but a story about how fresh and organic their ingredients are.
