Thats all fine and good, but your cooks really need to make sure there aren't any surprises in my salad.  The rest of the day my stomach felt funky and I sank into a slight depression knowing that one of my favorite eateries in town had sunk to the bottom of my list.

First time visiting Santa Barbara and searched a place to eat lunch downtown.  Ordered the Fried Rice with poached egg, Turkey Thyme sandwich and a Thai Tea.  Don't ask for your thai tea in a to-go cup as you will get shorted 1/4 of your $3.25 drink. Also if you like your thai tea on the sweet side like I do then do not order this tea.  
Food took 15 minutes to come out.  Husband enjoyed his Turkey Thyme sandwich $9 flavors went really well together.  I've had better fried rice and thought it was a little pricey at $10 (extra $2 to add meat&tofu).

Yes: Fried Egg Rice with tri-tip, Pork Bahn Mi, Crab Melt. 

No: The hordes of drunkies at 2AM in front of you in line when you're sober trying to get your goddamn food!

My boyfriend and I went to this place, and it was fantastic. The staff was very friendly ... and the food was absolutely delicious. I had the Pork Bahn Mi, which had fresh crisp pickled vegetables and a very crunchy roll, it was delicious. My boyfriend got the breakfast sandwich on waffles, it was really different and would recommend trying it! can't wait to go back again and enjoy something different this time!

My boss took me here the other day and we got the fried rice. It was so delicious I kept thinking about it for like 8 days afterwards. They are closed on Mondays though, so that hankering for fried rice must wait until Tuesday.

This is the best tri-tip sandwich I've ever had. And who knew it'd come from a thai restaurant? The oyster aioli, smothered on the perfectly toasted brioche roll adds a slightly fishy element to the sandwich - but it works. And it works well.
The tri-tip fried rice topped with an egg is also a good call.
Although the portions are small for the price, the two things I've had (fried rice $10, tri tip sandwich $8) are worth every penny.  You also have to take into consideration that this is one of SB's few late night options. Otherwise, you're stuck with Mad Dogs or Jack in the Crack.
For more photos, link to my personal blog: http://stepinmysize10.blogspot.com/2011/08/blue-owl-at-zen-yai.html
I took an eggplant sandwich for breakfast. You can't imagine how delicious it is from the appearance.

I am a huge fan of the tri tip fried rice!  The flavor is amazing!  I love the added spice of the red chili and the poached egg on top.  Since it is only offered on the late night menu on Friday and Saturday night, I go every Friday and Saturday when I work late.  While I've never tasted anything bad at this place, the fried rice is still my favorite by far!  I rave about it to all my friends and family until they go taste it for themselves.  Highly recommend the tri tip fried rice!!  The customer service here is fantastic as well!!
Just when i think "i'm sick of eating out", i stumble upon the Blue Owl.  Roast Beef Bah-mi and Rosemary infused lemonade brought my appetite back.  New favorite place in town:)

Holy Fuck!!

Their Salami Sandwich with the bread, are you fucking kidding me?  It was one of the best lil sandwiches I had in a while.  It came with lil chips and I had it with the Citrus Mint Soda, which complimented it very well, I think.   

I'd love to dive into their night menu, but I think that's where they're fucking up.  The night menu only happens Thurs-Sat from 11:30 pm-2 am.  11:30??  I mean COME ON!!  No one's supposed to be eating at that time.  That shit ain't good for you.  I mean, I get it,  it's for the post Bar/Club kids, but what about us surly loners with no where to go?  I assure you,  surly loners probably eat twice as much as your regular fun time kid.  It's all we have left in life.

I've only managed it one night and it was a strain.  I guess this is how I know I'm not a young kid anymore.  I'm not out on the weekend "fucking it up" on the streets.  Ha ha ha, I don't think I ever was.  I digress,  All in all,  I wish their night menu started at like...9 or something.  That'd be more doable.  I had the fried rice with tri tip.  It was fucking awesome.  I wanna fuck around with one of their burgers next time, see how that goes.

You know,  I wish there were more places with this kind of food stylings around here.    State street doesn't have too many creative places.  Oh yeah,  I wish they had more seating going on.  I know they can't help that, the location is tiny, but it'd be nice for dealing with larger crowds.

The cashier was very courteous and accommodating. The service is top notch. I had the banh mi sandwich with pork and it was just the right amount of spicey. It comes  with ruffles and was the perfect amount of food without feeling bloated. The sandwich is about one dollar more expensive than other sandwiches but worth it due to the quality and taste. The service is fast as well it took about 5-10 minutes for my sandwich to arrive. You should try at least once.

What great service at this cute little place!  I went in a couple weeks ago with a couple friends.  We had to wait maybe 5 minutes to be helped because they were slammed... but we weren't in any rush, no big deal.  But the man working there was so apologetic for the wait, and gave us all a discount on our orders!  Plus, the food was great!  As was the flavored iced tea.  They allowed me to make some substitutions on a salad and didn't charge me extra.  Plus, I love the casual and home-y ambiance.

Some of the words that come to mind when I think about this place are..amazing, unique, intimate, delicious..The owner really has a knack for putting flavors together.  I haven't tried everything on the menu, but everything I have tried has just been delicious.  Please never close!
Great salads and sandwiches.  The baked cheese sandwich is a combination of a grilled cheese and salad. The pear and goat cheese salad was terrific.

A local friend pulled me into this yummy spot for a late night meal! I still crave the fried rice with an egg! Such delicious flavor! Wish they had a bit more seating to accommodate more people at once. Will definitely be back when we are back in town!
Best burger I've ever had. I think it was the Thai basil burger. Add the fried egg! Tritip sandwhich is bomb 2

my crabmelt was pretttyy darn good. the woman at the cash register was particularly friendly as well. 

only downside is it is a little overpriced. but who knows, maybe they provide excellent pay for employees at the extra cost (I hope so)!!
Loved this! Best egg plant sandwich in a long time. The Wake n Bacon looked great, and my company really enjoyed it. Wonderful place!

Amazing customer service! I was in a hurry to catch my bus and asked what would taste good at the time (11:00). The employee gave exactly what I didn't know I was in the mood for and it was an egg sandwich with chorizo and it was delicious!
The chips and orange juice with it tasted fresh and I loved the combination, this is definitely a place I would take a semi-hipster friend to haha

Great spot for late night food. Menu is a little strange for needing that Burger or Taco after a night of drinking, but the way they put everything together is awesome! The staff is chill and the food is quick! A+ in Santa Barbara for sure!

Stopped in for a late night meal while driving for Lyft and I couldn't be happier in my choice. I ordered the Peanut Butter Hamburger which was simply outstanding. I will absolutely be coming back to try some of the other items they have.

The Owl is an oasis in the culinary desert that is lower State. I only wish I didn't have to stay up until 11 to eat there! Everyone raves about the sandwiches, and of course the tri-tip is always amazing, but my personal favorite is the fried rice with an egg on top. Perfectly seasoned, garnished with green onions and fresh cilantro, and and piping hot. Plus, the owner is always coming up with new and interesting specials, so there's always a reason to check out what's new.

When I am down in SB late on Friday or Saturday, this is the spot to be.  Open late hours is perfect when you work nights or are out at the clubs.  Super casual, great food.  You can tell that these guys really care what is coming out of the kitchen.  I will be back soon!

Tri-Tip Fried Rice, and the Thai Burger with an egg on top are a must!
My kids rarely like Asian food but they love this place. Every time they visit their grandparents in Santa Barbara they have to eat here and happy kids equals happy mom.
What a find! You can get healthy food with incredible flavor and variety, highly recommended.

First off, let me start by thanking the owners of the Blue Owl for being one of the few places open at night. Since not all of us live the robot lifestyle, I wanted to acknowledge that. Also I give u props for creating a menu which is different and unique. As a fellow business owner in Santa Barbara, I know hard it is not fall in to the "me too" trap of Mexican food, pizza, and burgers which everyone else seems to have succumb too. All that said, you get a three star rating because quite frankly your customer service sucks, and you ALWAYS RUN OUT OF FOOD!!! What is it with u guys? Shrimp and crab are the reasons everyone comes to your place! It certainly isn't for the service, and definitely NOT for the atmosphere of drunk college kids. Come on guys, if we are gonna drag our asses out of our homes and drive across town to an area of town that simply is annoying ... The least you can do is have what we want when we arrive.

Total bust.  Checked the on-line order menu but it didn't include sandwiches which is on the dinner menu.  So I called, The two entrees and sandwich I ordered they don't serve anymore.  When I tried to ordered something else I heard, "Sorry we don't make that anymore either." In fact, their  menu is much smaller and they didn't have anything I wanted.  Sorry guys, you may have OK food but in Santa Barbara, you have to have your act together with decent customer service to make it.....

Blue owl is amazing! A group of friends and I went to Blue owl and had a number of their sandwiches including the pork bah min, which was personally my favorite!  Everything was so fresh and scrumptious! Try the lavender lemonade, yum!
No more Wake n' Bacon :( bummed out but I might try the Pb burger next time I visit other than just leaving.

Wow. This is amazing. 

When we first saw the plates, we were a little disappointed, the portions are small. But let me tell you, once the plates were empty all you could hear were people moaning out of pure joy. The wake n' bacon is a creme brûlée waffle, with a literal crust on it, orgasmic to say the least.  I got the special, the Bleu Beef, a tri-tip burger with caramelized onions. All amazing.

 I plan on coming here for the late night menu, because everyone knows good food tastes even better when you are shwasted.

OMG. I am a foodie SNOB and I LOVED THIS PLACE.

I had the seasonal "sweet" salad: micro greens (the best) with strawberries, raspberries and goat cheese with a guava vinaigrette. UNBELIEVABLE. Freshness, texture, taste, originality ... I cook, I eat, I am a tough critic but this was OUT OF THIS WORLD.

Can't wait to go back to try other seasonal goodies :)

The place is very cute and has very interesting flavor combinations, pairing more Asian herbs and spices with American sandwiches with Latin influences. A group of three of us went and one of our group for her food very quickly, while the other two orders took a while. It turned out their printer got jammed so our order wasn't shown, but the head chef was very apologetic and brought us soup (broccoli curry, it was delicious!) while we waited. Totally understand that things happen and it did not seem typical of the place, and they again were very kind about it. Everyone was very helpful, the food was great (we got the Crabmelt, Baked Cheese and Egg Sandwiches) and all were delicious and came with a side salad that had an excellent vinaigrette. Would gladly go back again!

The Thai Basil Burger is a grilled cheese sandwich on white bread with a medium rare beef patty and American cheese. It's like something you make at home when you have random ingredients and don't want to go to the store. 

It wasn't bad, but nothing 4.5 star worthy either, hence the 3 star "a-okay." The patty was cooked well, but I could hardly taste the beef because it was saturated with spicy green curry flavor. 

The burger was served in wrapped aluminum foil, as were the ban mhi I saw other people eating. They didn't have sides of chips.

If you're craving a grilled cheese I recommend this.

I have only tried the Bahn Mi sandwiches from here and a bite of the fried rice. I didnt like the rice but the sandwiches are the best I have ever had. They have the perfect modern twist and just so full of flavor. Kinda pricey, but those sandwiches are seriously the best.
Wonderful staff, wonderful food, not a huge menu but a great selection... Im picky eater but love everything blue owl offers. Everytime im in Sb i have to stop by blue owl for a tasty midnight dinner
This place is amazing! Had the breakfast crabmelt sandwich and was blown away! Went here for late night around 2:30am "today" after bar hopping and despite a long wait it was completely worth it!!
One of the best sandwiches I've ever had.  Highly recommend the muffaletta.

I am so in love with this place! After a long flight from JFK and another two-and-a-half-hour drive from LAX, my husband and I managed to arrive right on top of a large parade during Fiesta weekend. Many restaurants were closed, but we were lucky to find this gem hidden away in a shopping center in downtown Santa Barbara. It's funny because on the locals called this a "hole in the wall" but this place is far from it. It has a cute cafe feel to it, with picnic benches and minimalist rustic decor.

I had a baked cheese sandwich with aged Gouda, Swiss, provolone, Basilmayo, greens, tomato, and vinaigrette. I am usually disappointed with the whole Asian fusion concept, but was impressed with the quality of it here. Even the salad was to die for! They switch up their menu periodically, so it's nice that you will not get bored with the selection. They are also open late nights (2:30am) unlike other Santa Barbara joints. This goes far beyond the typical greasy pizza late night snack that many cities have.

Enjoyed the fried rice and roasted eggplant here for a late dinner! Food was tasty, but the quantity of the fried rice was small compared to the price. Wish they had a bigger portion. Otherwise the food preparation was very good, food was delicious, and the atmosphere was very relaxed.

Hmm.. Although they try to offer a unique item through the Wake N' Bake, it doesn't justify the price... Left with my hunger un- satiated... Ended up going to another quality spot to satisfy my hunger.

I'm glad this is something I tried and it was one of the only things open. BUT it did have a weird vibe as someone mentioned before. Their hours are awkward and the person I went with swears one of the cooks was high (not that I mind).
The food tasted great! It was a bit expensive for what you purchase and they were running out of everything. So if you see tape on the menu - don't ask if they have it. 

Overall it was okay.
This place is great for lunch and certainly hits the spot. I really enjoyed the friendly atmosphere, herb flavored lemonade and the crab melt.  The breads were yummy and fresh.
First time here ever and I started with the beef Banh Mi. A good baseline, right? It's great! I will be back repeatedly.

Des pures sandwich créatif, avec des super goût !!! (pour la faire courte)

C'est la bonne idée, des sandwichs gourmet et créatif, mais pas que. Pour ma part j'ai tester que les sandwichs et c'est juste une tuerie, c'est plein de goût, équilibré et plein de bonne idée. Les sandwichs sont préparé minutes, il faut donc attendre un peu mais cela en vaut la plein. Les boissons son aussi surprenante comme le Blue owl thai tea qui est une expérience qu'il faut essayer.

Bref une super découverte pour manger gourmet.

Yummy! Went late night and the place wasnt too too busy. Fast service. Tri tip banh mi was delicious! Pork banh mi was good but not stellar. Fried rice with tri tip was pretty darn good. All n all very good. Prices about the same as everywhere else. Id definitely go back, especially since theyre open til 0200. Menu isnt too big so not hard picking something out. A must try when in SB.

For the most part, not enough quality food is available past, say, 9 or 10 PM. What is available (particularly in the area surrounding UCSB) tends to cater towards those not necessarily in the most lucid state of mind -- those just looking for something to fill their stomachs. Not to say that that's inherently bad, but sometimes something superior is sought. This is where the Blue Owl's "Late Night" menu earns its stars.

I had the Thai Basil Burger, with no cheese (I'm not really into American) and a fried egg, the latter of which costs an extra dollar. The first thing to happen upon my diving in was its falling apart. Immediately. The egg burst, and although this is no fault of the chef's, the bigger problem was that the bottom slice of bread crumbled to pieces, creating a considerable mess. The top remained intact, fortunately.

Additionally, if I recall correctly, the in-store menu says "sauteed veggies," or something to that effect, while the online menu offers caramelized onions and peppers and sauteed mushrooms. On further examination, I found only the aforementioned peppers. Not a huge complaint, but it made me a little sad.

Regarding beverages, unfortunately all they had were canned and bottled items; I was disappointed, as I was looking forward to experiencing the rather cryptic "Blue Owl Soda," or at the very least their Thai Iced Tea. I resorted instead to a Mexican Coke (think glass bottle).

If these matters raise any qualms as to whether you would want to visit the Blue Owl, allow me to put them down. Mess aside, the burger was delicious. The meat was perfectly cooked, with a lovely texture. The green curry infusion provided a fantastic and unique kick without muting the flavor of the beef; unless you, for whatever reason, insist on having it, I suggest skipping the cheese. The bread (not a bun, but there was nothing wrong with this) complimented it well, and the peppers (I'm still a little sad) added good flavor. Distinctive and actually pretty creative, while at the same time very simple (in a good way).

The most critical issue I had with the Blue Owl was with the people who were there at the time I went. The staff and chefs were nice enough, and I'd even venture to say that the cashier was extraordinarily and uncommonly friendly; it was my fellow patrons I took issue with. When I entered, it was around 10:35 PM , and by 11 when I left I had received more than two hands' count of snooty, disdainful looks from hip, chic, modern twenty-somethings. Indeed, I concede that this is potentially irrelevant, that it is in no way the restaurant's doing, and that they should not be held accountable for solving it, but there was a strong air of condescension (ostensibly because I am a teenager, just a kid, and ergo not "serious" about the food I eat). Feeling as if those around you believe you don't belong does not contribute to an enjoyable meal. I really can't say much more about this than to expect that these people will be at such prominent alternative/niche restaurants as this one.

All things considered, I have no doubt I'll be returning to the Blue Owl. They're open late, with a menu that is appealing and (on my first visit, at least) well-executed. I just hope they don't run out of the special soda next time...

What a fantastic find! The service, food and ambience is wonderful. The pork bahn mi is easily now my favorite sandwich in Santa Barbara. The sweet and spicy balance is perfect, it tastes very fresh. The pork is tender and flavorful, the bread is soft, delicate, and perfectly toasted. The beet salad also blew me away by how much delicious flavor is disguised in a seemingly simple dish, definitely recommended. Jordan (if I remember her name correctly) was awesome! She was passionate and knowledgeable about food, and chatted with my wife and I for a while. Great service! We can hardly wait to try their late night menu!

Pork banh mi is amazing
Thai basil burger is one of the most unique burgers I have ever had bomb! Deserts are all amazing bottle cokes yes!!!!!

Amazing restaurant established by a former chef of the world famous San Ysidro Ranch --but without the out-of-this-world prices. Most menu items are under $10!!!  Great bang for the buck for gourmet cuisine. I only wish they were open Sundays and Mon-Thurs dinner.

Great late night food, especially the Thai basil burger that always hits the spot. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Was there last night and it was very busy, so as I was waiting the extra few minutes Ernie, the man behind the counter, offered some free toppings on the sandwich and a free drink for my wait. Needless to say I'll be back soon.

I loved eating here. I ordered the pork bahn mi and husband got the roast beef bahn mi. Both delicious, but the pork was our favorite. We also ordered a side of potato salad which wasn't needed, but was great anyway. Get the pork bahn mi, you will love it!
Came here for lunch on a Saturday with family. I ordered the Nam Toc Burrito and it did not disappoint. I'd highly recommend this place. The staff are very nice and food quality and taste are high.

i love The Blue Owl! Since i just moved to SB from Venice I was a little concerned that I wouldn't find the kind of places I loved as the food scene seems a little behind in SB. Then I found The Blue Owl! i love this place, everything i have had was amazing.  I know some people don't like the odd hours but I think it is great to have a late night eat spot since everything else closes at 8-9pm.  The chef in incredible and I hope they expand so more people can eat there, i tell any friends coming to visit from LA the Blue Owl is a must eat.

My gal and I split a Pork sandwich we agreed that it was amazing! Great flavors and fantastic bun. The only thing I could say is we did not get any chips with our $9 sandwich and it is not the largest sandwich. Flavor wise it is a five star sandwich though.

I 'For what it is', the Blue Owl is great. There is no pretense for it to be fancy. It is good creative food and fairly well priced for the high rent district of Santa Barbara. 
Last week I had a late night (Saturday) Thai Basil Burger that was really good. Great flavors.  Served in a sheet of aluminum foil... Very basic... but tasty.  
Yesterday I tried the Bahn Mi for lunch. Not my favorite... but I appreciate that they are trying different flavors.

The people behind the cash register were very friendly and seemed happy to be there.

I will be back soon!

Great Eggplant Banh-Mi's! Good pickled veggies and Eggplant on a nice crusty baguette with a small side salad for dinner.
Open Wed-Sat.
This is a great little place to grab a relatively unique lunch.  Its not fast food, just a good spot to take a moment and enjoy the taste of good food.

This place is the shizzle.  I have been a big fan of Cindy Black for a long time and her food is excellent.  Its the kinda of grub your looking for on a night of binge drinking and or puffing the green, that is going to make you say OMG this is amazing.  Yes, it is amazing with or without the enhancements.  I come here almost once or twice a month and get food to eat here as well as take home.  I love the tri-tip sandwich here and the shrimp roll.  Try the fried rice with tri-tip and fried egg on top with saracha sauce.  It's the best damn fried rice in town.  I will even order a second order of fried rice for the next morning, for the hangover.  Sooooo good!  And I cant forget the 420 burger, its a grilled cheese with a Thai Green curry in the burger.  Uh yea, this is the bomb diggidy.  This little gem is only open Thurs, Fri, Sat nights, late night, 11:30pm to 2:30am  So you must go out and enjoy the nightlife here in Santa Barbara, crawl back to your hotel or million dollar shack, but hit up the Blue Owl on the way and get some of the best late night grub this side of the international date line.
Bacon, poached egg, waffle. That's what I'm talking about.

My dad and here went here last night for dinner and we were both really impressed by the quality of the food and the EXCELLENT customer service. The food is obviously made thoughtfully (both our sandwiches were delicious) and both the girl at the counter and the chef were extremely awesome and helpful. Love places like this!!!

Got the best salad, and it was definitely one for the books. The goat cheese was a fantastic addition to the salad, and the pistachios were amazing. These are all pretty expensive ingredients so this felt like a gourmet salad. I got the half size, and I was still hungry right after. I'd probably get some protein add-ons (beef is pretty juicy). 

Also, the decor is hilarious! Cat photos everywhere

Seriously AMAZING- hadn't been to Santa Barbara in awhile and I'm now officially obsessed. Had the shrimp bun, the tri tip fried rice, and the Thai basil burger- ALL outstanding. Probably heading back for lunch today!
Solid late night. Thai basil burger with a fried egg is a fusion that just works. Recommend any day.

Very disappointed. We came for late night but left with an unsatisfied stomach. We tried the fried rice, bahn mi, and a Thai basil burger. The fried rice was a little cold and had no real flavor, just add on. The bahn mi was the biggest disappointment, it was cold and had only a few small bites of meat. Sad. The burger was the biggest hit and it was the size of a school lunch sandwich. It is not a blue owl... It is a sad owl.
For late night you can't beat it, Friday and Saturday night's till 2:30am!  Closed Sunday's.  The Thai Basil Burger is outta this world.  Go get em' night owl's!
Best late night munchie spot. Great food, great quality, great portions and prices!

I had this place at 5 stars until...


They raised their prices once again and my biggest pet peeve, changed their hours again! Very inconvenient. Always have to stop and think if they are open that it's not even worth making this place an option. I get there is a reason they have these hours (more traffic coming in fri and Saturday, probably making enough even being closed 3 days a week etc..) but honestly I have stopped coming here because it s a very inconvenient schedule they function on for me. Also, with the constant raising of prices.. (Twice in the past year) it's really not worth it. 

Pros: real ingredients, great flavor, quality, great customer service 

Cons: 
-over priced, ($10 for basically 1/2 of a sandwich because it was so small and not much ingredients under the bread at all)
-small meal,skimpy ingredients 

This place rocks bc it's open late and uses  real ingredients. But the sandwiches can easily be made at home for $2-3 a piece. They get their 4 stars for convenience of late night and that their food isn't greasy garbage. (As SB doesn't have very many quality healthy eateries)

Nice customer service, quick delivery.
Tried several times at this place. All turned out very good.  The mango salad is my favorite, so fresh and tasty and healthy. Love their fried rice and beef sandwiches too.

Would have been a 4 star if it weren't for a minor interaction I had with a girl that works there awhile back (possibly a part owner?) when she vehemently disagreed with my comment that they were a tad overpriced. The food is decent, especially good when you're drunk late-night on the weekends, but it's not a real kitchen. The sandwiches are solid but not REALLY worth the double digit price.

Perfect find for late night eats. My husband inhaled his basil burger. I managed a bite before it was devoured and it was tasty. The fried rice was a little sweet for my liking but it hit the spot at 10pm and erased my famished state of mind. Thanks yelpers for pointing us this way.
One of the few places in SB with late-night dining. I love their eggplant sandwich and shrimp roll.
The Red Curry Tofu and Shrimp is served in a sandwich with salad. It was very flavored in taste. There was not as much of the shrimp, but plenty of the red curry flavored tofu. I bit pricy $10.
Love the food,wish the hours of operation weren't so erratic

This was our first stop for lunch on our way up to NorCal. After seeing the great reviews for this place, I was a little disappointed after eating here. This definitely isn't an Asian Fusion place, since the only (available) item on the menu that was Asian was Banh Mih. 

This was a very cute small place with a bunch of owl decors. When we came, we were disappointed that they didn't have duck, which was a key ingredient in a few of their items. With that said, I ended up getting the Salami sandwich. It was a little spicy, but not too terribly so, which was good. However, I just didn't think it was that good. It came with a side of Lays/Ruffles or whatever, and wasn't freshly made. For the price of the sandwich (~$9), I was expecting more. Also, you have to bus yourself - which I personally don't mind, but I know some people would (like my friend). At least the staff was friendly, and they had free cucumber water.

I wanted to like this. I ordered the beef BahnMi spicy and within three hours my body went into shock and I got food poising. Have been sick for the last couple of days  and upset that this happened. Had to go to the doctor and it was confirmed that it was food poisoning.

Cindy, the owner called me today to apologize for the situation. I appreciated her call back and spoke with her in regards to my situation and what I ate. We spoke about how many people ordered the same thing and that no one else got sick. I don't know if my body just rejected an ingredient but I thank you for the call.
Late night spot. Wish it was open after 3pm. Favorites: Fried rice w/ tri-tip and the thai basil cheeseburger w/ a fried egg.

For the longest time I could never get there when they were open.  My first time I ordered the wrong thing, but everyone else's was amazing!  I went back and got hooked!  OMG their Kale Salad rules!  The spicy miso dressing yum!  The salami sandwich is one of the best sandwiches I've ever had and I don't even like salami!!  The homemade freshly baked jalapeno foccacia is insane!  I can't figure out which I like the best, the pork or beef Bahn Mi?  Turkey Thyme is soooo good too!  Everything goes down better with either rosemary lemonade and homemade blood orange or ginger soda!  I still have to try the Thai Basil Burger and fried rice, etc., but it's too hard not to stick w/the old favorites...  The employees are awesome too! I LOVE THIS PLACE! YUM!
Thank you for another great sandwich!  I had the beef Bahn Mi. It had great flavor and perfect amount of heat.  My only complaint is the bread was small and hard, needs a different roll.

I've been here many times for their late night menu and I've always been impressed. I decided to try their breakfast one day and was blown away. Their "English muffin" is homemade and delicious. It's pretty small with just 3-4 tables but the decor is really cute and welcoming.

Kimchi fried rice for the win! Even in the middle of the night I've had wonderful service, and highly recommend anything from the late-night menu if the late-night craving hits. Only downside is having to wait until the weekend for my favorite fried rice at midnight :)

This place is amazing. My coworker and I were in Santa Barbara for a meeting and used yell to lick a place for lunch. This place had lots of good reviews and it didn't disappoint!  

I had the BLTA and my coworker had the pastrami. It was just the right amount of food. Everything had amazing flavor and prices were reasonable.
Finally tried the food and it was great so I am upgrading to 4 stars. Kale salad was fantastic. Soup was great too.

I  LOVE eating here, menu, price, food outstanding!
Late night eats is awesome.
So you know, I took a friend there after a concert, and he sat and was like, oh ordering at the register... was suspicious. I said, wait...  We ordered, sat, and he was transformed. He said he had never eaten such a great crab sandwich EVER, I had fried rice with tri tip. I also  have an experience every time I get there.
Right food, right price, worth the line  that forms late at night.
Owner, Cindy is passionate about food and it shows!staff is caring, upbeat and  there for the costumer.

LOVE THE BLUE OWL!

Stopped in SB for one night and came here with my wife. Now, I might not leave. Amazing food and great staff. Banh Mi sandwich is great. Just get it. Don't argue, just order it, eat it, and smile. Good craft beers on tap and in bottle too. Just can't miss at this place.

The shop was cozy, dark wood/white walls,  but small - I took  my $10 Bánh mì to go with a Mexican Coke and ate it in the SB sunshine!  I walked out skeptical...

Is this the most authentic Bánh mì outside of saigon... probably not, is this a F*%@ING unbelievable sandwich? YES!. 

With my first bite, my mind and body were wholly wrapped in pure baguette bliss! 

The interior of the sandwich was dominated by soft saucy shredded meat that melted the flavors and textures into a perfect harmony (I ordered mine spicy, which had some heat, but did not distract or overwhelm the complexity in this masterpiece).  

The sandwich was good up to this point... Where this masterpiece elevated beyond mortal understand was in the bread. 

It was perfect. 

It was sublime.

This bread that encased this sandwich so lovingly was something very special. Light, crusty, delicious.

Maybe its just that everything tastes better on vacation but,  SB you are very lucky, treat this owl well!
Great place to stop and have lunch. Had the BLTA roll and my wife had the root vege salad. Both were delicious and well priced. Would eat here again

This place is amazing! My boyfriend, his friend and I came here for lunch and it was so tasty!  I had the pork banh mi which you must try! The place is cute, down to earth and obviously homemade and healthy. It is a must try!

Great lunch spot in SB.  We split a shredded kale salad with cabbage, cucumbers, baby heirloom tomatoes, avocado, sunflower seeds and miso-soy vinaigrette dressing. I had a pork banh mi sandwich on a crispy baguette, with just the right degree of spiciness.  My partner had the breakfast flatbread with eggplant substituted for chorizo.  We wouldn't have thought of that combination but it was delicious.  Blue Owl is informal and quick.  It was a fantastic find for us.
The crab melt was delicious! Service was very quick. Convenient location near the mall. Restaurant is a little small but has a cozy feeling.

Their crab melt sandwich was amazing, and I don't even like sandwiches. Crab meat with egg and salad on an English muffin. Sounds simple, but the flavors mixed together perfectly. Definitely worth the price. My friend had the beet salad and it was very good and fresh. The environment is rustic / casual with some small tables and some large common tables.

This is a great lunch spot. The restaurant is conveniently located downtown and across from a parking garage. Sandwiches are super fresh, flavorful, and delicious. We had the BLTA and salami both excellent choices. This is a great go-to in Santa Barbara for a quick and delicious bite!
Very good food. Very nice place, service is fast. Different from other sandwichs places, everything is tasty and original!

What can be better than a great Thai restaurant? Another one in the same location that's open late night!

Personal favorite: shrimp roll. I was expecting a cold egg roll type of item, but instead was surprised to get a warm sandwich. Absolutely AMAZING.
Very cool vibe and excellent food. Big foodies here and love places like this off the beaten path! Pork banh mi was amazing!
We had the turkey tyme, pork bhan mi, and egg sandwich. All DELICIOUS! The bread is fresh, perfectly toasted and slathered in various home made mayos. Will be back whenever I'm in town

I was a bit skeptical about this place.  I've eaten at many incredible places, but this tiny hole in wall is AMAZING!  I overheard other customers expressing the same sentiments.   American/Asian infusion breakfast/brunch has such delicate flavors and balanced by all fresh ingredients.  We order d the Egg sandwich (garlic mayo, frittata, Spanish chorizo, and arugula on a homemade English muffin), soup of the day was a broccoli soup (cooked in curry and coconut milk, garnished with chives), and an eggplant sandwich (roasted red bell peppers, caramelized onions, fresh basil, on a thyme ciabatta), and a lavender homemade lemonade.  Service = A+!
We visited Blue Owl as a late night stop and what they are cooking up there is perfect for relaxing after being out on the town.  The food tasted wonderful and it feels comfortable.

To anyone who gives this 1 or 2 stars, I'd like to here your idea of a great dining experience. Everything on this menu is delicious. I've tried the Thai Basil Burger, Egg Melt, Turkey Thyme, Banh Mi, Fried Rice, and a couple things from their old menu. You really can't go wrong here. Late night it is the best option in the town by far. Day time, it is my favorite place to eat as well. I believe this and The Shop are probably equals when it comes to lunch. 

The new layout of the restaurant is nice so it isn't as packed. I believe if you live in Santa Barbara and you haven't been here then you aren't really living. The spicy mayo on the Banh Mi is my favorite aioli on the planet. Start with the Beef Banh Mi and keep trying things here. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu!

One of my favorite SB spots. Very unassuming with an awesome lunch and late night menu. 

I've tried the fried rice with tri-tip (wonderful)., the crab melt--the house made English muffin bread is so soft and good. I've also had the bahn-mi, which was one of the best things I've ever tasted. The baguette was PERFECT with a chewy soft interior and crisp exterior. The roast beef was so fresh and awesome and whatever aioli they put on it was simply amazing. I want to try everything on the menu, so I'm going to keep coming back. They also have creative house made teas (and sodas?). I tried the grapefruit green tea one day and it was incredible.

L'endroit est adorable mais un peu plus de déco serait pas de refus. 

Incroyable salade pour ma part et sandwichs originaux pour mes amis. Un des meilleurs lunchs aux US. 

Le sandwich au fromage était peut-être un peu trop gras. Le pain était délicieux. La salade était parfaite mais la vinaigrette miso n'était selon moi pas la meilleure combinaison. Pas de souci pour en avoir une autre ;)

Sinon, c'était plutôt sain, rapide et bon. Je recommande!

Can't say enough great things about this place! 4 stars because their hours are weird and sporadic, but they've improved on them over the years. But, their food is so good, it's worth it trying to find out when they're open. The Thai Basil Burger is literally one of the most juiciest and flavorful burgers I've ever had - it surprises me every time I order it. Their Fried Rice is also pretty dang amazing, and garnishing it with chili garlic sauce is a great touch. Blue Owl is one of the few late-night Asian places around SB, so I'm super glad they're here!
Best late night munchies off state street. Buns are locally made, food is affordable ($10-12) and always leaves me satisfied

BEST FOOD EVER, in SB. A MUST try, the hours are strange but you definitely have to wake up or stay up late enough to try.

We popped in at 10:15pm on a Friday night, a decent amount of people were inside eating or waiting for their orders. The breakfast menu looked good but we had to stick with the late night menu. All of the cook staff were attentive and the owner made sure each dish tasted to perfection.

Fried rice w/trip tip: DELICIOUS, a deconstructed fried rice of sorts, all of the mix-ins were perfect, topped with a poached egg. I hate drippy eggs and this didn't make my skin crawl. The sriracha of some sort sealed the deal and a healthy serving of tri-tip put this over the edge.

Spicy Pork banh-mi: DELICIOUS yet again, a little soggy but the bread was a perfectly crisp baguette. The pork was soft and moist, the vegetables crisp.

Thai iced tea: sweet and more spicy chai than others I've had.

Axxess, buy one get one free entree

Santa Barbara needs more restaurants like The Blue Owl at Canon Perdido: adventurous, flavorful, satisfying, unique, delicious, and affordable. The fresh ingredients and experimentally innovative preparations create a multi-layered texture and flavor experience. The food looks beautiful and tastes amazing. I would blame myself if I didn't like something here. It would be my failing not theirs. Ask questions if you don't know what something is and then order it anyway so you and your mouth will learn something new. When was the last time eating was an adventure of discovery? I know when it was for me: lunch! Seriously, Thank You.
Flavor explosion! Absolutely brilliant, late night eats. Get the fried rice.

4.5 average? No.

Went here to check out their late night menu, and left extremely disappointed & unsatisfied. 

1. Pork Banh Mi: $9?! Unbelievably overpriced for banh mi that is tiny, filled with shredded pork, and offers nothing unique whatsoever.

2. Fried Rice w/ Tri Tip: Rice was sticky & clumpy. Fried rice should not be like that. Honestly just seemed like rice topped with meat, sauce, and chilli paste. The poached egg on top had a rubbery texture.

3. Thai Basil Burger: It came dripping all over the place. It was a patty served on two slices of bread no better than wonder bread, I swear. Got it with an egg. Once again this "poached egg" was rubbery and strangely hard & tough.

Only later did I find out from a friend that they don't even have a cooking license...so everything is just heated up. That explains the chunky "fried" rice, the shredded pork in place of normally chargrilled meat inside a banh mi, and the rubbery poached eggs. 

Definitely will not be returning here. Definitely will not recommend this place to anyone.
What a great surprise!  Interesting, out of the box menu choices.  LOVE the late night menu.  Perfect place to go after a Bowl concert!

Delicious!!!!  One of our first stops when we come to SB.  This time we enjoyed the pork BahnMi, Beet Salad, and apple fennel salad.  If I had to sum it up in one word it would be 'fresh'.  She uses a lot of fresh mint, cilantro and Thai basil and it just leaves your mouth feeling happy!  Thank you Chef Cindy for another wonderful experience.

Can't go wrong with the rice bowls!! So tasty. Went in one night for late night eats and ordered the eggplant sandwich to switch it up and oh my!!! So flavorful and delicious. I'm ruined for eggplant sandwiches now. The staff is always nice, which I appreciate! Super casual place with a great sense of humor--and who doesn't love the ridiculous movies and cats on the wall?
Blue beef sandwich is incredible. Always a cool vibe for wifey and the kids. Has that SF sort of feel, which great organic produce and easy mellow service.

Cute place in Santa Barbara. Went around 12:30 on a Tuesday, there was no wait. We ordered and sat down at a table Shortly after, our food was brought to us. I ordered the fried rice with kimchi and a poached egg. I would recommend getting some type of meat as well, but it was still good. The sauce that they have at the counter is a must if you enjoy spicy food, but be careful because a little goes a long way. Chill atmosphere in a nice neighborhood.

Love everything in their interesting menu. You have to love food from other countries to like this place and know what to order. Also it is open until late at night so go here instead of a fast-food chain

Food was great, customer service left a lot to be desired. Today they forgot to call my name when my to go order was ready and my baked cheese became a cold cheese. 

3 stars because even cold it tasted pretty good.

Excellent little cafe right around the corner from H&M. Seating is a little tight if you have more than three people but all in all a great cafe to stop at for lunch. The crabmeat sandwich is something everyone should try. The rosemary lemonade was a pleasant surprise along with the cucumber infused water.

Awesome sandwich shop near the Paseo Nuevo shopping center in Santa Barbara. It's a tiny place that's worth finding. Had the pork banh mi sandwich. Although not a traditional Vietnamese banh mi as I've eaten at plenty of Vietnamese places, it was actually one of the best sandwiches I've ever had. It was exacly what I was hoping for when I was wandering State Street in hopes of eating something worthwhile. 

The shop itself has a comfortable, hip vibe inside. It was full but not overwhelming when I ate here. But plan on not getting a seat at one of the 5 tables. But if you do it's chill. Enjoy.

Ordered the Wake N Bacon and enjoyed it very much.  I think the dish was tasty but I don't think the components complimented one another.  The waffles didn't soak up the runny yolk from my poached egg in a way I wanted to.  I think if they made it separte then it would have worked a little bit better.

Great food, lots of flavor, great ingredients, gluten-free, dairy-free tasty options. Friendly service. The pork fried rice is specially delicious, overall a great place to eat. Try the thai tea options. Call, since Yelp has their hours wrong. I'd let them know and they said they contacted Yelp to correct the times without any luck.

Terrific!  A cute little place with friendly people and reasonable prices. The pork banh mi was off the charts. She asked if I wanted it spicy, which I always do, but usually it's a) not spicy, or b) so spicy that it's a sweaty exercise in perseverance. This was perfect. The flavor of the sandwich was front and center, with heat humming along behind keeping it exciting like a good drummer. Yummy!

Tasty food, tiny portions, friendly service. We had the creme brûlée breakfast sandwich and while it was fantastic the portion is half of a sandwich. It's barely worth the price with a buy one, get one on Axxess.

This place serves fresh food with Asian inspired flavors. If you are expecting cuisine that is true to traditional Asian dishes, this won't be your style; but if you want somewhere that has a twist to those dishes, you'll love it here! Also, they just started serving beer and wine, hooray!

Pros: fresh ingredients, delicious crusty-yet-chewy baguettes, nice employees (the owner, the woman with the curly dark hair, is awesome!), casual ambiance, late hours.
Cons: slightly pricey/smaller portions, gets really busy, weird hours.

If you see the night menu and get discouraged, don't worry! They'll oftentimes serve some of their evening stuff during the day--I just had a shrimp roll for lunch. ALSO, the reviews about the Thai Basil Burger using sandwich bread are outdated; I bought one and they used a baguette as well. Everything's yummy here!
Umm a little disappointed in this place. The fried rice was just rice with condiments and the sandwiches were just that a patty on bread
I had the blue owl fried rice with chicken and kimchee last night. The fried rice tasted pretty good but it wasn't all that, I guess it's on a reasonable price.

We happened to find this place on Yelp when we were looking for a place to eat in Santa Barbara. Best sandwich ever! We saw other reviews that said the portions were small - we found them to be perfect. Either way, we would have stilled lined up for one to go! Highly recommended!

Walked in, the girl said "2 minutes till we close, so could you take it to go", I said "it is to go".  So far, no big deal, even though people still there eating.  I looked up at the menu for 10 seconds and she shouted out "one minute!".  I left immediately.

This place is yummy!  I got the Wake n Bacon and it was perfect...the sweet, the savory...the runny egg...yum! Thai tea was great as well. Can't wait to go again to try something else on the menu.

Only 1 con:
Small amount of food for the price. I don't know if this goes for all items on the menu but the Wake n' Bacon was small and I could have eaten 2 of those . Would not come to eat here if I was really hungry.

Overrated!!!   This is a absolutely terrible experience! We arrived around 12:30am and they informed us the main menu is not working because the computer can't be access. And they gave me a piece of paper with only less than 10 items on it and the cheapest option cost $9. I then order the $10 sandwich and the fried rice with eggs $10 . When the food arrived, we were shocked! The food comes in with an delivery box and the amount of food we got was tiny where you can judge from the photo. Won't come back again, the place where has only the most expensive food . And they wouldn't help us to cut the sandwiches in half !

I wanted to like this. I ordered the beef BahnMi spicy and within three hours my body went into shock and I got food poising. Have been sick for the last couple of days  and upset that this happened. Had to go to the doctor and it was confirmed that it was food poisoning.

Cindy, the owner called me today to apologize for the situation. I appreciated her call back and spoke with her in regards to my situation and what I ate. We spoke about how many people ordered the same thing and that no one else got sick. I don't know if my body just rejected an ingredient but I thank you for the call.

Casual space, delightful and delicious! The strawberry, peach, fig, and goat cheese salad is amazing! So is the Pork Banh Mi sandwich. This is not the Vietnamese kind.  They use pulled pork and an interesting spicy sauce. The pecan pie was perfection.  A must for lunch.

This place rocks my socks!
I honestly can't get enough.
I eat here a few times a week because their Nam -toc burrito, BLTA, and fried rice with kimchi and all the spicey sauce are most delicious. my boyfriend n I seriously enjoy treating ourselves to these 3 things all the F-in time because it leaves our tummies happy and it's scrumptious, clean and nutritious !
Thank you see you lovely blue owls soon!

I do not understand why this spot gets so much hype, except that it's open late. The food sounds great but ends up being small and nothing special, and the wait can be lengthy for "fast food." Maybe if you've had a couple of drinks and almost nothing else is open then this would be better...

If you're not from Santa Barbara and are used to food options in cities, I doubt that you will really like this spot.

Let me first say, I would probably decapitate a man for their breakfast crabmelt. Let's be honest here. It's Friday night, you're having a good time with your friends and then you get hungry. Forget Velvet Jones! Forget Mad Dogs! Forget that New York Pizza place! Walk your drunk self to Blue Owl and get REAL, tasty, savory, filling food. You won't regret it!

Also it's amazing for lunch.

The Blue Owl is one of my favorite places to eat in SB.  

It's a great lunch spot or as it's better known for, a late night snack spot.  After eating here several times, I would say it's a place with fancy and delicious sandwich varieties.

Overall, the unique and creative culinary skills are tasted in the deliciously rich sandwich creations.  They're not necessarily cheap, but worth the money.  I find myself bringing out of town guests here to experience a unique culinary experience.

By far my go to is the crab melt sandwich.  The fresh veggies, high quality crab meat, frittata and buttery bread end up being a delicious combination of rich flavor and smooth texture.  After some experimenting on the menu, I find myself becoming more picky and sticking with what I KNOW is good, the crabmelt!

Another delectable and tasty favorite is the "wake n bake" sandwich.  It's not very sizable but, what it lacks in size it makes up for in deliciousness.  The combination of bacon, a runny poached egg, and the sweet creme brule on top make for a unique sweet and savory flavor combination.

The burgers(thai basil and peanut butter) are also quite tasty, especially with an egg on top.  I recommend the sandwiches over the other options.

If and when they get a rush, mostly late night after last call at the bars, it can occasionally be a bit of a wait.

Thanks for your creativity and delicious food.  Keep up the good work Blue Owl!
Great, friendly service, and even better food! I got the BLTA and shared an egg sandwich, both of which were excellent! Definitely would recommend!

Went here for breakfast this past Saturday around 11am. Lovely, attentive place, not too many people and pretty quiet. They have a short menu with similar inputs so it's doesn't take long to make a decision. I ordered the crab melt and after about 7 mins it came out. On arrival the sandwich looked a bit looked small (I have a ginormous appetite) and the few chips on the plate seemed measly but as I begin to eat I was impressed with the taste, quality and fillingness of the meal. The crab, egg, tomato ratio was perfect paired with the crunch of the baguette-like bread on the outside. My boyfriend got the pork belly and was equally impressed by his meal.

Really enjoyed my meal here and can't wait to go back!

This place is great. The vibe is cool and laid back.  A bit hipster. The food is freshly made in an open kitchen and delicious. It's an interesting Asian-American fusion. Actually reminds me a bit of many restaurants popular in Honolulu (we used to live there) since it's got a lot of American favorites with an Asian twist. The pork sandwich is amazing. So is the friend chicken sandwich. Fried rice is delicious. Pulled noodles were good but not a favorite. We've had Jillian as our waitress a couple of times and she is AMAZING, sweet, and attentive.

Everything that we have tried there is to die for!!!!!! So good and yummy!!! Each dish or sandwich has its own unique flavors and they are so original that I don't think there is anything like this in town. And they are open on weekends until 2 am!!! It's worth going and try their menu! We heard they are expanding next door so I am glad they are doing great as planning to stay. I hope the food quality stays the same in a couple of years!!!

Best after hours restaurant EVER. The thai basil cheeseburger w/ fried egg is the ultimate drunk meal.  (I've had it during the day too, and it is still just as amazing) ;) They also have an amazing wake n' bacon waffle sandwich for breakfast but I usually head to other establishments for breakfast simply out of habit.

Peach, Strawberry, Thai Basil, Candied Nuts, and Chévre Salad is refreshing like summer in a bowl. The Thai basil pairs well with peach and strawberry. The dressing is light yet lets the fresh summer produce shine through. The chévre adds a creamy flavor and texture. Rating: 4.8/5

Wake N' Bacon is a house-made waffle sandwich filled with poached egg, bacon, and topped with bruléed maple pastry cream. The waffle is fluffy, and makes the perfect blank canvas for the rich poached egg; crispy, salty bacon; and sweet, creamy maple crème brulée. It is bruléed perfectly and shatters like glass. Rating: 5/5

Banh Mi is stuffed with pork, cilantro, pickled veggies, and topped with oyster-chili mayo. Chef Cindy's banh mi is a reimagined Asian-style pulled pork sandwich. The pork is melt-in-your-mouth tender. The acidity in the pickled veggies balances out with the rich, fatty flavor of the pork. The cilantro lends a refreshing green flavor to the palate. The French bread is splendidly crusty on the outside and chewy on the inside. The oyster-chili mayo adds just the right amount of spicy kick. Rating: 4.8/5

Don't know why it's taken so long to find this place, it was right under my nose. The best sandwich joint in town....hands down. The owner, Cindy (whom I met today) started her career in a Thai kitchen. That inspired her amazing ingredient concoctions that are mouth watering. Everything freshly made and attentive staff. The muffuletta sandwich is terrific and I tried a bite of the crabwich and another (Thai infused).... Hard to pick a favorite. Keep it up Blue Owl....you got a good thing going there. Can't wait till you expand and start offering dinner!

Height of mediocrity.  Food was good and should be given 3-4 stars.  Out of this, out of that.  "Go get your water over there."  11 pm.   "You have to finish your drinks by 12. "   Ok We're almost half finished with our aluminum foil wrapped food on our sticky tables.
Great spot! They recently expanded and added few new items on the menu! Thai basil burger at night is a must try
Late night, succulent Asian fusion yumminess! Friendly, fast, and fabulously delicious :)) The go-to place for after dancing. . .
Great service and the bahn mi is absolutely amazing. Also, their quirky hours work for a late lunch or nighttime meal. Everything is very fresh and very, very delicious. Great place to go!

This place is amazing!  I tried it for the first time on a Friday morning and got the Wake n' Bake.  It was unique, delicious, indulgent, and only $6.  It's also the perfect amount of food.  I've yet to find that combination of things anywhere else in Santa Barbara.  I liked it so much, I brought friends with me for breakfast the next day.  I got the breakfast pizza this time, and then decided it will be my goal to try everything on her menu.  My friends all liked it so much, they finished breakfast and ordered lunch to-go right after.   Also, her cinnamon rolls will make your day.

Unique, casual lunch spot, healthy options, friendly service. Found this on Yelp, so glad we stopped here and not at the busier restaurants on State. My husband and I both had salads, very flavorful and tasty, we both are eating vegetarian and this was no problem here.

The food is good. We enjoyed the sandwiches -- turkey thyme, roasted eggplant and muffaletta -- as well as the chicken fried rice. We're not sure we experienced Asian fusion in the sandwiches. Maybe there is a hint of fish or oyster sauce there. They have a sign listing the three menu items without shellfish and, of what we ate, only the muffaletta was on that list. We would have been more adventurous but we were there for lunch and the menu is limited. For the adventurous who are limited by the lunch menu, we recommend the chicken fried rice which had us guessing ingredients to figure out how they achieved such great (and spicy) flavor.

This place was really good! 10/10 recommend. 

I had the Egg Melt and Thai-Basil Cheeseburger with Egg. (Not both whole, but half of each, hehe)
Delicious food and a fun atmosphere. Fun staff, spacious seating. Creative menu and not very big variety.

I had been wanting to try this place for a while.  Today was my chance so I went in for lunch.  I decided on the Bahn Mi with chicken.  I liked the crunchy roll it was on and the spice in the sandwich.  I just wish there was more of the pickled carrots, daikon and cilantro.  I'm not a Bahn Mi expert but I have had many of them and I would rate this as average.  Next time maybe I'll try a salad - they looked pretty tasted.

This place cleverly hacks Santa Barbara nonsense laws -- or at least the particular Santa Barbara nonsense laws that prevent food trucks from parking on streets. Where, y'know, food trucks park. The proprietor sets up her stand outside at 11:30 (more like 11:45 when I went) and uses Zen Yai's kitchen to whip up a few different dishes, including egg-topped fried rice, shrimp sandwiches, "peanut butter burgers," and trip-tip sandwiches with oyster mayo. 

These dishes all but force you at gunpoint to eat them -- and fast. Those with health concerns, know that they're as good for you as anything so compulsively wolfable isn't. Not to say Blue Owl tries to pull a Jamba Juice; I distinctly recall the promotion pretty naked playing the whole "food for after you've burnt the evening drinking" angle. They serve dishes in the Roy Choi tradition, meaning they taste apocalyptically buttery even when/if they don't actually contain butter. Not that they could fool anybody -- I mean, even decadent ancient Rome couldn't dream of peanut butter burgers.

People told me Blue Owl operates firmly on the take-your-shite-and-leave business model, but the woman in charge offered us a seat at one of Zen Yai's tables without hesitation. Plates, utensils, and water, too. We had ourselves a mini-restaurant going. I still feel like I'm languishing in the provinces when I eat food-truck food in a brick-and-mortar because of the quaintness fetishists around here -- remember when the Kogi truck came to town and we all waited in line for hours? -- but this stuff oughta hold me for the months before I move down to Babylon.
The late night is the best time to go to blue owl. I go only for the Thai basil burger and the tri tip sandwich. It is best to call it in so you won't have to wait in the long line at night.

The vegan fried rice is delicious and an attractive dish. Nicely presented with chili and sprouts on top. Very friendly service and appropriately relaxed atmosphere. They have silly posters of cats on the wall. I'm very compelled to return and try more!
Delici.. Friday Saturday and Sunday late night after dt you'll find them open !:) their tritip rice on point !!:)  and it's open late .. !

My mouth is watering just writing this review. This is my go-to place on a Saturday night out. I've had the peanut butter burger ($8) which has the perfect amount of peanut flavor to it. And my usual order is now the fried rice ($8) and the red curry shrimp roll ($8). Both are perfectly spiced for me. Just enough to clear my sinuses but not to much that I stop eating.  And I usually can't eat all this food so the cost spreads out over 2-3 meals. Winning!

The food here deserves 5 stars but I'm giving it a 4 star rating only because they only accept cash which I never have! When I do, this is my first stop late night gourmet grab stop. I would highly recommend the friend rice which is a meal in itself as well as the tri tip sandwich. They have some really interesting other choices but I can't seem to get away from these 2 because they are so amazing. This isn't just drunk food, its an experience.

Great food, but they forgot our order when we were the only customers in the place. We sat at the table waiting patiently (for about 30 minutes) until we finally checked. They apologized and said they would start marking the order, but it still took another 45 minutes. The new owner seems to be completely incapable of running this once great restaurant.

I was walking by this place and realize that I haven't been here in years and decided to stop by for lunch with my little boy. At first I was a bit worried because the menu wasn't so child friendly but thankfully the guy behind the register told me about an off menu grilled cheese and that's all I needed to hear. I had the banh mi with pork and it was divine. The bread was excellent and the salad was also nice. The guy behind the register seemed to have a French accent which may be explains why the bread was so damn good.  I definitely will be going back and having more lunches there, seems from the reviews that late-night food also would be pretty damn good. Check it out!

Very tasty and delicious food!! Just went for lunch today with my husband. We ordered Fried rice and mango mints salad. It was so good!! If you're vegetarian or trying to eat less meat. The restaurant is cute... perfect place for get together with friends for lunch.
The owner very nice and friendly. I highly recommended!!

Mmmm yes please! I'm never up late enough to try out the evening menu, but I've been here several times for lunch and it's always been great. The Bahn Mi is good (though it's more like a hipsterized version of a bahn mi if we're being honest), the root salad is amazing, and the service is always awesome. Local fav for sure!
Food was incredible! Best baked cheese sandwich ever. Kale salad to die for.
Good food and nice wine list, the front facing service could be a little more friendly.

Would love to review them, but we went today to eat there and apparently they're closed on Monday. But not according to their website. 

Might be an important thing to change so that potential customers aren't disappointed? Just a tip.

Will try to get back there and actually eat the food.

1) Viet Bahn Mi - tasty but way too much sauce, it was messy to eat and bun got soggy fast.

2) Thai Basil - was ok, not as great as what people say here but not bad. I wouldn't order it again though.

Definitely will return to try the other options on the menu, wish the chef can go lighter on the sauces, it is too much.

Stopped here for brunch...Great food! Small portions but creative and unique menu. I could have done without the random chips on the side but overall it was very tasty!

Food: great!
Atmosphere: kinda cramped and not so pretty
Service: great
Portions: medium

A nice place to stop and even better for carry out i imagine.

We tried the Turkey Thyme and loved it. The sandwich was nice and toasty. We were able to get the sandwich to go since we were in hurry. They were also happy to answer any questions we had about what was on the menu.

I really enjoyed the breakfast here.  Its small and gourmet.  The crabmelt was deliciously cooked with a perfect scrambled egg in a square shape and arugula to fit into their gourmwt english muffin. Crabmeat is almost like a tunasalad but jus with crab.  Must try

Other items ordered was their wake n bake. A brulee waffle filled with eggs and bacon strips. 

The breakfast flatbread was pretty much an english muffin tht is crispy topped with arugula, poach eggs, eggplant bits, and tomatos

Every item is made to order and their menu is pretty simple with a handful of items listed.  

This will be a stop I will make if im in the area again.

The food here is pretty good if you're looking for something a little different. The prices really aren't that bad either. 

I had the bleu beef sandwich. This was very good, but unfortunately it came with potato chips that fell flat. I was expecting maybe some greens on the side. I hear their salads are delicious.

The meal took quite a while to come out, which wouldn't be that bad if it wasn't for..

The uncomfortable seating. Cheap stools are all you get here. I guess maybe they are going for the take out crowd? Definitely lose a star here.

The iced tea was very good as well

This place is really good. Though the food is a bit heavy. I don't know that it deserves the single dollar sign on Yelp--I spent over $50 for two adults and two children.

The Guy Fiore burger was good, and my wife liked the chicken and biscuits.  The kids were happy with the grilled cheese.
This women is a genius. Best fried rice I have ever had. Everything on the menu is innovative, creative, and amazing. Must try.

My husband and I heard they were now open for dinner. So we had to go check it out
To start we ordered Shimp guacamole -You wouldn't think the Shimp and guacamole would work together but it does...and  they did not skim on the shrimp at all....ever bite had shrimp. 

For our main- I ordered the biscuits and chicken...OMG where do I start....the chicken was perfectly crispy with a hint of sweetness....the mash potatoes and gravy were so good but the biscuits were to die for, the buttery fluffy biscuits just melted in your mouth....they are a little piece of heaven.

My husband ordered pulled Noodles -  the spicy sauce was full of flavor, cilantro, green oinon, and soy sauce...so yummy. .... My husband let me have a small taste...not in the sharing mood with his noodles....lol 

For dessert we had the short cake- fresh fruit poured over delicious buttery fluffy mouth-watering biscuits, topped with whipped cream.....I had dreams about that desserts....

If you have not tryed there new dinner menu....you must!!!!

Not that this place is in desperate need of another 5 Star review, but here ya go!
Visiting the city; saw the mission and stopped here for lunch.  Everything we tried was good. 
Bathroom could use a little more loving, but nothing is wrong with it; I just see potential.

Fantastic place for lunch.  I had the Turkey Thyme sandwich.  the focaccia bread is amazing, perfect light crunch on the outside, soft on the inside.  Minimal menu, makes it easy to pick something.  Such a simple place but man that was delicious.  i will definitely be back.  thanks!

Blue Owl is a great place to get a quick meal.  The gluten-free fried rice with egg and chicken was amazing.  I like the egg as it was served - a whole fried egg served on top.  Overall it was like Thai fried rice but much less greasy.  The spring rolls were the most fresh I've ever had.  Thai iced tea was great.
The ambiance is kind of cafe-takeout.  It's great for a quick bite, but I wouldn't go for a quiet romantic dinner.  
But also the women running Blue Owl were super nice, made it really pleasant.

I love EVERYTHING Cindy makes...homemade sodas and bread, farmers market produce, fusion done awesome. Flavor profile is edgy and thoughtful. 

Cindy also catered our wedding and guests still rave of the food. 

My only gripe is that her late night doesn't open until 11:30! I'm too old for that!!!

The blue owl will just have such a special place in my heart. The service here is great, and they're always playing good music (hello 90s grunge throwback). They have interesting hours of operation, but I've tended to go here during their late night hours on Fridays and weekends. I highly, highly, highly recommend the fried rice!! It's spicy, but so good.

Holy moly this place is so good.  This is my friend's favorite restaurant in Santa Barbara and I can see why.  We got a Bleu Beef sandwich with an Owl Soda and I loved every bit of it.  Food aside, the place had some really cute and tacky decorations.  There's little gems hidden around the restaurant.  The only issue is that sometimes the wait can be a bit long and that during lunch hours, it could get hard to find a table for your party.  

As a note for everyone, they no longer offer the Wake'n'Bacon on their menu.  We asked them about it and the staff told us that it was too hard to maintain on their menu.

interesting place. Cool fusion food, and I really enjoyed all the interesting menu items they had. Fun diversion for late night state street food considering mad dogs is the only other place open super late.

This place has the worst customer service. When I see a big line, it's obvious something is good and business is booming. I enter with my boyfriend and half the lobby is closed? I understand that there was vandalism going on SO maybe in that case close the whole place. They kept over 45 people in a small entrance. really makes no sense. I also witnessed a guy, trying his best to get permission to use the restroom and the young lady really didn't let him and after rushing them to order because "she has a big line" she still argued with them that the restroom was closed due to "vandalism"(maybe they just didn't want to clean it) these customers claimed to know the owner and they laughed at his face just because he was drunk, I would have never done that! They spent 52$ on their order they should be treated like royalty!!!! Also if you guys know how busy it is after hours then why struggle having it open?? and seriously if vandalism was such a huge issue then maybe walk these people to the restroom and check it right after. you guys are only scaring people away. lady's in the front were extremely rude to others as well. because people are possibly under the influence of alcohol that doesn't mean you guys can just step all over your customers. Never coming here again. The two bigger women and the one who was obviously being trained were just a mess, if I owned this place I wouldn't leave them in charge on a Friday night with 40 customers putting a girl on a register who doesn't know anything and the other arguing with every customer that asks for the restroom as if we were kids being punished. This place is something else.
ALSO GAVE US ONE UTENCIL AND NO NAPKINS, NO BAG OR TRAY JUST A SANDWICH WRAPPED IN FOIL I HAD TO ASK FOR THE REST. COMMON SENSE!

I grew up kinda spoiled when it comes to great food. Additionally, I've eaten at some of the best restaurants in the United States. James Beard Award winners, Michelin starred restaurants, and more. This place is far and away the best restaurant of them all! Almost everything on the menu makes me want to cry as I eat it, it is THAT good! My favorites to date: Tri-tip fried rice, thai basil cheeseburger, and the red curry tofu & shrimp sandwich. It's worth a multiple hour drive just to eat this food. Just sayin......

I had the fried rice with pork on the late-night menu one Saturday night after leaving SoHo. My rice was extremely greasy and under-cooked. The rice had a raw crunch about it. I would not eat that item again.
One of my favorite sandwiches in Santa Barbara. The Pork is fantastic, love the use of cilantro and cabbage. They also do a nice version of hot wings. My wife loved her fried rice salad

Eggplant sandwhich for the win. Sooooo good. Was going to save this for a late-night snack but I was hungry and once I started one bite I was curious as to what the next bite would bring. Very flavorful. I couldn't believe what was happening. Pure ecstasy.

They have kombuchas, Thai tea, and Yerba Mate by Guayaki if you are thirsty. 

The server with the mustache was super friendly and informative. Really cool guy. 10/10 for friendly service.

After hearing many good reviews from friends and online sources, I finally decided to try out the relatively new eatery in Santa Barbara, The Blue Owl. The menu looked fair, enticing, and varied, and the location is perfect if you don't want to fight the crowds. There was the typical SB riffraff of state street circling the scene, but it was more of a turn on than turn off. That is until a guy decided to moon a couple women sitting in the window, but I digress. I ordered the peanut butter burger and my date ordered the tri tip sandwich. Her sandwich came out first and I had to wait a good five to ten minutes for my burger after she was served. No big deal. I noticed they cooked my burger in a mini oven similar to those used by less than reputable sandwich chain shops, but that's fine, space is limited. The tri tip sandwich was a let down. It tasted more like a roast beef bahn mi than tri tip, and if it was listed as such I would have gladly paid the $8 for it, but a tri tip sandwich it is not. Disappointed, we waited for my burger. I was nearly dreading the tin foil wrapped ball of food like substance I was about to receive, wondering if it would be just a bun with peanut butter and cow meat that would disappoint (much like the mooner from earlier). What I received was a small slice of heaven. Spicy and tangy, the tamarind peanut sauce sent me to a whole new world, tantalizing my tastebuds, and leaving my tongue craving for more. While the slaw could have used some acid from lime or sweetness from carrot, the sauce carried the show. It was served on two slices of toasted bread, buttery and soft with the perfect golden crust. The burger was cooked more than my liking, but I can only expect so much from a late night eatery. The service staff was friendly and the cooks were upbeat, enthused about the fusion food they were preparing. Over all I'm happy that this place took over the Bitterman's shop front, and I expect great things from them in the future. Just please, change the name of your tri tip, it isn't worthy of the hallowed name. I was a bit put out by the fact that their porkducken was 86ed and the kimchee dish didn't have the menu, but for the peanut tamarind chutney, I would gladly return.

Back again.  Fantastic!

This time I had the thai basil cheeseburger with poached egg.   OMG.  This was unbelievable.   
My wife had the BLTA also amazing.   Everyone in our group loved their food.  Thanks again.  This might have to become one of my regulars when I'm in town.
I have tried to eat here twice, but had no luck. Menu looks great, but staff always seem overwhelmed and service is slow. I will update this revie when I try again.
A Hidden Gem - Interesting menu items - Fried rice is Unique and Tasty.  My friend had the peanut butter hamburger.
Amazing sandwiches!  Cheese sandwich and turkey thyme sandwich are favorites.  Delicious lunch spot.
Unique Asian fusion, open late and revolving menu. Staff was friendly. I enjoyed their duck and they have delicious rice. Great Thai tea as well!!

My new spot for a kickass late breakfast or lunch. They know how to make flavors pop with their simply executed bites I had the breakfast flatbread w/eggplant, the egg was poached perfectly! I enjoyed a glass of their homemade Rosemary lemonade and ordered the spicy pastrami for an afternoon snack!

If we're out late drinking on a friday/saturday night, we're going to The Blue Owl... AMAZING fried rice with a gooey poached egg - just as good the next morning when you're hung over. The Tri-tip sandwich is the best I've EVER had.. Last time we tried the crab melt, but I actually liked the egg sandwich better. 
Love the local, relaxed vibe from the young cooks/staff. They have something special going on!!! 
Brought my parents here while they were visiting one weekend, and they were VERY impressed.. Never had anything like it. 
MMMMMMMM.. I think we'll have to stop by tonight :)

This place is amazing. Every single time I go in I am get the same welcoming atmosphere and delicious smells from the kitchen. I'm addicted to the fried rice which isn't going to surprise you once you order it. AJ always gives me the best recommendations I could eat. I haven't left here disappointed or hungry ever and it'll be the same for you. This is a regular lunch stop during the work week for sure!

Once again "The Blue Owl" has made for a perfect evening. It has to be the best late night food, I have ever tasted. And no where else can you find food like this! I laugh at the people walking by with a old slice of pizza. They all look in. And wonder why they didn't eat at the Owl? It may be a big line. But there is a reason. And it is worth it period:P

I ate at the blue owl and had an amazing lunch!!! I tried the turkey thyme sandwich, the crab melt, and the italian sando and each one was better than the last. Cindy, the owner and chef, makes her own bread and it is amazing!!! Way to go Cindy!!! Your creativity and palate produce amazing food. thank you! I cant wait to try your cookies.

For dinner order the handmade pulled noodles.  For lunch the bahn mi.  The burger is decent but kind of ridiculous. Only order it if you want a bunch of different noshes with your patty serving like an appetizer plate. 

My new summer favorite is the bacon lettuce tomato avocado (BLTA) with basil mayo. If it's too hot to cook and you don't have AC eat this. 

Hours are limited, and they are closed Sunday through Tuesday.

Update: Still love this place, just wish they would get a stronger exhaust fan. It can be a bit overwhelming, and my clothes often smell like Blue Owl when I get home. But still eating here because it's that good.
