mmm the thai basil burger is my favorite item on the menu. Along with the burger, I've had the fried rice and thats also delicious. This place has amazing asian fusion food, and I have had the Blue Owl at least once every two weeks because of how good it is.
The price is very much worth it for the quality of the food, and you shouldn't have any issues with parking.

Overpriced, greasy, pass...

This was one of the restaurants that was opened late.  Upon arriving, I realized the food was Vietnamese fusion.   I ordered the pork fried rice and the banh mi.  Both dishes are overpriced and brings shame to Vietnamese food.  The banh mi was more of a sandwich than banh mi and the friend rice was soaked in oil.  Such a dissapointment.

Where did you hear that the blue owl doesn't have a "cooking license" because you may want to check your facts.
A) cooking license isn't even a permit one can attain, if the facility is zoned for a restaurant and you file your business license under the restaurant option, an onsite meeting with the health inspector is all that's needed to cook.
 
B) Cindy (the owner) sources from the farmers market. I see her shopping there, but you're from LA so you would know nothing about the community here and how Cindy actually does use responsible and fresh ingredients

C) if you don't like the blue owl fine, say that. At times I have been less than stoked on the establishment.
-long lines
-poor service
- hot coffee served in a compostable cup meant for cold drinks which exploded all over my car
Just to name a few.
BUT DONT MAKE THINGS UP AND POST THEM TO YELP, BECAUSE:
A) your mother taught you better than to lie when you didn't get what you wanted

B) your hurting a local business that is trying to do the right thing by buying fresh ingredients that are local and organic

Sheesh! If you don't like a place just don't go there, chanes are the business would be happier to not have to deal with you. But DO NOT spread lies and slander all over yelp.

One of my favorite places in Santa Barbara. Every single thing I've have is delicious. Definitely consider trying the peanut butter burger. The food is delicious. Put their pork in/on everything. Hands down the best late night food I've had anywhere in the country!
Oh, Man. OH MAN! So good. Sooo Sooo Good. Sorry for a less than cerebral review. But man or man. Oh my gosh. So good.

Can't stop thinking about how good this place is!!! I LOVE their fried rice with the egg on top and their thai burger is nothing I've ever tasted. This place used to only open on weekends at 11pm but lovin' how its open during the day! This place was such a great find..and it's great drunchies too (:

I came here one time and my friend ordered the whole menu...now that's impressive.

This place would get 4.5 stars if that feature was available.

The good stuff:
Blue owl has amazing good fusion food. Last time I came here it was lunchtime during the work week. I got the Banh Mi Sandwich with pork instead of the usual beef. I've never tried the beef version, cuz I'm picky about my Banh Mi sandwiches and generally in any Vietnamese deli shop I've been to, beef is not a common meat used for these sandwiches. Hence, I defer to pork and let me tell you...I did not go wrong. That sandwich is YUMMY! It has the right amount of umami, spice, acidity and texture. It's a must on my list for things to devour.

The ok stuff: 
My bf tried the crab melt sandwich. It was good but in comparison to the pork Banh Mi, it was blah. Although we both agreed the house made English muffin was bomb and had great texture in of itself, the sandwich overall was a bit too salty almost to the point of too much salt or fish sauce (Yes, fish sauce...it's Asian fusion peeps) and had an imbalance with texture. It was just too soft and gooey and the frittata patty definitely did not help. However, don't knock it until you tried it. On another occasion my co-worker tried it and he loved it. I think this varies with your palate. Personally, for me I don't recommend it when there's something better on the menu.The staff was good, causal and friendly. Nothing extraordinary or horrible.

The challenges:
   *The ambiance is very much a hole in the wall kind of place meets hipster. Small, few tables and chairs and odd pieces of painting. I definitely felt I could be somewhere in the Frisco with the interesting menu display and the different kitchen setup. 
   *The place is small so there's not much space to eat if you have a party of 5 or more. Don't eat in if you have a large group, order to-go. Also, the whole ordering flow seems confusing, slow, and definitely not efficient. Sometimes, the person that takes your order is also working in the kitchen. So this may add to the confusion and delay in one's food. 
   *The lack of a clean table. The concept here is self-busing, which is okay but the times I've been here the tables were still unclean and/or had some crumbs. They can use a little help in this area. If the customer has to bus their own stuff, then please make sure you have a clean table. 

Recommendation:
Overall, this place is still dope. Come here to eat great food. It's a must on my list for tasty food with an extra kick. You don't have a lot of these places in SB, so I highly recommend taking a day off from your usual lunch haunts and run down here for a Banh-Mi sandwich.

I came here for lunch with a friend. It was after the lunch rush so not many people were there. The establishment was smaller than expected. I ordered the B.L.T.A., which wasn't bad, but it wasn't amazing either. I was expecting a slightly larger portion and something more flavorful. It did seem healthy though, having been made from natural ingredients and served with a salad. Something which was strange: the utensils and cups were all placed out in the open, next to the entrance, and customers are allowed to pick them up on their own.

This place has a crazy reputation for its late night food and vibe. I may come back for that but probably won't for lunch.

Ok food, but kinda weird too. It's not bad tasting as far as just food goes, but I feel the salad was just a little on the oily side and the fried rice was... a Hipster's interpretation of Asian fried rice?

DELICIOUS herb lemonade... not too sweet and wonderfully refreshing.

This review is for the Chicken Banh Mi sandwich only.  I didn't try the other menu options, however a couple of them that I wanted wasn't available anyway.

The bread was really good, nice and frenchy.  Soft on the inside, crisp on the outside and it tasted really fresh.  I asked for the chili/mayo sauce on the side and it was left off the plate entirely so I had to ask for it on the side.  They ended up just giving me a side of the red Thai chili paste (similar to those you see in Thai restaurants).  The sandwich was considerably dry, not just for the lack of the mayo/chili sauce, but there wasn't any pate.  Perhaps I'm wrong, but I thought traditional banh mi sandwiches were smeared with pate on one side?  There wasn't a lot of pickled veggies either, making the sandwich more dry.  For a chicken sandwich, it was ok but I wouldn't consider it a banh mi.  Maybe the kitchen was just off that day.
They serve a poached egg and bacon waffle sandwich with creme brulee on top.
Banh Mi and Turkey focaccia are two of the best sandwiches we've ever had. Absolutely delicious and high quality food.

I ordered the Fried Rice bowl with chicken and kimchi add ons, such a great choice! Not only did I savor every ingredient, but the food tasted really fresh. From the cilantro to the seasoning on the chicken, everything was very yummy.Honestly this is such a cute little spot with amazing food, might have just found my new favorite little lunch spot.
Amazing late night food. Best fried rice in town. The tri-tip sandwich was so spectacular that our table ordered two more. If you're up late and hungry, do this!

Ugh going to be that person :/

Coworkers absolutely LOVE this place & fried rice. It's a common thing to see in the break room.

Just tried it for the first time... and well... if you're looking for fancy/gourmet fried rice this is the place! If your looking for just fried rice, save some $$ and go to panda! 

Even getting it with no egg & no meat cost the same as the others ($12). 

I'm probably just one of the few who didn't find it amazing, but everyone else swears by it.
Delicious asian-american fusion. Unique dishes and fun take-out joint atmosphere. Bonus points for their late-night menu!

The bouncer was very rude and demeaning towards people of color. I understand, my job is retail, but that's not the way to go about asserting himself. I come here all the time, I'm not going to come anymore if this bounce is outside...

Fantastic interesting menu that changes regularly (or irregularly). I eat here frequently. I am SB resident and this is one of my top three regulars. Great location off State St in the middle of downtown.
I'm only giving one star because it's the lowest I can give. Terrible experience and wouldn't recommend.

this place is really good for late-night eating.  However, the place is way too small and it gets REALLY packed at night.  So you will feel like you're at a concert while ur waiting for your food.  Regardless, the food was delicious.  We ordered the thai basil burger and the banh ni, and they were very tasty.  If i ever come back to santa barbara, i will most definitely stop by.  Hopefully it won't be as crowded haha
Great little stop. Had the rice bowl with chicken and avocado. Awesome! Great staff and cool little room.
Food is awful. Expensive for what you get.  We had a small service dog with us and were forced to eat outside out of Styrofoam dishes.  Can't say enough bad things about this place.

The staff is very friendly, I ordered a peanut butter burger, unfortunately they ran out. The lady that was helping us apologized and recommended the tomato basil sandwich. It was GREAT! And because they didn't have what i initially ordered, they gave me a slice of pecan pie. The family and i were just driving through, looking for nice quality place to eat, im glad we stopped here.

I've ordered food from this restaurant a few times for my office lunches. The food is good, BUT. The last time I ordered, this past week, I waited more than a half an hour past when they said it would be ready. This is a BIG problem when it is a lunch meeting for an office. The meeting starts and there's no food. BUT a bigger problem was that while I was waiting, the person at the counter who was taking the orders and operating the cash register and handling all kinds of stuff at the counter, went into the kitchen to help, I suppose, and she reached into a bin of some kind of food and crammed it into one of those Chinese fast food containers with her dirty hands. No gloves. No washing before putting her hands all over the food she was about to give to a customer. Her hands were all over everything up front and now she's got her hands in the food. She repeated this action a few times. It made me cringe. I was glad I wasn't going to that meeting. And I won't be ordering food there anymore. Somebody, please call OSHA.

Good option for lunch and late-night dining. Order in line and find self-seating on a couch, communal or traditional tables.  If you are in a hurry at lunch, you might want to try somewhere else. They have not mastered a to-go line and downtown can get packed at lunch. This place has a unique blend of Asian cuisine made with French sensibility. I love the sandwiches. The bread is substantial so I actually get mine in a wrap. The burger is pretty interesting...not the norm.  So if you are a purest, try one of their other wonderful dishes. I doubt you will be disappointed

I am a Santa Barbara Local and have been looking for a place like this!  The food was excellent. (probably the best bahn mi I have ever had, and the homemade noodle bowl had so much flavor)  It was casual and just a chill place with good prices.  I am excited to go back and try the burger with a duck egg on it.  Also I am a pecan pie enthusiast and the one at the Blue Owl was amazing to say the least.  Overall a visiting the Blue Owl was great surprise as to how good a small, non-pretentious restaurant can be.  Thanks

This place gets five stars for one item on the menu.  The Thai Basil Burger (with a fried egg).   It continues to be the benchmark for me for burgers in SB.  American Ale, and Pace are pretty damn good with their homemade bread, but this one burger takes them on straight up flavor.
I won't comment on ambiance or service.  They are fine and nothing fancy.  But get this burger before having an opinion.

Explosively delicious sandwiches. The Blue Cheese Roast Beef is warm and comforting while intensely flavorful. I also had a lovely homemade soda, and sampled a pork bahn mi special. It's a cute little place that is all about the fresh, flavorful food.
We ordered the Bahn-Mi, Red Curry Shrimp Roll, Fried Chicken Sandwich. All were amazing.

Fried rice with beef and poached eggs - yummy! Lots of meat, just the way I like it.  Well seasoned and unique concept. Asian fusion food with options of full salad or brown rice or gluten free.  Casual atmosphere and eclectic decor with several couches to sit and eat.  It's a blend of things that on  the surface doesn't seem to go together but somehow they make it work.  Definitely will be visiting this place next time we're in Santa Barbara.

This place does not sell bear nor wine after midnight but they don't provide this information on their website. When I suggested to the waitress that it would be fair to add this information (since we drove for a while to get here and waited in line) she started yelling at me, she appeared to be intoxicated.

Located in Downtown Santa Barbara, The Blue Owl offers a large selection of sandwiches and salads. Many of these options have an Asian twist. 

1. What is the restaurant like?
This fast casual restaurant screams hipster.

2. What should you get here?
According to the staff member that helped us, the most popular items are the fried rice and the Banh Mi. We ordered:

-  Banh Mi (choice of protein on a toasted baguette with cilantro, pickled veggies, oyster-chil mayo) - We've had our fair share of banh mis, and this sandwich was good, but not necessarily special. 
- Egg Melt (choice of protein, frittata, provolone, mayo, and tomatoes on ciabatta) - We swapped the ciabatta for the foccaccia and selected chorizo for our protein. The slightly spicy chorizo melded harmoniously with the melted provolone cheese and frittata. Needless to say, we thoroughly enjoyed this sandwich. 

3. Other things to note?
- Everything is made to order, so be prepared to wait.
- The menu can be hard to follow. There is a daytime and nighttime menu, but it was somewhat difficult to decipher which items belonged under lunch vs. dinner. 
- They sell Zapp's chips. 

If I am ever close by, I might return to The Blue Owl. Maybe.

Soooooo good! I had the shrimp roll which was insanely good. Tofu, shrimp, cilantro all in a ciabatta roll. 
Skip the cookie jar and just save room for the food. All are huge servings with no lack of flavor. We shared a seat at one of the community tables and chatted up a frequenter. Everyone was stopping in for a late night treat. You should too!
The guy at the register was adorable too.
The food was not good at all!! Went because of all the great reviews but our family did not like anything we ordered. Decor and service were good.
My boyfriend and I ordered the wake n bacon and the Bahi pork sandwich. Both were delicious. The wake n bacon was our favorite, but it is very small and not worth the 9 dollar price.

Big fan of The Blue Owl. First of all, it is one of the only places that is open late (till 2:30AM). Second, the Grilled Cheese Tomato is the perfect late night sandwich. Finally, the guy that works behind the register is so polite and sweet. Lovely place. Do check it out
Not a ton of options at 1:30am, so we went to this place. Strange menu. I ordered a hamburger and they gave it to me on sandwich bread. Great place to go if your drunk and don't care.

Love this place! It's eclectic vibe and interesting decor is a great addition to its superb food. We were looking for some late night food - and were lucky enough to stumble upon this place. The gentleman taking our order filled us in on what's good to have and how the place got famous for its rice.... we had a toasted cheese and fried rice dish - both were delicious! Can't wait to come back to try the burrito and donuts ..

This place is deliciously quaint and always great customer service when deciding on their impeccable small menu! :)

Homemade Dutch crunch rolls!

One of the best late night food options available in downtown Santa Barbara!

There's just something about their fried rice; maybe it's the poached egg or the way they cook their tri-tip (which I highly recommend adding to your fried rice). Anyway, it's become a staple for my "post downtown shenanigans cravings."

It would be nice if it was a tad bit cheaper, but then again the price is rather fair for Santa Barbara and for the amount of fried rice you get. (I always have leftovers for the following morning, or I easily share it with someone the night of).
Cindy is a food maven. The Blue owl is soul food for modern day foodies. Get in there and surrender.
Wow! What a neat little place. Great beer and great food! Bahn Mi sandwich was amazing! Great fusion eatery with fun atmosphere.

Fried rice with an extra poached egg on top with some chili sauce is defs the best!!! Thank you blue owl for the late night drunchies.

This place never disappoints! I wish you were open all day.

Friendly staff and talented cooks. 

I will return again and again!
Delicious root veggie salad. Friendly & prompt service. This is a small restaurant with no bathroom on site.

This place is exactly what downtown Santa Barbara needed! It's open late for the night life, those with drunk munchies, late night employees (bartenders, bouncers) or anyone with the desire for a delicious midnight meal. Even if you aren't into the bar scene, it's totally worth it to save your appetite and cruise down state street to eat at the blue owl. The food here is phenomenal!

I left Santa Barbara 4 years ago and I still dream of the Blue owl. The peanut butter burger is truly the best thing I've ever tasted, the Thai basil is a close second. I drove through sb and literally bought 3 just to freeze for later  pleassee open more locations throughout CA

Disappointment, much? :(

1) They don't even have a cooking license, so they only "heat" pre-made items. No cooking allowed, period. Everything's just refrigerated 

2) Wake n bacon : not worth the price. Yummy, but not worth it.  

3) Crabmelt : Super fishy tasting, def not quality ingredients.  


Especially after learning that they don't cook any of their items in-house, it was a huge turn off.  Tasted very un-fresh and wasn't pleasant.
The tomato basil grill cheese was delicious. This was my first time here but I'm definitely coming back!

Walking by the restaurant we could not resist
the aroma. The menu is Asian Fusion...
so delicious.

I came here once before and got the bahn mi sandwich and a thai tea which were good but nothing that would have made me need to come back to try other dishes. 
Well, I came back again after a friend suggested we eat here. Trying to be on the healthier side, I decided to order the fried rice salad. To me, it sounded like something I'd randomly put together at the house when I need to get rid of leftovers, but then I was caught off guard when it came out looking super healthy with bean sprouts and sunflower seeds on top. I was a little nervous because I didn't want to go THAT healthy. LOL. Fortunately, I started eating the salad and discovered a wonderful mix of fresh greens, herbs, peppers and tomatoes, along with perfectly cooked riced. There was a good amount of flavor in every bite. I would definitely go there again for this dish and am curious to see what else they have to offer that may surprise me.

Best late night place to eat ever!!! Their tri-tip sandwiches and fried rice are to dieeee for. The only issue I have with this place is the woman is pretty rude. Kind of understandable as shes dealing with obnoxious drunks all night but come on! That's what you signed up for! 

Hoping that she'll be able to open up this place every night instead of just Thursday through Saturday late night. I'd definitely go there!

If the people were friendlier and the portions were bigger for the price, I'd give it 5 stars!
The fried rice in this place is amazing. Lots of choices what to have served with the rice. Small and cozy, feels like someone dining at home.
Nice and cute location, best of all, the food was awesome. I had the tri tip burrito with fried rice??!? nuf said

I've been wanting to try this restaurant because everyone raves about it. Today I tried this place for the first time and I'm not too impressed. The place is very small and you have to order at the counter. The iced tea I ordered came in a 6 oz cup. When I asked for a refill, she charged $1, which is the first time I've ever been charged for an iced tea refill. My crab met was very tasty with lots of flavor. However, my date's pork sandwich was super dry and had hair in it. They didn't cut either of the sandwiches in half, which would be nice. I might go back and give them another shot, but not for a while.
Great sandwich spot with a variety of choices for meat, chicken, and veggie fans. The crabmelt is a must have! The eatery is quick, convenient, and laid back. A good look for Santa Barbara!
Food was great and came out fast, 4 stars because it was a little pricey but comparable to other places in town. Got the Pork Banh MI and Crab Sandwich for about $10 each.
So glad i stumbled upon this gem! I got fried rice salad with pork and the wife had the bah mi

Reviewing the Fried Rice Salad. I got the food "to go" so I cannot comment on presentation in restaurant. The presentation as a to go item is very good, however. It has a lot of color and supplies just enough dressing. It has great flavor, but I don't notice the Mint or Basil too well. There is a good balance of spring mix salad and kale. Kale sometimes can be over powering. There is a nice crunch in every bite! The cucumbers and snap peas really aide to this. The fried rice is not greasy and adds great texture. I wish the alfalfa sprouts were premixed: they can clump up. 

Overall would definitely recommend this menu item as a vegetarian option for a quick lunch.
I like to consider myself a sandwich Conness sore. I have to say their pork bánh mì sandwich is one of the best sandwiches I have ever had. If you have not tried it, I highly suggest you do.

I was expecting a lot from the reviews. I would say it's 3.5 more than a 4 star rating. We ordered the bunh mi, eggplant, and bake n wake. Bunh mi was ok. The eggplant sandwich was on the charred side. The bake n wake was AWESOME. I'd probably go back for that sandwich. Although it's a bit on the small side it's definitely worth it!

This is my favorite lunch stop. The owner is fantastic and really knows how to pair flavors together. I often see her at the farmers market, supporting local farmers, and picking up all the fruits and veggies that go into each meal. I've never had a bad meal there. I love the eggplant sandwich and the BLTA. They also have super yummy salads. I like the tomato and feta salad, I add pickled snow peas to mine. They have great bread there too!

Stumbled upon this place when my boyfriend and I were searching for late night grub after a concert. The girl working the counter was nice and the food  came out quick! We ordered the tri tip bahn mi and pork fried rice, I highly recommend both. It was a good portion for two people, and super flavorful. Can't wait to come back!
Pork Bahn Mi Sandwich was awesome.  Crunchy bread, perfectly marinated veggies, and spicy chili sauce.  That is all..  I will be back..

Sandwich portions are on the small side and they were all priced around $9.  I actually laughed when they brought my plate out because of how few potato chips came with my sandwich.  It was more like a potato chip garnish than a side.  Less than 10 full chips worth. Made me question why they bothered.  The only answer that made sense to me was that they were intended to be an optional topping.  

The quality of the food was above average.  I ordered the Tri tip sandwich with blue cheese and caramelized onions.  The cashier who took my order was very pleasant.  She made suggestions and described menu items well.  The cook who brought out my sandwich had no reaction when I told her why I laughed at my plate.

Overall good quality, but not a great value

I've only ever gone to blue owl for late night bites, but everything has been delicious! My go to is the egg melt with crab. The egg melt has got scrambled eggs with melted cheese served on ciabatta with spring green.  Then you can add Spanish chorizo or crab. I opt for the crab!! It's a crab salad with decent sized lumps of crab meat. This is to die for!

My husband usually gets the peanut butter burger, which comes on sourdough. I can't seem to wrap my head around a peanut butter burger, but the one bite I had tasted like Thai food. My husband is obsessed though.

They are a small restaurant, have beer on tap. I highly recommend.
Asian fusion sandwiches, burgers, gourmet salads, fried rice  .. ... rustic decor, a nice relaxing coffee shop ambiance.

Just ate the Turkey Thyme sandwich from The Blue Owl at Canon Perdido. It was on fresh baked warm focaccia, with shaved turkey, spinach, cilantro, and red onions. The focaccia was perfectly crunchy and moist and all the ingredients combined for total bliss. This sandwich had so much flavor, I was completely elevated.

I had the Thai basil burger which was more like a grilled cheese sandwich with a flavored patty - absolutely loved it. My friends ordered the shrimp roll - amazing shrimp tofu mix with the red curry sauce, and the pork bahn mi sandwich (My favorite). The food was delightfully amazing and fresh. It was a little more on the spicy end, but was worth every bite. Overall great service and great food! I'm looking forward to coming back here again!

the chef is awesome. she will make little changes to the menu so it's exactly right. the cookies are really yummy too but they sell our fast. luck of the draw. they had these little yummy salted butter cookies that were ridic.

So we finally came back after they moved locations. 

We have never been here for their early menu. I got the Wakin Bacon and the bf got the Egg Sandwich. The portions are pretty small and the plates they use are tiny too. Why does that matter? Well, we tried to cut out sandwiches to share, but things kept flying off the plate. I'll take credit for partial dexterity issues. =P

The Wakin Bacon is filled with creme brûlée in the waffle. Although the idea sounded interesting, the execution was not what I expected. There was too much creme brûlée and it overpowered the dish. Coming from me, a person whose sweet tooth is almost insatiable, that is not a good thing. The poached egg was nicely cooked, the bacon was crispy, maybe a bit too overcooked for me. Because of the sweetness, the chips that were served were a perfect compliment to the sandwich. Salty to counterbalance the sweet.

The Egg Sandwich was crispy and tasty. The bf enjoyed it and the sliver he cut off for me was yummy. This was a bit larger than what I had, and since he doesn't like to mix sweet and savory, he decided not to try my dish. Really good for him, since his sweet tooth is minuscule compared to mine.

It's great that they have their own place now. The unfortunate thing is that they don't have air conditioning and they also don't have a screen door to keep out the flies. In other words, if it's a hot day, it's better to get your order to go. Even not on a hot day, it wouldn't be a bad option either actually.

There is limited seating, so if you are coming with a big group, don't expect to find a place to rest your rump and chow down unless it is empty when you arrive.

The service is friendly and they have some interesting combinations.
Simply incredible. The staff is fantastic, and the food is even better. The pork Bahn mi changed my life.

Bummed that it has taken me so long to go. People have always told me to try and am glad I finally have. Been back 4 days in a row. All sandos I have tried have been  awesome... Crab melt being my favorite so far. Strongly recommend

My crabmelt thingy was super delicious and I even ordered a second one--the portions are a bit small for what you pay, but the food is high quality and ultra delicious. The inside is very cute and cozy and the late night menu is open until 3 am. There weren't a whole TON of options, but it's pretty great for the niche it's created. Have already been back since my first visit and will go probably a ton more before I get sick of it and move on to my next thing.

Wow! The food is so full of flavor. You can smell it just standing out front. Absolutely the most delicious eggplant sandwich I've had! The focaccia bread is grilled so it's nice and toasty. The ingredients blended so we'll together and the portion was perfect for me (this sandwich is a bit rich). The blat was also awesome and even the plain fried rice was amazing (Thai fried rice flavor). The price is just right which will keep us coming back. The staff is very accommodating when ordering for our daughter. Excellent staff, great service.

Learning to really appreciate this place. The food is Asian/Korean fusion and packed with basil and spicy flavors.

I recommend the fried rice and PB burger.

It's open late and has self-serve water with plenty of seating.

You're going to need to try this place. We had the Bahn-mi and fried rice with a couple of beers. So good. Everything was fresh - including the baguette - with a ton of flavor and a little heat. Just go.

One of our favorite places we ate at while in Santa Barbara; I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a tasty and fresh bite to eat. The decoration was also cute as well. Thanks to The Blue Owl!

Best Bahn Mi sandwich and side salad I've ever had!  I love great sandwiches. The Blue Owl's Bahn mi has THE perfect baguette bread- a flavorful crisp, crunchy crust on the whole bread, and very light, fluffy inside that perfectly absorbs this sauce from heaven. The pork was succulent and the sauce really brought out the meat flavor, balanced perfectly well with crisp, fresh veggies inside.

The White Ale was the perfect complement to my lunch here.

I don't want to just come back, I want to bring all my friends and family to let them experience this good ness for themselves!

Came with the in laws
Everyone ordered the tri tip sandwich- which was really a glorified bahn mi. 
I ordered the breakfast crabmeat sandwich which was good
Open late at night 
Decent service

Really great sandwiches.  I had the salami which was excellent, I highly recommend it.  The place had a weird vibe, though.  

The woman working the register didn't seem to know what she was doing, and there was talk radio coming from this vintage radio in the corner of the restaurant.  The service was pretty slow, considering they were only making my sandwich and there was no one else in front of me in line.

It's okay, a good effort for a Santa Barbara restaurant.  I had the pork bahn mi.  The flavored were good, however the pork was not as tender as I would have liked it (a bit dry as well).  I did like the flavors of the sauce they used and how perfectly toasted the bun was. 

Would I go back?  I don't think so unfortunately - my expectations are pretty high though for a good bahn mi (being Chinese and all)
Amazing bahi mi and great rice bowls. Best spot to stop into after bar hopping for the night. Great late night eats after having a bunch of drinks. Must check out
Staff is crazy lovey. Great for dinner. Everyone loved their meals. Chicken fried rice, BLTA, salmon salad,  Thai basil cheeseburger with egg. BLTA like no other BLTA you've ever had.
Delicious!  Stopped here on a road trip for lunch. Shared beet salad and fried rice salad.  Split fried rice for our kiddos.  Would definitely recommend. Nice casual dining spot.
Just a great spot with my favorite dish in SB. Kimchi, vegan fried rice( I'm not vegan) and sprouts. I dream of this dish when I am away. Cool eclectic seating makes it fun too!

My new favorite lunch spot.  Cozy setting, super friendly staff that offer helpful recommendations and delicious high quality food.  Gluten free options galore!    The fried rice kale salad is my go-to!   May be worth the drive from LA just to indulge my craving.  We will be back.

It's great that they are open late. The menu is limited but that is to be expected I guess. Problem is when you have 10 items on the menu & you run out of 1 or 2 items it really limits the choices. Considering everything is $10 plus vs going to a full on dinner for $25 per person I'm just gonna eat and be happy!

The food QUALITY is a mixed bag. The Kimcheezer was ok, kinda small and didn't care for the jalapeños, would've loved tomatoes. Fried rice was delish!! A 10!! Sharp, Crisp & Full of Flavor!  Crab Melt was a mushy disappointment, maybe it was just to rich for me at the time so take my critique with a grain of sea salt. 

Wines were overpriced by 2-$3 per glass considering the brands, 2 beers & 2 ciders  with good prices but needed some local influence.
The service is Good! The young lady working the register was nice! She smiled, you could tell she actually cared about her job. The owner asked how my food was. Asked for a 2nd beer picking up my food and gave up and sat down after waiting. 

I'll come back again to see different menus. In SB you really have to support local businesses not tear them down. No matter what, we're all Brothers & Sisters!!

Stopped here for quick food as we were stopping in SB to visit a wine tasting room.  I wanted to come back the next day from Goleta but wife didn't want to make the trip.  The salad I got here, and her rice bowl were good enough to eat every day.

Great option for lunch and late-night dining. Order in line and find self-seating on a couch, communal or traditional tables.  This place has a unique blend of Asian cuisine made with French sensibility. I love the sandwiches. The bread is substantial so I actually get mine in a wrap. The burger is pretty interesting...not the norm.  So if you are a purest, try one of their other wonderful dishes. I doubt you will be disappointed.
Love the food here try the smoked salmon salad or any of the sandwiches you can't go wrong . Super friendly staff with a happy vibe Aj is a hoot !

Late night menu until 230 AM!! all locals suggested this place to us for after bar eats

The booths remind me of a late night diner 
---crab sandwich: tasty! Definitely had to share this freshly roasted Sammie 
---fried rice: served with runny egg, it's s vegetarian dish but something about it was so addicting even though k was stuffed 

Locals warned us it would get crowded later in the night but we were fine at 2am

We've made this place a regular spot! Our go-to is the fried rice with an egg and beef and the Pork Bahn Mi. Whether we are dining in or taking it to go, the staff is always welcoming. The food is consistently delicious, the decor is fun, and the vibe is comfortable. Good for groups, a casual date, take out... or even dining solo!

Tried the bann mi, fried rice and tots. The fried rice was good but wish it was without the cilantro, sprout, chili topping. The Hahn mi was good but wish it had more of the daikon. The tots were awesome, the sauce sent it over the top. Great place, also great late night stop.

Delicious Asian-fusion! Tried the Banhmi Sandwich with pork and added avo w/side salad! Loved that the salad was adequately dressed without being drenched! 

We also had the Fried Rice (omg!! Get this)! Was ample portion (just enough to feel full and not too much to be stuffed).

They have craft beers on tap...one made by locals just for The Blue Owl! Highly recommend. 

Had lunch (moderately busy and a reasonable wait for fresh food). Did not visit late-night, but can imagine that fried rice would be even more amazing after a few drinks.
The Thai Basil burger is amazing every time, nothing like it. The fried rice has so much flavor and is a favorite.
Unbelievably good flavors for any sandwich And amazing inside. Highly recommended for anyone who likes The best sandwiches in town.

We ended our day of wine tasting in Santa Barbara at The Blue Owl. We each were hungry and ready for a good meal to finish our visit. The Blue Owl was all that and more. Unassuming from the outside but a burst of eclectic and unique styles and features when you walk through the door.

I loved the ambience but the food is what really impressed. I ordered the Mango Mint Salad and added their marinated tofu for a couple dollars more. My sisters each got a Chicken Fried Rice.

After seeing my sisters' fried rices arrive I was slightly jealous I had chosen a salad. However, after trying my Mango Mint Salad Bowl I could not have been happier with my choice.

The bowl was incredibly flavorful. All ingredients seemed very fresh and were diced up so that it was a very easy salad to eat. The marinated tofu (coconut marinated) paired so well with the rest of the salad and was cut small enough to blend in easily. The mango offered sweet relief to the slight spiciness of the delicious dressing. Overall the salad was truly enjoyed and I finished it in its entirety!

I highly recommend a visit to The Blue Owl for some high quality Asian food. My sisters both enjoyed their Chicken Fried Rice bowls as well. A win for everyone!

was in santa barbra for the day with my vegan friend and ate lunch at blue owl and it was great! i got the miso kale salad and even though there was barely any kale, it was still great! i added chicken and the flavor was amazing! the vibe in there was also great. unfortunately there was a bone in my chicken and a bone in my moms salad as well. kind of gross to discover. overall, pretty good/healthy place that won't disappoint!

I'm a sucker for a good sandwich, and Asian fusion is fantastic when done well. 

I loved the idea of the Thai Basil Cheeseburger, but my patty was a bit dry. I do like the idea of a spicy green curry, and that fried egg was perfect, but I just needed more moisture in the beef. 
I got the Nam Toc Burrito for the tri-tip, but it gets a little bit lost in the sheer volume of fried rice. The rice was fine, but I don't think it was made better by wrapping it in a tortilla.
A Kid Grilled Cheese was the best of the three. Gooey goodness in a great toasted sourdough, with a side of mixed green salad. It's the most basic, but sometimes basic is best. 

I love all Asian flavors, but the devil's in the details. I love the concepts here, and I love the idea of fusion, but I just needed a little more in the execution.

I have loved the Blue Owl since it opened and Im so glad that I can receive their delicious and creative dishes by delivery ( through Grubhub). Open late enough to stop by for a late night bite downtown or an afternoon late lunch the Blue Owl has fresh and delicious, interesting food. My favorite it the beet/ pistachio salad.

Good food. A little pricey. I had the fried rice. The spicy red sauce served on the side of it set my tongue on fire. Husband had salami and mayo - nothing else - on focaccia. Loved it. He even ate the small greens on the side. Niece and nephew enjoyed their beet salad and fried rice salad. Niece RAVED over her beet salad. 

Bathrooms were gender neutral. Service was very good. We sat outside in pleasant weather, and food was delivered to us. Only complaint was lack of Thai Iced Tea. It was not readily available. I didn't want to wait.  Had tap water, which was free and refreshing.

Yes, yes, yes!!! Service with a smile, covid measures in place, fantastic food! Great job!

Try the fried rice with egg and kimchi, so good
Yummy - always so fresh whatever you get. Eggplant sandwich is great, gluten free/ vegan fried rice and the mango mint salad. Healthy dishes, healthy life

I did not like this place. The only good thing they have going on is that the place is aesthetic. The service is half assed. They should have more than one cook because from what it seemed I only saw one individual. Order took long to come out and we had to ask for it a couple of times. If you must come here, keep in mind it's only for the ambiance, don't expect your food to come out right away or for it to taste all that great. At least be picky with what you food you ask for.

This is my new favorite lunch spot. I always bring my out of town guests here as well. The food is so fresh and flavorful. The crab sandwich is amazing. Salads and soups are delicious and interesting.
Love this place. Best BLT sandwich I've ever had. Its the bread, the bacon, the aioli...just can't top it and hits the spot every single time.
Such a cute place and everyone was super friendly. My food and drink was pretty good, I'll definitely be back and post a more in-depth review :)
Friendly and helpful staff, quick service, open bathrooms, plus amazing amazing sandwiches!! I highly recommend this place and will definitely be back next time I come to SB!
Very delicious cute little cafe! Definitely underrated, their smoked salmon salad was amazing & so unique, I never had anything like it. And they had vegan donuts!!! Will definitely come back.

Yum! If you love spicy food definitely get the red sauce with the fried rice! I personally love the fried rice with a poached egg with the spicy sauce. The staff is great, the inside is a little hot due to poor ventilation but I always get it to go so no problems there! I hear they have late night bites as well but I have not tried that yet. Hopefully in the near future!
I always get the fried rice.  Its spicy!  Their chicken wings are delicious too except they dont always have those on the menu or they run out .
Yummm so good, fried rice is delish, I got the BLTA sandwich and it was fire! Im here a second time trying the bon mi, getting fried rice for dinner to go! That's how good it is

I haven't been to Santa Barbara in ... well in more than a year ... but I came up today and joined friends at the Blue Owl.  I remember a smaller version of it before, but they've expanded the indoor and outdoor spaces and punched up the menu as well.  Three of the four of us at the table had the fried rice bowl - mine with chicken and a poached egg on top, plus cilantro, spicy sauce and all sorts of YUM.  The staff was friendly, accommodating - and the food was great.  Thanks for a great lunch today!

My husband and I love this place! They make the best fried rice. Not greasy at all, very fresh ingredients. The salads are original and tasty! I met the French owner should is really nice and welcoming. I highly recommend this place.
Very casual place in downtown Santa Barbara right around the corner of Paseo Nuevo. Great food, vegan options, amazing taste!!!! Good price and fun interior design and great taste on music as well
I love this place, I always get their Thai hamburger with a fried egg. Their large fried rice with a fried egg is so yummy.

After walking around looking for this place with the whole one way streets close I found it. I told the girl can I get a vinaigrette dressing twice got back to my hotel room and of course they for got my dressing thanks guys  my god now I'm eating a dry ass salad.

After being on my Bookmark list for over a year, we finally made it to The Blue Owl for lunch. With two toddlers in tow, we ordered the Nam Tok burrito, kid fried rice, and pork banh mi as a takeout order. To the park we went, and immediately inhaled our lunch. I didn't get to take pictures because my kids were trying to run as far as possible while we were eating. But man... that burrito was so good. I'm Thai, and Nam Tok Neau is near and dear to my heart. All of the flavors were there, but I really wanted more heat. The fried rice was delicious for us adults, but the kids would have appreciated less cabbage. And the banh mi was delicious, though my partner wanted jalapeños instead of the spicy mayo sauce. We are glad we tried it finally, and hope to come back soon.
Real. good. food. Execution is spot on. Ingredients are quality. Plus they have beer on tap.

The blue owl is one of those places that continues to get better every time you go. Generally at restaurants I have a favorite food that's hard to turn away from during my visits, but at the blue Owl I'm not afraid to order something new because I know it's going to be delicious. It's also great that they are one of the only late night places to grab a bite to eat in Santa Barbara. Do yourself a favor and try this hip trendy delicious restaurant!!!

Overpriced! Overrated! One of the worst dinning experience in SB, the food they gave you is so small and little and in take away container. I paid $23 in total for these two items, judge for yourself and go somewhere else.

Customer service has always been pleasant. No complaints there!

Sandwiches has always been good! We usually get the turkey thyme and the banh mi and another that I can't remember off the top of my head.

I semi recently tried the rice bowl with chicken because I've been told by many that their rice bowls are good. Wasn't the biggest fan not that it was terrible. Just didn't live up the the hype people gave it. Maybe it was an off day or maybe it's less delicious ToGo? 

Anyway I'm not opposed to giving the rice bowls another chance

We stopped at The Blue Owl with my husband today for lunch and both enjoyed our meal! The food is delicious and beautifully prepared. Lots of flavours  Also I loved the decor as we are both French, it was nice to see so many familiar posters and maps. Staff is very friendly too.
We will come back soon for sure!
We got Turkey thyme, mango salad and banh mi, food were great!! Friendly staff, lots of outdoor seating. Highly recommend!!

One of my favorite places to eat in Santa Barbara- the Bahn Mi sandwich alone will make you come back for more. ALL the food is just scrumptious!! I stop by here every time I am lucky enough to be in Santa Barbara :)

When we first arrived to the blue owl there is a female employee at the register with her mask down. We assumed that mask or not required so my husband and I walked in without a mask. The gentleman at the register then came out to pass out menus and passively aggressively told me we have to wear our mask, no big deal! (When we were in line that was the only time that evening but he left the register to pass at menus and the place was busy) We put our mask on ordered and than we then sat down and waited for our food to arrive. I found it very interesting that there was an employee walking around serving food to customers mask less? That left me really confused with this establishment! Do as I say not as I do kind of mentality was going on here.

My husband and I split the tater tot's, fried rice with pork and a lemon bar all super tasty!

Mango mint salad
Thai basil cheeseburger
Bahn mi sandwhich

Such a cute spot! So happy I stopped here on my way to SLO. SB is always a great place to visit and I'll definitely be having The Blue Owl on my list of go-to places when I am in town. We had their mango mint salad, thai basil cheeseburger, and bahn mi sandwich. All were AMAZING. I do not have any complaints. Everything was flavorful, cooked perfectly, and had great portions. I even had some left-overs. Highly recommend for anyone who lives in town or just visiting. Staff is also lovely as well and very accommodating!
This place was exceptional. The person with a great mustache at the front was friendly and the burrito was amazinnnggg! Would come again

Absolutely amazing sandwiches!!

My wife and I stopped in on a yelp suggestion while we were riding by on the motorcycle getting hungry, and we are so glad we stopped! Doesn't look like much, though there is some very intriguing, amazing, and sometimes weird, art on the walls. Menu is pretty limited, but what they do have they definitely specialize in!

I had the salami sandwich and my wife had the eggplant, both of which had phenomenal flavor. Came with a small amount of greens on the side, the perfect amount of food for a light lunch. Mine was a little spicy with some cool cabbage mixed in, great flavors! My wife's eggplant was a superb meat-free option!

Highly recommend, though we only did a couple sandwiches and only for lunch, I imagine everything here would hold up to the highest standards!

My husband and I were looking forward to the pork bahn mi sandwich, the meat was very oily and not much pickled veggies inside, since we took out the food I even added my own cilantro in my sandwich from my refrigerator. Also our beet salad had old and wilted spring mix, we had to pick them out as we ate. Not our best take out experience.

My friend and I decided to come eat here for the second time the other weekend and we were really excited since this is definitely the perfect place to go to on a Saturday night.  I ordered the Kimchi fried rice and my friend ordered the grilled cheese sandwich.  The food was SO GOOD, kimchi fried rice, perfect amount of spiciness.  The people working there were also super nice to my friend and I: they made conversation, made us laugh, and answered any questions that came up.  The awesome thing about this place is its hours, especially on the weekend since it closes at 2:30am.  Definitely recommend coming to this place for a nice dinner or after a long night at the bars.  Everyone gets along with each other inside and it's just a very fun atmosphere to be surrounded in!!

I've gotten takeout and eaten in here and both times have been great. It's very vegan- and vegetarian friendly and I really enjoyed their happy hour specials like the strawberry crostini! Even the side salad is simple but super yummy :) the wait is usually a bit long but pretty great experience overall!

I've tried most everything on the menu, and it is all outstanding. Bahn Mi and Thai Burger are two highlights, and the fried rice is amazing. Add in excellent service, great desserts, and extended weekend hours, and you've got a true Santa Barbara gem.
really cool place. awesome vibes, music, and decoration. Vegan food was ON POINT! good selection on beer (really cold!). perfect place for an awesome lunch. The service was amazing.

I went here last week for lunch and had the Kale Avocado Salad.  This chef never disappoints.  I've been coming here since it was a fraction of this size.  The menu has expanded and the seating has improved.  My friends had the grilled cheese with tomato and basil and they both finished it entirely.  You know when everyone gets quiet while eating they are really enjoying their lunch.  Great Santa Barbara lunch find.  I've enjoyed the Banh Mi in the past and will return in the future.
Outstanding! Eclectic decor fills an elegant space, with helpful, friendly staff and DELICIOUS, healthy food. Fried rice bar is highly recommended. Great with the kids too.
Wonderful atmosphere and food to match! What a lovely night in SB....dinner was perfect.

This spot was perfect. Appreciated the decor, the friendly service, quality food and the attention to health and safely (During June 2020 COVID). Also love the outdoor patio. I enjoyed the Miso salad with prosciutto and the Banh Mi with pork. Highly recommended!
Very good curry sandwich and the Thai ice tea was not too sweet. The baguette was excellent. Great place to pick up a few sandwiches on the way home.

blue owl is one of my favorite spots in sb. the tomato basil grilled cheese with a thai tea is my go to. employees have always been friendly and my order has never been late. cute decor is a plus! this weekend they accidentally gave me the wrong order but handled it very gracefully. my new order was made very quickly and they even included a chocolate chip cookie for me which was so sweet and thoughtful. would recommend to anyone.

Ok it's cute and on paper, the menu looks great: Asian fusion twist on vegan & pescatarian offerings. Still... the food is ok... not flavorful as I had expected. They very slow & disorganized in the kitchen & really lack something... just can't really figure out what that is but noticed something important is missing...oh, I did really like their rocky road cookie! Scrumptious ... but their salads are meh...

I was so surprised and pleased by my lunch. I had the tomato/feta salad and chicken fried rice - the chicken was marinated in a curry sauce and had a nice sesame oil flavor. My husband had the pork banh mi sandwich - the pork was very flavorful and the bread was nice and crunchy. The service was great, very friendly. If I lived in SB I would be here every day!

Food plus outstanding. The front staff was so incredibly rude, I couldn't give this place 5 stars. A restaurant experience involves both. If you want food to go, come here! I hope the manager reads this. Gabriella either a day off or an attitude adjustment.

Great food; terrible service. I ordered 20 minutes ahead of time, arrived to a not-so-crowded restaurant, was told that my food would be out shortly, witnessed them put in my order for the first time right in front of me, waited 30 minutes, went up to the counter to inquire about my order, and found out that it was waiting there on the counter with no name or evidence that it was for me.

Their food is great, but I can't stand their service.

My first visit. Everything was bursting with flavor! I started with a small fried rice, which had lots of sprouts on top with cilantro and some scallions. It was mildly spicy without the spicy sauce. I love spicy, but my ulcer doesn't. This pleased both of them.

I finished with a chicken bahn mi sandwich. Mixed wild greens on the side. Very flavorful with much more chicken than a typical Vietnamese one.

I washed it all down with a fresh made glass of herbed lemonade with rosemary.

The total for everything was less than $20, which is a good deal for Santa Barbara. I'm happily full of tasty and healthy food. YUM!!!
Nadia the owner was very friendly. We split a large bowl of fried rice. There are a few beers on tap. Another time I had an eggplant sandwich.

The perk of this place is that it stays open until 2:30am and plays dope music... this is rare for Santa Barbara. Typically when I come here I get the fried rice with chicken but this evening I tried the Raspberry Bar...mmm mmm good. Definitely give it a try.

***Vegans and Vegetarians Beware***

I'll start by saying that it is genuinely painful for me to write this.

The Blue Owl has been one of my top favorite SB restaurants since I moved here three years ago, and I've dined there and gotten takeout countless times, as well as brought my friends and family from out of town to show them how awesome it was. I always order the same thing; a bahn mi with tofu and an eggplant sandwich (one for dinner and one for lunch the next day).

I went to The Blue Owl last night for the first time since they came under new ownership. I remember feeling nervous when I saw their Instagram post announcing new ownership, but that feeling quickly went away when the new owner said that the existing menu would stay the same, they would just be adding new things. I placed a phone order and got my usual tofu bahn mi and eggplant sandwiches.

Picking up my food was very easy, since I paid over the phone, I just walked in and the cashier handed it to me and I left.

I had a long drive to Carpinteria that night to take care of a friend's house and I had been working all day, and it was around 1am so it was dark outside. I unwrapped my bahn mi and noticed the bread was different and the sandwich was bigger, which were upgrades I was okay with. But then I took a bite and the sandwich tasted way different than it normally does. I pulled over and turned on my car light to look at it, and was horrified to see that there was PORK, instead of tofu, on my sandwich. I do not eat meat for ethical, health, and environmental reasons, and have been very strict with this for over six years. I immediately felt so disgusted and nauseous. I sat and thought about what to do for a moment, before calling them to let them know about the mistake so that hopefully this doesn't happen to anyone else. I don't believe in pestering businesses and customer service workers, and I don't think I've ever called a restaurant and complained in my life, but this warranted it.

The same person who took my order initially answered the phone, and when I told them what happened, they gave me a half hearted apology and offered to refund me or remake the sandwich. I told them that I don't eat meat and that I was really upset by this mistake, and that I had a long drive home ahead of me so I couldn't come back for another, but they didn't really seem to care or understand the gravity of the situation. They didn't even offer to compensate me for my full order. 

This has never once happened to me in my entire time in Santa Barbara or anywhere in Southern California. 

To add insult to injury, I ate the eggplant sandwich the next day for lunch and they did, in fact, change the menu and recipe and it tasted completely different from what it used to. And it's not better.

They've done so much work recently creating and marketing an all new vegan menu but the restaurant is OBVIOUSLY no longer vegan and vegetarian friendly like it used to be if they're being as careless as this.

I'm sad to say that they've lost a faithful customer, I don't think I'll ever return there again. Hopefully they can create some quality control systems to prevent this from happening to anyone else in the future.

A quaint spot in Santa Barbara that offers delicious and a variety of sandwiches. 

Also shoutout to the team for excellent service!

The Blue Owl has some of my favorite sandwiches.  The ingredients sound kind of funny being put together, but they work really well and taste so good.

My sandwich recommendations:
* Thai Basil Cheeseburger: bun, green curry infused burger, American cheese, basil mayo, caramelized onions and red bell peppers, and fried egg
* Red Curry Tofu and Curry Shrimp Sandwich: baguette, basil mayo, cabbage slaw, shrimp and tofu in red curry sauce, cilantro, and green onions
* Eggplant Sandwich: focaccia, basil mayo, roasted eggplants, bell peppers, caramelized onions, tomato, provolone cheese, garlic oil, and salad

My salad recommendation:
* Fried Rice Salad: kale, spring mix, fried-rice, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, snap peas, mint, Thai basil, sunflower seeds, sprouts, and miso dressing

I can just sit, I mean eat, here forever!
The Blue Owl is one of the best restaurants in SB. The peanut butter burger is like eating beef satay, their bahn mi sandwiches are incredible.

This Asian fusion cuisine was just what I was craving. The fried rice bowl with the poached egg was delicious! The chili sauce was a little bit hot but once you mix it up it's not as intense. The bánh mì pork sandwich, oh my gosh so yummy. 
Great place to order in lunch from. Delivery was quick and the food very fresh when it arrived.

Place has been recommended to me for a while. Major disappointment.
Went for the burgers that are supposed to be all the rage. Basil thai burger has some basil mayo & cheese. A flavorful meat patty. ON SOME WONDER BREAD. Thats it. When i got this sorry tiny a* sandwich my jaw hit the floor. $8.50?!? They ought to be ashamed!!! Ive had home made lunch sandwiches more impressive than this. And to add an egg is like $2 more. Bull.

Also got the fried rice which someone near by told me was the best fried rice he'd had in life. It was made in an authentic style w sprouts, chili paste, edamame. But the rice was soft mushy white rice, not fried at all. Bull.

Dont buy the hype. This joint is a rip off.

The banh mi sandwich is one of the best I've ever had. Their bread has a thin, crunchy crust that is just perfect. The meat is full of flavor and the veggies are fresh. This was my first time here but I will definitely be coming back!

Food is great. Service is bad. I absolutely love the food and often will order online for take out. During the lock down they added curbside delivery but the service is just bad. On several occasions when I arrived, I called to let them know I was outside, and they either hung up or left me on endless hold. When I did get the food, there was often something missing. Today the same thing happened. I called. They hung up. So I went inside. Had to wait in a line of people ordering. There were at least 6 people behind the counter. I asked one if they could just give me my order that I could see sitting there. She said I don't take orders and walked away. When I finally got to the cashier, I said I have a togo curbside order. Oh did you want that walked out to your car. I said no. I called, you hung up on me so I walked into get it. Then he handed me the box and I reminded him I had also ordered chips. He forgot.

We enjoyed a couple of delicious sandwiches here today. The eggplant on focaccia and the pork bahn mi were both delicious. The service was friendly. It is a cute and comfortable spot off of State street with outside seating available.

We came for dinner.  We ordered the $12 dollar fried rice.  One with pork and the other with tri tip.  It was ok.  I was expecting more flavor and more meat.  It honestly was a cheap version for $12 bucks of walk up ordering.  

The Tri tip seemed boiled.  The pulled pork was much better.

Over all, it was ok flavor.  Not booming or party in your mouth.  I would return for the day time offerings.  Just not the night menu.

Hope this helps ya'll.
Just finished the Nom Tac Burrito. It was delicious. I love the vibe of this place. It's going to be one of my go to places in Santa Barbara.

My friends and I decided to treat ourselves to a dinner out, which we don't do often since we're college students. I'm so glad we chose this place! Delicious food for reasonable prices. I got the eggplant sandwich and it was impressively tasty, definitely exceeded my expectations. My friend got the nom tok burrito and we were all asking her for bites throughout the night. I am definitely gonna come back here in the future to try more on their menu!

A great place to visit if you're in the area.  They have a small deck outside the restaurant that is shaded and looks really nice.  You order at the counter and the server will bring the food to you.  They have some great beer on tap as well.  

The food was quite good overall.  I had the chicken banh-mi that was really flavorful and delicious.  I also ordered their Persian cucumber and lime appetizer but it was way too salty. It tasted like they just dumped the entire bottle onto it, but that might have been a fluke since everything else was really good.  Overall, I highly recommend the restaurant.

Pros: real ingredients, great flavor, quality, great customer service 

Cons: 
-over priced, ($10 for basically 1/2 of a sandwich because it was so small and not much ingredients under the bread at all)
-small meal,skimpy ingredients 

This place rocks bc it's open late and uses  real ingredients. But the sandwiches can easily be made at home for $2-3 a piece. They get their 4 stars for convenience of late night and that their food isn't greasy garbage. (As SB doesn't have very many quality healthy eateries)

Nice customer service, quick delivery.

Delicious and exotic!  We eat here frequently either dining outside (during Pandemic), take-out or Grub Hub.  Can't get enough.  The servers are accommodating (we always tweak our ingredients somehow) and serve with a smile.  You order at the counter, find a seat and wait for your food to be brought to you.  Food arrives timely.  Seating may be limited given the pandemic restrictions but no biggie, order TO GO and enjoy at home.  Fried rice, fried rice salad, salami sandwich, Nam Toc burrito, Thai ice tea are our regular food orders.  The veggies are CRISP.  I feel like I'm eating healthy with every bite.  Happy to support this local business!

I loved the outdoor seating with my pups. It was private and cozy. Perfect for a lunch date with my friends. The beet salad I ordered was one of the best salads I've ever had. My friends loved their food as well. Will definitely visit again.
YUM! Didn't know what fried rice could be, but this place turns it into perfection I didn't know existed. Will be returning to try more on the menu. Cheers, so good

Love the Blue Owl! Found this place on an article with the tastiest spots on Santa Barbara that had the best value, and I would say that's spot on. Amazing Asian-inspired menu items that are incredibly tasty and affordable. You order at the counter and the food is brought to your table quickly. I've gotten the thai curry burger and the chicken banh mi and thought both were great but that the thai curry burger in particular was pretty spectacular. It's infused with green curry and is very juicy and flavorful. It's a unique combo that I'd definitely recommend trying. I'd get it once a week if I could. They can count me a regular!

Loved their crab melt on homemade English muffin.  The crab tasted like crab, which Was delicious, and the muffin was firm enough to hold the goodies.    Yum!

The Waken Bacon was an amazing idea, but it was a little too sweet for my taste.  Creme brûlée waffles are such a good idea though!!

Small place so you may have to wait or share a table, or take it to go.

This restaurant has character and that cozy neighborhood feeling. But wait, the food on the menu is absolutely great. I recently visited theBlueOwl for a quick bite. It was during the change of shifts and I overheard one of the employees state that the cook that was supposed to be there was in the middle of a family issue. The owner looked a little perplexed and then rolled up her sleeves and started to bang these orders out, and every single dish that came out of the kitchen looked amazing. 10 stars for the owner. I will definitely be a chronic repeat customer.
Respectfully
joseph mancuso
Amazing sandwich shop. Ordered the bahn mi which was off the charts good. Friendly service, chill atmosphere. If you are in SB definitely stop in this place for a bite.

This is by far the best fried rice I've ever had in my life. You can add a fried egg to it but I don't really like egg so I don't. I always get chicken but today I tried beef and chicken. The beef was a tad bit salty but still sooooo freaking good. Service is always super friendly! Love this place

best restaurant in SB hands down. Nadia and her entire team are AMAZING and the food is nothing less than stellar every time. The nom tac salad and pork banh mi are our go to's. they use the freshest ingredients and everything has soooo much flavor! will never stop coming here

Really love the food here and wish I knew about it sooner! I love the tomato and feta salad or the fried rice salad. One of these days I'll try the burger! Never had a bad meal and I eat here at least twice a week.

I first found out about this spot when I was looking for some vegan donuts that were recommended to me in the area and when I called the company about them they basically told me the Owl was the only place to get them.  Well little did I know this place even existed, and so since then I've been a regular to this cool spot and I've found some good eats to have here too.

The B Owl is located right off of Canon Perdido and State tucked away.  They have now a little outdoor seating area in front of the place. Normally it's a small diner type atmosphere here with the old red glitter cushy booth seats and old 70's type Knick knacks of France and cute little owls decorating the place.  

Menu is pretty simple and it mostly revolves around traditional sandwiches but also modern Thai and Viet themed ones as well. They also have different salads, and as mentioned earlier their ginormous vegan donuts and cinnamon rolls. But probably what they are most famous for is their full on fried rice bar including a vegan version of such item with all kinds of different toppings to choose from.

I always come here for the donuts and cinnamon rolls and this is coming from a guy who hates sweets and is almost on a very low sugar diet in general so that is saying something...  The bakery in crime here involved in these addicting incredible treats is called Good Stuff Bakery. They are locally made fresh and they are probably the most expensive donuts I've ever bought before, like $5 for one of them.  But man,  they are giant and just one goes a long way.  I actually use a knife on one of them to cut my little portion to ration my self ( I know I love torture) so we are talking 3 or 4 days before I finish one:)  I've only had the chocolate one and oh man I'm still thinking about this guy.  Then I really did myself in by trying out their cinnamon roll the last time I was there.  OMG I have never tasted such a rich cinnamon tasting beauty as these giants.  I love peeling them from their spiral and break off a piece and move towards the center where it's the most gooey.  I'm just warning you that you may become forever addicted so this review needs to come with a capital Disclaimer...:D

Like I said earlier they are best known for their fried rice and if you don't want fish sauce in yours you can opt in for the vegan version for a small upcharge.  I have tried this in their fried rice salad and it's pretty darn good.  Ask for extra dressing as they don't give you enough.  I've also had their plain miso salad and I have always been happy.  I take those to the beach to have after swimming and they hold up well as the produce they use here is super fresh.

Finally the service here is very good.  They seem to hire Europeans as they all have interesting accents but super cool people.  It takes a bit of time to get your orders but that's probably because they hand make everything here so you got to just be patient.  

Overall I'm a fan of the Owl for sure...

Really delicious food at a great price in downtown Santa Barbara. Came here with my sister on a Friday night, and there were plenty of tables outside to sit. We had a small fried rice, which was deliciously flavored, the shrimp and tofu red curry sandwich, and the eggplant sandwich. Everything was really nicely flavored, and the focaccia and baguette for the sandwiches were delicious. Definitely would return here for lunch or dinner!

We had the vegan nam toc burrito and tofu banh mi sandwich. They were both good, and the nam toc had a lot of delicious, fresh herbs and flavor. I wish they would have had a bit of hot sauce or something to spice it up a bit.

This was my first stop on a week long vacation and had a hankering for a sandwich. The server recommended the Thai basil cheeseburger, so I ended up ordering it for my husband (which he enjoyed). I ordered the red curry tofu and shrimp sandwich. To be completely honest it was ok. The tofu and shrimp were the same soft texture, so there wasn't much of a textural contrast inside. Definitely order a latte or a mocha while you're here! The tables outside were a safe distance a part and was able to have my 10 month old out without worrying.

Had a late night dinner here.  It was amazing.  Best thing was the fried rice with tri tip.  I will be going back here anytime I'm in the SB area.  We also had the eggplant sandwich and an egg sandwich that were quite good as well.
Stopped by today, ordered the vegan fried rice with tofu and a cinnamon roll for my girlfriend. She really enjoyed it and couldn't believe it was vegan. I'll have to try it next time.
This spot was amazing!! We stopped by while shopping around and had the beet salad and chicken fried rice. Mind blowingly amazing flavor!!! We will definitely be back for both dishes!

Late night hit in Santa Barbara, line was out the door! People in line seemed to rave around the fried rice and luckily for us we took that suggestion. No regrets. That fried rice topped with some kimchi hit the spot after a couple drinks in town. Topped with some kimchi and pair it with a thai tea that has a hint of cinnamon. 

Second item to rave about was the burrito, similar in flavor to the fried rice but held together really well and perfect with some hot sauce. 

They have a lounge feel section and some tables in the restaurant, order at the front and they'll call you when your order is ready. Water dispenser on the side and a bathroom in the back but expect a line because its a single.

Unexpectedly awesome lunch! Walking around SB for the first time, during COVID with the eerie almost dead streets, saw this cafe open and decided to give it a punt. Delicious food - pulled chicken in my salad had a Thai-ish take that was fragrant and delicious and husband loved his banh mi - and we both have travelled to Asia! Happy to recommend and certainly will revisit as a lunch spot.

Wonderful menu but outstanding service!!!
They shorted us on an order and the owner drove up to our home to make it whole plus  ...an extra sandwich, cookies and a gift certificate.
Not common!!

Their service is very poor.
The food is good. I love their bahn mi, but it isn't good enough that I wait 30 mins for it.
I will give them one last chance though, hopefully they're better staffed by then.

I decided to stop by this restaurant (that I've been eyeing for quite awhile) after watching a movie that ended at 8:30! I felt immediately welcomed by a great server who was able to answer my questions and was very friendly! I ordered the kimchi fried rice, which I highly recommend, and it was a great price! Shortly after ordering my food, I received it in a takeout box. Their late night hours start at 8, but I was able to use a bowl and take the leftovers to go. Overall, the interior aesthetic mixed with the great customer service and delicious dishes, this a great Santa Barbara stop for all you foodies!
So good. The pork banh mi is now my favorite sandwich in town. Limited seating but it flowed well timing-wise when we were there

This place has gone to shit. Waited 23 minutes for a Bahn mi at 2:00am because the guy with the accent wanted to chat and hug his friends instead of working. Finally got the Sammy and it was hard and salty as ever. This is the second time I've come since management has changed to a salty Bahn mi. It's not as tasty as it used to be. Raised prices for subpar food. ‍

Tofu fried rice was a takeout container of cabbage with a bit of rice and four small pieces of tofu on top. The chili sauce was squirted to the corner in a small puddle. I know that Asian Fusion can be open to interpretation, but the amount of cabbage was easily 3/4 of the container.

Another in my party got a sammie, and said it was tasty.

I'm happy to write my 1000th review for The Blue Owl for fantastic service and delicious meal overall.

Hubby and I were in Santa Barbara for a day trip and needed a pick me up, so we ordered the Bleu beef sandwich with side of salad and Basil Thai Burger with side of fries for take out through the Yelp App. The order was ready in reasonable time for pick up. 

The Basil Thai burger was my favorite.  They combined the spices together well that it was so flavorful and juicy!

Definitely recommend this place for a pit stop when visiting Santa Barbara.

Blue Owl has redeemed themselves!! I went by for lunch  yesterday with a friend and enjoyed a socially-distanced, safe experience. They've put out a nice parklet in front of the building for fresh, outdoor dining with lots of umbrellas for shade. 

Ordering was a breeze, as always. Places my order at the counter. I was initially interested in the eggplant sandwich (the focaccia just sounds fantastic!) but I decided to try the Nam Toc Burrito. I have no regrets! The tri tip was generous and perfectly grilled, their fried rice is always a hit and the mint, chili, fish sauce, etc. all made a beautiful burrito to savor. It was so unique and delicious and only $10!! 

My friend enjoyed the Egg Melt Sandwich, a meal I'm looking forward to trying next time I visit Blue Owl. I learned from my friend that the focaccia bread is locally made and delivered every day! And it showed. This bread looked fresh and flavorful. 

Be sure to check the hours before you go since they do tend to change frequently.

Heard about the Blue Owl from a friend!  Best lunch downtown I've had in ages. Great service, engaging staff and superb food. Try the Thai cheeseburger or the Fried Rice Salad. Way different and truly excellent! Added bonus...great atmosphere and super music!!

the food is really good! however, i ordered on uber eats and they didn't send a salad when it said in the description that my item came with a salad. slightly disappointed by that! otherwise, tomato grilled cheese is actually amazing

Went here after a great night out with my friends I was happy with our service from the customer service to the amazing food! Filled with so much flavor I felt like I made this food myself. Amazing  service thank you for a healthy bite   I can't wait to try the day time menu.

I always had assumed that any chance of getting food after 10pm would have been limited to some fast food joint. Boy, was I wrong. 

I knew that this place had been in existence for a little while, but wasn't aware of the phenomenal fare it offered. 

The first time I set foot here, I was with a group of friends who were positively raving about their fried rice. Drunk food? Sure. Drunk food with awesome flavor? Definitely. 

PSA: the fried rice is very spicy. For a guy like me, it's a cough-inducing spice. They are happy to make it sans-spice, and this works just fine for me. The dish comes in a traditional Chinese food-style takeout container and is filled to the top with a number of tasty items. So good, in fact, that my drunk self can usually put the entire dish down in one sitting. It's a must-try for sure. 

The cashiers are always super friendly, light-hearted, and attentive. They probably receive their fair share of nightly bar characters, so have to put on that easygoing persona. I commend them!

This isn't JUST a late night restaurant - I believe that they are open during the day, though I haven't been. The next time I find myself in that particular section of downtown SB during the day, I will give them another try!
Best late night food, or lunch stop. Get their grilled cheese with added chicken! 10/10 recommend

Food: The food was very delicious, We got two sandwiches and one salad and they were absolutely delicious. This place has great healthy options.

Price: the price was very well worth it, considering how healthy and delicious this food is. All three items and water came to $43. 

Location: This place is located in the main Santa Barbara shopping center, very walkable. 

Ambiance: very casual & laid back place, you order at the front and then sit outside or inside to eat. The server brought us our food outdoors

I will definitely come back here again the next time I am in Santa Barbara.

As I stand in my kitchen (I brought it home) eating the amazing grilled cheese sandwich for the second day in a row, I think....why did I wait so long to try this place! Yes, I ate the same one yesterday! :-)

It is so delicious!  This isn't your typical grilled cheese.  And it comes with a little salad that compliments the sandwich so well!
