Take my advice and go get one.  You will definitely thank me!

And as an added bonus, the people working there are so wonderful!  In my opinion The Blue Owl on Canon Perdido, just off State street is my latest "best of the best" in Santa Barbara!

Ask for Nadia, she will be thrilled to have you as a new customer after such a tough year! Tell her Beckie sent you!

Now what should I try next on the menu! :-)

I've had the bahn mi, tater tots, and fried rice and nothing has disappointed. Every time my friends and I go to bars downtown we always end the night talking about their tater tots because they're unreal. The aioli that comes with them is a 10/10.

We used to visit the blue owl somewhat regularly when we lived in Santa Barbara, and we were delighted to find the quality is still as high as ever.

As always, the fried rice had great textures and a unique flavor. 

The thai basil burger might even have been better than we remembered, the flavors infused in the beef taste incredible.

The stars are mostly for the cool late-night coffee shop living room vibes. The food was nothing to write home about and a little overpriced. We tried the Thai basil cheeseburger, fried rice salad, and red curry & tofu shrimp sandwich. The sandwich was the most flavorful of the three and the fried rice salad did taste bright and fresh, balancing out the heavier dishes. However, the Thai basil cheeseburger and the herbed lemonade both ironically tasted quite plain/the herb flavors were completely absent. 

Overall, I still might come back to chill in the late-night hours if I'm in the area!

Food:  great lunch menu with a New American vibe with touches of Asian influence; I had the Nam Toc Burrito (Thai Tri Tip Beef) and was delicious
Service:  great, friendly service
Design:  small, quaint homey feel with lots of interesting artifacts on the walls with of course many different blue owls
Overall:  if you want interesting ecclectic fusion food and not your typical american fare in a quaint, interesting place, then this is the place for you
Food was great, we love the flavors!  Taking off one star because the Thai iced tea was grainy with the additioanl herbs.
Great service, really cute, and amazing food! I really enjoyed visiting town and this spot, super good!

Sometimes when I want to eat healthy on a trip, I feel like I've wasted a vacation meal on something sort of generic. Not here. Tried the fried rice salad and the smoked salmon salad and they were both perfect: filling, delicious, interesting flavors, and beautifully presented to boot. Actually tried to go back but mistimed it and they were closed.
This place is outstanding with the most delicious highest quality food. The service was excellent. I'm rigorous when it come to good food, this place passes all test with flying colors.

I love a place that's open this late (230AM on Fri & Sat).

Barebones, hole-in-the-wall low price place... big communal table, some seating along counters... it's all about asian/american fusion comfort food done right, hipster style.

We had the Bahn Mi Sandwich and the special Thai Basil Burger w/ fried egg. Both are recommended.

Bahn Mi: moist & tasty roast beef, pickled veggies, with oyster chili mayo. Just the right amount of chewy, crunchy, gooey served on a delicious fresh equal parts crisp and airy french roll. Not Vietnamese authentic but perfect in its own happy way.

Thai Basil Burger: Delicious Thai flavors that didn't overpower but complimented the burger served not on a bun but between two pieces of crisp toast. Velvetty cooked egg added to the tastes and textures.

This is low rent cooking done with high art.

We've been to Blue Owl a few times before, mostly when they first opened, and found them to be phenomenal. However after a long hiatus, we were very disappointed at how little flavor and effort was put into our meal. 

I was really glad to see they use Art of Tea brand teas and almost ordered a hot tea, but I went with a fun Thai iced tea instead. It looked like it had plenty of condensed milk in it but it was barely sweet. And not only that, the Thai tea flavor was barely there. 

And you know how the burger is usually on shitty wonder bread but it doesn't matter because it sooooo good that you don't care?? The burger is on a nice roll now, but it's not as good. I tasted no basil. It was just fried cheese and egg. 

The burger came with a side salad. It was a nice spring mix but that was basically it. No other veggies and barely had any dressing on it. Not very appetizing. 

And finally we shared a large order of fried rice. We added kimchi and a poached egg. There was plenty of kimchi in the bowl and it was delicious. But the poached egg was basically a hard boiled egg and there was hardly any rice in the bowl. 

What gives?? Blue Owl used to be phenomenal! And now we're just left disappointed.
the best most enjoyable fried rice I've very had. 10/10 would recommend the vegetarian/vegan options
One of the best Bahn mi's ive ever had. Highly recommend for sure. Great service and very reliable, an enjoyable experience all around.

The food is so fresh and flavorful. They make their owl French baguette and it's unlike any I have had in the US. I usually get either the Bon Mi sandwich, comes on baguette, or the fried rice. Even the fried rice is fresh! Desserts look awesome too, I've only had the brownie, which is amazing. They also sell Night Lizard Bear, a local Santa Barbara brewery that my friends love.

How cool that The Blue Owl only comes out at night! :)

It doesn't open until 11pm, and you'd think for late night drunk food, this place would be sub-par. But no, it's one of the best tri-tip I've ever had!

- Tri-tip sandwich: a must have! Tender meat and great spices!
- Cheeseburger: It was ok, although adding a fried egg to it made it a lot yummier.
- Fried rice with tri-tip: the tri-tip was again good, but I'm not a fan of the bland mushy fried rice (sorta like Shanghai style fried rice)

The portions are small for $8-10/item, but it's the best choice for post-clubbing eats. And c'mon, you spend that much or more on a drink at the club anyways :)

Yummy and fresh and delicious food! I ordered their vegan fried rice with tofu and kimchi with toppings and it was delicious! Not greasy at all and kinda spicy too, just the way I love it! Their tofu bahn mi was delicious too! Would highly recommend.

I hear that the fried rice is still good but I had the green curry burger, which used to be so incredibly good, the bread was basically Texas toast, thick buttered white bread, the burger was super yummy and flavorful, green curry burger. Now there's no flavor, it's on a sad brioche bun. There was a hard fried egg on it that was gross. I know Blue Owl can do better. But the owners have changed 3 times. The new owners just need to reread the recipes and do some qualtiy control on their chefs. Please. This place is special. It at least it was. And I think it still can with a little bit of work

We love Blue Owl and heard ownership may change so pray the menu doesn't. We just ordered our favorite Thai basil burger with egg and tried on Blue Owl website but that item wasn't available ( except for late-night item which must be a much smaller version ). Had to go with Yelp to order instead as we wanted this delicious burger. Hope the menu adjusts on the website as we've raved about it to friends. Wishing Blue Owl continued success.

We came here for a quick/healthy lunch and this place did not disappoint!! It's a cute little spot, by the main shopping areas. Had inside and outdoor dining. It's an order out the counter and they bring it to you. 

I got the beet salad and it was AMAZING. Top 5 best best salads that I have ever had. It was paired nicely with goat cheese and pistachios. Also.l, so filling. My husband who doesn't even like beets thought the salad was great and finished it for me because I was too full. 

My husband got the fried rice with chicken. He ordered the small version (we had a lot to do so We went light) but he was full and said it was a really good lunch portion. He doesn't even like cilantro and didn't know it came with it (didn't read) and he said that the fried rice made him think cilantro wasn't so bad (for once). 

We both enjoyed our meals and can't wait to come back!

Finally was able to try this place, it's been on my  list for quite a while? But somehow never made it in.  My friend and I asked in, cashier pretty friendly, as we browsed the menu on wall, she asked of she could be of any help and did answered couple questions, we ended up with sandwiches, I had the eggplant one and it was so good!! And the ice was perfect as well, the only not so great thing was that it took a pretty long time for our food to come out, since this was not rush hour, and when we got there we were the only ones there.  Other than that, this is a nice place for sandwiches!!

Really fantastic! The Blue Owl is nothing like it used to be. Vast improvement and expansive menu! I am straight up addicted to the Fried Rice w/Poached Egg. It's the best fried rice I have ever had in my life. I love it so much in fact that I have not tried anything else since they expanded their menu and restaurant! So all I can say is, "order the fried rice!" What makes it so good? The spices are incredible as are the fresh, crunchy veggies and the tender grains of rice. I also like adding tofu. It's hardy, it's delicious and it can induce a serious carb habit...but it's worth! Go get it!
This place slaps! I've lived in SB for 5 years and I hit Blue owls all the time. 10/10 would recommend. Fav is the Rice with pork and spicy chili sauce!

It has been over 20 years since I have been to Santa Barbara but when I had a week with Pismo Beach as my home base, it was the perfect chance to go for a day trip.  Unfortunately that day happened to be during a heat wave limiting how much time we were going to spend outdoors.  

The fusion aspect of Blue Owl was what intrigued me but found out that my first choice of the red curry tofu and shrimp sandwich was medium on the spice level because of the red curry sauce.  Since I only tolerate mild, sweating more from spicy food was not a good idea eating outside when it was going to reach 100.  Womp, womp.   Although not fusion as I wanted, I did inhale a delicious eggplant sandwich with a Thai Ice Tea and had a bite of a just as delicious pork banh mi.  

What really impressed me was our server noticed me trying to fish out a flower that fell into my Thai Ice Tea from the tree I was sitting under and he actually offered to bring me a new one.  Since I was already halfway done, I did say half would be sufficient.  Now that is attentive service.
I love the fried rice and like some of the sandwiches. My friends that are into salads love those as well. Service is generally good and the setup is interesting. I recommend!

This place absolutely rocks when it comes to flavor, quality, quantity and personal customer service! A large menus and relaxing atmosphere makes for one of my favorite places in Santa Barbara to Grab lunch and get away from the work mind mentality.  This is also my fiancé's favorite spot in Santa Barbara because She loves how the entire menu is super healthy and delicious. Also everything is at a great price. I really enjoy trying all the whale bird kombuchas (by far the most affordable place to pick these up in town).

I got a tofu banh mi, and it was pretty disappointing. The sandwich was fairly small for the price, and the inside of the sandwich was basically empty. Like, if you looked at it from the side, you would think it was just a piece of bread sliced down the middle. Seriously!

To add insult to injury, it tastes *nothing* like a banh mi. They should just call it something else because there was nothing inside that sandwich that tasted anything remotely like a banh mi does.

Three stars because my friend got a turkey sandwich that they really loved, so just averaging out the stars between the two of us.

Everytime I walk by this place, it makes me so hungry! I ordered the Nam Toc Burrito to-go and it comes with a small side salad. I thought it came with a sauce but maybe you have to ask for it? Either way, the burrito is very large and filling, however, I felt it was a little on the salty side. The flavor besides that was good and refreshing. I'm going to give this place another shot and try their bahn mi sandwich, as those are usually my go-to.
Naughtia saved my night. And I am so greatful. Wow what amazing food the chicken and rice with the cabbage and cilantro spicy amazing dish. Lights out ;)  n on point.

I've been here only twice, each time hoping to try the duck croissant but it is ALWAYS sold out!! One day. It will happen. However, the crabmelt made for a nice substitute--I'm pretty sure I got it both times, and the second time I got it to go so it was cold by the time I ate it, but still delicious! The english muffin they serve it on is perfectly crispy on the outside and the garlic mayo really hits the spot. I need to try more of the sandwiches on the menu, but so far what I've tried is amazing! The only thing is that sometimes they can take a while because they can get pretty busy around lunchtime.

It's 2am on Friday night. You're drunk and you've lost all control of your motor skills. Your friend turns to you and asks if you want food. You mutter something resembling a 'yes' and try to nod. You trust her.

Thirty minutes later you're feasting on something incredible. Why is it so hard to articulate how you're feeling? It couldn't be the half handle of Jameson or the 10 Moscow mules you consumed earlier, could it?

The next day she informs you that it was a Thai basil cheeseburger with fried egg with a side of tri tip fried rice with more fried egg. Through the fogginess you're reminded of how heavenly it was.

You thank your lucky stars for your friend and the Blue Owl.
Great little restaurant in SB. Nice atmosphere. Good food, simple yet refined and well prepared. Very nice staff and service. Well priced.

Wow it's so good! I tried the red curry tofu and shrimp sandwich (comes with a side salad) - it's really good! I would definitely order again, the tofu makes it feel somewhat lighter? It was super yummy and filling; the salad is dressed really well - 5 stars

My sister ordered the blue beef (she substituted goat cheese for the blue cheese) - it's sooooooo good. I tried a bite, legit 10 stars. I want to revisit and get this. There's like a buttery garlicky flavor. 

Def recommending this to friends and stopping by next time I'm in town.
amazing superb excellent meal. love the nom tok burr. go her if you want the best tasting food! great service and cool atmosphere. no place like it in sb. hamds down my favorite! love you blu owl!

Maybe this would be better late at night when one is ravenous and drunk because during the day it was less-than-stellar. The banh mi was small, cold, and the bread was too crusty, hard and dry. There were barely any fillings (skimpy on meat and veggies but heavy on the mayo sauce). The kimchee pastrami was better in that it was bigger and more filling but really not any flavoring in that beyond mediocre kimchee and pastrami meat. Apparently they make their bread in house but it didn't really make a difference. And I found it a bit obnoxious that the they provide tip options for you  beginning with 15%, then 20% and 25%. For a place that started as a late night, "food truck"  option that evolved into no frills, no service (you seat yourself, bus yourself) place I do NOT want to have to pay 15% tip minimum. Sorry, not coming back.

Solid place for brunch, with a nice small outdoor eating area along the street.  Staff friendly and relatively efficient.  They have parking in a nearby public lot or could park at Paseo (free parking up to 70ish min)

Their Bahn-Mi sandwich was our favorite.  Flavorful and comes with a nice side salad.  We also got their Nam Toc Burrito which was also good, but did prefer their Bahn Mi.  Their Thai ice tea was unique and had less condensed milk than most but had an extra flavor (cardamom?) that was a nice twist.

Overall solid place!

Hidden gem!! 

I was stoked to find this place the other day, fried rice bar with awesome coffee and beer on tap as well as a bunch of homemade healthy food options. On top of all of this the decor inside is super retro and fun. We will definitely be back to do some remote work and sip on coffee. The food was fantastic and the people were so inviting and friendly!!

Thai Basil Burger: 
Lots of flavor here and I really enjoyed that. The meat wasn't that good but the saving grace for the burger is that it was cooked really well. The regular bread in lieu of a bun is weirdly nostalgic and makes me think of a home cooked meal. Needs something to balance the spice maybe some veggies.

It's a hole in the wall but 4.5/5 is pushing it. Average place for a bite and yes it's a bite.

Great sandwiches, I selected the Bahn mi with pork and turkey thyme sandwich on focaccia bread. Both were delicious. Cute and cozy little spot for a quick bite or short lunch. The Bahn mi was on a toasted baguette and even though was spicy, was not intense at all. By default they use an oyster based mayo, but they offer alternatives, like a basil mayo. Turkey sandwich is pretty self explanatory. Washed it down with a couple pellegrinos... Today was a good day

What a great little lunch spot! We dropped by one afternoon and were really pleasantly surprised but the quality of the food. Reasonably priced as well, if you factor in the Santa Barbara "tax". The beet salad was really fresh and flavorful, and don't forget to throw an egg on top of that fried rice! Did I mention they serve beer? Not that you would ever have one during lunchtime...

Where do I begin......that's a more difficult question than usual since I usually roll in here a little drunk.  Um, the Blue Owl is amazing!  You really can't go wrong with anything on the menu here.

The Thai Basil Cheeseburger is legit - not perfect but uniquely good.  It comes on white bread and it's spicy!  Also, don't forget to add an egg, you won't regret it.  I kinda wish they added some lettuce, slaw, or tomato to the burger.  I feel like it can use an addition to the bread - meat - egg connection but hey, I'm not the chef.

The Fried Rice is also super unique and very good.  A little spicy but not in the same league as the burger.  There's lots of cabbage which not only provides great color to the dish, but also some crunch.  The poached egg is delicious and unique in that it adds creaminess to the rice (as opposed to being the typical fried, dry egg).  I wish I added the tri-tip but again, I wasn't thinking clearly for reasons outlined earlier.

I really like their new space, they used to share a store front with Zen Yai (my favorite Thai restaurant in SB).  The restaurant on upper state is small but not tiny and has some nice details.

If you can stagger up State Street late at night....or better yet, get your act together and arrive for a solid breakfast - you gotta get yourself some Blue Owl.

The Blue Owl is the perfect blend of Asian and California cuisines. I had the miso salad with tofu. Everything was so fresh! The portion was the perfect size (large, but not too filling). My mom just ordered the fried rice with kimchi. I had a small and it was delicious! The woman at the counter recommended the Bahn mi sandwich, which I hope to try on my next visit. The decor was cute and eclectic--very Santa Barbara. Overall, I highly recommend! Veg/pescatarian-friendly, too!
An excellent twist on Asian dishes. Cute setting and very delicious offerings in Santa Barbara. A must visit anytime I'm in town

I really wanted to like this place. My husband and I went in for our first time and it took a few minutes before anyone greeted us ( even though there were 3 people working) Since it was my first time, I asked a couple of general questions and I honestly felt like I was burdening the three guys that were working there. With only one other couple in the restaurant, it still took about 20 minutes for them to make me a piece of salmon...which unfortunately was not worth the wait. Again, I really wanted to like this place, but we won't be going back.

I stopped at Savoy for lunch on my drive from LA to San Fran, and then spent the last 3 hours of my drive imagining a world where I could put this wonderful little deli in my pocket and keep it with me everywhere I go.  Totally normal response considering how killer my sandwich was.  I got the 9 Trails sandwich on gluten free bread, and FYI for my fellow Celiac-ers, the bread itself was awesome.  Not the dry cardboard stuff I'm sure we've all come across.  The fillings were just as good- turkey, homemade cranberry sauce, Dijon mustard, mayo, greens and cream cheese.  Yep, cream cheese.  Odd combination that makes for an absolutely delish sandwich!  My boyfriend built his own sandwich (on regular bread) with some turkey/bacon/avocado combo which he really enjoyed.  The serving sizes were really large, and there were plenty of gluten free and non-GF dessert options.  Definitely a winner!

Delicious and perfect for gluten free! They offer gluten free pancakes, which were delicious and covered in berries, butter, and pure maple syrup, as well as gluten free bread that they use to make into French toast or breakfast sandwiches! My breakfast sandwich was incredible, with egg, tomato, mustard, mayo, and a healthy slab of cheese all melted into fluffy gluten free bread that was probably one of the best GF breads I've ever had. Coffee and cappuccino were good too. Prices were high, but in Santa Barbara, what can you expect? Breakfast was serve yourself, with ordering at the counter and picking your food and coffee up when it's ready and then sitting down.

YUM! Good clean ingredients, tasty food and professional, nice service.
I'd never been for breakfast but today we tried it and it was very good. Axxess card made it closer to what I think the price should be.
The patio presents well considering it opens onto a parking lot.

Ok so i knocked off a star because of the price, but the food is amazing. I got two breakfasts. Eggs Benedict and A breakfast burrito. The hollandaise sauce was spectacular despite its color (red orange) the burrito was even better i recommend it without the potatoes, carbs on top of carbs is just too much, and they give you more egg and cheese without it. If i didn't have an Axxcess card this place would have ruined my but the buy one get one free entré was definitely appealing.
Wonderful food. Find it a bit pricy for deli style restaurant. Very compete offering of high end deli foods and beverages.
Delicious, fresh food. The back patio is a perfect quiet setting.
Very trendy, healthy, vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free breakfast and lunch spot. Expensive but good quality food

Great little deli for a quick, healthy bite to eat. The food is almost all organic and they have a wide selection of delicious food. 

The place is clean and the staff were friendly and not over attentive (which suits me well). 

The only downside is it is a little pricy for what it is.

Their breakfast is excellent!

The eggs benedict was transcendental.

their menu is chock full of silly,
vegan, organic, locally-sourced, egg-whites only,
hippie shit that sounded pretty gay. 

But,
The eggs benedict was transcendental.
Beef stroganoff,  Greek salad and blueberry kale salad...BOMB.. (I'm kicking my plate!)

Whether you want an almond milk latte, a protein filled salad, a hot soup to warm your tummy on a rainy day, or just friendly faces to talk to.. Savoy will always hit the spot. 

I went in for a sandwich earlier today and it was perfect. Ask for Noah to make you one, he won't disappoint. Enjoy!

We happened upon this place this week and really enjoyed it.  The atmosphere and people were great.  Food was wonderful.  Everything was homemade...no boxed mac and cheese here!!!  The salad bar had everything you could imagine...everything was fresh and yummy.  We really enjoyed ourselves!

My son and I did a day trip (on Memorial Day - yesterday) to Santa Barbara and found this spot through one of my FoodNetwork searches.   

I loved it!   Next time I visit SB, I will visit again!

I had the yummiest plain basic latte ever - the coffee was so good.   We went for breakfast, and unfortunately I am not a fan of sweet stuff but the baked goods were beautiful.  My son and I split a breakfast burrito and it was good.    Best of all was the cute quaint atmosphere and the friendly staff.  I especially liked the nice, tall, handsome, blonde man that helped us pick out the best local beach for our relaxing day - Thanks!

We stopped at the Savoy Cafe after reading good reviews on Yelp. It is a rather small place with lots of yummy food choices and a great salad bar. On first look, it was a little overwhelming as to what to order. I now wish I had noticed the yummy breakfast options, as they looked wonderful when brought to other diners. The sandwiches were great, with an especially wonderful and tasty carrot cake for dessert. Would definitely recommend eating here....casual, affordable, and delicious.

Saw this place on Diners drive ins and dives, and had to try it! It lives up to the reputation! Amazing healthy organic food, friendly staff clean and very cheery atmosphere! I had the eggs Benedict and my husband had their gluten free citrus dipped French toast. Both amazing and with a beautiful presentation!
Absolutely amazing organic local food. Owner managed and operated. Employees always greet you with a friendly smile. Savoy makes a great choice for a healthy lunch

Love this tiny little place. Interior and exterior design makes it a nice and comfortable place to eat.

The food is great and very healthy. I don't feel bad after eating here. 

Free parking right outside in the back.
This is one of my favorite stops in Santa Barbara!! I love the turkey fritter and enjoy trying new sides!! I love their customer service too!!!

Love, love, love this place! The food is always great and I really love their soups! And the staff is always nice with big smiles on their faces :) If you haven't been to Savoy, you should try out, you will love it, just as I do.

Go to spot for breakfast! The burrito is my fav but really you can't go wrong at Savoy. I've been a regular here since they opened. Great salad bar, friendly staff and an impressive selection of teas. 

Dogs are allowed on the back patio, where you can enjoy the fabulous Santa Barbara breeze and drink your tea or coffee. They also have great vegan and gluten free baked goods. Two thumbs up!

Sounds cheesy but, I came here for one reason. Guy Fieri. He went there for a turkey fritter, so figuring he would highlight the best dish available I was stoked. Boy was I wrong. I am pretty venturous with food, so seeing that this cafe was mainly composed of vegan\vegetarian friendly food didn't bother me too much. So I grabbed the fritter, some mac and cheese, and a ginger beer. The fritter was old, it had been sitting there for a while, it wasn't crispy, it was hard. As if it was under the heating lamp for far too long. the inside of the fritter was dry, with little flavor. The only good thing it had going for it was it was a bit spicy. The mac and cheese was more like mac and soup. It was very loose and ran all over my plate, it should have been served in a bowl, but the flavor was decent. The ginger beer ( which isn't made by the cafe, its just available on the drink rack) was great. I have to say I am very disappointed in the old and frumpy food. I expected more from a DDD stop. Also from the heart breaking story about the ups and downs of the cafe, it seems as if they have fallen back into old times I suppose.

Order the iced mocha! It has shaved chocolate and good coffee. I was surprised!

I came for brunch on a Saturday and ordered the eggs benedict, which was scrumptious. It's filling and can be shared if you don't like a heavy breakfast. Fruit felt fresh and was sweet. Potatoes were good, but I felt like it was too much because the bread they used was very dense (ciabatta?) so I couldn't even fit it in my stomach. Hollandaise sauce was yummy, but I secretly wished it was tangier. Still yummy as a whole and would recommend it.

My only problem about this place are the prices. I payed over $13 for a breakfast plate. Definitely not the place for college students on a budget, but I think trying this place at least once is worth a shot while you are in Santa Barbara. Maybe next time I can try the Guy plate and see what the hype is all about. And another iced mocha. 

P.S. Great place to read/study in the back.

Great food! Lots of pre-made deli style super fresh healthy variety and very reasonable pricing. Also the kitchen and grill makes a great menu for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. It's one of the only places I love to go back to for all three meals!
Also dog friendly- a big plus!

Love SB and really like this place! This place is the best health spot in town. Organic, vegan, gluten free and paleo options galore. And, they're delish at that. Fast service, great lunch spot overall.

Very nice atmosphere, good food and a huge selection of drinks. The stuffed chicken was great and so were the sandwiches, MAC and cheese is kinda lame, but liked the chips that come with the sandwich. They also have a large salad bar and selection of foods that seem a little exotic.

Off to the side from the main road State St. is a small, quaint, and homey deli that serves fresh, organic foods and drinks.

Varieties from prepared foods, salad bar, sweets, drinks, coffee, teas and cheese..

There's a large counter that displays shelves of coffee beans and tins of tea to offer a wide selection of hot drinks.

The prepared foods case offers tuna salads, green salad, macaroni, tomato & mozzarella capreses, etc.

Sweets are all organic and homemade!! Cookies. Bars, cakes (chocolate buttermilk cake, yum!!!), muffins (pumpkin, whole grain, bran, raisin, etc)  
They also sell bottled drinks like YerbaMate, Konbucha, teas, etc.

I was also surprised to see a small selection of imported cheese, and jams. 
Unfortunately the salad bar/soup is very small...Not much variety there. 
But the rest of the store is packed with other yummy treats. They also sell cute, antique ish tea sets, cups and saucers, etc.
Clean organic restaurant. Delicious breakfast . Me and my wife's new favorite spot. 5/5

My husband and I stopped here for lunch on our way up the coast. I opted for the salad bar, which has a huge variety of ingredients to choose from and a good selection of dressings. I also picked up a ciabbata roll on the side. All of the salad bar ingredients were delicious and fresh and the roll was amazing. My husband got the turkey-cranberry sandwich and loved it as well, although he did think it was too small.

Our only slight disappointment was the slice of butter pecan coconut cake that we took to go from the bakery case. The cake part had good flavor, but I was expecting cream cheese icing and instead it was an overly sweet buttercream. 

A little on the pricey side, but totally worth it. I would totally come here again!

We tried Savoy Cafe because it was featured on Diners Drive-ins & Dives.  Overall - I thought it was pretty good!  It had a cute cafe feel to the place and they had a lot of healthy options.  The food seemed fresh and flavorful.  I got the chicken curry, brown rice, and veggies.  The curry was good, but the veggies were plain.  My husband had the turkey fritter, pesto fries, and macaroni and cheese.  The macaroni and cheese was yummy!  We also had a snickerdoodle cookie and banana bread from the bakery section - but we thought the two desserts weren't special.  In the end - I decided on 4 stars because the place had a nice vibe : )!

Amazing gluten free option!!  The flapjacks are awesome and the berries were so big they had to cut them in half. All organic and delicious. My husband got the feta spinach scramble and it was also amazing. We went to Scarlett Begonia on our stay in Santa Barbara as well, and Savoy was definitely much more delicious without the wait. Highly recommend!

Outstanding! Lots of fresh healthy food option .  Everything really well labeled and tons of gluten free choices! The staff was super helpful. I even forgot to order something for my daughter and the server brought it to me and I just paid on the way out after we were done with our meal. How cool is that ? There is an oh so cute dog friendly patio around back. Lots of to go options . I recommend the chicken ( you can pick breast or thigh ), mash potatoes and kale salad. Kid friendly with some pasta options as well! Convenient to a large public parking lot that you can park for free for 75 minutes.
Great breakfast place shown on TripleD (although it's lunch that was shown). Love the organic everything and emphasis on quality without all the fuss.

Closed!

Boo. I was a fan.

Happened in early December. I'd heard that rent had been boosted too high for the business to continue. No more awesome salads.

After searching for vegetarian restaurants, I was happy to find Savoy which came highly recommended.   I enjoyed the ambience while I had the Lorraine sandwich and a glass of Sauvignon Blanc.  They offered the cute idea of writing a postcard and they'd send it for me, so I wrote my daughter a postcard...this deli was cozy and quaint.   A definite must -try for anyone visiting Santa Barbara.
Eggs Benedict was amazing. Cool relaxed dining environment and great menu

Really great coffee.  I went there for lunch and didn't have any sandwiches, but got the thing recommended by Guy Fieri.  I highly recommend it.  Also the service was really good.  
You can park across the street in the lot.  I believe it's free for the first 3 hours.

Savoy is amazing! One of the best and most reasonably priced salad bars with tons of options including salmon! Woo! The sandwiches are bomb and the baked good always look delicious. There are two giant fridges with fresh juices and other drinks that are hard to find in your everyday deli.

Savoy is perfect for any meal of the day. Their gf meal and treat options are very enjoyable. We have eaten there many times and have not had a single thing we disliked. We feel great after eating here. No heavy after feeling, and no food guilt. The location is easily accessible. The cafe is clean and airy. We definitely recommend Savoy!

Absolutely delightful cafe with all organic foods. Awesome breakfast menu, super friendly service, and a steady stream of regular customers make this restaurant a must for your Santa Barbara dining. Don't miss it!
Favorite brunch place in town. They have real maple syrup and fresh squeezed orange juice. Food delicious. Wait staff friendly and attentive. Nice laid back option.

This place is fantastic. It has a ton of gluten free options for those with celiac, that are clearly labeled. Huge selection for food, something for everyone. Pastries were Delilah, both regular and gluten free! Has several soups daily, and a deli style counter with hot foods and cold salads, a sandwich station and alcohol. What more could you want?!

This place is an even more gourmet version of those crazy Whole Foods delis and snack bars. The pretty wood furnishings and the simple floral decorations make me think of Le Pain Quotidian -- very chic and calming.

The sandwiches are made fresh to order on super soft bread, and no joke -- the cookies I pointed to under the pastry glass were somehow still warm and ridiculously, deliriously soft and melty. Either I have great timing or they have an incredible, ever-moist recipe.  The double chocolate chip cookie was insane good.  I wish I lived in SB!

Great prices. Great food. 
At first I was afraid of the "deli" style food sitting behind a case, but did not affect the flavor at all.
Owner Kathy is super nice and really helped us choose our order. Being a Triple D fan, we had the "Guy plate" : The pastilla pepper and turkey fritter. Served with pesto green beans and mango quinoa. A slice of Kathy's carrot cake with cream cheese frosting. We also got the Stuffing stuffed chicken breast with wild rice and roasted veges. Hands down the best triple D spot that I've been too.
The vegan burrito is the bomb, and I'm far from a vegetarian.  This place is legit.

Lovely, comfortable place to eat, grab coffee or tea or go through a salad bar. They even have a selection of to-go food, pastries, drinks like bottled tea and kombucha. 

I ordered the Benedict and they were kind enough to swap out the bread for a bed of sautéed spinach which was nice of them to accommodate. The dish was ok, nothing to write home about, although the ham was very good and moist. It came with a large salad so the meal portion was very decent.

I ordered a matcha latte which is probably the worst I've ever had- watery and the coconut milk was hardly frothed. The matcha tea also didn't seem very good.

But I give them applause for an almost all-organic ingredient list, a menu that appeals to a wide variety of people, and a charming atmosphere. 

I will probably be back, I just won't order my favorite drink (matcha latte) and will try something else on the menu.

I've been here three times since moving to Santa Barbara for a 4 month assignment.  Poached eggs and toast with greens instead of hash browns?  Yep!  A lunch of chopped salads?  Yep!  The roast beef sandwich was awesome.  Simple, fresh food prepared creatively.   I'll go back before heading to Durango.

So we read all the great reviews and thought wow. The employees not so friendly. The chicken breast was dry. The flavor of the chicken thigh wasn't tasty although it was not dry. Hard to get water from employees. And as far as the supposedly fantastic salad bar; I've had much better. Also much too pricy.
This place has everything! Highly recommended and service was great. Glad i stopped here and will be back for sure!

One of our favorite places to eat in Santa Barbara. 
Sure, we only found out about the place through DDD. But the food keeps us coming back. I can't get enough of the Turkey Fritter. 
Not only that, of all the McDonalds, Taco Bells, Jack in the Box crap I put in my body -- walking away from Savoy, not only do I feel like I did my body a favor, I enjoyed eating one of the few healthier things I eat. 

I don't know what Quinoa is -- but I like their Quinoa Mango Salad to go with my Turkey Fritter.

Great food. Friendly.  Clean and comfortable. Stopped here on our way home from a trip. So nice to have gluten free bread as a choice for sandwiches. All ingredients are organic and meats are nitrate free. Well done!! Had some wonderful butternut squash soup. The soups we so good we ordered some to take home. They have great gluten free desserts too. This will be a must stop for us in the future when traveling thru Santa Barbara!!

Best salad bar in town, and if that was the only thing I was reviewing this would be five stars. It's got a huge selection and you can make your salad as big or small and as healthy or unhealthy as you want. Soups are great too.
The deli area can be complete chaos at lunchtime and the selection occasionally hard to see/figure out. 

The only bad experience I've had here was when ordering tea to go. They use these enormous tea bags which they drape over the edge of the to-go cup. It has the effect of wicking boiling hot water down the side of the cup and, in my case, into the cupholder of my car, which had a full inch of hot tea in it by the time I reached my destination four blocks away. This also makes the cup nearly impossible to hold without getting seriously burned. Please, Savoy, rethink how you're doing your tea to go - not everyone has time to sit down and order a whole pot of tea in your cafe.

This place was delightful. I really like that this place catered to both Carnivores and vegans. I had the vegan burrito, it had tofu inside with vegetables. It was refreshing to find vegan organic food that had good seasoning. The coffee is a little pricey but well worth it, there's non- diary options and raw cane sugar. I will definitely be back to try more!

This place is such a gem.  Husband and I came in very hungry and left very happy.  The quality of their ingredients is sooo good.  You can taste it with every bite.  We both enjoyed the coconut chicken curry that was clean and extremely delicious.  I also wanted to try absolutely everything in their baked goods section, it all looked amazing.  Lots of gluten free, VEGAN, nut free, sugar free type options!  An absolute gem!

I've seen this place on occasion as I visited family in Santa Barbara as it's down the street from the cigar shop, but I had never gone in. Why? Because every time, I usually had a plan to visit other places to eat as recommended by said family member. In a bid it eat healthier, we visited this place.

Salad bar along the wall, hot combo meals (also available a la carte too), salads and bakery items to the middle section and a large selection of kambucha teas and drinks in the back, this place offers a good mishmash of organic and non-organic items to suit every palate. I ordered the beef stroganoff and mango couscous salad. I was pleasantly surprised the stroganoff was not as salty as I expected and was hot, creamy and filling. The couscous was done just right and not too tart with the mangos in it. 

Items can be a little pricey (salads are sold by the pound and a little higher price wise than the average) considering what you get, but the portions were generous and I left satisfied with no cravings for dessert.This is located in the heart of downtown Santa Barbara after all, so your best bet is to park in the nearby lots or metered parking along the street, if you can find a spot (some lots have the 1st 75min free).

 Seating can get a little crowded especially during peak hours and manuevering around other patrons can make you feel like a rat in a maze at times to get to your table and forgotten items. Food offerings are fresh and flavorful. I'd consider this place if I came back into town again.

This is a restaurant that you will be coming back to again and again.  Everybody is friendly and treats you like family. And the food, is off the charts. We just kept eating because the food was so good. We had chicken Marseilles and a Turkey Fritter, mashed potatoes, soup, salad and dessert.  Can't wait to go back!!

This is my best friend's favorite place to eat in Santa Barbara.  She absolutely loves the salad bar here and always raves about this place.  Over the years, she has brought me here along with her more times than I can remember.

I do like this place, it's casual and cool inside with lots of seating (and outdoor seating in the back).  The guys that work here are really nice and give good suggestions.  It's clean and fair priced.  Today I had a side of pesto pasta salad ... mmm, was very lemon-y.  I enjoyed myself for sure.  My caprese sandwich was unique from the fig balsamic (which I like when I come here), but was a little messy and hard to eat.

All in all, a good place to come!  They can satisfy anyone.

Great salad bar here! The selection is really nice, even though the salad bar looks like it is very small. Along with the usual salad bar-stuff, there's a great selection of other fun stuff like, roasted garlic cloves, roasted beets, baked salmon pieces, baked tuna, steak, roasted eggplant... really nice! Salad bar is sold by weight at $9.99/lbs.

They also have premade sandwiches if you're in a rush, a sandwich counter, deli items, and an espresso bar. 

Fresh everything. Check it out!

(I guess this place used to be a Cantwells at some point?)

I love this place!  I've been there 4-5 times now and already the staff greets me like a regular :)  Friendly, Courteous and helpful staff with great attitudes.  The only thing better than the staff there is the food!  Healthy, delicious, quality food that you unfortunately don't find most places.  

I was just in there today and they had a brief internet connectivity issue outside of their control which caused them to be unable to accept Credit Cards.  This happened mid-transaction for me and instead of making it into an issue or passing any frustration my way the Manager smiled and said "it's on us today".  Mind you it was just a couple muffins that I ordered but the simple gesture ensured I'll continue to be a regular customer for years to come :)

Quality there all around!

PS Their Pumpkin Muffins are unreal good

I really enjoy the Savoy for the ambience, Plus fresh, healthy food and especially the loose leaf tea. I'm sorry to say that they unfortunately have become the place that will get my rant about onions. Not everybody likes onions!!!  Why do so many chefs think otherwise?! A lot of their dishes include onions and I have not been back for a long time, unfortunately.

Our go to place in SB for brunch, lunch, and dinner because it is organic with no spices or oils we have sensitivities from. Great yams, chicken, enchiladas and soups. They also have gluten free sandwiches, a salad bar and yummy gluten/non gluten free brownies and desserts. I love the chocolate chip cookie and ganache brownie.
the breakfast is wonderful! Price is reasonable while the food and service make the price more worthy than it seems. Highly recommend.

So insanely good! I could not stop ordering things. I got a deliciously savory frittata, then tried the very well-stocked salad bar, and then ended with a slice of GF key lime pie (all with a glass of sauv, of course). They have an incredibly diverse selection of food and have a good supermarket-ish area for if you want to eat on the go. The deco is like you're visiting someone's co-op cottage. Great place! I'll be back here for lunch all the time.
We stopped here because our usual place we enjoy vegan carrot cake at was out. The carrot cake was delicious and the portion was generous. They also have an organic salad bar.

This is definitely one of my favorite places in Santa Barbara, perhaps the world!  The food is delicious, the atmosphere is amazing, and the employees are fantastic! My boyfriend and I come here for dinner on occasion and every time we've come in has been wonderful. We even got free desserts one night! (I think they could tell we were poor college kids).  You MUST try this place.

I love Savoy! So artsy, everything is fresh and delicious. And all the employees actually act like they want to be there! Imagine that! If you live in SB or are visiting, must visit Savoy for coffee, breakfast, lunch, or even a snack! Bravo

Was super happy that there were LOTS of different gluten free options, and they have a bakery too with gluten free and dairy free options. OMG the brownie was amazing! Also had a sandwich on gluten free bread and it was very good, the staff was super friendly!

Although the food is delicious i found hair in my meals twice in a row and that was it.
don't like to dig through my meal to make sure there is no hair.
be cleaner please.dont ruin the delicious food with it.

I give the food here an A+. The portions are very generous (depending on the sandwich) and everything is made really well. You can taste the freshness of the ingredients in the first bite. My husband and I split the pastrami with a side of pesto pasta salad, and both items were crazy good. The only downside is that it's pretty pricey. For the sandwich, side, and two bottled drinks, it was $20. Maybe I'm just cheap, but that seemed like a lot when your splitting. But like I said, ingredients are great, and they make an awesome sandwich.

I'm giving this one a middle-of-the-road review, because while the food was decent, it was nothing to write home about, and it was, in my opinion, way overpriced.

When I visited here back in December 2013, I had the Gaviota sandwich and some kind of kale salad.  They were both fine.  I did check out the salad bar, and it looked well-stocked and had a good variety, but it was SO expensive, so I opted out.

The girl that took my order was friendly, but the rest of the staff seemed really aloof.  It was really hard to get someone's attention to ask a question -- they all seemed to have better things to do, like gossiping about co-workers with each other.

All in all, it was an OK dinner, but I probably won't go back here.

Delicious, amazing salads. I KNOW! How can salads be delicious? This salad bar made me fall in love with the idea of a dry salad. Well, salads in general, but specifically a dry salad. Their pastrami is pretty stellar also. I would give five stars if it wasn't so dang expensive!

I really enjoyed eating here. I got a plate of coconut curried chicken and a side of butternut squash. My wife got a roast beef, turkey, and bacon sandwich. Being able to select a protein and sides at the counter was exactly the type of place I needed for my dietary needs. The food itself was simple and delicious. I was thrilled to see that they had a soda sweetened with stevia and a good selection of beer. We sat on the back patio, which was very laid back. The employees were polite and had smiles. I'm visiting for a few days, and I plan on going back. Next time, I will try the salad bar.
Super cute and great menu options. Prices were reasonable and staff was helpful. I liked the help yourself to glasses and water setup that they had.

I love the salad bar and most things on the menu. The stroganoff is excellent. The sandwiches are the weak point. Not enough meat, mostly lettuce and bread. Not worth it. Everything else is good though.

This place is so refreshing! I am always so grateful to little cafe's with great quality food, good coffee, good prices, and a significant amount of gluten free options. I was in and out within 12 minutes, I had a DELICIOUS breakfast sandwich, I purchase a few miscellaneous GF cookies//muffins, I loved the white chocolate mocha, and the staff with adorable! I am looking forward to going back to SB so I can visit and purchase more goodies from the cafe! The cafe had a smell that wasn't the best but ultimately in my books is a MUST if you want good GF options, great service, and lovely drinks! Go visit!

This was one of my favorites to visit on the way to work Downtown. Offers a bounty of fresh farm-to-table options. Both a fresh salad bar and deli. I recommend sitting at their tea bar and enjoying some loose-leaf options after a meal. They also offer a variety of to-go options for those in a rush at the deli counter.

The food is extremely high quality and the staff is friendly and attentive. Noise level is low, so this is also a good place to meet with friends and treat visitors from out of town. Savoy has a simultaneously chic and rustic feel.

Organic-affordable-fast-nice atmosphere-family owned... an unbeatable combo. 

I eat out about five times a week. Each time I go through this whole process of deciding where to go...and 85% of the time I go back to Savoy. 

The salad bar is amazing. There is wild caught Alaska salmon just sitting there and you can put it on your plate, surround it with organic veggies and eat it. It takes 8 minutes to get from my living room to check out, via the salad bar. If I am not that hungry I can get a $5 portion, if hungry, a $15 portion. With their gift card, the $15 custom all I can eat salmon plate costs $13.50.

Anywhere else the food quality is lower, the wait longer, and often the prices higher. 

Savoy doesn't make a big deal about it but an unusually high percentage of their food is organic. (Hint: look for the list high on the wall above the salad bar to the R).  Other local restaurants (won't name names) *feel* like they the are organic, but are not. 

The only flaw for my taste: the deserts could have less sugar and more chocolate. Then I discovered that the "mint" cookie is in fact a low sugar, high chocolate cookie. So now there is basically no reason for me to eat anywhere else. 

Enjoy!

I visited Santa Barbara for the first time this weekend, and a friend took us here. She said "it's not very scenic, but it's delicious and reasonable." I agree! There are so many choices that I could t decide what to have. My turkey fritter plate with arugula salad and curry quinoa salad was perfect and all my friends food looked fresh and delicious. They were all very happy with their meals (baked chicken, salad, sandwiches). We took home a berry tart for later and it was perfect!

Between my husband and I, we ordered the regular and vegan versions of the Savoy breakfast burrito. I had the pleasure of consuming the latter. Please note, I'm not vegan!, but I appreciate that, when done correctly, vegan fare can easily and greatly surpass non vegan foods. I will say that Savoy does it right. The portion is monstrous; coming off of a six mile run earlier that morning, I had difficulty finishing it but went the distance driven by the fresh ingredients and wonderfully melded flavors. Fresh side of salsa also a nice touch!

This was our second visit to Savoy Cafe and was again very pleased with our selections.  After a 4 hour drive from the desert...and watching Guy on Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives...this was so worth the wait.  We ordered the "Pasilla Turkey Fritter" and the "Gibraltar Sandwich"...OMG ~ So Delicious!  Even the iced tea was yummy in the canning jars!  So Cute.   Everything was very fresh and the staff were very friendly.  Next time I want to try the amazing salad bar with some of their homemade soups.  We plan to make this place one of our favorite stops when in the area.  Just very inviting and fresh flowers on all of the tables.

Amazing amazing amazing! There sandwiches are the best I work around the corner and love getting their food for lunch. Can't go there everyday because of my budget but if I could I would. Tastes like fresh ingredients, staff is always nice, baked goods are incredible.

Heaven is finding healthy, lovely and super yummy food by surprise on our travels! The Chicken Curry was wonderful, with tender chicken and delicious vegetables pieces. Service was so helpful and sweet, ambiance happy and peaceful with great music (Sinatra!) and a water fountain in the background. Ending with a paleo Snickerdoodle for dessert. Lovely, lovely, lovely!!!!

We were a somewhat large group (7 persons) on break from presenting shows at the nearby Granada Theatre.  This format of eating establishment works well for a larger group; everyone orders what they wish, and sit and enjoy time together!  Even though this is a deli sort of format (no waiters), we were nonetheless definitely attended to nicely, from the cordial service at the ordering counters to the table clearing.  All in the group were very satisfied with the food choice options and quality.

we have been here a couple of times and have mixed feelings.  Sometimes some items are delicious and other times they taste like they have been on the warming tray too long.  Great little place, almost like a cafeteria with some added treats.  The salads, seem, fresh although the salad bar has a lot of strange items, not you standard salad bar.  The prepared foods with meat later in the evening get a bit rubber like or hard, but if you get them when they first open they are wonderful.

Love this place! It's not only dog friendly on patio and food is great. They have vegan meals and lots of sweets. Many kinds of drinks too.
Only bad thing is sometime service is too slow!

A nearby business owner suggested I try Savoy for lunch.  Great advice!  Casual, friendly, and perfect for eating solo or in a group.  I had what the deli guy recommended:  Blueberry Kale Salad with goat cheese, snap peas, walnuts and cranberries.  House Roasted Turkey and Pasilla Fritter.  Delicious!  I could eat this everyday.

Omg I love this place! Thank you Yelp for being there and recommending this adorable cafe/deli with tons of different options all feeling healthy. I'm in love! Had the turkey fritter (amazing) and portobello mushrooms from the deli case. I got a surprise side of spicy chipotle aioli to dip in - yay!! As a recovering sweet tooth addict I don't eat too many sweet dessert bombs anymore, but when on vacation and I see a naturally sweetened gf/vegan treat, I'm gonna try it. Had the raspberry bar. Delish. And they had tiny little baby cupcakes, so I got one of those too. Happy tastebuds. Oh and the covered patio out back was perfect for my dog and I on this rainy day. Savoy I will be back!
Salad bar was fresh and had good selection. At $10/lb I guess it was quite reasonable. Nice atmosphere, clean bathrooms and friendly staff.

This is my go-to lunch or breakfast spot when I'm driving north through Santa Barbara. The atmosphere is cozy, the food is very fresh, and they have a wide assortment of organic snacks and drinks. Their home-made pastries are to die for!

Where can I start. This is my favorite place to eat when I'm Santa Barbara.. the food is great here and the gluten free and vegan options are delicious. My favorite item on the menu are the pancakes and their pastries are very yummy. I enjoy coming here even though it can get little busy but the staff is friendly and very welcoming. Prices are not bad either!

Excellent food selection! It's a great to go pick up sandwiches and goodies for a picnic or you can just eat there. It's a bit pricey, but the ingredients are top notch. I like the breakfast burritos, but they are big enough for two people to share. They have a huge selection for gluten free eaters too!

A good selection of vegan options. I really liked the el cap sandwich and the black bean soup. The vegan burrito was also good and they have good hot sauce. Good spot for health conscious eaters and the environment is nice. They have a salad bar and a large selection of beverages as well.

Used yelp to find a place while in the area.  Very busy on a nice sunny Saturday.  Tons of choices on the menu with options for every taste and vegans too.  Quick service and nice back patio to relax.  Portions very good and one sandwich was plenty.  Lots of bottled teas, soda and a few beers.  Will be on my list to visit again.
Huge, fresh portebella for salad bar? Damn yes! Stopped serving breakfast at noon, which is a shame for a late riser.

Walked around State Street and heard about the Diners, Drive In, and Dives spot so my boyfriend and I decided to check it out. I absolutely loved the soup and salad bar and the little sweet corner. I recommend the carrot cake.

WOW and WOW.

My favorite place to grab lunch in Santa Barbara.  The staff is friendly, the food comes out quick and is always fresh and they have such a great variety of options you couldn't get board even if you ate here every day.

They have a salad bar, 4 different soups each day, a hot food station that has enchiladas, turkey patties, etc as well as a sandwich board (or create your own) and a full blown bakery case.  On top of that, they have breakfast and serve their awesome breakfast burrito all day.  They have Figueroa Brewing Company beer on tap and Turkey Posole that is to die for.

On my last visit, I created a sandwich and it was all I could do to chew and not just swallow it whole.

The best part of Savoy?  Their pancakes!!!  Literally the best pancake I've ever had.

Do NOT miss Savoy if you are looking for a cozy cafe to sit and enjoy a coffee and pastry in or if you want a full blown lunch.

Found about this place on Yelp when I looked for a good cafe in anticipation of stopping by Santa Barbara for lunch on the way back to LA. This was my first time hanging out in SB, and I was sorry I wasn't able to take advantage of the sunny, lovely day to do so longer after lunch. 

I appreciate the super pleasant, bright atmosphere (fresh flowers on every table and lovely sunlight from wide windows bathing the whole place) and friendly, knowledgeable staff. There's a fresh and extensive salad bar (including yams, salmon, steak, and chicken, a plethora of olive oil-based dressings); yummy cold prepared and hot, freshly made food (they offer free samples of your choosing), including hot sandwiches; coffee bar that offers almond milk!; baked goods section that tempts passersby with goodies including gluten-free sweets like the zucchini bread that made me cave; and a retail section boasting rosemary olive oil tortas, dark chocolate bars with almonds, sea salt, and more!

I'd definitely go back if I lived in the area.

Four of us ate lunch on April 17, 2015.  The place was nice enough inside and we were looking forward to a special treat since it was on Diners, Drive-ins and Dives.  Once we figured out how you order your food (the hot items were in a case and you had to go up to choose the entree and 2 sides) everything looked good so my husband and I ordered to Chicken Adobo and 2 sides.  Our friends ordered the Balsamic Chicken and too sides.
Our Adobo chicken was a leg/thigh and looked good in the case. HOWEVER, they had almost no meat on the bones - we were AMAZED how little meat there was - like eating a plate of bones!  And our friend's Balsamic Chicken - was a nice size breast BUT they were TOO dried out!  The sides were good and the desserts were good.
This place is billed as Best Salad Bar in Santa Barbara - guess we should have chosen the salad bar!! especially since those plates of bones cost $12.95.
This place is AMAZING!  Spent a lot of $$ for breakfast and the servings were not that big, but the food was delicious, the ambience is awesome, the service was great.

Went for brunch, ordered the eggs benedict.

Instead of an English muffin, it came on badly burned ciabatta bread.  Not lightly toasted, not "whoops, forgot about that for a minute".  Blackened.  Could be used as a doorstop.

Anyway, got a fresh one and it was sort of fine, nothing special.  The hollandaise was unusual, sort of herby and a little bitter, not sure I would have called it hollandaise if I didn't know what it was.  Obviously they were trying to do something with this, but different isn't always better.

As an amusing aside, girlfriend had ordered her salad with the dressing on the side; they forgot to bring it, and when she asked for it, they tried to charge us.  To his credit, the waiter brought it quickly and apologized after we explained it to him, but I don't think that's ever happened to me before.
This was a accidental find with a delicious result.  The service, ambiance and food are wonderful--it's a casual and refreshing experience.
I really enjoyed this place. They have a great salad bar with great topping...even salmon! I'll absolutely be back. Healthy, quick...in love :) and they have a patio so it's dog friendly :)

This place was very cute and quaint! Dog friendly on the back porch. Loved the ambiance :) the gluten free French toast was awesome but my husband didn't love their breakfast burrito. He gets breakfast burritos a lot, and he wasn't a fan. I loved the healthy options though and people were very nice and friendly.

Favorite amongst the locals & always recommend to people visiting/passing through. 

Breakfast burritos good, French toast & pancakes good too!

Have tried the mac and cheese (try along side brown rice). It really compliments each other haha. 

Honestly, everything I've tried has been good! Great options for gluten free, vegetarian, organic etc groups.

Nice outdoor areA,  if inside is cozy too!

One of my favorite places for breakfast. The pancakes with fresh berries are excellent (and gluten free!). The bacon is excellent. They have the best selection of loose leaf teas in Santa Barbara. Tea is served in Japanese cast iron teapots with decorative China cups and saucers. It's also the best place in town for cookies. They are baked multiple times a day and I've often gotten one still warm from the oven. They also have some of the best iced tea in town, including a caffeine free blueberry tea. Sometimes they have house made specialty lemonades including lavender lemonade and basil lemonade. Lastly, this is a family owned restaurant and the owners are there daily, always friendly and helpful.

The owner was nice enough to let us order breakfast when they stopped serving them at noon. 
We drove from San Diego and we are ready for some gluten-free brunch. 
Cute place for brunch

My experience here was a case of the food appearing much better than it tasted. I had the entree w/one side of beef stroganoff & a beet salad. They used ground beef, not chunks of beef as it's always made. This cheap short cut was a turn off though the dish was pretty tasty. The beet salad was very pretty but it inexplicably had A LOT of corn in it. Wha...?! Beets and corn are NOT a good combo and considering that it's not corn season, a puzzling choice. BTW my friend's strawberry spinach salad also had a bunch of corn in it (?!). Apparently Savoy Cafe got a buttload of corn they were getting rid of. The worst thing is of the meal is that I found a long coiled up piece of hair in my salad. GAG! Also the lemon bar & peanut butter cookie were mediocre.
I really enjoy the salad bar at Savoy! So much great stuff. Great sandwiches too and so many healthy juices and drinks to choose from, great place!

Love this place! Their salads at the counter and food you order are amazing and we have never been disappointed. They aslo have a lot of vegan, gluten-free, and sugar-free foods and desserts. I got a vegan, gluten-free chocolate chip cookie that I really enjoyed. Their coffee bar is great, and has a large selection of teas. They have almond and coconut milk options for coffee drinks, which I really appreciate. The only drawback is that their salad bar is kind of radom with its toppings. Also, the prices aren't the cheapest, but it is in the heart of downtown, so that's expected. Really cute atmosphere, great service, and an overall happy place. I come here too often, and love it!

I love the salad bar! It is fresh, delicious, and the house Italian dressing is spicy and to die for. I love their tofu as well. This review is strictly for the salad bar & soups - since that is all I have tasted. It's definitely a little pricey- so I only go about once a week. At 9.95 a pound for salad, it gets expensive, fast. Sit on the back patio, you won't regret it!

Paul & Kathy Shields are the husband/wife magic behind this great restaurant.  The food is fresh, creative, and always changing.  They have created a friendly, welcoming ambiance and carry outstanding teas, coffees, and wines.  (Kathy's desserts are amazing.)  Love this place!

Best French toast ever!!! Their gluten free and vegan options are also very tasty and the food is always fresh here. Staff are friendly and the cafe is super cute. Great place to meet friends for brunch.

I've been going to the Savoy Cafe since it was called something a little different! While they are a bit pricey for deli/cafe food, it is truly gourmet! Every time I am there the service is awesome and the food is delicious. The desserts are killer - especially the chocolate cake! I picked up an All Day Breakfast Burrito this morning and, while it is super tasty, the salsa may be one of the best I've had in years! Only problem is that it is sooo good, I want to eat it all and it is huge! I was so excited when they opened for breakfast AND dinner! Keep up the great work!

Where else can you find a salad bar that stocks mostly organic items?  And also salmon and roast beef?  While I was in school, this was my favorite place to study.  Healthy and yummy food, with baked goods for special treats, and the staff never made me feel like I was in the way.

HOWEVER, last week I took a salad to go, then realized I forgot my wallet.  The cashier (pretty girl with brown shoulder length hair) said she recognized me and took an IOU.  What?!  What a wonderful place!!
Great little place to get away for a quiet dinner.  Food is fresh and delicious.  Good portions at good prices.  Good service.  Easy to get to.  Satisfaction every time.

My absolute favorite place to eat in town. This place is very charming and has a good indoor and outdoor seating area. Pretty much everything on the hot and cold case counter is good but the things I highly recommend trying are the turkey pasilla fritters, quinoa mango salad, strawberry spinach salad, turkey pozole. 
I also love that they have health conscious desserts for those with intolerance or allergies. I'm sensitive to milk products so I appreciate that they have vegan option desserts that are delicious. 
One of my other favorite things about this place is that when you order tea, they serve it to you in a cast iron pot and they use these adorable English teacups and saucers. Their tea selection is great and you can choose to mix two different kinds if you're indecisive. 
I would definitely recommend Savoy Deli. They use quality ingredients, have a wide selection of tasty food and the staff are very attentive and helpful.

Came here for the first time because my friend recommended it. Got the pancakes and they were pretty bad. Not sure how you can mess up plain pancakes but I will put the picture up of the burnt pancake that they tried to hide on the bottom. I should've known when I saw the black flakes surrounding the cakes. Even the other pancakes would fall apart as you're trying to eat it. So for $12 I would say it was a complete rip off. I mean $12 for pancakes is already crazy to me but then you get them and they're terrible. Stay away.

Great experience! Food was excellent and the service was very helpful and friendly. I did not find the layout to be confusing at all. No matter how full you are, don't pass up the deserts. The cookies were terrific, and only .99 cents, even if you have to get them to go.
I love everything about this place; best salad bar in town, but the quiche is the star: as good as quiche in France. Best desserts too!

Solid gourmet deli in Santa Barbara. I love that they list their organic items on the board right where you walk in. They have a salad bar with great specialty items like sun dried tomatoes, hearts of palm, roasted garlic different nuts/seeds, as well as the usual veggies and greens. It is $10.95 a pound, which is pretty steep considering the salad bar is not totally organic. The case has some great prepared dishes as well. I got the forbidden rice salad, which was organic black rice with sweet potato and some other veggies and it was great! The ambiance is nice with a small fountain in the center of the dining room. Overall, Savoy cafe is a good, casual healthy food stop in Santa Barbara. Glad I found it.

Excellent food! Up there with the best breakfasts we've had. Huevos rancheros - probably the best one we've tasted, and delicious Turkey pasilla jack scramble. Friendly, quick service. Clean, pretty cafe.
Great options for a dine in or take out breakfast, lunch, or snack.  Very creative with many menu items and have gluten free options.  Also have a great salad bar.

I would give this more than 5 stars if I could. Very delicious and flavorful food - and so many options! Came with husband (GF) and twin 1st grade daughters. Everyone was happy with sharing Breakfast burrito, pancakes, and huevos rancheros. We will definitely be back.

I'm a major foodie and this place is the bomb!  I'm quite addicted to Savoy and have been coming a couple times a week just because I love the atmosphere so much.  I was so surprised to see Savoy Cafe & Deli on Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives with Guy Fieri since it doesn't seem to fit into the greasy spoon category so commonly featured on his show. 

They have THE best coffee in town and make mochas and lattes homemade - meaning quality chocolate melted into your mug and for lattes, vanilla chips melted...though they do have the syrups for those of you who haven't evolved your senses to the highest quality ingredients you can find.  I stop in just for their reasonably priced coffee--my favorite roast is the Ethiopian DIGS.  So good it hardly needs any creamer.  Their breakfasts are so good - though I prefer the wonderful breakfast burrito or eggs scramble over their eggs benedict just because of the thick crusty bread used makes it hard for me to cut and chew, nothing to knock a star off for though.  Their turkey pazole is excellent too...their sides look yummy though I haven't tried them.  

Don't miss getting a bakery item though - highly recommend their muffins, CARROT CAKE, and CHOCOLATE BUTTERMILK CAKE...OH MY!  Everything is so good - I have recently gone gluten-free and there are a ton of options for us. The gluten-free snickerdoodles and brownies with ganache and the gluten-free banana bread are perfect with my coffee.

The owners are almost always there and are so caring and have really gotten the right mix here...they care about the small details in a way I have't seen done this well.  Ingredients are high quality, mostly organic, and the tea selection, tea pots, individual tea cups and plates are all different.  It's like going to a friend's house...comforting and delightful. 

I love cooking and preparing good quality food and if I'm too tired to do it, I go to Savoy.  Enough said.

Pretty tasty organic food, it tastes somewhat like my grandma's food. ( this is a compliment, as my grandma is a french chef). I mean you can feel that the food is homemade and the ingredients are fresh. Their pumpkin vanilla gluten free cupcake is probably one of the best cupcake I've ever eaten! Just a little pricey for the food... but it's organic so...

We ate here four times on our weekend trip. Great atmosphere, excellent food, good prices, pleasant service. The loose leaf tea was especially good. My gluten free daughter loves the pancakes and muffins.

Wide selection of great food! Plenty of vegan and gluten free options if that's your thing. Staff is always friendly, service is great, coffee even better (they make a mean latte with a coconut/almond milk blend). I usually swing in for breakfast and have never been disappointed with their scrambles. Breads are great and I love their jams! Great place to check out in SB.

They are very accommodating to celiacs and have a decent amount of gluten free options. I was so happy that I found out about this little hole in the wall cafe. I also love the way they set up their establishment too. My one critique is that I feel their prices are slightly higher than I would normally pay for particular cafe meal. However, I keep coming back so they are doing something right lol

My husband and I had gone here for lunch. Seating is limited but there are seats in the back of the restaurant as well. The food is good but definitely a bit on the pricey end. All sides are a la carte. 

The reason for my rating is because of service, not the food or environment. Just so you know, you pay at the counter after you order your food. I paid for lunch and put in a tip. First off, I have an 18 month old child who was very hungry. My husband had to ask the cashier/worker to get the mac n cheese we ordered because she wanted us to wait. All she had to do was take less than 10 steps to the deli area and scoop it up for us.

Second, I checked my bank statement after a week and seen that my receipt did not match up what was charged. Which ever person closes for the day had put in an extra amount on the tip.

For some people this is not a big deal but its the principal behind it. I spoke with the manager and was told that this would be taken care of. I waited 2 weeks only to not have been credited the amount. I went to culinary school and have worked both FOH and BOH. I understand the hard work everyone puts into this industry. However, putting in more for your tip then what was given is morally and ethically wrong. 

Be sure that if you go here to eat that you keep your receipt and double check that there is no mistake. For this reason, I don't think I'll be coming back here.
Whoa!  Super great healthy fantastic food. G-free, vegan delicious. I'm organically happy here.

This is place is great and other people think so too. Be prepared to wait in line to order and then for a table. Wide selection of gluten free, vegan & organic choices. Delicious build your own salad bar available. The gf brownie is the best I've ever tasted. Order at the counter & have a seat. When in the SB area, don't miss this one.
Amazing little place! Wonderful service and delightful eggs Benedict on gluten-free bread.

Love this place.  Would eat here everyday if I could.  Best quiche ever.  Whipped sweet potatoes are killer. Everything is fresh and homemade. Lots of organic items.  Great atmosphere for a quick lunch.  Public Parking lot across the street. Alway busy at lunch but you can share a table.  Great way to make new friends! 10 stars!

A must visit after seeing this on diner's drive-ins, and dives. My boyfriend and I shared the 'guy plate' which was a great size for two who aren't big eaters. The mango quinoa salad was just---the best. And the carrot cake is the best I have ever had. Staff is so-so, one woman was mind of rude. But the food is worth getting past that. Also, cute atmosphere!

Savoy has a lot of healthy food options! There is a salad bar with soups as well as sampler plates with two or three sides. They also have a really breakfast selection. I will definitely try more dishes at this really healthy cafe!

Just stopped by today with my wife.  My Huevos Rancheros was very good.  It was nice and hot with a crunchy none-soggy hard shell taco.  Awesome homemade salsa.  My wife liked her eggs and potatoes ok as well.

The atmosphere was ok overall, but you have to order from the counter which is good or bad depending on what you are looking for.  Kinda felt like a comfy cafeteria.

No complaints other than a kinda boring menu. However, if you want a quick and simple breakfast I recommend this place.

I was so bummed. I get excited about their gluten free French Toast because you can't find that very many places here in SB. Well we went and the Fresno toast well was toast but barely had any egg in it. It was dry (gluten free bread is naturally very dry which makes it perfect to soak up the eggs) it was like a lukewarm likely toasted piece of toast. Anyway our excitement for the place has gone down significantly and will not be going back. Too bad. Back to my search for gluten free French toast. And hopefully the best place had more comfortable chairs. That can be overlooked if the food is good but if not, the hard small wood chairs are not comfortable. 

They have good coffee so go there for coffee.

I can't believe I've never had this place before! My new SB favorite for healthy, delicious, FRESH food. Absolutely recommend. I had the 9 trails sandwich and it did not disappoint. Another must - the chocolate chip cookie.
Huevos Rancheros their own way, and over the top delicious.  Very rich with the fried, crispy corn tortillas and wonderfully gooey melted cheese.  Fresh Orange Juice A+.

For lunch, this is my absolute favorite place to go for a healthy, high-quality, light meal. The salad bar is the best I've ever experienced, and allows me to have a light, protein-rich lunch that keeps me feeling energetic through the rest of my work day rather than sinking into a post-lunch coma after a big sandwich or the like. The house-made poppyseed vinaigrette is one of my favorite dressings at any restaurant in Santa Barbara and is now sold by the bottle in their refrigerated section. There is also a lovely selection of drinks from natural cola to kombucha, as well as an array of gluten-free and sugar-free baked goods (and full-gluten and sugar as well!). It is a gift to have this establishment in Santa Barbara.
