I love Savoy! I eat there every time I'm in Santa Barbara. Turkey Fritter is amazing. Love the quinoa salad. So many healthy options for delicious food!

Came in on Monday August 5th, 2013 after the cashier at CVS on State Street -- swore it was the place to visit.

We arrived to a fairly empty restaurant around 11:45 AM --- however, it didn't stay that way for long. We ordered: Breakfast Burrito with eggs, potatoes, cheese, avocado, house made salsa $8.95, along with Build Your Own Sandwich for $9.95 --- Roast Beef, Provolone and Sliced Sourdough. After ordering, we proceeded to the counter --- where we ordered two Kolsch Beers on Tap and was given #14 --- where we sat down a table on the front window.

The breakfast burrito came out first --- and was gigantic. I enjoyed every last bite of it --- as each item complimented the others perfectly and did not skimp in any areas. After a few minutes --- the roast beef sandwich came out and was spot on. It would have been nice for both items to come out at once --- but I understood with how packed they were this probably was not practical on their end. 

However at this point I had wait in a 5 person line of people paying to ask for the two beers that we ordered about 10 to 15 minutes earlier which did not arrive. The staff apologized for the delay --- and all was solved.

I recommend this place if in the area --- and had no idea it was on Dives, Drive-Ins, and Dinners until seeing it on the back of the employees shirts.

Solid four stars. Great concept. I love the fact that this is a gluten free farm to fork style restaurant. Butter and syrup was organic as well. I can't begin to tell you how I can't stand the artificial syrup most restaurants have. Pricing was a bit on the higher side. $11 for 4 lavender sodas. I know Sprouts and such sells the same brand for about $6-7. Food was also quite slow to arrive for a self-service type place.

Go around back to the patio if you're with a dog! I did enjoy the salad bar, but found it pricey or I'm just a pig and put too much yummies on there! LOL I loved the patio as did my dog. The ice tea was delish. I wish the steak would have been warm to put on my salad... I like it when it wilts my lettuce a bit. The salmon - for me, I just didn't care for it (gave it to the dog). But everything else was good. The dolmas were nice as well!!!

This place was amazing! I recommend it to everyone. The staff was brilliant, especially our boy matt. They are all so kind and helpful. The food is to die for. It is very fresh and makes you feel fabulous because it is so healthy. 

5 STARS!!!!!!

My Two girls love this place. I'm not big on going out for breakfast mostly because its easy to cook a great meal. But with the refrigerator a barren landscape it was time to go out. I could see how this place could easily get overwhelmed with people and be quite annoying but lucky for us it was fairly empty on a late Sunday morning. I ordered the French Toast and my beautiful sidekick the Breakfast Sandwich. Honestly I was not expecting the perfectly cooked "pile" of French Toast with a assortment of organic fruit and berries that arrived. 

The attractive person at the table (not me) sandwich was also prepared excellently and tasted great with a side of semi spicy chipotle sauce. I will say this, next time the refrigerator echos we're at the Savoy.

This is by far the cutest deli I have ever seen! Their style and decor is cute yet classy. 

We came here because we heard the sandwiches were amazing, and they were! You can tell their ingredients are fresh. 

Inside they also had a salad bar, other food items to order (thought I saw a guy with curry, but I could be wrong), little cafe bar for coffee that also doubled as a wine bar, desserts, and plenty of excellent drink selections.

They provided excellent service and next time I'm in town, I'll be sure to come back here!
Fresh ingredients and flavorful dishes. The coffee is fantastic too. We were impressed and will definitely return. The seating area is nicely decorated.

My wife and I were looking for a nice restaurant for lunch and this one certainly hit it out of the park. We loved the atmosphere - very cozy and clean. The people were friendly and it was very quiet with a calm fountain in the background. And the food was excellent. I got their famous eggs benedict which did not disappoint and my wife got the Guy Fieri plate which had this really tasty turkey fritter that melted in your mouth.

The calm environment and tasty food was just what we were looking for.

Fabulous Food, Delicious Drinks, Special Staff! These are the reasons to go to Savoy! Honestly, I can get a latte anywhere, but latte art? Only thanks to Heather at Savoy. She's the best barista in the world, and honestly, probably the universe. I love my cat creations in the morning. Also, she knows how to brew amazing cold brew coffee. Gotta try their kale salad AND their eggs benedict. Delish!! Quaint and cozy atmosphere makes you feel right at home at Savoy.

Enjoyed a rainy day breakfast of Veggie Eggs Benedict and Yerba Matte tea. OMG it was delish! Loved the house made hollandaise sauce, such a relief to see something other than the yellow gunk everyone always has. Mushrooms and tomatoes were sautéed with wilted spinach piled beneath the perfectly poached eggs. Don't try to be all healthy by ordering a salad...the potatoes are totally worth the additional carb intake.

Okay, I have to admit something.... I rely heavily upon Yelp reviews, but you know that already.  What you don't know is that I also watch "Triple D," and when Guy Fieri raves about a place, or if I'm impressed with what I see, I THEN consult Yelp to see how Yelpers have rated the places Guy is at.  I then "may" bookmark them to try....... but I don't always.  Sometimes Guy raves, the food looks great, but Yelpers feel a different way, and I just don't always want to try them.  HOWEVER, with the Savoy Café and Deli, not only did Guy rave, not only was I uber impressed with that segment of the show, but I then got onto Yelp and found 4.5 stars....... that is simply sooooooooooooooooo rare, I can't tell you.  Usually, most typically, the places Guy hits usually just get 3.5 stars, less often 4 stars........ but 4.5, well, I can count on one hand.... okay, maybe 2....... but it's not often.  Trust me.

While this episode first aired in 2012, I just recently saw a rerun of it, and within one week of that, we descended upon this place in an attempt to escape Los Angeles heat in the summertime.  Super cute little place.  Dining inside, a patio out back.  You walk up to a counter with all kinds of freshly prepared salads, quiches, baked goods, and you can order whatever you want...... breakfast/brunch foods (I saw a plate of gorgeous looking Belgian waffles with fresh fruit piled high) if that be your craving, sandwiches, salads, quiches, dessert items.  There's a separate salad bar....... and even a coffee/tea bar.  I think there's even wine and beer, but I'm not 100% sure about that part.  They are also known for their freshly baked desserts, especially carrot cake.

I can tell you hands down everything we ate was OUTSTANDING.  My husband loved his broccoli cheese quiche and caprese salad, and I loved my "Gibraltar" sandwich, which consisted of roast beef, turkey and bacon (altho I didn't get bacon in mine), lettuce, tomato, avocado, provolone cheese, mayonnaise and Dijon mustard on sourdough bread.  It was a great sandwich with lots of each ingredient.  The only downfall to the sandwich is that the sourdough bread couldn't withstand the weight and moisture of these ingredients, and it fell apart almost instantly.   Probably could have used a sturdier bread, but it was still delicious, and I ate it all.  I asked for a side of the pesto green beans, and they were absolutely wonderful.  The green beans were cooked, but crisp, then refrigerated and slathered with this wonderful pesto; it wasn't at all greasy, just yummy !!!  So glad I tried those.

While we were too full to eat anything else THERE, we absolutely did order take-out of some of the bakery items.  Darn tootin !!!  We got a slice..... which is huuuuuge....... of their famous carrot cake, a 4" pecan pie tart, a cranberry almond muffin and a pumpkin streusel muffin.  OMG........... that was the BEST carrot cake EVER.  Seriously.  I think it was the cinnamon.  Something set it apart, and that's my opinion of what it was.  Absolutely perfect.  The pecan pie and muffins were equally delicious, but I'm not gonna lie, the carrot cake stole the show....... and NO, we didn't eat all that in one sitting.  We savored it and ate it over a few days....... and it wasn't easy to do.

We've been making Santa Barbara our home away from home (only an hour from us, and in this heat, we've been going up there weekly).  This place gives us yet one more reason to go up there.  Sooooooooooooooo delish !!!

I was sent here because a local recommended it. The atmosphere is awesome and the staff were very friendly, but I found the food over-priced and not as delicious as I was hoping. Perhaps I simply ordered the wrong thing or had my expectations too high. It can get very busy on a weekend morning, but if you're looking for a neat, family-friendly, comfortable place to grab some food (and are willing to hunt down seating), then this is a lovely place. I'd love to return during a less busy time of day and try something else on the menu, which I plan to do whenever I'm back in the area.

Gluten free options are as good or better, specialky the toast, cakes and cookies. Great ossobuco. Delicious breakfast (Flap Jacks specially!) Organic salad bar with lots of options. Tasty soups (pea/bacon, meat/kale, among others.

Food is good but I don't understand the prices. It's a bit steep. 2 combo plates and no drinks $37... also food is pre-made so any allergies or food sensitivities lead to a limiting menu for anything other than salad bar. Nice vibe for atmosphere and music though.

Recently stayed in Santa Barbara for a few days and the food here was so good that we ended up eating breakfast here twice.

The service was also very friendly on both visits. I'd highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Santa Barbara for breakfast.

It might also be helpful to know that they have several gluten-free options for anyone with allergies.

This place has the best salad bar ever! They have so many fresh ingredients including chicken and salmon to put on top. They also have delicious breads and desserts. 

The only problem is, it is very overpriced. Sometimes the salad comes out to $10-15. However if you can afford it, it is a delicious place to grab lunch and dinner.

Love, love, love this place!! But then again any place with a quality salad bar wins my heart pretty quickly.... They have an extensive salad bar, excellent deli with sandwiches, have a parking lot across the street (always a plus...), and the staff is pleasant in general. (I think) they also have an expresso bar, and may serve alcohol as well. Overall, an A+ for a deli!!

I was so disappointed with this place.. my friend recommended the Gluten-Free pancakes, saying they were delicious and fluffy- I was SO excited.

I came in and ordered, this was maybe around 11 AM on a weekday, so it was slow (maybe 5-6 other people). First off, the pancakes were over 13 dollars.... I was hesitant to pay so much, but my friend's recommendation made it sound worth it, so I forked over the cash. Then, it took ~25 to 30 minutes to get my order, and it was SO quiet in there, I have no idea how it could possibly take that long. Then, the pancakes were skimpy, flat and TINY. There were only 3 of them, and they were barely bigger than silver dollar pancakes from IHOP (and not even as good...). 

So, 13+ bucks and 30 minute wait later, the pancakes were super disappointing and I was still hungry... Sorry but I am not coming back. :(

Love this cafe!  The curry chicken salad was so flavorful as well as the kale salad.  Will have to go back and taste other items because everything looked delicious.  The portions were very generous too!  Definitely recommend Savoy cafe and deli!

Turkey. Pasilla. Fritter. Ate 1 in store, and immediately bought 3 stowaways to bring back to LA. If they delivered these things from Santa Barbara, I'd be ordering....

Salad bar and sides rock also. The only bad reviews are probably from people not used to eating real, healthy food. Go to Denny's, simpletons!

I went with two friends about a week ago, and was so so excited because I had heard it had all the health foods like natural cafe, but it was just down the street from my work!

Well it was the most ho-hum salad I have ever had. The only perk was the viniagrette dressing that I got with it. That was awesome. I probably wont go back for such a boring meal. Bummer

Yummy soups and sandwiches! My favorite is the Gaviota sandwich (minus the Dijon mustard) and Turkey Posole soup. 

Fresh, healthy, and tasty. Super friendly staff in a very welcoming little shop. They have hot foods and desserts too.
Great little breakfast or lunch spot where you can get great coffee and food in a nice off the path location and maybe listen to a local musician if you're lucky.

Very pleasant atmosphere in this cafe. Had breakfast burrito that was very good. Wife had vege Benedict which was very good but bread a little burnt. The deli food looked good and I would think they have big take out business. Friendly people and good food.

Amazing food....so good in fact we decided it would be worth a weekend drive next time just for lunch. The hot pastrami sandwich is the best I've ever had. Ever. Seriously. The green beans smothered in pesto are so unexpectedly delicious. What a gem. We'll be back!
Excellent natural food, soup and salad bar cannot be beat, sandwiches are superb. Best beverage and desert selections in town.

The best spot for breakfast hands down in Santa Barbara.  Kathy Paul and heir family have worked a miracle....terrific food friendly staff and a welcoming atmosphere even for dogs in the outdoor patio.  Kathy's gluten free treats are other worldly...can cupcakes muffins and. Robbie's that food really be gluten free?  You bet.  A real community place that celebrates the family's enduring faith in community.  You won't be sorry...especially if you try the gluten free pancakes with a turkey fritter on the side!

Me and my BFF had dinner at this place sooo good, blown away at customer service felt amazing after we ate a good full and the quality of food for the amount you pay was not believable . We can't wait to go back and try other items on there menu.

We discovered this place on a recent weekend away and the whole family loves it!  They have delicious gluten free pancakes & desserts my 5 year old flipped over!  I'm partial to the curry over brown rice and my husband couldn't get enough of the butternut squash puree!  They have a great selection of teas and serve them in quaint mismatched cups.  If you're in a hurry, they have a nice selection of sandwiches and beverages to go.  We spend many weekends in SB so we'll be regulars at Savoy!

It was my first time to Santa Barbara and my sister took me here for lunch! It was wonderful !! Everything was fresh and homemade. And then there are all the wonderful desserts. I got the Gibraltar , Greek salad and the butter pecan cake ! Oh dear god it was good! The atmosphere is very causal , most of the tables are family style witch is fun and makes for meeting interesting people! I highly recommend this place!

Great breakfast burrito! Thick cut chunks of potato, fluffy eggs, avocado, and an impossibly thin tortilla so you can taste the filling. Add on some housemade pico and you're set!  Dont worry, if you're gluten free this is your spot.

Not what I expected as far as taste or customer service. The ambiance and options were nice, but I was disappointed with the taste. I ordered the eggs Benedict and did not like their version of hollandaise (can't remember what it was called) it had a sweet taste to it, plus the ciabatta was a little too tough. They also seemed to mess up my husband's eggs. He ordered scrambled, but they were more like a chopped up over easy. They re-made the eggs, no problem, but it did interrupt our time and conversation.
Absolute must try in Santa Barbara!  Amazing salad bar, terrific entrees, unique desserts, craft beer, delicious wine, insane variety of tea and amazing service which is rare for Santa Barbara.

Been meaning to write this review for a while... Savoy Cafe catered the reception after my mom's memorial service in January 2013. Delicious food, beautifully presented, and delivered on time without a hitch. I'd been to the cafe a few times and always loved it. I'm very grateful for their service, and most especially for their sensitivity and kindness.
The restaurant & deli are super cute! The vegan options are pretty good too :) If I'm ever in the area again, I'll be back!
Good place for a quick casual healthy lunch.
Only had the desserts from here, extremely satisfied. Gluten free cupcakes and cookies are great, the banana walnut bread is perfect.
Great sandwiches and pastries, including lots of gluten-free options (good sandwich bread! multiple pastries!).

I really liked this place. A lot. 

We stopped in here for a mid-afternoon cup of coffee, and I wanted something a bit sweet too. I had an Apricot and Cranberry bar, and it was super delicious. I also had an Americano with two extra shot, and the caffeine buzz has yet to wear off some eight hours later. Gotta Love it!

To top all that off, the dining room was beautiful, clean, and well lit, The decor was warm and inviting, and the service was great. All of the girls who work here were really nice and friendly. 

If I lived in the area, this would totally be my spot for coffee and light snacks.

This place is so mediocre and stingy with portions. They are milking this Guy Fieri thing which really focused on Norton's Pastrami and not Savoy. They have signs with his name and pictures literally everywhere, making it extremely tacky. I do like the El Cap sandwich although it is further shrinking every time I get it. Now it can only be classified as a snack rather than a sandwich.
This not your normal Deli, or cafe.  The food is fresh, healthy, and prepared with care.  Grab and go or eat in for breakfast-lunch-dinner.  Very nice people and reasonable prices.  I'll be back!

I am in love with this place! I love the fact that they have mostly organic food, both regular and vegan. You can find pretty much everything at this place. Wonderful and fresh salad bar, great bakery. The vibe, decor of the place, the plants, the candles and the nice little touches here and there (of both the restaurant and the patio) make Savoy down to earth yet very romantic and classy. Every detail shows that the owners and staff really care. And, it is very reasonably priced. Can't wait to return!!

My go to lunch spot! I love how they have so many organic options. They also have many options for those with dietary constraints such as gluten free, vegetarian and vegan. 

Great atmosphere with indoor and outdoor seating. The outdoor is shaded and located through the back door with a nice fountain for a soothing ambiance.

Their desserts are located by the cashier and of course look so delicious! The carrot cake is a must try.

They also have an Axxess deal of buy one entree get one free woohoo! Also great staff. A must try!

Great place full of gluten free choices.
I had a chocolate cake and a cookie later on. Both were delicious. A little on the pricey side but always expect that with gluten free. A lot of other cakes to choose from.
I had an iced mocha and it had chocolate chips in the bottom, which didn't really work. So I knocked off a star for that.
Going back the next day for breakfast whilst visiting SB though so am excited :-)

Savoy Truffles is a great gourmet deli, and much more than a traditional deli. Food from the salad bar is purchased by weight, and prepared foods from the service counter can be purchased a la carte or as a set meal. Menus are fresh and the choices are delicious. For the price of a greasy burger lunch, about $10, you can have savory stuffed chicken breast or seared salmon with sides of grilled vegetables, just as an example. During a moment of indecisiveness, the man behind the counter let me sample a few selections. The surroundings, which can be hectic during the lunch hour, is still decorated with class. 
They also carry local artisan truffles, which come in exciting flavors like green tea, rosewater or roasted coconut. 
For those who feel this place is reminicent of the deli at Lazy Acres, I've heard it's owned by a couple formerly associated with the upscale grocery store, but I cannot confirm this.
I really like coming here for casual business lunches.
Very good breakfast, Chai Lattès with almond milk, and very nice staff

The pre-made salads behind the counter are delicious. It would be awesome if they included all of those dishes in the salad bar. Generally pretty expensive, but tasty and nice tables to sit and eat lunch

I walked into Savoy because it's conveniently located by my workplace. When I walked in to Savoy, it had an immediately cozy and welcoming atmosphere. There was even a small water fountain going! Although I didn't have enough time to have a full sit down meal, I did get a take-out sandwich.

It seems as if there's two different options you may choose from when buying a sandwich. Either you can choose on of their own creations or make your own. 

My boyfriend had previously brought me a sandwich from Savoy a few weeks prior to me going. It was delicious. He made one for me, which I loved because it included sprouts and guacamole. I think I would recommend making your own sandwich rather than getting one of their creations. They have a great veggie combo that they add to your creation.

However, when I went there I decided to get one of the listed sandwiches. I went with... I can't remember the name, but it was the one with turkey and cranberry. It was right after Thanksgiving, so I thought it was fitting. It was yummy.... but small. For $9, I was still hungry. Forewarned their sourdough bread they used for this sandwich was very tiny! But overall, I really enjoyed the sandwich. 

Not a bad experience, I would go back again and check out their normal menu.

Delicous food. I aleays go here for the chicken pozole soup, awesome salad bar, and caprece slices. My friend loves the french toast. If you have alergies to gluten, or are vegan, there are many options. Vegan pastries, gluten free french toast, largest selection of fancy drinks. Youll get hipsters, old folks, and even punks and goths in here. The only downfall is the prices. You have to watch it or you'll end up spending 25 bucks for lunch, a drink, and a pastry. Other then that its a great lil place!
Just updating to add that the quiche is the best I've ever had and that combined with the mixed greens is my new favorite breakfast! Thanks, Savoy!
If I lived in Santa Barbara, I'd come here daily. Such a great selection and mostly extremely friendly staff. Love it. Tasty everything. Lots for vegetarians and glutenfree.
Breakfast Lunch or Dinner. Get you buns down here and order ANYTHING. If you are on a diet don't go near the pastry displays!

Savoy - this review is for you, out of love. First off - your desserts are amazing, truly, the best. And I really enjoy your cafe and excellent salad bar... but I want to enjoy it even more. There are a couple things that have left me a bit ho-hum that would be simple changes to make.  The mac and cheese - it looks great but it is in serious need of flavor, please, please spice it up or choose a more flavorable cheese or something. I also feel the beef stroganoff could use a little help in this area too. Recently I chose beef and veggie soup and found several pieces of not so choice meat. There were parts that looked like an artery, it disturbed me and I could not continue eating the soup, which, given the price, was irritating. Lastly, the mixed greens bin at the salad bar are frequently wilted which leaves me with spinach or oversized chunky romaine to choose from. Bite sized romaine chunks would be more welcoming. My friend and fellow Savoy lover would like to suggest some fruit options on your salad bar, such as strawberries and/or oranges. That's all, I hope you take this as a most kind suggestion. Thanks!

Great little organic cafe in santa Barbara. We stored here on our way back to L.A. and I was not disappointed. The chicken coconut curry was super delicious, and tasted like authentic Thai food (and I know Thai food!). I paired it with a side of roasted veggies and it costed about $10 to $12. 

They also have a great variety of teas!

Fantastic pastries and delicious sandwiches!

I come here about once a week for lunch and never tire of their gourmet sandwiches. Ingredients are always fresh and never too heavy. Every once in a while I sneak in a brownie or double chocolate chip cookie (heavenly).

My only complaint is that the salad bar -while it has a great selection- is a more than bit over-priced.

I highly recommend the citrus french toast with fresh fruit. The salad bar was also excellent (try the butter poached salmon!). How to order and get food was a little unclear, but it was a really nice spot and we will be back. The service was very professional and accommodating.

this place is pretty cute and they play classical music. i got a turkey sandwich which was good but def overpriced.  my friend got chicken and a sweet potato mash which was awesome. my other friend got a quiche and strawberry and hearts of palm salad which is really good.

coffee is also excellent

We stopped in for lunch after reading Yelp reviews.  We were not disappointed.  It was wonderful.  I had the salad bar which was the best salad bar ever.  It had chicken, salmon, steak, tofu, roasted garlic, hearts or palm, nuts, seeds, beets, sweet potatoes and all of the usual suspects.  I loved it!  My honey had a beef and turkey sandwich that he really enjoyed.  What a great find!
Pesto green beens, chicken curry, all desserts and the salad bar are all excellent! They have a great tea selection as well. Great overall ambiance.
Great choice of fresh food and all kinds of drinks, relaxed atmosphere plus very friendly staff. Loved it!

This is my first time visiting savoy. I have lived in Santa Barbara several years, without realizing there is such a fantastic brunch here! First of all, my favorite part about savoy is the lovely atmosphere here. On Saturday morning, everyone is so relaxed and happy. We could either order at the counter, or choose by ourselves in the salad bar. There are a lot of choices. I ordered a chicken cake. It is soooo delicious, although it does not look so cool ahaha. The staff here are very patient and helpful! I really recommend savoy if you want some American brunch!

Diners, Dine-ins yada yada yada.  The turkey fritter is good but this place offers a lot more.  Soups, Salad bar, sandwiches, and incredible breakfast!  Every time I go I find a new treasure on the menu.  One time I went and just drank a pot of tea!

I have friends who are regulars, partly because it caters well to the their diet restrictions, and I have enjoyed each of my visits there.  Tables are close together but that's part of the charm.  Also check out the cozy back patio.

Seriously delicious stuff. If you're ever in the Santa Barbara area and need something good and clean in your system (probably because you just ate some intense Freebirds the night before) this is your place to go. 

Coffee is great, perfect temp and the mugs are cute too! I had the with coconut milk and it was seriously so delicious. I can't rave enough about how much coconut milk can make or break a drink and it definitely made the drink even better. 

They were also super accomodating for us late goers who wanted breakfast and we just had to swoop over to the other side to grab breakfast menus. They have options for every kind of diet (and by diet I really mean diet restrictions) for Celiacs, for Paleo's and for Vegans. 

I had the Vegan omelette with Tofu and the gluten free french toast. Seriously what delicious food. My friend who's a Celiac really enjoyed the place and was so in love with the options. The Vegan omelette was delicious and really just made in a way that I had to take some home because I wanted everyone to try it. 

The French Toast was just one toast but it was split in half. I thought I was going to get ripped off because the flap jack seemed bigger but really it was the same because the French Toast was super sweet and it definitely was enough after the Omelette. 

The only con I can say and I won't deduct a star for it is parking kind of sucks but it was worth the walk. (I think there's parking right behind the Cafe but we didn't see it until later) And seating is kind of weird. It's a medium sized place and it seemed mildly busy on a Sunday morning but because it was even mildly busy it was still pretty loud. Your best bet is to find seating outside, which is beautiful but chillllllllly if you're not prepared. 

Other than that, with a stock full of Vegan/Gluten-Free bread it was definitely worth the trip to eat here. I'll definetely be back again.

GREAT place, great atmosphere, good food options. Back patio, organic drinks and foods, vegan options and gluten free foods. 1 star down because I would have loved even more gluten free/DAIRY FREE options, less grease and a cheerier waitress, but generally really great experience!

What a great selection of gluten free items! I would recommend this to any one coming to SB looking for a quaint and cute cafe! Got the gluten free cinnamon carrot muffin and was delighted by its light and fluffy texture and flavor! The GF bread is good as well! Arugula salad was okay but the atmosphere, GF accommodations and flavor of everything else made up for it! Will definitely be back.

Went here twice on the same day. Breakfast burrito was delicious and filling, quiche was moist and flavorful.  Even the gluten-free chai cookie was delicious.  Came back for dinner and had pastrami sandwich, lentil soup and side salad. All delicious!

Very charming place
The food is healthy & tasty
Homemade products
Familial business - fairly priced

Fell in love with this deli after my first trip. Amazing sandwiches and great assortment of salads as well. Don't get me started on their cold beverage selection; it's just impeccable. They have all sorts of drinks that I cannot live without like Yerba Maté, Honest Tea, Califia Farms almond milk iced coffee...I'm obsessed!!
Favorite place in SB. best salad bar and great place for a quick lunch. anybody would find something they like and the quality is topnotch.

I can't say enough about them. I have been coming in since they opened. One of the best things about Savoy is their service. All of the staff is so friendly helpful, always attentive and accommodating. The owners are always there and very hands on. Paul and Kathy care so much about their customers and it really shows. This is a family run business and the care and attention that goes to everyone walking in their door is second to none. I have a lot of dietary restrictions that have come on since becoming an adult. I am a vegan with allergies to most fruit and sensitivity to gluten. Not only does Savoy cater to my dietary restrictions, but they have options!!!! I come in several times a week as I work in the same neighborhood. Their salad bar has so many options (vegan caesar!!! Hearts of palm!!!!). They always have different soups on the daily that include a vegetarian option and often a vegan soup as well.  They offer a full espresso bar with the option of soy, almond, and coconut milk as well as an array of teas. I'm partial to lemonades and teas and they have so many options. They even have delicious freshly made desserts that cater to vegan/paleo/gluten free diets. One of my favorites is the vegan Chinese almond cookie and the salted "caramel" brownies. The fact that they place such an emphasis on their customer service really makes such a difference. Everything I have ever eaten here has been delicious and made with care and it shows. My favorites on Saturday mornings tend to be the vegan scramble and the tofu burrito (the tofu burrito is vegan and in the cold case ready to go for those in a hurry!). They use a lot of organic and locally sourced food. I can't rave enough about this place. I come in very often for my breaks from work. They tend to be very popular so calling in ahead of time is suggested!

Savoy truffles is by far my favorite place to go for lunch. The soups are almost always a good choice and the sandwiches are amazing. The pre-made salads are delicious. It's a great place to go with a group because there is such a range of foods available. They cater to a wide range taste from the salad bar to their hot, prepared food and have many veg/vegan options. Sometimes the vegan selections can be a little strange, but I'm not a vegan so there you go. I also like that they are mainly local & organic.

Drawbacks - It can get crowded and a little pricey if you're like me and can't decide what to get.
Whoa!  Super great healthy fantastic food. G-free, vegan delicious. I'm organically happy here.

This recommendation popped up when looking for paleo-friendly/Whole30 friendly restaurants in Santa Barbara. If this is currently your lifestyle, Savoy is perfect. I found that the employee who took my order was very accommodating when asking for a lettuce substitute for my sandwich as well as address my question about the mayo and other sauces. Thank you for serving hormone-free, antibiotic-free meat and a plethora of organic veggies!

My husband and I decided to try A different restaurant for breakfast yesterday. We live in Santa Barbara and have our favorite breakfast restaurants in town. Neither of us of ever been to the Savoy Café and deli so we decided to try something new yesterday. We are so happy. The food is outstanding. The restaurant specializes in healthy farm to table type of atmosphere they have food for Vegetarians, Vegans, Paleo and everyone else. My husband had the Huevos rancheros which he said was some of the best he's eaten. He devoured every single drop of his food which he typically does not do. I had eggs with a side of bacon and gluten-free toast. The bacon was cooked perfectly and it was delicious my only suggestion would be that they actually have breakfast offerings to include breakfast meats because a side is four pieces -too much and a little pricey. The potatoes are deliciously crunchy and packed with flavor. This is our new lunch place.

Was walking around downtown and decided to stop at Savoy for dinner since I was craving a sandwich and heard some good reviews about this place (including that it was on Triple D). Ordered the Gibraltar Sandwich (beef, turkey, bacon, avocado, sun dried tomato mayo) which was good and large but I think pricey for $11. Got a side of the macaroni and cheese to go with my sandwich and I definitely regretted that. It was watery and soggy and pretty terrible. I could only take a couple of bites. 

There is a salad bar and a lot of other pre made items, reminded me a lot of Whole Foods. But I think it was pricey and it's not really my style so I won't be returning.

This is the BEST place to eat in Santa Barbara!  The food is always fresh, colorful, and delicious!  The service here is top notch.  Paul and Kathy, the owners, treat you like family.  
My favorite dishes are the salmon with mango salsa, blueberry kale salad, strawberry spinach salad, and pesto green beans.  The breakfast is also incredible!  This is the perfect spot for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.  Even a great spot for a glass of wine, cup of tea, or espresso drink.
We also love that they are kid friendly.
Such great food- it's hard to decide what to order! Love that there are so many healthy choices.

I can't sing the praises loud enough for one of our very favorite local restaurants.

We especially love their breakfast menu.  Best gluten free pancakes and french toast I've ever found in a restaurant.  But be warned..the portions are big enough for 2. The pancakes come topped with fresh berries and real maple syrup.

Don't miss trying their mocha latte.  No artificial yucky syrups added to coffee to get the mocha flavor.  They melt chocolate chips into espresso--get the double espresso latte if you want the coffee flavor to come thru.

We love their soups and often take a couple of quarts home for easy lunches during the week.

Only thing I would like to see different is an occasional change of menu options, especially in the hot foods and the salads.  We eat there so often we'd like to have some different items to try.

but seriously, if you want a pleasant place, friendly staff, organic healthy and tasty food, you can't do better than the Savoy.

I was disappointed. The turkey fritter was very dry. I think they picked an old one for my "guy plate". I saw them take the original one off and hunt around for a replacement from the bottom. I went about 4:30 and you would expect that they would have something that was a little fresher. The carrot cake was good. My friends chicken Marsala was flavorful, but I would pass on the fritter and beef stroganoff.

Really nice peaceful cafe with good quality selections -  nice salad bar- 
 3 homemade soups to choose from  - yummy small selection of made to order sandwiches
they also have a delicious breakfast selection using organic eggs
I wouldn't mind being vegan if I can eat here everyday. Amazing veg dishes. No wonder it's a local fav.
The quality of service, atmosphere, and food here is so refreshing. I will definitely make this spot a regular!

I work on the block and frequent this spot quite often. I am never disappointed... in anything. The staff is so friendly and nice and the food is always amazing. Today I went with a friend on a quick lunch break. We both had the TurkeyChili, with some undertone of coriander and cloves, this was absolutely delightful. I then had a small portion of the Spinach&StrawberrySalad. This was the perfect ending to a meal. A little sweet, naturally, and the spinach was very fresh. Not to mention the walnuts mixed in! YUUUMMMM! I usually get a sandwich, which I just can't eat fast enough or enjoy slow enough-so delicious!

Clean, comfortable atmosphere. Lots of seating, attractive place. Definitely pricey. I enjoyed the Gibraltar sandwich, but for $11.83 I wouldn't visit again on a normal occasion. There was a wide selection of fresh sides as well. It's a cafe with a plus that's for sure. Enjoyed my lunch but $30 for two people seems a bit much

Being a relatively new transplant from Pasadena, I have been looking to replace my Pain Quotidient addiction with a SB organic, health conscious cafe.  As luck would have it, I parked in front of Savoy on my way to the best haircut I have ever had at Salon Brit.  I ran so late coming home that I was glad to stop ing and pick up some food to go for dinner.  The fritters were lovely, the quinoa salad bright and delicious and the chicken curry was gobbled up by hubby.  I could not believe my eyes when I saw they had agave sweetened desserts!!  As I looked around I saw all this organic food.  I am just thrilled I have a health option.  Love the deli.  No old stuff in the case.  All fresh and delish!  I plan on ordering some quiches for a brunch I am hosting.

The food is excellent here and I would come here much more often if the staff were not so unfriendly.  The girl that helped me today did not smile, say hi, and just stared at me blankly.  She did not give me my receipt and when I asked what was in the sample, she didn't know.  Love the food but the staff really needs to practice better customer service.  Just smiling would be nice.
Lovely salad selection and a changing daily selection of several gluten free (and delicious!) baked goods. Bonus: around the corner from The French Press!

I really want to like this place however the food is extremely expensive.  Think $45+ for two people for breakfast. For that I expect to get good service but instead the staff has an "I don't care" attitude. Really disappointing.  The food is really good.

What a treat this places. At lunch we had a breakfast burrito without the tortilla. It was terrific so we ordered a whole bunch of things to take with us for a picnic later the same later today,all of which were excellent as well. Five star rating on yelp really good

The salad bar alone is worth the visit but the rest of the menu gives a group a lot of options unless you are hung up on burgers and fries. Savoy has earned a place in the hearts and stomachs of Many Santa Barbara foodies. This is a special favorite of my vegetarian friends that appreciate the myriad options of cold and cooked options. 

There is a tiny deck out back and lots of tables inside. It will fill up at lunch since it has become such a favorite if you can't decide pick multiple salads by the 1/4 lb and sample a bunch.

Smelled good, clean inside, this place should be good, right? Nope. Confusing menu and when I ordered they served the wrong entree. No problem, they fixed it. Then, the prices don't match the menu. Way over charged for what it should cost. We started eating our food and "this is interesting"... Nothing tasted like it should. The spices were all wrong, dairy in what was claimed a vegetarian salad, just... underwhelming. The corner store sells dog food and at least you know what you are getting there. Needles to say, I will not be back.
Had a chicken and pasta dish here that was delicious. Can't remember the name. Portions weren't very large though for the price though so keep that in mind. They had a variety of options though.

This is my favorite place to go for lunch in downtown Santa Barbara. The atmosphere is very pleasant, staff is friendly, and the food is delicious. There are many options for the healthy-minded diners. Don't even get me started on the freshly baked desserts! The salad bar is the best in town and includes delicious soups. Food is fresh and natural. Took a visitor from Kenya here and she wanted to come back the next day! So we did.

Everything was fresh and delicious. Went for breakfast and had the best Huevos Rancheros I've ever had .. And I live in So. Cal. Not a "table service" place. You order at the counter and they bring it over. Don't let that stop you.

great customer service and clean.
We came for breakfast around 830 and I was hoping to get the "guy plate" but they said it was too early so I ended up getting the pasilla chile scramble and it was very good. My daughter was able to get some gluten free French toast and she loved it. She also loved the tea she got.
We all enjoyed our breakfast and now I have to go back to the guy plate
Great place for lunch and coffee. A good variety but not a huge menu. Bakery items are nice. Tables and seating sometimes feels a little crowded. Also mostly self serve.

Best for groups with a wide variety of diets/palettes, they have a giant selection of options from a DIY by-the-pound salad bar, to premade dishes and a coffee bar. However as we know the Jack of all trades is the master of none.

One of my favorites in all of Santa Barbara.  Food is always fresh and healthy...I have never had a bad meal here.  People are extremely friendly and helpful.  Try the coconut tea and spinach salad with strawberries!
Everything here is organic and delicious! Best orange juice! Freshly squeezed! The breakfast was amazing!

This place has a great market / deli feel which makes it unique in SB. The food is great and the deli-counter style make for a casual atmosphere. On top of that the staff is very pleasant. In a small way reminds me of a place that would feel at home in my beloved Reading terminal market in Philly (unlike the disaster that is/was the public market in SB). This is also a great place for kids.

As for the food: there is a really nice salad bar and deli case with all kinds of curries, osso bucco, etc, and creative salads. They also have a nice sandwich selection: to order.

I haven't been to Santa Barbara in years and I was eager to go for 2 reasons. It's a beautiful, vibrant city, and it boasts 3 restaurants I've been wanting to try. This is exactly what you want in a local eatery. Great food, great staff, and a totally relaxed atmosphere. I enjoyed the Savoy Benedict. Perfectly poached eggs served with black forest ham and a delightful Charon sauce, placed on a grilled Ciabatta roll. Extraordinary! My wife had their Quiche of the Moment. This day it was the Quiche Lorraine with bacon Swiss cheese and onion. Very nice! Our friend had the house made granola with Greek yogurt. We also had the carrot cake featured on the show. Almost a meal in itself A special shout out to our server Chloe. She made our visit even better than expected. Everything was exceptional and we look forward to a return trip.

Everything on yelp is true. I had the famous turkey patty thing featured on the food network, and it was awesome. Highly recommend this place. French decor throughout, very very cute cafe!! Would def return here when in SB!

Lunch today. Our second visit. Wonderful food and bright high energy ambiance. Their deli includes some offerings that are not the usual fare, and some have won awards. DW had mango quinoa and a turkey fritter. I had Osso Bucco and a special black rice with orange squash(?) or sweet potato(?). All 4 dishes were delightful. They serve (local Santa Barbara) Handlebar Coffees, which are some of the best, Anywhere.
My most favorite breakfast place in the world!! GF amazing food! Looove their GF French Toast. Service is super friendly! Great presentation of foods! Huge portions! Cute interior! Simply delicious!!

adorable, busy cafe with fast service, but unfortunately the tofu scramble was very bland. no seasoning like turmeric or nutritional yeast, just lightly fried with veggies. i'd love to see more places try to make a good yellow flavorful tofu scramble (without quinoa or soggy zucchini!) but the toast and potatoes were hearty and warm so it wasn't awful. the rest of my group enjoyed their huevos rancheros so maybe they just need to work on their vegan options so people won't assume all vegan food is so bland!
If you enjoy organic, local, incredible food in a cottage-like atmosphere, this is easily one of the greatest places I've ever eaten.

Delicious and amazing atmosphere! Came back 2x in one day while visiting Santa Barbara!

Citrus cheesecake is out of this world.

Great lunch, Lorraine veggie sandwich was excellent; had a sharp spicy mustard that gave it a great kick. Boyfriend had a turkey pasilla that he loved. His mashed potatoes were fantastic. Great ambiance, quiet, peaceful, very feng shui-esque. Perfect option for a quick lunch. Lots of gluten free desserts; g free thin mint cookie was awesome.

I'm from the Pacific Northwest and back home coffee is a big deal. The vanilla latte I just had was the best coffee I've had since I moved to California two years ago. So pleased with the quality of coffee. The tables are sticky and could use a wipe down, but the people and coffee are amazing. I'm gonna have to try lunch next time.

We came to the Savoy for lunch on a Sunday, and it was busy but not uncomfortably packed. We liked the wide variety of options. I had the vegan burrito, which was packed with good stuff like tofu, sweet potato, and avocado. They had some vegan baked goods as well, but I was too stuffed to try any! 

Solid location for a casual and relatively healthy breakfast or lunch.

Great selection of food choices, VERY tasty and health conscious.  It was funny because we love the show Diners, Drive-Ins & Dives and come to find that Guy Fieri also visited this same tasty location.  I had the turkey fritter which was amazing with a side of mashed potatoes and mac & cheese.  Everything was very tasty. There is also a full do it yourself salad bar.  I can't wait to go back to try that.  Highly recommended.

Found a little pocket menu in the office of our hotel we are staying at and saw that this place was on Diners, Drive-ins and Dives so the wife and I obviously had to check it out. 

Small little organic cafe in downtown Santa Barbara and it is fantastic. I was a little thrown off when some of the things in the cafe are self service but it's hard to tell what is and what isn't. 

The coffee was delicious and so was the food. Food came out very quickly and presentation was great. 

If you are looking for a small quite place to eat a great breakfast or brunch this is the place to do it.

We found this place thru Triple D. We walked in and got an early odd vibe about this place. Walked up to the counter and were greeted by some really friendly girls that were very helpful with our order. Breakfast till 3:00 on the weekend...yahoo!
I ordered the Salmon + eggs. Who knew? It was fantastic!  With a big fat piece of carrot cake...Yum Yum. The kind of place you go that you don't care how much money it costs.

We stopped at this wonderful cafe en route from L.A. to San Francisco.  It was pure luck!  The decor is charming, the staff was helpful & friendly and the sandwiches we ate were DELICIOUS!  We didn't order any of the specialty items, just some basic deli sandwiches but they were fresh and yummy.  
I like to support family-owned and operated businesses.  This spacious, immaculate cafe will remain bookmarked for future road trips.  Thank you!!!

Was in Santa Barbara for a Bob Dylan concert last weekend and a hotel employee recommended Savoy.
Enjoyed the Cap sandwich very much. (Portabella mushroom, avocado, tomato, greens, dijon and a great virgin olive oil and fig balsamic dressing on ciabatta bread.) Also had a tasty side of quinoa mango salad.
They offer a Guy Fieri-approved combo meal among many other choices.
This is a family-run business and staff is polite and efficient. The place has an understated country decor.

Usually we avoid the spots made famous by the food network, because they tend to be mobbed with people who watch the show and in our previous experience, the food and service tend to suffer with the pickup in volume. 

My sister had a friend in SB that recommended this spot, though, so we sidled on in with a group of six for a mid day lunch upon arrival in SB. I have to say, the food here clearly has NOT suffered one bit from the fame, everything we ate was extremely tasty, we mostly had a variety of sandwiches. Me, I am a sucker for rosemary infused chicken so I chose the Gaviota, and I was not disappointed. The selection of organic and specialty iced teas was huge, I found something in a chai white tea that I enjoyed. 

The negative here is there is that food network crowd to deal with, and they simply do not have the space to handle it. The tables are so close together you will be repeatedly hit by people making their way to the deli to order sandwiches or to the other side of the restaurant to pay or order breakfast. In some spots the tables are too close together for two people to sit back to back without hitting one another. 

I think if they bought the place next door, blew out a wall and gave everyone just a bit more space, that the Savoy would be just about the perfect lunch spot. They certainly have the food side of the business down.

This delicious deli was in walking distance from our  B&B. terrific roasted veggies, good chicken curry, respectable wine. We got some key lime pie for later and it was sublime, 

Grab your casual dine in meal here or pack a picnic to- go.

I come to Savoy cafe probably 3 times a week. I think I am addicted to their breakfast. Although I come to work away from my office, there are lots of interesting people to talk to. Great coffee and friendly staff.
Had the BEST gluten free french toast. Super cute place with great staff. They also have a huge selection of treats. Highly recommend!

Clean 
Well prepared friendly 
What more can u ask
Well I did just have s mood altering chocolate brownie that was actually gluten 
free 
OMG

What a great little place! We had breakfast there, and the food was simply excellent. My husband and I usually cook at home because we value good, organic ingredients and frankly, we are pretty darn good cooks, but this place actually made a very tasty breakfast - the eggs were really creamy, and everything was fresh. I didn't get to try the salad bar, but it looks amazing.

This place has the best salad bar ever! They have so many fresh ingredients including chicken and salmon to put on top. They also have delicious breads and desserts. 

The only problem is, it is very overpriced. Sometimes the salad comes out to $10-15. However if you can afford it, it is a delicious place to grab lunch and dinner. It was also on the food network-:)
Great stop while driving to the Ca Central Coast. Lots of gluten free choices even deserts! Lots of organic food and everything looking tasty.

We love Savoy! 

Recommend the breakfast burrito, the vegan breakfast burrito in particular! Comes with kale, quinoa, and sweet potatoes! So delicious. And big! 

Delicious hot coffee here too!

Lunch is delicious as well. Sandwiches are hard to beat. 

There are outlets by the long center table if you're wanting to do work on a computer.
Really solid breakfast. Love that they have healthy options. Fantastic gluten free options.

It's a little pricey but your paying for excellent food service and atmosphere. The salad and soup bar are both so yummy and the hot and cold items look delicious. I've never gotten one of their sandwiches because I just buy a ciabatta roll and stuff it with items from the salad bar! Delicious. Did I mention the hot tea is amazing.

Such a great place for a quick, healthy meal. Their commitment to ingredient transparency and accessibility for special diets is so apparent and appreciated. I've never had a bad meal here! Their salad bar, breakfast menu, prepared foods, sandwiches, fresh homemade soups, baked goods, coffee bar.... it's all good! A paleo, dairy-free, gluten-free, and vegan dream. I even ordered special dairy-free/gluten-free pies from here for Thanksgiving last year, and they were a big hit. It's truly a community gathering place where there is something delicious for everyone to enjoy!

First time here and it's already a favorite. The food is home made, healthy and tasty, the prices are quite reasonable and the vibe is friendly and mellow. Build your own salads and sandwiches, and an interesting selection of salads and side dishes. Can order a'la carte or with 1 or 2 sides. The choice and flexibility is refreshing. I had a slice of broccoli $ cheddar quiche with caprese salad. Both were quite good; a little thyme added to the quiche would have brought out the flavor of the eggs, but I'm not complaining. They have a fantastic array of home made desserts (some vegan and raw offerings as well). There was even a guy playing mellow accordion tunes. Sort of Paris meets SB. Great selection of teas & coffee too! Nothing missing as far as I'm concerned. I'll be back!

I eat here about 4 times a week. Seriously. By far the best salad bar I've ever seen, with a fantastic mix of veggies (their roasted beets are sumptuous), proteins, and other types of toppings. The hot mains and sammies look fantastic although I've never tried, and their brunch looks great too. Really friendly, laid-back, local vibe and the staff are all awesome. I love it here so much!

TO DIE FOR!!!! Was in the area for work, someone recommended to try it out. I had the turkey fritter. SO GOOD! It reminded me or a Mexican Thanksgiving  stuffed Turkey (sounds weird I know). Amazing! since the meal comes with a side I asked the worker what he recommended. he let me sample the sides. I ended up picking the spinach and strawberry salad! I was a happy camper. Can't wait to go back to Santa Barbara for more!
Great atmosphere, delicious healthy food!  Super cute and charming.  Will definitely visit again.  Recommend the chicken enchiladas, kale salad and vegan burrito

I love this place. I went by myself on Tuesday and had the Turkey Fritter. Then I brought my whole team from work back today and I had the Chicken Masala. I really like all of the GF, DF, and SF options. There are LOTS of organic options too!

This was a delightful little cafe with good quality food and beverages. We shared a Gibraltar with two delicious sides. We also shared a wonderful pot of tea. Its a market/deli/coffee shop and if you think that sounds messy, pop in and see it done right.

This is my absolute favorite place for lunch in Santa Barbara. Their breakfast and dinner options are also amazing. All ingredients are of the highest quality and the owners support local, organic and sustainable food industries. The owners are also phenomenally kind people, who hand-make almost everything themselves. Definitely check this place out next time your are downtown and need a healthy, delicious meal.

Walked into Savoy on a Friday afternoon and it was quite busy. I got in line for the turkey pozole rojo, scooped a spoon of soup and got a huge surprise - a long black hair inside my soup and it was also hanging outside of my cup. I walked to the front counter and handed the cup to an employee, told them that I found a long hair inside the pozole. I told the employee that they need to move the pozole soup immediately from the soup station because it's disgusting and contaminated. The employee said yes and walked to the back of the kitchen, came out a couple seconds later and carried on with the customers. I waited for 3 minutes to see if any they were going to remove the soup, nope. Will not be eating here anymore, super disappointed.
Great food and friendly staff. The ambiance is very peaceful and they have a great back patio. I had the quiche Lorraine with potatoes and loved it.

I had high hopes when I returned to Savoy.  The sandwich choices were interesting and I ordered the special tuna with salad.  I bit into the incredibly stale bread and decided to ask for another sandwich, assuming there had been a mistake of some type.  When the server returned with the second sandwich he rudely announced that bread was fresh.  Whether Savoy serves fresh, stale bread - or simply stale bread seems beside the point - since the second sandwich was as stale as the first.  The broken cappuccino machine, and luke warm drip coffee was the perfect end of a very disappointing lunch!

This place deserves 5 stars for their delicious deserts, pastries, and cookies! And you can taste the quality of the ingredients.
Also, their breakfast burritos with added bacon and their pancakes are huge and delicious as well! 

A little pricey, but the quality is worth it.
Amazing food!! Had the best Americano ever and the staff is so friendly.  Seems like everyone takes pride in working here. If you have not tried this place, you are missing out!!

Great local lunch spot! Came here on a recommendation from a local business owner at Stearns Wharf. Portions are fresh and big for the price - sandwiches with a side of pickle about $9+. 

They also have water available with glasses and ice! 

I also heard the salad bar is delicious but didn't try it this time around. 

Employees were also great - friendly and helpful.

*3.5 stars*

I only ordered sides here so my rating is based on this. I ordered the mango rice and pesto bow tie pasta. The mango rice was great--the fruit was crisp and firm and the rice was al dente, plus it was a special red rice I've never had. The pesto on the other hand was a bit too salty for me. The person helping me was super friendly and the place is like eating in someone's cute kitchen. However, it was rather pricey at around $10 for two small sides. Overall, a fun place to try for some light and tasty food.
Great vegan burrito with lots of flavor and delicious salsa on the side! Very lovely service and I loved all of the drinks! Happy you are hear.
Chicken Marsala was off the charts! Perfect balance of cream and flavor. The cafe has a nice homey feel as well

Fresh food, good ambiance, smiling faces. If you like cafefully prepared, thoughtful food this is a great casual spot. Little surprised to see Guy Fieri came here as this is definitely not a diner, drive in or dive, but hey, good food is good food.
The food is wonderful, they have a great salad bar and they are always friendly. I always take family to Savoy for breakfast or lunch when they come to town for a visit.

When my daughter mentioned that she wanted to have a scavenger hunt birthday party on State St, my first thought was, where do we have the cake? We LOVE Savoy for breakfast, lunch and dinner, but hadn't thought of it as an option until my daughter remembered the patio out back. I called to see if it was available (four days before the party) and was told it could definitely be reserved for that Saturday afternoon. Kathy bakes an incredible carrot cake but knowing not all kids like that, we also ordered 30 cookies (chocolate chocolate chip, chocolate chip, oatmeal raisin and snickerdoodle).
When we arrived, the table was set for 15, and looked beautiful! Our daughter LOVED it and so did her friends. We were served by Danae who was kind, helpful, available and took pictures for us! ALL of the kids commented on how great the cookies and carrot cake tasted! What a perfect ending to a very fun birthday party! We HIGHLY recommend Savoy!

Savoy cafe is really delicious. They have an array of hot dishes and make your own salad bar that has fresh veggies. I really liked the mashed potatoes, the turkey fritter and the chicken marsala. I would give this place 5/5 stars, but this place is slightly on the more pricey side for my liking. This can also be due to the fact that the food is pretty gourmet! Would come back here.

I haven't been here in ages but I am definitely returning again soon. There is plenty of seating inside and out and a cool coffee bar you can eat at too. They are open breakfast,  lunch and dinner. They have a salad bar, pre made salads, sandwiches, hot food and an array of drinks and also a cool little dessert case. The portions are pretty big. My friend had the vegetarian enchilada, I had half sandwich and a kale and blueberry salad. Very filling and really tasty! The staff are really friendly too.

My wife almost begged me to go to this place after watching an episode in the food network. So after a long drive hearing about the story of this Deli and blah blah once we get there  the first thing we realized is that the place closes at 8:00 PM. We were about 18 mins from closing, and the attitude from the employees was not good at all looked like they were crazy to go home for the long weekend. In addition,  the worst part was looking at the food.... It looked OLD; like it was sitting there since early in the morning. That food seriously looked bad, it looked harmful. So combining that with the creepy service recieved my wife and I ended up leaving

Seriously, my new favorite in town! Hard to find a decent salad bar in town but theirs is awesome!! Fun little market concept combined with yummy warm dishes, made to order meals, sandwiches and amazing healthy & some more indulgent desserts! Even open early for breakfast! Love it here!

Good lord, Savoy is the place where stomach meets quality food. 

An excellent selection for people who choose to eat healthy. Produce is fresh, dishes are made from the freshest ingredients.

If you like Scarlet Begonia, Trader Joes, Whole Foods and appreciate nice restaurants like Plow & Angel, Brophy Bros etc... then add Savoy to your list of places to go.

You will be happy you walked in the door. Great resturant!

Wow wow wow. THIS FOOD IS SO GOOD!!!!!!!! It's pricey but WELL worth it! I don't eat dairy or gluten, and had so so so many delicious and healthy options to choose from. If I lived in SB, I would be here allllll the time. 

We had the turkey fritter (my absolute favorite, so flavorful and moist), beef osso bucco (tender meat and veggies, just a little on the salty side), black rice salad (with sweet potatoes!), and strawberry spinach salad (perfect in between of crisp and wilted). Everything was so flavorful it was hard to slow down. And the tea (blueberry rooibos) was spectacular and smooth. 

And for dessert - paleo, vegan, gluten free and sugar free options galore! And the drink selection wines, teas, coffees, juices, milks, kombuchas, sodas... seriously more options than I could possibly look at. 

And to top it off, everyone was incredibly nice, welcoming and helpful. Plus an awesome vibe. I would probably drive up from Long Beach just to eat here :)

Hip and savvy joint! Made a point of stopping for a tasty breakfast on the way to Morro Bay. Good choice! My woman and me had the grilled salmon and scrambled eggs, side of potatoes. 

All good, nice friendly staff and quiet environment. We'll return as we retrace our steps up the coast.

I have had both the coconut chicken curry and the tomato basil soup!! These two items are soooo amazing. Service is good, people are friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. I love coming here. I will keep coming back.

Salad bar as a ton of choices almost everything organic! The kale is all nice and chopped small and already massaged so it's actually good in salads. 
Everything is very clearly labeled, vegan/vegetarian/paleo and in the desserts container also if nut free/soy free/gluten free. Options for all of them. Quite nice!
They have 2 refrigerator sections. One that has the types of drinks you see at the health food store (a few brands of kombucha, teas, ginger beer, etc) another that has some premade salads, califia farms single serve coffees, califia farms milks, house made dressings. 
There is a deli counter with again clearly labeled foods (always a win) and you can get sandwiches made there for you also.

Savoy became my favorite place to get food in Santa Barbara really quickly! I moved here a year ago and automatically became hooked on Backyard Bowls, but after a year of gorging myself with acai I started branching out. I now find myself coming here once a week and feeling like a regular and I have no idea how it happened...

Well, I actually do have an idea. The place is wonderful. Great atmosphere- calm, yet full of warm people. I just always want to be in here either eating, doing work, or both. I do both often! And the food is of course, super. High quality ingredients and interesting recipes. I've never been disappointed. It is pretty pricey and not really in my student budget, but I stretch for Savoy.

My favorite dishes are the Pesto Green Beans (a must) and the Strawberry Spinach salad (another must). 

The salad bar and soups are always great as well. I still have a lot to try on the menu. Here's to many, many more meals!

I've been frequenting Savoy Cafe for lunch more and more lately.  It's consistently good and they offer several healthy, delicious options to please your palette as well as cater to those with certain dietary restrictions.

They have a deli style window for you to pick and choose what you like.  There are meats (like turkey fritters and baked balsamic chicken) and hot entrees (like beef stroganoff, veggie or meat enchiladas, and lasagne) on one side and an assortment of side dishes (mixed veggies, mashed potatoes, mac & cheese, sweet potato souffle) and salads (spinach and strawberry salad, quinoa mango salad, different rice salads, chicken salad, mixed fruit) on the other.  You can get combos of 1entree + 1or 2sides, an all sides combo of 2 or 3, whatever makes your little mouth merry.

I'm always eyeballing their baked goods section like the neighborhood cookie creeper.  It's filled with cakes, cookies, muffins, veggie muffins, even of the gluten-free variety.  There are shelves of drinks so you have a bevy of beverages to chose from to quench your thirst.

There's a soup and salad bar which looks great, but I've never tried because I get skeeved by the idea of tons of people blowing their hot breath and picking at my food like hungry birds before I even get to it.  I'm just weird like that, but if you like your salad bars, I won't judge!  If I catch you using your hands then licking your fingers, then going back for more (real talk - I have seen this), I WILL judge!  I will.  Possibly (probably) even harshly.  Moving along.

The breakfast is good and it's nice to know they use nitrate-free bacon and all that, but it's pretty expensive for a basic breakfast so instead I think I'll hit up my neighborhood breakfast buffet with their nitrated bacon AND endless mimosas for the same price....

The employees are always pleasant and it's a great place for any meal.  You can even get tubs of whatever you want to take on a picnic.  Guy Fieri gives Savoy his seal of approval, and I do too!
This used to be good, but nowadays the breakfast burrito is super salty, I always tip them well, but the customer service is poor, unfriendly, they don't even say hi or smile, they seem very sad,

We tried to go to Norton's, but it was closed on Labor Day so we went to Savoy out of convenience, and also knowing it was featured on DDD.  They also had a back patio for our dog, so that's a winner right there. 

The menu is very confusing and overwhelming because they have items listed on chalk boards, and about 3 dozen different salads and hot dishes in the glass display. I had no clue what to order and nothing was jumping out at me, so I got the turkey fritter that they featured on DDD and a side of the quinoa mango salad. The turkey fritter was almost inedible. It was lukewarm, extremely dry, and had NO flavor whatsoever. It was so tough, that I could barely cut it, and the pieces of turkey were nasty and dry. The quinoa salad was good, but very sweet. 

My husband's Italian sandwich was nothing special and the bread had such a hard crust that I could barely bite into it.  My daughter got a ham and cheese sandwich on ciabatta bread, which was just ok. The food plus one beer was $42. Kind of pricey for what it was.

This place is lovely. Beautiful salad bar, super healthy breakfast and lunch menu, semi-self serve, and bright and cheerful cafe. Seating is plentiful at long tables. A friendly bar too, and you can enjoy a glass of wine with a sandwich or soup. A quiet neighborhood spot!

Great local cafe! Breakfast burrito w/ Applegate chicken sausage. Yum! Good place to come if you eat healthy , and you have Vegan friends. Something for everyone! We took home a bag of their flavorful organic "turmeric - ginger" tea.
Best french toast I have ever had! Citrus dipped bagguete slices with berries served with syrup and jams on the side. Great organic cafe with friendly staff. Great coffee too!

I like Savoy Cafe & Deli but it is overpriced for what they serve. The only thing that i would say is worth buying is the salad bar and the soup. Everything else sits out all day and doesn't look too appetizing. The sandwiches are okay but the bread is pretty hard and last time i ate a sandwich there i injured the roof of my mouth. The staff is always friendly and it is a nice environment.

I had been recommended this place by a lot of Californians and I understand it's the pick of the crop in terms of healthy, natural food. The breakfast menu looked amazing but I never made it in time for that. 
The place itself is a bit confusing, some things are self serve, others are ordering from the counter, then you have to go around and pay at the coffee station. Around lunch time it's crazy busy and the chairs are not comfortable at all-- it has the feel of a cafeteria, as someone said before. 
I got a sandwich here and I remember not finishing it and having to pick things out but I can't quite remember why. I also had a flavoured iced tea and had to sweeten the crap out of it because it wasn't very nice. 
It's also a little expensive here. 
I'm sorry to give this a less than glowing review because I understand its something of an institution in SB but it just wasn't for me. That said, the coffee was nice and the service was great. Also they had Justin's peanut butter cups.

Food was cooked to perfection had the "Guy plate" carrot cake, pesto green beans and turkey fritter oh and the mango quinoa sald! Perfect combo since I am the worst at choosing options at dinner I love how this plate is just a bit of everything. Ate in the back where it so much more intimate and the decorations are really nice perfect for me and my date :) Would have given it a 5 if staff was a bit more upbeat !

We stopped here on our way home from Buellton. It was really good. The staff was very knowledgable about what was in each item. I have a tree nut allergy and it was great to see a sign indicating they use walnuts in their pesto. The food was brilliant. Light and refreshing in a hot summer day. The portions were more than generous and the vegan chocolate crunch brownie was to die for. All in all we will definitely go back and try some of their other options.
I USED to love the food here. Until I found a rubber band in my chicken posole verde.  Talk about major yuck.
Very good and fresh food. We had a really nice eggplant and asparagus salad. The Greek quiche, vegetable frittata and breakfast burrito were all great!
Got the Turkey-Pasilla-Jack Scramble, 2.5 stars. It was really salty, maybe because of the turkey (couldn't tell if it was deli meat or fresh). The breakfast burrito was very good, 3.5-4 stars.
I LOVE Savoy. Great for on the go or if you want a cute little space to hang out and eat. The food is SO GOOD! I've never been disappointed.

Absolutely lovely cafe ! Appealing atmosphere very airy and relaxing , the people working there are friendly and super nice , and the food is healthy , fresh and delicious ! Not to mention they have great vegetarian and vegan options . I loved my vegan scramble - came with ciabatta bread, potatoes, kale, zucchini , tomatoes , tofu . Healthy and delicious . 

My mother enjoyed her egg breakfast plate and the jams that came with our meal . We also had a small pot of peppermint tea that the server filled up with hot water again for us so we could drink more . 

Highly recommend this place for breakfast and they have a good selection of sweets - vegan too :)

Meh.. The people are great there, good location, good food, it's a solid place. Just doesn't move the needle for me. I guess that's just a testament to how many great places there are in Santa Barbara. This place would be 5 stars in another city in my opinion.

The food here is amazing! I had the turkey frittata with quinoa. The service was great, they have a very cool vibe and the bathroom was very clean. If I'm ever in Santa Barbara again I will definitely be back. 

Also, Guy Fieri had stopped through and there's a map on the wall to mark where you're from. Love those.

Too ordinary for the price they charge. I'd rather go to South Coast Deli for better tasting sammies with great ingridients at about the same price. I've eaten better and I will definitely eat better.

My favorite please to eat in Santa Barbara. Amazing breakfast, salad bar and deli selections as well as gluten free options. Try the Turkey Pasilla Jack Scramble, Veggie Benedict, Blueberry Kale Salad and Sweet Potato Au Gratin. There's a hidden patio out back too!

I went to a local cafe and they ran out of gluten-free pastries, so I was disappointed...until I came here-saved by Savoy! The gluten-free corn muffin was great and the matcha green tea latte was excellent! I will have to return next time to enjoy their salad bar and other healthy foods!
Yes, yes, yes--come to Savoy! My favorite thing is the portobello mushroom sandwich. Yum! And they often have great vegan pastries.

i really enjoyed this special place. its tight seating but packed full of happy vibes and quality. they have something for everyone. a yummy salad bar, hot soups,  pre made dishes, hot foods made fresh to order, pastries, cold drinks, coffees. i'm plantbased so no eggs for me and they had quiches. i mention to paul that i had made some yummy egg free quiches and he was open to hearing about it. he said they are open to guest sharing ideas! so great to be supported. went back 2 days in a row! thanks again. they have vegan butter for your toast even if they say no asks them to dlb check they do!! :) oh the gluten free bread is local and very yummy

The twelve dollar breakfast burrito (substituted egg whites) was underwhelming to say the least. You can make this stuff at home and save a large portion of your income. Not sure how the reviews are as high as they are..
This is my Go-To in Santa Barbara. I love the salad bar. It has everything a salad lover could ask for and I healthy environment.
They have a great salad bar which includes salmon, steak, beets, sweet potatoes, blue cheese...such amazing and fresh options

This is our "go to" place when driving through Santa Barbara. Counter has excellent hot & cold food ready to be played. Super convenient and fast. I think the food is delicious. Add a side and perfect balance. They go extra distance on food. Often I travel with person with unusual food allergies and a vegan. They never have a problem choosing a great meal. This trip we have our dog with us and found out that they are really dog friendly. They have a back patio. They brought out a clean water dish, friendly smiles, etc. it's in the back with a water fountain so the dog was relaxed away from street noises. We used to go to sojourners before they closed.

Amazing selection of gluten free food that is a natural part of their menu and doesn't feel forced or limited. The options seem like regular food without being Frankenstein's version. 


Try it.  Grrat
Excellent meal, price and atmosphere. Had the "guy plate" which was a great combo of things I wouldn't normally order, but was very tasty.

Stopped in for a chai latte. Not sure how they make it (concentrate, powdered, or brewed) but it is made with spiced madness and love. Spicy and delicious. The baked goods are really good too. I wanna just sit and drink a variety of brewed caffeines and write my novel but it gets super busy at mealtimes, as it should.

One word excellent. This place is full of healthy and well prepared food set out in deli and cafeteria style. There is a lot of indoor seating and more out back. If I lived closer to Santa Barbara this would defiantly be one of my regular eateries. I wish we could get something like this here in Vacaville.

Simply the best. I have been trying to look for a healthy place to eat and I noticed this was on the food net work. I walked in to a very nice enviroment with friendly workers. It smelled so good!!! I ordered the Guy plate and my mother ordered the Fritter. Needless to say this is an amazing place to eat. Plus its healthy and taste amazing!

What a great gem!! Open, airy, welcoming, and great food besides. We went for a late Sunday breakfast. Best Eggs Benedict ever (on ciabatta with shaved ham). My daughter was so excited to see several gluten-free options. 

Next time we will be sure to check out the fresh salad and soup bar as well as some of the interesting entree options.

WOW! Their pesto pasta was AWESOME. I ordered it and reordered it. Even the capers were delicious. The pasta had vegetables mixed in. The Italian sandwich was perfectly balanced with meat and toppings the crust on the bread had body with out being too hard. The ice coffee was good.
