The decor was comfortable, clean, relaxed, fresh, and well laid out. Their staff were young and friendly. To bad we are from out of town.
Love love! Most ingredients are organic. Almond milk and gluten free options. Super healthy super yummy and super fresh!
Great food, great coffee, great atmosphere, great service! Perfect spot for breakfast when you only have one morning in Santa Barbara!

We had some selections form the prepared dishes and salad bar. Ingredients are obviously fresh and of quality.

Salad bar was great.

Prepared dishes definitely lacked flavor you'd find in San Francisco or LA especially for the $$$!

Gluten free find!!  Breakfast: GF pancakes & French Toast.  Lunch:  GF bread for sandwiches and GF soy sauce glaze on their roast chicken.  Treats: GF cupcakes, cookies, banana bread....   Oh and they have non-GF foods too.  Terrific salad and soup bar!  Yum!!!!

Came here looking for a delicious sandwich and got exactly what I was hoping for. I opted for a veg sandwich (Lorraine's) that was packed with sprouts, carrots, avocado, tomato, cucumber, and cheese. It was a great fresh sandwich and I wish I could have tried more of the delicious options!

I have celiacs. Going out to eat at places that won't get me sick/trigger an immune response due to cross contamination is impossible, unless I go to a dedicated gluten-free restaurant. Often, when I go to restaurants that have "gluten free items" the gluten free items aren't truly GF - restaurants boil GF pasta in the same water as regular pasta, prep GF sandwiches on the same cutting boards or work surfaces that have regular bread, etc. And, to make a stressful immune disorder even more fun, restaurant waitstaff are often dismissive or rude about my bizzaro dietary needs. It's no fun. But Savoy is GREAT - their staff is knowledgeable about celiacs, kind, flexible and honest. They will make certain items and GF items in clean pans, with clean utensils, and are happy to do it. They'll also be honest if something may have a risk of cross contamination, such as their deli items, so that the customer can decide if they want to risk it or not. Also, their food is BOMB! I loved the veggie scramble and gf french toast for breakfast. Thank you, Savoy, for making my life a little easier! I appreciate you!

One of the best salad bars I have had. Fresh, delicious, good variety and some unique items. The baked goods look delicious but I have only had one of the brownies, which maybe was a fudge brownie, which I did not like.  Too gooey, not chewy enough, not satisfying flavor. It's a cute place with a nice variety of to-order, ready made, and mini market items.
Kale salad was good, my frittata was a bit dry.  Nice ambiance, prices are expected for the quality of ingredients they use I suppose.

[Disclaimer: Vegan/Gluten-Free - Based Review]

Walking in, I was pretty surprised that it was a restaurant & market type of setting. We quickly realized that it was an order-and-seat yourself type of place, so I recommend that you do quickly grab a table because we ended up having to sit at the bar - we were busy, but mainly distracted looking at the items (especially the gluten-free and vegan desserts) displayed in their market.

I ordered:

Vegan Breakfast Burrito - Surprisingly, very very good. I didn't expect anything eye-catching or mouth-watering, but I actually craved for my leftovers. Simple ingredients, but very well put together. Also, I didn't want to nag or inquire on such a busy Sat. morning whether the tortilla was gluten-free or not, and so I had my gluten-pills as back-up.

Additionally, my brother and boyfriend (normal meat and everything-you-can-think-of eaters) ordered the french toast and eggs Benedict, which they thoroughly enjoyed.

Question: Would I eat here again? 
Verdict: Definitely, especially because there's easy 1-hour parking as well.
Why?: Its difficult to find a breakfast venue that provides vegan-friendly foods, and especially as assortment of gluten-free and vegan desserts.

Cheers!
C.

This place is awesome. From the paleo desserts to the fresh salad bar! (not to mention the fact that a lot of the things they have are organic) Everyone who works there is so nice. I wish more places could be like Savoy.

After I ate here, I was sick for days after. The hot food that I selected was only lukewarm, and I believe in severe violation of public health food standards.

They also served a brownie that they did not note included peanut butter. Those of you who are allergic to nuts beware.

Upon walking into Savoy I immediately asked myself why I'd never been there before. A deli + a cafe? How can it get any better than that?

The staff is very friendly and accommodating, the cafe itself is quaint yet spacious (simple and elegant, I can see myself settling in at a table next to the window working on projects on my laptop for hours), and there are many vegetarian and vegan options to choose from. 

What caught my eye was the display of delicious looking pastries. It took everything for me not to buy an Olive Oil Chocolate Chip Cookie (yummy vegan option) to savor after my sandwich. Next time I will be sampling!

I ordered the Gaviota, a chicken sandwich with greens, provolone, and balsamic vinaigrette on Ciabatta. I devoured every bite and will be ordering this option again soon. It was scrumptiously delicious!

I can't wait to try other menu items and test out the cafe.

Cute deli restaurant. Delicious dishes-- I got the broccoli cheddar quiche and my partner got the paleo bowl. Appreciate the healthy breakfast and lunch options they have here. The 20 hour cold brew was a perfect accompaniment to it all. Would definitely come back if were in the area.

Even if this wonderful cafe didn't offer a huge range of gluten-free options it would still be a wonderful breakfast/lunch location.    But having a family with two GF members this was a find!    It has a warm calm atmosphere, the servers are very attentive but personable and subtle and the food is prepared beautifully with fresh ingredients and good attention to flavors.    We liked it so much during our Santa Barbara vacation we came back for breakfast 3 days in a row.

Really yummy food! I had the vegan burrito which was delicious! It has kale, sweet potato, quinoa, and some other things that all tasted so fresh and healthy. I love that they have a few different vegan options since many places don't.

The workers here were very friendly as well :)

One thing I will say is that the menu is really confusing. There are only a few things listed on the menu inside but there is also a menu they put outside. (My burrito for instance was only on the outside menu.) I was running back and forth to try and decide what I wanted to eat.

One of my favorite spots downtown. Savoy continually offers terrific (down to earth / genuine) service, as well as tasty and healthy food! 

We'll be regulars as long as we live here in SB.

Great menu and great food! It really is from organic farm to table! It is located in a great part of town and a beautiful setting.  They have breakfast, bakery, an award winning salad bar, soup bar with a great selection, sand which menu, chefs deli case, hot entrees, grab and go food items, and an extensive tea and win bar! And it never fails when they were featured on diners, drive-ins and dives!

Stumbled on this cute cafe while in town waiting for the zoo to open. Quaint rustic ambience, great variety in selections and food made with love and quality ingredients, at great prices. Seriously the best huevos rancheros you'll ever have! Be sure to stop by if you find yourself in the area; you'll be glad you did.

Wish I could say we liked this place and my husband and I are not hard to please. We saw this on tripple D so decided to check it out and try the turkey fritter. First off it was cold because it was pre made. They could have warmed it up at least. Then again probably wouldn't make a difference because I just thought it was ok tasting. I only had the salad bar so cant judge on all food. The place is cute but dont think we'd come back for fritters.

This place is delightful, excellent salad and soup bar, as well as a variety of entrees and beverages. Homemade dessert selections can't be beat. Great downtown location, have even spotted a celebrity in there. I LOVE meeting friends there for lunch. Fresh, natural, high quality ingredients = deliciousness.

We were recently in Santa Barbara and had the opportunity to eat at Savoy Cafe a couple of times... it is a great spot and the food is very good. My only complaint is that they charged us $4.00/each to add spinach to our burritos... kind of excessive!

Savoy has so many options for everyone. It's easy, fast and affordable. Their costumer service is on point as well. If you want healthy options, great costumer service, and a great atmosphere this place is a must eat in SB.

I love this place! They have great items that are fresh & healthy. Delicious gluten free bake goods made in-house. My favorite is the buttermilk chocolate cake...so yummy! I love the organic salad bar. Can't wait to go back.

Probably my favorite family owned business in SB. Wonderful staff and great fresh food. Very cozy atmosphere. I recommend the gluten free almond meal pancakes, the turkey fritter is a must try, the beef stews, chicken curry, salad bar options and the homemade baked goods! They have good gluten free options and organic vegetable choices. Grab a drink too from their huge selections of healthy beverages.

Food is fresh. Service was good. Had the veggie scramble. Split it with my sister. My plate had no scramble just veggies. So the lesson was never share plates here. Good for one person.   Was supposed to be two eggs and looked more like one. Veggies nice and fresh!  Organic!

I've only been for breakfast.  Everything is excellent.  Try the juevos rancheros, the pancakes, or both.  The Ethiopian coffee is awesome.  The waitresses aren't the friendliest (no idea why) but don't take it personally, it's just that kind of place.

Great little local place.  took the family, got the chicken enchiladas UNBELIEVABLE!!  Healthy portion for sure with lots of flavor!  My son got the chicken marsala and loved it.  Got the key lime pie also which was also great.  A little pricy and small but great atmosphere and well worth it.  Although I'm a local I had never been there until I saw them on DDD, what an awesome story behind this little gem!

Great place in downtown SB with accessible parking across the street. This cafe is super cute! At first, the many options available could be pretty overwhelming. I was going to go with a sandwich but decided for something from the deli since I didn't want to build my own. Got the pesto pasta salad and roasted veggies. Delicious and tasted fresh. They also have a bunch of healthy options as well. Also a huge variety of juices. The back patio is perfect for a sunny day. I loved that people had their dogs there as well. Would definitely try their breakfast food next time!

I am SO happy this place is back. It was my favorite lunch spot and I have been missing it. Great salad bar, great hot food, wonderful desserts. The chocolate cake is my favorite, period. I wish they would give me the recipe - because I felt like I lost a good friend when is disappeared. BUT happy day ..It is Back!
I had the best chicken salad ever ! I ordered the grilled salmon with salsa and 1 side. The vegetables taste so fresh and flavorful!!

We love Savoy!  So many choices!!!  The salad bar is amazing!  You can choose from a great breakfast menu or order a hot dish or choose from a million prepared salads. Everything is delicious and fresh and organic. Gluten free? No problem. Vegan?  No problem. None of those? No problem. There really is something fabulous for everyone. Oh and don't forget to check out the key lime pie

Wow. 

Great spot. 

The food is excellent and they made a perfect cappuccino. Found this place from my boy Guy Fieri - glad I did. Service was super too.

Santa Barbara's play on deli!  I love the place from the order process to the staff to the food.  I couldn't help myself and did the Turkey Fritter & 2 sides.  The Forbbidden Rice is a must have, but the beet salad was wilted and missed the mark.  Thankfully my wife opted for the Mango Quinoa which made up for the beets.  Love the ambiance right down to the self serve ice and water.  If you're looking for fresh this place is it.  You're going to think there's a garden out back not a parking lot!

Cutest little brunch spot for the weekend, I loved the back patio. The staff is extremely helpful, efficient, and polite. The entire ambience is very friendly and lively, not to mention the insane amount of ordering options. My only suggestion is to have the staff occasionally come by the tables and fill waters, as we had to get up from our meal several times to fill up our little cups. Or, it would also be just as convenient to set up an additional water station outside so guests don't have to trek through the early afternoon brunch crowd. However, this is one of those places where you order at the counter and get a number, then they bring it out to you. Super cute and casual nonetheless, there's plenty of seating and tons of items I really want to come back and try! I can't wait til my next visit!
Everything is great.  Fresh food and a huge selection of great food and desserts. The atmosphere is fantastic.  I love the Savoy Cafe and Deli.
Great place for taking the family.  Easy access and great menu options.

Eggs benedict of a lifetime there. I drive an hour just to eat that. The tea selection is great, if your a tea drinker. The steup in there is awesome, gives you a family feeling with having a really modern setup. It's a must go

This is such a cute place! We ordered the Gaviota chicken sandwich and the Turkey-Pasilla Fritter and they were both delicious. The environment is so neat and unique. You just want to sit there all day and hang out. They have plenty of fresh and organic produce which is a plus. They also have amazing desserts!
Really, really good food!  Would eat here every day if I could!  Nice people, love the environment and I appreciate all the gluten-free options! Hope this place stays around for a long time!

If you are looking for organic,  gluten-free, and/or healthy foods options in a laid back, friendly atmosphere, this is the place. Great food,  nice wait staff,  and a whole host of tastey offerings. I highly recommend this restaurant.  We live in the NY, NJ area and this is exactly the type of restaurant we look for when traveling.

You never get a second chance at a first impression and my first impression of walking into Savoy was that it was going to be an unique, fresh dining experience...and it did not disappoint.

As soon as you walk in to the left, you see a salad bar filled with gourmet fixins' (no iceberg lettuce here!).  To the right, you see a coffee bar that has beer taps along with wine bottles!  And straight back is the "deli".   Seating is plenty and even if it's full, the place clears out quickly.

Now on to the food, this is not your typical, artery-clogging Triple D.  This place is about "FRESHNESS" and they don't mess around.

I ordered the Guy Plate...Beware- it's a TON of food.  

Here's my breakdown:
1. Turkey Fritter: Deceptively filling; a bit dry but maybe because they pre-make them.  It tastes like a bite of Thanksgiving in your mouth.  So if you don't like Thanksgiving food, avoid this.  However, if you do, you're in for a treat.

2. Quinoa: Weakest part of the entire plate.  There are fruitful notes in there, but the quinoa is just plain and dry.

3. Pesto Green Beans: This was a surprisingly delicious side dish.  Pesto has that "bacon effect" and makes everything taste better.  It was a very nice compliment to quinoa and the turkey fritter. 

With these three dishes, Savoy would at about 3.5 to 4 stars....but here's what pushes up the star ratings...Dessert.

The "Guy plate" comes with dessert!  Not just any dessert...

CARROT CAKE!!!!  This is the best carrot cake I have ever had.  Moist, fresh, the frosting is not too sugary nor is it too much.  Each bite is balanced with sweetness and moistness that's not too heavy.  This carrot cake has set the new bar for all carrot cakes and therefore, has changed my life!   

This is #37 on my quest to eat at all the Diners, Drive-ins, & Dives in America! (or at least in California).

I always go for breakfast & get the vegan scramble & my husband gets the vegan burrito. Both are so delicious & big portions! 
I just wish they were open on Sundays. 
Highly recommend this place! :)

Always enjoy going to Savoy. As a non restrictive eater except for not liking stuff for taste or looks, my gluten free wife has a very large selection of gluten free options from the hot, cold or dessert sections.  I can always find anything I'd easily devour from comfort food (mac n cheese) to the healthy but tasty salads.  This place does not get old like so many others.  Always a stop after we work out locally for a good meal or dessert.

This place is every kind of Awesome. It's such a No-brainer to have a place like this in SLO and especially CAMBRIA, I wish......Soup and Salad Bar...a hot deli, cold deli with entrées, salads and sides a sweets display case with yummy baked goods...gluten-free, vegan, organic everything....a coffee and tea counter, a cold drink wall cooler, and plenty of self serve seating. I was there during off hours and there were plenty of tables. Just a lovely atmosphere. The canned music was a tad bit loud.

Heaven on earth! Very, very, very nice atmosphere. Great service, and I still haven't talked about the food. I had the citrus dipped gluten-free French toast with berries! THE best I've ever had! If you're gluten free you know it's all about the taste of the bread and this was superb. Not the dense gf breads you often find. Also had a side of chicken sausage which was the bomb! Took home a couple of corn muffins which I ended up eating on the way home. I live in LA but will find an excuse to get back up to Savoy soon.

This is my favorite local lunch spot.  The salad bar is fantastic! It's always clean and plentiful - food full of color and flavor.  The way it should be. The service providers are friendly and treat the customers with care and attention.  The pastries are also great - not too heavy but sweet and yummy!
Best salad bar in town. Great baked goods. Delicious, fresh, home-cooking type food. Cozy, informal, clean eatery.  Many take-out options. One of my favorite places in town.

Just like everyone I agree that this place is super cute. Vegan friendly!  
Make sure to walk to the back and pay for your food there. They will give you a number and bring food the food to you.

savoy cafe and deli is slightly off the beaten path (on figueroa) and should not be passed by.  a great selection of sandwiches, salads, quiche, and a soup and salad bar that rivals some of the best i've ever tried.
salads from the salad bar are priced by weight and the selection of ingredients for
your personalized salad is huge.  everything is fresh and delicious.  i had their carrot
chipotle soup and the flavors were terrific
together.  the lorraine was very good, in spite of the gf bread crumbling apart when eating (maybe a bit stale?) but i gave it a buy the first time.  a custom salad from the salad bar with asian dressing was d'lish.
servers were helpful, knowledgeable and just plain nice! ice tea has free refills.  super clean and a great indoor space; there's an outdoor patio for eating as well.  definitely a good place to try!

Stop here do not pass GO do not collect $200.  Look no further for fresh, high quality food artfully plated and delicious!  Everything my family had here was superb from the quiche of the moment to the turkey sandwich.  I couldn't resist a chocolate muffin either.  Rich, dense, moist and chocolatey!  
Service was pleasant but the music was a little bland for me.  There's a good reason DDD made a pit stop.

My favorite place to eat. Who else has an all organic menu?  The salad bar is a sure thing and their baked goods never disappoint.  I love the greek feta quiche. No matter what I order I always get a tub of the mango quinoa salad to go- I eat it at home over a bed of spring mix! They have my favorite flavors of kombucha and the coffee bar is pretty great too. Best breakfast/lunch spot or a quick stop to get a snack after yoga. My only complaint is that I wish they would clean up the decor and simplify the space with some clean lines.
Gluten free vegan carrot muffin- and coconut milk decaf latte: can't live without my weekly dose of savoy. Service is excellent and I haven't tried anything that I haven't loved.
Such a sweet restaurant. Amazing food, desserts are wonderful, ambiance is fantastic.

This is one of my best breakfast recommendations in Santa Barbara.  I first came here for an Axxess deal over a year ago and I was so blown away by the HUEVOS RANCHEROS that I keep coming back, and I never stray from this dish.  The tortillas are beautifully crisp, the beans are super flavorful, as is the chunky homemade salsa that tops the usually perfectly cooked over easy eggs.  The other breakfast items also look delicious, but I strongly recommend the huevos rancheros.  Also, they're house coffee is outstanding! 

They also have a delicious sandwich menu and deli.  I've had a couple sandwiches and never been disappointed, and they're deli salads are fresh and delicious.  I think they use all organic products too.  

The plus...the staff is super friendly too!  And they have an axxess BOGO offer.  I haven't tried dinner yet but I plan on it.

I FINALLYYY came here for lunch and am feeling pretty dumb for not coming sooner. The salad bar, cold foods selection, and hot food menu had awesome options that made ordering pretty difficult. Finally decided on a salad that I packed with their delicious salmon and one of the special sandwiches that was packed with three different meats, avocado, and chipotle mayo. Everything was delicious, flavorful, and filling. I only wish I had come for all their other food! Don't make my mistake, come visit and eat everything.

This little gem just happened to have vegan options on the menu.  We both had the vegan scramble with potatoes. First time I have never been able to eat all of it.  So good. So healthy.  So filling. The scramble had tofu, greens, mushrooms, zucchini and more and add the potatoes and sourdough toast and you have a feast. It is Santa Barbara so everything is on the slightly higher side cost wise. But well worth it.  Going to take a vegan dark chocolate sea salt cupcake to go.  There goes the diet folks.   Btw...it looked so good I started eating it before taking a picture. My bad. Maybe I can take a photo of the desserts before eating them. Don't bet on that. Lol.

This place is awful. First of all, good luck finding a place to sit.  Furthermore, while there are seemingly 100 people that work here, none of them will make eye contact with you, so you will never get decent service.  The salad that I purchased for $14 was adequate; the dressing was pretty good.  I tried to order a beer, and the girl at the register had no idea what was on tap. So I went and sat at the bar to the side, where the four flustered girls never once asked me if I needed help.  There was a dirty plate and half full glass at the place I sat at, and it never got bused the entire hour that I was there. This place has a great selection of good looking foods, and I heard incredible things before coming here.  My experience was terrible, but I will try to give it a second chance soon......

I love savoy. The ambiance is awesome. It's a great little cafe. I come here all the time when I'm up in Santa Barbara and I always get the Turkey Fritter with Mango Quinoa. The turkey fritters are really really good. I wish the mango quinoa had more mango to go with all that quinoa, but it was still good. I've never tried any of the desserts but they look so tasty!

A wonderful find! My daughter and I drove up to Santa Barbara to visit friends....when we arrived we said we felt like something fresh and healthy for lunch. Funny thing was that we were parked right across the street from Savoy. Our friend suggested it and it was perfect! It smells good as soon as you enter. You order up at the deli-type counter and pay before getting your food. So many choices.....there's a salad bar, soups, hot food, more salads, sandwiches.....We had one sandwich ( you pick what you want on it), one super power bowl, beef stroganoff, mac&cheese, kale salad, chicken enchilada, roasted vegetables and cauliflower quiche. We enjoyed it all!

A gem of a place in downtown Santa Barbara.  Fresh, healthy and delicious.  Went here for lunch and it was a little busy.  The crowd thinned out after 1:00.   Just walk up and order your food.  Nice wide selection to choose from.  I got the turkey frittata.  Very unique and satisfying.  Nice zesty sauce to go with it.  Have to go back and explore more of the menu.

I would give it 5 stars but I get the same thing every time so I can't speak for the entire menu. Chicken marsala and mashed potatoes or veggie side, these are 5 star items for me!

Lot of gluten free dessert options as well!

I got the black bean enchiladas and a strawberry salad. It was tasty and just what I needed for a quick lunch. I was on my laptop there too which was nice and convenient. I like the order at the counter aspect and so many people turned through the space over the time I was there, which is great. People really flocked to the salad bar and it seemed like a ton of locals (I'm visiting) so that is always a good sign. My only issue is that the chairs and tables did not fit all the well in the space. It is just sooo tight in there, especially considering that people are also shuffling at the salad bar. I think they need to remove about 25% of the tables OR, better yet, get smaller chairs b/c the high-backed ones they had only made it more awkward b/c there was more bulk and those were elbow height. I really really recommend they consider that; they probably have tunnel vision around it but it was an awkward set up especially during the height of lunch and it would definitely keep me from going back- just a smaller scaled table/chair would help tremendously to alleviate that issue and make the space much more functional.
They have a great variety of healthy and savory for all palates! Try the quiche you will not regret it!
Best salad bar I have ever eaten, full of fresh organic goodies soooo yummy a must if you like good fresh food in Santa Barbara

We stopped here for lunch on our way up the coast, we were drawn by the good reviews.  Floor space is a little tight but that wasn't a huge problem.  I ordered The Gibraltar and my wife ordered the Italian Sub. 

The sandwiches were good, but not exceptional.  We were very disappointed that the sandwiches as they were described on the boards did not come to the table. The Gibraltar was supposed to have included roast beef and sun dried tomatoes, but I effectively got a turkey club sandwich.  The Italian Sub was also missing sun dried tomatoes.  If you're out of something you really need to let the customers know right up front. I don't plan on coming back.

Really my friends?! Savoy could've deserved 4 stars but they definitely lost major brownie points today.

"GUY" MUST be out of his mind and trippen because I was feeling noble today after my 4th/5th time here and ordered the Guy Plate. The raved after turkey pasilla fritter tasted like crunchy plain mush with no flavor at all (didn't even taste or see the turkey/pasilla chiles), while the mango quinoa salad smelled painfully sour and rotten and tasted plain as well. The pesto green beans that I usually get and are delicious were soggy and mushy, and sadly broke my heart today. So bad with the last two that I had to just throw it away. The carrot cake was honestly nothing special and the frosting was too sweet and overwhelming. This must have been a super off day for Savoy and was truly disappointing for the price and usual high ratings. Makes me question the Food Network extremely as there are many other delicious food places in SB that could've made it. All of the food/premade salad today looked old and soggy :'(

I've tried the Gibralter sandwich as well and the chicken was delicous and juicy, but the dijon mustard (which I requested be taken off when I ordered but was forgotten, but I let it slide since it was to go and I didn't wan't to be THAT person) was ridiculously overwhelming and killed the sandwich for me

Pesto Salad (solid) is usually a go to for me because I love pesto, but if you screw that up that is REALLY bad 

Salad bar is nice only because there are lots of options/variety, but it isn't always stocked up on items you want but if there are people in front of you/behind you and you don't feel like leaving to go ask a worker for more of it, it just makes you even more frustrated at the place

The prices are so-so and could probably be a dollar or two less for the soup sizes and portions. I hate that it's a mystery sometimes or that i have to squint my eyes all over the place to look for prices.

1 Star gained because this is one of the few relatively healthy places to eat that I don't feel horribly about myself going to compared to Los Arroyos, Norton's, or the other amazing restaurants in DT, and another star because the service/workers are usually pretty nice and attentive

But Holy Bejeezus this place can be overwhelming and claustrophobic especially during lunch and if it is your first time. Honestly raises my blood pressure a little bit every time since there is little room to walk through the aisles and tables and there are things all over the place with awkward space for lines.

If you want a relatively relaxing and peaceful place to eat lunch or escape work for a bit, this is not a place I would recommend at all.

So happy this exists!  When you don't want to make a healthy organic meal at home then Savoy is the place to go.  I eat here at least twice a week and always bring visitors because there is something delicious for everyone. I love their organic salad bar and their breakfasts.

Santa Barbara is my go-to place when I want to escape the usual LA hustle + summer heat waves. And now I found a go-to place for lunch when I want to escape the State St crowds - Savoy! I happen to park around the corner from the Cafe and discovered it in passing. The selection is broad. The service is hospitable & helpful. The deli menu entailed an interesting array of options I had never before tasted. I ordered a half 9-grain sandwich (uniquely combined cream cheese + cranberry jam + turkey + field greens) along with a side of a Quinoa salad (a savory blend of sliced almonds + cilantro + mangos + green onions). For an added touch of home-style comfort, they had pitchers of water and sliced lemons available for you to help yourself. Instead of boring glasses, they provided a fun set of country mason jars. I was so full after my lunch that I didn't have any room for one of their vegan desserts...till next time Savoy :)
The food is amazing, no question. I'm writing this review because the staff are just so kind and attentive. Every person I've interacted with today has just been lovely.

I had the gluten free pancakes here and they were soo good! You would expect the pancakes to taste a little off but they tasted like a regular pancake. The pancakes were topped with strawberries, blueberries and powdered sugar. 

I don't remember the prices but I know that it wasn't that expensive. The environment is really friendly and they have a back patio for a place to eat with your dogs.

If you want food fast, but not fast food, this place is great. They have a nice little seating area out back that borders the parking lot.  I had the quinoa and mango salad with turkey fritters. Very good!

Love Savoy! Eggs Benedict, Tofu Scramble, Roasted Beet Salad, Turkey Fritters, Mac and Cheese all so delicious. Super friendly staff and so many delicious options. For desert Buttermilk Chocolate Cake!

This place was a total godsend for my time in Santa Barbara. No matter which meal, I knew I could find something to satisfy here. It's cute and "market-y" inside with a rotation of fresh ala carte options and made-to-order sandwiches. The food was clean and yummy. The gluten free treats were SO DELICIOUS. I especially enjoyed the carrot cake cupcake. Mmmmmm. 
My only complaint is the pricing; it seemed extremely overpriced for actual quantity and quality.

How sad I must be to give one of Santa Barbara's most critically acclaimed eateries a meh review.

First off, it took me an embarrassing amount of time to even figure out how to place an order here. Do you sit? Do you start at the bar on the left? Is that a bartender on the right? Oh, nope. Go straight to the back if you want something out of their deli or bakery cases. Not very intuitive.

Second, I'm pretty sure I've been greeted by nicer cats than the staff here. I was browsing the case for pasta salads, looked up, and made eye contact with the person behind the counter, who didn't say a single word. After some prodding and flustered questions, I was starting to get the feeling that I was asking too much. I have no clue how much half a pound of cooked pasta looks -- please don't talk down to me while I'm trying to figure out what works in my budget. I managed to wrangle a container of pesto pasta salad out of him even after he managed to drop the plastic tub in the bowl of pasta once. The oily container then went behind the counter and he told me I could pay "around the corner."

Well, the way that Savoy is laid out is that the counter around that corner has a line that bumps into what's kinda the wine (?) line, and there's not much space for people who are passing through the line to get to the drink fridge in the back. By the time I made it to the front of the line, the woman at the register noticed I was empty-handed and gave me a weird look. Just paying for the food on the counter behind ya -- I'm not here to waste your time! That and I couldn't pass up a double chocolate cookie.

Needless to say, I didn't eat there. But when I had the pesto pasta salad at my office afterward, I was surprised at the inclusion of fresh veggies. Their pesto sauce is light and coats the bowtie pasta evenly, which was a nice break from the bad things about Savoy. Not garlicky at all, so it's a good choice if you have to talk face-to-face with someone right after. Crunchy broccoli and cherry tomatoes make this a hearty vegetarian dish, even for us meat eaters. What I detested, though, was the inclusion of capers -- they were a sour infusion I didn't need in my herby lunch.  I think I ended up paying $5 or so for a half pint of pasta. 

The dessert, a double chocolate cookie that cost $1, was worth the price. It tasted like the high quality foods Savoy purports to put out, with a glossy chocolate skin and gooey ganache filling. Had I not known better, I'd have thought it underdone, but this was instead very well-done

I'd really looked forward to trying Savoy, given local appreciation and national recognition from Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives. But I didn't get any of that famous hospitality -- just a lunch dulled by snooty treatment.

Pretty awesome place that serves a plethora of simple made dishes eloquently. Tasty and awesome market, deli, inn, type of vibe. Portions are bigger than expected but organic fresh and at least makes me feel that they are somewhat healthy in a weird way. Ordered their eggs Benedict, side of flap jacks, and latte. A GIANT step above your normal Denny's.

What a wonderful experience for my tastebuds. Relaxing environment, great food choices! My gluten free meat lover breakfast was perfectly prepared, and my Matcha latte was creamy and delicious. I highly recommend this place if you're looking for plentiful and healthy options.

My family and I were really looking forward to eating here but unfortunately we were let down. Our curry was lukewarm at best and tasted as though it had been sitting there for a while. We paid a significant amount of money on almost cold food. It was a let down.
My diet is based on an #AIProtocol and this place was a life saver during my trip to Santa Barbara!! The food was so good and so fresh!  I wish I had a Savoy in my hometown.

Enjoyed my brunch. The wild salmon was moist and had a nice, thin buttery crust. roasted potatoes were a little burnt and definitely recommend baguette  with a dollop of the marvelous orange marmalade jam. The pastries looked amazingly mouth watering. I think I gained 5 pounds just looking at them. Lol. Lots of Gluten free options too! Cute place overall - liken it to a mini-Whole Foods. Minus one star for the kinda expensiveness. Will be back.

This really is not a place your come across. It is less then a block off of State St and not in a walking pattern to a parking lot, so it would be some place you need to seek out to find.
Quality of the food is strong. Pricing is ok, not great, but not overly pricey. And if you are not familiar with the set up, you may sit and a table and wait for help. 
Logan was a huge help on welcoming us, walking us thru the process, making recommendations and keeping us from trying some place else.  I think he could see we needed talking to and he sold us on it.
The food is good, but highly overpriced. There's better options around.Don't know what the big hype is about! Won't be back!!!

This is a great little cafe in Santa Barbara, hidden away and a little difficult to find but very worth it. We stumbled in here on a Saturday afternoon when we needed a quick lunch to take with us on a road trip down to Los Angeles. It looks like they had an option for a sit-down meal where you order at your table, but they also had a great deli counter and a HUGE salad bar with lots of interesting options. 

I ended up making a salad with artichoke hearts, kale, quinoa, sweet potatoes, beans and stuffed grape leaves. There were also plenty of protein options, including chicken, tofu, salmon and steak. Cheeses, nuts, seeds, interesting dressings...I could have spent forever trying to decide what to put on my salad. We ended up getting two large salads and a container of cut up cantaloupe for about $22. Good food for a good price. When we're back in Santa Barbara, we will definitely be visiting Savoy!

Honestly I was hoping for good food based on the reviews, but it was horrible. There was absolutely no seasoning in anything I tried. I spent a good amount of money for bland, flavorless food. I'm very disappointed in this place and really not sure why it has good reviews.

Found this place because I saw it had a lot of gluten free options and boy did it really. I ordered the breakfast burrito in a bowl with corn tortillas on the side. It was amazing 5/5 would come back again. I also ordered a sandwich to go which was also 5/5 would come back again. Our server also was a friendly guy, gave us food recommendations and conversation. Overall, this is a great restaurant for breakfast and will return if I am in the Santa Barbara area.

A great little cafe-slash-deli that's a perfect spot to pick up lunch to-go or to sit down and enjoy.

I loved the hot deli combo plate. A bit pricey, but offers really tasty and healthy options for when you need a healthy alternative (I'd go for the salmon and veggie options). They've also got a great salad bar and fresh soup that changes daily.

If you're not down with the healthy, gorge on those chocolate chip cookies by the register; they're AMAZE-BALLS.

Love this place as it was reccomended by my facialist who frequents Santa Barbara. It's a deli style place where you order at the counter. Food will be delivered to your table. It is a small place so seating can be tight but cozy. You sit close to the next patron. Lots of vegetarian meals to explore on the menu. It's on the back side of north State street. Parking is by the bus depot.

I was not impressed. I know a lot of people love this place but the batch of dishes my family got for breakfast were not good quality. My french toast was not cooked all the way and the two egg benedicts we received were not cooked correctly. The eggs were completely over cooked and the bread was so hard we could barely cut through it with a steak knife.  The hollandaise sauce and the ham were the only things that were good. The potatoes were way under seasoned as well. The tea was excellent, I love a place that gives you loose tea in its own pot.

Super hip and cool spot with a local feel of welcome and community. You have a wide variety of choices here (mostly all healthy). You can make your own salad bar, savory sandwich or choose a side of soup, quinoa, Greek cucumber salad or even a pasta side. Then.......the bakery/dessert bar.... it's literally everything you would dream about with huge portions and easy prices. Absolutely enjoyed this place and next time I'm in Santa Barbara I'll be back.

Attentive and kind service, beautiful decor and atmosphere, decent prices, generous servings, and truly delectable cuisine. Savoy has it all and for that, they get 5 stars!

The salmon was baked to perfection and the pineapple flavored it perfectly. The Mac and cheese was ridiculously creamy and the butter, which was probably super bad, felt too right. 

The chicken marsala was tender and the sauce perfectly complemented the richness of the organic mashed potatoes. The servers weren't prickly as well-- they made sure to fill, even exceed the capacity of the plate!

The only negative thing about my experience was that they were out of turkey pretty early on in the day, so I wasn't able to taste the renowned "Guy Plate," which features the fritters Guy Fieri himself presented on the Food Network's "Diners, Drive- ins, and Dives."

Oh well, I'll definitely be here another time soon to try it out and based one my first time at Savoy's, I know I won't be disappointed.

What a cute little place!  It's almost like a little farmers market in there. They have soups and a make your own salad bar and fresh foods and baked goods. They have a bar and a drink selection, too!  The food here seems very healthy and they have vegan and gluten-free options, which is cool.  There's lots of tables to sit at, and there's additional seating in the back!  All of the staff was very helpful and nice, too.

The employees here are so nice! The original side I ordered was all of a sudden all ordered before they could put any on my plate, so they gave me TWO sides of my choice and even threw in a cupcake! Definitely went above and beyond!
If you like cake & you like chocolate - do yourself a favor and try the chocolate buttermilk cake. It's delicious. So moist &  dense... my new go to decedent dessert.

Super cute restaurant/market with fresh, delicious food. Parking for out-of-towners was confusing. There are car parks in the area but they all were strangely full as well as the street parking in front of the store. Do NOT park in the corner where the flower and mattress shops are. They're pretty anal about it and will absolutely give you dirty looks.

On to the food! 

Fresh Butternut Squash: YES YES YES! Get this. It's soooo good if you typically like squash soups. 
Gibraltar: This is one of their signature sandwiches. I thought it was really good and the bacon in there helped a lot. I have a small mouth and the sandwich was stacked a bit high so that was the only con for me but don't let this affect you decision. This was my problem. 
Lemon bar: Yummmmmmy. Really tangy, really good. 

I'd definitely be back again for the soup for sure and to try another sandwich!

I work in downtown Santa Barbara. If I want to go out for a delicious breakfast with natural/organic ingredients, this is my only choice. Their food is consistently good/excellent and I'm grateful that this place exists!
Order at the counter. Tons of great, fresh options. Price is totally reasonable. And the food was delicious. If I lived in SB I'd definitely be back!

Staff has no idea what anything is. I asked about what was in the entree and they looked around so confused. They didn't know what the axxess card got me for a discount and charged me extra. Not the greatest food for the price.

Savoy cafe was so wonderful. The staff was very helpful and friendly. Great customer service. My husband and I went in for their vegan options in their menu. It was a nice surprise for my husband to find they have cold brew. I had their vegan power bowl. And it was filling and a little  bland but after I added some salt and avocado it was perfect. My husband had the oatmeal that had a beautiful assortment or fresh berries and nut! It was amazing. Such a great place. We will be back!
Very expensive for average quality take out food. The tuna salad was mostly apples and their bread was stale

Great food, and one of my favorite local places. Great quality food, a wide variety of gluten free dairy free vegan options. The perfect place to take a picky eater or someone with allergies. Beyond that, fantastic coffee and a really fun local atmosphere. Could not recommend more.
Delicious deli style cafe. Great vegetarian and vegan options. 4 stars because it is a little pricey!
Savoy has one of the best fritters I have  ever had in my life. The Pasilla turkey fritter comes with a delicious aioli sauce as well. The pesto green beans and the enchiladas are also great here.

There's one in every crowd. I loathe Savoy, the most over-rated, over-priced, and over- crowded restaurant in town. The salad bar? What's the big deal? You can go to the equally horrific Whole Foods and get a far more wide ranging selection in an ambient seating arrangement. And parking in their super dangerous sardine tin parking lot is better than none which is what you generally get at Savoy as the adjacent lot is mostly mobbed.  You can even choose al fresco, as you can at Ralphs right around the corner from Savoy.  But I personally lean toward Gelson's these days, esp. on Tuesday - when they knock a dollar off the price.  I don't know whether the iceberg lettuce is heavy on gluten.  But again, I'm not sure if what's marked organic at Savoy is not actually hydroponic these days. The only justification I can see for going to Savoy is if your doctor has put you on a kombucha diet.  Savoy boasts the most extensive selection of this epicurean delicacy anywhere on the Central Coast right on its back wall.
Simply fresh, delicious food! Sam took wonderful care of us. Send your calorie worries out the window and make a selection from the bakery case. A new FAVORITE!

I like the idea of this place, the location, and the atmosphere. But is the food anything to write home about - no. It's convenient to have a fairly healthy yet casual option for dining along State Street, but I'd rather eat at Whole Foods Market. 

The buttermilk chocolate cake is very good and the carrot cake is a runner up, in my opinion, to the one at Natural Cafe, which is more moist with larger chunks of walnuts and more shredded carrots and richer cream cheese frosting. Cookies and muffins are also far, far better at Whole Foods.

This place is best if you work nearby and want to grab breakfast or lunch with coworkers. Or if you're tired of Whole Foods and want something close to a homemade meal. 3.5.

Amazing food! 
I got the chicken marsala with brown rice and it was delicious! The ambiance is great and the employees are extremely friendly.  I loved that they had a salad bar and a wide selection of drinks that you can choose from. 
Try some of their housemade desserts as well! 

Highly recommend the Savoy Cafe :)
Savoy is awesome, great environment. Staff and owners are excellent. Tranquil atmosphere, the best salad var in Santa Barbara.

THIS PLACE ROCKS!! Delish deli section where you can pick a main and two sides (which is my fav because i get to make my own meal!) I grabbed the famous, Guy Fieri approved, turkey fritter along with a fresh mango quinoa salad and some of the pesto green beans. I took it to go and reheated it and it was absolutely delish. I was only briefly stopping by Santa Barbara on a trip but wish I could go back and try some of the other yummy options!!!! Healthy, fresh, homemade, and just worth every penny. Also I love supporting local family owned restaurants, and this place felt so cozy and full of love!!! delish delish delish!
I absolutely love the food and service at this place! I think I come here at least once a week! The service is awesome and everything tastedelicious!

LOVE this place! For years I came at least once a week for their salad bar. I'll come in on weekends with friends to get sandwiches for the beach or on a Friday night before movies at the Sunken Gardens. Recently I tried their gluten free brownie & I wouldn't change a thing.
I moved away for two years and tried to replicate their marinated tofu, but it wasn't the same. 
I especially want to thank Matt who is often there when I come in. He's so friendly and makes Savoy feel like home. 
A lot of restaurants come and go in SB, but this is the only one that is an absolute necessity.

Strolled into this place after showing up and finch and fork and seeing how stuffy that place looked! This was the COZIEST best New Year's Eve brunch we could of asked for. Organic everything, BEST COFFEE, and cheap fresh squeezed mimosas ! Not to mention the service was so warm and welcoming. We'll be back for you, thanks guys !

Black Bean enchilada = 4 stars
Vegan chocolate mint cookie = 5 stars
Service = 5 stars
Value = 5 stars
Seating/lines = 3 stars
I go to this restaurant to meet friends and hang out. I'm never tired of it. The food is always fresh, the service is friendly, and it's like a kitchen away from home.

I love this place so much that I joke about moving to Santa Barbara just to eat here every day. I live in LA, but I make sure to stop by when I'm driving north up the 101. The food and atmosphere are both spectacular! Highly recommend the preprepared salads.

You walk in and the first thing you notice is all the wood. It's everywhere. Very rustic, Ancient Greece feel. There was a cool waiter who walked out and did a full u-turn throughout the whole cafe while carrying a plate of food, that was amazing to watch. I got a coffee and it was pretty good. Overall would go again. 5/5

Super fresh and prices reasonable for Santa Barbara standards. My personal favorite is the wild salmon either all a cart or with sides. I usually prefer arugula salad - something with more of a bite. ;)

Finally, REAL FOOD! All organic and local produce= Tasty tasty food. It's so refreshing for a restaurant/ mini grocery that puts quality first! Gluten free options of course. Stop in, get a bite to eat, grab a kombucha and snack for the road to go, and you're golden.

We had to check out this bakery while in SB. I love snickerdoodles and needs to try theirs. It was just a little dry. The sugar cookie however, was delicious. I love heart shaped cookies and the frosting was soft. Highly recommend the heart shaped cookie!

This is a super cool little spot! They have lots of wine and currently groceries to help out for the Quarantine. We have eaten there a couple times and the girlfriend loves it. They have lots of healthy options and you can sit out on the back patio surrounded by lots of plants. It's pretty cool and the food is good!

Healthy, wholesome breakfast on the pricey side for just some eggs and a salad. Their Matcha Lattes are carefully crafted and super foamy with the steamed milk. Free refills if you buy a cup of coffee.

I live only a few blocks away but have eaten at this place only about half a dozen times over the years, mostly because of a friend who really liked it here.  The ambience of the restaurant is very cozy and cute.  But other than that, the experience has always been "mehhh."  

Food is overpriced for the quality, which is nothing special. I ordered the Turkey Fritter that Guy Fieri liked--and the fritter itself had zero seasoning and was like eating dough. It came with a not-so-good sauce that was like a spicy Thousand Island dressing.... And to give an example of it's markup,   they sell Harmless Coconut Water at $6 a bottle; at Costco I can buy a whole half dozen case for about $10!

Finally, the people who work there pretty much act like cafeteria workers. Just not friendly, consistently so.  Every single time.  They do their job ok but definitely do not go out of their way to make the dining experience special.   The thought did flit through my mind that maybe it's because I'm a person of color and everyone who works there is white.

Great options. I wanted to select a restaurant where my bf could have some vegan options but I could still get my breakfast fix. We ordered the vegan burrito, Olive oil potatoes,citrus French toast, and Orange Juice. Soooo good. 
I had to go in and ask how everything worked because it was a bit confusing walking in (2 different counter tops and welcome sign doesn't make it clear whether you seat yourself first or order before seating yourself).

Why is there not a savoy in Ventura?! So vegan/gluten-free friendly. Deli atmosphere. Serves the type of food that would be twice as expensive in a more upscale environment, but is instead in a casual, cozy setting.

This place is delicious!! Awesome salad bar and the bakery is soooo sinfully good! I work on State st. and any time I go out for my lunch break I go there! Outdoor and indoor seating, great food, healthy choices. Really an excellent lunch spot!
Only downside, when it's crowded in there, the set up makes it extra-difficult to get around. And there is a very rude woman who works there. Everyone else is really nice, but she puts a damper on the place. 
I love it here though! If you've never had it, it's a must!

I loved this place! The ambiance at Christmas time is so festive and classy. I ordered the garden scramble with chicken and sage sausage, and it was incredible. The. Cheese was so melty.The potatoes were yummy and light. 

My three regrets are that i ordered orange juice and it had a lot of seeds in it and was a tad sour, and that the toast doesn't come buttered. By the time you butter the toast it's not warm enough to melt the butter all the way! The side of fruit with my mom's dish wasn't our favorite, but melon is out of season in December. 

But i absolutely loved this place and I'm definitely coming back!
Hands down, one of the best salad bars I've ever had....so many delectable items and all really healthy too. Highly recommend!

3.5 stars.  I don't totally love, but I totally like...and therefore, round up to 4.0 stars.

Went for the salad bar, but it really didn't look too interesting ($9.99 per lb).  Instead, I opted for the item featured on Diners, Drive-ins & Dives, aired originally on the Food Network, 3/5/2012: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hh4TcOqGw2g.

Turkey Pasilla Fritter ($12.95) -- mainly chopped turkey, pasilla chilies, jalapenos, potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, egg, mayo, salt, and flour.  A very generous portion, quite good, but I was bored after 10 bites.  They offer a Guy's Special, 2 sides (Quinoa Mango Salad and Pesto Green Beans) and 1/2 slice carrot cake, but I wanted to pick my own sides.  Mac & Cheese and the Pesto Green Beans for the same price, but no carrot cake.  Sides were good, but I wouldn't order this again.  Fascination over.  (3.5 stars)

AMBIANCE: good energy, good spirit, woodsy, bright.
FOOD: good selection of ready-made comfort food, sandwiches, and a 25 item or so salad bar.
SERVICE: very nice, very helpful.
MUSIC: live guy on accordion.  Odd feature, but interesting.
BAKED GOODS: looks amazing, but didn't try.  GOING BACK!

The story of Paul and Cathy Shields is a good one.  They got a second chance at owning this business, and I wish them continued success.

Ordered the vegan scramble with potatoes and toast. Presentation good, nice fresh veggies. NO seasoning on any of the food.. no salt, no pepper nothing. I had to put in a ton of salt and even that didn't help. I appreciate the vegan offerings, but if did your research, a tofu scramble should be seasoned. The tofu was just thrown in completely white, not seasoned. A good tofu scramble would be yellow from the cumin, nutritional yeast and turmeric. My boyfriend's eggs were not seasoned either. I thought seasoning was like the number one thing for a chef... I guess if this is there "healthy" style, sure but not worth $14. Also no vegan butter or jam offered for my toast.

My husband and I ate breakfast here and we bolth loved our dishes. I have Celiac and ordered the gluten free citrus dipped french toast. It was the best french toast I have ever eaten! I love that this place offers gluten free dishes and does not use refined sugar! This is my kinda food and I only wish there was one in Orange County.

I loved this place! The ambiance at Christmas time is so festive and classy. I ordered the garden scramble with chicken and sage sausage, and it was incredible. The. Cheese was so melty.The potatoes were yummy and light. 

My three regrets are that i ordered orange juice and it had a lot of seeds in it and was a tad sour, and that the toast doesn't come buttered. By the time you butter the toast it's not warm enough to melt the butter all the way! The side of fruit with my mom's dish wasn't our favorite, but melon is out of season in Dec

But i absolutely loved this place and I'm definitely coming back! 

I came again with my mom and sisters, and they have such good gluten-free options (my sister has Celiacs!)! The citrus dipped French toast was delicious, although she would've liked it to be more toasty in the middle. They have a lot of good gluten-free baked goods in their case too. The butterscotch bars are TDF (to die for) !

My mom said she wishes the toast was buttered, because the toast is not warm when she gets it and be butter doesn't melt when she tries to spread it. Everything else on the protein plate was delicious! 

I got the breakfast burrito and i give that particular dish 5/5 stars! Perfect in every way in my opinion.

We had the Guy plate and Chicken Marsala. Both were very good. The Guy plate was very refreshing for a warm summer afternoon with the mango quinoa and pesto green beans. The Turkey fritter was very tasty with a nice chili flavor without to much heat. Mmmmm Mashed potatoes and moist chicken, both dark and white (a must in our book) made an enjoyable Chicken Marsala

The first time I had gluten-free pancakes at Savoy I was certain there had been a mistake with my order. I hadn't been able to enjoy pancakes in more than twenty-years due to a gluten allergy. How could these pancakes be gluten free? They were the pancakes of my youth; soft and fluffy, perfectly delightful. So I tried to return them to the kitchen only to be told the only pancakes they serve at Savoy are gluten free. And that is just Savoy in a nutshell. If you have food allergies or can eat anything you want, just know at Savoy you cannot tell the difference. Also, they source local and the staff is amazing and the owners are the cutest couple. And the patio out back is charming. And they have literally everything from a crazy good salad bar, to matcha lattes and chicken marsala (made with coconut milk), but they also have lasagna and a stellar selection of wines. So there, go to Savoy and thank me later. And pancakes. Try them!

We were visiting Santa Barbara for the day and were so happy that we happened upon this place for lunch!  Being of the organic, non processed food bunch, having an organic salad bar with an incredible selection AND paleo/gluten free dessert options?  The Savoy Cafe is like hitting the lottery!   

We both had a salad and soup.  The turkey posole and cream of broccoli are both delish.

Reasonably priced for the quality,  a quaint outdoor seating area and friendly staff.   

Restrooms were clean.  This is always a huge plus for us!

Next time we are in the area, this is certainly a must for us!

One of my favorite places in Santa Barbara. Hands down. I eat here probably twice a week (I have a problem I know) and it never disappoints! 

The salad bar is AMAZING. Fresh, organic with tons of options! They always have a vegan soup which is great since I'm dairy intolerant. There's also tons of grab and go options, great sandwiches and homemade dishes. 

Staff is usually friendly and there is always room to sit inside and outside! Would recommend to anyone looking for an easy place to have lunch or dinner.

This is my favorite lunch spot in the area because I love buffet/deli style to pick out your food in small amounts to explore. Sometimes I just want a bit of some exotic rice or simply a bowl of soup. Everyone is very accommodating ..good deliish place! Yum

Well the first thing I can say to this is I'm going back. I'm going back again and again. This is a fantastic little restaurant. I can see why it's packed all the time. The quality of the food the selection of the salads and just the great taste that get into your mouth when you start eating you just can't help but love this place. Everything we tasted was perfect the service was perfect. Yeah the place can be a little busy, and if you're a little impatient well go somewhere else. Parking is easy across the street and it's free for the first hour so if you time it right you can park have lunch and drive away and never have to pay a nickel for parking. I like that a lot anyway rather than Babble on and on about all the things I like, I'm going to say get on in there taste whatever you want and I know you'll be happy. Probably make a lot of nice new friends from the next table I know we did and it just seems like the right people are there and the right cooks are in the back making it happen. See you there next time I'm in Santa Barbara
I am from out of town and this place is awesome! Great organic fresh food. Highly recommend it!

Very good deli. The salad bar and prepared food case is very extensive. I loved the chicken Marsala over mashed potatoes. Delicious carrot cake. Breakfast is good, too. The seating area is really crowded and you have people standing right on top of you, so I usually get my food to go.
Probably my favorite place for breakfast/brunch. Has something for everyone. The 'Veggie benedict' is my personal favorite & my daughter loves the 'Citrus-dipped Flapjacks'. Their Mocha is the best!
Fresh healthy delicious food.  I especially like the Protein Plate for breakfast.  All lunch items are great.  Kathy's carrot cake is the best I've ever had. Wonderful family run restaurant

Canned salad bar 
Nothing fresh
What a waste of space this place is
The food is bland and dry
Fresh, tasty and organic food. What more can you ask for?

We arrived first thing Friday morning with the sun pouring through the glass front window.  The high-back wooden chairs and natural wood tables are beautifully welcoming!
The choices of food  can meet anyone's cravings.  The food is counter ordered.  Our family has gluten-free needs and Savoy has many options.  We chose G/F pancakes and they made their Benedict with G/F Bread...Absolutely delicious!!  The staff is very helpful to be sure you get what you crave (thanks Jade!)...ENJOY
Public parking is available directly connected to the back entrance patio...a must try!!

One of my favorite spots in town, absolute first choice for breakfast. Great salad bar, always a vegan soup option, vegan baked goods daily, and my favorite two breakfast options in SB: vegan breakfast burrito and tofu scramble. Both are large portions. Swap out the sweet potato in the burrito for regular potatoes if you're into savory!! Fresh squeezed OJ is amazing, especially in a mimosa. Friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful staff. See you there!
I hope to get back up to SB soon in order to get another GF sandwich! What a great spot to grab a bite to eat.

Such a cute place! Inside is a mini grocery store and then they have a cafe side for your coffee beverages and the other part is your deli/food/baked goods. I ordered their quinoa vegan bowl and added chicken sausage with a side a fruit and it was great! Of course I couldn't pass up on their sweets so I took a vegan gluten free chocolate cookie to go. Nice little spot for those with food sensitivities! Will be back next time I'm visiting SB

Absolute perfection. Very quick service as it's cafe style. The servers were all incredibly helpful, and warm, and on point. The flavors of the food were great and it was very fresh. Dynamite gluten free carrot muffin. I don't give five star reviews away but this place deserves it.

Savoy is very nice deli in the heart of Santa Barbara.  Everything at this deli is made out of quality organic ingredients.  I tried the open salad bar and absolutely loved it.  I'm not vegan or vegetarian, but for those that are, they have a large variety of options.  I wish the opened one of these in San Diego.

Great and friendly service.  With some family members taking the Vegan route and others not, it was amazing to find a spot that provided delicious food for all!  Wish I had enough stomach to try more food, everything looked incredible!

This place came up on a blog's list of restaurants you needed to try while visiting Santa Barbara, and Savoy did not disappoint. I decided to get takeout and was instantly greeted when I got to the counter. There are endless possibilities of sides to choose from and I love how you can mix them up creating new meals each time you visit. The staff was super friendly and even allowed me to try some different sides, before I decided on what to get.

I ended up ordering the Turkey Pasilla Fritter, Mango Quinoa Salad, and Pesto Green Beans.

Turkey Fritter: I can see why this item is so popular. It was seasoned while and the turkey was so juicy. 

Mango Quinoa: Not overly sweet and has just enough of the mango taste.

Green Beans: The highlight of my whole meal. I love green beans and these were perfection. They were covered in pesto and totally bumped up my entire meal.

They give a lot in those small takeout boxes. I ended up having quite the leftovers for the following day.
I had the eggs Benedict and it was amazing. Salad bar looked incredible too. Definite a permanent fixture on our agenda when we drive through SB.

First heard about savoy for their amazing salad bar and I absolutely loved it! They have a large variety of options for a healthy create-your-own lunch. Came back again for the famous all-day breakfast burritos and was not disappointed at all. I had it for a late lunch and it was definitely filling and just as delicious as everyone mentioned. They also have a vegan all-day breakfast burrito and the flavors in it were amazing. The filler was sweet potato with quinoa and the perfect amount of spices. 

Inside savoy there's plenty of seating, lively conversations, and locals who are enjoying their meals. There is also a coffee shop that makes wonderful tasting coffee. Their darks are strong and flavorful and their lattes are creamy to perfection. There's also pastries that you can pick up as well as drinks from other vendors (yerba matte, water bottles..., etc.)

Overall 2 great experiences, and will definitely be back.

- Jess H
Melt in your mouth chicken marsala.  Best lunch meal Ive had in a while.  Sweet little deli with tasty food.

food: decent.

service: its not that the service is bad but rather this is the 2nd time they have made a mistake and handled their mistake not only in a way that lacks the most basic professionalism (its a cafe not a bank but still, there needs to be SOME responsibility. christ. people. take responsibility for your actions. pathetic the way I was treated.) the first time someone swiped my card/charged me incorrectly i thought "ok mistakes happen." but this past Saturday the blonde white girl swipes my card as I am saying, "wait a minute" because the dollar amount she told me was did not sound right. Visiting Santa Barbara and State Street for the weekend, and looking for a good place to eat, we stumbled upon this place, and sure glad we did. From the looks of it, looks like a favorite among the locals. It has a deli atmosphere, but they also offer delicious full service entrees. We decided to have brunch (I think they serve till 2pm on Saturdays), I had the breakfast burrito (absolutely delicious without being too heavy, and light) and my boyfriend had the french toast with fruit, which he raved about (though he was later jealous of my fantastic breakfast burrito). Great quaint, small town atmosphere, and staff was very friendly. We'll definitely go back for future visits!

If you only eat gluten free food, visiting a new place and trying to find restaurants that can accommodate you can be a daunting task. I was excited to find Savoy Cafe & Deli who doesn't have one or two gluten free items - it has a lot. Excellent baked goods, sandwiches on their own GF bread.  I had their GF pancakes which were excellent. They were sprinkled with raspberries, blueberries and blackberries and dusted with powdered sugar. Excellent!

On a trip to pismo I did research of places to eat on the way. We got hungry and stopped here in Santa Barbara. Yelp reviews and pict were spot on! This place is awesome.  Prices are decent. Food is delicious and fresh. Service is great. Good looking salad bar. Wife n I both got sandwiches and they will custom make them. Huge selection of organic items.. drinks. Can get crowded at peak hours but some how it never got uncomfortably packed .. Friday at noon. They have great bakery items. There's a back patio for extra seating. Parking can be difficult but ya gotta pay .. its Santa Barbara!!! Would definitely go back.. my pictures showed what we ate.. check them out!!

Visited for brunch twice during a trip to Santa Barbara. I highly recommend their BREAKFAST BURRITO; and the "Quiche of the Moment" with side salad (had a fig dressing) was very tasty too. There are multiple 'stations' inside the store, which gives it a fun market/deli feeling, though it takes a moment to scan all of the food options and decide where to focus! The staff were extremely friendly and helpful in explaining the menu options and how to order. They also offer picnic basket rentals (along with food!), which is a fantastic idea for anyone looking to take a picnic up to a park or the beach.
Great healthy selection. Fast service a little something for everyone. Great selection on desserts and coffee drinks.

Really delicious spot for breakfast or lunch. Excellent variety and quality of prepared foods and made to order. They have tons or vegetarian and vegan options. Their tofu scramble was excellent and comes with side salad , toast and fruit. Really good size portion and the food was delicious. They brew handlebar coffee as well which was really tasty. I would definitely go back here again when in Santa Barbara.
The food is excellent! They have gluten free options which I like. The potatoes were some of the very best I have ever had! Great coffee too!!!!!

I stopped in here to grab lunch due to the reviews. Since it was my first visit, I was really confused on how the place was setup. You could tell the  regulars had it down because, they fell in line, went to the salad bar (which is amazing) then if they wanted added other items and paid for their food. Me I went to the deli area, ordered the mango quinoa salad and a quiche,  which was delicious. I didn't understand that I was to then go to the cashier and tell her my order, which she promptly retrieved and then make my payment. The nice young man behind the deli explained the process, and I left fulfilled. Next time, I'll act like a regular, grab my salad, add a few other items and ... nice place though.

I wasn't super impressed with Savoy Café & Deli, stopped by on the way to San Luis Obispo... we had trouble finding parking in the area, the food in the deli area looked like it had been sitting out for awhile and didn't look super fresh. My sandwich was lacking a bit of flavor, even after adding salt and pepper, it was just a bit flat. My boyfriend really liked his sandwich, which was the turkey one with cream cheese and avocado, so perhaps the mozzarella with basil was just the wrong choice. Its hard for me because I eat a similar one in a restaurant in San Diego that is amazing, so its hard not to compare the 2. Next time I would most likely try something else.

Great place for brunch. We were looking for a place that is vegan friendly. Surprisingly, there aren't so many restaurants in the downtown Santa Barbara being vegan friendly. (We also have someone in the group who is not vegan/ vegetarian). It was hard to find something that would satisfy everyone. This place is definitely the spot! They have a quite few vegan options and some regular sandwiches or salad. We had gluten free pancakes, veggie scrambled, vegan burritos and el cape which is a grilled portobello sandwich. They were ALL GOOD! The food comes with huge proportion that I got so full after finish eating the meal. The taste of food was certainly thumbs up. Environment was clean, somewhat crowded. There is an "outdoor" seating where you can bring your dog to sit there. They also provide water for dogs. So sweet! I'd definitely recommend here and come back again!

I eat here everytime I am in Santa Barbara for work.  The salad bar is good - it doesn't really change - but it has good variety, similar to a Whole Foods salad bar and some soups.  I haven't eaten any of the prepared hot foods but I am always happy with the salad.  I recommmend.

The server Lauren was extremely nice and accmmodating. We asked her about the Diners Drive ins and Dives TV spot and she showed us the Guy Fieri shrine they have which is pretty funny! 

Citrus French Toast was delicious and so was the omlette! Very good food done the right way, served with a smile!

First time at the Savoy cafe and I will definitely be going back. I ordered the "Guy Special", which had a turkey fritter, pesto green beans, mango quinoa salad and a half of slice of carrot cake and a pot of oolong coconut tea with almond coconut milk. This is a casual deli and I could see myself returning for a cup of tea or picking up food to go. My favorite was the mango quinoa salad, which would be perfect for a picnic or beach day. The only be aware I have to mention is the customers here were kind of annoying so be patient while ordering!
This is the go to place if you want affordable, organic meals. It's family owned and has a cozy, mellow vibe.
This is not a place for tourists. This is more like a place for localities to have casual dinner at a place like Chipotle. I would not come here on vacation though.

A small gem for any dietary need! 

All Yelpers out there who posted and recommended this place, thank you! The service, food, ambience, and options are fantastic!!!! 

Everything was extremely fresh delicious!! There were so many options that I didn't know what to choose. I have to say the bow tie pesto pasta was out of this world! The lavender lemonade was real lemonade and not fruit juice! Oh and the strawberry shortcake.... not too sweet, melts in your mouth!!! 

Hands down a must try place if in the area!!!

A Saturday brunch visit here for myself my brother and parents. Think whole food/Starbucks meets a quaint cafe. Community seating. Ambience is very laid back, with a coffee bar and salad station. Also included are a place to order sandwiches and other staples, such as the item guy fiery ordered a turkey fritter. Food was good, everything is organic/humane. Fresh juices were excellent and cold brew coffee is offered. French toast and the "Naples" sandwich (fresh mozz evoo,greens, sea salt on ciabatta, I added ham) were very good. Be prepared to wait 15-20 minutes to get your food on the weekend.
I ate there for the first time this past week and I plan on making it one of my favorite stops. My sandwhich was delicious and the staff was very friendly. I can't wait to go back with my hubby.

Worst customer service ever. Had to stand in two lines, both had people in front of me being waited on, then when I got to the front, both times, both staff members simply turned away and went on to do other things as though I was literally invisible. I have never seen anything like it! And to make it worse, there was a third 'floater' who was moving between the two pay stations doing nothing at all. I finally asked him "Can I please pay for this?" and was greeted with an expression of how could I possibly ask that kind of question - then as though it was obvious, suggested I go back to the first station where there was an employee working. When I went there, she had her back to the register and was not about to turn around anytime soon, so I had to ask her "Can I please pay for this?" to which she turned around and looked at me like that was quite a question to ask! It was all very bizarre and while the food itself can be good at times, I just can't get beyond the totally disaffected employees they hire who are all college students with chips on their shoulders - or at the very least, totally disconnected socially with no social skills of any kind. I am in sales and can't believe a business runs with people like this making the impression on behalf of the owner's vision and efforts. Amazing. And, you can't even email them as their website has no email address - I guess they're just 'that cool'... enough. Go somewhere else where your business (and money) are appreciated and not expected.

What a wonderful experience for my tastebuds. Relaxing environment, great food choices! My gluten free meat lover breakfast was perfectly prepared, and my Matcha latte was creamy and delicious. I highly recommend this place if you're looking for plentiful and healthy options. 
This is a very kid-friendly establishment as well. My kids love the gluten free pancakes and salad bar. The outdoor seating is lovely if you can get a table, and in the fall they spice up their tea options to include flavors like pina colada oolong tea. Mmm! I highly recommend Savoy!

My boyfriend and I were passing through Santa Barbara on our way up the coast, and we were craving some delicious breakfast sandwiches.  He discovered this place on la.eater.com and we decided to give it a shot.  What a delightful and tasty experience!  It was one of the best breakfasts I've had in a while.

The cafe is really adorable and offers plenty of seating.  I like how you order at the counter first, so you can just grab a quick snack or a coffee when you're in a hurry.  It was pretty busy, but the people working behind the counter were fast and really helpful.  In addition to offering a nice sandwich selection, they also have baked goods (which looked incredible) and a wide variety of salads in their deli case.  I ordered the breakfast sandwich, with scrambled egg, cheese and tomato on sourdough bread, and I asked them to add chipotle aioli instead of mustard and mayo.  My boyfriend had the chicken sandwich, which had pesto sauce and was on a ciabatta roll.  To drink, I had a chai tea latte.  The latte was heavy on the ginger and overly spiced, so it wasn't really my thing, but it was made well, with the milk being frothy and perfectly hot.  I just wanted it to be a bit more mild on the spice.  However, the sandwiches were incredible!!  Very flavorful, good quality, fresh bread and beautifully assembled.
