When it comes to egg sandwiches, I am almost always disappointed, for two reasons: the sandwich is dry and the eggs are overcooked.  Definitely not the case here.  My boyfriend and I gobbled up our food in no time, upon which we felt a moment of despondency when we realized our meal was over.

I'm so sad that I don't live near SB, because I would frequent this place daily and try everything they have to offer.  They even have a lovely selection of wines to choose from.  Highly recommend this cafe!!

Lovely, comfortable place to eat, grab coffee or tea or go through a salad bar. They even have a selection of to-go food, pastries, drinks like bottled tea and kombucha. 

I ordered the Benedict and they were kind enough to swap out the bread for a bed of sautéed spinach which was nice of them to accommodate. The dish was ok, nothing to write home about, although the ham was very good and moist. It came with a large salad so the meal portion was very decent.

I ordered a matcha latte which is probably the worst I've ever had- watery and the coconut milk was hardly frothed. The matcha tea also didn't seem very good.

But I give them applause for an almost all-organic ingredient list, a menu that appeals to a wide variety of people, and a charming atmosphere. 

I will probably be back, I just won't order my favorite drink (matcha latte) and will try something else on the men

9-29-18

Stopped in for lunch and a big thank you goes out to Phil? the general manager. I was hoping for breakfast but missed it and was having a hard time finding something to eat since I avoid so many things that were incorporated into the deli case items. He was very patient, answered all my questions and let me know he would find me something to eat. At last he recommended a burrito in a bowl, ditching the tortilla and swapping out tofu for chicken and grilled veggies instead of quinoa. I received a hot bowl of delicious veggies, yam, chicken, spiced and topped with avocado.

I always go here when I'm in Santa Barbara! Cute place to grab stuff to go or when you're with people who disagree on where to eat. A variety of options especially for people with food restrictions! I love the Vegan Burrito, make your own salad bar, and sandwiches! Amazing gluten free pastries as well.
Wonderful Gluten Free menu. The GF french toast was so nice and moist. We always stop here when in SB as their food is fresh, and tasty and even organic!

If you want to experience the best kept secret for dining with a vegan (I'm not) hunt down Savoy Cafe & Deli! I had the best better than home cooked Huevos Rancheros. They use all organic ingredients, they even have "campfire" toast cooked over open flames, house made gluten free bread to die for! 
The ambiance with outdoor seating sets the perfect mood for your dining experience. Staff is quick and super friendly. Don't pass this experience up! I'll be back tomorrow!!!

Really bummed. Had heard great things about this joint and was excited to check it out. I ordered the Quiche Lorraine and a side of Tabbouleh and GT's Cosmic Cranberry Kombucha. The Kombucha was great as usual. The Tabbouleh was bland and dry and the gal assisting me, very dry too apparently, heated up the Broccoli Quiche instead of the Lorraine. Being an easy going guy, I told her I'd try the Broccoli to make things easier. I had a couple of bites. It was bland and over cooked. I decided it was unacceptable. Went back in and gently shared my experience with the server who assisted me. She curtly provided me with the slice I originally asked for and asked for payment full payment for the new slice. I payed without a flinch. It was better. My experience on the whole was not great. Too bad. It seems like this place has potential. Plenty of other fabulous places to enjoy in sunny Santa Barbara.

Savoy is great and I love it, BUT beware if you have celiac, this place is not actually gluten free. They have "gluten free" items but do not prep them separately so you will have a problem on your hands unless you're just playing around with the whole gluten free thing. 

That being said, their food is fantastic, menu selection is enormous. Better prepared foods than Whole Foods and you get to support a local business. Not sure what you want for lunch? Savoy has everything you can think of and probably more. Fresh made desserts and a salad bar are just a few highlights of what this spot has to offer.

Savoy, step it up in one area if you're going to claim having gluten free options. Other than that, I love you.

Simply fantastic. We found this spot just from seeing the back door open, did a quick Yelp review, and knew we needed to give it a try. The ideal local, quaint spot. Their extensive gluten free menu was a huge win for me. The GF citrus dipped French toast was good, but the huevos rancheros was phenomenal.  We'll be grabbing some baked goods from their vast selection on our way out. Highly recommend this spot!

Genuinely good quality food and great service. I have loved eating at Savoy for years. It reminds me a little village shop that I found in England because it has lots a great ready-made food to dine in or take away, but also lots of stuff for the fridge and pantry, in case you want to pick up a few items while you're grabbing lunch. They sell dried pasta, grains, loaves of bread (including amazing gluten free options), cured meats, juices, wine and a lot more. This is definitely one of my favorite spots in all of Santa Barbara. The breakfast menu is my favorite!

This is one of my favorite spots in SB! As a young and busy college student, when I want some home cooked and healthy food, this is my go-to. The options here aren't like any other place I have ever seen. Over the course of my visits, a couple memorable dishes are: the Lorraine's sandwich - a vegetarian option full of fresh and crunchy veggies and the turkey fritter that comes with chipotle sauce (SO GOOD). I have tried various sides and they are all so good and the desserts are the perfect end to the meal. The coffee is also great! This is an easy place to spend some time at and the staff has always been so friendly and provided great service. Also, since covid times, there is online ordering which is super helpful as well. Go here, again and again, you won't regret it.

Quaint little deli in Santa Barbara on Figueroa St. 
Chicken Enchilada & Beef Stroganoff were the Choices for lunch topped off with an amazing piece of Carrot Cake! 
The Stroganoff was creamy loaded with tender beef cubes and mushrooms & farfalle
The Chicken Enchilada was large & stuffed with chicken and just the right amount of jalapeños to spice it up plenty of cheese and served hot!
A coke and a Latte for drinks!
What a relaxing lunch we had and a great conversation with Kathy really brought our the hospitality and homeliness of the Savoy! 
Highly recommend you visit this little deli!
They also have a nice wine selection if you choose to pick up a bottle or two!

Real good, fresh food here.

 I had the Gibraltar sandwich and yes it was almost as big as that rock, but way tastier!

Nice and friendly folks running the place too!

I waited for 10 minutes standing at the coffee counter waiting for eye contact to order a coffee. I was ignored by three employees standing behind the door. One of them was so abnormally intetested in telling these two people about S.B. as though he wanted group sex with them. All i wanted was a cup of coffee.

Never got my food. But all the white people did. Wouldn't want to support a place that is so unorganized that they didn't notice us. But did notice all the white customers that came after me. Guess people of color don't matter here.

Stopped by in for lunch, got the turkey fritter with the blueberry kale salad as a side. Both were DELICIOUS!!! Turkey fritter was very tasteful, had a amazing sauce dip. Blueberry kale salad is my new favorite salad. GF got the salmon and she said it was one if the best cooked salmons she has ever had
Savoy Is a great place to grab a quick salad or sandwich. They have a nice outdoor patio in the back, great food selection and friendly staff.

Ok. So, we decided to have lunch here since it was on Diners, Dine-ins, & Dives. It was a disappointment. I will say that the Turkey fritter that was tasted by Guy on the show was tasty. If I had been able to eat it hot like Guy did, I probably would have loved it as much as he did. This is a deli though, so all is pre-made and heated when ordered. Unfortunately, it isn't heated as hot as I would prefer and definitely not as hot as my mom (whom we call "fire mouth") would like.

The turkey fritter has very good flavor. The Pasilla chilis and onions combine well with the turkey.  I wished I had only gotten two of those and not gotten the rest of the "Guy Plate". the Guy Plate costs $13.95 and comes with cold mango quinoa, cold pesto green beans, and a small piece of carrot cake.  The quinoa was a nice treat on a somewhat hot day, but the green beans were crunchy and bland.  was surprised I didn't like them since I love green beans, The carrot cake was one of the better carrot cakes I have had.

We also got a cup of chicken curry which is sold by weight ($6 per half pound..I'm guessing they know that $12 per pound would shock most).  It had big chunks of carrots and zucchini.  It had a really good flavor, but was barely warm. I'm not sure if their thermostat is not working or what. A cup cost over $6, so I'm not sure it was worth it since I  can get much more curry (and very good curry) at Thai Place at home for the same. I haven't tried Thai on this visit to SB, so I don't know about here.

I would suggest that if you want to go here to try a Triple D place, then just grab a turkey fritter and check it off your list. Otherwise, it is not worth the cost.

Fresh and healthy food. 
Recommend for a quick lunch or snack in town. 
The outdoor is pretty.

Stopped by Savoy for a little dessert snack & I ended up buying stuff I really needed.  I purchased gloves, masks, sanitizer, peach jam, cute butterfly cookie and chocolate muffin.  I'm planning to go back for a dinner & bottle of wine to go soon.  Their beef stroganoff is delicious!

I like the food here and think the service is excellent. i have but one complaint: I wish i could enjoy that back patio. but they usually blare loud crummy old music and i can't eat or converse with that going on. can you get some cool, up-to-date, mellow grooves -so me and my friends can eat out there again?

well i tried the patio and the music was nicer and not too loud. but i don't have much luck with this place. a metal sign fell off a shelf and hit me on the head. omg.

Keto brownies for the win!!! I used to eat here at least 4 times a week and i stopped when I started my keto journey. Since they have paleo dessert options I thought maybe they'd start accommodating keto at one point in their pastry case and I finally called yesterday and THEY DO!! So, so happy  thank you savoy

The food is tasty. The Kale salad has a decadent citrus flavor and the Turkey fritter is delicious. 

I would continue frequenting this place because I live so close by.  However, the other day I had a terrible experience with one of the owners sons.  This high school boy, who identified himself as the owners' son was talking to his friend at one of the tables about a lesbian classmate of his at the high school he attends.  He told his friend she was such a "dy@#" and she was going to burn in "h#$%" .  I asked him why he was saying this and he told me to "f$#%" off.  "I am the owners' son" he said.  I proceeded to leave the place because I did not want to get myself in trouble with this teenager. As I left I heard him talking about how much he hated his liberal classmates at school and how he wished Santa Barbara was more supportive of Tr#$% supporters like himself.  

I can't believe how such an organic, kosher, free-range, natural, tasty place would have owners that are so intolerant.  I won't be going there again.

This was our first time here. We wanted to try a gluten free and egg free restaurant. This did not disappoint. The staff was friendly and helpful. They answered questions and helped us with our food allergies. The coffee was great. 

I made the gluten free French Toast. It was covered with fresh berries and served with syrup, butter and jam. I ordered a side of sausage. My sister enjoyed her potatoes, bacon and sourdough toast. My husband enjoyed his eggs, sausage and sourdough toast. 

They also have gluten free baked options, vegan and paleo baked goods!! We had the peanut butter cookies and paleo brownie. 

I highly recommend coming here.

Savoy is a staple Santa Barbara restaurant that has never let me down. There's a combination of deli style food as well as made to order, but the deli case is always delicious. 

 A few personal favorites are the sides of macaroni and cheese, the quiches, and turkey fritters! Beyond the amazing deli case, they have some absolutely outstanding baked goods. The carrot cake is one of a kind and stands out amongst the deserts available downtown. 

It's a bustling spot, but the line goes quick and the food is always worth it

Nothing says Santa Barbara more than organic ingredients, fresh brewed coffee, yoga pants, and plants on a wall. Savoy is all of those things, nestled downtown next to a corepower yoga studio and other small hole-in-the wall restaurants. 

The set up is like a market: so be forewarned to not expect a hostess leading you to a table and a waiter taking care of you after - you have to pretty much figure out how to order by observing what everyone else is doing. The back of the cafe is the wine, to the left of that is the bakery, and in front is where to order food/drinks. 

I came here for brunch on the Saturday of the SB Film Festival, so it was a chaotic mad house crowd of people, but we finally sat down after ordering and calmed down. The breakfast burritos are made with fresh ingredients, and it had a sense of a farm to table charm, the coffee was strong and the chai was well made. 

It can get pretty warm in here when there are a lot of people and the sun is out, so be prepped to sweat. But it usually doesn't matter because you might just be among others dressed in yoga/pilates attire who swung by for a bite after their morning yoga/pilates routine. Santa Barbara thanks you, Savoy Cafe!
We drove up from LA just to try the turkey fritter... it did not disappoint. The vibe is laid back local.  If you're in a hurry pack it to go.  Otherwise sit back and relax and enjoy!

Gluten free and dairy light eater. 

This place has options for cold salads, lettuce style salads, hot and cold sandwiches. I loved everything about this. 

I got gluten free white bread with smashed avocado and chicken. It was so tasty. I was quite full. It felt like a good portion even without a side. 

My husband got a portobello sandwich and he raved about it. We got gluten free snickerdoodles and had them before lunch. 

I really didn't think the snickerdoodles tasted like their gluten counter part. But they were tasty. 

The bread was good. And holds up okay when toasted. I bought a loaf and it is pretty dense as most gluten free breads are. But has good flavor. 

Overall a good experience.

Santa Barbara's sweetest, all around best place!  
Locally owned.
Almost everything is organic and local. 
Cozy, homey, clean, consistent, and comfortable. 
There is something for everyone here, whether you are Paleo, vegan, vegetarian, or carnivore.   Open everyday for  breakfast, lunch, dinner, brunch, espresso, 
tea, & wine... you will have a  fine time  no matter if you are solo or meeting with friends~family, etc..
 Especially delightful for anyone who has a sweet tooth too...check out the the full desert display (  gluten free chocolate chip cookies, delicious moist  carrot cake, chocolate buttermilk cake, and much more). 
Eclectic & fresh salad bar with Bragg's & house-made dressings,  nuts and seeds for sprinkling.   
Usually three soups available. 
The deli has nourishing  hot options and a beautiful assortment of salads ( I love the butternut squash and anything made with their awesome pesto). Sandwiches too. 
Breakfast everyday, ( wonderful pancakes and excellent eggs),  from early morn'  until noon and brunch on weekends luxuriously served until mid afternoon.

Lunch is their busiest time. 
Live jazz on some Saturday nights  
Nice back area where dogs are allowed

Everything is good here, really good.

Loved the ambience here and the small market. We got vegan breakfast burritos and coffee while here. The burritos were big but full of quinoa and sweet potatoes. Kind of hard to get a good taste of any one flavor, more tasteless than anything else. I think we would've had better luck with the regular breakfast burritos.
Staff was friendly and it's a very clean place!

A mainstay staple of Santa Barbara for good, wholesome and clean eating. Mostly organic items, thoughtfully prepared and presented. Hands down the best salad bar in town, along with a cold and hot case of delicious foods you can see and even sample! Also many menu items and Kathy's baked goods are not to be missed!!! 
Family owned and staffed along with the most thoughtful, helpful crew that go the extra mile. I have watched many troublesome customers get treated with more patience and care then they deserve, but Savoy serves with a smile and glides along.

Went for brunch with my mom and boyfriend: they each ordered quiche Lorraine with a side salad and I got the eggs Benedict. There was a massive green bug (pictured) in my mom's salad, and the woman who worked their explained the bug's presence by saying "you can't wash organic greens." Absurd. Needless to say, our appetites were curbed by the insect in the salad and they didn't even offer to comp her meal. They offered a free side of berries (I hope you can wash organic berries)

They're breakfast is my favorite around and I love how many gluten free options they have. My only compliant is their coffee is hit or miss. It's really inconsistent and the last time I had their cold brew it was SO bitter. But other than that it's vibes.

I write short reviews, so here it goes:

This place is my favorite place to eat in Santa Barbara.  Fresh, delicious, friendly with something for everyone.  I can't recommend it enough.  Just trust me; they are awesome in all ways.  It is not super cheap, but other than that, I would give 100 stars if I could.  Tip: breakfast burrito is the beeeeeest.

Damn, definitely one of the best salad bar options in Santa Barbara. The salad bar has everything from tofu, salmon, quinoa, chicken, all different type of greens, and veggies.  Usually when I come to Savoy I come straight for the salad bar and make the ultimate salad box, even though it gets me in trouble at times since they weigh it at the counter.  

They also have a full sandwich bar where you can order meals, sides, and desserts.  The zucchini basil muffin is delicious and moist too.  

Honestly, everything here is a good choice.  Healthy, delicious, organic, and good for the soul.

Savoy is a great stop for a healthy meal. It is order at the counter and they have plenty of tables to eat at after you order. They have a salad and soup bar and cold/hot case of already prepared food (ex: chicken, quinoa salad etc) and another case of baked goods (ex: muffins and cookies) for people who don't have a lot of time. This place is great for people with dietary restrictions as they have vegetarian options and gluten free options. They also have a regular menu to pick from (sandwiches, breakfast burritos, eggs etc... ). They have an adorable outdoor patio (which faces the parking lot but it is still cute). There isn't anything that I absolutely love on the menu but it is a great place for breakfast/lunch and there is something for everyone.

VERY LOUD TV~pricy and cold curry dish! The TV was BLASTING at the bar with 2 employees sitting and watching it from the bar~it was so loud my friend and I couldn't hear the music!!!! The restaurant deli is quaint (SMALL) so you can hear the TV no matter what table you pick! I don't remember a huge flat screen tv BLASTING while people enjoy their expensive food...before? TV is new! A month ago the atmosphere was nice~with music and some laughter~a nice feeling~however yesterday the BLASTING TV took over the room! I asked an employee if she could turn down the volume of the TV and IF she turned it down~It didn't work because I could still only hear the TV and not my dinner parter or the music! It was clear that the employees needs come before the customers comfort. Our 2~plates added up to be $20 and my curry dish was very cold. I hoped that I could treat my friend to a special dinner~it turned out that we got 2 TO GO containers and went home to eat our over priced meals...I wouldn't mind getting a beer at the bar but if you want to enjoy a meal~DONT GO TO SAVOY~

I love this place. My favorite thing to get is the grilled salmon with a side of anything! My boyfriend likes getting the curry. We are always happy with our meals and service when we eat here. Oh and the salad bar is the best!

I love Savoy Cafe & Deli! Great salad bar, even better prepared food options. Excellent selection of Gluten Free baked goods that taste every bit as good as their predecessors. Some of my favorite dishes are the Chicken Marsala, Sweet Potato Gratin, Turkey Fritter and GF Chocolate Cupcake. Yum! They are also 2 for 1 on SB Axxess, so bring a date or invite a friend and save! :)

Excellent breakfast with the vegan burrito add black beans and the vegan tofu rancheros. The burrito was wonderful and flavorful with the tortilla bursting with fresh veggies and quinoa. The sauce on the rancheros yummy. Takes awhile since the food is freshly made so don't be in too much of a hurry.
Best breakfast ever! Gluten free pancake, so good! Everything organic and so tasty! Yum!
Great place for the kiddos and us vegans too. Our vegan burritos with the ranchero sauce as recommended were delicious. The non-vegans loved the pancakes and egg sandwich.

The cashier was really tacky and inappropriate in eavesdropping on a private conversation and then laughing about it with a customer. Catering to the new trend of 'paleo' screams desperation. Get an identity and stick with it.

Wanna have some nice flavorful tea in a good relaxing atmosphere?

Then, go to Savoy Cafe & Deli!!

I'm glad that I came here by following the yelpers.

They have a small but beautiful salad bar, soup, deli, cake, many kinds of drinks, and many kinds of tea! You will definitely take a long time to decide what to eat. Actually, I did. The lady who was working at the deli section tried to help me order food, giving me suggestions and a sample.
I finally chose sweet potato gratin and roasted veges, and green tea.

My tea came in a traditional Chinese pot and fancy cup and saucer. Drinking nice tea in a beautiful cup made me feel special. I could forget about tests, assignments whatever hurt me for a while. The food I got was also great. They were seasoned lightly and fresh. Especially I loved the sweet potato. 

Although I spent more money than I had expected, I'm totally satisfied with the experience here. I can't believe that they have only 6 reviews. This place must be a secret place though it's close to State street.

They don't have a private parking, but no worries. There is a huge public parking across the street. 75min FREE!!
Best cafe in Santa Barbara, family owned!!! I would recommend coming here if you are ever close by or even across town, it's the best vibe..

Surprisingly their dishes offer great portions. I had the Beef Stroganoff featuring local grass fed beef with a side of Sweet Potatoes au Gratin and of course a famous House Roasted Turkey Pasilla Fritter - (As Seen on Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives). It was delicious. Take a look at my photo. Enjoy.

Went for a bicycle ride with the wife and decided to stop at Safoy Cafe & Deli, plus had it on my list to try. I was a little worried that it was too foo-foo for me, but I was wrong. When it comes to food I like easy and simple, not a fan of fancy food. They had a lot of of fancy food tho. I ordered a roast beef sandwich on sourdough with mayo, mustard, lettuce, tomato and cucumbers(foo-foo). When it came I got a turkey sandwich . The waitress said they would make me a new sandwich, but I said I'll eat the turkey. I hate to see food wasted. The turkey sandwich was delicious. All the ingredients tasted so fresh. The bread was great.
My wife ordered the Italian wedding soup, the soup was very good, made from scratch. We also got a peanut butter cookie and snickerdoodle cookie, both were very good. I can see why Savoy has such great reviews, all of our food tasted so fresh and delicious.

There's a parking lot directly across the street that's FREE for the first hour and 15 minutes... more than enough time to get in and out. Silverware and napkins are kept on the table so you don't have to worry about grabbing any, just carrying your food. They have many food and drink options( gluten free, vegan). The employees aren't overly friendly and most likely won't reach out if you look like you're needing assistance. Once you start asking the questions they will assist. It was on the pricey side for deli like food. $36 for 2 waters, and 2 entrees each with 2 sides.

The breakfast burrito was hearty, cheesy amazing goodness, the vegan burrito was a little disappointing. I'm not completely vegan but I'll always give vegan options a try if it sounds good, but I kinda felt let down. Ok so back to the breakfast burrito- scrambled eggs, avo, cheese, grilled potatoes, really how much more do you need!! Expertly wrapped in a warm tortilla and pico on the side. Online ordering was super convenient. Vegan burrito- it was scrambled tofu, kale, quinoa, yam. Tbh really needed to work on the seasoning- needs much more salt, pepper etc. when I make scrambled tofu at home, I load it up with nutritional yeast, sometimes Italian seasoning etc. but this was quite bland and sad, I took a few bites and even with pico wasn't super great. I just ended up sharing the breakfast burrito with my hubby. I'm appreciative that they had a vegan option, but why not just do a simple one with potato, avo, tofu and more seasoning? The yam and quinoa were a little distracting esp when bland, even tho I love those flavors in say, a salad. Anyways. Def a good breakfast option to go and next time would try other things on the menu!
Over-priced, average quality, plus deceptive business practices. They literally take Simply Grapefruit juice from the container and fill up plastic bottles to make it seem fresh squeezed. LOL!

Friendliest place in town great food great service! The owners Paul and Kathy go out of their way to make you feel at home and their 4 sons and rest of the staff breakfast served till 2 PM!  Favorites turkey scramble, lasagna eggplant and wild salmon fantastic baked goods try the Gnash brownie carrot cake pumpkin muffin and carrot muffin. The breakfast burrito is served all day! :-)

Best place for a salad bar or great sandwich. They also have amazing scones and great coffee. I go here for my lunch break because it's quick, easy, and yummy. I love the 9 trails sandwich. It's definitely a nice change from the other restaurants off state. I'm glad they're back and the staff is friendly and cool. They also have a back patio where dogs are welcomed!! Go Savoy!

This was a very well run establishment. Except for the fact that the young men were not as diligent as I would have liked with cleaning the tables. Although the owner has a good eye because all of the employees were attractive. The garden scramble was cooked well and tasted good. The vegan breakfast burrito was delicious but too many yams, it was too sweet. The power bowl was excellent but too oily. It was a little on the expensive side. Overall I will return and try some of the other items. Oh, get the orange juice it was fresh and delicious highly recommend!

Delicious huevos rancheros at this downtown spot! Food was fresh and tasty, unique menu, with tons of gluten free options.

Had a dinner here as well- the turkey fritters w the dipping sauce were incredible! I had a side of delicious sweet potatoes and quinoa, and all for a very reasonable price.

During our recent visit to Santa Barbara we wanted to check out few new dining spots as we tend to constantly revisit our favorites, and there are so many choices in that town.  My wife choose Savoy Cafe & Deli which has a nice decor and friendly servers, but unfortunately our food was just not that great. After asking the gentleman taking our order about a few of the breakfast items, he convinced us their Eggs Benidict was a great choice and a favorite.  First, this was not your typical Eggs Benidict.  The Hollandaise sauce is made with Chula hot sauce which sounded great as we love spicy/hot dishes.  It was also the veggie version and was served on a toasted Ciabatta roll.  Well, the sauce had such minimal flavors that we both poured more Chula sauce over the entire Eggs Benidict.  The veggies left much to be desired too.  Had they just used steamed spinach it would have been a far better dish, but instead they said it was a mix of their greens which were basically tasteless, and the veggie serving was surprisingly smaller than the poached egg itself.  To add to our disappointment, the Ciabatta was so hard to cut through it was difficult to keep it on the plate and very frustrating to eat.  We even asked for a steak knife, but they only carry butter knifes.  Unfortunately the last possible saving grace of the meal, the breakfast potatoes, were heavily over salted to the point of being inedible.  Given I paid roughly $30 ($24.86 plus $4 tip)  for two less than satisfying Eggs Benidict's, and drank only water with our meal, I could not help feel I had just been duped out of my hard earned cash.
There are far to many wonderful restaurants in Santa Barbara with really good food to have had and spent what we did on a mediocre food at the Savoy Cafe.
So so so good!  I love their food!  It's my favorite stop in Santa Barbara. Plus the gluten free options are amazing

This place has DELICIOUS food!

I ordered the Guy Special and my boyfriend got the Salmon with the Red Rice salad.  Both were exceptional.  It is pricey, but worth it.

Also, best carrot cake I've ever had!

Great Breakfast. I had the gluten-free French toast and my husband had the huevos rancheros. The toast was tasty with fruit and maple syrup and I could hardly tell it was GF. I also tried the huevos which was delicious. The salsa was light but slightly spicey. The restaurant is light and bright and tons of tasty looking options for all.
They have all kinds of cakes and cookies! I really wanna try all of them! Coffee is ok. Food is also so goooood!
We come up from San Diego quite a bit and "always" stop to eat at Savoy. Great quality, inviting atmosphere, and exceptional service & staff!

We arrived first thing Friday morning with the sun pouring through the glass front window.  The high back wooden chairs and natural wood tables are beautifully welcoming!
The choices of food  can meet anyone's cravings.  The food is counter ordered.  Our family has gluten-free needs and Savoy has many options.  We chose G/F pancakes and they made their Benedict with G/F Bread...Absolutely delicious!!  The staff is very helpful to be sure you get what you crave...ENJOY 
Public parking is available directly connected to the back entrance patio...a must try!!

Racist pigs. I was going to buy two brownies and while he was ringing me up I said I I needed a fork because I was going to taste one before I bought two. There was another type of brownie that I saw that I might want as the second option because the ones I selected said "gluten free" or "vegan" or something like that. He stopped dead in his tracks and said he had to ring me up before giving me the brownie!!! LOL. And when I asked for a manager, he agreed!!! I am still in UTTER disbelief and shock. I've lived in areas that are extremely more affluent than Santa Barbara, and they would have NEVERRRR treated me like that. 

Then, when I was outside, he said "I'm sorry I couldn't give you free food". YES! HE SAID THAT TO MY FACE!!,THE NERVEEEEE! He ACTUALLY told me that he thought I was trying to pull the wool over his eyes and steal food from him. PLEASE go to any of the other bakeries that are in the immediate vicinity if you have any compassion for humanity whatsoever. I can't even begin to describe how absolutely outraged I am.
Great food and service! I don't live in the area, but next time I'm in Santa Barbara,  I will definitely eat there.

Savoy gets me every time! 

While the prices are high, you get high quality food that fills you up and is wholesome. 

I'm a huevos rancheros fiend and Savoy has some of my favorite huevos. They put refried black beans on theirs and the tortillas are tostadas. The beans taste homemade. 

If you're there for sweets, you must try the Chocolate Buttermilk Cake. The frosting to cake ratio is divine. 

Go to meal is the turkey pasilla chile fritter with the Tuscan kale salad and mac & cheese.

I love the quality and the freshness of the ingredients at Savoy. The vegan burrito is the best I have ever had. A perfect blend of flavors and texture from the fresh and warm quinoa, sweet potato, avocado, tofu, and finely chopped kale. Easy to customize and substitute to create a non-vegan as well. Excellent ingredients for a burrito. Even the tortilla screams quality. Delightful flavors and original based on my experience. From vegans to carnivores, this burrito will pass the test every time, across the board. The service is top-notch and very helpful with great attitudes. The front and back outdoor dining areas are very cozy and peaceful. I'm looking foreword to going back and trying other items on the menu in the near future.

Bottom line: The food is good, the vibe is great, the prices are just okay.

I've eaten dinner here a few times now, as well as a few items from their bakery.  I haven't tried any of the sandwiches, just the entrees from the "hot case".  Everything I've had in that department has been quite tasty.  The food has rich flavor and you feel like you're eating something wholesome.

The prices are hit or miss.  The thing is, it's hard to know how much food you're going to get when you order from the hot case.  I think I've figured out a rule of thumb: order the entrees that have the meat chopped up and cooked in pieces, not the ones where you're getting a whole chicken leg or the like.  The reason is that if you get a whole-body-part item, they only give you about the same amount as with a cut-pieces item, but it winds up being less because a lot of it is bone.

That aside, the portions are reasonably sized, but not huge.  I've generally stayed towards the cheaper end of their menu, where you can get a hot entree and a side for about $10 or $11.  The side dishes are good too --- rice, roasted veggies, etc.

The baked goods I've tried (a few muffins of various types) are good, and reasonably priced.  Not being a coffee or wine guy, I have ignored the bar area where they serve coffee in the morning and wine in the evening.  Not being a salad guy, I have ignored their much-vaunted salad bar.  (This may be worth noting, given the preponderance of salad-oriented reviews here: I don't care about salad, but I like Savoy ANYWAY!)

The best thing about this place, though, is the atmosphere.  It's difficult to describe, a combination of quaint rural roadhouse, urban-oasis bistro, and health-conscious hipster hangout.  Each table has a little flower vase on it, next to a metal bucket where you get your silverware and napkins.  You can serve yourself water from pitchers at the front, next to which is a jar of lemon slices to garnish your beverage.  When I was in there the other night, there was live music from a band consisting of an electric guitar and an accordion.  I've come here a few times to meet with clients for consulting sessions; they have free wifi.

All in all, it's just a very comfortable place to hang out.  It would definitely be nice if it was cheaper, but it's definitely possible (for me at least) to have a satisfying experience here without spending too much money.

One of my favorite casual spots for brunch and lunch in Santa Barbara. The best thing on the menu, in my opinion, is the breakfast burrito. So filling, and so delicious. I get it everytime. And the coffee is really good to. If you're looking for a lowkey, casual, tasty spot to grab a bite, sit and read, people watch, then this is your spot. 

Oh, and Guy Fieri came here, so you know that it's Flavor Town!

I love this place, I know I'm going to get healthy yet delicious food, and have a very wide variety of choices. I feel comfortable coming here with a book and having a mocha (which is amazing) or coming here for a hot meal when I don't want to cook or even if I want a quick snack to go. The staff is always friendly and willing to help. The ambiance is great for a daydream believer. I don't usually leave reviews but I think this one deserves it!
A little pricy but really good and super nice staff!

I'm a fan you will be too!! 

It's a lovely place filled with charm and loads of organic yummy-goodness. 

The service is sweet, friendly, and caring. Very much the warmth you would expect from a family run, local food spot. 

I was impressed with the selection of prepared and freshly made food both for lunch and breakfast. 

I love the inside courtyard feel with fresh cut flowers in each table, the bright airy feel, the lovely water fountain, and the soft French music lighting the air with happiness. 

Their salad bar is loaded with organic goodies, an excellent variety, and it's so fresh! 

The deli counter is just packed with bright gorgeous options. 

For the tea lover-- welcome to an excellent selection of fine, organic, delish varieties of green, black, and white teas. 

Before I mention any ideas for improvements lets note more bonus points: free wifi, sea salt on the tables, delish GF bread options, organic ketchup, and seriously sweet service...

Now here's why I only have 4-stars-- the food while good lacks wow factor. I felt the 4 breakfast options I've tried as well as the GF baked bread was on the bland side. I am looking for more explosive flavors and rich tastes. Please season more, add yummyness to your impressive menu of wonderful items to match the incredible feel. Also the fine teas should have a better water temp system, most fine teas require less heat and the flavor of greens especially become bitter when paired with nearly boiling water. 

I know I am being so critical, but the best ones need a lil harsh reality check to improve and live up to their full potential. 

And if anyone think that Whole Foods offers better food selections as one review I read wrote, perhaps your tastes aren't quite so refined... I'll always choose local owned, fresh, organic, and independent over any corporate run greed motivated options!!

Truthfully I am a fan, a big fan and will happily return often and have no problem adding some sea salt to my food and enjoying every last bite...

Savoy is a classic Santa Barbara spot. The energy inside is warm and inviting, with large pictures of the mountains and beach by local artist Chris Potter adorning the walls, and plenty of local products like Bragg vinegar and local beers and wine. 

The food is a traditional deli case style, with an incredible depth of flavor. There is a large selection to choose from for those who may have diet restrictions, and their salad bar prices are comparable or slightly more fair than Whole Foods. 

Personal favorites include the turkey fritter, Mac n cheese, and carrot cake! 

Ps: they're also the best soup spot around!

Savoy is impeccable.  Somehow every single item is delicious and fresh.  I always have a good experience.  The salad bar is for sure the best in the city.  The sandwiches, excellent.  The entrees, you guessed it, so good.  I would recommend them to anyone -- you gotta try it.  Note: closed Sundays!

The food was good, a bit pricey but delicious. We stopped by SB on our way back to the bay and ordered two breakfast burritos, French Toast and the yogurt with granola, The food here is so good and the quality isn't common up north. The female who took our order didnt make our experience so great, i understand we have all have our bad days but they seemed very forced to be there and took our order in a rude manner they also tried to charge us for a sandwhich we never even mentioned for that fact. I dont mean to pull the race card but they somehow couldn't understand my dads slight accent that was very clear asking how many Oz there was in the the cups so he could figure out how many espresso shots to put in. The coffee was filled a little above the halfway mark, the cup was small and for 5 dollars you atleast expect your cup to be filled at almost the rim. There was another person working and they were a male and they were very polite, wish they would've taken our order instead.

Awesome little hangout joint with a very wide variety of selection from coffees and fridge drinks fresh made foods and salad bars! I have loved everything I have tried here and would recommend the Chicken Marsala and/or going for the salad bar. 

The matcha green tea is always quite delicious, as well. 

Only concern is that it is extremely pricey BUT you get what you pay for and there is a wide variety of organic, GF and vegan as well.

Wanted brunch for my last day in SB. Finch & Fork was closed so this cute cafe was our next bet! Parking was free for us(?) not sure about other people. There's a big lot so that's convenient. 

First impression was how home-y it felt, but also how confusing it looked. You got a winery, a coffee bar, a little market, and a brunch place all in one which is super convenient! But the system to order food was very funky. The cashier who took our order seemed very forgetful and almost hungover. He asked me many times what I wanted and couldn't finish getting my boyfriend's order in without forgetting to ask him something about his order. That part met me oddly, so we sat and waited for our food. They forgot to give me my side of fruit as pictured so I had to go and ask for it. Thankfully they didn't charge me or question me because that would've been a hassle.

The sauce on the eggs benny was very sour and vinegar-y to the point where I had to scrape it off. I personally didn't enjoy my food, but my boyfriend ordered more after. Their fresh OJ is really good too. Highly recommend that despite the price for a small glass! I give it a 4 stars for the half and half review!

I tried Savoy because my friend Julie highly recommended it.  I must say, my quest for the perfect carrot cake is over!  Additionally, the Handlebar Roasters coffee they brew is somehow much better than at Handlebar itself!!  I'm in!

FRESH FRESH FRESH! We got the Guy's Plate and the folks behind the counter were extremely attentive and helpful. The turkey fritter was perfection and the green beans and quinoa were flavorful. This is an awesome choice to grab a bite! And the ambiance is cute.

Absolutely tasteless vegan breakfast scramble served with a bottle of flaming hot sauce.  I guess it's supposed to be served raw.  I took 2 small bites and couldn't choke down anymore.  The server never bothered to ask how was the dish.  I'll tell you how it was....inedible.  A complete waste of $27.

There are several of our favorites on Figueroa including Gino's. We hit Savoy for lunch. You order from an extensive menu then can sit inside or outside on a parkette. The service was friendly and the hard-working crew brought out our meal quickly. I enjoyed my ok sized but very flavorful pastrami sandwich. I just wished there was more to it. My wife enjoyed her turkey fritter. It tasted like thanksgiving. I also got to try the sub sandwich and it was very good. SB is a good sandwich town. There is lots of competition. We will return to Savoy.

So good, that we went for breakfast and then again for lunch.

We really loved the gluten-free bread options. I have not had a sandwich in a long time.  It was so thick with turkey!

A very lovely restaurant with a salad bar (yes, really), open space, nice outdoor seating, and a comfortable bar area.

I shouldn't be reviewing this place because:

1. I'm Latina so, I like food with flavor. ( That's no on the tarragon potato salad with raisins and celery PLEASE, Susan) 
2. I prefer food that isn't overpriced. 

I will be gaining haters because for some reason people in SB loveeee this place but, why- I can't say? Seriously? $20 for a bland veggie sandwich, a deli side and a drink?

I mean the food is nothing special and it's your basic order at the cashier type of spot. I gave 3 stars for the variety, and because it's a local spot. This is huge- I will choose to buy local whenever I can and definitely appreciate the plentiful drink options and pre-made sides to choose from. But it's a deli. There are way better ones in LA and NYC ( and even a couple blocks up Chapala). I get that this is SB and I'm reviewing Savoy- not those other places, but I can't help but compare when I'm over paying for food that's better elsewhere. I guess people in Santa Barbara haven't had much better and it shows because they'll pay whatever the cost for basic grab and go food. 

That being said, if you have time there are a made-to-order breakfast that is nice- but the line and bustle of my morning stop in have prevented me from trying it. Calling in ahead of time has not been successful for me either so I stick with the deli-case and sandwiches which are just very average. The salad bar is cool- but I prefer Lazies due to price.  

Despite the absence of flavor and lack of any uniqueness- Savoy Deli tries their best and generally, the food is home-made. All in all Savoy Cafe does just fine but the prices are lame for what you get. It's good if you don't mind the price and just want variety. If this is the case- try Savoy Deli, you won't be disappointed. 

The lattes are nice but pricey. Gluten-free and Vegan options available.

I have been coming here for 15 years or so. They've always had a fantastic salad bar, deli items, coffee and they're run by a very nice family. Since I became vegan 5 years ago it's my top place to go as they have plenty of really healthy options.

As a Santa Barbara local, I'm happy to have tried this place out for the first time today. Better late than never!

This restaurant is located in a great part of downtown Santa Barbara. It's in the heart of town, just off State Street but still close enough to be near all the action. 

The place is large and very clean. It's decorated well and is quite appealing with its fresh pre-prepared salads on display. There isn't a traditional posted menu, per se, but the counter staff were great about helping my first-time self navigate through the process. 

I ended up ordering their pastrami sandwich (coincidentally, they are located next door to Norton's Pastrami which is the most prominent of its kind in town), along with a side order of their pesto green beans. The pastrami held its own and was prepared very well. The green beans were great as well. I never would have thought to pair pesto with legumes but the combination worked well!
 
This is a great lunch place and I will be back!

Service is great, my French toast was amazing and the chai cookie was fabulous. I got the gluten free mint cookie and corn muffin. They were dry BUT gluten free foods are tough to get right. The coffee was good and the restaurant was cute. I have to say the staff and service there was amazing even though they were so busy.  I enjoyed this restaurant allot and would come back and try the other goodies.  Ohhhhh the Bacon was
Sooooooo gooooooood
Great coffee. Great service. Great vibe. This is the type of coffee shop that gives you the time of day to relax and contemplate over a good cup of joe.

This place easily became my favorite coffee and breakfast spot. Yummy delicious coffee and iced tea. Their breakfast sandwiches are to die for...candy maple something bacon was heaven on a plate! Super friendly staff too.

The single star here I'm giving to the staff, they we're perfectly nice. My problem is that this cafe exemplifies a trend that makes me *livid*; businesses who adopt the minimalist/rustic/modern hippie aesthetic by using "humble"materials and re-claimed wood, trendy branding and hiring some lightly tattooed staff. Yes, it all looks good. But it's utter BULLSHIT if the business doesn't actual care about the issues people who started these trends care about.
Maybe dial back the effort on "branding and interior design" and look into "sustainability and climate change". By the way, I'm not mad at super chic establishments who look gorgeous but  back it up with action. Cafe Gratitude is obnoxiously on-trend/good-looking/pricey - but they walk the walk.

I checked this place out pretty early on a Friday about a week after they opened. I walked in to meet a friendly barista and no line. Prices were standard for high-end coffee. 

The barista put together an expertly crafted latte the way lattes should be-- no scalding on the milk and espresso drawn at just the right temperature. 

For breakfast, I just had their toast and jam. It was thick-sliced, pre-buttered, and pre-jammed with my choice of strawberry jam. All top notch ingredients. 

They have a coffee-roasting model where they rotate through different roasters from different geographies. The espresso they were making when I was there was a Populace Coffee from Michigan, and they were almost out of that and moving to a coffee from Portland, OR. Curated roasting styles seems like a fun way to try different styles; looking forward to it!

Great coffee and cold brew. The breakfast options are delicious. And for those interested in reducing their waste they are a very good option. 

The location is great. Atmosphere is relaxed. Probably my new favorite coffee place

Stopped in for a quick breakfast before leaving Santa Barbara after passing through for the night. Delicious coffee, yummy sandwich (I had the BTA), and super friendly service! Indoor and outdoor seating available, and the decor is very chill.

REBAR, WHAT IS GOING ON!!!!! 

You had the best cold brew in town!  I was willing to spend $4+ dollars every weekend morning after yoga.  The Iced Vanilla Lattes were amazing, and then the last two times it tastes nothing like vanilla or latte or even coffee.  I actually threw both away.  The first time I thought it was a fluke, but then it was exactly the same the next time. Let's fix whatever is happening, but until then, I guess I have to find a new place for my weekend coffee.
Great service and delicious food. Nice little place we flown in from the uk and couldnt  expected any more frkm them thumbs up

Stopped by in the morning (traveling through Santa Barbara) I am overwhelmed by all the "goodz". It has everything I love: wonderful friendly staff, cool ambiance, fast internet, outside patio, huge window so that you can sit inside and see the view, great coffee (Stumptown) and the food is delish.The guy at the bar was very helpful and offered advice on what other places to check out in the area. :) Additional thanks to him (sorry didn't get the name)! Service was fast too.
Oh, almost forgot! THE MUSIC was totally up my alley. It was kind of hard to work since I kept distracting myself and using Shazam hah. Anyway, 5 stars overall! Love love love!!

Really good spot. Recommended by my brother-in-law. Breakfast is great. They were out of the cinnamon buns, but that's probably for the better of my waistline. Da wife got the bacon, egg, avocado sandwich, and she loved it. I got the sausage, egg sandwich and it was delish. The bun has a sweet flavor to it. The egg was cooked over-easy, and was delish, with the yoke dropping all over everything. I ended up going knife/fork on it. Both sandwiches are garnished with fresh fruit...refreshing. Da wife says the vanilla latte was great. Outdoor seating is wonderful. Building is beautiful and well decorated. Great location...close to the shoreline. Staff was kind. Great, relaxing spot. Worth a second visit.

it was very good, not great.  We came here around 11am on a Sunday, ordered the bacon egg and avocado breakfast sandwich and the lemon pancakes.  Also a black coffee and a vanilla latte.  Latte was great, black coffee was nothing special.  the sandwich was good but the ketchup on it was weird, I would have much rather preferred and aioli or a different mayo based sauce.  The lemon pancakes were pretty good, could definitely use more lemon flavor, but they were light and fluffy and yummy.

There wasn't any seating inside, so we sat outside but it was a bit cold.  The décor was kind of all over the place, but it was kind of cool and had a good vibe.

The bathroom was very odd... two toilets literally 2 feet apart from each other.  It was clean, but it was probably originally a two seater with stalls but the stalls were most likely removed and it became a single seater.  It was odd.

I would recommend for a nice brunch.  And bring your doggy because there were tons here!

Cute and trendy place to get coffee - and they have kombucha on tap! The cold brew vanilla latte was yummy, but a little sweet for my tastes, even with half the normal sweetener added. There is a good amount of seating and pretty extensive food menu for a place that's also a coffee shop, and it's extremely close to the pier and beach so the location is great.

I got the rebar smoothie that tasted really terrible, which wouldn't have been an issue with me but when I tried to exchange it for something more preferable, like toast, the guy that worked there said they don't do exchanges if it's the way it's supposed to taste. He stuck a straw into the drink and pulled smoothie out to taste, he said it was the way it was supposed to taste so he wouldn't let me have anything in exchange. It got even worse when he said that if you go into a restaurant and order a steak, that you cannot exchange a steak if you don't like it. Let me just say that I worked in a restaurant and there is no limit to what people exchange, and if it's a good place, they will do the exchange to make there customer happy. I told him he could throw away that smoothie because I really hated it. It was the worst smoothie I've ever tasted. I rarely use my Yelp account, but it really upset me and I wouldn't want anyone else to be victim to this.

Wow, what a coffee joint . This place is awesome, warm interior design, and the coffee is great. Never thought I would fall in love with a breakfast and which but the Ruben (I believe that's what it was called ) with arugula , was magnificent! Service is an A+
Great Irish cofffee. Good spot to wait the next train.

Rebar had THE BEST breakfast in Santa Barbara!! The bacon egg sandwich is amazing!! Ali is  awesome! She is very engaging with customers and friendly. The cold brew vanilla latte was also great! I will definitely be going back next time in town!

I'm a coffee enthusiast, and Rebar's cold brew was some of the best I've tried! Their Colombian Cold Brew is consistently fantastic, and the service is friendly. Also it's a neat location with a great interior design, and it's very close to the Harbor. The one down side is their operation hours, since they do close pretty early...

Beautiful espresso,  the most delicious coffee, up there with Italy, the cold brew is so good, I highly recommend you get some in your mouth ASAP:) management is eager to please and takes pride in the quality and service which is an added bonus to the super yummy food and coffee. Clean and kid friendly which made it my favorite stop on state Street since I had the little one with me.  Was able to get right off the state st shuttle in front of the place so we actually made it our recharging station, a nice break from the SB madness. Thanks guys, be back soon for some of that rebar roast!

Stumbled across this place while looking for somewhere to grab coffee and study. The ambience is just what I was looking for: a place with quality coffee, good music, and great people. Rafael was super cool in asking what I like and had solid recommendations for what I should try. Needless to say, you won't leave this place disappointed, and your first cup of coffee here certainly won't be your last.

The coffee is very good, as they have many on tap, cold brewed coffee's available. 

I don't recommend trying to fill up a growler here as it is crazy expensive and SB roasting company has a good cold brew for cheaper. 

If I did the math right 12oz cold brew refugio costed me $3.00 plus tax so around $3.24. So a growler having 64oz I figured it would cost around $15-$18 pretax.

The lady behind the counter charged be $21 dollars plus tax. I did get my growler filled anyways since I was already there, but I can go next door to Figueroa Mountain Brewery and get a wonderful IIPA Lizard's mouth filled for 18 dollars in the Growler I bought from them. 

Really enjoy the coffee but the pricing scheme seems out of touch.

Rebar is the BEST! Ive been 5 or 6 times now and the food is always perfectly cooked, comes out hot, fresh, and delicious! They have a cool indoor area and relaxing patio as well. A lot of their stuff is house made (like the bagels!) or locally sourced and the workers are always super friendly! Great loose lead tea selection, they have beer and wine too. I cant think of anything to suggest for improvements. I've been all around town in search of the best breakfast place and can surely say this is it!

I had the avocado toast with tomato and arugula instead of egg, with a vanilla latte with almond milk. My husband had the breakfast sandwich. Everything was greasy and delicious. The atmosphere is laid back. Everything is clean.

Finally a coffee shop for the West Beach/lower State neighborhood! Ever since Hot Spots closed in the wake of (never ending) La Entrada construction, this area has been devoid of any coffee presence. Pleasantly surprised to stop in today, enjoy a draft cold brew coffee and the AC on this warm "winter" day. Friendly service, too. Glad the Funk Zone is getting more offerings to round out the glut of wineries.

The food is nothing to write home about, though the coffee is very good.  

The customer service truly leaves me with a bad taste.  While the cashier was very nice, the barista (dark haired, moving to LA soon) was incredibly rude and demeaning.  I asked for the Colombian Cold Brew, as it sounded the closest to a typical cup of Joe, then realized that it was iced and changed my order.  Though the coffee was not yet poured, this barista clearly showed her frustration with me and then condescendingly told me, "Cold brew means it's cold."  While this sure does make sense, this is a town of tourists who aren't coffee connoisseurs, and there was no explanation to be had on the menu board.  Not the most down to earth place I've been around here.
Horrible experience.  They have one menu that  everyone has to fight over and they were out of half the stuff on the menu.  No wonder the place was empty.  Won't be back.

Hands down the worst overpriced espresso ever,. Just know when you ask for a double shot you are getting one. One shot of espresso is one ounce, i asked for 2 shots and i got 1 ounce .  employees were snobby and seemed put out by anything asked of  them. Will never go back

Coffee is very delicious! ...but the service was slow and I was given the wrong drink twice. Bathrooms were in rough shape and install PURSE HOOKS in the bathroom, please!!! Dirty floors and wet countertops give us no options.

Rebar Egg Sandwich - BEST VEGETARIAN BREAKFAST SANDWICH IN SB! Hands down. So bomb. Must try! Consistent amazing service and high quality/house made/locally sourced ingredients and menu items. I am a breakfast foodie/critic at times, and I am addicted to this place!

This venue is pretty tiny, but the sand which was amazing and I love how they serve all day breakfast and have great coffee. It's a nice little shop to stop in and have breakfast and coffee or just stop for coffee
Found by accident and so glad we did. The Bacon egg sandwich and French Toast were so good.  Will be back next time we are in SB
Their coffee cocktails are expertly  made! The service is impeccable! I highly recommended this place!

The first time I went, I tried their sweet vanilla cold brew on draught, and it was so good that I got it the second time I went as well. When my partner spilled his coffee all over the table and floor, they quickly swooped in to clean it up and were so nice to offer to re-fill his cup. The space is great- there are a few tables inside a space with high wood beamed ceilings, as well as picnic style tables and benches outside that are shared, along with a kitchen and restroom, with the adjoining restaurant.

Really great coffee shop! Casual yet classy breakfast, lunch beer and wine. Everything is great at this  place, but you gotta have the Chia Seed porridge - it's amazing and fills you with energy all day. Rebar is a relatively unknown gem in the funk zone. I hope you love it too and we can keep them in business. Easy parking but for some reason this location has been tricky for past restauranteurs, go Rebar!
I'm pretty sure the phrase BOMB.COM originated here. Perfect spot for a light breakfast or snack any time of the day.

The BEST hands down!  Their almond milk lattes are the best I've ever had - period. And the homemade butterscotch syrup they have is the "icing" on the cup. Their egg sandwiches are delicious as well. I highly recommend this place.

This is the first negative Yelp review I give. I came to 'Rebar' after hearing good things about the place. I got a double shot of espresso, for here, which comes out to over $4.00 and this is how it was served to me. I've been to many coffee shops around the world and this is by far the worst experience I've had. Deeply disappointed. I don't know which was worse; the service, the price or the espresso itself. Save yourself the time and money. Check the photo I posted of their double shot. Rebar, this is terrible.

I wasn't particularly a fan of this place. High prices for low flavor.

And they don't have a bathroom.

Very nice and friendly barista early on a Sunday morning. Great outdoor seating and vanilla cold brew latte. Sausage, egg and cheese breakfast sandwich was great but if you don't like runny yokes you better tell them.

This place is horrible. If there was an option for negative stars that's what they would've received from me. The service just sucks. Kylie C. Needs a lesson in customer service. I stood at the counter for 10 minutes to get more coffee just for her to ignore me and help other people. When I was finally helped the attitude was crap. I'd say you would be better off going to Starbucks, or better yet go to McDonalds, either place would at least give you better service and is way cheaper.
Best vanilla cold brew coffee I have ever had - enough said.
Nice choice of Cold Brew Coffee on tap and some yummy breakfast sandwhiches. We were staying around the corner and happened to stumble upon Rebar on our search for java.
Food is good and fresh, as is coffee, but the service is really slow. Not the servers fault but only ever one person behind the counter.

Great coffee shop! Rebar is at the top of my list of goto coffee spots. The atmosphere is great with both indoor and outdoor seating, which makes taking dogs here a joy. 

I highly recommend the coffees on draft; they offer straight iced coffee as well as lattes and other drinks. Haven't yet enjoyed too much of the food, but the Bacon Avocado Egg Sandwich is a mmm mmm good! 

Rebar is a great addition to the funk zone. Check it out!

Great coffee. Cold brew excellent, especially coco puff infused creamer. 

But their delays on food order list are ridiculous. Waited thirty minutes for egg sandwich and toast. They seemed overwhelmed. Provided no notice to customers of potential delay. If you're thinking of ordering food, ask how long the wait will be ahead of time

I liked Rebar. The position is cool (on State near the beach), the outside patio is nice, service was gentle with a smile and some chats. The burger with egg, bacon and avocado was actually awesome. The muffin was okay. I loved the jar of orange juice. The cappuccino... honestly, I had better. Much better. But I'm Italian so I'm biased :-)

All in all, great spot for breakfast!

Food - recommend their avocado toast and ricotta toast with strawberry and apricot jam 

Ambience - cute little coffee shop with outside patio seating

Location - fairly close to the wharf. Parking lot is next to it and street parking is also available

I was visiting Santa Barbara with the girls and we were trying to find a coffee shop to grab a light breakfast! We were pleasantly surprised with the food and drinks! I had an egg, bacon and avocado sandwich and it was so delicious! I also drank a hot chocolate and that was so delicious too! The girls had coffee drinks and they each loved them all! A nice change of pace from Starbucks... Would def come back in if I was in the area!

Stopped by this cute little place on Christmas Eve when I needed caffeine. I absolutely loved the atmosphere and interior design (that brick wall though)! The barista was very friendly. I enjoyed our conversation so as my handcrafted butterscotch latte and yummy cinnamon roll. Will definitely return when I visit Santa Barbara again :)

It's October... Every single coffee place has seasonal flavors. Where is our pumpkin? Come on rebar. Keep your customers happy. Who doesn't have pumpkin coffee in October? You have had the same things on your chalkboard for months. A little creativity would be nice...
Such a cute coffee place! Staff was super friendly and tons of snacks available also. Although we did not have time for lunch, the food looked delicious as well. Nice outdoor patio area.

Great breakfast sandwiches and coffee. I always stop here on the way to work, they are one of the rare places with quick parking. The service is also quick and the staff is very friendly. The best coffee in the funk zone!
Best coffee in town I swear. We were driving through Santa Barbara and still decided to stop just for their coffee. Cold brew vanilla latte is bomb!

My wife and I stopped by for a quick pick-us-up - we were practically falling asleep. Great little spot. Awesome environment and ambience. Just an all-around cool setting. 

We were the only ones ordering anything and it took about 5 minutes for a latte. We liked that they took so long to make a perfect iced latte for us. It was great - the perfect amount of espresso shots and milk. Didn't taste like a pile of dairy and sugar and had a perfect amount of caffeine to wake us up. 

I didn't check to see if they had wifi, but if they do, it seemed like a great spot to get some work done. 

Very friendly service and a great latte. Much recommended.

LOVE the Bacon Avocado Egg Sandwich they offer. And it's becoming a great place to eat a meal, grab a snack, or sit with a friend for coffee. I work in the area and come here often. Kylie and Allison are awesome, too!

It's a cute spot, came for my birthday breakfast. There was a problem when I paid I got charged three times but they refunded me as soon as I told them. Mimosas were small and the food was really heavy but it was very good! I'd deff come back

Killer coffee, food, and service - can't ask for a better/cuter coffee shop. This place was so awesome I ended up stopping in two times during my 36 hour visit to Santa Barbara! The girl working behind the counter was AMAZING - so friendly and helpful! The first day I got the cold brew mixed with their *cinnamon toast crunch milk*(whaaaat?? Yeah. It's as good as it sounds). 

On Day 2 my friend and I stopped in before we boarded the train back to SD and she got a turkey sandwich that was sooo good. I, of course, rocked the cold brew/CTCM combo. The girl working heard me debating whether to get food, which I ended up deciding against since we'd just eaten lunch, but she surprised me and hooked me up with some toast with killer strawberry jam when she delivered my friend's sandwich! Saved my life from train food during hour 6. Definitely will be back next time I'm town!

I found out about this place from our valet guy at Hotel Milo, who recommended this place for great coffee. It was just a walk away from where we were staying. The service was amazing as the staff was very friendly. I was so full from dinner so I did not order food even tho the menu looked delicious. However, after taking a walk on the beach and packing up to leave back to OC, I had my bf stop by to purchase a pastry for the road. There was one scone left around noon time and the girl wasn't sure if it was blueberry or chocolate but it happened to be maple bacon and it was amazing. It tasted so fresh and light. We will be back when we come back to visit Santa Barbra.

almost afraid to write this review because i have a feeling that the next time we go it ill take 2 hours to get a table here- THAT GOOD. Egg sammy was spot on, cappuccino was perfectly frothy and HUGE. we will definitely be back.  Please don't go a changin'

What a wonderful little coffee shop! I wish there were one closer to where I live. I stopped in and had a nice breakfast and coffee before hoping on the Amtrak train to leave. I tried the chia seed porridge which is something I had never heard of before. It was incredibly delicious, with just the right touch of honey to give it a delicate sweetness, finished with a topping of fruit. I also had a cappuccino and was pleased to find out they also offer milk alternatives such as almond milk, so I got my cappuccino made with almond milk. Additionally the people working in the shop were very friendly and accommodating. I will certainly be back on my next visit to Santa Barbara and hope to try some of their yummy looking pastries the next time I come!

Looked for breakfast places on the Pacific coast bike trail in Santa Barbara. As we headed inland to another yelp rated breakfast place we saw rebar and wanted to give it a shot. The breakfast options seemed a little pricey, however as we just wanted an option to satisfy our hangriness and since we were splitting the cost, the price didn't matter. I wish we didn't have lunch plans because it was an amazing avocado egg sandwhich.
Excellent Americano!! Their breakfast sandwich was great too and came with fresh berries. Truly tasty breakfast experience.

I am giving this place a 3 star due to the following:

Food quality:
Ordered the Chia Seed Bowl (like oatmeal), Toast, and French Toast.
The Chia Seed Bowl gets a 4 star. Tasted ok and felt healthy. So definitely recommend it.
However, the French Toast and the Toast get a 1 star. And that set the poor impression in me about the quality of the food and the kitchen.
The Strawberry jam tasted very "canned" like. Did not taste fresh. Just like a jelly mix and fake/flavored fast.
The French Toast was not well done at all. Tasted simply like a cinnamon roll with fake jam on it.

Kitchen:
It feels as if the kitchen is shared with their bar next door and so the Breakfast that we had did not have a taste of clean morning food. It felt more like a bar food. Despite them trying to make it look super healthy.

Overall the taste of the food, quality, and gut feel on cleanliness was poor.


On the plus side:
The 2 ladies working there were super sweet and "lively".
Service was great.
Price was "ok". 
Coffee/espresso was "ok".

I personally will not head here again. Not for breakfast at least.

My experience was horrible. The staff did not give me my complete order, leaving out one item. When I asked for the forgotten item they tried to charge me again and I had to flag down the waitress that helped me. Then they insisted that a bran muffin was a banana nut muffin (what I had ordered). I knew right away it wasn't and the assistant manager, Amber, came out from the kitchen, got in my face, and started, defensively asking me what a "brand muffin" was until I explained to her what bran flour is... Next she proceeded to insist the bran muffin was a banana nut until I asked her open it. When Amber opened the muffin and pulled out raisins in it, without saying another word to me she rushed back into the kitchen and wave of her hand told the barista to "refund me." I know this is so minor. Who cares? It's just a muffin. If they had just apologized and admitted their mistake that would have been the end. But to have sold me something that wasn't in stock, forgetter to give me it, tried to charge me twice, giving me the wrong item and making me feel like an idiot until I literally have to prove the person in charge wrong... And then to just be dismissed. It was absolutely awful.

This is not your ordinary  coffee shop. Loved the rustic decor. The food was exceptional and coffee was great. You can also have a Bloody Mary or Mimosa with your breakfast. Our friend said it was the best beef french dip he has had in all of Santa Barbara .
Be sure to go see the new addition and have a beer with your lunch.
Best expresso in Barbara...supercool staff as well.

Had a late breakfast here today.  The chia seed porridge was great full of mixed berries.  The Italian sausage breakfast sandwich was absolutely delicious not over done but great flavors and seasoned perfectly.  The staff was very nice they made you feel like you've been there before and they where just waiting for your return. I do think that it is higher on the scale price wise because it's quality food.
Awesome cold brew coffee (Colombian mix). Didn't even want to add the usual 1/2 and 1/2. Excellent muffin and fresh juice too, and service/surroundings. Back here the rest of my stay!

We ordered 3 items and 2 were horrible.  The Americano and hot chocolate were the worst drinks possible.  I mean, tasted terrible.  Wasted $10 and had to throw them away. The barista took about 10 minutes to make the Americano so I think she was simply untrained.  

The cinnamon roll was actually very good.
Excellent coffee. My favorite food item is the bacon, avocado and egg sandwich. They have excellent cold brew too
Great cortado, killer menu with killer food.  Lovely rustic atmosphere and friendly staff.  Win win win win!
The staff is friendly. The espresso was perfectly made. The ambience is sort of a rustic warehouse industrial. The food is on order and the music is a mix of jazz and blues.

This is the place to get brioche french toast and the best cup of coffee in SB. The staff is very friendly and the location is ideal, steps from the beach and downtown right on State Street. The outdoor dining tables are rustic but that adds to the charm of this perfect local spot for breakfast or lunch.  They do have a couple morning libations if you prefer over coffee but the coffee was so good, I didn't indulge in any other beverages.  

It is across the street from the train station so if you take the SurfLiner up/down, and hop off in SB, you will see it across State Street.  The bus stops right in front too if you are traveling via public transportation.
Came by and they had no coffee and only day old pastries left. The vanilla latte was ok but almost all ice. It's a nice atmosphere though so it has that going for it

Tucked away on the edge of the funk zone, this is one of the best kept secrets in town for coffee and all-day breakfast.  Featuring Heart, Stumptown and other Portland cult favorite single-origin beans the brick walls and rustic exposed beams provide a welcoming respite from the occasional winds along the gorgeous American riviera.
Super cool dog friendly spot with cold brew coffe growlers and an amazing bacon avocado and egg sandwich. The bacon avocado and egg sandwich is amazing.

I can only speak to the coffee. There was no line and a cappuccino took 10 minutes and tasted like dirt and burnt toast. If you like old Starbucks brew then this is your place. Otherwise go find handlebar or french press nearby. It's a better way to spend $4.

This place is awesome! The interior is sweet, the atmosphere is pleasant, the food is delicious and well portioned. If I lived in SB this would be my go to spot, but I know I will be back when I visit SB

Came here for coffee two mornings in a row. It's a cute quant place but the latte I ordered was really bitter, the latte bubbly and flat- not frothy at all. Staff was lovely and they have a cool outdoor patio.

Cute little coffee shop. Open and rustic feeling with great music (love hearing Ella Fitzgerald played!). There aren't any outlets inside so make sure you're charged up before coming. There's seating inside for about 20 so it can get filled up fast around brunch.
Your coffee and breakfast menu is solid. Love the outdoor seating.

One of my favorite spots for breakfast in SB. Love their chia porridge -- I get it warm and it always hits the spot. The bacon, egg, avocado sandwich is also amazing and delicious, the spicy ketchup is so good! Their coffee is amazing too and well crafted! They have some fun drinks on tap and take time to make your drink just right! Oh and they have yummy pastries too! I've never had wine there but am always impressed with their selection! Perfect stop to fuel up for a fun day in Santa Barbara!

Coffee: 2.0
Atmosphere: 4.5
(Didn't taste food)

Coffee: 2.0 
Coffee tasted quite burnt. We tried a cortado, a cold brew, a dulce de leche cold brew, and a vanilla latte cold brew--the coffee in each tasted burnt, and a bit on the old side. The vanilla latte cold brew was the least offensive, although it had a strangely strong bourbon taste, far stronger than the coffee. 

Atmosphere: 4.5 
Beautiful, woody interior with a great patio. Smells like pine, it's great. 

I'm giving them a 3.0, benefit of the doubt, since I didn't try their food. Although it did look overpriced--$10 for French toast is definitely excessive.

Wow. This is everything I want in a breakfast restaurant. Fresh healthy options, beautiful food presentation, great service, and top notch taste. I had the vege omelet. It was loaded with fresh tasty veges in a thin delicate egg omelet. It included avocado toast and fresh fruit garnish. Yum! My husband had over east eggs with the pastrami hash...and wow again. Sweet potatoes, onions, hashed potato and tasty tender chunks of pastrami. We both had delicious brewed coffee. If there were 6 stars, I would say they earned it. My new fav SB breakfast place.
Wonderful coffee and and cinnamon roll was best in SB so far! Very cinnamonnny and made from a croissant so it's not so heavy as usual. Will be back to try more goodies and coffees!

Rebar is a little hidden gem in Santa Barbara, it's the best place for coffee as well as breakfast. I highly recommend people to try the Bacon Avocado Egg Sandwich it is AMAZING!!! Everyone is super friendly and will give you great recommendations if it's your first time there. Patio seating is available so you can take your pup along with you. It has a nice little view so you can sit outside enjoy breakfast and your coffee. I always come for breakfast but the lunch menu looks yummy as well, definitely going to have to try it one of these days!
Rebar is one of my favorites.  Don't forget, they have a 2 for 1 Deal on the Santa Barbara Axxess card.
