Came here for a quick Mother's Day brunch. Great choices for the kids (Mac and cheese, pancakes with bananas, etc). The adults had the Justin Yo Face (cured salmon with dill creme freche and fried capers topped with a perfectly poached egg). Mamma was very happy!

The Shop has consistently been a pleasant experience over the past several weeks that is has been my go-to breakfast morning location. My girlfriend and I have been absolutely hooked since her initial discovery of the place via Yelp. This place is the real deal. Great outdoor and indoor seating, friendly staff, and amazing food (with a large enough spectrum of varieties to please everyone in the group). I'm stuck on the Rollex still, a homemade wheat rap with bacon, avocado, eggs, and a house made aioli. 

Tldr: seriously check this humble location out. Unbelievable. Best option on the east side of SB if not in all of Santa Barbara.

My family and I all had a different dish and all were superb!  I had the YOLO.  Best chicken, biscuits, and gravy I've had.  My son had the shrimp and grits.  Cheesy and incredibly delicious grits.  My daughter had the Col. Sanders.  Delish fried chicken sandwich.  Hubby had Chilaquiles and littlest had the Shop Burger.  All was perfect!  Can't wait to come back to Santa Barbara to eat here again.

I've been here lots of times and typically get the Tugboat Benedict or the Rollex. Both so good! I love that they're creative with their menu and you know you'll get diverse AND delicious options. The dishes also come out pretty quick and the owners/staff are all very friendly. Not your standard breakfast/lunch spot and they're definitely the beginning of what's to come on the east side. Highly recommend it!

The food was good. The menu was interesting and there was obvious care in their choice of ingredients. 

This place seriously lacks hygiene though. I was sat outside and the place was covered in flies. I couldn't site down and enjoy my food for it. I tried to move inside and it was no better. 

This place has a lot of potential but it needs to look at it's hygiene.

When ending our road trip we thought to stop by for a quick breakfast and was astonished at how well my girlfriend and i were taken care of. The restaurant was well maintained and taken care of to have a very comfortable laid back vibe. The staff were all well knowledgable, kind, and knew what the restaurant had to offer. They gave both of us amazing recommendations me the yolo and her the salmon. The food was so very delicious just looking at it made my mouth water the plating was so wonderful with the house made gravy and biscuits and the best orange juice in the world I will most likely be back when ever I visit nearby. All in all highly recommend this place you will not be disappointed!

As an avid fan of a good Benedict, the tugboat ranks among the most memorable I've had, for its flavor and customizability, as well as value in that it's enough for two people. Next time I'm in SB I will be back.

Have had several bad experiences here and now officially never going back. 
Flies were everywhere, landing all over our food and even on our faces  
When their tables are full they don't say they are, or even let you know that there is a wait. They will  let you order it "for here" then when your food comes up and there is no place to sit, you are left just standing there awkwardly with your plates of food looking like a jackass with flies on your face. Some people sat with someone they didn't know and shared a dirty table, other just started at the people eating until they left.
When I asked for "light cheese" on my melt, the girl at the counter was very rude and said they can't do that.
They forgot my latte, and the next time only had skim milk for the coffee.
The place is way too overpriced for the quality of the food and the horrible atmosphere and service.
Everything here on their menu rocks!  Every time a friend comes to visit I take them and they are so happy;)
I had the General Sanders on Sat 7/16/16 and got food poisoning would not recommend this place

Was recommended this place by a local and I'm in love!! I ordered the Cecelia: kale salad with quinoa, squash, white bean, toasted almonds, tangerine and a chili lime dressing!! I added avocado $1 sooooo good and so fresh! I will be back!
Everything is great here! Eastside is definitely one of my favorites. They used to cut the jalapenos thinner and fry them, I miss that, but still epkcly delicious. Be sure to add the carnitas.

Came here again the next day after enjoying a delicious lunch, this kitchen knows its stuff. With clever names each dish holds up to it's promise to kick you in the face with flavor, wrestle you to the ground with comfort and blow your mind with creativity. 

This time around I had the tugboat, only available in the weekends, a unique and incredible choice foe eggs benedict. I had two perfectly poached eggs, sitting on fall apart in your mouth, moist and buttery biscuits topped with avocado, fried chicken and hollandaise. 

Seriously good, and not as heavy as you would think, I will be dreaming about those biscuits and fried chicken until my next stint at this joint.

First off, thank you to whoever posted that you order at the window and then sit down. Saved me a lot of confusion!

We (boyfriend and I) spent the weekend in Santa Barbara and I love me a place that serves chilaquiles, so that picture reeled me in. We showed up about 10ish on Saturday morning, easily found parking on the street, but would have missed out on the actual place had it not been for the fetching yellow umbrellas on the patio. The place looks crowded and the line is a little intimidating, but trust me, it moves quick.

I ordered chilaquiles with carnitas and a coffee, boyfriend ordered the tugboat with bacon and a latte. Came out to about $39. 

It was a little hard for us to find seat outside, but we found a table inside no problem. Food came out quick, and it looked delicious. Chilaquiles were on point, first few bite were heaven - crunchy chips, tender meat, creamy cheese. Have I mentioned I thoroughly enjoy chilaquiles? Unfortunately (for me, maybe not for you) the green sauce was just a tad on the too spicy side and it started to build and build until I really couldn't take it anymore. I'm a lightweight when it comes to spice, so if you're like me... tell em to go easy on it. Also, the portion is large - plan on sharing!

This place takes fresh quality ingredients and creates familiar dishes but with a Twist That Succeeds. The flavors here have this hip (not hipster!) urban flair without trying too hard to be foodie/trendy." The Shop Cafe retains a casual neighborhood feel staying true to the SB local atmosphere. It's competitively priced and is very reasonable considering how much love they put into making their own breads/cured-products!

Just-in-Yo-Face = 2 perfectly poached eggs on house-cured salmon, fresh herbs, creme fraiche on their special toast. The salmon is delicate but they don't skimp here; it stands up to the poached eggs. The shop-toast is much better than, say an english muffin, because you get the perfect bite on your fork every time. 

Cecilia Salad = Kale, chilled quinoa, corn, thinly sliced raw squash and more. A surprise for me and I'm the idiot that added chicken believing it'd be a skimpy leafy salad. The key here is the chilled quinoa which was very refreshing and added this extra contrast along with the slight crunch and bitterness of the raw squash. It's a large portion for a 10$ salad and this is an amazingly healthy option that caught me off guard with how good it was.  The chicken was ok but unnecessary - that's my fault.

Pig in the Grass = Their take on the BLT is done well - I had a couple bites of my friend's. Soft ciabatta bread was a suitable vehicle that would've been otherwise unwieldy to hold. Their house-made pork belly bacon is luxuriously hammy, thick and seared with a nice crunchy crust.  

Serves a limited but interesting selection of beer. Good iced tea. Outdoor patio is nice but the rare occasion when it's windy, beware, the unstabilized table umbrellas nearly decapitated us.  Dogs allowed too :)
Super yummy food!!!! Everything we ordered was tasty and fresh. The kids loved the mac and cheese and chicken tenders.  Whenever I come to Santa Barbara I will make a stop here.

Just OK- French Toast Melt was served so quickly and of a barely warm temp that I highly doubt it was made to order. When you're paying extra, you don't want the food hanging around in a warming tray...it should be piping hot. Coffee was slow to arrive so we were already eating when we had to ask for the rest of our order (our drinks). And for the price it should be served with a side.
Very good food, takes a min to get it , but worth it! Great tunes too outside , very relaxed. If you getting breakfast you should give this place a Go ..
You order from a window and get a number. The waitress/waiter will then find you by your number. Food was served pretty fast. Fried chicken egg benedict was good and salmon dish tasted just right.

Best neighborhood restaurant hands down! The food is consistently perfect, the portion sizes are not crazy huge which is nice, and the staff are the friendliest I've met! 

They're open for dinner now, my family and I went a few nights ago and I had the salmon which was cooked perfectly with amazing crispy skin. My daughter loves the quinoa salad, and my husband orders something new every time we go :) and is always pleased. 

This is our families favorite restaurant in our neighborhood. Breakfast lunch or dinner we always enjoy the shop

I'm not sure why their rated so high.  They are very creative with the way the cook the food, so people who love to cook will be interested in trying different things on the menu. The food was just OK

The perfect breakfast spot. Great location, easy enough to find parking. (I'm from L.A. so parking is alway a B ) and super friendly service, which for me is really important because it sets the whole vibe/mood of the restaurant . I got the shrimp n grits and I have never finished a meal so fast in my life lol. Was very delicious and we only waited less than 10 mins for our food.  Overall such a good simple delicious breakfast experience in Santa Barbara.

Great place! Food was delicious, guys that run it were really nice and helpful, out door patio is perfect for large groups! I had the tug boat with Salmon, would definitely have it again and will come back for sure:)
Finally tried this place and it lives up to the hype.  Try it out.  You won't be disappointed.  The Cecila salad is de-iish...but that mac n cheese is TO DIE FOR.

Flat out the best coffee and breakfast sandwiches. My wife and I just finished an 11 day road trip from LA to Seattle and The Shop Kitchen had the best coffee of our entire trip! We showed up around 8am on Sunday morning and there was no line, ordering was a breeze. The food came out quickly and was delicious, the outdoor seating was nice and quiet, overall really good experience.

You order at the front counter then sit down and they deliver the food, don't be awkward like we were.

Holy sh*t order anything, no anything, with hollandaise sauce and you will be happy. We got the Tugboat with ham (so good but maybe next time I'd substitute toast for the biscuit) and the Eastside In Yo Face (spicy and delicious).

Friendly service. Cute patio. Surprisingly impressive food and presentation. Do it.

I have to downgrade my initial review.  My husband and I had breakfast this morning after a bike ride.  I ordered the Rollex and Eggs in Your Face.  His EIYF was great as in eggs nicely poached on top of perfectly toasted bread.  Mine was not so great.  The Wheat Wrap was greasy and the eggs inside were hard and rubbery and dry. I had one bite's worth of the tomato spread and there were a scanty 2 slices of avocado.  I like The Shop and I will continue to eat here but hope it's better next time.
We are never disappointed but the food and the staff is always refreshing and helpful! My personal favorite are the fish tacos.

Creative comfort food on the East Side--need I say more?!

I've been to the Shop Cafe several times over the last 18 months, and every experience is the same. A great location, great outdoor patio, good music in the background, and a chance to know your neighbors and fellow Santa Barbarians. I dig this place. 

Most recently, I had what I can only describe as a fried chicken benedict but with a buttermilk biscuit instead of an english muffin (and avocado, which, in Santa Barbara, is a must). I added a side of potatoes (thin cut, lots of flavor), and a mimosa to sip as I people-watched on the umbrella-covered patio. The food is wonderful, and a great changeup from the usual Santa Barbara offerings (California Cuisine, Mexican, Italian, Steak & Seafood... it gets boring after a minute or two). I have yet to find something on the menu I didn't like. 

Having spent 6 years in San Francisco (where food is king, and if you price it too high, the person next door will beat you at that too), this feels like a place that might do well in the Bay Area with a few improvements. But for Santa Barbara, this is definitely 4-stars a a fave.

Beyond brilliant!  This place has depth of flavor and exquisite quality if ingredients.  Every element has been weighed and weighed again.  From the chai latte to the Deep South buttermilk fried chicken with biscuit and sausage gravy.  The best I've ever tasted.  Poaching an egg here has been elevated to an art form.  Can't wait to come back on the weekend!  Xoxo GFG bakery loves you!

This breakfast/brunch/lunch spot has everything you could ever want.  Beautiful outdoor seating, cozy indoor seating, coffee, beer and fantastic food.

I highly recommend the Rolex breakfast sandwich with egg whites.  Very savory and full of flavor.  They have 3 draft beers which are served in mason jars.  The staff is friendly and helpful and the service is fast.  Do yourself a favor and give this gem a try!
So bomb. I got the sweet Maria and it was unlike any chicken sandwich I've had. AMAZING.

I'm a cheap ass, so when it comes to paying $30 for a burger and eggs Benedict with some onion rings, I expect to have a mouthful of flavor taking over my palate. Not so, my gf was ok with the eggs Benedict but the burger was lame. Burger doesn't come with fries nor a drink. If you're ok with spending a pretty penny for mediocre food this is the spot. I'll give it another shot on another visit, perhaps I wasn't in the mood for a burger and that clouded my judgement.

Other The food is good. That's not the issues. My problem is there is no accommodation for dairy free families and no kids menu. Thus making this place very unfriendly to anyone with lactose issues or people with small kids. The average meal is $10-12 with no sides. So a 2 burgers or Tri-tip sandwich will run you $32 without fries, soda or tax. Add 3 drinks and two sides your looking $45 for lunch. Yes. The food is good, but I can't bring myself to spend that kind of cash on lunch for two adults and one toddler. As another reviewer said, a few dollars more and you could be sitting by the beach at a full service fine dinning place.
The BEST toasts I have ever had - hands down. Don't let the oddball location deter you, this little spot is worth the trek away from State Street.

Oh dear sweet baby tacos The Shop Cafe is AMAZING! 
Stopped off in Santa Barbara with friends on our way up to San Francisco and were looking for a cute place to stop off and eat some lunch. After searching Yelp (and the streets) for about forty-five minutes we came across this absolute gem of a restaurant and thought "Why Not?". We had a puppy with us so the outdoor seating sealed the deal and we made our way in to grab some grub and try it out.
Firstly, the setting is beautiful! Especially if its a nice day and you're sitting outside in the sun! The atmosphere is very laid back which I love when coming somewhere to eat and it makes it easier when narrowing down what you're going to eat from the plethora of delicious meals on offer here.
I settled on the Fish Tacos, mainly because the tortillas are handmade in house! I was not disappointed in my decision at all! Although my two companions got equally incredible looking meals my tacos were definitely the envy of all around even if they did take slightly longer to come out.
I wish I ventured out of Hollywood more because this place could easily become my local!
Super cute trendy spot in Santa Barbara. Great friendly service they have a breakfast lovers dream menu all the good all day - great spot!

I've had better.

The menu is decent sized which includes breakfast and lunch items. I didn't feel that there was much on my Salmon In Yo' Face plate to justify the $13+ they charged. I was kinda hungry after. BFF's avocado toast was skimpy and she said it was average. Portion size didn't bother her.

Her mocha had a hint of cinnamon in it. My ice tea was refreshing.
EXCELLENT food.  This place is fantastic.  The service is great too.  Lots of creative dishes.  Go here for a good quality meal made from quality ingredients.

First food after camping for three days.  What a treat!! 

The General Sanders was delicious.  Satisfied, 10 out 10, will come back for most!!

Outside seating can be tricky though!

This place used to be better. Now it seems like every time I come, the food is rushed and not well executed. And I always come during the week, so it's not busy. Gravy not hot, bland, No seasoning, no crispy bacon? Biscuits are dense and don't taste fresh. Also who wants to eat raw bacon in my rollex burrito? Stop cooking it with the eggs. And fluff the eggs, no egg patties. Some texture would be nice. The crispy chicken is probably the best. Summer patio is nice.  I think quality control dropped off. Not sure what happened. Defintetly not 5 Star. Not sure who these fools are rating it, must not be cools or foodies .

Amazing! Gluten-free bread from a local bread is incredible. Had the smoked salmon with it and it was heaven. My husband has the egg white omelette and absolutely loved it as well. Will definitively be back!
Something about this place that I loved. I've never been a fan of the eggs benedict, but this place has completely changed my mind. Definitely coming back.

The food is delicious! I had the Justin-yo-face and I can honestly say its one of the best rendition of lox in a bagel I've had.  (they use Texas toast rather then a bagel) I'll definitely be coming back here again.

Delicious food and a relaxing summery atmosphere. 

Street parking. Indoor & outdoor seating. Order at the window then go sit down.

My boyfriend and I got the:
1) Shrimp & grits 5/5 stars: the grits were thicker and more solidified than other grits I've ever gotten.. and I really liked that. Had enough flavor to taste good on its own, but still complementary to the shrimp without being overwhelming.
2) Fried chicken eggs benedict 5/5 stars: juicy and delicious, not to mention bright and beautiful

Must visit for breakfast or brunch!
Good food, decent cost, and I like the location.

One of the best brunches I have had. We got 2 Benedicts- one with veggies, the other with salmon. Also got the French toast (which comes with basil on top, What!!!! Wait till you try the fusion of the flavors in your mouth) and the banana almond honey toast. Their home-made almond butter is a killer. The mocha was excellent as well. A must-visit in Santa Barbara.

Bonus: on a clear day you can get beautiful views of the mountains while eating.
Ummm - yummm!!  So good.  Everything I've had here is delicious; if I want a breakfast treat I always come here.  Super creative and yummy dishes ;)

If you don't come here YOU'RE CRAZY!!

Everything was fresh, great flavors!! unique, it's like a fusion of Mexican and brunch American dishes. It's GREAT! I would eat here everyday if I could HANDs DOWN.

Out of towner from New York (Manhattan), visted Santa Barbara for new year

ENJOY!

This place is a hidden gem! We loved it!!! We had the chilaquiles with carnitas and they were to die for, just the right amount of spice. We also had the Frenchies toast, also delicious! The service was great. We were greeted with a smile and questions were answered kindly. Can't wait to come back and eat here again!
The fried chicken and biscuit with sausage gravy was some serious comfort food. The biscuit was massive, fluffy, and unexpectedly toasted. Delish!

The sweetest, spontaneous find ever!

Was waiting for car work to be done before embarking on the 6 hour journey back to SF Bay when we sauntered down the street from Big Brand Tires to find this gem.

The quality of the atmosphere and food was so right. Clean, fresh, simple, extraordinarily healthy. 

Food: strawberry lemonade, coffee, poached eggs with avocado and bacon
Atmosphere: outside closed off area with umbrellas, picnic tables and nice music jams was the best and made it cozy, casual, and charming.
Service: everyone working there was psyched to be working there!

Really excellent. No joke you gotta hit this place up!!

Ordered a tugboat and rollax. Man! The egg Benedict is soooo good. First time trying egg Benedict with biscuit base, surprisingly delicious. The egg york is so fresh that you can taste the sweetness, and mixes with perfectly cooked bacon and fresh avocados. Totally foodgasm. Really like the Kombucha, a pineapple flavor sparkling water. Can't wait to visit it again next time and try out more awesome brunch!

Food was ok. The service was slow and absent. The inside dining room was a mess. We ordered biscuits that never arrived. Part of our order arrived and when I asked about the biscuits, I was told don't worry, they're coming. It wasn't that busy and there was no real explanation for it. No silverware inside.
Awsome, really good the only negative thing is the need a Sign a big sign. BUT the food was excellent!
I had the fish tacos, they were pretty good but not very large. Two tacos for 13 dollars is not really in my budget but if it is for you I recommend them.
Excellent customer service & delicious food! Everything I've tried on the menu (most of the menu) has been amazing, and I love the "lunch box" options for my kids!

So good I got the Justin salmon  with heirlooms tomatoes with a vanilla latte. Staff was kind and very attentive.  Breakfast  came out in under 10min. My first time here  and the craving is real!!!!!!! I'll be back

My fiance surprised me by bringing me here for breakfast. They are dog friendly, and so my golden retriever pup was able to hang out with us while we ate. We would have sat outside, but it was rainy, so we sat in the corner so that our puppy wouldn't bother other diners too much.

We ordered the fried chicken tugboat. My fiance said that's what they were known for, so I just took his word for it, and went with it. And I do not regret it one bit. The tugboat is essentially an eggs benedict with avocados. You can opt for different proteins, but the fried chicken is just absolutely amazing. And the poached eggs were perfect, which I know is hard to do in large batches.

We also ordered the maple bacon and roasted potatoes on the side, the potatoes were filling, but I couldn't stop eating them!

I wish there was a place like this near my house! I'd be a regular for sure!

Hands down favorite. My husband and I don't visit SB without going to the shop for Breakfast.

Everything is made in-house, from the thick-cut bread to the syrups in the coffee.

My personal favorite is the Salmon in-yo-Face: house cured salmon, creme fraiche, thick-cut bread and crispy capers (they're actually crispy, dried capers. i never want oil soaked capers again).

Indoor and Outdoor seating, walk-up to the window to order, very nice & accommodating staff, fairly affordable for SB. DELICIOUS.
Hipsta haven for this maven. Meaning the food was inventive and unique and creative. With hot tattoo guys taking my order no complaints here. On my way to LA and not mad I stopped at All!

Usually don't do reviews for trendy places since it would only increase traffic, but I don't live in SB. If the line gets longer, sucks to be you. 

Tug boat carnitas. Yummy. Poached perfectly. Great flavors. Just everything on that sucker went well together. My favorite franken eggs Benedict ever. 

Tugs boat fried chicken. It was good. It was breakfast so it felt a little heavy but that's just me. Flavors and crisp were spot on. If it were lunch or dinner time I would enjoy it more. 

Roasted potato were yummy. I'm a breakfast potato guy. This place was above average with caramelized onions and good flavors. 

Lastly read a review someone complaining about tipping too much. There's a button on top of where you sign that shows the amount. I thought that review was unfair. Look before you sign. 

Lucky SB. Bring this to The OC. Thanks

This place is perfect. Order at the window they bring it out. Really good price for the area, had the Tug Boat w Fried chicken and it blew my mind. Not only do they have bomb food but they have bomb coffee. My wife's latte was fire exactly the same as you would get at Handlebar Coffee downtown. 

I'm gonna stop here every time I'm in Santa Barbara.

Go here. It's the kind of food that you wish you could eat everyday if there was a built in time for a nap. It's hefty, but so so delicious. We had the tugboat with maple bacon and the frenchie with fried chicken. Both were pretty good. The best thing is that this place lets you order at the window and then you find a seat. Even though it felt like a long-ish line, it all went pretty quick and there was street parking all around. I'll hit this place again when we're in town.
Breakfast salad was awesome. Muffin was tasty. Coffee was so so but not terrible so I give it 4 stars!

The breakfast here was outstanding. Both my husband and I tried the gluten free egg dishes. They were healthy and delicious. 

The outdoor seating and general ambiance had such a good vibe. We really enjoyed our experience.

My favorite breakfast spot in town, but get there early. The yolo and tug boats are delicious and hearty. Good pastries and great local coffee from Dune roasting co. High quality and portions that won't leave you hungry.

I absolutely LOVE the fried chicken here. I would definitely recommend the fried chicken benedict, although I've also tried the salmon benedict and that was quite delicious as well. The portions look small, but they're so filling. Prices are a little expensive, around $14 for the benedicts I mentioned, but it's worth it once in awhile. This place is definitely one of the best brunch spots in SB.
Hubby's favorite local breakfast shop, close to our house and DELICIOUS options.

This place is amazing!  Best shrimp and grits I have ever tasted.  I also ordered it with a poached egg on top, so good!  It is a walk up restaurant with patio seating.  Nothing fancy, but the food is top notch.

Love this place. the out door seating is awesome for SB weather. The menu is unique and eclectic with epic ingredients. i suggest the steak sandwich. The staff is very attentive and attractive, which adds to the experience. Definitely a local go to!

We go here fairly often and the food never disappoints. On weekends there's usually a line down the sidewalk but the staff are friendly and work quickly. Wait times are never more than 10-15 minutes for food depending on how many people you're with. My personal favorite is The Sando and it comes on a delicious soft bun. I'll keep coming here as long as they don't move!

We ordered Salmon in yo face with one poached egg, fish tacos, sweet Maria, and the Shop burger. They were all delicious. Portion was mean for one person. They were all delicious. My favorite was the fish tacos, one of the best I ever tasted.

Good fresh food. First time having poached eggs and I enjoyed them. Toast wasn't anything special. My friends didn't enjoy there poached eggs. I like the holland aide sauce. I liked the gravy on the fried chicken.  The biscuits were okay too.

This is a fantastic little cafe that offers your favorite classics with an innovative twist.  You place your order at a window and have a seat in either the outdoor patio or cozy dining room.  Everything is homemade, from the breads to the granola all the way down to the ketchup, and nothing is basic.  It makes you feel like you have your fancy pants on that they go the extra distance to make sure every bite is fresh and specially crafted, not just shplopped out of a can and onto your plate.  Then again, I wouldn't expect any less from the best chef in town, the one and only Chef Richie Maxwell!

All of the baked goods are freshly baked each day.  I've never been more excited about a biscuit in my life - they are light, fluffy, and moist.  Spread the honey butter and strawberry jam on top and it will have you will singing in your seat!  I usually have to choke down oatmeal, but theirs is stand-out.  Actually, I think it's called The Best Damn Oatmeal and that is the damn TRUTH!  It's creamy and decadent, made with mascarpone cheese topped with fresh fruit and raisins.  The YOLO is an amazing breakfast of breaded chicken on top of a biscuit, swimming in a lake of delicious gravy.  As simple as it is, Eggs in Yo Face, which are poached eggs on toast with a zesty lemon oil drizzle on top, is one of my breakfast favorites.  I don't need frills to give me thrills!

They offer several excellent sandwiches/burgers and the Santa Maria sandwich is definitely one to try.  It's a chicken sandwich with smoked gouda and a strawberry BBQ sauce that adds a delicious and surprising flavor.  Just the Tip is so good it'll have you drooling for more!   It's tri-tip on a bun with perfectly caramelized onions and a home-made wasabi creme fraiche.  It's a pretty hefty, heavy sandwich so you  wouldn't want to eat this before having to do anything other than lay on the couch with your pants unbuttoned.  My new favorite is the Jean Claude Van Ham.  And the Pig in the Grass.  Ok, fine.  They're all my favorite! :)

The Shop is starting to really generate a lot of buzz around town (as well as a line that wraps around the corner) and once you experience it for yourself, you'll immediately see why.  Everything on the menu will make your tastebuds do a happy dance in your mouth.  Just go already and thank me later!

Adorable place. Quaint and organic great food!
We found it through YELP and the reviews were spot on!
A must with a menu that has something for everyone.

What a wonderful experience this was!!!!! This place came highly recommended to us by some people we know. I had poached eggs on toast with avocado and bacon, and a fresh bowl of fruit which consisted of pears, apples, pomegranate seeds, blueberries, and bananas. Yum tactic!!!!! The staff are extremely friendly and the prices are reasonable. I now highly recommend this place.

Super casual brunch place with mainly outdoor seating on wooden "picnic tables" and plenty of shade under yellow umbrellas. You order at the front and self serve for water, utensils and napkins. 
The granola and yogurt is to die for! It comes in a small mason jar topped with blueberries. One of the creamiest yogurts I've ever had. 
I've also ordered the burger which was mediocre as far as burgers go, it wasn't anything special but it's hard to do a burger wrong. 
I would recommend the fried chicken Benedict, unique and tasty! 
Overall, a great place for a simple brunch

Checked this spot out for breakfast on a road trip up the coast from LA, and rest assured we'll be back!!!  The food was fresh, prepared with quality ingredients, and most importantly, DELICIOUS!!!  I had the "salmon in yo face" (I think that's what it was called) with the poached eggs and heirloom tomatoes - YUM!!!  Hubby had the AHNOLD, added a few things, and was literally (and a bit embarrassingly) licking his plate!  Luckily, the vibe here is ultra mellow and friendly.  Plate licking is encouraged from what I could gather.  Also - the coffee was EXCELLENT!!  Order at the window, get a table on the patio, and enjoy life - you'll be glad you did!!

Recognizable but creative menu ("ramped up comfort food" isn't a bad descriptive). Ordered a Tugboat and the fried chicken sandwich. Both good.  Obviously a popular brunch spot, because they got busier when we were there. Outdoor seating area is quite nice, staff attentive.

The food was not good.  I ordered a "The Tijuana - grilled chicken breast, parmesan, avocado, caesar dressing, romaine lettuce, all wrapped up in Shop Flatbread "...I was thinking it would be a yummy chicken wrap or something different, but it was just a plain old "chicken caesar wrap with avocado.  It wasn't easy to eat and it was too salty.  Not what I expected at all.  

As for my husband, he ordered the "Sweet Maria -grilled chicken, strawberry BBQ sauce, smoked gouda, shoestring onion on Shop Bread ".  It was so greasy and messy.  It was gross to eat.  The "shop bread" was basically a Texas Toast.  The bread was so thick that it was hard to take a bite into.  We were so disappointed.  Maybe if we ordered something else, maybe it would've been better?  I will never know.  

The only cool part about The Shop was it was connected to a auto shop and the outdoor seating was cool. Overall, I give the taste level a OK rating.

I was excited to try out the shop cafe after reading about them in this weeks Sentinel and I am so happy I did! We sat on their sunny patio and enjoyed the shrimp and grits and rolex. They were busy so we did wait a little for our food but it was worth the wait! It's clear that they put a lot of effort into the food, coffee and service. The shop cafe is a great place and we will be back!

A solid breakfast option. The breakfast rollex isn't just cleverly named, but has distinct flavors and textures that can be hard to achieve in a burrito style wrap. The salmon on toast is nice, but is swimming in too much salt. The coffee is on point.

Best place to eat. Everything is fresh.
The tugboat is delish. Everything is just like the pics.
Lines are there, but worth the wait. I'm from out of the area but I will eat here whenever I can.
A chicken sandwich so good, it'll ruin your life. Service is friendly and fast. Nothing better on north Milpas!

I kind of don't want to share the secret. I love this place. The owners and other people who work there are amazing! The food is cheap but doesn't taste cheap! Homemade tortillas for my egg wrap...yes please! I highly recommend and get a seat on the patio and enjoy the SB way of life :)
Love this place!!!! Great brunch, super cute, and best vanilla  latte I have had in a while!  Love the outside seating area too!

You order at the counter and sit down. There is a great patio. We really enjoyed the avo bacon Benedict-it was loaded with all of the good stuff. The fried chicken sandwich was also really good with a really nice slaw. The Bloody Mary had the perfect spice level.

The best food in Santa Barbara.  This place had a unique and interesting menu.  Everything on there looks good and so far it has not disappointed when I do order!  The only thing is, I wish they were opened more.

Walked to this place from our airbnb house. It was a wonderful suprise to see gluten free bread on the menu. My wife had In your face eggs, while I had the gluten free frenchie. Then we topp3d it off with fresh fruit and mimosas. Everything was perfectly cooked and delivered to our table fast. Can't wait to come back tomorrow.
OMG! This is the best sandwich I've had in a long time! I got the Just the Tip tri-tip sandwich and it was DELICIOUS! I can't wait to go back and try other items on the menu!

I was in Santa Barbara for 2 days and went here both mornings for breakfast. I could do breakfast here every day and be very happy. 

The cold brew is delicious. 

Get the "eggs". Totally simple but perfectly executed. Soft poached egg with a little pepper and the avocado. So good. So simple. 

My only knock (but not worth a star) is the first day I also added bacon to the "eggs" and it was way too much bacon. I love bacon and didn't think the phrase "too much bacon" could exist but it did for this situation. Took away from the egg and avocado deliciousness.

a great experience, i knew nothing about the cafe before joining some friends there. I was very pleasantly surprised. Somewhere I would be happy to bring my family and friends with high expectations!
really fantastic food, and great coffee :) they obviously know what they are doing.
Holy crap! YOLO is amazing! Had some uneasy feelings when I ordered at a window but was definitely not let down. Make it s point to hit this place up for breakfast.

Was delicious! I had the tug boat and my husband had the yolo. It was not steak it was chicken - so fried chicken on a biscuit in a bowl of gravy. He could have eaten more. But it was good. We shared a side of bacon. It was drizzled with honey. Yum! Will go back next time we're in town. Nice and relaxing to sit outside and eat too...

This has always been my go-to casual brunch spot and I feel super lucky to now live right around the corner. I've eaten my way through almost everything on the menu by now and have never been disappointed. The salmon toast is so delish with fried capers and some magical dill creme fraiche. The benedicts, called "tugboats," are also killer and anything with their fried chicken is a must try. The YOLO is such a guilty pleasure with buttermilk fried chicken drowned in a wonderfully seasoned sausage gravy on biscuits. And the syrup they use for the French toast dishes is the best I've ever had. I could eat it by the spoonful. The micheladas are some of my favorite in town. All very reasonably priced, definitely give it a try.

Wish I would have found this place sooner. Didn't realize what it was at first because there is no sign out front. Eventually thanks to Yelp I figured it out and it's my favorite spot for brunch or lunch. The sunshine salad is my go to favorite. It's a breakfast salad. Genius! Has bacon, eggs, potatoes, mandarin oranges and more. So good. They also serve Handlebar coffee. Outdoor seating is great if you have a dog.

I live in the neighborhood, and I like this place because it's convenient and they have great coffee and poached eggs.  I always get the same thing, just breakfast, so I can't speak for the other menu items.  Nice people, and I like the urban, un-fussy vibe there.

So delicious! The owner is super sweet and always makes a point to say hi and ask how our food is, as are the employees.

The coffee is so delicious - not sure what makes it so yummy but it's perfectly strong but not too strong, and it hits the spot every time. I've only had their Salmon in yo face but I find myself craving it throughout the week. Also, their blueberry muffins are fresh and perfectly tart. Highly recommend!
These guys are killing it. Super good food and a fun place to chill

This is my first review for a Santa Barbara restaurant. I'm absolutely shocked at all the five star the greatest restaurant ever for.this place. No I take that back I'm not shocked considering there are so few great restaurants in Santa Barbara people in this town would not know a good restaurant if it ran them over.

Was hungry Yelp this location decided to check it out. I was too much in a hurry to figure out what the hell all these cute little names were on the menu so I went off script ordered bacon eggs toast and a latte.
It was okay the eggs were a little over cooked the bacon was decent the latte was weak. The staff were very nice the prices I thought were a little high. 
A lot of people love to come here Ive seen lines out front it has potential.

This place is great!  I had been wanting to try it out for a while now, and I am so glad that I finally did.  I had wanted to get the Justin-yo-face (the delicious toast and salmon and poached eggs), but my friend wanted that also and I thought it ridiculous for us to get the same thing...soooo I got the Colonel Sanders (friend chicken sandwich) and I was not disappointed.  Oh me oh my it was all delicious.  It is amazing to get such great food from a place on Milpas.  Everything coming out of the kitchen looked great, everything tasted homemade, and everything our table of 4 got was perfect.  The gravy for their biscuits and gravy was delicious.  I want to continue to go back until I try everything on the menu!  My only complaint would be the cashier service was a little stiff if I dare say a little unfriendly.  We asked 3 times why a French Bulldog was their mascot and he ignored us each time, which was odd.  He seemed a little irritated that we were using our Axxess card, which I found ironic because 98% of the reason we were there was because of that deal.  This place is good, but it is not cheap.  Also they bring the food and drinks to your table, and we got our food about 5 minutes before we got our ice-teas.  The server asked if we wanted anything else and a friend of mine asked for salsa which she was told the server would bring to her, and we never got it.  The place was swamped, so I would advise more servers for a little better service, and unless the bulldog mascot story is a secret, maybe some response to what it means when you are asked.  Not the end of the world, but just an idea.

The best brunch spot for locals for sure. Very chill, and the food here is so good that you'll have a good dozen ways to change things up for brunch. My personal favorite is the rollex. However, I can't give the place 5 stars, because the last time we went here (today), I asked for a simple (in my mind totally fair) substitute: avocado instead of the cream cheese on the salmon in yo face. The guy who took our order was super rude about it, made me feel uncomfortable about even asking, and said, "Yeah, those really aren't the same thing. So you're gonna have to add it." Never mind the fact that I'm lactose intolerant. Smh.

young ideas in a great location for foot traffic the owner was super nice and chatted a bit his suggestion was more than helpful its always nice to be able to see your food prepared and it was served very promptly. good job guys will be back for more
AMAZING! Helpful customer service, fresh and healthy food! Highly recommend as a good neighborhood spot

Try the YOLO:  Biscuits n' Gravy + Fried Chicken
Then call-in sick 
cause you're going back home to sleep it off.
YOLO was so good!! The food came out really fast, and the staff was very friendly. If you're in Santa Barbara looking for a nice breakfast place, this is the spot to go to!
Relaxing place, delicious food, economic & friendly staff. Good portion size plates. Pet friendly with inside & outside seating!
I love this place ! Although  I was a little  upset they changed  the bread on the sando!!!:( I love their fresh choices! Yum  Yum yum!!
Wow. The food here is amazing. We ordered two varieties of eggs Benedict--which seems to be their specialty. Staff very friendly and helpful. Clean, beautiful patio.

Check your total before you pay. The employees at the cashier add their own tip to your bill. I went here with a group of people and we all checked our receipts after we paid and noticed that they automatically added a 20% tip to each bill. Now let me say I am definitely not against tipping, but that should be the customers choice as to how much. I also emailed them about this issue before I posted this review because I generally don't like leaving bad reviews and received no reply. 

The food was okay though. I'd recommend it for a quick breakfast/brunch.

This is some QUALITY FOOD. I had the Louis Louis oh baby here and it was HEAVEN. Not going to lie, you KIND OF have to be in the mood to splurge for this place (or go with your parents/lovers cause they'll pay - that's what I did, thanks dad!) Idk, it's just not a place I can afford to always eat at cause it'll hurt my wallet but keep in mind that I'm speaking in terms of a college student budget. We want to focus on if this place is worth the stop so you can judge completely for yourself.  

WORTH. IT. 

Everything was really fresh and I think that may be because they use some organic or local ingredients. They bake the biscuits/breads/etc. themselves because they had a taste that was just WOW - not store bought (yes that is a taste). Also, I saw them baking in the back :) Just know, these meals are ones that you really should ENJOY. There was just so much taste in every bite that I took my precious time.

It's outside seating only, which means you can bring your loyal companions on a leash! And they're umbrellas set up! So don't think you'll be suntanning while enjoying your meal, thank god!
Tasty, awesome, comfort-style food. Fast and friendly service. Love the eastsider and eggs benedict.

Best breakfast in Santa Barbara! Highly recommend the Tugboat, YOLO, or Rolex.

Staff is always friendly and service is prompt!

We were in Santa Barbara for a few days and ate here every morning. The food was amazing and fresh. It is hard to find from the street if you are not familiar with the area. It's right next to a tire shop but don't let that scare you off.
OMG! Great food. Best homemade chips and smoothies. Especially delicious Mac on Crack. Mac and cheese with pecans, blue cheese and apples! Yum!

OUTSTANDING breakfast place!

You order at the counter and take a seat either inside or outside and they bring your food out.

We ordered the Fried Chicken Tugboat and the YOLO. 

The Tugboat was eggs benedict with fried chicken and oh my god was it delicious. The chicken isn't too overwhelming or greasy and works perfect with this dish.  The dish was cooked perfectly and the hollandaise was delicious.  

The Yolo is the same chicken, an egg and biscuits with a sausage gravy that might have been the best gravy I've ever had. 

We loved this place and will be stopping back on our next trip out West!

I've been coming here for years! I work only a couple blocks away and this place is amazing I've tried nearly everything and by far my favorites are the TJ, the Rolex, and the Sweet Maria! I always order to go. I don't ever eat there. There's a school near by and the place is crawling with middle schoolers around noon. The only down side is that they are only open until 3ish and they're service is a little slow. I ordered my lunch then waited 5 minutes. Walked 5 minutes there. Then waited for 5 more minutes for the food to be ready. Still doesn't take away from how delicious the food is. It's interesting and unique and worth it. The portions are smaller than normal but most things average about $10 but I guarantee you it will be money well spent!

I wish i could give this place 5 stars but there were a few things I didn't like. 1) they don't substitute their salad with fries, like why not?? 2) they have canned sodas.. everyone knows canned sodas at restaurants are over priced and never enough! 3) our food took forever to come out.. we even seen people who ordered after us get their food before us and last but not least.. parking and seating sucks,  hardly any of both. So with that said.. the food alone deserves the 4 stars. I had the Tijuana.. basically a chicken wrap but it was amazing! My husband had "Just the tip" and that was equally as delicious!

This little number was quaint. I really liked the large window and the view of the cooks preparing your awesome food. Just to let you know that this is a pet friendly establishment. Sashabelle my little furry baby, was with us... They have a very large patio to the left of the building, with a water bowl for the fur babies. 
It is a little on the small side inside the cafe, so if it is busy and you are claustrophobic you are better eating outside. There is one bathroom and it seemed to be really clean when I used it. Downside was that there was only one bathroom and sometimes you have to wait a really long time... like Hubbs had to ....lol

This place had some really great sandwiches and were quick and efficient.

General Sanders sandwich and their burger are so delicious. The buns they use are fresh and soft with a delicate flavor and lovely consistency. They're totally willing to make modifications (within reason) to accommodate food allergies - I love the General Sanders sandwich but get an averse reaction to raw apples, so they prepared the slaw without apples the last time I stopped by. The place is small and there isn't a lot of seating, but I've never had a problem finding a table. The iced tea is really good. Think I need to try their breakfast next time - I've heard great things about their mimosas/manmosas. Love this place.

Wife and I was visiting Santa Barbara and decided to try this place out.  When you drive by it doesn't look like much, nothing spectacular.  You order from a window and eat at picnic tables.  But definitely don't judge this place by its cover.  The food was fantastic!  I got the YOLO and wife got the TUGBOAT.  Not the most healthy but who doesn't like biscuits and fried chicken in sausage gravy.  Yum...

Yes! The world needs more places like The Shop. This joint has a wonderful vibe and even better food that's made fresh, baked in house! I had the Ahhhnold (egg white scramble with sauteed kale, squash, and onion, topped with avo and Pico, served with toast) and I was so pleased. The bread and jam were fresh and out of this world. Great iced tea, too. We'll be back next time we visit.

This place is so
Yummy! Fresh and really good food! We were visiting SB and found this on yelp. It was so good that we went back the next day!

Unpretentious little breakfast stand with some indoor and outdoor seating. Everything about this place is about the food and boy does it not dissapoint. I had the YOLO, a tender piece of fried chicken served between two crumbly home made biscuits, topped with an optional poached egg and smothered in sausage gravy. 

Luckily the portions were not gut busting. Gave me room for a side of the pork belly bacon. It was a revelation. Four strips of bacon that was close to 1/4" thick AFTER cooking! The thickness allowed for a super crispy exterior but an interior that was just exploding in delicious bacon juices. I could eat this bacon all day long, until I die of a massive heart attack. Completely would recommend this place when you just want a great breakfast and none of the pretentiousness of a touristy SB brunch place.

Got the Shop Burger. Best burger I've had in months! So much flavor, nice and juicy (not dry at all), add bacon + avocado. Will change your life!

My buddy ordered Just the Tip. Incredible Tri-Tip-Sandwich. he would describe it as DYNAMITE.

Very impressed!

Great spot to have brunch. 
Love how all their dishes have a catching name to it
This is what we ordered for four of us!

Yolo! - Gravy served with buttermilk fried chicken & grilled buttermilk biscuit and poached egg on top! It was pretty good. The biscuit did seem a bit dry but the gravy helped~

Salmon in yo face - cured salmon on top of a toasted bread. The put some spread on top of the bread along with red onion and capers.

Tugboat -Pretty much its an eggs Benedict. Comes with two biscuits, poached eggs, hollandaise, ham and avocado

Also ordered mimosas and chardonnay!

Loved the vibe and food. It's outdoor seating so you can bring your dogs with you!
I would recommend this place to anyone who is visiting SB and looking for a brunch spot. Walking distance (well when I mean walking distance, you are going to have to walk ab it but not bad, since you can digest before you start wine tasting!) to all the major wineries too!

Great Avocado toast and latte. Almond butter was greasy (which ruined the banana honey toast) but everything on their menu looked amazing. Atmosphere on the patio was super chill and dog friendly. Free water that they have tased like SB tap water (which is gross) so opt for something else to drink. Parking wasn't great, but it was a busy weekend morning. We will definitely be back.
First off, the food is fantastic. As are the owners. This place is wonderful, all around, and you should definitely stop by if you're anywhere near the area. You'll be glad you did.

Don't be fooled by their lil menu, they've got a good selection of local n organic food that can please veggie n meat eaters alike. They also serve up wine n beer!

It's a funny lil walk up window to order from w all outdoor seating on picnic style benches n the flies that go along w that ughh. Order, grab utensils n water on the right hand side as you head over to the eating area n choose ur seating. 

We got the Best Damn Oatmeal w no brown sugar or pecans, the Rollex and a side of fruit. Flavor of the oatmeal was pretty darn good but I prefer mine to be a bit thicker in consistency. Would def order again but might ask for no brown sugar and light on the honey next time cause it was still a lil too sweet. Rollex was good but the eggs were somewhat brown n less light n fluffy. Side of fruit didn't look all that fresh but perhaps it was cut into such small bits that it was somewhat overly manhandled. Decent tho. 

Too many delicious sounding options to check out n not enough room in my belly so I'll have to be back again :)

What an unexpected pleasure! The Shop looks like a walk up take out sidewalk place, but the food is 5 star white tablecloth quality. I had the best smoked ribs I can remember. Every ingredient tasted fresh. This is the gourmet version of old favorites; ribs, potato salad, kale salad, biscuits and honey. We dined in the pleasant courtyard picnic tables, a surprise hideaway on busy north Milpas. If you are headed to The County Bowl for a concert, this would be an ideal dining spot. I plan to return this week to try a different entree.

Great vibe. Delicious food. Husband had the YOLO - fried chicken w/ biscuits and gravy, I had the oatmeal with clementine wedges. Both were awesome. Picnic tables outside are the perfect spot for breakfast on a warm morning. Friendly locals with great advice. Wish we had the time to go again before we left. I would try everything on the menu.

Came here around 2:45pm on a Sunday and it wasn't crowded (they close at 3 pm but were nice to let us order). If it's sunny, I'd definitely recommend sitting outside! It was so nice. 

I ordered the YOLO and it was the BOMB. The fried chicken was crispy yet still moist on the inside. The biscuit and gravy were also good. I'd give this dish a try if you're planning on visiting! Overall, I'd come back and try another item on the menu.

Ridiculously good. You could point blindly to the menu and still have the best meal of your year. Menu is very well thought out, really nice food pairings, cooked perfectly. Bonus is the fresh ice tea, or option of a little alcohol if you wish. I'll be daydreaming of coming back here for a long time.

I am soooo impressed with THE SHOP!!  A client introduced me because they know as a chiropractor and health coach how seriously we take our nutrition and how difficult it is to find HEALTHY breakfasts that are also fun and tasty!!  My wife and I love the Breakfast salad and if you are into green stuff for breakfast you will too!

Great biscuits! Its our first time here and ordered the tugboat as recommended by the staff. We got the salmon tugboat and Yolo. Both are great! With a bit if Cholula on it, Yolo just rocks!! Its right next to a auto shop, don't miss it. Highly recommended for visitors like myself for a great starting meal for a day of adventure!

Fried chicken tugboat is a must, it's super good. The food was great and I loved the atmosphere. It was quiet and not too rowdy. Kind of confusing because you order first and they bring it to you, I wish there was a sign or something that said order here. Only big problem I had was my friend found a piece of hair in her salad, she was really digging it out so it was IN there. They were nice enough to make her another dish (obviously a different one), it was really unfortunate though.

My vote for most instagrammable breakfast in Santa Barbara! You really can't go wrong with anything on he menu here, my personal favorite is the tugboat with bacon. The portion size is also perfect, I never walk away feeling overly full or guilty. They also serve handlebar coffee which is a personal favorite of mine. If you are looking to woo out of town guests take them here it's a little hidden spot perfect for a breakfast or brunch on a nice day. (Bonus they have indoor and outdoor seating)
Great place to eat. The environment is very pleasant amd food is unique and tasteful.

The Shop Cafe, having getting rave reviews on Yelp and wanting brunch/lunch, we gave it a try. It's a tiny place where you stand in line to wait to place your order, then given a number and if you're lucky, you will fine one of the far and few covered outdoor table limited seating. You can also fine a few tables inside where it is extremely stuffy, which we did.

The service at the order window was pleasant. The menu having very trendy names to their items was entertaining and all traditional dishes traditional dishes had a nice twist to them. We ordered the "Mac on Crack" (elbow noodles, bechamel sauce, bacon, crushed pecan, gorgonzola cheese, topped with diced apple), "Pig in the Garden" (maple bacon, romaine, avocado, heirloom tomatoes, mayo on ciabatta ), "The Shop Burger" (1/2 pound seasoned beef patty, cheddar, shredded iceburg, pickles, horseradish mayo ). All were made with fresh ingredients and tasted very good.

The food delivery timing though was inconsistent, while we got our drinks, we were done with our drinks before 2 or the 3 entrees were delivered. Other tables of entrees that ordered after us came. I reminded them that my entree was still missing, finally received after my dining partners were 1/2 done with theirs. My huge complaint is the price which I noted a lot of other Yelpers had. Your paying $12 for a BLT, $11 Mac and Cheese and $11 Burger, and you don't have enough adequat seating. As some one described he Shop Cafe to a tee "a food truck without wheels".

I'm glad we tried, good service, food prep delivery long, food very good, seating horrible.
This place has amazing food! Get the Salmon in Yo Face! Love the outdoor seating and friendly staff.
Nice brunch place to sit outside when the weather is nice. Favorites: The tugboat, Sando, and YOLO. Pair it with a chai latte. Nice!

Great breakfast place. 
Sunny side up with bacon in toast. Heavenly. 

Great outdoor patio with music. 

Service is pleasant and professional. 

Highly recommend.

Just awesome. I had the tugboat with ham and a michelada. My only compliant was that the ham was a tad bit salty for me, but the biscuit was buttery and soft, the eggs were perfect, and the avacado amazing. Love this place.

Excellent breakfast at the Shop Cafe this morning.  Kudos to Dudley and his crew for delicious, plentiful food, and great service!  Being out-of-towners, we had to drive by twice to be sure we were at the right place.  No signs; the line out front is the cue. The Sando was huge; Eggs-in-yo-face delicious with poached eggs, and no problem ordering mine with scrambled rather than poached.  Great music to boot!  Don't miss it.
Great food and great coffee. I am more than happy to say whenever we are in Santa Barbara, we will be visiting the Shop Kitchen.
The food here is really good. We had the shrimp and grits, french toast, Rolex and side of fruits. Highly recommend.

Banana toast was delicious and so was the coffee! You walk up to a counter and order food, they deliver to your table. Pretty patio seating available as well as indoor seating. Definitely would recommend for a quick weekend bite!

Absolutely wonderful! You order at the window, and they bring your food to the table. They have about 7 tables inside where the water and condiments are, and 10 or so very nice covered picnic tables with benches outside. It's quaint, but roomy. 

I ordered the YOLO: if you want to really splurge and you like biscuits and gravy, this is the dish for you! I've never had a fried chicken breast with my B&G, and I feel like I've been living life all wrong. It is SO TASTY. The chicken breast was juicy, crispy, seasoned well; the gravy was out of this world...but the piece de resistance was the biscuit. I haven't had a biscuit homemade from real lard/butter (whatever they use), in a long time. It was fluffy and dense all at once. It didn't stick to the roof of my mouth like a cheap bread would, nor did it soak up everything completely. Their biscuit is the base for many of their dishes, and I can understand why; they are very very good.

I came here via groupon. Best deal ever! Worth the trip! Happy eating!

Ignore the sourpuss reviews. Food is scratch made and better than most snooty breakfast places in town. Owners work in house and always check on customers to ensure breakfast is up to par. 

Update: Came a couple weeks later. Ordered Cecilia, The Tijuana, side of fries and Mac. Mac and cheese worse than from the box, fries used to be craft skinny fries with a great seasoning, now like cheaper version of in and out. Way too much kale in the Cecilia. Missing the quality of when this restaurant first opened. Rooting for you guys!!!
Great place for breakfast and lunch! The Cecilia salad is my favorite with a side of fries!

4/5 salsa packets to the Rolex. A hearty burrito featuring mix of eggs, avocado, secret roasted tomato sauce, cheese and top-shelf bacon, all wrapped in Uganda-native whole-wheat chapati bread. $1 proceeds go to Uganda relief. So you can feel good while you're feeling good. Try it!

I would recommend this place over all the other places I've tried in Santa Barbara!

This place is right beside a tire shop and a sandwich shop called "Sams To Go". Order at the front and take a seat inside to your right or to your left you have the option of sitting under umbrellas. It was a nice day so we sat outside! Someone will call out your drink order and you can go up to the window to grab it. Otherwise someone came to us with a tray of what we bought.

Food:

Sunshine ($12) - An egg,, roasted potatoes, veggies, feta, pomegranate, and mixed greens. Super delicious! The dressing doesn't overpower the meal and the feta adds this creamy texture to the entire dish! Also, the pops of pomegranate in your mouth add a bit of a sour flavor to the meal while cleansing your pallet for another bite. 

Tugboat Eggs Benedict ($14) - We got it with Fried Chicken, avocados, poached eggs, and smoked tomato hollandaise sauce. This wasn't as good as we thought it would be. The chicken was not very crispy and didn't seem like there was enough salt in it to really bring out its natural flavors. Also, the hollandaise sauce didn't have a tang to it like we've had at other places.

Roasted Potatoes ($5) - This was really good! I really liked how crispy it was on the outside and that it was cooked with onions!

Yogurt Parfait ($5) - The best yogurt ever! Their yogurt was made in-house and I was told they make it with vanilla beans - which you can taste!! It comes topped with bananas, pomegranates, strawberries, blueberries, and walnuts. If you want one thing and don't want a full meal, get this!

Frenchie ($14) - Bonus meal because they screwed up our order thinking we got this! There's a fried chicken on french toast with hints of basil. We got this order by mistake and they let us have it - Thank you! It was really good, too! This chicken just tasted different than the one on the Tugboat - maybe it was the sweetness of the french toast that helped bring out the chicken's flavor? Or maybe because it was free? LOL I don't know but we ate it!

Parking: I don't believe they have a parking lot but you can park behind their building on Spring Street.

This place looks like a grab-n-go window, but offers indoor and outdoor seating. I like that you can watch the staff cook the food through the window. All the food is very fresh . My boyfriend and I both had the "Ahnold" which is an egg white scramble with various veggies and wheat toast. It was enjoyable and made me feel very healthy. He was bummed they no longer serve pancakes and have opted for french toast instead (which I'm sure is still delicious!)  Staff was friendly and on top of things.
This is a nice place. Quick service and great food! We had the Tugboat and Yolo. Definitely recommend!!!
Efficient service. Flavorful food. Good portion sizes. Wonderful presentation. Easy and no-fuss brunch.

We went there for the first time today and both had the General Sanders because it looked so good. It was as good as it looked and we'll be back to try some of the other menu items that look equally tempting.

Had the Jean Claude van Hamme, side of mac and cheese and the onion rings and it was all amazing!
I never thought that a simple sandwich with some ham and brie could taste that good but it did. The sandwich had thick slabs of both and I think they must have glazed the pork or something because it's porky goodness was cranked up with something sweet. That combined with the earthy creamy brie en the sharp arugula made this sandwich heaven on bread. Yay!!

The mac and cheese side was great too and pretty big for a side. It could have used a bit more oooopff but at the end of the meal I had eaten the whole thing so it must have been good ;)
The onion rings were great too. The crunch on them was something I never had before and I would definitely get them again. 

Only downside of this place, it's in such a weird location and the seating area is in the back so if you are not paying attention it's easy to miss. Loved the long tables and the friendly waiters. Great place :)

Popped in to get a latte (dreamy and frothy) and a Rolex. Wonderful! The Rolex had this spicy roasted tomato garlic sauce and was excellent! I am excited to see this coffee shop cafe on upper Milpas - it's been a neighborhood need for a long time! I can't wait to try the YOLO (You Only Live Once) - a buttermilk biscuit drenched in gravy - when the chef rolls it out. Great owners, nice place - welcome!

Very Good good and service here.
Love the environment very chill and relaxing.
I recommend eating here for you, Benedict is bombshell!

Literally the best little spot for breakfast, Lunch, and for drinks! 

Best yogurt parfait I have ever had, hands down! 

Anything you order to eat you won't disappointed. 

Best Michelada I have had in a while. Their iced Chai Tea is amazing. 

Can't wait to come back and try more from their menu!
Great spot for brunch! You can be as healthy or as indulgent as you want to be, and everything is fresh with generous portions.

This place was delicious! Came in on a Sunday morning, long line yet it went by very quickly.  We waited maybe 10 minutes at most for our food.  Awesome customer service, cool vibe and great food. We came in from L.A. to try this place because a friend recommended it.  Well worth the drive :)

This is a tiny little spot with only outdoor seating but the way they have done it, it feels like a garden instead of roadside. Very pretty.

The food was amazing. I wanted to try everything on the menu so I will definitely be back. I had a beet salad that was almost too pretty to eat. All the ingredients were very fresh and crispy with a tangy dressing. 

We also tried a tri-tip sandwich that had some caramelized onions that were so good it was hard to believe. The meat was tender and lean. 

In my opinion, this is a must try.  Maybe we will see you there.

Menu full of interesting sounding items. Chose the eggs Benedict (tugboat) with fried chicken. It was tasty but I think it was a little much (that's more the fault of my choice of food; the chicken was good just too much for the benedict). Definitely going back to try some other things.

If you find yourself in Santa Barbara in the morning, this place is a must!  It is literally attached to a tire shop, which I think provides great character and charm.  It's nice going to a place that isn't in a strip mall.   It was recommended by a local and I wasn't disappointed.  I had the "Tugboat" which was amazing!  It's one of their famous dishes, which is basically eggs Benedict, only we're talking fried chicken, avocado, and a homemade fresh biscuit as the base.  I'll definitely be back.

I really wanted to give this place 4 stars if not only for the name of the menu items but also the types of food they serve. A normal person may give it 4 stars, but for me the verdict is 3. 

I ordered the YOLO with poached egg. I expected amazing. I mean, who can turn down poached egg, buttermilk biscuit, fried chicken and gravy?

The idea is great. Execution not so much. 

Chicken was more of a thin cutlet, instead of savory chicken breast you'd expect. Biscuit tasted absolutely perfect and egg was cooked right. I could have dealt with the chicken but the gravy was overwhelming. I'm from the south, and trust me, I'm used to gravy. 

However, it was almost like they threw the meal into a full bowl of gravy. The gravy was okay in taste but when the gravy takes up more of the bowl than all the other ingredients you have a problem. 

Id give this place another shot. After all, their Benedict (tugboat) looked amazing as they were prepping it for another customer. I'd have ordered that but I was already mentally and physically committed to the YOLO. 

TIP: if weather is not great, very limited seating (and no ambience) inside. It has the feel of a large storage locker. Outside area looks nice, so go when it's nice out.

Fiancé recommended this place for breakfast since she visited for her bachelorette party weekend. Wow. As an eggs Benedict connoisseur, I can say with confidence that this was the best one I've ever had-named "the tugboat" with ham. I plan on returning for the same thing after the wedding at some point.

Great spot for a quick and casual breakfast. The toasts are HUGE and delicious! Had the egg and avocado toast and the banana almond butter toast. Loved them both. Order at the window then sit and wait less than 5min for food. Taste trumps all at this local corner spot.

This place is amazing! Great people, amazing food and a nice warm sunny patio to sit and chat on while enjoying anything off their menu. I've had the fries, onion rings, the shop burger, multiple breakfast specials, and they are all mouth drooling delicious! Go here anytime I'm in town! Must try!
everything was really good we got a bunch of things and all tried everything. I loved the arugula/ham/bree/honey sandwhich

One of my favorite places in town. The fried chicken eggs Benedict is my favorite dish, but it's only available on weekends. The Mac n cheese is also one of my favorite splurges. And they have a good selection of beers. It's clear the staff enjoys working here, everyone is always smiling.

This was by far my favorite place in Santa Barbara! There are very few places where you can get a gourmet breakfast that costs less than Denny's. I bought 2 orders of the "in your face." Its two poached eggs on top of homemade bread and cured salmon. The salmon tastes like sashimi and is way better than lox. Overall great experience. If you can only choose one place in Santa Barbara this is it.

Third and final time im coming here, 3 strikes and your out right? If you put the name of your establishment on the burger it better be a Damm good burger. It wasnt. Homemade bun? Okay sure that's great if it's good, but you might want to fire your baker. And the names of all the menu items is just stupid, it's not cute and it's not funny, way over the top. This place reminds me of a Brooklyn breakfast hideout or LA food truck that created the menu off of a  Buzzfeed list "25 Most Hipster Breakfast Items of 2011" 

Pros.. outdoor seating, and it's also right next to Ceasars Mexican restaurant that has the best damn micheladas in town. 

2 stars

Best hidden gem in downtown Santa Barbara! Their fried chicken Benedict was amazing, they have great iced coffee and sparking kombucha on tap. I didn't get their breakfast burrito or French toast but both looked incredible. I will absolutely be back!
Great breakfast spot. Capuccino excellent, had the poached eggs with salmon which were very tasteful. Certainly recommend this place.

The food is good here. I highly recommend it for the breakfast choices. I just ate there with my wife who had a great plate. Mine was ok but it is my fault because I ordered the wrong thing. Here is my only complaint about the place: Mediocre customer service. The staff seems very entitled. Their vibe is very millennial generation with no old world courtesy and charm. I would consider coming back but I recommend to the owner that he/she teach the employers a few graces. For example: "I'm sorry. We no longer have that dish you saw on Yelp on the menu but here are some suggestions..." or "Might I suggest this as an alternative?" or "Please pick up your coffee order around here to your left and we'll bring your food order to your table shortly." or "Here is your food order. Is there anything else I can get you folks. Enjoy!" or simply "Welcome to The Shop Cafe! What can I get you folks?" Just a humble suggestion that I think would go a long way.  Continued success regardless!

Get The tugboat (eggs Benedict ) because the hollandaise is yummy and the eggs perfectly cooked and best ham too .

Sweet cakes was that sweet.

Like the fact it's a casual Brekkie place and filled with beautiful people.
It was great they have a lot of choices and it all tasted great! The orange juice was amazing too. I highly recommend for a savory breakfast!

I can not tell you how excited i was when i found this place by driving by! after just moving to SB from Venice(where there is yummy food everywhere) it has been a little challenging to find creative, affordable food in SB. Well The Shop nailed it!  The burger I had there was crave worthy, came back the next day for breakfast and again was thrilled. They are very kid friendly which is rare and the prices are great.  The staff is super friendly and the owner was so nice to my friend and her little 2 year old, that says a lot.... I am pretty sure I will be a regular here.
First time visiting Santa Barbara and our best breakfast me and my wife . The cashier was very nice and helpful with our Groupon and the food was amazing and different style of breakfast

I've been there more than ten times now and never has their food or the customer service failed me! The employees are very sweet, the food is amazing, and the price is great for how high quality the food is! It has to be my favorite restaurant in Santa barbara! I highly recommend everyone tries this place at least once, you won't be disappointed.

I love this place. No matter what you get it will be delicious and flavorful. All of their food is made with quality ingredients and is perfected down to a T. You can't go wrong with this place weather you choose it for brunch or lunch. One of my favs from here is the general Saunders fried chicken sandwich. Definitely a must try!!!
Great service. Easy set up for families. We really enjoyed the grilled cheese sandwich, the general (fried chicken salad) and the strawberry shake.
Not what it justo be... Bring the diced potatoes for that breakfast salad and the beats.... Hum

Just had breakfast here,5 people including 3 kids!
Phenomenal in delicacy,taste,esthetics. Eggs Benedict with chicken - great choice! Loved my choice of poached eggs with veggies on gluten free toast!
The wide and tasty  variety of options on the menu make the rusty chairs and wobbly tables seem like ambiance. A gem !!

This place used to be 5-stars but the quality has been suffering lately. 

I ordered their BLT today, which comes with avocado. I was dismayed to find that the avocado they used was black and brown. I love avocado but there is nothing more disgusting than rotting avocado. They also drenched the sandwich in mayo.

The last two times I ordered the smoothie, they left out the key ingredient (basil), and I ended up with a pretty mediocre smoothie. The first time I asked about the basil and they said they had run out. The second time I ordered it I clarified with the cashier that the smoothie still had basil in it, but still got a smoothie with no basil.

Anyway, I think you can still get great food here. But you may need to be lucky, or just willing to send your food back until you get what you ordered.

Cannot say enough about this amazing find. My husband and I went two mornings in a row as we couldn't find a better breakfast spot in SB durning our stay, and it was not for lack of trying. Highly recommend.

I see why they are rated so high on yelp. Great food and atmosphere. Nice patio to sit and enjoy a leisurely brunch on sundays (if you can ignore all the people staring at you, as they wait for a table to open up) :-)

Always looking for new places to eat with my hubby, we found the shop cafe. Incredible coffee and breakfast is served here. The tugboat and the Rolex were in tasty and fresh. The biscuit was perfectly fluffy with a hint of sweetness. The Rolex had a very savory sauce on an Indian type flat bread. The mocha and vanilla latte was 5 stars. Great job guys.

I'm a big fan of The Shop.  It feels family owned and has a great space to eat outdoors, a must in my opinion for dining in paradise Santa Barbara.  The food comes out quick and delicious.  I recommend the Salmon in yo face, for less than $10 its a steal!
Came into town for a weekend getaway and came across this place from yelp. Was not disappointed get the YOLO!!!

I have been here several times and everything I had was delish!  The warm biscuit was amazing and every cup of coffee was perfect: smooth, warm, and with my cappuccino, frothy goodness!  The people are cheerful and the music is good. I can't wait for warmer weather to sit on their patio in the sun. Check it out, it is worth it.

Parked to walk to the Bowl for a concert and wanted to grab a bite to eat and have a glass of wine. they were open during bowl season for their lunch menu and some wine and beer. had a GREAT quinoa salad and my brother had some fish tacos. I would make this my regular stop. Open parking across the street, super close tot he bowl and nice outside patio. great addition to the night!
Such a great place tucked in on Milpas. The environment was friendly and the food was delicious. Perfect little cafe for a sunny day.

Really good food and friendly staff. I would prefer ordering from the table rather than a window. I would have tipped way better too. I had carnitas eggs Benedict. Yummy. Menu full of creative dishes.

Ugly rainy day so we sat inside.  The area was packed but food comes quick.

Grab a menu (in basket near window) and order at window.

There is a nice, large patio area for sunny days.

Mimosas are great!

I had the poached egg with avocado, jalapeños and some kind of cheese, maybe feta on delicious wheat bread, my husband had to Yolo.  Everything was great!

Fantastic breakfast and super filling!

Pretty good a bit pricey no fountain drinks which sucks and the burger comes with chips you have to order the fries separately 

But the food was good and the burger had kinda a unique taste to it

So much yum! The service was great! And the were so incredibly fast. Everything tasted so delicious...especially the eggs Benedict. You cannot go wrong with whichever one you order. Their outdoor seating was also very cute too.

I always get the banana toast.
It take moderate time for the
food to come. But I entertain
myself. Usually. When you
get the Banana toast ,it's
a little too filling.


-A Second grader
