YOLO. Need I say anymore? I absolutely loved everything about the yolo breakfast - fried chicken, biscuits, gravy, all topped with an egg! So delicious! Service was quick and all the food was perfectly cooked. Breakfast for two with coffee totaled about $40, but it was worth every penny!
Delicious, fresh tasting healthy choices with fast, friendly service and Kombucha!!! I'll definitely be back

SO. GOOD. 
New american, fresh, funky flavors. The Sweet Maria is tantalizing, balancing sweet with savory and slapped in a sandwich. Yum. Everything I've tried Ive left impressed. Staff is friendly, enthusiastic and patient/helpful!

Breakfast and Lunch, last time I was by earlier and it seemed like a popular place for brunch with room for a handful of families/groups, a few couples and some seating to spare. 

Patio has an inviting courtyard feel, with surrounding hedge and neat tables. There are sun umbrellas at each table but bring a jacket if its chilly.
Delicious, fun and creative menu.  Friendly owners with great customer service.  And they have a patio in a city where your always going to want to eat outside.

Price was way to high for the General Sanders, the chicken was way to small and they used extra coleslaw to make up for it.  It should be called General Slaw. I am fine with a pricy chicken sandwich but it better be tasty and a decent size. 
The Sanders wasn't! While I was dealing with my lack luster meal my friend was attempting to eat her fish tacos that she described as "off and inedible". Both of us were still hungry so we unfortunately wasted another $12, and ordered Just The Tip.   A tri tip sandwich that we were going to split.   We waited over 20 mins, then I asked if we could get it to go.  Since we were head to the SB bowl for a concert.  The second I bit in to the sandwich the only thing noticeable was how grisly the tritip was. My friend and I deconstructed the sandwich to try and pick out any decent meat, there were only a few nibbles. Needless to say, if we had stayed I would have demanded my money back. The only good thing was the staff, they were very friendly. Save your time, save your money.   Go to Los Agaves, it's a few blocks away, great food at a worthy price.   We Will Never Go There Again!!!
That eggs benedict. man....You ain't lived 'till you tried it. Biscuits are fluffy and firm enough to stand up to the sauce and egg yolk. 'The Bacon', you ask? Oooh Weee!

in one word....STOP! At first glance you may not want to stop, but do. This is one of the best places I have ever eaten at. Everything was fresh, looked great and tasted better! Everyone from ordering to server was very friendly and asked how things were. I would highly recommend this, as a must.

Fantastic!  Loved every part of the experience, from the interesting and inviting menu, to the clean and nice-smelling bathroom.  Kid-friendly, great staff, great owners, and most importantly, great food!  The only thing that could make it better would be a play area for kids so that parents can sit back and enjoy a meal while the kids play.  Thanks for a great time today!
Came on a Saturday morning and had the Tugboat with salmon. AMAZING! Definitely a place I would come again whenever I come to Santa Barbara.

This is ok place for food, but a little bit too expensive based on the environment they have. There aren't many seats compared to the lines. We order the egg Benedict with fried chicken and banana toast. Both are pretty good. But the so-called handlebar coffee is terrible!
Nice little gem on Milpas. Loved the "Salmon in Yo Face". Although all of their breakfast items looked amazing. Can't wait to try more of their menu.

I am an original customer remembering when it just opened and thinking "Boy, I hope they make it here"  They are located on Milpas Street, out-of-the-way from the busy State Street.  It's worth the "trek" of a few blocks!  

The food is original in the way it's presented and put together but not fussy.  It's GOOD fresh food.  The portion size has increased since it opened which is appreciated.  

Breakfast is our "go-to" here in town and this is the spot.  Oatmeal is a surprise, eggs are served in different ways.  Their home-made blueberry muffin is a must and the coffee is French Press.  Now, it can actually be crowded:)  Good for them.  

You order and pay at the counter then sit with your number and your food is delivered to your table.  There are places to sit outside on picnic benches under umbrellas and for inside space, several tables as well.
Stopped by this little place on a road trip. Ordered the YOLO and a parfait. The best decision ever. The chicken was perfect and the parfait tasted like a light ice cream

SB AXXESS CARD buy one entree get one free! Cannot beat this!!

I came here with my boyfriend to check out this cool new spot on Milpas in Santa Barbara. It is located on a very busy street and in a unique foodie area. I could tell it was going to be a fun experience judging by the vintage airstream out front as well as the cool industrial architecture. You start off your adventure at The Shop by ordering at the window. They offer an amazing array of foods. From salads to delicious sandwiches and craft beer (THEY EVEN HAVE MAUI BREW CO), this place is definitely a MUST TRY when visiting SB.

I had the General Sanders chicken sandwich and it was fantastic! The chicken was perfectly crisp and tender and practically melted in my mouth. But the secret was the delicious slaw that was on the yummy homemade biscuit! ORGASMIC!

You can taste the local freshness and that makes me happy :)

I will be back!

They have plenty of patio seating as well as indoor seating and I did notice a dog on the patio so they are pretty cool. I can't wait to go back and get their crazy pecan infused mac and cheese! YUM!
We got the fried chicken and French toast, amazing combo, great beading and flavor, not too heavy!

Food is ok. Portion is good. 

In Yo Face Salmon: good. Toast is very good.

Salmon Benedict: Salmon good. Sauce average. Biscuit, bad, wth is wrong with it? It's a tasteless scone.

Coffee is some of the most HORRIBLE coffee I have had. Reminds me of the 80s when coffee tasted sour, bitter, and chemical like.

I read the reviews, looked at the menu, and this placed sounded like they had fun with the menu but took the food seriously so I went and ordered the Yolo...Buttermilk Fried Chicken with gravy & a house baked biscuit...and I had a fresh Blueberry Muffin right out of the oven...everything was just ok...They used less costly thigh meat so I had to ask if it was in fact dark meat because it was so pink and I did not want to risk illness, the biscuit was good but it and the chicken were actually sitting in a large pool of gravy in a bowl with a big chip in it. I tried to be a trooper and eat it anyway, but could not bring myself to finish it  : (
A hole in the wall place, has good food.  I ordered the Tug boat.  The home made smoked salmon was good.

Dog friendly! Health food friendly! Vegetarian friendly! 

Pros: 
- Great outdoor seating where dogs are welcome. Several large picnic-style tables with umbrellas and one long family-style table. 
- It's a super cute place. You order at the window, pay and take your number. They are friendly. The to-go cups have stamps of a little dog on them. The food is fast. The menu items have cute names. 

Menu items: 
- Eggs in yo face (V): Two poached eggs on a thick cut slice of (homemade?) white toast. Yum!
- Bowl of fruit: I thought ~$4 was a little steep but it was a big bowl with fresh banana, orange, blueberries and sliced red apple.
- Tugboat: Eggs Benedict (two biscuits, poached eggs, hollandaise, ham and avocado). They were happy to sub tomato slices for ham to make this vegetarian.
- Rolex: Eggs, bacon and tomato spread wrapped in a flatbread.
- YOLO: Biscuits, fried chicken and gravy. This looked delicious. 

Notes: It's street parking. This is a local place not like having brunch on State Street. I had trouble with the menu on their website, but another one is available here: https://orderup.com/restaurants/the-shop-cafe-santa-barbara/takeout.

After not finding parking in the beach across the street from SB Community College, the family and I drove around in search of a breakfast sandwich or burrito and pulled up Yelp to find this spot. Picked up the Sando (ham, egg, cheese, mayo on Ciabatta) and hubby got the salmon-in-yo-face (cured salmon, capers, on Texas toast) and took it to a nearby park to eat while my little girl played on the playground. Oh yeah, and we got one homemade biscuit for my daughter. Where should I start? The $4 biscuit was freakin deelish. Hubby and I ate what our daughter didn't. My Sando was huge! I only ate half and gave some of the scrambled egg to my 10 month old and some ham to my 2yr old. The bread was so fresh and the sandwich was deelish. Hubby ate the other half, as his breakfast wasn't  as large. Would we visit again when we are in town? Uhh YEAH!

Love having this little gem two blocks from my house! I used to kind of only walk to Buen Gusto, but this is my new favorite spot. Everything I've tried is perfect and it's fun sitting outside with the unobstructed riviera view. The pink neon piggy sign puts a smile on my face on my drive home from work!
Amazingly tasty and creative food. Love the tugboat, but I seriously haven't ordered anything there I haven't liked. Decent portions for the price and holy heck it's delicious.

Great breakfast! The Shop Cafe is exactly what you'd expect from it's popularity and all the pictures here of runny poached eggs, fried chicken, and thick slices of toasted, buttery bread. 

I ordered the house-cured smoked salmon and poached eggs and creme fraiche on toast which was just as delicious as it looks in pictures. Ordering was somewhat awkward, as this dish is called "Justin-yo-face", as opposed to just "in yo face", which is only slightly less awkward.

Overall, a really solid breakfast/brunch/lunch option in Santa Barbara, away from the craziness of downtown and State Street.

I'm giving one star for the coffee...because the food deserves 0 stars...I spit out the greasy piece of chicken soaked in some separated cream that tasted like raw sausage smells...(yolo)...frenchie wasnt much better fench toast was already soggy when I started eating it...not sure what the big fuss is about this place... very disappointed spent $33 and got good coffee and 2 plates of yuck...left with no appetite!

This place is awesome!!!!!

Amazing food. Eggs Benedict with smoked tomato hollandaise.  Delicious!!!!!
One of the best Breakfast spots in town. Its awesome to see a restaurant doing outside the box stuff!

As I chowed down on the "Rollex" I pondered what I would write about this cafe and thought I would give a 3, maybe a 4 out of 5. The food didn't blow me away (I like a stronger kick of flavor) but I thought points were deserved for friendly staff and a chill atmosphere. 

However, mid consumption, I found a 3 inch hair in my breakfast wrap, snug as a bug in a rug.

Needless to say I did not finish my meal.

I let one of the staff know and although he offered to "get me next time" I'm from out of town so unfortunately that won't do me much good.

I gave a 2/5 because the food tasted good (not great), the staff was nice, and I liked the atmosphere. This place had potential but hair in my food? Yuck.

I had really wanted to eat breakfast here, but being a late riser without an immediate appetite, it's a bit tough.

I stopped by here to grab a coffee and a pastry of some sort.

Coffee was excellent.

I chose the blueberry muffin. They looked a bit funny, but oddly delicious.

Delicious it was. The blueberries were fresh and the muffin had the most perfect amount of sweetness.

I took a look at the plates being served, and they all look amazing.

Staff is really friendly and welcoming.

Saw this place on a friends snapchat story and knew I had to try it out myself, the place did not disappoint! Their famous Tugboat with the fried chicken was very yummy. I'm not the biggest fan of hollandaise sauce so I got in on the side, but their smoked tomato hollandaise sauce made the dish! It's so good!! I thought the biscuit could have been a little bit better, but still a great breakfast. 

Outdoor seating is definitely the way to go here. It's kinda small so might be a little crowded on the weekends, but I went on a Thursday and had no problems! 

They also have a Rosé Spritzer, and a Kombucha Sangria on the menu. Love the fresh take on brunch cocktails!!
Best brunch spot in SB. You have to try the Rolexx or the Tugboat. Its unforgettable.

A diamond among the Milpas shops. This place is consistently good, consistently friendly and a newly wrought staple in my weekly breakfasting. 

Couple of recommendations: the Rollex, the Salmon-in-Yo-Face (add eggs, add heirloom tomatoes) and the Eggs-in-Yo-Face(add bacon, add avocado). 

Espresso is perfect -- which is something Milpas has been lacking for as long as I can remember. 

I see a lot of people order the Tugboat on the weekend, but I've never had the guts. It looks DECADENT. 

Hope these folks are open for a long, long time.

This is a great spot for brunch! The tugboat is amazing but I have tried a lot of different food on the menu and never been disappointed. My boyfriend and I come here about once every two weeks we love it so much. Best micheladas and fruit parfaits in town!
I can't wait to go back! This is the best breakfast place ever! Food was sooo good and the portions were huge. Definitely worth the wait.  Hands down, my favorite breakfast spot.

Lunch was wonderful! 
We had fish tacos, burgers, salads, cookies... And all of it was great! There was something for everyone.
Yum food and coffee. Salmon Benedict was yum. Fried chicken Benedict was yum. Coffee and kombucha was yum too.
We were skeptical from the outside looking in. But the food was extremely tasty. We really enjoyed our breakfast. Highly recommend.

Omg this place is amazing! I had to drive around the block 3 times to find this place and a place to park but it was actually so worth it! To find the shop, look for the yellow umbrellas or the tire shop sign. For parking, I recommend parking in the neighborhood by Spring St which is just on the other side of The Shop Kitchen.
The service was great, everyone was really nice and helpful! You order at the window then you can find a place to sit down but they do call your number from the window facing the tables so you can grab your drink. For food, they'll bring it to you. The food was soooooo good! I got the Banana Almond Butter Toast, Orange June, and Tugboat with fried chicken and I don't even like fried chicken but I loved this dish! Everything tasted so fresh and delicious! I wish they opened one in OC but can't wait to go back again!

Great for brunch. The eggs Benedict was delicious. It's served over a biscuit which is unusual and very filling. The only negative thing to say was that they have a smoker in the seating area constantly blowing out smoke that smells like campfire.
Perfect little breakfast place.  Very simplistic, but flavorful!  Totally going back.

Loved shop kitchen! My husband got the tugboat and I got simple bacon and eggs but lemme tell you the sourdough bread that came with it was worth it alone to comeback. My husband gave his fried chicken eggs benedict a 10. The staff was amazingly friendly and accommodating. Will definitely be back.

I came here last Sunday with some friends for my 21st birthday brunch and it was the best setting for this kind of celebration. There is an open dining area outside with tables, benches, and umbrellas that scan sit large parties perfectly. Bathrooms and more seating exists inside too. This place was very convenient because you order before you take your table, making it very accommodating for multiple people and their separate tabs. 

This place also serves Handlebar coffee roasters and they make a bulletproof coffee which I plan to try sometime. But the Kombucha Sangria, made local in Santa Barbara by Conscious Kombucha (MY FAVORITE), made my birthday 5x better than any mimosa could have.

The food was fantastic, from the eggs benedict to the various flavors of toppings for toast. I cannot wait to come back. 

I think it is important to mention that the drinks come out immediately so you can drink it while you wait for your food.

Although my food didn't arrive until 45 minutes after the fact and all of my guests had eaten already, I was still very happy with my experience here because everyone had a good time, the drinks were good, the service was friendly, and the food was bomb.

We met one of the owners last night.  We are always down to support locals and Friends of friends businesses.  We were not disappointed.  Awesome.  The burger and the General Sanders were out if this world.  My kid destroyed the smoothie.  
      The ingredients we're all fresh, and local.  The staff were all friendly, smiling and happy to be here.  My favorite part was that the prepping and plating area is right there in the window as you order.  We are going to be back soon and often.  Nice work guys.

DELICIOUS 
I believe it is called the salmon tugboat, but that's my go-to thing to order. I live right next to Milpas and it is by far one of my favorite places to eat on this street. I wish it wasn't so expensive of a breakfast place, but the portions are filling & large so that's worth it! 

Also, I'm absolutely obsessed with the bullet coffee. I had never heard of it until my first visit to the Shop, but now I crave it. According to various articles I've read (I ain't no doctor) it's supposed to work wonders for your metabolism because it has added butter (good kind) & healthy oil to substitute a good amount of your fat intake for the day with healthy fats! And it's just the creamiest most delicious cup of Joe I ever did taste
Great place for breakfast! My first bullet proof coffee which was really good and I ordered the tug boat with Ham. Defiantly worth the stop.
I LOVE THIS PLACE! It's a really cute place and general sanders is my favorite! I think it's a little pricey but everything on the menu is really fresh and good

Stumbled upon this place while looking for somewhere to eat before going to The Bowl.  Turns out there are not a lot of options within walking distance.  It's place does need some better signage because you could easily miss them.  They also need something to indicate that their shop does a lot of homemade options, because at first glance, we dismissed them, they had a limited menu and the board said cheeseburger or chicken nuggets and we thought, bleh.

So glad we chose here.  Burger was very thin, not like the ones shown in photos on here.  It had an excellent crust which we loved and fantastic flavor.  The fries were thin and really tasty and came with house made ketchup which was so good.  This came with a soda for 9 which ended up being a good deal considering the quality.

We definitely want to go back and try the rest of the menu.  They are usually only open for breakfast and lunch, but if you are going to the bowl, see if they are open.

I've been to the shop so many times and always had great experiences. I noticed that they started to change their presentation of their items slightly about 6 months ago (aka smaller portions for still the same prices). Today when I went some of their menu items were removed (such as "The Ahhhnold") and some new items were added. When I got to the window, I asked the woman if they no longer had The Ahhhnold, she said they didn't and replaced it with the frittata. When I asked why, she said it was to make it easier and faster for the cooks (what the heck?!??). Mind you, the frittata had different ingredients on different menus. One menu it included a baguette and cauliflower. Another menu it included no cauliflower and sourdough toast. When I asked her what it actually had she seemed to be annoyed and asked the cooks. So I ordered the frittata with hopes of it living up to the previous plate that they used to have on their menu. When it got to the table, the slice was smaller than the size of my hand (I have really really small hands) and seemed like it had been pre-prepared and just heated up (no wonder it's easier for the cooks). I'm ok with change but not when it's for the worse. After having this experience, and seeing the owners response to a previous review written by someone else, I will never be giving them my business again. Now off to go find more breakfast since I'm not filled at all.

What a surprise!!!! Located beside Tire Place thus the name The Shop.  Service was fast.  Food is very tasty and fresh.  My son enjoyed his French Toast.   Wife has fresh muffin.  I couldn't decide what to get- the lady who helped me recommend the Colonel Saunders.    What a great advised!!!  Chicken was breaded nicely, topped with carrot cole slaw- a perfect topping.  Definitely a try if you are in SB.

Quite possibly the best breakfast in SB. Breakfast is our thing(me and wife). We hit them all. I wolfed down the Rollex and wifey had the Prius. Latte was only thing close average even though they use French Press coffee. This defiantly be on our circuit. Wish they were in a different locale even though it's close to our house.
Loved it!  Excellent food and service.  Very dog friendly.  We had the eggs benedict and the banana peanut butter toast - both were excellent.

My wife and I came here on a Sunday morning on Memorial day weekend and the food was SOOOOOO GOOODDDD!!!!!  I had the sweet cakes (banana pancakes) and my wife had the tugboat which is an Eggs Benedict with homemade biscuits and heirloom tomatoes that they only serve on the weekends.  We also had 2 mimosa's and they were AMAZING!!!  
 
We ate on the patio with our 2 small dogs and it was great.  The place is a little hard to spot when coming from the north.  There's a bunch of signage for the auto shop next door but not this place.  But you can tell it's a cafe because of all the unbrella's in front and most likely the line.

The only reason I have to take off a star is the line moves VERY slowly.  I realize it was our first time and only time there and it was a holiday weekend but a local told me the line is always slow.  So don't go here if you need food fast or are in a rush but it is totally worth the wait!!!  And I think I saw you can phone in your order, that might be quicker.  

Much love,
Trev
Breakfast salad, side of bacon, and coffee were all delicious!! Atmosphere was peaceful and relaxing. Employees were very friendly and attentive. Music was great :)

Deftly composed, breakfast at the Shop Cafe is filling, but not gut-busting, entertainment for your mouth. Had the salmon in yo-face with the egg and heirloom tomatoes: the dill and sour cream elevated the salmon wonderfully. The Tug-Boat (eggs Benedict with the buttermilk fried chicken) was delicious and should be partial to anyone who is partial to the mix of sage and tangy. Totally recommend the place, even if the iced tea is forgettable and not particularly good, as the server led me to believe.

Tucked away in an industrial area and not touristy at all. Walk up to order and have a seat outside (which gives you a view of some homes on the mountain) a tad pricey but worth it because you can tell everything is homemade. Fresh squeezed OJ as well. I'd go back and try other items on the menu.
Visiting Santa Barbara for a few days, and found this place on recomendation from a server petit valentin.Good Coffee, friendly people, tasty eats.

This place is like a food truck turned restaurant - it might've been. Idk. Place is very hip and laid back. There's outdoor seating, seat yourself or you can eat inside. The names on the menu just makes you wanna order everything. The food we ordered was brought out to us pretty quick. The portions aren't humongous but not small either. I got the souper cheesy. The tomato soup is good by itself - I also used it as a dip for the grilled cheese that came with my meal! I tried some of my friend's Yolo and the one bite is delicious. I'd love to come back for more.

Ohhhh how do I love this place let me count the ways. I was in town over the summer and had one of those hangovers when you truly think you won't make it through the day.

Cut to the breakfast sandwich in the wrap burrito - oh my God. Life saving. It was filling and ingredients were super fresh, and was not at all "greasy spoon" heavy.

I also LOVE that you order first and then sit and get your food - in cases of severe hangovers this is essential. Very family and dog-friendly patio, too!

I ordered Rollex which was super good! My friend had eggs Benedict with fried chicken which was very tasty too. The only thing is that the outside benches and tables were not very clean. In all, it's a lovely place for breakfast.

OK its been way to long for me to write this review.  This place rocks!!!  You got to get down here and try The Shop.  Everything is home made, everything.  Great little local spot on Milpas, chill outdoor seating, and fantastic food.  Everything is less than or around 10 bucks.  I usually come here for breakfast and get the YOLO, omg its amazing.  A buttermilk fried biscuit grilled in half and covered in sausage gravy then topped with fried chicken, are you kidding me.  They have great burgers and fries, salads, and wraps.  Homemade rolls and desserts, killer mac on crack, oh yes, and great smoothies.  I hear there coffee is really good too.  Thank you to The Shop for opening and bring SB some great food.

Please do not be deceived by the high star reviews! We were excited to visit based on their ratings, but were very disappointed. We prepped our coffees and hadn't even sat down when the waiter was already waiting with our dishes behind us! How fresh was our food????!!! The chilaquiles were very soggy and the carnitas were tasteless. The green sauce did not have any spice to it whatsoever. I only took a few bites and decided not too overload on carbs for a bad dish. The Benedict: the fried chicken was over cooked and the breading tasted too eggy. The bread was soggy. To top it off our bill was 50 dollars! We left sad and disappointed. Don't come here.
Great food. Eggs Benedict was perfect. The biscuit was soft and melts in your mouth. They out thick slices of maple bacon then two big eggs on top.
What a find! New to the area and this is my kind of place. Healthy, delicious food in a casual setting. Unique menu items in addition to main stream. So yummy!!! We will be back . . . Thank you!

Amazing! I am definitely a harsh cretic when it comes to food but this place was fantastic. Great flavor super chill and comfortable setting. I had the salmon toast and French toast with chicken and my girlfriend had the maple bacon eggs Benedict. All three dishes were fantastic

Nice outdoor patio. I had the tugboat with fried chicken. Bechamel was great, eggs perfect, interesting, tasty biscuit, unfortunately avos were hard as a rock and there was a 1 cm piece of seed in mine. The fried chicken was good, but to me there was a little bit of a fishy (?) taste to the batter. Maybe the oil was et end of life? That being said, my husband had the YOLO and detected none of that with his fried chicken. He loved it and said he would come back again. Which we will. The Rollex was pretty good. The bacon was awesome and the tortilla was fresh and delicious. The avocado toast was marginal only because the avocados were not ripe. The toast, eggs and bacon were all amazing. Unfortunate about the avos today. Ripe ones would have elevated the whole shebang. The coffee (Handlebar) was great. Yogurt parfait was exceptional. I could taste vanilla and honey, just the right proportion of each. The fruit was fresh and yumService was fantastic. Got our food quickly and the staff was helpful and friendly. We will come back again.
Amazing brunch food! I am always craving the Rolex wrap. They serve handlebar coffee which is a nice touch. I love the adorable outdoor patio!

Great food!  Made with local, farm fresh ingredient, and it's amazing!  We had the fried chicken eggs Benedict and the maple bacon eggs Benedict- both looked good and were delicious. Not like a typical restaurant... you order outside and then choose a place to sit- either outside or inside; doesn't look like a restaurant from the front either so be on the lookout for it!  Overall, I would definitely recommend stopping at this jem!

My family and I visited the Shop Café for breakfast and lunch on the same day while vacationing in Santa Barbara. We all felt Shop Café delivers outstanding food and value.

There is something to be said about fewer choices at a restaurant, as it might allow the kitchen to focus on making one great item, as opposed to a few pretty good varieties of the same item.

Less is more applies not only to the number of smoothie choices (1) but the utter lack of ingredients in their outstanding strawberry yogurt basil smoothie. It is not overly sweet and tastes more sophisticated than the sugary offerings from Jamba Juice.

We all sampled the oatmeal, and I really enjoyed the McQueen quiche. It was one of the better quiches I have had in quite some time due to the lightness and flavor of the cheese, and I loved the beans at the bottom. The salsa was creative, subtle, and really made the McQueen sing. Our best local French restaurants in Boston could learn something from the Shop Café about quiche!

We all came back for lunch, and I had the Shrimp Po Boy special. Everything about it from the way the shrimp was undercooked to the mayonaisse based sauce to the bread was perfect. I could have had another, except that I was stuffed. 

If I lived in Santa Barbara, I'd come back at least once a week!

Why on earth would you ever want to eat here for breakfast? My girlfriend and I went there for breakfast and the woman who took our order couldn't of been any more friendlier - yes, I'm  being very sarcastic. We ordered our food at the window and she was acting as if she had more important things to do than serve us. Apparently customers aren't important here. I ordered the chicken, gravy and biscuits - and potatoes and bacon - which our side dishes came out first. The best thing on the menu was the bacon . Even getting silverware was a hassle. The only person who was decent to us was a smiling woman who was cleaning up afterbus and she promptly provided us a box. Honestly, I ate there an hour ago and I feel gross and sluggish. Is this SB restaurant trying too hard to be like LA? Nice try but even similar restaurants in LA have better service and items on their menu. Definitely not worth it!

I went here today for the first time after reading the review in the independent several weeks ago and wanting to go....  I had the fried chicken sandwich and i myself make fried chicken all the time and very well i might add, i own a fry daddy and everything and this was deliscious and all around worth it.  i was impressed and i sure hope this place sticks around for a long time cuz i'm gonna keep coming back!!!!!!!!!!!!
Food is great! The chilaquiles are very good and my favorite item here. Disclaimer*** these are not authentic chilaquiles, so don't expect that. Never the less, they are good. Definitely recommend!

Excellent food at a great location.

Great menu selection and comfortable outdoor Patio seating
Great find, cool hipster place in an industrial part of SB. Eggs Benedict done to perfection with huge portions enough to share.

How is there not an hour long wait for a table here???  We were in town for the weekend and ended up eating here twice in two days.  After our Sunday morning breakfast of the Tugboat with bacon, French toast with strawberries and bananas, Conscious pineapple kombucha on tap and iced mocha we started planning a group road trip back up just for breakfast. It was amazing.

What I ordered was basic. Eggs in your face and a banana in your face. I really wish the bananas had been cooked, it would have taken the dish over the top. As far as the bread they serve these two dishes on, it's very good. Crunch, savory, and tasty. My hubs had the yolo and was in heaven. All I heard were moans and groans during our breakfast (awkward). 3 stars because my meals were underwhelming. Wish I would have tried something else.

I want to give them more stars, and I even came back a second day in a row to try something different, but the best parts of the meal both days were the coffee and the service. And the prices were really high for what you get. We spent $40 for 2 people each day.
To start with, they've got some creative ideas for putting food together in an ambitious way that somehow just fell short both times. 
Day 1: tug boat with salmon, chilaquiles, yogurt parfait and vanilla latte. Tug boat is on a biscuit that wasn't really cooked through, and the eggs were over cooked (not runny). Chilaquiles we asked in advance if they are crispy and crunchy (ie not soggy). Their answer was yes, but the chips were soggy on arrival because of the green sauce they mix the chips with. For anyone reading, I would just ask for them deconstructed and build it myself. The yogurt parfait was good but they serve it in a jar that is ridiculously small given their spoon options lol.
Day 2: Rollex, muffin, and French toast. The rollex was filling, but the avocado just didn't mix right with the other ingredients. Eggs were bland. The French toast was good, but the cheddar cheese and ham were a bit over the top stuffed inside.
This place has 4.5 stars so maybe I'm missing something. Again, I think they're ambitious, but the execution was just a little off on the things we ordered.

Visiting from out of town and wish this place was closer to home! Cool spot with nice outdoor seating. The food was sooooo good! The Eggs Benedict on a homemade biscuit was incredible!  There are some great healthier options too. Everything is fresh, and flavorful. Just finished breakfast and I'm tempted to go back for lunch later:)

A bit pricy for the quality of food. Some of the kale leafs were yellow. The seating area is not well kept. 

The good stuff? The staff is very friendly. I like the open dining area. I enjoy cooks and chefs trying to explore their art...

Cheers!

So very, very happy to have a cafe on Milpas other than Mexican food.  We need a variety & this is perfect!  Had coffee & cinnamon roll-yummy.  Good to know we can come here for coffee - sit outside in nice weather & dog friendly.  Breakfast today will either be the Rolex or the oatmeal.  Richie described the oatmeal & it sounds luscious.  Keep up the good work Chris & all the others we need you in the neighborhood......

This place is super cute. I randomly found this awesome spot via trusty old Yelp and it was so awesome.  All my friends kept asking me how I found this hidden gem as we were all leaving Santa Ynez wine country and some of us were headed to Los Angeles, and some to Las Vegas, and The Shop Café was still on the way for all of us.

As we were driving there, it is sort of hard to miss so watch out for it.  Small restaurant with a large dining patio which is bench cafeteria style seating with umbrellas on the tables.  The indoor dining area consists of about 5 tables, 2 tops and a 4 top.  Not really made for seating large groups inside at all.  

Super friendly staff. We went when it wasn't so busy so that was a plus.  You order before you sit.  And they give you a # where they bring your food to you.

I ordered a variety breakfast which I basically ordered each item off the menu: 2 egg scramble, side of bacon, and potatoes.  Honestly, out of everything,  Ienjoyed the potatoes the most.  They are a home made recipe and is delicious as a side.  Eggs are eggs, and the bacon was too sweet and soft for my liking... and i'm not one of the CRUNCHY bacon eaters... I like a range of cooked well but not too crispy.  Anywho, I returned the bacon b/c it came WAAAAAyyyyyy later, so I got a refund.  

My friends ordered the ROLEX and the Bananas in yo FACE! Both yum!!

Rolex is made with fresh ingredients, definitely can share with a friend and order something else b/c it is pretty big and it gets a little boring.

Bananas in yo face, homemade almond butter?  I think so... delicious!!!!  Very rich so not for the faint of heart!

Corn soup!  YUM!!  I love all soup though... on a soup judging scale though... a solid 7

I will totally come back here b/c it's off the beaten tourist path and there are plenty of items on the menu i'd like to try.

We drove by this place a few times. We didn't realize this place is a former tire shop hence the name. We had the tugboat and the rollex. Both were delicious and just the right portion size. This looks like a locals spot and we are glad we tried it out. And t he kombucha was on tap
The coffee is out of this world! I had the toast and lox Benedict. Only outdoor seating- but its in a cute quite area

The Shop Kitchen is situated off Milpas right next to a tire shop. The ambiance is Santa Barbara chic - a little casual, but bougie pricing. I ordered the almond milk vanilla latte, veggie eggs Benedict, and banana toast and my friend ordered the chilequiles with carnitas. The food was delicious and the portion sizes were more filling than expected. My meal cost $30 and hers around $20 with a drink. 

This is a nice brunch place to come to with girl friends, dates, or alone.

I've only been for breakfast.  Really great items in unique combinations.  The best biscuits and gravy I've found in SB!  Not pretentious - actually quite the opposite.  But super friendly staff, great (!) food, and a handful of Johnny Cash on the sound-system.  What else could you want to start your day?  Also, nice to see young entrepreneurs working hard to make something special happen.  Kudos!

Amazing brunch. Don't underestimate the portions. 

Cali egg Benedict with chicken was awesome

Thanks to all the yelpers we found this Santa Barbara gem! Most people will order the tugboat which is delicious but my wife ordered the yolo. This dish was INCREDIBLE!! It's a perfectly breaded fried chicken with the most amazing gravy, topped with a poached egg. You might shy away from the combination but don't. Worth every scrumptious bite. Do not leave SB without hitting this spot. We were tempted to head back in the afternoon for a breafast dinner if there is such a thing.

YUMMMM! Every time.  I can just taste the  extra love and happiness everything is made with, from , salads to yogurt, to my morning coffee.  My favorite is the Rolex for breakfast ((next time I'm adding avocado :))

  And they play kool music if you want to stay and hang out on the patio.
Look forward to going often, and working my way through the menu. Delicious.  Mac n Cheese (gorgonzola, pecans, bacon, apples) was great.  Nice people, nice vibe.  Thanks for opening!

Every time I have eaten here I leave happy. Today was the first time though I ordered off the breakfast menu. I grabbed the Sando and a blueberry muffin. When I saw the muffin in the window I had to get it. It looked perfectly toasted and the top was gigantic! And it was delicious. My biggest beef about muffins is that they tend to either be a little too sweet or they're so moist that they're almost soggy and it grosses me out. But this muffin was awesome. The top has a little crunch to it and it was buttery. I didn't feel heavy at all in my stomach.

The ciabatta for the Sando was to die for. It was fresh and soft and perfectly complimented the scrambled egg and cheddar galore melted onto it. I did a happy food dance in my seat. And I enjoyed a good cup of latte with my breakfast. I love little  throwaway details and I got a kick out of the stamp of the little dog on the coffee cup.

I've eaten the chicken nuggets and mac n cheese before and loved them!

I should definitely start coming here more frequently!

Great vibe and cool spot. Very friendly and quality service. Had the salmon with poached eggs on thick toast. Eggs a bit undercooked for my taste. It was ok but I had high expectations given the reviews. My wife had a muffin and fruit bowl. Muffin was fine. Fruit had some mealy peaches that were a bit out of season. We will go back and try some other stuff next time we are in town.

My wife and I recently came to The Shop the morning after our wedding for a 'Farewell Brunch' with our closest friends. My wife and I have actually been to The Shop multiple times in the past during trips to Santa Barbara for brunch and have always enjoyed the food and atmosphere here, and this most recent visit was more of the same. We ordered the General Sanders, Chilaquiles, and Banana Toast. The General Sanders is your typical fried chicken sandwich that they amped up a bit with apple slaw and spicy mayo. The Chilaquiles are solid and my wife loves their Banana Toast; she makes sure to order it every time we visit. We also ordered a Modern Times Pale Ale and an Iced Coffee. They also have a pretty decent beer selection. In summary, The Shop is an awesome spot in Santa Barbara that is no frills, with good food, good beer and has an awesome outdoor area to have brunch with your friends!

I came here on a rainy day and they were so kind to let my pup and I sit inside bc the patio was all wet. I ordered the salmon tugboat, which was so yummy and really filling. My friend ordered the salmon tacos, quite the value! This little shack it so cute and had a wide range of menu items. I find myself coming back to try other menu items too!

I just discovered this place and wish I had known about it sooner. It's easy to miss. I drove by it several times, not knowing it was even there. Great brewpub/brunch place with awesome food, away from the ruckus of State Street, all for under $10. Good size portions too. Highly recommend. Only wish they served dinner!

Update - As of March 2015, they are now open for dinner. Woohoo

This place is excellent. The portions are huge. We split 'the general' chicken sandwich and a small side salad. The chips that came with the sandwich are house made. The side salad was made with a spring mix, tomatoes, white radish and a really nice balsamic dressing. You can watch as they make your food in the front window. Everything they made while we were watching looked great. We have to go back tomorrow for breakfast!
I found this restaurant by chance making a stop in Santa Barbara. Very good breakfast. The Sando was a great choice.
Decent food. No service whatsoever. You have to go up to a window and order your food and when it's ready, they call you to pick it up. 15% tip is included unless you wish to change it.

Like the rollex here, though could've had more bacon bits. Excellent mocha.
Relaxing seating outside amidst the mountain view.
I may have paid their rent a few times. Sando, Yolo, and Tijuana are like a Religious ceremony to me.

Great breakfast/lunch place to go to. I had the banana toast and my boyfriend had the tugboat; both were delicious! It has a cute little patio and indoor seating as well. Only thing I could say would be its a little pricey for what you get. The portions could be larger; that being said quality vs quantity!
I wish I could have gone here every morning in SB! The brunch is sooooooo good. There's ample street parking and picnic tables.

Easily my favorite lunch spot in SB!  Really unique, fun options.  My favorite is the Mac on Crack--macaroni and cheese with bleu cheese, bacon, apples, walnuts.  It's amazing.  Quick service, outdoor seating.
Tons of gluten free options. They have gf bread for the egg Benedict plates which I'm so happy about!!! They're salads look amazing btw (and I'm not even a salad person).
Great food! Simple counter service. Great biscuits, house cured salmon is delicious, and the fried chicken was great! Would 100% recommend.

Such good food and such a cute place! I had to make sure I came twice during my visit in Santa Barbara. First time I got the chilaquiles and the second time I got the yolo. Both so good!!! Their lemonade is also good but a little on the tarte side. Make sure you come check this place out if you're in the area!!

I really can't pinpoint the exact reason for the 5 star rating that I'm giving it; it could be due to many reasons such as: affordability, casual atmosphere, quality ingredients, flavorful dishes, good service, convenient location. 

Oops, I've just provided you with 6 good ones! 

Cool little spot that offers both hardy and savory options as well as traditional breakfast options. 

We loved it!

I've dined hear twice and both times the food has been delicious. The service is standard, my first visit the wait staff forgot to bring me my beverage, and if you stick around for a while casually engaging in conversation with your party they will keep checking in on you, hinting that they want you to leave. But overall the food is great and I will continue to visit.

ENVIRONMENT 
You order from a street side window and then proceed to sit on benches on the side patio or a small indoor areas.

There's a smoker next to the seating area and if the wind blows towards you, it's not a good experience. Unless you like what feels like bonfire smoke while eating. 

BREAKFAST
The Ahhnold -- Super light and healthy option. Due to its healthiness, add provided Sriracha and hot sauce. Comes with thick white toast -- in case you want some unhealthiness 

Tugboat -- eggs Benedict served on a biscuit. The most customizable option on the menu. Very filling.

It's entertaining to listen to people order - I'll have the "Eggs in Yo Face." I'll take the "Best Damn Oatmeal." I had the Ahhhnold - scrambled egg whites with sautéed kale, squash, onions and a welcomed portion of avocado. My friend added bacon & avocado

They aren't joking about the THICK cut toast. Hearty & tasty. 

The blueberry muffins are so prized that I almost wasn't able to get a half dozen to go!
I caused a mini scene at the counter & thankfully the negotiations were a success. They lived up to their reputation.

Spacious patio seating with a great sun to shade ratio. Enjoyed the outside dining. A nice addition to Milpas & good mix of long communal seating area interspersed with picnic tables. And as The Ahhhnold had been known to say, "I'll be back."

OMG this food is off the chain.  We tried lots of things for breakfast, since everything sounded so good and was so cheap!  The smoothie with basil is so unique and delicious--I want to start using basil in my smoothies at home.  And the baked goods are fresh and delicious.  Everything is made right there in the shop and you can definitely tell.   Homemade sausage gravy? I mean, come on.   And they play really good music and the pretty girl who took my order was really sweet, knowledgable and helpful.  I want to go again tomorrow!

One of the best overall places in Santa Barbara with wonderful food, excellent and friendly service and cheap prices for such excellent food will keep myself and my friends coming back again and agian!

Way too sweet. You cannot order oatmeal without brown sugar. The yogurt and fruit dish has vanilla yogurt that is way too sugary. 
The coffee is average at best.

THIS PLACE WILL NOT DISAPPOINT !!!!! If you're visiting Santa Barbara, you have to come here. The pictures I saw on yelp made it too hard to choose what I wanted. So my boyfriend and I ordered the Fried Chicken Tugboat, the Honey Bacon Tugboat and the Frenchie. The hollandaise sauce had a kick of citrus to it which made it so much more enjoyable than any other Eggs Benedict's I've ever had. The French toast was also out of this world! I got the Vanilla Latte which was also so yummy. No complaints. Pure bliss. I will definitely be returning. I truly believe it was the best breakfast I've ever had! Thank you!!
Real food. Really good. Hang out or on the go, it works. Will be a SB classic for sure.
The food here is so good!  (so is the coffee). It's a great place for families of all ages. This is a must for Santa Barbarans.

A great place for brunch in Santa Barbara. I've been here a couple times with various different friends, and they all love the food here. There is an outdoor and indoor seating area, so you get to choose if you want to sit outside or inside. From the times I've went, it's not too crowded, so it's nice and peaceful. As for the menu, I like most of the menu, since their burgers are good, their French toast is good, their fries are really good, their mac n cheese, etc. There is probably something on the menu for everyone! My only complaint would be the pricing is a bit expensive, like how is an order of French fries as a side $5??? Most of their sides menu prices are just too pricey for what it is. But the portion sizes for most of  food is decent and filling, so I think everything else prices are somewhat reasonable. Overall, this is a nice cute brunch spot that would be great to try with a friend.

Tugboat Benedict w ham and bacon was amazing.  I don't like hollandaise, but this roasted tomato version was crazy good.  The avocado toast with everything was very igen as my 14 yr old ordered it and was extremely good. OJ was freshly squeezed and 16oz served in a mason jar.  Between 2 adults, a teen and pre-teen, we shared 3 dishes which was sufficient.  When in Santa Barbara this is a must-stop for breakfast/brunch.

A delicious breakfast at a bit of a price. The fried chicken benny and the frenchie with chicken were both outstanding with perfectly poached eggs. Generous side of roasted potatoes were nicely prepare with a hint of garlic and onions. Ambience was nice with funky tunes and nice outdoor patio. Downsides were price (auto suggested tip for indifferent counter service) and the cappuccino could be served in a mug rather than paper cup.

Off the tourist routes but worth the drive, this small and enchanted shop is worth the travels. 

The "YOLO" (Egg, Fried Chicken, Biscuits and Gravy) is my absolute favorite. 

Great place to stop for brunch or anytime of the day  really. Do not be discouraged by its location which is adjacent to a mechanics shop, the food here is high quality and highly delicious. 

A must try for Santa Barbara locals and for tourists willing to trek off the main path.

My Wife and I had a brunch at The Shop. We're excited about the Atmosphere between the stuff - customers and customers - customers. Lots of friendly people around here. I recommend to have a Brunch here on Sunny days. Absolut a nice place to eat and enjoy the Outside.
The Burger from my wife was only warm to cold.

I don't live in SB anymore... and I still ask myself every day why I ever left. It was the BF's second time in SB and I've brought him to numerous restaurants near State St, the more popular ones and what not.. There are soooo many brunch places to choose from in SB. I decided to choose a place that neither of us have been before & I'm so glad I came across The Shop this past weekend! I loved the neighborhood local vibe, loved the service, loved the outdoor seating, and loved the food! 

Another great thing about it was that there was no wait (which is very unusual for a brunch restaurant in SF). Parking was easy peasyyy! We were able to walk straight to the counter & order our food, grabbed seats outdoors, and the food came shortly after! Weather was brilliant so it was the perfect experience here! 

Food-wise... I'm trying to stay on the healthier side so I ordered The Ahhhnold w/ ham along with a side of fresh fruit. BF ordered the Tugboat eggs benny (without the muffin cause we're still off the bread ughhh) w/ bacon, avo, and added potatoes. Everything was delish and I'll def come back to order the bread-y goodness! We were drooling over everyone else's heavenly looking bread dishes!!

This place is gooood. I went for breakfast and had a cappuccino and the "salmon in yo face." The food was delicious and reasonably priced, and the service was friendly. The atmosphere could use a little work, but at least it's clean. Can't wait to go back!

Came here on a nice Friday right when they opened. No line, no customers, the service was great. Cashier was friendly and answered my questions about the food.

In terms of the food, I ordered a Fried Chicken Tugboat. As much hype as I saw from the reviews, my order tasted a bit bland for my liking. The chicken tasted good, but the  combination of the egg, avocado, and hollandaise sauce on top of the biscuit really didn't do it for me. The biscuit felt a bit undercooked as well. Had to put some sriracha to make the flavors a bit better.

Great people behind the counter and the kitchen, but this menu item just wasn't the best imho.

Ahhhhhmazzzingggg!!!!

Everything is made from scratch and everything tastes out of this world!

The staff is super friendly and attentive!

Love
Favorite breakfast spot ever. Chilaquiles with carnitas is AMAZING!!!!!! Delicious handlebar coffee and fresh OJ...
Good service, decent quality food, very reasonable price, friendly staff, but odd location.

Nice spot for breakfast/brunch. Order at the window, seat yourself style. Whole family enjoyed their meals, I got the eggs Benedict with vegetables which really tasty. Pricey but good outside seating and recommendable overall experience.

Mixed opinion: My Yoly breakfast of poached egg, chicken and biscuit with gravy was amazing! It's a winner. My pal ordered the Rollex, which was a poor presentation of a bacon and egg wrap. Mistake #1 was to create a dense dry egg/meat blend that simply lay unfluffy in an exaggerated oversized brown tortilla shell. Awful. Mistake #2 was to put a $5.25 orange juice on the menu. I don't care what holistic farm from which the darn orange was picked, it's ridiculously priced. 

P. S. The dining room is drab and prison-like. Get it To-Go!

Road our bikes from our hotel on the waterfront to experience this gem before catching our train back to SLO! So worth it! GREAT coffee, Hall and Oats playing on the Sonos, and THE FOOD!!!! We shared the Tug Boat (a kick ass version of a Benedict) and the Chilaquiles...so so so so delicious. Nice folks too!

I love this place. The food is absolutely delicious. You really see the difference when everything is freshly prepared. They're still tinkering with the menu, so some of my favorites have disappeared, which is just as well because otherwise I would never have tried anything else on the menu. (Still, I'd love to see the Questlove salad back again, guys, and the full-size yogurt parfait!) Nowadays I am always getting the Fried Chicken Tugboat (biscuit, fried chicken, poached egg, avocado, and sauce, so good) or the french toast with fruit. They're usually just open for breakfast and lunch, but they're also open in the evening when there's a concert at the Bowl.

employee at the front was super helpful. very informative, helped me figure out what I wanted. we got two shop burgers and two YOLOs and everyone finished everything. we all loved the food, glad we ended up coming here. if you like horseradish, get the side of the mayo horseradish dip. great with fries. 

try the cucumber soda. it's weird. but good. 

next time I'm in town, definitely coming here
Tugboat and Yolo are delicious. Fresh OJ, and a large coffee... Yum. Nice casual environment, super friendly staff.  Will definitely come here again and again...
Quaint brunch spot that has a large outdoor patio. You place your order at the window and they bring your food to the table. The tug boat is amazing. Would definitely go back.

Went with the Tugboat
With fried chicken. You better be hungry! Two mounds of basically eggs Benedict with avocado and friend chicken under the eggs. Delish!!
Fabulous new spot in Santa Barbara.  I went there today and had their homemade "shop" cured salmon on their homemade bread.  Delicious.  I highly recommend you try it.

I came here for breakfast and it did not disappoint. I had the McQueen which was a savory quiche with butternut squash, corn, tomato and kale. It was light and very flavorful. It came with a side salad which helped balance the sweetness of the corn and butternut squash. Excellent food. I just wish the patio wasn't full so I could enjoy it in the beautiful Santa Barbara sun.

Don't get me wrong- the food is excellent - well, as much as I could allow myself to eat..  I went there for my first time this afternoon on my lunch break from work.  I ordered the Tijuana and a side of fries to bring back to work and share.  I paid with my card, and shortly after the man behind the register handled my card and the register, he took a towel and wiped a counter clean.  After that I watched as he took his unwashed hands and dug into a big salad bowl with his HANDS and grabbed the lettuce w/ dressing and put a handful on a plate to go out.  I almost vomited on the spot.  He wasn't the only one who did it.  Another girl behind the counter also handled money and multiple plates and placed her hands on the dirty counter and then grabbed a handful of salad to put on a plate, shaking her hand to make sure all the lettuce got off.  This happened multiple times.  I must have made a face behind the glass because when I received my food, the guy used tongs to put salad on my plate.  Needless to say, I was VERY cautious about eating my food, and halfway through it, was so grossed out I threw it away.  Just saying - you should probably follow basic kitchen cleanliness guidelines if everyone can see through a big glass window into your kitchen. 

I'd like to try the food again but I'm not sure I actually will.  Its disappointing as I have heard many great things.

I wish I could give this place more stars! The food was so freakin good! My boyfriend and I were visiting SB and find this place because of a Groupon. Usually it is a hit or miss when you use those, but this time we definitely got the good end of the deal. The portions are enough for two and the food is very flavorful. We couldn't decide on what to get so we got three! The Tub Boat with Bacon, the Chilaquiles and the French Toast. I would highly recommend this place for breakfast/brunch.
I ordered salmon in yo face w one egg. I got eggs in yo face w two eggs. Make sure they repeat your order. It's a LONG wait and they ran out of forks and knives for a while. Food is ok.

this establishment was cute and chill, two key components for a schweet brunch, but was lacking in areas such as cleanliness (there were a lot of dirty tables, kind of off-putting), and food quality (we ordered three dishes but only one, the salmon, tasted above average. the others were v mediocre). maybe I'm just expecting too much but I feel gypped when cute places like this don't deliver on tasty food! I'd come again with friends but wouldn't make an effort by myself. 
"very whatevs" "not really worth the price tag" "a solid three stars"

Super disappointing....have been here many times and loved it when it first opened. The owner seemed nice and everything was cool and the food was great. So what happened??? I had not been for over six months and thought I'd give it a try this morning. I had the "eggs in yo face" with avocado and for $8 the food itself was just "ok" (eggs were not exactly
poached, they were cooked through so didn't ooze when you cut into them) 
When I got home I looked up the latest reviews and I could not believe that no one has mentioned the (lack of) cleanliness of this place. It is shockingly dirty!! There are flies swarming everywhere - yuck!! Sitting outside in SB is always great, but the fact that it's simply not clean is not really acceptable. Not only are the tables tired and splintered, but the floor looks like it's never been power washed nor swept - super, super dirty! (Don't use the excuse that we are in a drought....it can be swept!)
The fact that you get up to get water - out of a container that was empty...and use unappealing stainless cups....then go looking for silverware - all out of forks, only to grab a knife that was - you guessed it - DIRTY! Then to go looking for salt and pepper - well it's all a lot of work for a $10 breakfast. The table next to me was looking for sugar for their coffee...would be nice if when the coffee is served the server would ask if they needed sugar or milk. Instead when they asked, the server motioned where to get it themselves. Wow.  
BTW - the cantina was all out of water so we had to tip it to get the last drops of water out and the servers were just walking by. No offer to help, I couldn't believe it. They easily could have said, "please feel free to sit down and I'll bring you a glass of water". 
It would be nice if the place would have servers assist customers - rather than say "the salt and pepper is inside". 
The sad part is that when you get up to get items, your food gets swarmed with flies - yuck! 
Another idea is to bring out a roll up of silverware with the meal so customers don't have to go digging in the buckets for clean silverware. 
It's super disappointing  to me because when they first opened the "serve-yourself-industrial feel" was very cool and really worked well with the location. Everything was clean. Now I only have to wonder what the health department say? It was so bad that I barely ate half my meal and left. I really hope the owners see this post and will do something about it. Maybe some training in customer service too. A little nice goes a long way.

Amazzzinnggg breakfast! And so close to home! Just went out to walk the dog and thought I'd get some coffee, well I ended up getting an order of French toast and veggie eggs benedict! Probably the best I've had in SB. Will definitely be going back!

The fish tacos are as good as any I've had in Mexico or California, authentic in that they use no quac, cheese or sour cream, just great fish, cabbage and tasty dressing with blue tortillas. Completely addictive!

I liked the food I ordered. Eggs and fried chicken 

My friend wasn't the biggest fan of her fried chicken sandwich. It was a little bit too plain. 

The location is nice but the day was a little bit windy and it was quite cold even inside. I would not recommend this place during cold or windy days.

I am writing this review as I take a bite of the crunchy pears, candied walnuts, smoked bacon and wonderful assorted cheeses that make up the delicious Mac on Crack. I've always been a mac and cheese fan, but this dish is something different all together! Also, the fresh lemonade was excellent complement to the meal.

Outdoor seating, casual wood tables with umbrellas and dog friendly for well behaved pups.  A great location to bring the kiddos too as the open-air  picnic tables make family style eating easy. Now, as far as the food goes...ahhhhmazingly delicious!  Had the General Sanders chicken sandwich and every component of the sandwich was superb, and then....wait for it...house made potato chips in the side.  Many open face egg options, and wraps, and sandwiches on the menu. Noting typical - all creative. So, next time you have a chance, give it a whirl and enjoy, like we did.

Great spot, Unique menu, and good people!

General sanders is my GO-TO fried-chicken sandwich of choice in this town.

Great outside patio for these beautiful SB days.

The perfect brunch. Santa Barbara never disappoints. We had the "Eastside", the "Frenchie" and the "the Tug Boat". All made and presented well. Patio seating is comfortable. Staff are friendly and efficient. A must stop for brunch if in SB.
Yummy! I had the rollex no bacon add veggies. Amazing. Cute easy breezy outside seating. Must try this place if you haven't and live on area.

Hands down best breakfast in Santa Barbara if you are looking for a heavy flavor'full' experience. My husband at first fought me on this one because of the obscure location "a tire shop". I must say we were so impressed! The chilaquiles were some of the best I've ever had. Try anything and everything on the menu! Items are great to share!

Outstanding! I loved this place, best of all the LOW PRICES! I really hope they never change that part... I had a Rolex (sandwhich) delicious, with a smoky roasted tomato sauce to die for. Second time I had the oatmeal for breakfast which was delicious! The freindliest service too, you can see plainly that they really care. Adorable hip decor, minimalist and clean. I heartily recommend this place. Yum.

I've eaten here twice and am a fan of the business as a whole. I liked the mac on crack. It's a generous portion of unconventional mac and cheese with large chunks of gorgonzola, walnuts, and bite-sized apples pieces as toppings.

I've also had the YOLO, which is a buttermilk fried chicken breast within a biscuit and slathered with a lot of gravy. It didn't meet my expectations. I thought it was heavy on the gravy, which was rather thick and bland. Also, the biscuit and chicken were a little dry. I have had much better biscuits elsewhere. Though it isn't freshly made, I actually prefer the ones at Chick fil A, which are far more tender.

My boyfriend Greg W. has had the burger here and isn't a fan of the bun because it tasted like a donut. 

If you like rich and fattening food you should definitely come here.

The food was pretty decent. We got the Shrimp and Grits, Tugboat and Eggs which were all super tasty...until their worker threw up behind us while we were eating inside. The stench of her vomit made me want to puke. I couldn't even finish my food as we grabbed our food and went outside to their patio. For future SIT OUTSIDE!!! I'm so grossed out. No one apologized or offered to comp the meal or even quickly clean up. Yuck

What a charmer! I had the smoked salmon on toast with poached eggs. Super tasty. Good coffee. Really nice guys and a lovely outdoor dining space. Casual, inexpensive and good food. What's not to like?

I'm honestly not sure why I only gave this place 4 stars last time, I love it!

I came here for breakfast on my birthday and loved everything! This time I got the Rolex and I think it was the best breakfast "sandwich" I've ever had! The pita wrap type thing that it is wrapped in is sooo yummy, and once again the smoked tomato sauce is delicious. I also got the Kombucha Sangria, it was pretty light and refreshing, no real alcohol taste to it. 

My friend secretly told the workers that we were visiting for my birthday and once we had all finished our meal they brought out a plate of french toast with berries as their version of a birthday dessert. It was so sweet and unexpected! We all shared it, the perfect way to end a birthday breakfast!

This place is the bomb, everyone go!!

I love finding local haunts when traveling and The Shop Cafe was just that. It's a walk up window with a huge menu. I love that everything in California has a healthy spin on it. I absolutely loved my breakfast. The coffee was way too strong for me, but I noticed that throughout the trip. Must be a West Coast thing.

I'll go again next time I visit SB, definitely.

Hooooooly crap. One of the best breakfast spots out there. If you're in an egg mood - absolutely come here. They have so many amazing Benedict options. My friend and I split the fried chicken tugboat and the bacon tugboat and they were both delicious. They come with HEAPING servings of avocado too. But if you're in a pancake/waffle mood, this isn't the place for you. They only have one french toast option.
One of my favorite places to indulge. The Tugboat is amazing and worthy the hassle of parking.

Just here for vacation and found this place on yelp. It was the worst burger I had in my life. They have good star on yelp but I don't know how. Place looks extremely dirty . Flies are everywhere. My wife said her food wasn't so bad so I have them 2 stars
Really great place.  Food is exactly what we needed. Had the ahhhnold, salmon in yo face and pancakes.  Amazing!

Highly recommend the "Yolo" and the "Really Good Fish Tacos". This is now my favorite food spot for when I'm passing through SB. Excellent food, friendly people, and really pleasant outdoor patio seating.

Amazing food super cute hip spot. 

We had the eggs Benedict and chilaquiles to die for also tried the Kombucha Sangria if your a fan of Kombucha you must try
I have never wanted to try ever single item on a menu more than at The Shop Cafe. This place is amazing!! The outside area is very cute and a nice place for a causal brunch. You must go!!

My mind was blown, totally exceeded my expectations. Came up to Santa Barbara to visit for the weekend and had brunch here. Absolutely incredible service, beautiful Ambience and food was so delicious. Perfect experience, recommend the chilaquiles, eggs Benedict and the insane banana toast. The toast is a bit small if you're hungry but it's a great appetizer, excited to return!!

Can't believe I never tried out this brunch place before ! Cute small shop near Cesar's Place. Went on Memorial Day + the service was quick! 

Environment + Location--
* Great outdoor seating 
* Next to Js tire on the corner of N Milpas + DLG 

Ordering--
* Quick ordering @ small window
* They give u a # + bring you your food 

Food + Value--
* Assortment of drinks: coffee, tea, smoothies, craft beer !! 
* With the price, portion + quality/types of food served I would give this place a solid 4 stars

Ordered--
*Tug Boat w/ Salmon 
($15 for 2 poached eggs, avo atop of two biscuits -- The hollandaise was superb, slight kick to it -- I would order again just not with salmon. I was hoping it would melt in my mouth... But it was rather chewy) 
- Side Mac n Cheese $5 
(Bland, good portion, needed hella siracha   + pepper)
- Maui Coco Porter 6%
Excellent food and service. Fresh veggies in egg white omelette is awesome. The location is easy to get to and the outdoor seating is perfect on cool mornings.
Wonderful breakfast spot!  The patio is dog-friendly and very cute.  We had the Mamma and the Chilaquiles.  Super tasty and quick service.  We will definitely be back the next time we're in town!

The shop does a good job and produces quality food from quality ingredients. I have been several times and I will go back. The reason it gets a 3 star is because we have had issues with food consistency. One example would be sometimes the bacon is cold and tastes like it was pre cooked. It's a good meal with slightly pricy feel.

I was really excited for breakfast here. There were some really great parts- super accommodating for requests for our kids, made them hit chocolate even though it wasn't on the menu. I ordered the eggs Benedict with fried chicken and the guacamole on the biscuit was black- clearly from yesterday's batch. Super disappointing as it looked like their attention to detail was on point but this was just sloppy. I removed that part and the biscuit and my breakfast was good but not great. My husband had the French toast with friend chicken and his was really good. The syrup is really tasty.

I ordered the Carrot Soup with veggie rice paper wrap. The soup was delicious but the wrap was a disgusting blob. It tasted like latex house paint smells and the texture was just gross. I was expecting something like a thai spring roll but it was a pile of mush with unrecognizable veggies. I did see red cabbage but that was it. My suggestion is to remove this item from the menu. I won't be back because no restaurant should serve something that I wouldn't even label as food. I should have complained but I just didn't.

Looking for some breakfast inspiration before you go work on your cool abstract sculptures?  Try In-Yo-Face french toast.  How about a place where you can soak in the mountain views while you ponder where your next piercing will go?  Welcome to the Shop Cafe!  Home of Santa Barbara's hippy dippy locals and Yelping tourists.  Amazing food and fun, eclectic outside picnic feel.  Great coffee too!

A reasonable choice.  We read about it in the local paper while traveling through and decided to give it a shot. 
The order process is a bit different in that you order outside and then are served inside the former shop. Nothing fancy about the location, the decor, or the process.
The food is good with generous portions and an attempt for fresh and local produce.

Had breakfast. Eggs, bacon, biscuit were all good. Coffee was good. Grits we're especially good. Muffin looked good when ordered but they ruined it by warming it on the flattop. Killed the muffin flavor. Our mistake was going on a day too rainy to eat outside. Inside is cramped and the experience is not helped by the entry door that SLAMS shut. Slams. They have a nice patio. Wait till the weather permits.

The tugboat (eggs Benedict) in carnitas, salmon and fried chicken are soooo good! Perfect size too not too much or too little. The frenchie (French toast and fried chicken) should be the new version of chicken and waffles, to die for! Amazing breakfast

Shrimp and grits were amazing. Rollex was fantastic. Everyone's dishes that went past us still made us jealous. Wish we could have everything on the menu. Service was the cherry on top. Super friendly. Love love love this place!!!

Such a great place to enjoy breakfast! I ordered the salmon toast with a kombucha sangria. Portions are perfect  Not too filling but just what you need to get your day going. My favorite part was probably the outdoor seating. The sangria could have been a little stronger, it was tasty but I'm pretty sure I wasn't drinking sangria.
Great spot for delicious eats and good local vibe. Great breakfast place with a delectable selection.

Nice idea but poor execution.  They make toast on the grill here which at other places is yummy, but if the grill isn't clean it tastes of old oil and will come with bits of egg or meat or grease that you weren't expecting, making a fresh breakfast dish taste... stale.  The chilaquiles look beautiful in pictures online but are essentially just a couple of ingredients, plus the fried eggs on mine had uncooked egg whites which is just gross.  I'd like to think the kitchen was having an off-day when we were there but life is short and I'd take a lot of convincing to return.

Both the service and the food was great! I ordered the The Ahhhnold and a small almond milk latté. Anybody who visits this spot NEEDS to order the gluten-free toast. It's super airy and tastes amazing.

I enjoyed the Frenchie today for lunch it was recommended. Sweet to the taste and the fried chicken was cooked just right and boneless to boot.

Try to find parking first and then order. I appreciate the great service.

This tiny little cafe on the corner of Milpas and De La Guerra busts out some killer food. The Rolex is what I got. Served on a wheat flatbread with egg bacon, tomato ramoulade, bacon and cheese, plus I added avocado.  The BEST part of this very yummy entree was the wheat flatbread. I wanted to eat it by itself. It was amazing. 

I keep craving this dish!!  I want to drive the 87 miles to SB just so I can go to breakfast here...it is that good.

Little gem on Milpas street we found while traveling to Santa Barbara. Service was quick, staff was super friendly. Food was yummy, I had the poached eggs with avocados on wheat toast and it was delicious . You order outside then there is a seating area inside and a patio area. It's self service as far as water and hot sauce, salt, pepper.. etc. enjoyed our breakfast here! Plus they allowed our little pup inside the restaurant which was a bonus

Spent a couple of nights up here with my 25 yo daughter as part of her bday celebration.  We are both foodies, she more than me!  She narrowed down our brunch meal to The Shop  Kitchen and Fork & Finch.  We decided on the former and it was AMAZING!  We were led to believe that there would be a loooong line but we must have hit it at the right time as there was almost NO line.  As we were eating, the line formed.  We arrived at about 12:15 on a Saturday afternoon.

I had a toast with smoke salmon, onions, roasted capers and a poached egg.  The salmon is smoked in house; the bread is baked in house; the capers roasted in house.  DELICIOUS!

Maggie had toast with fresh bananas and almond "butter.  House baked bread and home made almond "butter" that was more like a compote.  finely chopped almonds, roasted and mixed with a bit of honey.  

One the of the nice things about their toast is that it is NOT too crispy, a mistake (in my mind) that many restaurants make.

I was looking forward to coming here for breakfast and had high expectations, however we both left disappointed. The weather was a bit so-so to sit outside the benches were still damp. We were the only patrons there. 

We both ordered a different variation of the tugboat, the fried chicken and applewood ham. Our food came out in a timely manner but it wasn't hot hot as if it had just been cooked for us which it had. The hollandaise sauce looked like it had been under a hot lamp for too long, the eggs were a little over cooked, and the meats themselves were only luke warm.

The fried chicken was more little a chicken schnitzel, it was nice but had some bad cuts of chicken in it which made the meat tough. And the ham was quite fatty. 

The biscuit was great, served warm - it was a filling dish and we couldn't manage to finish ours. But we just left disappointed. All the elements weren't done correctly. 

The coffee was good, I got an iced vanilla latte, unfortunately they didn't have any sugar-free syrup though.

Burger was drenched in mayo which overpowered all other flavors.  Poor ingredients and bad meat, did not smell fresh at all.  Didn't eat after one bite.  
Try tip sandwich contained meat which looked oxidized on the edges.  Didn't eat any of the meal and paid $30.  Extreme disappointment and would not recommend for quality food at this price range.
Love this place! Dog friendly and the food is outstanding. Great flavor, good portions and prepared individually. You will love it!

took a tour to this little breakfast shop with my spouse, it was a great experience. order at the window and sit down kind of place, very speedy service. i recommend coming for brunch and getting eggs and burritos. sunshine salad was extremely refreshing and had a very happy vibe. very cute outside seating...overall great atmosphere and would definitely return again.

Do not miss this place for breakfast, brunch or lunch. A nondescript setting belies a fabulously creative and delicious menu of comfort food.

If you don't know about The Shop, you will need to seek it out as it one of many of SB's hidden jewels.

Highly recommended. Just go!

Great place for brunch and breakfast. Simple, good and cosy, The Shop Cafe will definitely check the box when it comes to look for "good brunch/breakfast place to go in Santa Barbara". 

4/5 stars
Really nice brunch. I recommend the aptly named Chingon: 2 biscuits, ham, avocado, fried chicken, poached eggs, and gravy.

The breakfast food was fantastic! We tried the Rolex and the banana toast. Both were incredible. Handlebar coffee was a real treat as well. Outdoor picnic tables added to the experience. Highly recommend this spot.

We found this little spot, and decided to try it. The food was  fresh and delicious. I think the only issue we had was, that while ordering we made the girl taking orders aware that we needed no butter on a breakfast for my husband due to an allergy he has Alpha-gal. She made sure to put oil and as the order was read back to us twice, and even saw the screen to make sure it was there we were confident there would be no butter on his meal. We get our food, my husband bites into his and boom, there's butter. We ask our waitress to confirm if butter was used and she comes back say it was and proceeds to share that sometimes the cooks don't pay attention to specifics.
