She one, asked did we let the girl at the window know, answer was yes,  and two asked how bad the allergy  was and we let her know we carry pills and an epi pen due to it. Ummmm....regardless of how bad he reacts to the allergy, the point is he has one, and we asked and paid for the accommodation. This was disappointing, and tarnished an otherwise amazing brfst.
They really do have the best Benedict I've ever hand, SB or otherwise.  Highly recommend! And the sangria kombucha is a great too

The Shop has never disappointed me whether I'm here with friends, for brunch, for an interview, etc. With many options on their menu - and one that's constantly changing - there's always something for everyone whether it be sweet (the Frenchie) or savory (the YOLO) and they even have vegetarian dishes. 

What they're famous for though, is the Tugboat - their take on eggs Benedict with a choice of tomatoes, fried chicken, smoked salmon, or bacon. Having tried all of these options, I can attest that the fried chicken is the best. It has just the right amount of crisp while the inside stays perfectly moist, making it a fine addition to their chicken sandwich, the General Sanders. Other notable orders include the Just the Tip (tri-tip sandwich with caramelized onions) and another personal favorite, the East Side (avocado toast with grilled jalapeños and a poached egg). 

Order at the counter when you arrive and if the line is long, don't worry, it'll move quickly though it can be difficult to snag a table. Water cups, takeout boxes, and utensils are readily available both inside and outside.

Quality and efficiency is what this place is all about! And if you're a fitness fanatic, this is THE breaky spot for you my friend. :)

On top of all the great food they serve here, they have CUTE and I mean cute names for items on their menu. And such a nice outdoor patio for perfect California weather.

I ordered the Ahhnold. Which is basically an egg scramble with fresh kale, sweet onion, tomato, seasonal squash and avocado. Cooked perfectly and everything tasted so fresh!! Shoutouts to my bodybuilder friends. I actually filmed the part where I enjoyed this meal on my YouTube vlog that weekend: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z7Lz6k-tXhI&list=UU5YaBtOxOYqeFEEQ_aW6JiA

I also got the honey buttermilk biscuit with local jam and honey butter. Mmmmm hmmm! I hope them carbs went straight to my booty. Gotta build up these glutes!

I also got to try out my friend's oatmeal which was bombtastic. 

This is definitely a place I would return to or breakfast if I'm ever back in SB!

Amazing breakfast in Santa Barbra! 

As soon as we walked up to the order window we were greeted by the helpful and friendly waiter. He gave us some recommendations and helped us navigate through the menu, we told him it was our first time here.  

My boyfriend & I ordered and shared the Eastside toast and the chilaquiles. I think we ordered some of the best things off the menu.

The east side toast: let me start off by saying the type of bread this establishment uses is by far what makes this dish so delicious. It is so fluffy and tasty (I opted for the wheat but I'm sure the sourdough would have been just as good or even more amazing). 

The chilaquiles: were not your standard tasting dish. They were lemony and crispy, yet soggy at the same time. Exactly what you're looking for in a dish like this. 

The iced lattes were also great. 

5/5

Go for the weekend and get the eggs Benedict.

I've had the tugboat and it was absolutely wonderful, nice soft poached egg, smokey hollandaise and grilled crispy biscuit. 

This time I got the salmon in yo face and the poach egg was borderline hard boiled, bread was below par. The salmon was good, the capers add a nice salty bit, and red onion added a bite. But the love was lacking.
Very casual, relaxed place.  Food is very good and they are super fast.  My only comment was that my food wasn't hot.  Was quite cold.  Would still definitely recommend.

Their food was tasty! A little pricey but portions were enough to satisfy your cravings. They had a little area to eat indoors. I liked their plates and utensils, classy for what seems to be a hole in the wall.

Shared breakfast here with family and friends. You order at the window and then find seating. We sat outside on their lovely patio, the Cali sunshine and their tunes help to make it a very memorable experience! Now to their food... Amazing! We all ordered different items off their menu and no one was disappointed! From their breakfast salad to the two eggs and toast, you will definitely enjoy their food. Some of us enjoyed their mimosas too! The staff there was very kind and courteous they even offered our pup some water. We will definitely be coming back the next time we pop over to SB!

Food is soft and tender. My friends had a Fried chicken Tugboat, while I had the burger. Needless to say the bread and meat were very soft and not crunchy. I did feel like the burger had too much pink in it. I'll be looking to get the tugboat next time.
One quick Yelp search for highly rated restaurants on our way through Santa Barbara brought up this place, and boy, we were not disappointed!! Perfect place to stop for lunch on our road trip.

I ordered the Tugboat with chicken and the chilaquiles with carnitas. My Tugboat was ok the chicken was overdone, the poached eggs well cooked but the hollandaise sauce was not saucy it was cold and lumpy. Now my chilaquiles were just soggy cold tortillas bland, the carnitas were ok but also cold with a pouched egg on top! I overall was disappointed with the service the girl taking the order far from friendly. Just disappointed I was expecting much more since it has good reviews but it's more like a 3 star!
Love this place, right down the street.  It;s a little pricey, but the food is always good.

Went here for breakfast on Sunday with my family, and the place was absolutely packed (for good reason, as I later learned). I got the eggs Benedict, and can highly recommend that for anyone going, though my family all enjoyed theirs as well. Would definitely recommend if you're looking for a brunch spot in SB

One of my favorite places to get brunch in town. I love the outdoor patio seating and staff is always pleasant and helpful. The food has never let me down...any menu item with the fried chicken is bound to be a winner!

The Shop Cafe is in a league of its own. Don't let the modest store front fool you this place is a gem.. the menu covers all the bases with breakfast and lunch options that are delicious, affordable, and all made in house (even the burger buns which are out of this world tasty). In a town where there is no shortage of places to eat, The Shop Cafe is without a doubt on top of my list. If you're a local it is your new favorite spot. If you are visiting I'd say skip the hotel front desk fella's recommendation to check out the "local spots" ie restaurants with luxury priced, diner quality food and find your way off the beaten path for a meal you'll actually enjoy.

YOLO. 

That's the name of a delicious and decadent breakfast dish served at The Shop. It has sausage gravy, poached egg, English muffin and fried chicken. This was a winner  and must order. 

I also ordered the tugboat with fried chicken which was essentially an eggs Benedict over fried chicken, filled out with avocado. 

For drinks we ordered a kombucha (helps digestion) as well as a vanilla latte. Both solid, but the highlight was the food. 

They have outdoor seating and around 830 AM when they opened it was not crowded. However I passed by again around 10 AM and the line was crazy so I would come early if you can.

Cute concept, decent Benedict for my wife, but the apathy of the staff, watery gravy on my biscuits and giving us our coffees in to go cups even though we were dining in, especially for the price, was a fail.
This is a great place. The staff is very friendly and there is an awesome selection of breakfast foods. I'll be back.
This place advertised as open on Christmas Eve but turned out to be closed. How hard could it be to make sure someone doesn't travel all the way just to find out that the restaurant is closed?
Great service and amazingly good food! Had eggs Benedict with the ham and avacado ! We'll plated !!

Oh my gosh so good, I can't even! Hubby ordered the salmon Benedict again because it was so good! I had the French toast with a fried chicken ( the fried chicken was an up charge) and was also very good. I'll give a slight nod to hubby's Benedict though. 

Service was good considering it's part self serve.  

Next time I want to try their Chilaquiles:)

We loved this place and tried the breakfast burrito and chilaquiles with eggs over easy. Both were delicious and not too heavy for breakfast. People near us had the eggs Benedict with fried chicken and said it was amazing. The outdoor seating was perfect for our lab too. Great stop on our way through SB.

Good food, not so good parking, outside only seating.
My wife and step son love this place, many food options. It is worth going you just need to plan to sit out side and find some parking.

Located on a nondescript stretch in Santa Barbara, The Shop Kitchen serves a stellar brunch of American fare that is novel, delicious, and memorable. 

We stopped by while driving to Northern California and will likely make this a stop for the drive from now on. 

From the staff and patrons there, we found out that the Shop Kitchen is typically busy and packed but was less so during the holiday break. 

The menu is straight forward with clear descriptions with an emphasis on the fried chicken and eggs Benedicts.  There's also a nice drink selection including my brunch favorite Michelada.  Our order: 

Bananas - $10. A simple concoction of sourdough bread, local honey, almond butter and sliced bananas. 

Fried Chicken Eggs Benedict - $14.  The fried chicken here is a popular addition to many items here and its easy to see why.  It's crispy, juicy, and has a unique batter that isn't common.  The eggs Benedict was also perfect with a perfect soft boiled egg and a wonderful Hollandaise sauce. Excellent. 

Shrimp and Grits - $13.  Delicious comfort dish with a generous portion of grits and nicely cooked shrimp and tomatoes. 

Michelada Proper - $8.  I drink a lot of Michelada and this one is delicious with a perfect ratio of modelo, tanjin, and Michelada mix (typically tomatoe juice, Clamato, worchestire). 

Overall, The Shop Kitchen was a great stop.  Delicious brunch fare in a friendly and low key environment.  Definitely look forward to coming back.  

The Shop Kitchen accepts credit cards.
Loved the food. Very different options from a regular breakfast place and everything was very well done. Loved the service and the outdoor seating too!
Hella legit self seat brunch spot! Tugboat with carnitas and a couple of there mimosas will put you in a good place, for sure!

Brunch is literally my favorite meal so I had to find the best brunch spots in Santa Barbara.  Thanks to you yelpers, you brought me to The Shop Kitchen and I cannot thank you enough for your recommendation!

First, the restaurant is off the path from busy State Street and located next to a car auto shop.  There's a lot of outdoor seating with a few tables on the inside.  There's one window where you order and you pick up your drinks and wait for your food at your table...pretty simple.

The menu...it's one of those places where you just want to try everything and order one of each.  My boyfriend got the famous YOLO (biscuit, egg, and fried chicken covered in white sausage gravy) and I got the tugboat (egg Benedict) with fried chicken and avocado.  Both were pretty good although my boyfriend thought the YOLO had too much gravy.

Next time I'm here I definitely want to try something sweet instead of savory.  If you love breakfast, look no further!

Delicious little dive! I had the Tijuana and it was delicious. Lots of avocados and the wrap was unforgettable. My husband had some pig sandwich which was just as awesome. You can taste the freshness in the food. Everyone was very friendly and we have already recommended it to others. A must stop. Don't let the exterior fool you.

Four and a half stars. This was easily our second favorite brunch from this trip. Not too crowded on a weekday as we ordered at the counter from the friendly staff. We availed ourselves of the filtered water inside, and then sat ourselves at one of the patio tables to enjoy the weather. We sipped our coffee and kombucha during the reasonable wait. As to be expected, the YOLO was richer than the Eastside (I would probably repeat this order without carnitas), but both dishes were very tasty and topped with excellent poached eggs. We'll definitely make a point to come back and try the Rollex, Frenchie, and shrimp & grits.
It was quiet here but it's a really cute lunch spot--a great place to read your book or do some work on your computer. I was pleasantly surprised that they serve Handlebar Coffee.

I wish Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives would do a segment on this place. They certainly deserve it. I've been here about 15 times with my fiancee. We've tried everything on the menu and have never had a bad experience. We've even been here with big groups for lunches and breakfasts and have gotten fantastic food quickly. That's pretty impressive given how small the place is. One of our favorite places to swing by last minute. The staff is always kind to us, and the outdoor seating is perfect. Located on Milpas, so you don't get the SB tourist traffic. A place for real locals. Just walk up to the window to order, and then take your food there or to-go. 

We NEVER tire of The Rolex (two scrambled eggs, bacon, smoked tomato spread wrapped in Shopmade flatbread). It's simple but both filling and FULL of flavor from the smoked tomato spread. Nor can we get over the In-Yo-Face topped with Shop-cured salmon, dill creme fraiche, and poached eggs. Their warm drinks and fresh baked goods are great too. 

For lunch, get the General Sanders (buttermilk-fried chicken, beets, carrot puree and spring greens). I don't even like beets normally, but they really make this. Also the Cecilia (chilled quinoa, roasted corn, kale, spring squash, feta, toasted almonds all tossed with a chili lime vinaigrette), the Just the Tip (grilled tri-tip, melted onion marmalade, white cheddar, romaine, mayonnaise on toasted ciabatta with wasabi creme fraiche), the Really Good Fish Tacos (Shop made blue corn tortillas, fresh grilled Santa Barbara Cod, sliced tomato salsa), and The Derby (thick-cut Shop toast, mayo-free shredded chicken salad, peach marmalade and spring greens) are quite good.

Some people might not like the simplicity, but it's a perfect breakfast and lunch spot with well-priced and well-made food. If you're a foodie but are also practical, this is the place to go.

I loved their Tugboat with Chignon (meaning eggs Benedict with avocado, bacon AND fried chicken). Their sandwiches are tasty as well. I have been disappointed a few times with some dish that lacked taste, but because of the fresh ingredients, the good vanilla late, and the excellent eggs Benedict this place is definitely worth a shot!

I came here specifically to try their carnitas chilaquiles which looked good in pictures. What you cant tell from the pictures is that this dish is huge. It's a big serving for one person. I tried but ended up taking half home. The green sauce was very good, eggs were cooked perfectly(soft-still runny yolk), and the carnitas was tender and flavorful. The dish comes topped with what I believe was cilantro and watercress. I did have two small modifications that I would ask for next time. I would ask them to go easier on the green sauce because there seemed to be a lot at the bottom and the chips got soggy quickly. Second, I would ask them to also go lighter on the crema. I'm generally a fan of less sauce in my dishes, so if you are a big sauce fan you should be fine. The rest of the menu sounded good too so I'll be back to try more.

One word: Awesome!  Stopped here after reading Yelp on the way up to wine country from LA and this was the best decision we made. Food was great for everyone. Fresh, flavorful and inventive.

I had one of the toasts with carnitas, onions, jalapeños and a poached egg. It was great. Everyone else enjoyed their food as well and we can't wait to come back when we're in SB.
Wonderful food and fun place.  You order at the window then sit and they bring you ambrosia.

This place was yummy. I had the Frenchie was delicious. My sister had the eggs Benedict that looked amazing as well. My friend had the almond butter banana toast, that was great as well. Over all the experience was amazing and made me miss my puppy at home because their seating was on the patio and other guests had brought their doggies and I LOVED it. If and when I'm back in Santa Barbara I will come to The Shop Kitchen.
Stellar lunch today.  Great food, great outdoor eating, and great service.  Just a perfect lunch.

What a fun, great local spot! The staff here are extremely warm and friendly, and quick to clean tables for the next guests. It's a funky little roadside eatery where you order at the window and then choose if you want to sit outside on the patio or in their very small indoor dining room. Because it was raining, we sat inside and waited on our food.

It was fairly quiet, even though the place was full and everyone seemed to be enjoying their meals. I had the chilaquiles and my husband had the banana toast. Both meals were yummy, but I was partial to my dish. The chips were cooked perfectly - soaked in delicious chile verde, but still crispy on the edges. The over easy eggs coated the dish and the cream brought everything together. I can't wait to try this place again the next time we're in Santa Barbara!
Stopped on the way back to LA for a fast breakfast. Good selection; you order in advance and then get a number. Outdoor and limited indoor seating.

Great brunch place! Order at the window kiosk, get a #, find a table, place # on table, food arrives. The entrance is located to the right of the kiosk, slightly hidden.

The tugboat is one of the most popular items and you can choose which type of meat. My favorite part about it was the poached eggs and avocado! Let the eggs run throughout for overall delight!

I also had the rolexx and it's basically a crepe sandwich with bacon, scrambled eggs, and avocado. Combined, it tasted good, but I prefer the tugboat!

Fresh OJ was fresh indeed. Self service inside but staff still around if you need them.

On our visit there was no seating inside due to a leak so seating was only outside which was very limited. Trying to get a table was like black Friday. When we finally ordered we were told plates were limited so our food might be in a to go box. Then the bill, very pricey...

Holy greatness Batman!!!! Hands down the BEST eggs benedict EVER! I wish they had one in San Diego. I would go everyday! My husband's Sando with avocado was delish too! A must visit if you're in the Santa Barbara area!!!!

Close to home, and close to my heart. So I've been up since 9 and Jeremy woke up at like 1 so this was a great place to go since they have breakfast AND lunch options. He got the breakfast Sando and I got the General. Both very different, but god damn delicious. Gotta try out more things on the menu there's so much good stuff on there it took us about 10 minutes just to decide  we'll definitely be bringing our car back into the shop
Great food and a great find thanks to Yelp. I really enjoyed brunch on the patio.

The Shop Kitchen is a casual eatery near Santa Barbara High, where my husband Matt B. went to school. It's on the same street as La Super-Rica, and appears to be one of the newer, trendier places in the area, open since late 2012. We went for brunch on Easter Sunday, during an overnight visit to town.

It's essentially a fast food restaurant with fancier food and a beer and wine license. You order and pay at a window, then find your seat on either the patio or the somewhat gloomy indoor dining area. There was a line when we walked up around noon, but it moved pretty briskly. Service was quick and perfunctory. I ordered a drink and only asked after it when it didn't come with our food. It turned out it had been sitting out at a different window, where I was supposed to pick it up. If I was given that instruction at any point, I missed it entirely.

The Sriracha Bloody was okay, a little bit spicy and not very strong, as it must've been made with soju or some other 14% liquor. $7 was a fine price for it, though, and it came with some tasty pickled green beans.

My food was also okay. I got the General Sanders, a buttermilk fried chicken sandwich with apple slaw, sweet and sour carrots, and spicy mayo on a soft bun. The chicken was good, but there wasn't much to the other ingredients. More slaw, more carrots, more spice would've been great. I tasted a tiny bit of apple in like one bite, and the sandwich needed more texture and flavor overall. I did like the housemade potato chips, though not all of them were crispy. Matt's food was better. He got the Frenchie, a grilled french toast with real maple syrup, and it was solid.

This was a totally serviceable meal, and if we lived nearby, we might visit again. The Shop Kitchen strikes me as a useful neighborhood restaurant, an unfussy brunch stop where you can get in and out in well under an hour. There just wasn't so much to it that I'd go back again during a short getaway to Santa Barbara.

I saw this place on yelp and had to give it a try. I was visiting from out of town and thought it was closer than it actually was, so I walked 12 blocks to get there, with my 9 yr old, my 2 yr old in the stroller, and I carried my 9 mo old; IT WAS WORTH IT! 
It's a super casual, amazing place that is almost like a speakeasy because there's no sign indicating what it is. There's just a big sign for an auto repair shop that's part of the same building. 
The food is absolutely out of this world, and I love the patio outside. It's nothing fancy, but so perfectly executed! The tables are picnic tables, but each has a huge umbrella, and it's a nice little patio. There's water for your dogs, and it just is a really pleasant place to sit and enjoy your breakfast or coffee. 
I got the basic egg breakfast (poached eggs on sourdough toast), and I added bacon, avocado and marinated tomatoes. It was awesome! 
My son got the french toast and it also was awesome! What made it so special is little bits on candied basil. It wasn't too strong, but totally elevated the dish. And we got the banana toast for the table, which is sourdough toast, local honey, house-made almond butter (which was more like super finely chopped almonds with a little bit of salt), and banana slices on top. It was our favorite dish of the day! It was just a wonderful combination on flavors with the really sour bread, the sweetness from the honey, the crunch and salt of the almond butter, and then the soft, sweet bananas to finish it off. 
We also got the fresh squeezed orange juice, and it was delicious! 
I ordered a bulletproof coffee with 2 shots of espresso added, and it was good. I like a bolder taste to my coffee, and I didn't quite get it from this coffee, but it was fine. 
Overall, this place is a must-go!!!! I recommend to anyone! Not fancy, but an absolutely out-of-this-world culinary experience, in a super chill atmosphere.

We have been waiting for this place to open for some time so when I saw that was open I took my friend there to try it out.  We ordered a bunch of items and split them all to try them out.  We had the Burger, Mac on Crack, fries, and onions rings.  I thought the Mac on crack was the best one while my friend was raving about the burger and especially the fries.  The prices are pretty good as well with most items at $8.

The Shop offers a wonderful selection of the most awesome breakfast dishes, served to perfection. We were very impressed with the food and service, though you will need to order your meal at the window, and wait for it to be served on their lovely little patio. We came to this highly recommended for the best breakfasts with high expectations, and we weren't let down in any way.

What an amazing breakfast.  Wife had the Tugboat with the fried chicken.  Chicken was perfect.  Great crispy skin and super moist inside.  Poached eggs were perfect (for some reason this isn't as easy at a lot of places)  I had the eastside toast with the carnitas, probably doesn't need the carnits, but why wouldn't you.  Good coffee too.  It's pricey, but worth every penny!!

Today was our first time there . We loved everything but the reason I put 4 stars is because people that came after us got their food before us . I saw that they had a sign saying " HELP WANTED " but it took too long and when we got our food it was just warm not hot . Even though it was delicious we wish it was hotter !  Here's a pic of what we got . We can't wait to go back to Santa Barbara so we can have breakfast there and hopefully they will have more people in the kitchen to help.

My partner and I had breakfast at The Shop Café on a Saturday. Pros: great menu; outdoor seating (on a busy street corner, so there was some noise); my partner was able to get a delicious kale salad (what she can eat is very restricted and it can be hard to eat out); my food was delicious when it finally came. BIG con (I'd have given 1 or 2 stars if I didn't think this was probably a rare experience): They were out of muffins, which caused it to take 20+ minutes to serve my breakfast; my partner was done with hers long before mine came. The kicker: They didn't tell me about this until I started inquiring after 15 minutes; if I'd been given the chance, I'd have ordered something else. (Even after I told them that, they didn't seem to get it.) Inexperienced restaurant personnel who didn't understand a basic rule: If you're out of something and it will delay the order significantly, you tell the customer and give him a chance to order something else. They offered me "iced tea or something on the house," and I took an orange juice, which was some consolation. I could tell they meant well, but they just didn't understand the right way to handle the situation.

Cute little local breakfast spot in SB that my husband and I got the opportunity to check out during our couples weekend here. 

We got there at 9 am and there wasn't a line. We ordered at the window and grabbed a semi-shaded table on the patio. 

The coffees were up first and the food came out shortly thereafter. I ordered the sando and loved it! Perfect breakfast sandwich with plenty of eggs, cheese, ham, and avo. It came with potatoes which I was pleasantly surprised about. My only critique is the potatoes could have been cooked a little longer. I like my breakfast potatoes crispy and these had a more slightly boiled consistency.

My husband raved about his biscuits and gravy.  Biscuits were crisp on the outside and fluffy on the inside. They paired nicely with the over easy egg and the meat it came with. He also liked that the gravy came on the side so you could add as much as you wanted. 

We also ordered the banana toast as it claimed to be the best thing on the menu. While we both agreed it was good, it's not their best item. It comes on a thick cut of fresh sourdough or wheat bread with a generous spread of super crunchy almond butter, banana slices, and honey. A nice sweet treat to share at the end of the meal, but don't feel like you have to try it like we did. 

Check out the Shop kitchen when you're in SB! It's close to the zoo for anyone looking on what to do afterwards :)

I wanted to get off the beaten path from the tourist area so I tried this place.
Great food 
Great service
Nice clientele 
I had the Cali burger and beet salad.
Worth the Lyft ride here from the beach!
Great lunch place on a beautiful Santa Barbara day.  Food was delicious!  Picnic bench seating outside is rustic but fun.

Found the perfect brunch/ breakfast spot in Santa Barbara that offered a diverse selection of food and drinks that everyone with different tastes could enjoy!

I run a fried chicken Instagram account (@Mothercluckerrr) and was enticed by their Fried Chicken Eggs Benedict. SAY NO MORE- I was sold! And WOW was it good! The eggs were perfectly cooked just the way I like them on eggs Benedict where you will get your perfect yolk porn video for the gram! And the chicken was more on the country fried style but STILL delicious. Overall I would come back JUST for this.

My bf and his dad got the frenchie and salmon eggs Benedict and also loved their dishes.

Highly recommend to come here and get the Groupon to save a few bucks!

Love love love this place!

Has proven to be a favorite while in Santa Barbara. Enjoyed the chilaquiles and fried chicken. The chilaquiles has a wonderful lime flavor.  While the gravy for the fried chicken was - OMG. Found this place via Groupon a couple of years ago - it didn't disappoint then and didn't disappoint today. Not the cleanest place but worth overlooking for the tastiness and enjoying the al fresco dining.

Had a Groupon for $20 worth of food for $13 (less with extra % off code).  We chose this place as a breakfast stop before a full day of Santa Barbara tourism.  

The Shop Cafe has a walk up window outside where you place an order.  There are several tables in an indoor area to the right of the windows and outdoor seating as well.  You pick up your drinks at the windows and your food is brought to your table.  

My SO had the "Good Day Sunshine" - Kale and mixed greens with roasted potatoes, parsnips feta pomegranate seeds and a poached egg ($12).  It was a large breakfast-y salad.  Not bad but not amazing.  

I had my standard avocado toast, here called the "Eastside" - with grilled jalapenos with avocado, queso fresco, cilantro and one poached egg ($8.50).  I actually asked for no grilled jalapenos but in retrospect, that was probably a bad idea because the toast was really bland and needed some sort of kick...  maybe some good fresh ground pepper at least.  Bread appeared to be a very soft Texas Toast and it was only lightly toasted which resulted in a rather soggy dish.  Not the best.

One word of caution - the floor inside is concrete and it was quite slick...  I was wearing high heeled boots and almost fell several times - so be careful!  

For breakfast for two people, our tab came to over $30 (before the Groupon).  For the atmosphere and quality of the food, that seemed a little excessive.  Wouldn't return.

This was a nice charming little spot that me and my wife checked out... We wanted singing different for breakfast, and this once did not disappoint. The biscuits and gravy was on point. Stupid good!! Only thing that kept me from giving this place a 5 start was a bit pricey and parking.

This is the best new place to eat in Santa Barbara with one of the best menus EVER!  I have referred so many people and they ALL call me as they are leaving to tell me this is their new best restaurant.  I have tried something different each time and each time it has been unbelievably delicious!  I had Mac on Crack the first time and HAD to have it again the second time...and have had it since, but I do try something different each time since and I am NEVER disappointed...always ooohhing and aaahhhhing throughout the meal!  AND they are super nice!

Yelp brought me here while I was visiting Santa Bárbara! I was looking for a good breakfast place and trust me this place was AMAZING!!! The place is nice and cute, you order at a window and they have outside and indoor eating. The outside patio has umbrellas for shade so it's not in direct sun. You pick your drinks up at a window and they walk your order out to your table. The line was long but not too crazy. I ordered the tugboat with carnitas and my bf had the burger special which included a fried egg, avocado, queso fresco, and pico de gallo. I took my first bite and instantly thought "OMG this is the best thing ever!!" The food is beyond amazing cooked to perfection! I ate every single bite of it along with the roasted potatoes I got on the side. Must try I promise won't be disappointed
I loved eating on the patio, and the food was delicious! I ordered the salmon! Very nice and helpful service too.

Cute hidden gem. Big huervos rancheros portion. Tugboat Benedict's was good although fried chicken was a little dry. Fruit was freshly cut. A nice change from old mushy fruit from most restaurants. Outside patio much nicer than inside seating.

There's no rhythm and blues vibe coming from the shrimp and grits but the heavy garlic make it every bit as amazing southern comfort food spin off. I highly recommend it with a side of mimosa in a mason jar. Cheers

Wow! Yelp came through as always. Had an amazing breakfast here on a Saturday morning. The spot is literally on the corner and can be hard to miss due to poor signage. Just know it's directly across from the fancy car dealership. Anyhow I was skeptical on how the food would taste being is that you order beforehand and sit down, but that was a sure error on my part. The food was amazing. Probably the best shrimp and grits I've ever had. The Rolex was good to, it was very big! All of the food portions in fact were good size. The mimosas we good and strong, gotta love that! This place is dog friendly and has ample outdoor seating. It is first come first serve. Most people are pretty good about eating and moving on though so that is good. The view of the mountains was gorgeous especially on a beautiful day. I can't wait to come back and try this pace again!!

We LOVE the Shop Cafe!  Everything is so fresh, made from scratch.  For breakfast, brunch, or lunch...really can't beat it!!  I love the tug boat with salmon, but any option from this group is a guaranteed winner. My son can't get enough of the chicken sandwich (General Sanders). The YOLO is a great lighter option.  Even their 'basic' burger is way above average...delicious!  Seriously, you' can't go wrong with anything on this menu.  AND, they welcome dogs on the patio, which is always a bonus. We are so lucky to live walking distance from the Shop!

Updating March '18 to recommend a recent menu addition, Cilaquiles! Incredible, with or without carnitas.

My boyfriend and I spent the weekend up in Santa Barbara, and we randomly decided to try The Shop Kitchen (and I am so glad we did). I got the Rollex and an iced americano, while he got the Frenchie with a side of bacon and a glass of orange juice. The Rollex was BOMB and I will 100% be coming back just for this next time I'm in the area. The chapati was so fresh and delicious, and the smoked tomato sauce added incredible flavor! I was lucky enough to get a single bite of the Frenchie before my boyfriend inhaled the whole thing hah. That basically speaks for itself. 
When we got there there was a long line, but don't let that fool you, it moves pretty quickly and is worth the wait. You order at the front and they bring your food to you. You can sit in their small indoor area or on the outside patio. I recommend sitting outside. It's a cute little spot with communal wood benches and it's so nice with the fresh air and view of the mountains. 
10/10 would recommend! (Only downside is their mimosas are TINY)
Totally unassuming. Small area to eat inside. Food was GREAT! Service was impeccable Friendly and accommodating.

Great breakfast! I had the Rolex (scrambled egg, bacon, and roasted tomato on flat bread wrap) and my wife had the poached eggs on shop toast. Lots of other sides and options as well and we got a cinnamon roll to go. Next are lunch and dinner!

We chose this as a quick stop before a flight. It had 4.5 stars so we went for it. We had lunch, although it seems like they are known for their breakfast. I am vegetarian and wanted a sandwich. There were no options, but it did say to ask for suggestions. The clerk was not helpful at all; he suggested a salad, but I wanted a sandwich. We also ordered 2 sides of fries at $5/pop, but they were horrible---little tidbits of the bottom of the bag. They certainly didn't look or taste like hand cut fries. My husband's burger was good. We didn't know that handmade potato chips came with our meals....we wouldn't have gotten all those fries. The chips were overcooked and flavorless. Overpriced, too. 

We chose to sit inside, but should've sat outside. The inside was quite uninspired and not somewhere you would like to hang out. The patio looked more promising with music playing (no music was playing inside).
The food is really bad I had salmon egg Benedict I really heated very bad quality ingredients waste of money

It has great outdoor seating if you want to bring your pets. You order at the window and they bring your food to you. I ordered eggs benedict with veggies on top, which consisted of a buttermilk biscuit topped with avocado, a poached egg, mushrooms and onions. Amazing. French toast. On Point! The coffee needs some work.

Really good food in new combinations. I've copied the Mac on Crack for home, and it's a hit. I prefer sitting outside or do takeaway, the inside is slightly cafeteria-ish. Staff has been nice too. Parking can be a bit of a chore, especially around lunch time. I've not yet tried the breakfast.
Fun and creative menu. The Yolo- fried chicken with biscuit and gravy is a little bland for my taste. The blueberry muffin redeemed this place. Their house made bread and pastry are incredible.
Cute cafe but food is over dressed.  Tacos lack flavor and salads are swimming in salad dressing.

I would move to Santa Barbara for this place. It is easily the best breakfast place we have ever had anywhere. Their fried chicken is perfectly crisp and tastes better than any I've ever had. If you are looking for something super battered and breaded this isn't that kind of chicken. The biscuits are light and fluffy. Service was prompt and easy, just order and find a seat. Bring this to LA

Great experience. I ordered the French toast with fried chicken. The chicken is a thin boneless cutlet that is breaded and fried. The dish comes with two pieces of fried chicken sandwiched between three pieces of French toast. Very tasty dish. 

My wife had the tugboat with ham. She loved it.

The only thing I've eaten here is their Quinoa/Kale/Peach salad, and it was good enough for me to stop on the way to San Francisco just to order it.

Definitely come eat here, and call your food in for takeout orders. Well-priced, fresh, delicious salad.

Amazing.  We just finished a delicious breakfast at Shop Cafe. Had the salmon in yo face, oatmeal, and yolo. All delicious. The one thing thing that disappointed was the 5$ bacon, which we thought was overpriced and mediocre. Everything else exceeded our expectations and worth every penny. 5 stars!

We decided to do a quick weekend getaway to Santa Barabara. I was going down the list of breakfast spots on labor day, and was happy they were open. You have to order your food at the window and the food will be delivered to you and your table. 

I ordered the tugboat with shop cured salmon (eggs bennedict). OH EMMM GEEE..I love the presentation of the dish and how the eggs were perfectly poached. It's hard to go to a "fast food" type breakfast spot with eggs being poached. My salmon was a bit on the salty side. I wish i added a tomato to it to break from that saltiness, however I was able to hid most of the saltiness by smoothering my salmon in the holandaise sauce. The biscuit it came with had a crunchy crust and was very flakey.  It was a lot of food for me, so I ate the second bennedict without the biscuit.  Definitely a good dish to share if you are not too hungry.  

My man ordered the Rolex. It was like a wrap. An omelette with slices of avocado, bacon, a little bit of cheese, and some type of tomato sauce that had a good smokey taste to it. The egg was a bit brown on both sides, which I am okay with because my grandma used to make my eggs this way, however it was a bit bland. The flavor factor in this wrap was the smokey sauce they used.  They put just the right amount of sauce so it would not taste over powering.  They used chipati as the wrap. I liked it because it had a perfect crunch to it.  This is definitely something you can split if you don't have a big appetite.

Downfalls- Outdoor seating so there were a lot of flies coming around your table.  They ran out of water bottles, so the water was self serve in small cups. We had to get up a few times to get water. You will have to look for street parking. 

Would I come back for breakfast? Absolutely. I would most likely share a plate though.

Looks great on photos, awesome reviews but short of expectations on our first experience.  My wife and I walked 1.5 mile and waited in line for a half hour for a luke-warm to cold tugboat and Yolo.  Food was average but looked wonderful on the plate.  Appreciate what it can be on a good day but we won't be back.
What a great place to enjoy the beautiful Santa Barbara weather, good friends and a yummy fresh local breakfast!!! Can't wait to share our newly faved restaurant with our kiddos!!!

Really good but very large portions, I would split a meal. Got the tugboat but everything else looked amazing! 
Note the side of breakfast potatoes are chips not your typical breakfast Ps but they are still delicious. 
The Bloody Mary is decent but if you have a love for them you will be a tad disappointed
Had breakfast this morning. Great little spot with indoor and outdoor seating. Chilaquiles and YOLO were very good. We will be back everytime we visit Santa Barbara.

This is a cute breakfast spot. My boyfriend and I decided to give it a try and we were not disappointed, the eggs Benedict with salmon is what I ordered and it was super fresh not an overly fishy taste. My boyfriend got a hamburger and he said it was very tasty. Bottom line if you're in the area give this place a try, also recommend their lemonade.
Everything is 5 Star, the food, atmosphere, the service. These guys are killing it! Best poached eggs in town, and dynamite homemade biscuits. Don't miss out!
This is a great place for an early morning breakfast. Good food and great environment.

So damn good, every damn time. 

- service is amazing
- order right every time
- food is perfectly done
- top breakfast spot
- coffee is also great
- each visit precedes the last in quality

So delicious..Love their Yolo, Yum‼Great find! Everything is made from scratch. I especially loved their warm fresh homemade biscuits & delicious sausage gravy‼They make some really Awesome & delicious creations‼
Delicious every time!  Attention to detail, quality and flavor are spot on.  Yummy!   Nice relaxed atmosphere dogs are allowed.  Nice place for a beer and good food.

Cecelia Salad, In Yo Face & Oatmeal is amazing!!  The rest of the menu looks hip, innovative and yummy!  All of the ingredients are super fresh, a lot of organic and carefully selected you can tell.  This place is awesome and all employees are very nice and happy.  I can't wait to go back!

The menu is super fun, immediately had my attention with "Yolo" and "Bananas in Yo Face". I ordered the yolo, partly just so I could say I ordered yolo off a menu, and it did not disappoint! Buttermilk fried chicken was perfectly crisp and yummy, and had that homey taste with the biscuit and gravy. It looked like a LOT of gravy... But in the end, I was cleaning  my plate, so obviously they served quantity based on demand. Far exceeded my expectations!
We had the YOLO and Eastside with a latte and mocha. All four were excellent.  This is a great spot for breakfast, brunch, and lunch. They are only open until 2:30 pm.
Outstanding breakfast and great philanthropy helping Uganda with their profits. A must visit location in beautiful Santa Barbara

This place mystifies me. Consistently good reviews for average - but good tasting and wholesome - food and no there there. Eat inside in an unadorned lunchroom or outside with the ambience of Milpas traffic and exhaust. Like I said, good reviews elsewhere and I don't get it.

I Absolutely recommend this place! The food is always fresh and delicious. This place has a relaxed vibe, so if you're looking for a fancy restaurant I would look somewhere else. This place is my go to spot for lunch during the week, when i want something that's not to unhealthy.

I had a memorable experience here. There is street parking around and you can identify the establishment by the yellow umbrellas and it's also westside across the street from Milpas Motors. Food is good, well presented and drinks are served in Mason jars, how relaxing.

If I'd written my review after the first time going, this would've been a five star review. Since then I've been about 3 more times, and every time has been different. The service varies in quality, sometimes overly nice and sometimes cold. The food changes too. For example I've always ordered the Mac n cheese and each time it's different. First time was perfect, second time the apples were missing, third time it was this insanely soupey mess that was sooo unappetizing. 

The shop probably won't be my first choice for brunch anymore. Don't understand why it's always changing.

Great place to eat! If you like omelettes get the chillaquiilas, whatever you like for breakfast just forget it for one morning and get the chillaquillas. Did I say to get the...well you understand.  This place won't disappoint!
Awesome Brunch/breakfast place !!! A must-go place if you are anywhere near Santa Barbara !!! The tug boats were awesome !!!
Creative and fun! Love the funky location. Food was great with unique options, even the name is unique. Coffee was great. Chill atmosphere that delivers. We will be back, well done.

This place was disappointing after reading all the great reviews. Cold brew coffee was sludgy at the bottom almost undrinkable. We ordered the poached eggs with bacon on sourdough toast and the eggs were somehow over-cooked but also cold so it felt like it was microwaved because the bacon was also tough and not crispy. Very sad because how do you ruin bacon?! I was too tired from night before to complain & send back but should have. My partner ordered the breakfast sandwich which was so-so, better than my meal. On the plus side, For dessert we wanted to try the banana almond butter toast and the almond butter was unique and actually good. It was more like freshly ground & mixed with honey than a butter-very chunky. We did enjoy that at least. Would probably not return however.
Service was atrocious. They forgot half our order and didn't know what we ordered despite having our numbers on the table. Won't likely return.

I ordered the Tugboat with the maple bacon. Wife got the beet salad. Both excellent choices if I do say so myself. They actually have Bulletproof coffee on the menu here but I was too timid to take the bait. That hints at the vibe here ... it's trendy but other than the Bulletproof it isn't trying too hard. This place would fit in well in Portland.

Wow. Review is for lunch. Found this spot on yelp and I have to admit with the reviews. Friendly service from the cashier and quick turnaround on the food. 

Had the half of the General Sanders & Just the Tip sandwich. The chicken sandwich was moist, flavorful, and the homemade bread just right. The tri-tip sandwich...phenomenal. Almost like a French onion soup on bread. Meat was tender and very tasty. For sides, we chose the Mac and cheese, also bomb, and the mixed greens. Would certainly like to return to taste some of their other offerings.
Great brunch place close to downtown Santa Barbara. YOLO was so delicious. The service was excellent and the prices are very affordable.
Well, we went back today after a disappointing visit over 2 years ago. It was very good. Quality ingredients and tasty meals. It is back on our list of "walk to breakfast spots"!

Been there twice now. Every time I sayI won't go back. 

Everyone talks about the rolex. But you should know, that it's tiny and lacks much flavor. My GF got the sausage gravy and there was only one tiny piece of chicken, and I mean TINY. 

This place will likely get some attention for being new to SB, but the if they don't make the servings larger I can't see it catching on. PLEASE be in it for a good experience and not to make profits.

Also, all the 5 stars have come from people who barely review anything. I guess that's what happens when all your friends get on Yelp to help.

I came here for my first time mid way through my bike ride. i got hungry and saw this place had 4.5 stars. I said to myself i gotta try this place out. I got the rollex wrap, potatoes and a large orange juice. It cost me $20 for some mediocore over priced food.  The potatoes were greasy and undercooked. Hide yo wife hide yo kids cause they taking everyones money!
The best coffee ever!  What a great way to experience the real Santa Barbara.
WOW!  What a great place to eat!  A little pricey but worth every penny!  Would definitely recommend this place to anyone.

The place may be over-rated, I would like to give a 3 star (4/4/2015). We ordered Tugboat with tomato and Yolo with soft egg on the top. The bread part of Tugboat was very good, though I personally felt the overall dish was too creamy, especially with non-veggie topping (I'm glad I chose tomato). Soft eggs for both dishes came out too hard. Yolo was also a tad too fatty for me. A good thing was that even though it is more like a fast food place, a staff came out and check if we were happy with the foods. Points for friendly service!
Never too late to have breakfast even close to 3pm lol. I got the Maria last time and decided to get the rolex this time. I love that lightly fried wrap, perfect consistency, loved every bite A1
What a hip and exciting place. Food was great, staff and owner were so kind and welcoming. Will definitely be back!!!

I can't think of one thing this brunch spot could have done better! Service was fast and friendly, the restaurant is nicely decorated and the outdoor seating is pretty and clean, and the menu has nice variety. 

I had the tugboat with fried chicken, which was perfectly done. I added grilled jalapeños, which was nice of them to do for me since that wasn't a choice on the menu, and all the flavors worked together beautifully. Biscuit on the bottom was soft and flaky, fried chicken was tender on the inside and crispy on the outside, and both eggs had a magically runny yolk that I was very impressed by. The hollandaise sauce was delicious: I usually don't eat eggs Benedict because hollandaise sauce is often not done well, but a friend recommended the tugboat so I thought I would give it a try, and I'm very glad I did. 

I also had a bite of shrimp and grits and of the fried chicken and french toast: the grits were very flavorful and fluffy and the savory fried chicken paired perfectly with the french toast.

I definitely recommend this place for any meal you can make it there for.
The patio is great. I was able to order some huevos rancheros with some minor tweaks. The carnitas Benedict was the best eggs Benedict that I've ever had.

This place was awesome! I was a tourist in Santa Barbra and this breakfast spot was off the beaten path. It's tucked away close to the mountains away from the coast in a somewhat quiet neighborhood

The cappuccino was good, but small, and the chilaquiles was great!
Tasty food, there is nothing I don't enjoy at this little cozy restaurant. When the weather is nice, enjoy their outdoor sitting with nice background view.

We found this last minute on our road trip. Came first thing on a Monday morning. No lines. Staff was attentive and gave great recommendations. But the cooks THANK YOU we loved the food. It made our day. Looking forward to coming here next time we're in Santa Barbara.
delicious and creative menu! nice hidden gem for sure. i thoroughly enjoyed the french toast and fried chicken dish! they serve handlebar coffee as well which is great.

Sashimi grade salmon was spectacular and delicious,for my wife biscuits and gravy with fried chicken delicious too.
Place was clean personal and service atentive and kind.
For sure I'll return again,

One of my absolute favorite breakfast spots in Santa Barbara. I often take visiting guests here and it's always a hit. The Tugboat and the Yogi are delish. The Best Damn Oatmeal is perfectly named (because it's so damn good). Chris, the owner, is always working and is so friendly. His staff and the service is also great. I've never had a bad experience here and don't anticipate it. Love this place.
Typisch amerikanisch, ungesund, fettig und lecker. Leider haben wir Pancakes und Waffeln vermisst. Kaffee ist okay.

THE best salmon toast!  I'm sure I annoyed the customers around us by continually commenting on how good it was.  The capers are fried and added the perfect touch.  If we were in town longer, I would go back for every meal!

Breakfast in SB!

Ordered: The Frenchie, Yolo and both were perfect! I will now, always, crave it! Portions are just right, you probably won't have leftovers because it's so good. I love the basil whip!

Pros: AMAZING! This place is great for a sunny day with their large amount of outdoor seating, friendly staff, quick service, variety menu, and pretty succulents! 

Cons: parking is a tad hard on a weekend or holiday break

We went here for breakfast while visiting the area. My husband got eggs Benedict and I got the "Frenchie" both were super good and fresh. We took our dog with us since it's a dog friendly restaurant. I only took one star off because you seat yourself and I don't think it was very reasonable or organized. But I would come here again for the food!

The service is amazing--casual and quick
The food is bomb and their menu is unique
The coffee drinks are incredibly well made
The outdoor patio is cozy 
The music and atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable

Overall, quality service & quality food! :D

I've only been here for breakfast & it's my favorite breakfast spot in town! Will be back for their lunch menu. :)
Great breakfast food served late. Friendly service. Typical Santa Barbara prices, but still worth repeated visits none the less. Order that biscuit and you won't be disappointed!!!

Very cute spot. Order at a counter and then sit down on a nice patio with picnic tables. Nice ambiance. I was so hungry and saw them making the fried chicken eggs benedict (tugboat) and my mouth started watering. I was so excited when it came, but a few bites in I realized the chicken was not great. It was not a moist, fluffy chicken breast, but almost seemed like a frozen chicken breast that was then fried. It kinda turned my stomach and ruined my appetite. I did eat the leftovers later without the chicken. I thought it was strange though, because I wouldn't expect that from this place based on seemingly good quality of the rest of the food. Little pricey.
Good place for breakfast - the salmon and fried capers on toast was delicious and the coffees were good quality.
Yum!! A delightful and unusual breakfast spot.  Friendly and casual with delicious food and prompt service.

Nice outside area to sit. Fun menu. They are definitely trying to be fancy with the food. The presentation was great. The taste however... They seem to overcook some of the meat. 
I got the tugboat with fried chicken. Looked great. But underneath the eggs, the chicken was completely black. Dried out. I paid extra for it, but I wish I hadn't.
I had a similar experience with their burger. Excessive burnt char on each side of the patty. Not my thing.

Very overrated, I saw all the glowing reviews and thought this would be an excellent brunch spot. I ordered the biscuits and gravy (aka yolo?) thinking it must be good, I mean it's such a simple dish, they can't mess it up right? Wrong. The chicken was so overcooked and dry inside, I had to tear it apart with my teeth like beef jerky. The biscuit was not really a biscuit, more like bread. The worst offender was the gravy, it was far too thin to be called gravy; it was essentially a small bowl of soup with bits of sausage in it. When real gravy is poured onto the biscuits, it sticks because of its viscosity, but this stuff just ran off them like water. On top of that it barely had any flavor, none of the pepper and savoriness of you'd expect from a true Southern gravy. The poached egg was good though, but it takes serious creativity to mess up a poached egg. 

Was it edible? Sure. Was it horrible? No. But it most definitely isn't worth the price and doesn't deserve all the rave reviews.
Great food and great costumer service !! Love the location . Seems like a simple coffee shop , but the food has great taste . Prices are reasonable :)

Delicious food! A lovely little stop on our road trip up north from so cal. We met the owner and he was super friendly, chatty, and made delicious suggestions! Very cool patio and inside area. Great place to grab a bite and yummy coffee! Oh and can't forget the mimosas made with fresh squeezed OJ!! Thanks for the memories!
Great fried chicken and biscuits! Tasty but not heavy. Creamy hearty gravy. Perfectly cooked and well seasoned eggs. And the americano was solid!
Great place for brunch, everything is pretty good, especially the salmon eggs benedict.

Great breakfast/brunch spot + cool patio dining too (family and furry friend approved)!

We ordered the tugboat with fried chicken paired with a Vanilla Latte and the Northwest Salad paired with a Siracha Bloodymary. 

Both dishes did not disappoint - they were plated beautifully and tasted great!

As self-professed brunch lovers, and my husband having worked at one of the best brunch joints in Denver, we were super excited to check out this place based on all the great reviews. Our review is based solely on food, not on service (in which they did forget my latte, haha). 

The chicken, biscuits, and gravy completely lacked flavor, the biscuit was dry, and the gravy had broken - super oily and more like a weird, bland soup than a breakfast gravy.

My husband had the chapati wrap that was super dry and bland. We barely ate either of the meals and left. 

Cute spot in an area that needs good breakfast, but wayyyy overrated and pretty disappointing.
Celebrating my girlfriend's 50th. Picky eater and loves kale . She loved it! The owner and service are awesome. Coming back tomorrow!!!!

My husband had the Yolo and I had the Eggs Benedict, truly 5 star. Incredibly flavorful without feeling "overdone" and just the right amount of food - filling, hearty, just the right amount. Ambience was beautiful, quaint, and music quiet enough to enjoy your time with others while appreciating your surroundings. If you're passing through or a local, add this stop to your list.

Fantastic, clean, fresh, unique food with a flair of its own! Staff was incredibly friendly, & true to Santa Barbara, the owner came out & checked on us to make sure our food was up to par. 

We came during lunch hour for the high schoolers so the seating was a tad limited but our meal was done quickly & we managed to find a seat with little effort.

Boy is this place amazing! The food is so great, for lunch or dinner, you never feel quilty eating the dishes that at any other place would make you feel that way. They use such great ingredients and create very unique takes on classic dishes. The atmosphere for a Sunday afternoon brunch is PERFECT. I love eating here and bringing friends from out of town here to try it. The Tri Tip sandwich and quinoa bowls are two things to absolutely try if you go here!
What is so hard about serving a hot breakfast?  Bacon was not crisp as order and cold.  Eggs were good but barely warm.  Sausage was forgotten and then brought to us cold.  Next time will go to IHOP

Amazing restaurant, will be returning the next time I hit SB.  Had the tri-tip sandwich at the recommendation of the person that took our order, I'm sorry I didn't get his name , just a sweetheart and so friendly!  The tri-tip sandwich served on fresh Ciabatta topped with caramelized onions  and a wasabi aolli , it was seasoned perfectly, it came with mixed greens with a light basalmic dressing.  My friends 5 year old grand-daughter who is a very picky eater took a bite of her grandmothers sandwich  her eyes got really big and she said " that is so good" and actually ate more of the sandwich than my friend.
When we were leaving we decided to get a Iced Vanilla Latte , not realizing they close at 3:00.  But the gentleman who spoke with us (and who I think was one of the owners) was a total doll and put the order through for us .  Great service, awesome food!  Congratulations on opening such a stellar establishment and your Vanilla Lattes are to die for, yum!!
Definitely recommend this place.  Food is amazing. Order your food and seat yourself..... perfectly casual

The Shop Cafe is a testament to excellent breakfast establishments! I had one of the best breakfast  experiences I've had since moving to Santa Barbara (2 years ago) at this tiny gem.  The service was impeccable from management to the handsome gent with the mustache at the counter. It is such a treat to have management and the owners come introduce themselves and go out of their way to make sure your meal is served to perfection!  The Yolo and Rolex breakfasts were unbelievable; the fried chicken was perfectly crisp and seasoned. All combinations were on point not to forget the meritage of the creamy crunchy textures that play perfectly on the palate.  All capped off with a fresh coffee made this an excellent breakfast experience

If you take anything from this review, take this advice:

If your looking for a 'morning after' date....take them here
Have family visiting....take them here
Have a foodie friend....take them here
If your visiting Santa Barbara......GO HERE.
Want a great meal with great people...GO HERE!

Enjoy

As it was my first time being in Santa Barbara I had no idea which places were good for brunch so I did what most people do; searched on yelp & filtered highest rated breakfast places. I immediately knew from the pictures that this was a place my girlfriend & I would enjoy. 

The setup is super simple & easy. Porch seating was clutch & I liked the idea of ordering through a window. My gf decided to order the ahhnold & a kombucha sangria while I got the tomato tugboat & an IPA brass monkey. Everything was perfect. Favorite breakfast place I've been to in a while. Food was fresh & service was great. Highly recommended

This place is just THE BEST. Chris is super nice and always smiling. He lets me borrow a mason jar for a ToGo cup, as long as I promise to bring it back. They also already have paper straws. I love getting my almond milk latte here several days a week because it's DELICIOUS, and also eco-friendly. I've cut my plastic usage down ENORMOUSLY since I've  decided to make this place part of my work-week morning routine. It's not just because I don't get Starbucks anymore, but also because this place has helped me be conscious of my plastic usage in other areas of my life. Thanks For helping me do my best to help the planet Chris and Company. They also have amazing food. They put their own twist on many brunch classics, such as their version of eggs Benedict. Their biscuits will make you think less of those who use pre packaged English muffins, and you'll never want to order eggs Benedict from anywhere else on this earth. Be aware visitors, you won't find another place like this wherever you hail from. This place alone will make you want to plan your next Santa Barbara Brunch outing. Get there a little early on the weekends, because the line can be long. It's worth the wait!
Came here recently for brunch while on vacation and it was super good!! Definitely lives up to the hype. The mocha was also slightly cinnamon-Y which was super delish. Recommend!

So many people had such amazing reviews of shop kitchen (I'm talking Yelp, google, and Reddit) I thought I had to stop by for coffee and brunch. We went on a cloudy Saturday morning and ordered a salmon toast and biscuit and gravy yolo I think(?) and we were sadly underwhelmed. 

While there was interior seating it was not at all inviting, well lit or particularly warm so we opted to sit outside with the other early birds and brace the light drizzle. When I mention early birds, probably good to note that there are birds and bird poop around so if you are squeamish about that sort of thing just sit indoors.  I imagine that in bright, sunny and warm afternoons with the music blaring and an ice coffee this might be quite the scene, but at 10 in the morning with drizzle and a chill wind, Ariana Grande hollering about being some goddess was not really welcome. The shop should really keep the music moderate until a crowd forms. 

The food itself was almost an afterthought, the gravy and biscuit was good but not something I would go out of my way for. The house cured salmon on the toast, while I appreciate the effort, was too fishy for my tastes and something I would probably actively go out of my way to avoid... I am sure people who like that sort of thing will appreciate the 'bite' and texture to the salmon, but it just was not for me.

Best Brunch on Milpas! Wether you want a Salad, eggs or a fried chicken sandwich, this little shop's got you covered. Owned by a couple cool local guys it's been a good place to grab a quick bite out on the patio, check it out!

Must try their salmon Yolo and salmon toast. The bread was very soft and puffy! It absorbs the egg yolk and tastes amazing. The yogurt granola is also a must-have. Better than any brunch restaurant I have been to in the area. Parking space is very limited nearby.

YUM! This place is definitely amazing. It's super small but I love everything about this place. I ordered the salmon toast with sourdough. I'm weird about cured salmon because once in awhile I would get the "unpleasant fishy taste." The salmon here so good! Super fresh and light. The fried capers was absolutely genius. Poached eggs cooked perfectly. Sooo good. My favorite! My cousin had the fried chicken Benny. Soooo amazing!!! You would think it's a heavy dish, but it wasn't. Super light and super flavorful. Chicken was not overbreaded and was moist! Definitely want to come back and try everything on the menu!

Oh my god so good. The best Santa Barbara brunch spot. It's order at the counter which isn't usually my choice for brunch, but the food makes it impossible to skip. Highly recommend over any touristy restaurant for brunch
The tugboat is awesome!  The portions are huge and the quality is great.  We also had the French toast sandwich with ham and avocado, which was really good.

This little breakfast stop is easy to miss. The establishment has outdoor and indoor seating. Ordering is done at a walk up window, and the food is quickly made.

I ordered the East side, which is a piece of toast with avocado spread, cheese, an egg on top, and a whole lotta grilled jalapenos. There were a couple of sprigs of arugula on top. In my experience, you're supposed to cut out the seeds of the jalapeno -- but that's just me. It seems that the jalapeno was the whole open-faced sandwich, with very little else.

My husband ordered the Tugboat with salmon, which is a take on the eggs Benedict. The major difference is that the bread is a buttermilk biscuit. It was served kinda cold, but that's partially due to the salmon. There was far too much sauce. It was flavorful, but the fish is overpowering. 

As a side, we ordered the roasted potatoes. It can be its own meal, or a great share for the table. It's quite a generous portion. This was by far the best part of the meal. 

Bullet coffee and regular coffee were good :)

In my mind, I think I'd skip this place next time around and find a better breakfasty place.

Really solid place to grab brunch in Santa Barbara. 
-Eggs benedict with your choice of protein: fried chicken. They have heirloom tomatoes for a vegetarian option. Comes on top of a delectable biscuit, avocado (always welcome), and an extremely delicious smoked tomato hollandaise. 
-The wrap with eggs, bacon, avocado was really HUGE !! You can easily share this or turn it into 2 meals. It wasn't as good as the eggs benedict but still a winner. 
-Strawberry banana and basil smoothie was OK. Nothing really mind blowing but the addition of the basil is different. 
-Lots of veggie options for you vegetarians. Our veggie friends had the salad with the potatoes which was huge and also extremely filling for a salad. They also tried the egg white scramble that comes with a biscuit! Yum. 

I agree with people who said the flow of this place is strange. You order at the window outside, but then have to wait for a seat because there's like.... 4 tables inside and a handful more outside which makes it even more difficult when it rains (I realize that's not the norm but it did when we were there). Sometimes your food is ready before you are able to find a table, so then you kind of oddly stand there staring at it since it's a glass window peering into the kitchen and wait. Or you could just take it to go and scarf it down somewhere else.

Such a unexpected gem of Milpas St., Had The Cecilia salad made with Quinoa, orange, goat cheese, and slivered almonds. such a awesome dish goes great with the Surf Brewery Lemon Wheat Ale. definitaly a regular spot especially with the new addition of craft beer on tap.

We have been by 3 times since my last review.  Kind of a regular thing when in the area. The food is quite good but the last few times things have been so overly salty that everyone in our party has not been able to finish their food.  From Yolo's to benedicts the key ingredient has been salt.  Kind of a big turn off.
Unique menu that exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend if you're in the area. As recommended by others the YOLO was delicious.

We had two YOLO's with chicken, both were absolutely incredible.  I am a huge biscuits and gravy fan and this coupled with some excellent fried chicken and a perfectly poached egg was amazing.  
The eggs with toast, bacon, avocado was also good. 
Reason for four stars and not five..... the indoor seating area is not "quaint" as others have stated. It is very basic and the morning we were there it stunk like urine oh so badly.  Not sure if from the attached restroom or a vagrant passer-by the night before.  This detracted from the experience.

This place was so great that we went every morning during our stay in Santa Barbara. The Tugboat Eggs Benedict (one with bacon and one with fried chicken), Banana Toast, Sando, and Rollex were all top notch. As far as beverages, the OJ was some of the best I've had and the Vanilla latte is made with homemade syrup and tasted way better than anything you could get at a coffee franchise.

Love this joint! They have a great selection of food. I especially love how well crafted their salads are. We have tried quite a variety of dishes on their menu. Our overall experiences have been great. It outdoor seating and indoor seating. The staff is always friendly and attentive. 

My only complaints are that their fish tacos are too wet and get the tortilla soggy. Additionally, their buns on their chicken sandwich and the burger aren't the best. The buns are little dry which is unfortunate because it distracts from their flavorful meat and fillings. 

Regardless, I still recommend this place because their menu has so many other great options.

This place never fails. Everytime I come I leave very satisfied. The side of potatoes (~$4)are a must for me. Its crispy- almost like chips! The only scary part is when you get to the bottom and its a puddle of grease. 

Last time, I got the special which was a toast with goatcheese, honey, persimmon, walnut. I was so amazed by it that I had to buy the ingredients to recreate it. Their toast is thick and very soft like a cushion. This time, I got the toast with jalepenos, avocado, cheese. Theyre reallly generous with the avocado! My friend got the tugboat with fried chicken. The portions were huge and the biscuit was different. Very flaky! The tri-tip sandwich was also very delicious. They had a good amount of tri-tip. It came with a side of homemade chips. I would recommend all the things I got!

Pretty good! I really loved the drinks, and the food came out fast! You order at a window then have a number that someone comes and serves you the food. The drinks come out of a separate window outside. The eggs benedict was phenomenal. My friend got the YOLO and said the chicken was dry, but everything else was good. I would return if I ever find myself in the area again!

Try this place because of the reviews 
But today wasn't a good day 
Eggs uncooked 
Chilaquiles looks good in pictures but was flavorless

I am heartbroken that they took the world's best Mac and cheese off the menu. 2 stars off for that, because now I'm not compelled to go out of my way to get that incredible dish. Now, I just dream about the strawberry basil smoothie.
Amzing food! So fresh and great options for breakfast/brunch. We visited for the first time and most definitely will be back.

What a great breakfast place! I tried the fried chicken tugboat and could not have gone wrong.

I like how you order your food and they bring it out for you, no waiter service. 
They have outdoor sitting and few tables inside. 
Food comes out pretty fast. 

The only con is the wait to order. There's only one person taking orders and if you go on a Sunday, you will have to wait a little bit.

Good casual breakfast joint with delicious food !

Love this place!! Super cute decor, friendly staff and amazing food. I went there with the hubby and I had the banana french toast (absolutely delicious) and he had the fried chicken benedict (also super yumy). I'll definitely come back and would recommend this place to anyone who's looking for a great meal. :)
Will come back to try the Cecilia, well, just 'cause, you know  hehehehehe
Awesome eggs Benedict with fried chicken and avocado jalapeño toast with same fried chicken. Took a star off because the bread was not toasted and the fried chicken was not hot.

I can't say enough good things about this place! The Shop is the restaurant I frequent most often. Hands down, best brunch/lunch in town. It's a tad on the pricey side, but the quality is amazing and this is also Santa Barbara... Try it out! You won't regret it!

Fantastic brunch! We went here three times on our trip from SF. Coffee from Handlebar (think Blue Bottle, Intellegentisia, etc) and delectable offerings. I had the tugboat (eggs Benedict with salmon) twice and the salmon toast. The Benedict is fantastic - perfect hollandaise - creamy, tangy, not too rich. Perfect poached egg, delicious house made salmon (great texture and not salty) all on a biscuit. Hubby had the Northwest salad, which he loved and the poached eggs on toast with avocado. Toddler had the French toast (it can come in kids size). Loved everything- also went on weekdays so no wait!
Oh dang. This place os the bomb.  Really good gluten free bread too.  All is good and really nice cool staff.  Always a good solid choice.

Love this place. Really thankful they have gluten free options and really nice GF bread as an option. I always have the poached egg with salmon & think the crunchy capers are the best idea ever. Wish it had 2 eggs though & it needs some arugula to perfect it. One of my favorite places in town.

I didn't know what to expect when my GPS told me we'd reached our destination--the exterior says it's J's tire and auto place.  I guess I thought it would be typical, greasy, warmed-up dive food.  Whatever I was expecting, I was wrong.

I ordered the Shop Burger, a burger with cheese, a generous serving of pickles, lettuce, and horseradish sauce on a ciabatta bun.  My husband ordered the "Bananas" toast, with your choice of toast (he chose sourdough), almond butter, honey, and banana.  Honestly, I thought I was getting the better end of the deal.

When our orders arrived, I saw I was once again wrong.  We both got the better end of the deal.  My burger was enormous, and came with homemade chips, and his "toast" was about an inch thick and eight or nine inches across, with a quarter inch thick spread of what was less almond butter and more finely chopped almonds, a dash of salt, and what appeared to be an entire banana.

And the taste.  I couldn't have gotten better from a fancy restaurant if I looked for one.  I want to come here every day.  It's a shame I live two whole hours away.
Nice Handlebar coffee and a great Tugboat eggs benedict with a twist on the hollandaise. There is plenty of outdoor seating with a view of the Santa Barbara hills. The French toast was average.

Walk up order type of place, very small. Quick with orders as well as getting the food out. Moderately friendly staff. Kinda a bad location. Food was ok, I got the eggs Benedict and my girlfriend got the Chilaquiles with pork. Pork was the best part of that dish, it was perfectly cooked and had good flavor. Eggs Benedict were good because they weren't swimming in hollandaise sauce. Not a place I would really go back

Soso happy they are in our hood! Finally some good food on milpas! really love the food, great fresh ingredients, creative, tasty and nice portions and prices. Beautiful indoor and outdoor seating. Very nice and fast service. Nice drinks. So happy we found this place will be back all the time!!
Very casual place on the side of a road, self-service. Friendly place with outdoor and a small indoor area. Food was delicious-had the French toast and potatoes.

We stopped here before heading to Los Olivos and had a GREAT breakfast. We tried their tugboat (Benedict on a biscuit) and their frenchie toast with fried chicken. Everything tasted great and wasn't too heavy considering the big flavors! We can't wait to come back!
Healthy, flavorful food that demonstrates the beauty of free market capitalism. I'd come back to savor a tugboat and steelcoat oatmeal any day.

The tugboat was everything. They use a southern style biscuit instead of English muffin. Good texture. Bacon was also very good. Loved it. Fresh orange juice was super fresh. The patio had a nice ambience with nice music in the background. Great place for a quick breakfast. Service was very fast.

Amazingly unique breakfast and lunch combinations in a quaint, simple setting. I had the Tugboat Eggs Benedict on carnitas, and they were absolutely to DIE for! Served on a moist, home-baked biscuit, covered with generous helpings of fresh guacamole, then layered with tender carnitas, a perfectly poached egg, and smothered in their tasty & tangy tomato-hollandaise. We are from the San Francisco Bay Area where there are sooo many restaurants - and yet, I'd say Santa Barbara has the food scene down! At literally *every* place we've eaten on this trip, the owner has come out to greet us, ask about the food, and check on us. I highly recommend this great little find on Milpas...!

Visiting my daughter in Santa Barbara and went to breakfast at the Shop! What an incredible experience! There are breakfasts and than there are BREAKFASTS! The yogurt parfait was superb as well as the sandwiches. Customer service was great and special Kudos to Jeremy for going out of his way to make us feel welcome!
