This was a great addition to Milpas Street in Santa Barbara several years back you get to sit on the patio an order at the window and the food that they create is so beautiful and tasty they can provide breakfast or lunch they're not open all day so that something to be aware of they also have selections of beer and wine along with items for the kids if you're looking for something fresh and farm to table you definitely want to check out the shop kitchen I absolutely love their tugboats really there's so many things on the menu I love I can't even list them all regardless of what you pick I guarantee the taste will amaze you and he will be back if you're looking for a discount to try this place check out Groupon

This is a hidden gem and an unexpected delicious eatery! I came here for a late Saturday breakfast and they were out of the  hollandaise. Most of the menu is made in-house and at a 3 PM arrival, I can't blame them for running out of sauce.  Luckily they were open for lunch so we decided to dine there anyways. There were three of us and we shared the mac-on-crack, which was a spin on mac and cheese but it still lacked that nice cheesy pop.  I ordered the quest love salad, which was prepared perfectly. I enjoyed the roasted carrots with beats and goat cheese. It was the perfect salad for a hot summer day.   

The next day we returned for breakfast and OhOhOh, it was amazing!  I added two poached eggs to the salmon-in-yo-face and also tried the tugboat. I can't tell you which was better; they were both amazing.  

I highly recommend The Shop Cafe for anyone who is looking for a decent priced yet delectable breakfast for lunch.  You will not be disappointed.

Don't let the outside fool you.  It is a walk up to order but there is plenty of seating inside or out.  Staff is super nice, patient and friendly.  I had the tugboat and my daughter had the oatmeal....neither disappointed.  Can't wait to go back and try some lunch items.  I don't believe they have a kids menu, which would have been nice.  $8.00 for oatmeal for a 5 year old is a little much and she could only eat half.  Smaller options would be nice.  Overall though, I highly recommend.

Quaint little breakfast and lunch place.  You step up to the window to order your food.  Then grab a seat, and your food will be served to you in a few minutes.  My friend and I sat outside since it was such a lovely day. 

My friend's Tugboat (eggs benedict made with a butter biscuit) was served by a runner, who brought a napkin and silverware with him, which was helpful as there weren't any at the tables.  A different runner served me my YOLO (butter biscuit topped with a fried chicken breast, fried egg and smothered with country sausage gravy), but my runner didn't bring any silverware nor napkins.  I had to get up and fetch a set for myself.  Hmm...

My friend enjoyed his Tugboat but had to get extra Hollandaise sauce, possibly because the biscuit is drier and denser than your traditional English muffin.

I found the YOLO to be just OK.  Good flavors with the gravy, but the thickness and the dryness of the biscuit seemed to hamper the enjoyment of the biscuit.  I ended up leaving 3/4 of the biscuit in the bowl.
Great food, and amazing people working there/owners. I LOVE the rolex breakfast wrap! Get it a couple times a month!

Call me basic but I love a good avocado toast. This place has about 6-8 different toasts on the menu and they all sound great. I went with the Eastside toast on wheat and it was more than I could have dreamt of. The sautéed jalapeños added a nice touch of spice. Can't wait to come back next time I'm in SB.

Literally everything I've tried here is delicious. I carry out a lot from here because you can park right in front of the carry out window. 15-minute/green zone. Very easy. But they also have a great patio with shade. Dog friendly. My favorite is the Tijuana wrap. And, the fries are always piping hot and delicious. The tugboat is amazing. Could go on and on. Just go eat here. Highly recommended.

A favorite in SB! The orange juice tastes better than any I have had before. The coffee is 10x better than any Starbucks. And the food (I love the chilaquiles) is amazing. I love the relaxed counter vibe of the place because I can bring my dogs and enjoy the weather. Parking is not too bad with street parking all around.
I got the Rollex and was extremely pleased. This is one of the breakfast wraps I've had in a long time.

This is my favorite breakfast /brunch spot up to date. It's a corner shop with a small living room like area with limited seating and an outside patio with tables. I recommend coming early as possible to avoid the large crowds. The way it works is you order first then grab a number for your table. 

I highly recommend ordering their french toast with fried chicken. This is spectacular and definitely out of the ordinary waffle & chicken hype. Their toast is thick with a nice maple syrup but not drenched where it's soggy. The chicken is almost like a thin slice from the breast and fried lightly with a nice glaze. To top it all off, they even add a small pinch of crushed basil on top of the toast. It's mind blowing really. 

My gf enjoyed her chicken, biscuit and gravy dish which was also delicious. I love how they serve their white meat sauce on the side to balance out the flavor and to have more control. I really enjoyed this dish from top to bottom. I do recommend pouring some hot sauce for more kick and flavoring. Truth be told, this dish is better than The Reggie from Pine State in Portland. 

Overall, this place was the best eatery we ate at in SB. It shined the most out of my list of eateries.

We decided to come here due to the great Yelp ratings, and were a bit disappointed. We ordered The Melt, Like a tiger, and the Tugboat with salmon.

The Melt (french toast sandwiches with ham and cheddar):
Probably the best dish of the three: not too sweet, and the cheese was nicely melted, but nothing special I would go out of my way for.

Likeatiger (egg white omelette):
Found a couple eggshell bits in here, but even ignoring this fact, the dish wasn't very cohesive. The rosemary sprinkled on top was out of place flavor-wise, and overwhelming considering the blandness of the underseasoned egg white and vegetables.

Tugboat (eggs benedict over biscuits, with salmon):
Similar to a couple other reviews on here, the salmon was extremely fishy. The avocado pieces were unripe/hard.

Overall, probably won't be coming back.

Wow. The best breakfast we have had in Santa Barbara. My wife and I both got the Eastside Toast, I added the carnitas. The avocado was perfect, creamy and delicious, jalapeños just the right heat, and the sourdough bread fantastic. The mimosas were tasty to boot. Tip, add the carnitas, seriously tender, moist and flavorful! Staff came out to check on us and were very considerate! We will def be back when visiting Santa Barbara!!!

My wife and I ordered the Eggs Benedict and my daughter something else (don't remember what). My wife's didn't come until 15 minutes after mine and my daughter's because they thought she just wanted 1 of the EB. Mine was cold so I told them and they made me a new one. The replacement came in about 5 minutes (not too bad) but it was still only warm not hot. It was pretty good but certainly not great. A ton of bacon, which I liked but my wife thought it was overkill. I've had better EB. Not sure what all the hype is about. If a restaurant can't get the part about serving hot food right, they have failed in my book. I would give 2-1/2 stars is I could.

I ordered the tugboat with chicken. It looked amazing but was kind of bland. Not worth the price. I didn't care for the biscuit - too "bready". Chicken was good. Hollandaise needs improvement. $55 for breakfast for two. Line took about 10-15 minutes on a Saturday morning but the food was served within 2 minutes.

Quick and easy for lunch. My go to is General Sanders. Hearty chicken deep fried sandwich with their amazing slaw. But what first got got their was the "Just The Tip" tri tip sandwich. Amazing sandwiches.

Best breakfast/lunch in Santa Barbara!  Menu is limited but it has all my favorites. And not just the usual fare. Chiliquilles and michelada and bullet proof coffee.  I love it:-). But come early because there will be a line.  And I would suggest the family style dining outside to enjoy your meal.

The food here is always good. My favorite is the egg toast with avocado and bacon. They know how to get the poached egg just right.  I went with a group of friends and everyone was happy with their food. Everything looked fresh and delicious! I will continue to eat here and i definetly recommend it!
We were just passing through Santa Barbara and decided to stop for some brunch. So glad we picked this place it was amazing delicious!
The Shop Kitchen!!! Is a hidden gem. If your a foodie I would urge you to visit this spot while in Santa Bárbara. Yummy  chilaquiles, eggs Benedict and chicken n waffles just to name a few.

I went to pick up my daughter from UCSB for the summer and figured that we would have brunch before we hit the highway back to OC. Like I often do before I head out of town I scope out Yelp for local eats in my destination city.  Santa Barbara / Goleta were both on my target list.  However most of the places I wanted to try weren't open at 10:30 AM.  However I did spy the Shop Kitchen and saw all the pictures of the different types of Benedict that they sell and I B-marked it marked it right away. 
 
When we first arrived I was a little confused about what we were getting into.  It's a walk up an order at the window joint that has both indoor and outdoor seating.  We opted to enjoy the great weather outside.  https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/the-shop-kitchen-santa-barbara?select=vLyo26GP9SnNcSrlEIDsfQ  

After a few minutes in line while scanning the menu we figured out what we were going to have. 

 Food Ordered
The three of us ordered the following goodies:

My daughter ordered The Maria:  Grilled chicken, marinara sauce, cheese, and Shop mayo on ciabatta.  Also came with a nice salad.  https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/the-shop-kitchen-santa-barbara?select=-o8maLS9rG0IcckeQ91Leg

Son ordered the Frenchie: Grilled French toast with basil, fried chicken and real maple syrup. https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/the-shop-kitchen-santa-barbara?select=VUi2dh4A3xHytyhiHEN6VA

I ordered the Fried Chicken Tugboat: Eggs Benedict with a grilled buttermilk biscuit topped with avocado, 2 poached eggs smoked tomato hollandaise with fried chicken.  https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/the-shop-kitchen-santa-barbara?select=J43Hc3vRVEHGsD8upoSuTA


Food Taste:

My daughters chicken sandwich was a freshly fried cheesy marinara love, She doesn't eat a lot normally so when she scarfed this one down that said a lot to me. She saved me one bite. She gave it 4.5 Stars!

My sons Frenchy consisted of fried chicken and delicious French toast. He said it was the bomb. 4.5 Stars

My fried chicken tug boat was basically a Benedict on freshly baked biscuits, with some more of that yummy fresh fried chicken, delish guacamole and the usual Benedict partners. It was a surprisingly large breakfast that tasted fantastic.  The chicken was on point and could be a meal in itself ... 5 Star! https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/the-shop-kitchen-santa-barbara?select=FKKVEIWI66eRMp3uTfthNg

The place has a fair amount of inside and outside seating.  https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/the-shop-kitchen-santa-barbara?select=lC2oU0RyepFZmS937BHXzQ   https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/the-shop-kitchen-santa-barbara?select=eYm743sTAz8jP3JOMqBHtw

Parking is where you find it, parked across the street.  https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/the-shop-kitchen-santa-barbara?select=-d04U11afNs6LjHP1Czwkw

I dig this place a lot!  And will return!

Disappointed. Food was mediocre and not what I expected. I got the smoked salmon instead of bacon in my wrap but by the time I got my food, the salmon had cooked and made the wrap fishy. Staff was unhelpful

Great spot for breakfast or lunch. The quality of  food is always consistent and the kitchen is clean. The staff are friendly and helpful. I love the Eggs Benedict but everything I've tried is amazing. I can always count on this restaurant for a satisfying meal!

Everyone needs to try this place. What a great experience. Casual and yet comfortable and delicious. This is one of the most wonderful breakfast entree I have had since moving to live in Santa Barbara for awhile. Casual, order at window, fabulous outdoor seating and great menu with lots of options. Friendly service and high quality food. If you don't need all the extras but love tasty wholesome food , this is the place. Order up and enjoy. I will be back.

Stopped here for lunch on our way out of town. Thoroughly enjoyed our meal. Had a tough time making up my mind and settled on YOLO, fried egg over fried chicken over biscuits and gravy. Very good. My wife enjoyed here Northwest salad as well. Will be back next in or through SB.
Sooo good with choices from healthy to decadent- all delicious.  Good coffee options including Bulletproof.  We had the Bananas, likeatiger, yolo, and east side.  All perfecto.

Came here for brunch when visiting Santa Barbara. Our party shared yolo and and the shrimp and grits. Everything was pretty good. Very much enjoyed it. I prob wouldn't go back the next time I visit only because I would much rather try other spots.

My husband and I had previously visited this place a few years ago and it was amazing!  We finally found this place again on our anniversary and it was just okay.. 

We went on a Tuesday and there was only 2 other parties there at around 11am 

Our tug boats came out cold... only thing that was hot was our poached eggs. Kind of weird. I had the fried chicken and husband had the carnitas. The carnitas was literally ice cold. We were on our way out of town so we didn't want to have them remake our food. 

Michelada was fantastic !

Cute little spot for some breakfast! Friendly staff, delicious food and fresh oj. One of my favorite breakfast places to stop by when in Santa Barbara. I have yet to have waited for a table and am always happy with my meal. Nice outside patio to enjoy the weather but also has inside seating.

Best spot on Milpas for breakfast! While I have yet to try something I haven't liked, I have a few suggestions.  If you are in the mood to indulge yourself, order the Eggs-in-Yo Face with bacon and avocado. Oh. My. Delicious.  A thick cut piece of house made bread toasted to perfection with poached eggs and a pile of chopped bacon.  If you prefer a lighter fare, try out the Good Day Sunshine; A delicious salad served in a bowl lined with potato chips. It's the perfect balance of trying to be healthy, but with a small cheat. 

They also have great lunch selections! Yet again, there's not one that I've tried and didn't like, but the Sweet Maria and Just the Tip are my go to choices.  All sandwiches are served on house made bread that can hold up to the meat and condiments inside. 

The staff is always friendly and helpful, but it does seem difficult for them to hear your order thru the small window, so speak up! They bring your food to the table and with a recent change, also bus the tables.

To recap, go to The Shop Café and try anything!

Prices are fair.  Food is decent, nothing to write home about. 3.5 stars.

Seating area can get uncomfortable on hot days.  Staff slow to clean tables.

It's like all of my wishes have been granted! Great place for breakfast/brunch! I got the egg Benedict with fried chicken. It was placed on a biscuit with avocado some sort of sauce and egg of course! I loved all the flavors together as well as the textures. I'm sure everything else on the menu is just as good! They also have handlebar coffee if you're familiar. 

There's indoor and outdoor seating. The only thing I suggest is that they make the indoor room echo proof cause it can get a tad bit loud in there.

It's amazing! The best part was the food and the worst part was that I don't live around here to come back often enough. The Tijuana wrap was satiating. The chicken in it was thin, but not dry and when I finished, I didn't feel a gut-bomb/food coma. I liked the patio with the rustic utensil holder and the service was pretty quick.

Visiting from Southern CA for a couple of days. Found this place on Yelp. Drove by and there was a long line, so we knew it was a must try. Not only that, we had to park a block away and we could smell the food as soon as we got out of the car. The eggs benedict with the applewood ham is deliciously amazing. My husband had the diner burger and that was just as good. We were both satisfied with both of our orders. Everyone is super friendly and polite. Love the food. Love the service. We can see why the ratings are so high. We will be back again.

I was visiting Santa Barbara in October and found this outdoor cafe through Yelp. Eggs Benedict and a french toast sandwich with egg, ham
and cheese were both delicious! Service was prompt. It's dog friendly, too. I will definitely go there again next time I visit Santa Barbara.
We stopped in on the way home from camping and I'm glad we did. Impressed with portion sizes and taste!

The Shop always has something new and incredible on the menu! I've been so impressed how they have brought the wait to order and get food down over the past season. When I need something quick, I'll always get one of the salads or if it's breakfast the yogi (yogurt parfait). There is something about their french fries where I want them even at breakfast (multiple of my friends have done just that). 

Honestly, can't think of anything I wouldn't be over the moon to eat here! We even had them cater our wedding and we received so many compliments!
The prices were high; and they messed up on my order twice. A good spot if you want egg Benedict's.
Hidden gem.Hole in the wall. Oatmeal is perfect with pomegranate. Unassuming. Good post hike brunch.

I have to say that I expected a bit more based on the reviews! Don't get me wrong, I loved the service and I think it's a pretty cute location but i have had the same style of chicken and Benedict eggs in SF and LA and they were way better! (3/5) Having said that, it was worth a try. Their coffee was superb in freshness, quality, and taste, which I included in the overall rating (5/5)! Probably wouldn't come here again, but I would still recommend it as a cute romantic spot for first timers or couples!

Was super excited over the menu options and great reviews so being a visitor in town decided to stop by and try! Overall our thoughts on the food were ehh. Excellent customer service but the food fell flat as far as flavor. The cost for the taste was not worth it BUT I'm guessing being in Santa Barbara the cost is expected. There MUST be better spots with flavor to match this beautiful beach town right!?

Visited The Shop Kitchen today, and had their Frenchie with fried chicken....  mind blown. Mixed their maple syrup with sriracha, to a whole new galaxy. Cleanliness inside and outside is what makes me give this place only 3 stars. There were flies when ordering at the window, dirty kitchen windows, and not just from the outside, but the inside. Sat inside the dining area, and I had to move 2 times because the flies were so bad. Very unfortunate, because the meal was delicious.

Update! 7/20/17 - I wrote a post about my experience at this reataurant (believe me - I'm being kind by not saying more). To make it even more appealing (and I'm being even more sarcastic) - Dudley, the owner wrote me this private message: 

"sorry about the attitude at the window, ill talk to my staff...we also just fired a girl for that so hopefully it was her and its fixed.

as to the food--you felt sluggish after eating fried chicken biscuits and sausage gravy? Fucking duh bro, i mean wow what a news bulletin...let me guess you ate it all too.  maybe next time go with a poached salmon on arugula, the bacon and potatoes probably didn't help either.  you might want to watch what the health on netflix...only you can make good decisions about your body.  Thanks for the feed back and we hope to have a shop open in Ventura soon, hope to see you there."

-- 

Well Dudley... It's my pleasure to share a little something with you....

I really don't need anyone (especially the owner of an establishment that I ate at) to remind me of making healthier food choices. Seriously man... if you want to keep your clientele, please be kind to them - both at your restaurant as well as on social media! This review wasn't created to go out of my way to knock you or your restaurant. It was to describe my experience at your restaurant. My experience (and my girlfriends experience) sucked primarily because of your teams lousy service (except for the one who actually was kind enough to smile and take our trays)! Remember - it is your crew who represent your 'fine dining' establishment. Seriously... I have no problem spending my money at other places who value my time, energy, money and patronage... My sincerest feedback to you: accommodating = positivity all the way around! It will help your future location(s). Attitude gets you nowhere...


Below the review that the owner (Dudley) reacted to:

Why on earth would you ever want to eat here for breakfast? My girlfriend and I went there for breakfast and the woman who took our order couldn't of been any more friendlier - yes, I'm  being very sarcastic. We ordered our food at the window and she was acting as if she had more important things to do than serve us. Apparently customers aren't very important here. I ordered the chicken, gravy and biscuits as well as side dishes of potatoes and bacon. Our side dishes came out first without warning and the food felt like it took forever to be served. The best thing on the menu was the bacon. Even getting silverware was a hassle! The only person who was decent to us was a smiling woman who was cleaning up after us and she promptly provided us a box. Honestly, I ate there an hour ago and I feel gross and sluggish. Is this SB restaurant trying too hard to be like LA? Nice try but even similar restaurants in LA have better service and items on their menu. Definitely not worth it!

As my first venture onto the Santa Barbara food scene, The Shop Kitchen was the perfect introduction to the cuisine the town had to offer. 

The Shop serves breakfast and lunch but specializes in brunch food. What I love about the place is that you don't have to wait until the weekend to enjoy brunch because they serve breakfast and brunch every day from 8AM-3PM. Another thing I love about The Shop is the quality of the food. While it's not upscale, you can be guaranteed a satisfying and filling meal at a good price point.

The dining area, which includes the outdoor patio, is a little small. That's the downside here. The turnover was quite fast, however, and even at 11AM when I went on a Sunday, I was able to get a table immediately. If you are in a rush, this is the perfect place to eat a quality meal without sacrificing your body to a diarrhea-inducing McGriddle or to a bacteria-infested IHOP table. 

But enough about The Shop itself, let's talk about the food!  

ll The Frenchie ll
For my first time there, I couldn't decide if I wanted to satisfy my sweet tooth or go for something salty and savory. As with all great decisions, the answer was compromise. I ordered "The Frenchie," grilled French toast served with fried chicken. The dish sounds basic, but skilled cooks know how to elevate the seemingly ordinary to something unexpected by marrying complimentary flavors together so that every bite is exceptional. Luckily, skilled cooks are the people employed at The Shop!

With "The Frenchie" what you get is the sweetness of the mixed berry syrup and vanilla extract that is tempered by the hint of basil and the boldness of nutmeg and cinnamon. Each slice of toast is paired by a juicy, perfectly seasoned chicken breast. 

The only thing that had me cringe about the restaurant was the faucet that you get your water from. At the risk of sounding like a snooty, privileged brat, I will admit that I am hesitant to drink tap water just because you never know how clean that water supply will be. 

Anyway, if you can overlook the water situation, The Shop Kitchen is the perfect place to brunch with your best friends regardless of whatever time of the week it is! 

Food: 4/5
Quality: 4/5
Service: 5/5
Atmosphere: 4/5
Wow - the breakfast sando is absolutely life changing! The kids got French toast - so good!
Delicious Eggs Benedict!  We got them on gluten free bread (husband) and over potatoes.  Yummy!  We will be back again.
Best breakfast in Santa Barbara. The eggs Benedict alone are worth the drive from LA.

I have been wanting to write this for a long time and today was finally the day. I have been coming here since they first opened. I went to SBHS and I would come here for lunch every. single. day. I've been a customer for 5+ years, or however long they have been open. The food is great. I recommend it to everyone! Awesome spot, dog friendly, owners are amazing and so nice and attentive. My issue here and it's been an issue for a very long time are the employees. The only nice employees are two girls that I am acquainted with, one which doesn't work there anymore. I called today and I told the man on the phone if i could place an order for pick and he hung up on me. I called again and he took my order in the rudest way you possible. I have encountered this rude behavior and attitude almost every time I go and i've had it. It's awkward and uncomfortable to deal with this as a customer that has been loyal to this establishment for years. Like i said, the food is amazing, the owners are amazing but the employees need extra training on customer service. Fast paced or not, you are an employee and you should treat your customers (and people!!) with basic respect, on and off the job. I have heard the same complaint from many people about the employees. I get the urge to go less and less after every visit. Sad but true.

Extremely Rude Business Owner/Manager! I decided to give this business a try on Sunday since I was in Santa Barbara. After 15 minutes of waiting, one of the employees came up to me and stated that she didn't see my ticket in the kitchen and wanted to know what I ordered. I restated my order and she then mentioned that they weren't getting people's orders because the system was malfunctioning for some reason. I said that it wasn't a problem and continued to wait. After about 5 more minutes (and noticing that people who ordered after me were getting their drinks) I approached the pick-up window and asked if I could get my drink order. They were a bit confused and extremely flustered, which is understandable considering that they were backed up. However, one of the gentlemen came through. After 45 minutes of waiting for my food and (again) noticing that people who ordered 10 minutes after me received their food, I asked one of the employees if I could please get a refund. She immediately went to the kitchen and came out with my plate. I stated that I didn't want my food and if I could just get my refund (primarily because I had a 60 minute drive home). She looked upset and went into the kitchen to call the manager. I walked to the pick-up window next to the kitchen entrance and waited. The owner/manager then asked me, "What's wrong with the food?" I said nothing and mentioned that I had been waiting for a long time and just wanted a refund so that I could leave. He gave me the same reasoning that the employees gave me about the system having issues (no apology the way). I said that I understood but still wanted a refund. He turned inside, then quickly turned back towards me and said, "This is what we'll do."....then proceeded to chuck a $20 at me and walked away. Luckily I was leaning on the counter and it landed in front of me...but that was one of the most upsetting thing that I have ever experienced. Look, I've worked in the restaurant business...I've been a waitress, cocktail waitress, and bartender...I understand how things can get frustrating in a business...and with that being said, this owner/manager showed the worst type of customer service. I will not be going back and will bot recommend for my friend and family to go there because of how I was treated. I was extremely disappointed and would give this business zero stars if I could.

Their salads are amazing and sooo filling. They are a meal and it's amazing because a lot of salads leave me hungry after. Especially their salmon salad is my favorite. I also love to get their Cesar salad without the chicken, I add eggs to it for protein.

This place is a hidden gem. Half tire repair shop and half restaurant, it definitely exceeds expectations. We stumbled across is about a year ago and now we make a point to go back every time we're in Santa Barbara. 

Personal favorites are the eggs Benedict and the challah french toast!

This is a walk up and order place. Considering that, the customer service was great!! The food was delicious and came out pretty fast even though they were quite busy! The also sell boochcraft yum! Now my boyfriends turn to write.... 


Hey guys! This is Pedro the boyfriend. This place was really good! The service was amazing the food is delicious and the ambience was okay, it's a great place to start off your beautiful day.
We ordered the Mac on Crack and the Santa Maria sandwich. Mac on Crack was amazing and the shop made strawberry BBQ sauce on the Santa Maria is unparalleled. Great service too!!

The Shop has been one of my favorites since they opened. I love the outdoor patio, quick service,& friendliness of the staff. Very genuine. 
I believe it was the owner who walked around checking in on their guest. That's always nice.
Now! Let's talk food. 
I had an amazing salad. The Celina (something like that). Loved it. My son had the arugula salmon salad. Loved it. Definitely enough to share. 
I would certainly eat here again, plus highly recommend! 
I wish there was a Shop Kitchen closer to goleta. 
None the less, it's worth the drive!

Food was yummy! I was hoping that is was a sit down brunch/breakfast place but you order at the window and they bring it to you. Great customer service, food was good, Cappuccino was served in a little cup if you can see in the corner which seems kinda dinky, orange juice was not that great, but overall it was good!

We stopped by for Saturday brunch and we're better for it. Plenty of outdoor seating, line move quickly, fast and friendly service.  All Covid rules in place and followed. Now that's out of the way let's discuss the food. 

The menu is varied everything from gut busters like the YOLO (sausage gravy, fried chicken, fried egg, and biscuit) to somewhat lighter fare like the beet salad (beets, kale, goat cheese and figs). We ordered the Eastside (toast, grilled onions, jalapeño, poached egg and carnitas) and French Toast with bananas. Both we're delicious. Portions were average so order extras (muffins, bacon, grits) if you're looking to really chow down.

Great atmosphere underneath the yellow umbrellas across from the car shop. It's a great place to order and sit down without having to go through the whole waiter ordeal. The Carnitas were mouth wateringly delicious. I think I could eat this everyday without ever getting tired it. My mom polished off the kale salad too...aka she loved it. Definitely a place to come with a group of friends to chill.
Great brunch place.  We always stop here when we're in the santa Barbera area.  Especially love the the eggs Benedict on gluten free bread.  So tasty

Decent drinks, the chilaquiles look good in picture but were really soggy and flavorless. For the price I 
was really disappointed

A wonderful find on upper Milpas Street, very understated, and yet delicious.

Carnitas Eggs Benedict, Bananas French Toast, "Just the Tip" with mayo on that delicious soft roll . . . A great way to spend quality brunch-time.

Staff was very helpful in making recommendations, and even with a large and very hungry crowd, our wait time was minimal.

And with these beautiful Santa Barbara mornings, the outside patio seating was way beyond perfect.

Conveniently located on North Milpas Street and De La Guerra Street, and across from Milpas Motors, and next to Sam's-To-Go.
delicious coffee & outstanding amazing chicken eggs Benedict and chiliques with carnitas and avocado. Also got some house squeezed homemade orange juice

This place doesn't look like anything special from the outside and the location is a little random, but The Shop Kitchen is actually a great spot for a casual breakfast or lunch ! The staff was warm and accommodating, though this is the kind of place where you order at the counter (you aren't going to be constantly waited on). I had the Cali cauli bowl and it was pretty good! I snacked on some of my sister's French fries and they were delicious. I ordered a coffee, too, which wasn't anything super special but it hit the spot! My Brother and Dad has the Chilaquiles and they loved it, they both said it was 10/10. My brother is a vegetarian and had this without any meat and still was pleased. My sister had the Soup and Grilled Cheese and said it was satisfactory, it's sort of a basic menu item so it wasn't exactly Michelin star... you can't expect much from a grilled cheese but she would order it again. The ingredients were good and it was the best that it could be!
I mean this place needs to change its name to the Fabulous kitchen. I came to Santa Barbara for the weekend and It's by far the best breakfast spot. Plain and simple the best!

Extremely shocked to see how this establishment has received such good ratings on Yelp. We ordered the Tijuana with fries and a salmon toast. Both were incredibly underwhelming even though we were starving. The pictures of the food on Yelp portray a very different experience than we had. Portions were much smaller and the flavors were on the same level as a Ralph's deli. The overall outdoor patio and service were decent though. Would not recommend.
Another yummy meal! Thank you TSK! I'd post a picture of my food, Cali-Cauli bowl, but it's in my belly!
First time here - LOVED it! Got the Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup and husband got the Chilaquiles. Both tasted wonderful. Good portions. Staff was really nice!

Great food and wonderful staff. 

Ran into regulars who highly recommended all their food on their menu and new comers who were able to order food for themselves and something for their kids. 

You can park, order, and take your food to go during the pandemic. 

So glad to find them open.
Love this place! Recommend to everyone in town!! Food is great and has a great atmosphere. The staff and service are phenomenal!

Came on a sunny Saturday morning and the line was quite long, but moved at a steady pace. I was recommended the chilaquiles so that's what I ordered - highly recommend, but only with carnitas for that extra flavor and protein! Love their spacious outdoor patio.

Good food and fast service! The only negative is that they didn't offer restrooms for customers- I was instructed that I can use the bathroom down the street at the Taco Bell...that wasn't exactly a pleasant part of the experience, but I'm sure COVID has something to do with it. Just be aware when you go- go before or after!

We came for breakfast and it was early so we didn't have to wait long for service.  Staffs are very friendly.  You ordered and pay at the front cashier and they will bring your foods to your table when ready.  We ordered salmon tug boat and ham with toasts soaked in syrup.  Plus English breakfast tea and fresh squeeze orange juice.  Food was delicious and fresh.  Portion size is small but the quality is good.  Price is relatively normal for Santa Barbara pricing.  Service was quick and we enjoyed our breakfast.  We parked on the street and walked there.  This is a local joint, we see a lot of local eating here and you see students walking to school in the morning.  Located right next to a car shop.

The mac & cheese is not to be missed. The staff are friendly and helpful, and will give you pointers, so don't be afraid to ask what they like! The probably tell you the chicken sandwich, that is also amazing.

I don't care how good your food is, if your employee can't be honest and are rude to customers, I rarely write bad reviews, and my experience with this place has just been one of the worst. 
I know this is a difficult time for everyone, but if you can't provide the service you promise to provide as a business, then you probably shouldn't be open at all

On one of those special weekends where I would visit a friend, I would always do my best to eat as much yummy local food as I can. The Shop Kitchen was a promising option for brunch in the Goleta/Santa Barbara area. 
You line up to order outside and then can go inside and sit down to wait for your food, after picking up your drinks. The indoor seating was clean and aesthetically pleasing. There is a water station to get your own cups of drinking water, which is fantastic.
I really enjoyed the YOLO. The gravy was good, the overall flavor was good. Helped me to enjoy the one life I am living.
The Rollex was alright. I felt it could have had more flavor. The YOLO was definitely superior.
Our cashier was friendly and also sounded really chilled out. I expect nothing less from a California beach town.

I've been back a few times and have realized that I stopped going, which means my first review was a little bit too early. 

After some visits, I found the food quality to be inconsistent (sometimes cold, sometimes not seasoned well) and the service was also hit or miss.

This place is alright. I'd come again if somebody suggested meeting here, but I don't think I'll be back because I crave anything.

Was really excited to try, but a major letdown. And after seeing rude owner response to bad reviews I lowered my rating even more. Ordered the eggs Benedict with the salmon and my wife got it with the fried chicken. Both were cold. Not even warm. The salmon was hard to put down, gag worthy - And I love salmon. Pretty expensive for such low standards. Sadly the star of the meal was the side of potatoes, which were really good and hot. I don't know how you could mess up serving cold fried chicken - cold eggs that were over cooked (no oozing yolk) and cold hollandaise sauce. Very disappointed based on reviews, and the food looked like it would taste amazing. But when its cold, it's just not good.

I didn't realize when I arrived at The Shop that I had died and gone to heaven! I will eventually devour every offering at this establishment of utter perfection. Today, we started with their delish cocktails and mimosas. The mimosa flight included elderflower, beet juice, grapefruit, and orange. The Nena Fresa cocktail was simultaneously refreshing and spicy- strawberry and tequila goodness combined with basil & chili pepper. Our food and drinks were out to us in under 2 minutes. How did they accomplish such wonderful wizardry? For our meals we shared the cheesy shrimp & grits which was fantastic and the "YOLO"- a biscuit baked to perfection (there's that word again) with a fried egg and fried chicken- with literally the best gravy we had ever had the pleasure to meet in our lives. It was all so filling, quality sourced ingredients, very reasonable prices, with the friendliest staff and clean comfortable outside dining. An absolute was a feast for the eyes, stomach, heart and soul! Did I mention it was perfection?

This place is absolutely outstanding. I found it on a google search and boy was I pleasantly suprised. After thinking that I knew all the amazing spots in Santa Barbara I realized how wrong I was. The food is absolutely incredible. The seating is mainly outdoors so it is dog friendly. Every dish they plated looked absolutely amazing! The most important piece though, the food is phenomenal. The flavor combinations are perfect and the portions are exactly correct. To top it off I dont think that I've ever had a better Chai Latte. It's not fancy dining, which Is a huge plus when loooking at brunch spots. This is a place that you must go to, absolutely positively must go to.
Great spot with a nice outdoor patio. I love so many of the dishes here I can't pick a favorite! They also have a great chai latte

The food was 0K. we had the ham and cheese omelette and the French toast. They omelette came with potatoes that tasted like they were old and they were chewy. The omelette had good flavor but was accompanied by a puddle of oil that soon gave us indigestion.

French toast was cold but had good flavor.

The staff seemed confused. We asked them for some creamer for our cappuccino and they gave it to a table next to us who said that they did not order it or want it. Had to ask two more times in order to get it.

Pretty pricey for what you get but the ambience is nice.
$51 for two breakfast not including tip
This was the second time eating here.  The wait is a bit long but the food is worth the wait.  Definitely a must go for breakfast when in Santa Barbara.

I started my morning with a delicious Eggs Benedict with Salmon today.  It was very good, the salmon was fresh and the portion size was huge.  They have both inside and outside seating areas, and the customer service was friendly.  I would love to come here again and enjoy other items off the menu.
Probably the best eggs Benedict I've ever had. I didn't have to add salt or pepper, it was bursting with its own flavor! Cute outdoor seating and dog friendly.

I thought this place was just ok. I got a shop kitchen burger and have had much better before and for paying $16 for a burger including the tax and tip I would have expected better.

Food: OK
Portion Size: average
Service: Great
Environment: Amazing

Based off one visit, I think this brunch cafe is popular due to hype. The food was decent and service was ok. There was nothing outstanding about the place.

When you arrive to The Shop Kitchen, you stand in line to place your order. We waited in line for 20-30 mins. After ordering, you look for an open table. There's minimal seating inside, and wood benches outside. We waited about 5-10 mins for a table to open up. 

I ordered the Burger Special and my boyfriend ordered a tri tip sandwich called Just The Tip. Both entrees came with potato chips. While each one was decent tasting, neither was worth $14. 

If you're looking for fun named, pricy breakfast plates then The Shop Kitchen is for you. If you're looking for quality breakfast at a reasonable price, look elsewhere.

Service was okay. The food was alright. Overall not a place I would go out of my way to visit again. I got the cali burger and the fries (they charge extra if you get fries over chips). The fries were very very crispy and somewhat burnt. The food took a while to come out because they seemed to have to forgotten about my order. Rate this place a 6.5/10.

This place is great.
Quite, clean and good quality food.
Its great to find a place that provides food based on quality and not how much they can fit on the plate.
Love the outdoor seating

We ordered the Salmon Tugboat and the Yolo. The gravy that came with the Yolo was watery but the chicken and the biscuit were good. The Salmon Tugboat was good. The sauce that comes with it isn't very good though. Overall, it was pretty good and would go back again to try other things.

At the time my husband and I went to the cafe, we knew it would be backed but there was still plenty of seating. The service was absolutely phenomenal and the space was inviting and gorgeous. The food we ordered was well prepared and prepared fresh for us. I can get a bit picky about my chai and this one was an absolute favorite. Overall, a great space and very dog friendly!

Went here because it had one of the best reviews for brunch in Santa Barbara. And after eating I've come to only one conclusion. The residents of Santa Barbara must have no f**king taste buds if you give this place anything above a 2 star. I was charged $14 for a single half a** egg, a sliver of "fried" chicken (it was breaded at most), between two BONE DRY dog biscuits, and watered down clam chowder as a "gravy" side. In my delusional opinion if you want to take it or not, save your money and go get a McChicken cause that's gonna have more flavor than "The YOLO" which was what I based this review on.

Great breakfast, had the Eggs benedict with carnitas, which came on a deliciously delicate biscuit coated with avocados, outstanding. My wife had shrimp and grits, which were also delicious, cooked perfectly and beautiful presentation. also great service and an outdoor dining area with cleaned tables that we felt COVID safe

This place is new since I was last in SB, and Good Lord, what a find.  My 2 girlfriends and I kept saying, "Oh my, try mine?"  Best new food I've had in a long time!!  I had the chilaquiles, and don't remember what my friends ordered, but all our dishes were fabulous; tasty and creative.  AND THEN, there was this tequila infused strawberry cocktail...which is when I fainted...jk!!  Servers were super nice too.  Well Done Shop Kitchen!!

Great little spot where the line moves quickly and the food arrives just as quick. 

Portions are great for a breakfast spot -- filling without being overwhelming. The outdoor seating makes it a great spot for brunch. 

The gravy in the yolo was amazing. It's on the heavy side, but the highlight of my meal. All the food we ordered was great!

We stopped at the Shop Kitchen before a hike and it did not disappoint! The banana toast was delicious; the almond butter was very coarse which lead to a nice crunch on top of the toast. This toast didn't have too many ingredients but it was done very well. We sat outside, nice tables and good service!
the eggs benedict completely bland with no salt and had no flavor what so ever but the melt was really good i suggest getting that or a cheeseburger
Bomb bomb bomb!! Such an amazing place to have brunch. The food price is a little high but so worth it. Ingredients are fresh and make for a great meal!
Pretty good. I was excited to get their breakfast. It wasn't the best I've had but it was good. Their drinks are really good. Get the OJ. The ice horchata latte was really good too.

The Maria, grilled chicken sandwich with sliced avocado, comes with thick chips. Yolo, breaded fried chicken in large biscuit made at the shop, in grit (southern style dish), is very filling.  Salmon in-yo face, thick slice of toasted whole wheat bread with salmon, onions and a poached egg on top was great too.  Menu is creative and would be worth further exploring.
However, the menu at the ordering window is for minimalists!  The shop could do a lot better helping customer to order from an illustrated menu.  The photos from reviews look great, yet the menu description does not match.

This was a nice outdoor breakfast spot on the east side. Medium paced service, not quick but not incredibly slow and they only bring you the food, you order at a window in the front ahead of sitting down. The food is pretty good and the atmosphere can be nice since it is much more quiet being on the east side, it's a very calm local brunch spot instead of the super mainstream tourist places if you are trying for that vibe.

Good food, especially the shrimp and grits!

My friend and I ordered the shrimp and grits, the yolo and the mimosa flight. The shrimp and grits was amazingly good; the shrimp was some of the juiciest that I've ever had, and the flavor combination with the grits was incredible. I highly recommend that dish! The yolo was pretty good, but in my mind not particularly special. The biscuits were fine, and I wish that the chicken had more flavor. I ended up putting a lot of Sriracha on the chicken to give it a bit more a kick, but without it the chicken tasted a bit bland to me. The mimosa flight was pretty fun! There were four mimosas with enough to share between two people. The mimosas were pretty good, but I wish that there was more of a flavor difference between the offerings. The one that stood out was the beet mimosa, which I believe would be pretty polarizing depending on one's taste. There's a strong dirt aftertaste that I think some people may find unpleasant (my friend disliked it, and I thought it was okay).

Overall, I would come back for the shrimp! The portions were also quite generous, so I think the pricing was pretty fair. The staff was pleasant and the environment was welcoming. As for parking, the restaurant is close to plenty of suburban neighborhoods where you can do curbside. Just be prepared to wait in line a bit!

I'm inspired by how hard working the chefs and servers are. You can see them through the glass door just being submerged in their work, constant movement and meticulous. There was one gentleman in particular who looked so focused, in the midst of all the busy work behind him, he was taking his time seasoning everything. It was really awesome to watch.

In terms of the food. BOMB. Simply delicious. Everything looks SO FRESH. I had the Cecilia kale salad, with an added poached egg. So so yummy. The dressing was **chef's-kiss** just everything in the bowl perfectly came together to offer the best experience of flavors and textures. 

Their matcha latte was so so good. I was not expecting it to be so delicious. The matcha tastes very high quality. Definitely a place to check out while in town!

If you're looking for a great place to grab a quick bite this place is it! You make an order very efficiently at the front and they bring out your food pretty promptly.

- looks like an old school diner but they bring out beautiful vibrant dishes

- ingredients were fresh and I was extremely happy with my healthy dish

@neeks93 on Insta
We had a very satisfying breakfast. Savory and sweet. Coffee and juice. All good!! Food can give you such great memories to be part of the trip. This place gave us that. :)
Got the tugboat with salmon yesterday. The presentation was great. However, the salmon was too salty. I had to separate it from the rest of the plate. The chai latte was average at best.

Had the popular Chilaqulies with carnitas, it was very good. Drizzled some cholula sauce over it and it set it over the top. Had plenty of outdoor seating and shade. The parking is very limited and may have to drive around the block to park. But nothing to out of the way. Definitely would like to try the variety of other items on the menu.
These dudes are hard workers and the customer service is supreme! We had a great family breakfast here and it's the best customer service we've seen so far in town. Heck of a great place.

Visited Sta B April '21 and this place had a line for brunch for sat and Sunday. We got the rollex, banana toast and wife got the salmon toast. Salmon toast was ok. Rollex was o. I would order the banana toast. That was goood! Oj and coffee missed the mark. I would still  come back.

Overall food was great. I was a bit disappointed with the portion for the sides.  I ordered a side of potatoes for $5 and it seemed as if I received  half of a potato. I would definitely eat here again as the Shop-cured Salmon tugboat was delicious.

Popular spot in Santa Barbara.  My in-laws asked me to search for a place to eat while we were in this lovely city.  Did the Yelp search and saw that this restaurant had 4.5 stars with over 800 reviews so we all decided to give them a try.

Plenty of street parking close by.  We order at the window, and find a seat to dine at.  Got lucky and snatched a table for the 7 of us.  Unfortunately, we were all disappointed with our food experience.  

Each one of us felt that the food was overpriced for the portion size.  Personally, I liked my Bananas Toast.  Not worth the $10 price tag though.  That was pretty much what everyone in our party was saying.  Food was not bad, but definitely too expensive.  

From reading all the positive reviews, I am in the minority.  Definitely try The Shop Kitchen for your own self to see what you think.
Awesome place.  We had the chilaquiles, the eggs Benedict, and the waffles.  All great and the drinks also very tasty.  The ambiance and the music also so nice and relaxing

Yum! Found this place with really high reviews on here and had to try it! The set-up is so perfect for brunch with only outdoor seating. You order food before you sit down. The staff were very friendly and found us a table before we went to sit. I ordered the Eastside on sourdough and the jalapeños did not disappoint. They were perfectly spicy. My husband had the Tugboat and devoured it. The food was so good and their orange juice tastes so fresh. We will definitely be back! So many goodies I want to try still.
So good! The staff was super friendly and the food was AMAZING. The Benedict came on a biscuit instead of an English muffin which I loved.
It is a brunch place right next to a car repair shop. We smelled gasoline while walking in. But their fried chicken was awesome.

There was a healthy line on a recent Sunday morning when we walked up but nothing unexpected or totally overwhelming. We waited in line for about 15-20 minutes to order and just chatted until we reached the front. The gal at the register was v helpful in choosing what to get as a first timer. We had a small dog so she showed us to a table where we'd be comfortable and await our food. 

FOOD:
I ordered the shrimp and grits. They were just ok for me. I ate them but they are not your typical S&G's. I'm accustomed to gourmet southern style S&G's and these are definitely a reinterpretation with a more spicy flair. The French Toast we're scrumptious! I'm an aficionado and these were yum. I also am obsessed with the Anna's Cider Rose. My friend had a bit of a struggle with trying to sweeten her coffee because there were none readily available. 

OTHER STUFF:
Outside seating is nice and open. It's also super dog heavy so we had to monitor our pup so he wasn't setting any of the other dogs off. But not a huge deal. 

Overall, loved it and will def be back!French Toast
Great food - the Eastside (and adding an extra poached egg) is the way to go! But our group also had the Tugboat w/Fried Chicken (ridiculously tasty) and the Rollex  (delicious !)

Sneaky delicious breakfast spot off the beaten path in Santa Barbara. It's casual and quick spot where you order from the counter with a quiet and cute outdoor patio with a partial Mountain View. 

We ordered an egg white omelet that was so incredibly fresh and healthy and cooked to perfection with the best local vegetables. The salmon toast was worth the visit alone. House cured salmon on homemade bread and all the right fixings to bring it over the top. 

Love this place for a quick, healthy breakfast that leaves nothing on the table, literally.

let me start off by saying that I'm a basic bitch, and like a true basic b* I love brunch. That being said, I felt like Santa Barbara's brunch culture was lacking and I was mostly unimpressed by the places I visited in my first year of moving there. That is, until I found the Shop Kitchen. 

My first visit, I had the French toast with fried chicken which was ABSOLUTELY to die for. Chicken was moist, bread was crispy, making it the perfect sweet/savory brunch combo. Not to mention the pulled pork eggs benedict  - totally killer.
Second visit I was less hungry and settled on their toasts. I absolutely loved their homemade nut butter and would highly recommend trying it. Avocado toast with egg was relatively standard. 

In addition to the fabulous food, the outdoor seating area is adorable, set at the foot of the mountains, and the perfect place for the gram. Parking is a bit of a hassle (street/neighborhood) and be prepared to wait in a line to order.

First let me start by raving about their amazing/friendly service.

The way it works is that you order at the counter and they bring your food for you. There's a cozy area with long tables covered by umbrellas that you can sit at and enjoy your food.

I ordered the beet salad which was out of this world! For my drink, I ordered a grapefruit kombucha, which was also amazing! 

You have to give this place a try when you're on town.

After a short wait in line you won't be disappointed with your brunch. The food comes out pretty quickly and all tables are shaded which is nice. The staff is extremely friendly with exemplary customer service. Am very excited to come back and try their wings for dinner!
Very average! Was disappointed! The bread was not fresh and the egg Benedict was not well cooked!
The seating was nice outside, service was great. What I ordered was okay, I still did enjoy my time because I had great company.

So, first impression upon walking up to this place was not so great. Although they have a nice outdoor seating area, I'm not a fan of ordering my food and paying prior to eating, especially when they ask for tip and there is no real service provided besides cooking the meal, which you are not even sure will be to your liking yet.

Now I wouldn't be so disgruntled if the food had at least been as good as the tip I provided, but I was sorely  disappointed.  
My friend and I ordered the sunshine and the fried chicken tugboat to share. I was initially impressed by how quickly the food came out and by the presentation, but realized my food was not fresh because the "fried" chicken and biscuit in the Tug Boat Breakfast were room temperature, flavorless,  and tough to cut through. The warmest  thing on my plate was the poached egg on top, and that wasn't saying much.  They were generous with the avocado, and that's the extent of the enjoyment of my meal. The sunshine was just ok- had fresh greens but lacking in potatoes as described. Besides, how badly can you screw up a salad? At least they got the temperature right on this one. 

In hindsight, I should've sent the meal back immediately, but was too hungry after traveling a long way to complain. Unfortunately, it was my first meal in Santa Barbara and I will not be back to give it another chance. Pass on this place. Way too much hype and left here unsatisfied
Great food. Kids loved the French toast. Eggs Benedict was great.  A walk up order place and they bring the food to you. Outdoor seating only.

Saw the reviews on yelp and I wanted to try this place out. I got the eggs Benedict with smoked salmon and my mom got the Frenchie. Also added a side of potatoes along with a Bloody Mary. 

The food was good! My Benedict was cooked perfectly. Poached eggs were perfect consistency and the Muffin that is used is actually a biscuit texture. It had a generous amount of avocado and the Hollandaise sauce was tasty. Great food and the wait was not long at all. The line can seem daunting at first and we almost skipped it but we decided to park and see how it moved. It moves quickly and the service is good. Would recommend!
Fast. Friendly staff. Nice peaceful place. God location. highly recommend. Breakfast time 5stars

OMG! Their food is awesome. Love their Salmon and my son always orders their Diner burger with fries. The meet has so much flavor.

Great customer service and the price is right.  Go for breakfast or lunch.

This place was ok. The service was great. They were friendly and helpful and made us feel comfortable. However, the food was not the best tasting food out here. It was missing something. Maybe I need to try something else.

So so delicious! Was searching for a Sunday brunch spot in downtown Santa Barbara and found The Shop on Yelp! It absolutely lived up to the hype. We waited in line for about 15 minutes (not too long for a Sunday brunch!) and were seated immediately at the super cute patio. The food came out within 20 minutes and it was so fresh and yummy. The potatoes were OUT OF THIS WORLD! If your dish doesn't come with potatoes, order a side of them. I found the niña fresa cocktail to be a bit strong and bitter, but as the ice melted it was much more enjoyable. The staff were kind and attentive and there were tons of dogs on the patio - a major plus. Will definitely be returning!

Do not place orders through Yelp, as they are not a priority. Placed order at 10:30am. Was told it was ready in the app at 11am. Arrived at 11:20am and was told it would "be awhile" before the order was even started. Didn't actually receive my order until 12pm. And food ended up very much not being worth it.

My husband and I went here for breakfast and it was super delicious!! We are in SB this weekend from the Bay Area for a wedding and we love trying new places when we travel - this place did NOT disappoint! I'm vegan, and while they didn't have a whole lot of options - I was able to have the banana toast with house-made almond butter (FYI - it has local honey so I went ahead and ate it, if you don't eat honey you'll need to order without) YUM! I also got the mixed greens which had radish, green beans and tomatoes with a tasty vinaigrette. My husband got the Tug Boat (ie eggs Benedict on house-made biscuit) and loved it! He was raving about how good the biscuit was. Highly recommend!

This restaurant knows how to cook good brunch. I ordered the "Frenchie " in the menu to say I was very delighted at the taste, freshness, flavor, serving size, and promptness of service. 
My friend ordered the Mexican Omelette, every crumb on that plate was not wasted. It was delicious, not oily or salty, eggs cooked perfect. 
This is a NOT to miss place to eat in Santa Barbara :)

Stopped by here on the drive up from LA, and was drawn in by all the amazing reviews! Really chill place right by a car shop -- perhaps that's why it's called The Shop? 

We went all out and ordered the tugboat (signature dish), yolo, and like-a-tiger. For my tastes, I liked the last one best. Had a good serving of vegetables and felt like a balanced meal with just the right amount of food. The yolo didn't look very appetizing with all the food smothered in gravy, but it sure was tasty. 

Loved that it was great value for the money and there was plenty of outdoor seating. If you're in the area, be sure to drop by and have a bite!

I would give this place a 3.5. I was excited to try this for brunch but it was just ok in my book. We ordered the fried chicken tugboat which comes with 2 poached eggs on top and the bacon and eggs on toast. Don't get me wrong, it was good but it wasn't anything special. Love the view and outdoor seating, but just thought the food was pretty bland.

Delicious food! We had the salmon Benedict and the fried chicken with biscuits and gravy, and everything was so delicious. Everyone knows that you first eat with your eyes, and both dishes delivered. We had the nitro coffee, which was delicious also, and the iced chai latte. One suggestion would just be that there would be more chai in that drink, but everything else was fantastic. The aesthetic was super chill for the environment, but a great place!
Some of the best breakfast I've ever had, I ordered the eggs Benedict with fried chicken, and it was super tasty. Don't miss out on Eggs Benedict

The strawberry bbq sauce is amazing as well as the mac and cheese!! The mac and cheese is more like a pasta than a mac and cheese to me, but either way it was delicious. Iced coffee was also really good!

We were looking for the best eggs Benedict in SB. Yelp listed this one as number one. We were very disappointed. Have to say ingredients were fresh eggs cooked perfectly. Guess I am just used to the original with English muffin and creamy White sauce.  Price was very high. People nice and friendly.

Amazing restaurant, will be returning the next time I hit SB.  Had the tri-tip sandwich at the recommendation of the person that took our order, I'm sorry I didn't get his name , just a sweetheart and so friendly!  The tri-tip sandwich served on fresh Ciabatta topped with caramelized onions  and a wasabi aolli , it was seasoned perfectly, it came with mixed greens with a light basalmic dressing.  My friends 5 year old grand-daughter who is a very picky eater took a bite of her grandmothers sandwich  her eyes got really big and she said " that is so good" and actually ate more of the sandwich than my friend.
When we were leaving we decided to get a Iced Vanilla Latte , not realizing they close at 3:00.  But the gentleman who spoke with us (and who I think was one of the owners) was a total doll and put the order through for us .  Great service, awesome food!  Congratulations on opening such a stellar establishment and your Vanilla Lattes are to due for, yum!!

Great food and great service! The staff was extremely nice and helpful. The food is sooo good and the portions are big. I will definitely come back again and again. If you are in the area check this place out!
I'm an eggs benedict freak; I believe I have found the best one in town. Had the salmon tugboat, aka eggs Benedict.

Came to Santa Barbara for this breakfast place and drove over an hour for it. Was very excited, heard so many good reviews about the place and people but unfortunately that was not the case for us. The food was bland, the customer service was awful. I am completely understanding we are in a pandemic but also doesn't need to mean we have to throw all customer service out the window. We kindly asked if there was any restroom she said no. We asked if there was any near by she rudely responded to us. Adriana I believe her name was, I will not recommend people to this place because of her service towards our family. Again i completely understand pandemic and guidelines, I own a business myself and customer service and kindness goes a long way. For her not to help us or be kind about it was rude and disrespectful.

In all my years of living in Santa Barbara I have never headed to the shop kitchen for brunch. This morning my boyfriend and I decided to check it out, he had been there before and he and his mom both rave about the Mac on crack. There was a bit of a line we ended up waiting to order for about 20 minutes but we were seated right away.

I ordered the chilaquiles my boyfriend ordered the Mac on crack, and we shared the sunshine salad. I also had a Horchata latte with my meal. The mac & cheese was by far the best thing that we ordered. It was very creamy very flavorful and the green apple was a really great touch that I hadn't expected to like. The salad was also really good, it comes with a poached egg that made the whole dish really come together. I really liked the potatoes though I kind of wish that they had been warm or a bit more seasoned. The Mandarins were really good, I'm not sure if they're in season but really enjoyed them in the salad.

The chilaquiles were good, I really liked the salsa Verde and the avocado was perfectly ripe. However I see what other reviewers mean when they say that it's a bit mushy. I wish that some of the tortilla chips were a bit crisper to break up all of the soft food. Also most of it was a bit cold once it arrived at the table. This dish definitely could've used some texture. 

The Horchata latte was also good but a bit sweet so I didn't end up finishing it. All in all it was quite a bit of food I think we could've just done the salad and the mac & cheese and been fine. Since the chilaquiles were good but not amazing, I'm wishing that we had done that instead. I would definitely come back here but I will probably order the mac & cheese or try something new.

I really enjoy the unique brunch menu here. it's been my experience that if you go a little later if they are out of some things so it's best to try to get there closer to when they open if you want the full selection. The chicken and biscuit is a great go to (the "yolo"). I tried the riced cauliflower daily special with poached egg last visit, it was good but it could have used a lot more of the sauce and more seasoning for the cauliflower. Overall my dish was pretty plain this visit and I was happy that we were sharing the chicken and biscuit to go with it - never a disappointment. I would recommend asking for your eggs cooked medium if you're not into runny whites. it's been my experience that the fried eggs are really lightly cooked here.

The staff was so nice and accommodating but, the food was just ok. The gravy was very thin, the biscuits dense and the food was overall bland and lacking a salt. 

The chicken was delicious crispy but, needed some flavor.

I absolutely loved my visit here! The service was incredibly fast & kind, and the food was delicious.

We ordered a beet salad, which was so full of flavor and texture. The beets were deliciously sweet and paired well with the savory cheese and crunchy nuts. We also got a cauliflower bowl, which came with this insanely tasty green sauce, an egg, a generous serving of mushrooms, and red onions. My only criticism would be that the onions could have been sliced a lot thinner, but it was still great! 

Lots of people were ordering cute drinks, so I want to try those soon!

Delicious food! Outdoor dining was seat yourself and comfortable. Dog friendly as well.

Definitely coming back here again the next time we are up in the SB region again!
Breakfast was absolutely delicious.    My husband had the Tugboat w/bacon & I had Salmon Toast.

I really want to elaborate with this post as The Shop Kitchen deserves it but I'm too busy eating the best eggs benedict of my life. This meal is called 'The Tugboat'. It's just like your traditional style eggs benedict but instead is made with what tasted like a fluffy homemade biscuit as fresh as can be with avocado and your choice of protein as well as the additional benedict ingredients. The service and atmosphere were very pleasing as well, but let's be real-- I'm here for the food. I highly recommend this place and obviously suggest you get a 'Tugboat' of your own or anything else on the menu.

Below average food. It tasted like microwave dinners. Way below average service. We kept having to wait for the server to take our order or check on us. At one point we didn't see her in sight for about 35 min and ended up switching to indoor seating. When she finally arrived, she looked for us and said she thought she lost us. Yeah we felt like you lost us from the beginning. I should have gone to Denny's.

Not sure what to order? My boyfriend and I shared the Beets and The Melt sandwich. What a perfect combo...The Melt is sweet and savory and the beet salad with its' bitter kale and refreshing veggies was the perfect compliment. Add a Michelada and you have a perfect Sunday brunch! So happy we made a pit stop here.

What I enjoy about this place is the outdoor seating arrangement. Such a great place to be on a sunny brunch day. Staff is friendly and food is delicious. I've only ordered the chilaquiles and I like them. My main frustration is how overpriced it can be. Nearly $19 for chilaquiles with carnitas... and they're not even enchilosos. Pero están buenos. I recommend this place.

I came here on a Saturday morning around 9 a.m. and there was no line at all which I didn't know what to think of at first. There was indoor and outdoor seating but I opted for outdoor seating for the cute brunch vibes. Unfortunately, the food was not as great as I expected.

The sando was the better option of the two items that I got. It had a good amount of avocado and plenty of flavor in the sandwich a lot of it coming from the ham. I'm usually not one for potatoes but they were good!

The tri-tip, however, was SO dry. Looking at the picture alone you can tell that you really need to add some sauces to save the sandwich. Even the caramelized onions were not that great and that's usually my favorite topping if it's part of a sandwich. That said, the fries again were the savior of the meal with their perfect crispiness and saltiness.

Overall, for the price point, I would expect a lot higher quality food. Nothing special about this brunch place and I wouldn't recommend going out of the way to stop by.
Best version of eggs Benedict (tugboat) in Santa Barbara!! Love this place!! Sit outside and look at the mountains. The roasts are great too!! Our favorite SB breakfast spot!!

A gem of a find while in Santa Barbara. Small, unpretentious place with delicious bites! We had a few things to share - The Chilaquiles and the honey banana toast with almonds. We were tempted to order the popular chicken and waffles, but the two entrees hit the spot. 

The food was very fresh, filled with flavor and the recommendation for "wheat" over "white" toast was a good call. We enjoyed dining al fresco under the sun. Great casual place without breaking the bank,  and the service - nice and friendly. I'll have to return for the chicken and smoothies! 

Tip: Do jump in the queue to order your food, then take a number and plant yourself inside or out. The staff will deliver your food to your table.
Everything we hoped and even Better!  Delicious food at a reasonable price on a lovely patio in Santa Barbara. Such a felicity!

Came for a Valentine's Day brunch and we ordered the Frenchie with fried chicken, and the Tugboat with salmon. The wait to sit was not too bad, and service and food came out relatively fast.

The food was great, and I'm glad to say that this is a brunch spot that tastes better than what you could cook up at home yourself - after all many brunch places turn out to be overpriced normal tasting breakfast at an aesthetic location.

Overall, if you're looking for a tasty brunch spot in Santa Barbara, you can't go wrong here.

Our family LOVES the Shop. The food, outdoor ambiance, staff. All foody fantastic. BUT...

I am disheartened that their payment system has a default 15% added tip. The only apparent service they provide, above making the food you order, is to walk the food to your table. You still have to stand in line to order. Then stand in line again if you want to add on, say, a hot chocolate. 

The staff says you can opt out of the automatic 15% tip, but then you are left with 10% or no tip. 

I just have never believed in tipping unless someone provides a special service. If you order and pay for a coffee, you should get a coffee. Why tip them to make the food you already paid for?

I had a lovely experience eating brunch here with a friend. The food may not look massive, but trust me when I say that it's enough to fill two people up. You get there, you walk up and order at the counter, and then you seat yourself. They'll bring the food out to you, and they do it pretty fast, given the wait at noon on a Sunday.

We split the fried chicken Tugboat, which is an eggs Benedict done on buttermilk biscuits, smashed avocado and a smoked tomato hollandaise. I've never had such a delicious eggs Benedict in my life, honestly. The contrasting textures of crunchy fried chicken, a flaky biscuit, and soft poached egg really did it for me. The egg is a bit closer to soft boil than poached, as the yolk to white ratio seemed pretty far off. The hollandaise is really unique and tasty, and the freshly cracked black pepper adorning the top sealed the deal.

On the side, we got the fries, which came with a large dipping cup of ketchup. You can fill your own water (a blessing for those who drink like horses) in metal cups, which keeps it nice and cold. I'll be looking to come back for that carnitas Tugboat, or perhaps one of the other fried chicken dishes.
AMAZING! I ordered the tugboat with chicken and it was unbelievable! The ambiance is great and the food is EXCELLENT!

Outdoor tables only, rarely a problem in Santa Barbara.  Good quality coffee, and my breakfast, a version of eggs benedict, was quite good and a fair price.  Carnitas, avocado, and eggs on a good biscuit.  No complaints.
We had shrimp grit, french toast, rollex, eggs Benedict , chai latte and mocha. Everything was awesome except eggs Benedict, the chicken was very hard to chew. Everything else was excellent!

One of the best brunch in Santa Barbara downtown!!! Fried chicken yolo is on my MUST-EAT list!!!! The taste of the gravy is unique and amazing. I never taste this flavor before and cannot forget it. Also recommend fruit yogurt!!!

After spending some days up north in Pismo beach where most restaurants serve burgers or flat bread... It was a really nice stop.on our way back home to L.A. the beets salad was fresh, tasty, well balanced between acidic and sweet dressing. My son Caesar salad wasn't as good, the lettuce was chopped too thin and it looses it's crunchiness, while the sauce was a little blend. There were some tomatoes in it, which was surprising, but a little too acidic.
The 3rd meal, french toast were delicious, more like a desert than a breakfast meal! If you're hungry and crave french toast you'll be delighted!
Outdoor seating area is adorable under yellow umbrellas, I loved my eggs benedict so much we ordered to go to the next day. The little onion jam was incredible!
This place is great! I always forget about it I guess maybe because it's on the east side. The Rolex is fantastic! Also love their salmon Benedict on biscuit!!!!

I'm so upset to have to write a negative review. Came here with high expectations and a big appetite, left with disappointed bellies and a stained dress! Ordering was fine. We got: chilaquiles, Yolo? (Fried chicken and egg on biscuits with gravy), side of bacon, coffee. 

Chilaquiles salsa was way too sour and their definition of a fried egg = barely cooked outside and runny inside. Personally I'm not a runny egg person at all so this took away lots of the appeal. I still gave it a shot, but the sauce was way too sour and not roasted or given any flavor.

The chicken/ waffle meal was very small - like a half sandwich and a bowl of gravy. My partner said if they hadn't told him it was chicken, he wouldn't be able to differentiate what meat it was. Very "okay."

Even the coffee wasn't great - it was very sour and I'm one for black coffee regularly. Server spilled coffee when setting it on the table. Didn't spill on me thankfully but it did stain my dress :/
Definitely overpriced for what it is. We actually went to Chad's after this to fill up and have a satisfactory brunch experience. We are on vacation on a budget so you can see why we'd be very disappointed!
Delicious smoked salmon toast with sunny side up egg! This is a go to spot for brunch!"

The food is crazy delicious. Very rich sometimes (Yolo, shrimp and grits, etc) but well balanced with acidity and complex. The coffee isn't the best imo. For my eco-nut takeout "packaging police" report, I give them an A-. I love getting takeout but the containers and waste can be a problem. I love that The Shop uses compressed paper containers that are unlined. If there is liquid they use compostable containers. The silverware for takeout isn't compostable and does seem to be compulsory but if you do an online order you might be able to opt out. With our new digester coming, these items will be very likely to break down. Yay for delicious takeout that doesn't create a ton of waste. If you can grab a seat in their outdoor tables, that is a win too.

We came here twice in 5 days. The food is so darn good!  Very casual setting, like diner vibes. Some inside but mostly outside seating. Pick up window style. There's a good chance there will be a line  in the AM (nothing too crazy),  bc everyone in SB is aware The Shop is the place to be for a delicious start to the day

We lovvvvvvvve The Shop Kitchen
