When we first walked in we almost walked out the guy before him started off not so nice (might be the owner who knows) then he ease up so we stayed.  He told us how the process worked since it was our first time, handed us a menu and walked away.  Then Julio came out and explained everything, we suddenly felt instantly comfortable the way he was.  We were excited to find out after he was also our waiter so YES.  Thank you Julio

We stopped by Dawn Patrol when driving back home to San Diego from Solvang this President's Day weekend. We were excited to check the out the build your own hash that everyone mentions in the reviews. The food, their coffee, the freshly pressed OJ, and the service were really good, but the LOOOONG wait really made the entire experience bad. We had to wait in line for for 20 minutes just to order, then it was 60 more minutes for the food to come. 

When the food came, it was very fresh, well seasoned, and flavorful, but we were just so hangry and annoyed that it took so long to arrive at our table that we weren't able to enjoy it. I think the Dawn Patrol could be a 5 star breakfast spot if they could figure out how to cook eggs in 15 minutes like most restaurants do.
Everything was delicious  Go with the hash! The vanilla latte was good too, super strong but tasty

Great staff. Delicious food. Great location.
This place is amazing, we always keep coming back for more!!
My favorite is the build your own hash, it's nice to be able to customize and it even gives you a choice of veggie sausage!! You can choose the veggies to put on it, either sweet potatoes or russet potatoes, and then your choice sauce! I always get the eggs on the side since I don't eat egg and it's always easy ordering here.
We tried the Luau French Toast and it's very yummy, the Hawaiian bread gives it great taste. 
Very dog friendly so highly recommend this spot because of that, I feel sometimes for breakfast it could be hit or miss with some spots saying they are pet friendly then turn you away either because they can or because it's crowded and don't want the hassle of having dogs on the patio. This place is not like that at all, they do get crowded busy but are always super friendly with dogs and the food is so delicious we will always wait for this spot. 
Don't really understand the comments about it being hard to find a parking spot here, right across the street there is a huge public parking lot which is free for the first 75 minutes and $1.50 every hour after that. With that parking structure there why worry about looking for street parking? Make your life easier, get those steps in and walk across the street!!  This place is so amazing if you turn away simply because you can't walk across the street your missing out on a lot!!!

I got the breakfast burrito it was OK. My husband got the hash and he liked it. Tap water was hard to drink. The home made bread was amazing.

Pricing doesn't match quality of food or environment. I am fine paying more for food if the food is higher quality tasting and/or the place is dialed in with decorations and cleanliness. Neither of which we experienced.

If everything was on the same level as the homemade bread I would have had a better experience. I left feeling disappointed.

A delicious way to start the day, with a very friendly and helpful staff.

Our server Julio could not have been nicer. He got us off to good start with his food recommendations, and kept our coffee mugs full and hot.

We usually dive in to the tasty hash dishes, but today seemed like a good morning for their Fish Tacos, and Huevos Rancheros. Highly recommend both. 

Also a great way to start the day, with a public parking lot right across State Street on Gutierrez, and in between the Funk Zone and all that fun shopping on lower State Street.

Our group grabbed some food here before going to the train station (about a 5 minute walk).
They had both indoor and outdoor seating. They had a wide variety of food as well. 
I got the build a hash plate where you can customized what you get. It was good but I could have done without the salad for a breakfast people. 
The others in my group got the burritos which were large and very filling.  
Reason for 4 stars is because this restaurant was priced high for what you get. My build a hash and coffee was around $25.

This restaurant deserves 6 stars! We ordered the Eggs Benny, Chorizo Hash, and French Toast handmade in house and EVERYTHING was delicious!! Truly, one of the best breakfasts we have had since we moved away from New Zealand. Each meal was a top 10 delight. I wish I took photos as the presentation was beautiful (but we scarfed it all down too fast). Cappuccino was made to perfection and since we had a late Brekkie, they brewed a fresh pot of coffee for us too. Dog friendly, this place is the pot for a scrumptious meal. We will be back next time we are in town for sure!!!
Food was very MEH and Dawn Patrol was a lot pricier than it looks. I know it's the area but still. We were visiting so thought we'd try it due to the good reviews. Just meh.

We found this place on yelp and it was only a 5 minute walk from the hotel.  There are plenty of tables available and some indoor dining as well.  The staff was very friendly and nice.  It was out first time so they explained it was order first then choose a table. 

We ordered The Patrol breakfast and added the pancake.  The flavors were good but the eggs tasted a little off and looked pale.  We also ordered the Build Your Own Hash.  This came with so much food!  The bread is amazing and was probably my favorite part of the meal.  We were told that it is homemade bread! 

We ordered 2 drinks - iced coffee and hot vanilla bean latte.  The latte was delicious, flavorful and had a right amount of foam.  I was honestly surprised because most breakfast places do not get specialty drinks on par.  However, the iced coffee was disappointing.  Its the same price as cold brew coffee and it was very watered down.  Speaking of price, our meal was about $45 (without tip) which is a little steep in my opinion.
The food here was good.  Little crowded and very very slow when we went.  The staff was friendly though, we'd totally go here again for a breakfast bite.

My cousin and I were visiting the area and stopped by this quaint brunch place on our last day in the city. There was a slight wait to order, but once we did the service was quick and wait to get our food was short. Both dishes we ordered were delicious. Everything tasted fresh and the outdoor seating was so pleasant on a sunny day. The restaurant is also just down the street for the pier and beach, so I definitely recommend taking a stroll down the boardwalk after you finish at this yummy spot.

First visit, Service was very quick. All servers are actively working to clear tables and Service.  Everyone in the party tried something different and all were extremely happy. Avocado toast, chorizo hash, strawberry waffle with Sausage and fluffy power sugared pancakes. We will definitely be back!!
Long line but it moves.  We had the chorizo hash special and it's was delicious!  We also had the French toast and it was just ok

Fake maple syrup that leaves a persistent funky aftertaste...seems like syrup should be real for the price ($51 for breakfast for three w/ tip)

The single-use plastic straws in every glass of tap water were especially dissonant and off-message given the ocean theme.

Breakfast burrito was good and the gluten free pancakes were fluffy and tasty ... bring your own syrup from home, though.

Had the "Build a Hash" which was Amazing. You choose your own ingredients. I chose sweet potatoes, spinach, tomatoes, vegan sausage.  Topped with eggs over medium and Hollandaise sauce. Delicious home baked bread with homemade jam on the side and a lovely salad. You can't go wrong eating here. And great coffee!  A bit pricey but worth it.

The hash that i ordered was amazing and flavorful and the most wonderful! That fire roasted salsa was so delicious. I wish i could bottle that up and add it to every breakfast. 
Fave breakfast spot in Santa Barbara!

Great spot for a quick breakfast. Build your own hash or choosing from the items on the menu.  

Had the egg white frittata and it was great.  Nice size and the avocado seeded was an interesting mix of taste and texture.  It worked.  

I recommend this place!

We came in this Sunday morning and it was insanely crowded on state street because the finish line of a marathon was directly in front of the restaurant. It was a bad start because the line was out the door. It took a bit to get to the register to order. After we ordered I had to go to the bathroom but the place was a mess because of all the foot traffic due to the marathon. So I sat donn and waited for my food a little grumpy. The staff was very friendly despite being slammed with a crowd. The food came out pretty quickly and piping hot. I ordered a veganized build your own hash which was very tasty. I sat down in a bad mood but they had me impressed by the end of the meal.
Watched the worker wipe down  all the water glasses with a bleach rag.  Water tasted like bleach.

The "Create your own hash" was absolutely delish! We got russet potatoes, bacon, corn beef, cheddar, tomato, avocado, scrambled eggs and hollandaise sauce. It came with toast and salad! 

The service was great. All the employees were very friendly and checked in on us multiple times. 

The one thing was that is was little pricy if you are on a budget, but it feels like quality ingredients!
got the hawaiian french toast which was pretty tasty! i liked that you can order up front and go seat yourself, pretty fast service

Dawn Patrol is a cool place in downtown Santa Barbara on State Street. The staff is so nice here...we arrived alittle before they opened and even though they weren't ready to open (nothing was set out like silverware, condiments, water...) they still put on a smile and welcomed us in! 

We created two hashes...both with sweet potato, chicken, side salad, wheat toast, and salsa. One of them had eggs over hard and the other had eggs over easy. Both dishes came out correct and looking fantastic! The chicken and sweet potatoes came mixed with tomatoes and onions and was really good! The bread is homemade and you can definitely tell...it has a lot of grains and seeds in it, it was delicious! If you're hungry and walking through Santa Barbara I suggest you stop into Dawn Patrol!

This was a lovely brunch place! We came for breakfast but they have lunch as well. They close at 2pm so make sure to get there in time! 

You order at the front and then they will bring the food/drinks to your table.

There is a parking lot right across from the restaurant you have to pay to park. We couldn't find another option for parking nearby. 

Staff were friendly, and there are cute decorations! Lots of people just stayed a while to eat and drink at a slow enjoyable pace.

The food was very good but quite a bit pricy for what you got. 

They have fresh orange juice and loose leaf tea. They also have homemade bread everyday. Yum! 

They have indoor and outdoor seating. For their seating they have booths and moveable tables. They have both chairs with and without arm rests.

Overall a good place, because of the price I would be less likely to return though.

Delicious!

Had breakfast here yesterday. 5 of us plus our pooch.

Popo had the ham and eggs with toast. Loved the Hawaiian bread toast! 

Wife had the egg white frittata she loved it! Thought the vegetables inside were perfectly cooked.

Son had the chorizo omelet and loved it! Nice spiciness flavor of the sausages.

Daughter had the calif burger and loved it! Thought this burger was delicious! Juicy patty, nice strips of tasty bacon covered with delicious avocado.

I had the build your own hash which was delicious. Potato's, Ham with corn, spinach and mushrooms topped with two over easy eggs. Delicious!

Wonderful place to go!
Yum! Dawn Patrol has been one of our favorites for breakfast since their doors opened. Love their Build a Hash and gluten free pancakes. Customer service is always friendly. Highly recommend DP!

We enjoyed our breakfast here so much that we returned again while staying in Santa Barbara . Jam and toast was a wonderful surprise to the main breakfast we ordered. Service is great and feels homey. I think the place is family owned. Not sure though but either way hard working and kind staff. We loved our experience here. Their toasts is made in house and tasty.

First off, this place is difficult to park near, as the small parking lot nearby doesn't have spots for Dawn Patrol rather the other small businesses in the same building. Make sure you park in the public parking across State street (which is free for 90 minutes) or you'll find yourself driving in circles with all the one-way streets in downtown SB. 

Furthermore, I was super disappointed in this place, and am kicking myself for not have ordered a build-your-own hash!! Instead, I opted for their egg white frittata which comes with a seeded avocado and "fresh" (not so fresh) berries and washed it down with the cold brew. It wasn't at all what I expected, as you would think something that has egg whites would be on the "lighter" side. In fact, the frittata was swimming in cheese and so buttery that I felt best to leave most of the frittata on the plate than to have that gut bomb sit in my stomach. I also didn't quite understand the flavors or the point of the seeded avocado? I think I'll take my avos unseeded in the future. 

I even didn't much care for the cold brew (bland and watery)...mehhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh

Did I mention this place is PRICEY?! We are talking $20 for my coffee and mostly inedible frittata. Yes, I get it, Santa Barbara but also, it's freaking eggs and potatoes. Don't think I'd return on my own dime.

Food was fantastic. Service could use some help. As the line grew longer and longer there was still just one person taking orders and answering menu questions. it would be helpful when the line is super long, to have someone check in with the people waiting to be sure they've seen the menu and can ask questions. It would also be helpful for the cashier to be more empowered to make common sense changes to orders -- he had to go back and ask the chef if he could offer a small side of potatoes. That probably contributed to the line getting longer and longer as the morning went on. Also be prepared to drop about $60 for breakfast and coffee for two people.

I came here on a Thursday morning for brunch around 10 AM and it's your typical average brunch spot. The menu is quite small and doesn't have many options- you can't customize much other.  They do not have avocado toast on the menu which is a huge disappointment. The young man taking our order was friendly and recommended to get toast and just pay extra for the avocado on top. 

My friend ordered a breakfast burrito. I took a bite and it was good, but just nothing out of this world for me. The one thing that stood out to me is the freshly squeezed orange juice. Oh, and apparently they are known for their hash. Not a budget friendly brunch spot either- we spent about $50, and I only got a piece of toast with some avocado on it, an orange juice and my friend ordered a breakfast burrito.
Perfect spot for brunch. The hash was delicious and there was great outdoor seating available.

*** 3.5 stars ***

Super long wait in line (even though the line was not that long it moved at a snail's pace) and for food once seated (another 20 - 30 minutes - yikes). The food is probably four stars but not worth the price and the wait. Not a huge menu and nothing stands out as particularly unique (just your standard brunch fare). Probably would not come back.

Chorizo Hash is the WAY TO GO. It was delicious. Sadly the picture I saw on here made me think it was much bigger. Expensive food but Friendly staff. Most of the other food wasn't as great as I wanted it to be. Served with barely any honey butter- needs more. Also the syrup was the cheap gross kind that ruined it. 

Nice spot with a great patio on Lower State Street.

Dawn Patrol used to be a really good restaurant, but this was "pre-covid." I hear it got new owners, not sure. But I went there yesterday for the first time after the covid lockdown, and I was so disappointed. First of all, the wait staff is really good, very accommodating. But their food was flat across the board. My husband, my friend, and I ordered the waffles, three-egg white fritatta, and the chicken and potatoes. All FLAT. Very little flavor (and no none of us have had covid to deaden our taste buds). The coffee cake and the coffee were "ok" - nothing to write home about. I know it's been a tough time for restaurants, and I really want them to succeed because this used to be one of my favorites, but with the kind of food Dawn Patrol is currently serving its customers, I'm not hopeful this one is going to make it. I tried to email the restaurant my feedback, but their website email link is down. So I thought I would put it on Yelp in case they read these reviews. Oh, and one more thing, get two registers, customers wait too long to place their order.

The hash was great! The ingredients are super fresh and you can really taste the freshness of every ingredient. Staff is super friendly and helpful. Highly recommend the Madagascar vanilla bean latte because it was DELICIOUS!

What a cute place in Santa Barbara's downtown. First you are greeted by the nicest people. They made suggestions and were patient while we decided from the many yummy choices. We went with their special chorizo hash and the breakfast burrito. First, the coffee. It was so bold and flavorful. I am a coffee snob and this passed the test. The food is great. Like this place almost reached 5 stars. The hash was great with the chorizo bursting with flavor. The avocado was weird to me, but damn it worked so well. Everything worked. The wife reports her breakfast burrito was outstanding. She liked how the many distinct flavors  worked together. The stand out was the salsa. I could definitely drink that shit. So good. Go here, you won't be disappointed.  Come hungry, the portions are big and come early because the lines are big too. Totally worth the wait.

Great place for breakfast/brunch. Restaurant can be very busy on weekends with a wait, but service is efficient and turn over fairly fast. Menu is varied with lots of ways to make your own style breakfast. Ingredients are mostly locally sourced and always fresh. We love to sit outside on the front patio with great views of Santa Barbara. You are sitting along the State Street under past so there is some great people watching. Plenty of seating inside restaurant as well. If you like good wholesome, tasty food from great basic breakfast to waffles or pancakes then stop here. They also have great choices for children; family and dog friendly.
This place was fantastic! Great service, great food, and amazing salsa. The building your own hash was tasty and fresh!

I visited Dawn Patrol for my first time this past Sunday. I had the Patrol combo with buttermilk pancakes - it was delicious! However, the reason I am giving this restaurant 5 stars is because our server, Ryan, provided my group with the best customer service ever. He was helpful, kind, charming, and easy to talk to. If you're reading this, Ryan, I want to thank you again for being you! @iluwee

P.S. shout out to the worker who noticed my "King" mask and confirmed he is also a raver like myself. Pretty dope moment!

I had a wonderful Eggs Benedict this morning, perfectly prepared to my specifications--poached well. They are unusual in that they are served on a delicicious bread, rather than the standard muffin. I wasn't going to eat the potatoes and salad because I was so full, but I tasted them both, and they were both expertly prepared. I finished them both. The Hollandaise sauce  was so good, I asked for more, and it was delivered instantly. Service , overall was exemplary.  The coffee was excellent as well. 
They have expanded their outdoor deck so that outdoor dining is plentiful and pleasant, and I felt very comfortable dining here in these pandemic days. 
I recommend the place whole-heartedly, and intend to return here on future visits to Santa Barbara.
Its overpriced. Also not consistent with the food it was good one time and not that good another time

Excellent breakfast!  The c
Beef chiliquiles is the only thing to order!

Interesting name for this Beechy looking breakfast spot.  Their specialty is making a custom order of hash with either sweet potatoes or russets and then adding your choice of protein veggies and topped with an egg if wished and finish with a choices of sauces. You also get a choice of toast or salad with the dish. 

Haven't had hash in a million years so thought I would give that one a shot.  Did the sweet potato as I've never seen that as an option.  Would have picked the veggie sausage  but it's made with eggs so they gave me avocado for no extra charge (normally $2).  Added all the veggies available which was tomatoes corn spinach and mushroom.  Got the two salsas they have on top one green and one red and chose the side salad.  

When I first got the dish I was impressed with the presentation.  Colorful with the orange potatoes and fresh looking veggies.  When I took that first bite I though wow those potatoes melted in your mouth.   Mixed in all the salsas and had a mini vegasam ..:)pretty dang tasty.  Love salad at any time of day so that was awesome too

Everyone in my party liked what they got which was the herbivore humus sandwich and the huevos rancheros. Everyone commented how fresh everything tasted.

My only reason for the 4 stars is they don't make the veggie sausage in house and it's not vegan and made by Morningstar and super processed.  Second if you omit many items like the egg or meats it's the same price.  It's still not bad at $13.50.  Overall I recommend people check this place out if you are looking for a hearty breakfast place with a fun vibe.
Decent little joint. Nice outdoor seating but pretty close to the noise from the highway. Great bacon! Very flavorful wedge potatoes. Good house made toast.
Service is second to none. They want to make sure you are completely satisfied. Food is great.

First time to Dawn Patrol and had a wonderful breakfast. It sits on a busy part of state street but has plenty of seating in-doors and outside. I was able to create my own hash which was fantastic and we also ordered the grain free pancakes. It's a casual space where you order from the counter and wait at your table. The staff was very accommodating after a couple of hiccups but the flavors and choices where excellent. Personally it's only disadvantage is the noise level. They have construction next door and street noise that can be over powering at times.

Nice spot in Santa Barbara to have a quick brekky. I got 2 eggs and bacon and coffee. 


It wasn't bad! But it also wasn't amazing.

The service was great and the food was delicious. I ordered their hash with sweet potatoes and also their sage sausage is fire!! My husband ordered their luau french toast and loved it.  We also had their orange juice which was fresh and delicious as well. Greatp place for food and outdoor seating. Thank you!

Yum. 

You can't go wrong with the make your own hash bowl with corn beef, poached eggs and sweet potatoes.. Or the three egg white frittata (sub sweet potatoes). I mean it's served with half an avocado rolled in seeds. Enough said.  Wait, I haven't said enough... They bake their own fresh breads daily. 

But really I'm an atmosphere junkie and this place does it for me. Dawn Patrol feels like Santa Barbara, they nailed 'locale' perfectly. 

Enormous coffee mugs, champagne and wine available, homemade breads and build your own hash? Yep, I'll be back.  

Star off because I was craving a fresh juice and it seemed funny to me that this place didn't have any. I also would have liked to see a made to order yogurt bowl. Perhaps a build your own yogurt and acai  bowl to accompany the build your own hash?  Now we're talking.

Cute place! Great breakfast, great service, and it was an overall relaxing stay. I got the combo and it was exactly what you would expect. My friend also got the chorizo breakfast and it looked amazing. So if you are looking for a solid breakfast place, definitely go to Dawn Patrol.

Just a heads up, you may be waiting in line for up to 30 minutes on some days so make sure you have plenty of time cause this place is poppin! My girlfriend told us about it so we went before the tacos and tequila festival. Got the build your own hash, best thing ever!!! Got the sweet potatoes, salmon, bacon, avocado, spinach and the herb aioli, the aioli was the only part I didn't like but luckily I asked for it on the side. The place it self is cool and colorful makes you feel like you're at the beach, lots of seating inside and out so that's great for right now that its so hot! Highly recommend and it's healthy so you won't feel bad for eating such delicious food!

Two stars because a simple breakfast shouldn't take 45 minutes to arrive! I had to check on our order since none of the staff came by our table. There was no apology of any kind when I did check. All I got was "It's almost ready".

My order was simple. Eggs, bacon, toast, and a few potatoes. My son ordered the three egg white frittata. 

The bacon was over cooked and my meal was luke warm. Nothing spectacular about it to take 45 minutes! Seems to be an ongoing issue here with the long wait. 

Rewind to my first visit ordering the salmon omelette which was amazing, and a nice surprise to find more salmon inside as well. Great taste and cooked perfectly. 

The chorizo hash was delicious and had great flavor unlike the traditional chorizo. Maybe it was spiced up with cumin? Not sure but it definitely worked. 

As far as service goes the cashier that helped me on both occasions was very friendly and greeted me with a smile. It's just a shame he couldn't give me the same service acknowledging the long wait for my order. 

Seems like hit and miss here because my first visit didn't take as long to get my food. My second visit left me very disappointed in the wait time and my food not satisfying me. 

Sorry to say I won't be coming back here!

We really enjoyed our breakfast at Dawn Patrol. I was in the mood for Huevos rancheros and they definitely hit the mark on this one. I ordered it with over easy eggs and the sauce and freshly made tortilla strips were delicious. We also ordered the special of the day which was chorizo hash and a vegetarian hash with sweet potatoes, spinach and tomatoes topped with over easy eggs. All were enjoyed and we would definitely recommend Dawn Patrol to those visiting the Santa Barbara area and locals alike.

We came in early for breakfast today and had a perfect dining experience. We were all really hungry so go the "Hash Plate". Service was speedy and food perfectly balanced, hearty and healthy! Lots of options for vegetarians too! Savory, big plates, great bread!!!

First time going to Santa Barbara and was starving Sunday morning! Wanted my eggs benedict and this place NAILED it with their flavor and even their portion! It was so good and the vegan sausage was a plus:) All the servers were nice and very attentive. Always came back to our table to make sure we didn't need anything else and our cup of  water kept getting refilled. I'd love to come back and would recommend it to everyone

I love a good, fresh OJ and homemade bread! This place offers both! I built my own hash with the sage sausage, spinach, tomatoes, onion & cheese with salsa. The homemade bread with jam really sealed the deal

I was stoked to try this place out based on the reviews.
I know we're spoiled living in SLO, but I expected more from this breakfast spot.

Walk in and grab your own table, do it quick as seating inside is limited.
Head to the counter to order, grab a cool cartoon order card and sit down, your food will be brought out.

I love the idea of building your own hash!
I got mine with russet potatoes, poached eggs, (I paid the extra $2 for avocado), country gravy, etc.  I did it all up, tons of options.
So why did it taste so bland, and why the heck did I get an 1/8th of a slice of an avocado?!  I shop at the store, I know what an avocado costs, these guys are making bank on avocado add-ons if everyone gets the portion I got, holy geez.  Common Dawn Patrol, for a surfing themed resturant you're not nearly as chill as I thought.  Greedy much?

My wife had an egg white frittata that was okay.

The self-serve water station is neat but the water tastes terrible.  Seriously and I'll drink just about anything.  This was gross, bad flavor.

So yea wanted to like it more, but the bland food, cheap add-on quantity,  and the bad water just made me wish I had not spent $37 on breakfast here.

Excellent experience. Casual dining, high quality food with excellent service. I had the beef chilaquiles special. It was one of the best chilaquiles dishes I've ever had. I also enjoyed the gluten free pancake. My wife had the avocado toast which she loved and my daughter had the French toast (ate all of it). And the coffee is excellent!

Delicious!!  Homemade breads fresh daily. The tomotillo sauce is just amazing.  Fresh green salad and oven potatoes.   Just delicious for breakfast.  Friendly guys. SB has a new best breakfast restaurant!!!

One of our new favorite brunch spots. We were absolutely blown away by this place. We got the build your own hash, and it was a great amount of food. But the all star...the house made jelly to go with the toast. I almost cried with how amazing it was.

I don't really understand the hype about this place. I ordered the breakfast burrito. That by itself was $11. We came early so we were some of the only people in the restaurant and somehow it still took 20 minutes to receive our food. My burrito was what looked like a can of beans dumped onto a tortilla with a little cheese and some avocado slices thrown in. Somehow I just can't understand how a tortilla and black beans can cost $11. If there was egg in there it was so little it was impossible to find. We will not be returning here.

Stopped here for our early, early breakfast to kick off our road trip.  The reviews were through the roof.  Cool place!  Great service and the food was not bad you can tell the ingredients were high quality and the menu was very exciting.  Liked the coffee a lot.  Really neat beach/surf/skate decor.  Parking was a little weird but nothing we couldn't handle at 7am as barely anyone was around.  Give them a try they have something for anyone.
Overall it was okay, but I wouldn't wait in line here. Portions are small, over priced. I waited as long as the people that showed up 15 min after me and no one checked on me after the fact.
Great spot for a breakfast burrito!  I enjoyed sitting on the patio in the morning with the wife and baby.  Chill spot with a beach atmosphere

Overall, a nice place in the middle of a shopping center environment. 2 kids meals - a burger sandwich (bread has seeds that prevented normal picky kid 1 from eating it); a grilled cheese sandwich that I ended up cutting the ends off & kid 2 ate it all. A small French toast that picky kid 3 ate all of -- the fruit that came was separated on the table cause it was too close to the food. Kid 3 then wanted a side of eggs so we ordered that after we all were done. Parent 1 and Parent 2 ordered the chorizo eggs with cheddar cheese instead of Oaxaca cheese. The clerk had to check to see if that was an acceptable replacement or if I had to start a custom order -- she determined it was ok. That Taste was average or maybe a bit weird. The iced cold brew tasted more like iced coffee.

I stopped by on a Sunday morning before it got busy and I I ordered the Spicy Chai and the BYOH, (Build Your Own Hash) which came with a green salad and toast. For almost $15, I hoped to get more hash - a little pricey for the amount of food (in my opinion). Both came out luke warm, like it had been sitting around for a while. I was afraid that my food would take forever to come out (based on other reviews), but it didn't seem to take too long. As I ate, I noticed how long the line was to order food. People dove for tables like hawks!

the food is just "ok".

Spent 15$, which is way more than I'd spend at a dennys or iHop for a small french toast, bacon and milk with the tip. The french toast tasted like plasticy bread. 

Staff was really nice. Go elsewhere for the money.

MY NEW FAVORITE BRUNCH SPOT IN SB COUNTY. 
Hands down, the BEST brunch/ breakfast place in all of SB county. I have been dying for this place to open back up since it closed because of the pandemic. It was worth the wait! So so delicious! 

My friend and I got the make your own hash (since that's what they're known for!) We couldn't decide on if we wanted regular potatoes or sweet potatoes, so we just got both and shared. I personally liked the regular potatoes more, but it's just because I cannot eat a large amount of sweet potatoes at once. However, if you love sweet potatoes, get it with sweet potatoes! It's so unique to see it as a hash option at breakfast places. The sweetness of the sweet potato with all the yummy savory veggies, runny egg yolk, and sauce is so DELICIOUS! Out of both sauces, the hollandaise was tasty, but I enjoyed the tang of the salsa more! 

We also got the Madagascar vanilla bean latte & the dark chocolate latte. Both were superb! Also, please don't forget to put jam on your toast, it is so good!! 

As for customer service, it was also amazing! They continuously checked up on us when needed and were super chatty/ helpful! We came on a Monday afternoon and it was packed, so I would be ready for the weekend if you choose to come. 

I will definitely be coming back to get another make your own hash & try to the french toast! 

Fun fact: they make their bread, chocolate sauce, and jam in house! 

Recommendation: 
- Madagascar vanilla bean latte
- Make your own hash: sweet potatoes, salsa, over easy egg, mushroom, spinach, pepper jack cheese and corn

Delicious food.  Ordered the Luau French Toast and the Build Your Own Hash.  Loved that you can make your own hash and add as many veggies as you want.  Yum!  And - if you're into chai (the spicy version), their house made spicy chai latte is to die for.  So good!  The service was also spectacular.  Our server was so attentive and nice too.  Would definitely recommend and come back if I'm visiting Santa Barbara.
The host made an incorrect order twice. Portions we're small and overpriced for quality. Ham on my eggs Benedict was served cold. Would not recommend. As a Santa Barbara local I am very disappointed!

This is why I love yelp. It led me here for breakfast and that made me super happy. 

Order at counter. Friendly casual spot with nice staff. Feels like the perfect local gem. 

Mimosas (duh), great coffee. Great beer selection. I had frittata at the suggestion of another Yelp review. It was delicious and didn't make me feel gross and full! The avocado was such a delicious addition, rolled in poppy, chia, sesame seeds. Why has no one thought of that before?!?!?! I added siracha because siracha. :-)

Friend got French toast, which he loved. Nice lemon touch. Only regret is not trying hash yet. So goals still to meet!!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
The bacon breakfast burrito is amazing. Lived in sb for 5 years and haven't found a better one yet! Their scones and muffins are also really good
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Good place to get work done as a group, and a lot of people seem to come for a bite and hang out. Convenient parking. Good food and beverages. Always glad to see coffee shops with milk alternatives other than soy, and a bottle of simple syrup for iced coffee.

The inside can get pretty loud with orders being shouted, smoothie/frappucino making, coffee bean grinding and chatter echoing throughout the room. Intense acoustics. Although, this does help drown out peoples' personal conversations which can be more distracting than general noise. 

Also, peculiar music choices- reminds me of an 90's night playlist. It's not awful but every now and then a song will come on that makes me chuckle. "Kiss From a Rose" is playing right now as I type this, no lie. I mean, I'm pretty delighted when some old school Destiny's Child comes on but it's a bit difficult to concentrate on a scientific paper when you catch yourself singing along to "Bills Bills Bills". I guess it's all about the kind of atmosphere a place is trying to cultivate, but I try to remember to bring headphones when I come here to get some real work done.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Passing through Santa Barbara on the way down south, I could tell from my little knowledge of the area that this place was a prime location for coffee. My friends and I had camped out the night before and we were craving some grub, so we went to where we observed was the most popular spot on the street (referring to Mission st.) At 10:00 in the morning, with coffee and breakfast goodies on the menu, this is just as popular as any other coffee shop.

I wasn't in the mood for coffee so I just bought a breakfast burrito, which many of the customers seemed to be ordering. Unfortunately, I wasn't satisfied with my breakfast burrito, but I suppose it passes for a decent breakfast. I honestly thought the breakfast burritos they served at my old high school cafeteria tasted better, except I don't think they were nearly as filling as the ones served here. If you aren't too picky about your breakfast, their burritos are worth it. Otherwise, I'd just get a muffin or some sort of pastry to eat with a nice coffee. Quite a bit cheaper too.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I did a health inspection for this place about a week ago, they had no violations and a sanitary kitchen. This place is up to code when it comes to the hospitality and coffee, but the burritos are a little over priced
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The coffee's good, and they make a really good sandwich. Baked goods are pretty tasty, too.

But I think that, despite the fact that it's only six blocks from my house, I'm going to stop going there. Why? Because, unlike LITERALLY EVERY OTHER COFFEE SHOP I PATRONIZE, The Daily Grind doesn't seem to get that it's important to serve coffee in a paper cup that has a lid that fits tightly enough that coffee won't drip all the fuck over my hand and pants and shirt during that six-block walk home.

Little things. They make a big difference.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

such an incredible bbq chicken salad, my boyfriend picked it up today for lunch and brought it home and I think I NEEd to go back tomorrow and have another for lunch so fresh and yummy and great bbq ranch dressing! I go sometimes for acoffe or a breakfast burrito but now I am hooked on this salad
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Traveling through Santa Barbara and found this local spot. Very cute. Ok service. Breakfast burritos were decent, nothing fancy. Fresh juice was spot on, great smoothie selection. Pastries were also good!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
great Lucy in the Sky smoothie today but there were multiple pieces plastic bag in it.  Not so delicious.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

There is a reason it's called DAILY Grind. You have to go there Daily. Why?  It's an addiction! The vanilla lattes are the bomb!  Don't get me started on the bacon burritos!  I have them add avocado and it just brings it all together.

The place is funky and fun. I walk in and they know me!  Many times my triple vanilla decaf is waiting for me!  I think they planted a sensor in my car and he just knows when I am approaching. 

Oh did I mention the muffins?  They are all made there and they are fricken amazing. I do the cranberry nut but they really all are great!  

I can go on and on but I am trying to hop in the shower so I can get on down there before the line is too long!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Love their Italian/French roast!! Breakfast burritos are amazing as well. Staff is always super friendly and the patio is great to hang out on and relax. Perfect local coffee spot:)
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Great sandwiches and muffins! Try the Primo, the 007 and the Mesa sandwiches. Also, great coffee :)
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Nice relaxed atmosphere with good food. Staff behind the register was very friendly and the staff preparing the breakfast, not as much.
  
A great variety of coffees to choose from, but somehow I guess I chose the wrong one since the coffee I had (an organic Mexican blend) was somewhat watered down tasting.


They also don't take credit cards which is somewhat ridiculous in this day and age.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Ok so you have to pay cash.... No big deal. What's really nice is that they are open early and the breakfast burritos are great! Staff is always up beat and helpful. Maybe it's from all that amazing caffeine they serve. They have really tasty fresh muffins to eat along with your hot drink. Thank goodness they are open so early.  They are quick and will get you out the door fast in case you are in a hurry to get to work. Or, hang out  Outside and enjoy patrons with friendly dogs. Love this place...
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Love this coffee shop for coffee, lunch, studying, etc.  yummy sandwiches & salads, and fair price.  outside patio is the best.  
Wish the wifi was all the time and not just after 11am.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Great place to enjoy some coffee, deserts and fellowship with locals. Staff is always friendly especially Brittney the barista at the new location..
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This coffee shop has been a family favorite since 2004. Thanks for maintaining the beauty and glory of Santa Barbara's finest coffee shop. My usual 4 shoot extra short vanilla latte and the bacon burrito with a nice walk on Hendry's Beach... and my kids love the bagels and muffins!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This place offers a nice outdoor seating patio atmosphere, and has some pretty amazing smoothies. They've also got a nice selection of loose-leaf tea and a fresh juice menu.

The friendliness of the service is a little lacking, and a couple sandwiches I've had there were less than impressive. Also, the coffee is pretty strong, but not necessarily that tasty. Maybe I'm spoiled because of the Blue Bottle and Ritual coffee I would get up in San Francisco, but it seems a more decent coffee supplier would befit a place of this vibe.

I'll definitely be a returning customer for their closeness to our neighborhood, and the fact that they've got a pretty decent vegetarian breakfast burrito. I also love all the old-school bikes they've got hanging from the ceiling, - especially the original Schwinn beach cruiser!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Came here for a pretty mediocre breakfast burrito. I got the spinach breakfast burrito with avocado. The food was nothing special, feel like they added no seasoning or anything special. They charge extra for salsa which is super lame so head up. Also the extra avocado I paid for was only in maybe half the burrito. It was one of those terrible moments where all the avocado is in a single bite and not evenly dispersed throughout the burrito. I shed a single tear as I chewed.
Portion size was pretty good but simple not worth the price for what you get. If you want a mindless and simple breakfast burrito for $8 this is the place for you. Bacon looked big and hearty in my buddies burrito so maybe that is the way to go.
Bomb coffee though, would come back for more of that!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

What a wonderful place. It is busy busy busy, but the lines move rapidly, with the people behind the counter moving even more rapidly. I don't know about the coffee, as I only came in for a bagel and a bran muffin. They were both fabulous thank you very much, prepared promptly, and oh so fresh. Judging by the line of people and the happy smiles I would wager that the coffee is pretty good too. Thank You Santa Barbara
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I like this coffee shop.   Been coming here for years off and on, it isn't the most convenient!    They have coffee (duh) and all the things a coffee shop has to have.  They also have lunch, salads and sandwiches.  The sandwiches are kind of like salads on bread as they are loaded with way too much lettuce, sprouts, cucumbers and all of that.   Don't think I don't like some of that on my sandwich but seriously folks, this place over does it.   I also find them to be kind of bland.  

I do wish that they had bigger coffee cups for drinking the coffee here.   I like a good sized mug, theirs is 12 oz but if you fill it more than 2/3 full it spills because the tables are all wobbly.   So I get my 8 ounces of coffee and it is cold before I can get the first sip to my lips.   

It seems like they cater mostly to an older clientelle because when I go in there seem to be very few young people.  The customers all seem very nice as are the people who work there.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Great coffee shop, with ample parking, perfect for a pit stop before / after the 101. Coffee is very good and well priced, with delicious shakes and delectable cakes to boot!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Uncomfortable seating. Good selection of coffee. The service was not the friendliest and the music was pretty terrible. Good parking though.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Not only was the food scrumptious, my wife left her purse and new iPhone and they held it behind the counter for her while we came back to get it. Thanks for the integrity.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
The breakfast burritos are amazing here. Great coffee/espresso and pastries, plus lots of sandwiches, etc, that I have not tried.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
I love this place.. an early morning coffee with their famous 007 sandwich is so good.. highly recommended...
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
The staff here are always friendly, the drinks are delicious, and so is the food! If you like tiramisu then try the San Andres shake! It is amazing and rich!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Canned black olives is a travesty on Greek salad..... Who does that??? I think that was also butter lettuce and some beers on there too--- and that dressing wasn't really greeky either---
Also had a skimpy little sand which that was bland and tasteless-  really bummed, but at least the kids at the soup, so they get a star for that.   I'm sure the coffee is good, but don't eat here.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Really cool stuff to look at. It's like a coffee science lab. I got my usual, a cappuccino, and it was divine.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I got a spinach breakfast burrito 2 days ago from The Daily Grind.  Sounded good.  Besides the fact that it had eggshell and raw potato in it, it gave me food poisoning that has been going on for the past 24+ hours.  It was definitely this burrito because it was the only thing I ate all day.  They are obviously unhygienic with their food prep.  Be wary.  I'm still having stomach problems as I'm writing this. :(((
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Free Wi Fi and more!  I like the comfortable atmosphere of the Grind where I can work on my computer over a cup of coffee or tea.  I especially like that this is one place in town where you can get a Teechinno coffee bag.  Perfect for a late afternoon pick-me-up without the sugar high or caffeine jolt!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I think after today I'm done coming to the Daily Grind. I was greeted with someone just standing there, no "hello, how can I help you" or anything, just a blank face. OK then, I order a latte. A few seconds later a guy yells "LATTE" and slams it down on the counter. I pick up drink to discover its a watered down (nonfat milk??) latte filled to the brim with no foam. It was so bad I just threw it away after a couple sips. To top it all off, they've had a cash only policy for years, but no worries, theres an ATM in the corner, so like another yelp reviewer wrote on here, just add another $1.50 to your order.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I like the sandwiches a lot, but I do wish they used better bread.  Yeah, I have high standards for bread, but still.  The coffee is so-so (tends to run a little weak by my tastes), and the past couple of times I've been there, the lady taking orders seems quite bored to be taking my order.  At any rate, I still go there when I'm hungry in the neighborhood, but wouldn't go out of my way.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

My friend is a vegetarian and she asked for no meat atleast 3 times and once she got her breakfast bagel she had discovered bacon all over .She returned it and they took the pieces of bacon off and gave it back to her..they did a disappointing job at even trying to remove the bacon just as sad as following the ticket order.
She took a bite into her bacon grease bagel also to find a hair on her tomatoe...disgusting!!!!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Delicious smoothie, delicious espresso, and good prices. Helpful employees, quick pace, and happy environment. This place is really cool and has a local vibe but does good business as well. They have great retro decorations like license plates and old bikes all around the shop.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Friendliest staff in the city.  The breakfast burritos are good and the Zucchini/Carrot muffins are heavenly.  A perfect post-run/post-bike fuel-up on the weekends.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This is my favorite coffee shop. Once I'd been a few times, the staff recognized me, and made it more fun, though it is always nice. I think their base coffee for drinks must be better than other places because even a simple latte was better here than elsewhere. Recently I started trying the juices and smoothies. Very good! Sandwiches are plenty (too big, really, for me), and their baked goods are good sized and yummy. My only complaint was that the chocolate scone was far too sweet for me. I've not tried their dessert selections (yet) but they look decadent. I have a lunch date tomorrow... I think I'll bring my friend here!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Best bakery in town huge servings. Small coffee is a large coffee anywhere else. Olalaberry scone, WOW! Danish was huge!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This place is great for sitting down and getting work done/studying on a Sunday morning (or any morning for that matter!) It is mostly busy and the music selection isn't always the best, but the coffee and food are what's important. There's plenty of chairs/tables inside and outside and outlets as well. 

The coffee is very well made and the food is delicious, would recommend to anyone!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Friendly staff.  Great location.  We had the Mision Impossible.  Too much bread and very little meat.  It had great flavor, after I removed the bread.  

Good sandwich, but probably wouldn't go outta my way to go back.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

It's a shame- good coffee, ridiculously bad customer service . I have no tolerance for that. 2 rude employees who both rolled their eyes at me that I wanted a latte with foam. One girl ignored me and ordered a cappuccino, and when I  asked for extra milk, the second employee rolled his eyes! Seriously? So rude
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I walked in with my service dog. There was a line and my dog was saying hi to some sweet girls that were enjoying their coffee and wanted to pet him. Let's start the reasons to my one star review by hearing a "yo your dog isn't allowed in here". As a customer it would have been nice for employee or owner.. whoever it was, to have come up to me when the environment was so busy and kindly asked me to bring my dog outside and I would have explained that he is a service dog. If it wasn't apparent enough that he had his service dog jacket on. By being the kind person I am, I stepped outside even though I was next in line and waited until there was no line and asked if he wanted me to order from the door, I can not leave my dog outside by himself. I then explained he is a service dog and he let me come in. I waited for my coffee outside and all I heard were orders that were not mine. The last order I heard was a decaf latte.. I ordered regular. I decided to come in and ask. The guys didn't know what drink it was and asked their co workers and the man who took my order got quietly defensive to his co worker that I didn't say decaf. Second while I was waiting for my coffee people came up to me and nicely asked what kind of service dog he was because your employee loudly had to embarrass me and the whole place heard. Don't come here. There is better coffee in town, and this place has the WORST customer service I have ever experienced.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
My cappuccino was a quarter of the way full, the terribly done foam was most of the drink. my wife's drink was fudged too. Not going back
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Usually a great place except for the new $.50 cent salsa policy. When you're spending 10 bucks for breakfast you think that one additional 1 oz. salsa Cup could be free and not an extra charge of $0.50. Plenty of other options in town for breakfast where there's not extra price gouging for salsa. Thanks for the bad taste in my mouth daily grind. For now they can keep there parsimonious salsa and I'll go elsewhere...
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Local's spot, good food and coffee. Recommend the breakfast burrito. 

Last time I was there I asked for "no meat" and they replied "would you like to add avocado" and now I'm in love.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I don't say this lightly, but this is my favorite breakfast burrito in Santa Barbara.  It's unlike any other in town and I absolutely love it.  The fresh-squeezed orange juice is also very noteworthy.  This is a great place for a relaxing, order-at-the-counter breakfast.  The patio is always packed but worth the wait!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I always visit the Grind when I am in SB. I love the products, teas, and the artwork on the walls. This was the first place I have been to that makes Thai hot coffee, and it is bomb! The chai is good too, but they just use a mix that I can buy at Trader Joes, so it's nothing special. The art gallery is cool as well, and there is a nice loft upstairs for larger groups.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
I love the daily grind! They make awesome bagels, they have good muffins and sweets, and other great food like sandwiches. They are usually pretty packed for a reason and they are not to expensive.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Cool atmosphere, great food (specifically muffins..yummy).  Small lot for parking but street parking easy enough.  Stopping here made me want to be a local.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

good coffee, good variety and the best breakfast burritos!  Ordering online is so easy too, had to get breakfast for the office early Monday morning, so I ordered online in less than 5 minutes.  They email you to let you know they received your order and an expected pick up time not less than 15 minutes later for 10 breakfast burritos.  On a hectic Monday morning where time is money- ordering breakfast and picking it up down the street took less than 30 minutes out of my morning and they were a total hit at the office-  huge bonus!  I highly recommend this location, good food, good service and super friendly cashiers!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Daily Grind is an awesome local spot - great coffee/espresso, bagels/pastries, and smoothies. They also have sandwiches and burritos if you're looking for something more substantial. Prices are as reasonable as they get in Santa Barbara, the atmosphere is relaxed, and outdoor seating is perfect for a sunny day.

Tables are a bit small if you are looking to get work done, but just fine for eating or meeting up with friends.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I am really easy to accomodate when it comes to a coffee shop.  I only have two drinks - Iced coffee and hot coffee.

Daily Grind always has excellently brewed iced coffee - perfect flavor and boldness - never watered down.  

Their hot coffee selection is the best in town - all their brews are delicious - I have never been unhappy with a hot coffee choice, even their bold brews are smooth without a hint of acidity.

Their staff is always friendly, patient, and fast.  

Seeing as they have a huge menu and people are always ordering more than just coffee - my guess is that the rest of their stuff is just as good.

This is a routine stop for me!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

If you require options this is a must for you! Muffins, scones, croissants, smoothies, juices, teas, a coffee smorgasbord. We snagged a well shaded spot on the patio (until some jerk moved the umbrella) and enjoyed an appropriately dark cup o joe with an olallieberry with cream cheese muffin and spinach feta croissant. Decent parking available in the adjacent lot.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Good coffee , great sandwiches and Breakfast burritos and the veggie juice is so good and fresh!
Service is friendly and the olalaberry muffin scrumptious.
A little loud at rush hour but calm and free wifi after 9am!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This place is amazing! So many different coffee flavors to choose from - yummy breakfast & lunch options - although I am dairy and gluten free, their baked items look SO yummy, just wish i could try them. Highly recommend!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

These guys have some many drip coffee options it is amazing! Love how they have wifi too. 
One complaint: I ordered a breakfast burrito and it was COLD. No one wants cold eggs. They were fairly busy so I didn't say anything. Will give them another try, maybe it was an off day.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

First of all, go there and get a muffin. 

It doesn't matter if its an appropriate hour for a muffin (ie breakfast) just get one... they are DELICIOUS! Something magical is put into the batter which makes them smooth, creamy and delicious.  My fav choice is the rasperry struesal. 

I have also had their sandwiches many times, most recently the Chipotle Chicken (warning it was very spicy) and I am always impressed.  Iced coffee is solid and outdoor seating is lovely.  Don't forget to bring cash, but if you do there is a small ATM in the corner.

Sadly I no longer live in Santa Barbara, but this is the place I come back to every time I visit.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

An impressive array of different flavored coffees (all so good! my favorite is the cinnamon bun with a lil bit of the peruvian vibrations, mmmm), fresh fruit smoothies (Fats Domino = the best!), and I am dangerously addicted to their LOW-FAT RASBERRY MUFFINS. Seriously awesome.

Cool decor, nice staff, big open windows, fresh healthy food, great coffee with .50 cent refills... ahhh yes, the refills. 

Cash only, and it's sometimes hard to find a seat on the weekends. But hands down one of my favorite coffee shops in SB.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Great coffee! The drip coffee is nice because you have a wide selection of coffee from different places, darker or lighter roasts etc. Then if you are hungry they have a tasty breakfast burrito with salsa and a nice selection of freshly made smoothies and juices in case you already didn't have to use the bathroom from all the coffee. Oh the bathroom is like a trucker stop off I-5-- just so you know.

The lines move quick but the tables go fast so grab a newspaper and enjoy your coffee.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
They have a great ginger detox tea at their upper state street location. Both locations open very early. Good salads and the macadamia nut coffee is amazing!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This is the 1st cafe I went to when I moved to SB, and for those reasons and a few other, the Grind already holds a soft place in my heart. 

It's exactly what I pictured an cute, independent, southern californian shop to be, complete with lots of pretty people (man is this place stacked with hot guys, that's 1 star right there). 

the Grind has a variety of drip coffee which is always fresh and tasty. The largest croissants and scones I've ever seen in my life. Now I don't know if that's a plus or a minus, but they look pretty epic. I have yet to attempt one myself. 

The only drawback is cash only, which I rarely have, which requires me to go downtown to either draw some out, or go downtown to other coffee shops, which sucks, because the grind is around the corner from my house.

Really this is a shop to cruise and be cruised and wonder if that abnormally good looking guy is an actor of some sort
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Stopped in at 6am on my way out of town, the staff was friendly and welcoming. They made me a fresh,delicious, and huge Ham & Cheese Croissant and a great cup of Tea for my road trip and sent me off with a smile =)
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I love this little spot. When I used to work for the LA Dodgers I lived around the corner on West Padre St. And would get up, jump in my itty bitty Toyota Tercel commuter and grab me a coffee and a scone or sandwich every morning at around 6 am like clockwork before hitting the 101 for my commute to LA. It's a great little spot, great coffee, friendly people and you would be surprised at how many commuters I met over those 2 years at this spot every morning. It's like the commuters club stop!!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Cute coffee shop with outdoor seating and lots of options - a variety of teas, decent coffee, sandwiches, smoothies, muffins etc. The mocha frap is delicious.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Only one word comes to mind to describe the Daily Grind...excellent! I spent a lovely morning on their patio enjoying their abundant selection of fresh brewed coffee and delicious pastries. I could not get enough of either. The French Dark Roast was strong and bold but not burnt or bitter. The savory spinach and feta croissant was buttery and flaky and their olallieberry muffin was moist and not overly sweet. My only regret was that I only have but one stomach to fill.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The gentleman working the checkout helped me out to the car with my large order! So unexpected and kind. 
Also this place has the best breakfast burritos in town.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The Daily Grind is sort of like Cheers for Santa Barbara coffee drinkers.  Everyone knows your name, you can recognize the newbies because they don't know how to cue in the original location.  The drinks are great.  The owners listen to requests and now serve almond milk, which is awesome!  Scott at the original location is a doll.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Great spot for breakfast. Visiting Santa Barbara with my mom. We checked it out after a visit to the Mission. Great food, great & casual vibe. So...great!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
funky little coffee shop - nice selection of brewed coffee - bagel sandwich and breakfast burritos
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

About once a month my wife and I go to Santa Barbara for the day.  Without fail, we eat breakfast at the Daily Grind.  The Hazelnut coffee is great.  My wife loves the banana blueberry muffins.  The mocha chip scone is pretty good to.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I decided that I'm not going to the daily grind at all anymore.  I've gone before and liked their sandwiches, but the tortilla chips that come with them are stale and not satisfying at all. When you're paying the prices that you are, you should expect that you could substitute it for a healthier choice, like a small garnish or cucumber salad.  I called and the chips are "complimentary" and they actually are thinking of getting rid of them. Umm, excuse me? No, they aren't complimentary, you are paying for them when you pay the $7-8 for a sandwich.  No thanks, I can make my whole family delicious sandwiches, with a salad, for that total myself. OR just go somewhere else, which is what I'll be doing now.  I don't care if I live 2 blocks away, the convenience isn't worth it.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

No non-dairy creamer for your coffee?!?! There's only the half-half, whole, and skim at the 'fixings station' and if you want non-dairy you have to pay extra!!! 

Although the coffee is good,  that was such a bad experience. Also, they got my order wrong and my husbands .
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Lately I've been going here after my appointments with Jennifer Henry. The veggie drinks and salads are consistent and satisfying. I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here and I haven't tried their coffee in a long time.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Definitely a fan, I'm glad to hear they finally accept credit cards! Their breakfast burritos, porky pig, and coffee are delicious! They also offer free wi-fi which is awesome! The parking lot is pretty small; there is parking in the back but the whole parking situation isn't very ideal. Atmosphere is cool and the employees are friendly.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Pretty relaxing spot! Good coffee and variety of pastries. Staff is friendly and efficient. I would recommend it for anybody in the area.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
The poppy seed bagel and cream cheese. Oh my god, the cream cheese. Can I get a bowl and a ladle please?!?!?
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Good espresso, free wi-fi, nice ambiance. Didn't eat here but everything looks yummy.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Awesome breakfast burritos, great service & killer location. Perfect pit stop!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This is a great little locals spot.  I almost always order the breakfast bagel with bacon sans tomato.  The breakfast burrito is good too especially with that yummy sauce, but as another person advised, better with a light amount of potatoes.  The sandwiches are decent and they load them up with veggies with corn tortilla chips on the side.  The salads are okay.  They're huge and great for sharing, but I've had some that just didn't do it for me.  

The smoothies are so very delicious, they have a wide selection of fresh juices and coffees.  There is a nice assortment of muffins and other pastries but I've yet to order any.  When it's busy, the coffee section is the most awkward coffee section ever!  It cracks me up.  There is only one small little area where the creams and sugars are so if you take a while getting your coffee just right, you will have people hovering behind you, breathing on your neck, and doing the sidestepping dance around you if you don't hurry!

The restrooms are pretty dingy so unless it's an emergency, keep it sealed shut until you get home.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Oh, how I love you, Daily Grind! 
You greet me with a smile and some of the best coffee in town! My son is hooked on your your breakfast sandwiches- which I'm not sure is a good thing or a bad thing...
I'll be a customer for life! Thank you for brightening my mornings
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

One of my favorite places to go for breakfast and coffee for over 20 years.  Sit inside or out and enjoy coffee and some of their awesome breakfast burritos.  10 different coffee flavors on tap at all times.  And lots and lots of traffic for fun people watching.  Definitely one of the more successful coffee houses in Santa Barbara.  One thing to share here is that the seats are not very comfortable. It's not a lounge.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

A neighborhood staple for the granolas in Santa Barbara. Their breakfast burritos are legit! So big! Wish I could. It half of one. The coffee is okay, but no place I'd rather be on a weekend morning when visiting SB
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Almond croissant tastes like a day or a two old, very thick and heavy, with few almond flakes and lots of powdered sugar on top.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I love this place. It's what I think of when I think of a cafe/restaurant that represents southern california/santa barbara. There's great drinks, open floorplan/atmosphere, and AWESOME salad and sandwiches. My favorite is 1/2 and 1/2:  2001 sandwich on wheat bread and the garden (or whatever it's called) salad with balsamic - add avocado because DUHHH.

The people who work there are so friendly and they began seeing me so often (since I worked down the street) that they would say "hey Kelsey!" whenever I walked it.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Love this place, good food, good coffee, and a nice atmosphere but man they need to work on their staff! There are a couple of cashiers that are super sweet but today the girl behind the counter was pretty rude! Rolled her eyes at me, didn't say please or thank you nor did she smile once, and had a very condescending tone. I have worked in the customer service F&B industry for many years so I get that it can get a little old, but come on. This also isn't the first time I've had a rude cashier here. 
Luis, screen your staff better!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Daily Grind has the most affordable and delicious coffee, espresso drinks, smoothies and juices in Santa Barbara.  

It is family owned.  The service is spectacular. There is an outdoor patio and it's a great place to hang out to do work.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This place is great, it gets busy during rush hour and on weekend mornings, but definitely a great spot to have coffee and some morning pastries. I always get their breakfast burrito, it's good stuff!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Accidental pit-stop when we took Mission St exit in SB early Saturday, on our way to Lake Lopez (Labor Day 2013).  And what a fantastic find!! 
First, the atmosphere was welcoming; colorful. Great decor. Lots of people milling about on the patio and indoors... Super friendly customer service.  
The staff were all HAPPY, PLEASANT, accommodating and knowledgeable. ***Your staff can make or break you and this staff is doing a great job.  
We tipped them well and I hope others do too.****  The drip coffee was tasty; loved the self-serve/refill bar.  Great selection of coffees, including organic & decaf.  We didn't sample espresso drinks, so no comment on those this time.  
Pastries were fantastic:  Blueberry muffin, Blueberry & Cranberry crumble? was incredible!  And the prices were so reasonable for such well-made food.  

So what did we do?  We planned another stop on the way back  down to the South Bay...  This time was during lunch - more coffees, fresh muffins, with the addition of sandwiches to go.  Heaven!  The Mission Impossible and the Porky Pig both fabulous - we shared them amongst the adults and kids.  
Look for us to stop here whenever traveling up and down the coast.  *****FIVE stars!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Great coffee, muffins, salad, juices and outdoor space. Lovely neighborhood hangout with one big exception:  But bathrooms are terrible ; please remodel and clean them! Really it's disgusting and not fair for a coffee place!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This is my go to coffee shop. I can't count the amount of times I visited for a quick cup or spent hours on the patio  reading a newspaper. It's the first place I ventured when after I had  a baby as we walked over with the stroller and I quietly tried to sit on the corner of the patio and sleepily watch people enjoy their day. I enjoy the peach smoothie and Mexican organic coffee. If I'm hungry I grab a scone or a vegetarian sandwich. The parking is pretty easy but getting in and out of the parking lot on the corner can be an issue some days. I highly recommend this place for standard coffee and not the fro-fro lattes we sometimes like on other days (Lilac Cafe is good for those). So, stop in and try a good cup of joe!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Barista was rude, bagel burnt, and for no explained reason the kitchen is not open until 6:30.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Hi everyone!!! Hope you like my review about this coffee place! Well I went to Santa Barbara the first time and then I wanted coffee and "The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station" was at a corner with a parking lot. When I went into the coffee shop I felt in loved with it...well if you order hot coffee they give you the size you ordered and you fill it up with any type of coffee....just for $2.00 only! AMAZING!!! Their latte is so good too and their iced coffee is super good I will recommend that to anyone who likes to drink iced coffee...if not then their hot coffee is also good too....the amazing part is that their muffins are the best too... I think it is better then the ones in Costco... Their not too sweet and not to dry...
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I love this coffee place! There's ample seating inside and outside. The staff has always been friendly. There are sandwiches, smoothies, bagels and pastries as well as coffee and espresso drinks. The food and coffee are great at decent prices!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

What I love about this place is that it's very unassuming. People are often thrown off by coffee shops that look the way this one does. It can give off the appearance of a deli or a fancier take out restaurant since its tables and chairs are not what you might think they would be. The chairs aren't the most comfortable, if I'm being real honest, but overall, I liked my experience there.

They have a lot of different drinks outside of coffee and tea, including smoothies! I happen to be on a really large smoothie kick at the moment, so it (the Fiesta Freeze, to be exact) happened to be exactly what I was looking for. This particular Daily Grind is fairly large and has outdoor seating, which is always a plus in my book. It also has outlets, which has become a pretty valuable commodity for those of us who bring laptops.

My friend has taken a particular liking the Daily Grind, so I'm fairly sure I'll be back and will try more of their smoothies (and maybe get some work done)!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Packed in the morning...all morning!  This is not the place if you're in a rush, the line is out the door!  But if you're not, it's worth the wait!

I just had the spinach breakfast burrito - oh YUM.  Lots of feta, lots of spinach, and the salsa has just the right amount of heat.  and b-i-g.  I am stuffed.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Everything you can possibly want for a morning stop is here! Wide variety of coffees, smoothies, egg sandwiches, bagels- definitely a popular locals spot. Good coffee. Not the best but solidly good. Great place to sit with newspaper or laptop and work. Not a hipster spot like French Press or Handlebar- those are to see and be seen. This is the place you go when you're not all dressed and put together and your hair isn't up to its hipster perfection. This place is like you're favorite sweater- nothing fancy, but seriously comfy and your standard go-to.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This is my favorite coffee shop in Santa Barbara. I've since moved away unfortunately but every time I return for a visit, I make a stop in here.  The coffee and espresso is great and I love the atmosphere. Especially the outside deck when it's sunny (which is all the time in SB). They've got a nice selection of regular black coffee including some organics and all the espresso regulars, latte, cappuccino, mocha, macchiato, americano, and iced coffees. They also sell pastries and muffins from local bakeries, as well as make sandwiches and smoothies.

There is free wi-fi internet of course. And private lot parking, which is somewhat limited to about 15 spaces. 2 bathrooms located outside, just grab the keys from the front counter.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The Daily grind has a great coffehouse culture. I give this place only 4 Stars, because I genuinely LOVE the coffee, but direly want, wish and HOPE the owners read this and all these reviews.

The drinks here are fabulous. The atmosphere is perfect for any kind of meet up, or study session. It's open early. It's fast. The drinks are almost always consistent and perfect.

The only problem.. Is the service! This is my first negative review on Yelp, and my general philosophy is to really give a place many, MANY times (over 5, but in this case I come here weekly) to set an impression before I review, and I just feel obligated because I love this joint so much.

But back to the service. The service..
I've been 2 times this week, and I will report on this week only, but unfortunately it reflects every other time i've been.

You walk up to the register. No one calls you up, or asks if you're ready to order - it's very awkward. You kind of have, to awkwardly initiate it.
Then, you get a blank stare. You're not sure if they're looking at you, or the walls beyond or wandering off contemplating the universe. Think the TOTAL opposite of Starbucks. Yeah.. It's very awkward. Then you assert something like 'Are you open to take orders'? 'Should I place my order here'? It's just, unnecessary to have this kind of experience. Then, the entire time they are just uninterested in you as a customer, and no matter how many times you ask for no whipped cream, you will ALWAYS get it. 

Then this morning, I walk in, and there's someone in front of me, and he was some type of friend of the guy @ Register, because they start showing eachother pics on eachother's phones - which is totally fine, I worked at Starbucks for 5 years and know some of my best friends now were customers.. But there's a TIME, and a PLACE, and that isn't when someone's waiting in line behind you, for 4 minutes..

Finally, someone else standing around calls me out to order on the other register (first time this has happened here) - and then next thing I know, a few minutes later someone yells out the first half of my drink (BLEND!) and they disappear, and there's my drink.. I asked.... Since I first started coming here for no whipped cream. Easy enough to scoop it out.. But the owners should really know this is a consistent experience for me.

Last but not least. The other day, I sat on the porch, and to my unfortunate event (because it ruined the down time of enjoying my coffee on the porch) an employee, VERY loudly chatted the entire time I was out there - complaining about when it was finally time to get off - blah blah. I get it, it's a Saturday and you're ready to go home - but the customers sure don't want to hear you talking WAY too loudly about it. So.. Unprofessional.

But enough ranting. The Coffee is amazing, but I do hope they begin to focus Customer Service on top of their crazy great Coffee!
