I live just up the street from The Daily Grind and go there a few times a week when I am in the mood for some amazing coffee that isn't coming from my own drip in the kitchen. 

Honestly, I have tried a lot of coffee shops here in SB and this one gets top bill. The coffee is, first and foremost, the best. But the selection and variation and the refill system makes you want to stay, hang, study and get excessively jittery. 

BUT, I have two complaints about the daily grind. After going there again this morning on a random morning walk, I once again forgot that they only accept cash. This may seem like a minor issue- especially since they have one of those 3rd party ATM machines inside (which takes a hefty cut on providing you cash). 

However, at this point in time, having a business that doesn't allow the use of cards makes it seem incredibly fly-by-night and somewhat sketchy. Why would this coffee shop, which is packed everyday, shy away from cards and getting hit by a slight ATM fee at the end of the month or per transaction? Surely they must turn enough people away to gain more profit by providing the service. Heck, I wouldn't even mind if they increased prices an extra 25 cents or whatever minuscule amount it would take to make up for it... 

If most businesses can afford the 20 cents per transaction why is Daily Grind still forcing us to use the huge "convenience fee" charging ATM which is almost always empty or out of order? Mysterious and annoying on those days when you just don't happen to have a few spare dollars. 

Secondly, they start their wifi at 11am or so. So if you plan on waking up early and studying while you're fresh at the start of the day- The Daily Grind is not your place.

Good coffee, great breakfast burritos, just make sure you have a ten dollar bill on you to get a drink and food. That is, if you want to save 2.25 and not use their ATM. 

Hopefully it's working that day.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Coming from New York, I knew that there would be certain sacrifices I would have to make. I didn't anticipate that good food would be one of them. Usually, I can quell my gastronomical yearnings with some local substitute. Unfortunately for me, I got the craving for a bagel with lox, and I found myself wandering aimlessly between delis and bakeries looking for the one thing that would give me peace. 

As a last ditch effort, I pulled into the daily grind hoping against hope that they'd be the ones to save my day. 

They did, but I left feeling cheated. Here's why:

Me: "Do you have lox."
Guy: "Yes."
Me: "Oh, thank God. I'll have a bagel with cream cheese and lox, and capers, do you have capers. And don't be stingy with the cream cheese.
Guy: "Oh, we don't actually make it"

At this point the guy at the counter pulls out a baggie of salmon as he explains to me that they'd give me the ingredients, the pieces and I coud "assemble it myself." Oh. Disappointing, but we could make it work, come on California-- if this is how you do things here, I'll meet you half way. 

It wasn't worth the effort. 

What I got was a plastic 1oz cup of whipped cream cheese, a baggie of salmon, and a lightly-toasted,  ring impersonating an everything bagel in a paper bag. And as I struggled to assemble my evening meal in the front seat of my car I couldn't help but feel some connection to my friends in the millitary who have to choke down MREs that were created in the spirit of good food, but did more to tease than satisfy.
And charging 85 cents for additional cream cheese when there wasn't nearly enough to begin with is just robbery. 

I give three stars for having what I wanted, but I'm subtracting one because it was a disappointing reflection of what it was intended to be, and another one for the presentation to cost ratio. I'm not exactly why my sack lunch was so expensive, snd I couldn't have imagined less effort being made.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Not only did I not see what she rung me up for until AFTER I paid and never saw the cost of my latte. but she didn't  bother to tell me a large latte had three shots of coffee and didn't bother to tell me that the salsa costs 50 cents extra.  Then, I pick up my burrito and there is no extra salsa in the bag.  Not cool. Oh dear god, I love this place. 

From the ample variety of brewed coffees, to the fresh squeezed orange juice, to the Spinach Feta breakfast burrito (with no egg), this places rules them all. It's worth the wait in line, it's worth the sometimes-crowded-Saturday-morning patio crowd, it's worth making sure you have CASH ON HAND (cash only). 

I'm not a meat eater, but my friends constantly rave about the Bacon breakfast burritos. That could be the bacon or it could be that, in their hungover state, all grease tastes like heaven, but it's consistent enough that you can be confident that you aren't going TERRIBLY wrong in an order of such an item. 

Baked goods are worth a nod. Bagels are standard bagels. I don't come here for pastries though, so default to other advisors in this arena. 

What I CAN say is the Spinach feta burrito is ridiculously good. I prefer the No Egg version of it, but I've got this weird thing with runny egg/spinach combinations (it squicks me out).  The provided salsa is what makes this experience out-of-body, and I feel comfortable saying that if you don't like the salsa, we need to talk about the last 20-some-odd years of your life. 

There's other stuff on the menu. Smoothies get a B average. Sandwiches weren't much to bat an eye at.  To me, this place very dominantly controls the breakfast scene. 

Particularly good when hungover.

I really like their lemonade-fresh- and their oriental chicken salad is tasty!! The juices are good (I was juicing before the hospital stay) so I was able to get my juice fix without spending a fortune (other juice spots in SB are ridiculously expensive). My son (who was a baker at Renaud's previously) loved the croissants!! They are huge-big enough to share. 

The staff is mostly friendly...there are some that will just ignore you while they chat with friends or regulars while everyone else waits. Also, there are many times when there is one big line snaking out the door and two registers open-customers will cut the big line and that is annoying. So far I have liked everything I have tried here, my son is really partial to the breakfast burritos. The tables inside are cramped and hard to maneuver-sometimes you can't even pull a chair out far enough to sit down-you are bumping into someone else in their chair; outside seating is nice, but pretty much packed all the time. I am giving 4 stars instead of 5, because of the inconsistency of the staff's attitudes/customer service, and the fact that you can have a very difficult time with the inside seating.

The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I also thought the food would be at the very least, satisfactory... but both my friend and I agreed that it was one of the worst sandwiches we have ever had at a public place. It is a sad day. Spent my last dollar ever at The Daily Grind - $15 in fact, with tip. After being a semi-regular customer for more than 20 years, today I experienced the opposite of what I would expect from their manager. A group of 10 friends had gathered for morning cheer, to exchange holiday gifts, and enjoy each other's company.  All of us had made a purchase (in fact I'd purchased three extra muffins to take home to my family) so we were paying customers. We were having a very nice time, and yes...we were laughing and talking - as large groups of friends often do. Then, about 20 minutes into exchanging gifts the manager approached our table. He proceeded to ask us to "tone it down" because The Daily Grind "is a restaurant, after all..." All 10 of us sat there waiting for the punch line, expecting him to crack a smile and actually check in with us, making sure the food and beverages were to our liking (keep in mind it's a restaurant, after all...so that would actually make sense). But he wasn't kidding. Dude, are you serious? It's December 21st and 10 paying customers choose to gather at YOUR coffee house (sorry, "restaurant") to exchange gifts...and you're going to Shush us? We were stunned (and a little upset) but we did as we were told, and took to snapping instead of clapping, whispering instead of talking. Then we finished up, put all four small tables back where they had been, bussed our tables completely, and exited the building. I'll never go back. 

I've been proud to buy coffee at a locally owned, independent operation like The Daily Grind for more than two decades. Supporting a local business over a mega corporation like Big Bucks just feels like the right thing to do. But The Daily Grind got the last $15 they'll ever get from me this morning. Handlebar, here I come.

We visit Santa Barbara often and we were tired of Starbucks, so we searched for a good local coffee shop. This one was open early and had a lot of different coffee/pastry options so we figured we had nothing to lose... We arrived as soon as they opened, walked in and immediately felt unwelcomed. The girl in the front looked us up and down as soon as we walked in, and I'm assuming she didn't like what she saw because instead of greeting us, she walked away. We were here for coffee, not to make friends so we continued to look at the menu.. Ordered 2 coffees and 3 pastries. At this point the same girl who failed to greet us, took our order and was extremely rude. I asked about the caramel macchiato and her response was "we're nothing like starbucks so dont expect us to make a macchiato like theirs".. I was fed up with her lack of service at this point, so I asked her what her name was. She responded, "Why? I dont just give out my name to random people." I said "So you guys dont give out your name or wear name tags?" She said "Nope.", and walked away with a disgusting look on her face. We are waiting for our coffees, which are being made by another worker.. I love this place! Fast service, cheap prices, relaxing atmosphere, free parking, and delicious food and drinks! What more could you want in local coffee spot? 

I have been a very bad girl lately and have been frequenting this joint for a morning bagel, or two, or three... I just can't stay away! They are too good. And don't even get me started on their cream cheese. Let's just say the dream of eating a bagel with cream cheese from the Daily Grind is enough to make this non-morning person get up and out of bed in the morning. And at less then $3 I'm 99% sure they were sent from heaven. 

Daily Grind, our morning love affair will continue. See you bright an early :)
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I was super disappointed with their spinach burrito. I had bacon added to it. The feta cheese did not pair well with the rest of the ingredients, and all of the cheese was on one side while all the bacon was at the bottom. I was super excited to try this place since I've heard good reviews. The cashiers were decent but not friendly. Sadly will not be returning.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Very disappointing visit today. I used to come to this location often but the service has gone downhill. I ordered a "16 oz blended mocha", those were my exact words, and I was given a hot white mocha instead. When I said that's not what I ordered the barista rolled his eyes and argued to me that I had said I wanted a white mocha. No, I know exactly what I said so I left the drink there and waited for the correct one. They remade the drink and the barista called it out with a very annoyed tone in his voice and they got the drink wrong again, they gave me a blended white mocha this time. I didn't wanna argue so I just took it but I barely drank any of it since it wasn't what I wanted. I don't know how you mistake blended mocha for white mocha. Won't be coming to this location anymore, I will go to the store on upper De La Vina where the customer service is much better.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Cute spot.  Good coffee and great smoothies.  Outside patios is a plus too!  Very inexpensive considering how much big coffee houses charge.  Definitely a small business people need to support.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Great coffee and food. Long lines but workers are pretty fast for most part. Only down fall is somthing Arne always smoothing, sometimes they are shakes more liquidy than would like. But aside from that fair price and lots of options
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Just got their chicken noodle soup with not one pice of chicken in it . Maybe should just be called noodle soup.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I do like this place for the variety of options. They have a really nice breakfast and good cappuccinos too. They are the 16-20-32oz kind of cappuccinos though. But still great! The breakfast sandwiches are awesome and the kombucha on tap is ideal. It's a great location too with a nice patio and lots of chill coffee house seating.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Ordered a lox bagel and was told all the bagels they left were cranberry or multigrain. Obviously got the multigrain and was not told that the bagel had walnuts in it. After starting to feel an allergic reaction, I called and asked about the ingredients and was told I'd have to call Jack's bagels, where their bagels come from. I had to call multiple stores to find out that they do have nuts in them. When I let the daily grind know, no one seemed very concerned. It's extremely dangerous for them to not know that some they sell has nuts in it, especially hidden and ground in a bagel, where you typically don't expect nuts. Which is why I didn't ask, but they didn't know anyway. Basically just paid for a meal to have to throw it up. Luckily I won't have to go to the hospital but if it was another nut, I would have. Do better, daily grind. Please be aware if you have any serious allergies. The staff has no idea what's in their food. Not to mention the food is extremely subpar anyway.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

If there was an award for Best Place to See and Be Seen in your Bedhead and Uggs, the Daily Grind would get my vote. Sometimes its popularity confuses me, much like the popularity of a nearby "cajun" style diner confuses me, but hey, it's a fact - the place is often heaving with people. 
I like their muffins, particularly the cranberry strusel and the maple pecan, but I always get it to take away. More often than not, there is NO place to sit. The regulars have camped out in their spot for, like, a week (which might explain some of the bedhead issues), along with their dogs, and I don't see much table turnover during the times I'm standing in the queue to get my muffins.  
I definitely support the Daily Grind over the coffee shop chains, and this shop can get you in and out in a time almost comparable to the chains, it's also not far from the Mission St. freeway exit/onramp, so quite convenient for a caffeine detour. A number of my friends put the Daily Grind on their list of weekend To Dos.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
The veggie burrito tasted old and bad.Their coffee was good, a large variety of coffee flavors to choose from,
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
The staff always has a bad attitude both locations, so excited Handlebar is coming to De La Vina!!!!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Amazing moist muffins without being super sugary. The spinach and egg burrito was so good (and that salsa though- spicy and delicious). The coffee was great- good blends. Such a great find!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

From out of town and went here on a recommendation from the hotel. Place (2001 De La Vina location) is just OK as far as "ambiance" inside.  But only outside eating available now. Ordered a Lox and Bagel sandwich, asked for butter on the bagel, I know she heard me, but didn't say anything to the guy making the order....didn't get butter on it.  Ordered a latte too, asked for half and half for the milk and her response was "yeah, yeah" (as if I was bothering her with this request)...same thing...didn't tell the person making the latte (and it's not on the receipt, if that how they give special requests, but not here I guess), so didn't get half and half.  Bagel itself was good and coffee itself was good (aside from not getting what I asked for).  But lox was meh, and service was less than meh.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Weekend getaway was even better with this delicious breakfast - lox bagel and ham cheese croissant!! Thank you guys!! We will be back!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

My go to place for coffee and breakfast. They have a great selection of different roasts of coffee. I have never gotten one that I didn't like. This place is good for stopping in and getting food to go real quick or having a cute brunch date with a friend. The breakfast burritos are really good and the hot sauce they give you is one of the best I've had. The bagels are good as well. But I'd recommend the burritos!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Perfect place to come study. Ample outdoor seating to enjoy the beautiful Santa Barbara weather, free wifi, and strong coffee. They even have stevia as a sugar substitute! Huge variety of coffee blends and a full breakfast and lunch menu as well. I'll definitely be returning here often!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
MMMMM best LOX bagel sandwiches in Santa Barbara! It is usually packed in the mornings so prepare to try and find parking, but it is defiantly worth it. The lattes are also delish, not too sweet.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Meant to post this for Daily Grind on Mission, but also applies to upper De La Vina!! Hands down the best breakfast burritos in town. I had a bacon burrito with egg, bacon, avo, light potatoes. Their homemade salsa rocks. Oh yeah, and don't even get me started on the oat milk latte!  The healthier option would be burrito bowl (sans the tortilla) which is also the bomb.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Service is always great and greeted with a smile!  My favorite is the Mexican coffee(a must try!)
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Here in SB from Portland OR for a girls' weekend. Walked here from Best Western hotel. What a find!!! Amazing food, great prices and totally awesome service. Coming back tomorrow for their package deal of gallon o' coffee and and muffins to have around the pool! Generous portions, fresh juices and smoothies. Lovely shaded outdoor seating.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The Daily Grind is the best coffee shop and deli in town! They not only have the most delicious food, they have a great selection of brewed coffee. You have to stop by and try out their Cinnabon brew, the best! 

They also have all new digital menus now, really cool and very easy to read! Depending on who you might be meeting, it's a great place for dogs on their outdoor patio and studying if needing a quite place to sit down and focus. 

My favorite refreshment is their Arnold Palmer Tea and favorite meal is their Spinach Breakfast Burrito.  MUST TRY!!!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Pretty surprised at the positive reviews for this place. Ordered a back. Breakfast burrito, ham and cheese croissant and double latte. 
The breakfast burrito has incredibly greasy and heavily seasoned in a chorizo flavoring even though I ordered bacon. 
The ham and cheese croissant was over toasted
And the double latte was so hot that even after waiting for a few minutes it still burned my wife's lips and tongue. We sat there for over 15 mins and the coffee was still too hot to drink before we left. 
Very disappointing
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The place is super cute! My mom and I were road-tripping though and stopped for morning coffee. We both went with a red-eye. I wasn't super impressed with the coffee, as it wasn't as smooth as I like and left an odd  aftertaste BUT the scones we purchased made up for it. I asked if they were super sweet, because I'm more on the English scone side of the spectrum and prefer mine a bit drier. The guy at the counter was super friendly and helpful in helping me make a decision (there are A LOT of flavor choices). We ended up with the cinnamon pecan and the cranberry almond. I've eaten a lot of scones and let me tell you, the ones at The Daily Grind are hands down the best I've ever had.

Do y'all ship pastries to Orange County?
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Best breakfast burrito in SB, by far. Everything about it is delicious. I especially like the seasoned potatoes and the salsa you get with it. Not to mention, it has a good ratio of everything in it. Nothing over powers. I get one of these babies at lease once a week, and I have never had a bad experience, it is consistently delicious, not to mention a great deal compared to other breakfast burritos in the area.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

During these current times, we have opted to come here once a week. My wife truly enjoys both the coffee and iced tea here, but we also eat here. I get the very large burritos and she gets the bagel sandwich. Very good.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I love coming to The Daily Grind. They have a very casual and relaxing vibe here, which I love! I always get fresh coffee every time I come here and they have many different types of coffee. They grind their own coffee beans here, which I love! They also have special hot drinks they can make such as mocha, green tea, latte, chai tea, and more. 

I love that they have fresh smoothies and juices here made to order. They also have a variety of different bagels, muffins, and pastries. They have many different choices of egg bagel sandwiches and breakfast burritos as well. 

I love coming here to hang out with friends, have breakfast, study, or work from my laptop. They have tons of tables inside and outside along with great free wifi with tons of plugs, which make it a great place to get work done. 

Outside they have a pretty big sized patio, which is great. They are also dog friendly so you can bring your dog here!  

I recommend this place to anyone looking for fresh coffee, juice, smoothies, and food all for great prices!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

They don't answer the phone. If you are driving is hard to place an order online, called during 20min still no answer. Arrived to the location where only two customers online waiting. They should cancel their phone line if they aren't willing to answer the phone.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Worst tuna melt I've ever had. Cheese wasn't melted and there was only mustard on an accidental section of the super dry wheat bread.

They took forever and seemed generally very confused about who ordered what or why anyone was asking them anything.

I've had better quality sandwiches in airports.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Their breakfast burrito is amazing. 
My husband recommended it and we picked some up to go and it did not disappoint. The sauce that comes with it is a bit spicy but just adds even more taste to the burrito. 
The coffee was good but not hot. This review is to recommend the bacon breakfast burrito.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Came here with my girlfriend for coffee and lunch and really enjoyed it. I had a 1/2 sandwich 1/2 salad with a roast beef sandwich and Caesar salad. Both were absolutely delicious and of great value. I myself didn't get anything to drink but my girlfriend enjoyed a lavender latte which I had a sip of, and it was also amazing. Tons of patio seating and friendly service. I will for sure be back!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Other than coffee, i've only tried their breakfast burritos. By far my favorite in Santa Barbara!
Potatoes, cheese, bacon, eggs! what else can you ask for? THEIR SALSA is what else you can ask for....

I would also consider coming back to try their endless options of smoothies and food options, they sound really good!

Parking can be tight so please be considerate and park within the lines, dont park where there are no parking spots and hmmm be careful when you back out of spots!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Great neighborhood coffee shop where they remember you and your order. And great quality coffee!  Highly recommended.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Oh my goooodness can we talk about the breakfast burritos?! Fluffy eggs, home style potatoes, sausage bites, served with salsa on the side. After a night out on the town it was the perfect thing I needed before hitting the road. Not to mention they have a large variety of juices, smoothies and tea/coffee choices. My friends and I stayed at the lemon tree and just walked down, it was about a five minute walk. I'll definitely be back next time I'm in town!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Breakfast burrito heaven!! Only place I'll go for a bfast burrito now. So good and so big! Their salads are also amazing. Love this place
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Had the bacon breakfast burrito. Super good. You order coffee and get to choose from a wall of options.  Very early 2000's and fun.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

smoothies and sandwiches here are delicious. They definitely strive to service fresh, local food. I do not like though when I order a sandwich and there is 5 inches of sprouts up in it. The atmosphere is great considering you are close to downtown, across the street from an amazing ice cream place, McConnell's , and there is adequate seating for a small/large group of people. Cash only, so I removed a star and service is SLOOWWW. Overall good experience but for coffee and tea I prefer Santa Barbara Roasting Co. or The French Press.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Don't go there if you want a simple sandwich with mayo, tomato and lettuce. The closest thing (wouldn't let us order the simple as it was 'custom') was filled with sprouts, bell peppers, cucumbers tomatoes, a lot of cheese and pesto - lettuce was extra. The bread was broken and smashed when they cut the sandwich and it was so big you couldn't bite it. It was the worst sandwiches we'd ever had - $20 with tax for 2 sandwiches. Never again stopping here for a sandwich.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
The mex coffee is delicious and the zucchini and carrot muffins are the the staff is always friendly
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Me and my boyfriend stopped here to get a quick breakfast. We ordered the bacon burrito and chorizo burrito, and it was soooo good. They don't skimp out on the meats. Online ordering was easy and you can set your own pickup time. Definitely worth it!!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

They are good at trying to keep people safe. That's the four stars rather than three. 
They used to have larger bagels that were perfectly toasted. Today I got given a variety I didn't ask for, then after waiting a while longer, I got one that seems smaller than they usually are. Barely toasted. The bigger than average bagels are worth 4$, these are not. I won't get bagels there again. 
The breakfast burrito is still big enough to warrant the high cost though.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This is a go to spot for salads and good cold brew.
I wish I would have taken a picture. It was beautiful as well as delicious. Even though it's on a busy street. It's easy to get to from mission st, and the outside dining area is under big beautiful trees.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
I love this place! Coffee is amazing and the sandwiches are delicious! Staff is super friendly!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I liked this casual coffee, breakfast, donut shop in Santa Barbara do much I wanted to bring it home. Looks like a converted old gas station. Great coffee and bakery selection with plenty of seating, and since it's Cali, ofc plenty of healthy option like cut up fruits and what green nots
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I'm a long time customer. The food and coffee are quite good.

But, the owner and staff encourage customers to bring dogs into the shop and on the patio areas.  On multiple occasions, I have been witness to dogs getting into furious barking matches, barely restrained from biting each other.

It's not the dogs fault.  Some dog owners just can't be trusted to not bring aggressive dogs to a restaurant.   Of course the Daily Grind owners and staff could have a policy of not allowing (non-service) dogs on the premises, or alternately asking dog owners to keep their dogs tied up so this doesn't happen. 

I've asked management about this, and they say The Daily Grind prefers to allow dogs,  even though they regularly create regular disturbances on the premises.   

If this what you like, when you are paying for breakfast and/or coffee, then it's your spot.  Otherwise, consider going to one of the many other  excellent coffee shops in town.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I've been here on about 4 different occasions when I'm in a time crunch for breakfast/lunch. It's always packed, and I can't really say why. The servers are nice enough, always friendly if a little bored. However, the food and drinks come slowly, and the place often runs out of items pretty quickly. The quality is also pretty poor considering the price. 

Basically, unless you're in a bind for a quick coffee and bagel (early before they run out), this is fine. Otherwise, I'd rather spend the five extra minutes going somewhere else.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Been trying several breakfast burritos in Saint Babs. This one is truly very good and inexpensive (I believe $6.95 at the time of this review). The staff was extremely pleasant and efficient and the place was spotless! I was pleasantly surprised by both the indoor space and outdoor inviting patio of I assume a remodeled once Taco Bell (?). There were only three choices of breakfast burritos which made life simple. I will definitely be back and look forward in trying their wide selection of coffees and hopefully one of their bakery items screaming out..."pick me, pick me, I am worth all my calories!"
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

We're all extremely bummed with the terrible experience we just had here. Would NEVER recommend the food at this place. First the guy at the register was very spaced out or just incompetent but had a hard time even taking our orders... should have just taken that as a warning. Gave him benefit of the doubt bc someone in our group had good bagels & coffee the other day but we will definitely not be back. 
They are incapable of melting cheese so DO NOT get a warm sandwich like grilled cheese or tuna melt bc you'll end up w bread w a slice of cheese that looks like it was just left outside in the sun for hours and started to semi-melt (pictured... looks way better in the pics than real life).
Our mom got a chicken salad that was literally worse than pre-packaged cheap grocery store salad with previously frozen chicken. After one bite she was like let's just leave & get something else. Everything seemed to come out straight out of a bag, low quality & dead. 

We were shocked it was this bad because their yelp reviews are good! Ugh so annoying to spend this much money but won't let it ruin our day. Getting food at Public Market and the amazing Brazil Arts Cafe now to make up for our sad lunch.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Amazing selection of bagels and combinations. Smoothies also very tasty, as well as decent sized portions for the price
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

My daily 'go to' for lattes, smoothies, fresh juice, salads , sandwiches, and much more. 
Good service, drinks are consistently good, lots of fresh home baked goods from muffins to bars, and carrot cake to bagels. Very good place to grab and go or eat in or at the outside patio.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I LOVE The Daily Grind.  I've been a frequenter of the Grind for over 10 years as a customer and as an employee.  So perhaps I'm a little biased, but the point is that no matter where I go, I always come back to the Grind. The entire experience including its the location, the staff, the regulars, the variety of in-house pastries and the serve-yourself coffee selection all add up to a one-of-a-kind, Santa Barbara coffee-shop experience. More like a coffee-house really, because of the strong, home-like atmosphere.  It is a nexus of social activity and everybody is welcome - the award for least pretentious and most local coffee-shop goes to the Daily Grind, every time!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Wonderful. Delicious coffee! Ample seating indoors and outdoors- very pleasant outdoor seating. The staff is friendly and helpful. The food is delicious! Highly recommend.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Outside patio seating area is fabulous here 
A lot of coffee choices  and a lot of treats too, all just okay...nothing that great. 
Service is always a bit strange here, off and on.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Bacon Breakfast Burrito, Hot Vanilla Latte: filling breakfast spot! Got a bacon breakfast burrito that lasted me through breakfast and lunch. Vanilla latte was solid as well.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The Grind is our neighborhood coffee fix and I always support the local businesses that we enjoy. I'm no longer a resident of SB, but come back every year for a long stay. I stop at The Grind often for coffee or lunch. I just had a request from my husband to get their recipe for their Mediterranean salad. If anyone can help me with that, I'd be beholden to you! The food is very good, satisfying portions. They make a great cappuchino. They have something for everyone. The "cash only" policy is a good way to stay out of credit card debt. The parking is too limited for its popularity. If I could change anything about The Grind it would be to offer more organics. Buone appetito.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Always showing up first thing in the morning when I'm in SB for a coffee. Good coffee. Sticky buns are fab if you can ever find them in stock. They go fast. I've had the breakfast burrito before and they are quite tasty and filling. Friendly staff.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

This business DOES NOT follow the health orders put in place by the city that clearly states and lists people that are exempt from wearing a mask therefore discriminating against people with medical & mental health disorders, not to mention discriminating against a minority! I wore a face shield covering my face and mouth while social distancing and the "manager" came over to harass me about not wearing a mask...when I told him I had an exemption he should have backed off instead he chose to defy the health orders put in place by the city! He stated "it was a private business and that it wasn't him, it wasn't him"....private businesses still have to follow the health orders that ALLOW for exemptions! This business is out of compliance with the CDC and the health department that clearly lists who is exempt from mask wearing...has this business even read the health orders issued by the city?? DO NOT SUPPORT THIS BUSINESS if you believe in NON DISCRIMINATION.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Okay, I'm giving a 5 star review because I come VERY often and am always extremely satisfied with my food. That being said, today I ordered a breakfast burrito. Same thing as always. Today I noticed a slightly rancid taste. It was the potatoes. Please guys, why re-use potatoes from the day before or even prior? It completely ruins the authenticity of the food and fresh-feel. Now I am skeptical about getting food again any time soon because I never want to experience that again. I know it's only $8 but I couldn't proceed with eating it because it was ACTUALLY awful. Just, use fresh ingredients EVERY DAY. And to the chefs, please use common sense, if it doesn't look right, it's probably not okay to give to customers. Santa Barbara has an extremely high expectation when it comes to food. No one wants to eat that. I am refraining from posting a picture because I don't want to scare potential customers down the road. But please be aware of what you're putting on people's plates. It was absolutely disgusting and,  now I'm skeptical about returning soon. Thank you for your time and the chance to write you a review. Fantastic coffee, great food, but please don't let this happen again!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I love this place!!!

In a world filled with corporate coffee houses, its nice to see a great family owned business that survives.  The food is amazing, salads, sandwiches, baked goods all are great.  The bfast burritos deserve their own review... BOMB.com  Seriously these are the best in town.

Great patio with wifi and people watching galore.  Its definitely my favorite spot to sit down and get a little work done with a coffee for those days when I telecommute.  The staff is awesome, they get to know you and always friendly.

tons of choice in freshly brewed drip coffee and lots of great smoothies and fresh juices.  Try the super veggie, its awesome!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
We ordered the bagel sandwiches but were pretty disappointed that they weren't toasted and the cheese wasn't melted :/
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

shit service, employees can't tell their right foot from their left, been coming for coffee pretty frequently, they pretend they don't know you and treat you like dirt. If you want a proper coffee, don't come here. if you want service there are a lot better coffee shops in Santa Barbara. will never step foot in here again
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Great local coffee spot in Santa Barbara. They have some really great pastries too! When I came in for a cappuccino and a pastry in the afternoon, they were doing a buy-one-get-one-free deal on their muffins!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Great breakfast burrito! Ordered the spinach burrito and added bacon and it fed two people; we also enjoyed the zucchini carrot muffin. We got mocha and a coffee to enjoy alongside our food. 

Enjoyed eating outside and feeling like a local. It was definitely getting busy after 9am, I'd recommend coming before that time to enjoy breakfast in the patio area.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The daily grind does not disappoint. The service is super friendly and the baristas don't make me feel rushed when I want to venture out and try new things. My favorite smoothie here is the Lucy in the Sky- a decadent array of peaches, blueberries, and fat free yogurt! I would totally recommend anyone who loves coffee or smoothies, bagels, and a good study location!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Tried this place two times before reviewing.

Review is for service and quality of drinks & food.

Had veggie sandwich yesterday which lists avocado as primary ingredient but only has avocado spread. Bread was stale and couldn't hold the sandwich. Needs better bread options (toasted would be great!)  and to either state avocado spread or add avocado to sandwich. Only ate a quarter of it, waste of 8 bucks.

Had iced chai latte, nothing remarkable. 

However, yesterday service was great!

Today service was indifferent almost dismissive but different towards "regulars". Only ordered a latte so no major comments. 

Would rate two stars but great space and yesterday I saw that they allow dogs (big dogs) inside so that was pretty cool.

More inclined to bring coffee and lunch from home than to stop here.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Needed a place to get some coffee and study for an hour. I was exploring the area and found The Daily Grind on Yelp. The reviews brought me in. First, there was plenty of parking. Maybe that isn't a big deal in Santa Barbara but having lived in San Francisco and LA for so long, this was a luxury. 

I walked in and the place had an interesting, although not unique, style. One Shell Gas station sign and license plates all over the ceiling were nice touches. The counter lines were a bit disorganized. And people kept walking up to the counter to ask about their missing orders or the status of their food orders. Although the service was slow, they were patient with some particularly difficult and entitled customers. Definitely not filling my coffee cup with a big, sunny smile but at least they're professional.

Outdoor seating area was nice and there was plenty of it. Inside, there aren't a whole lot of outlets. So, if you're planning to come with a laptop make sure it's got a full charge. I had an iced mocha for a hot day and it was pretty good. Nothing to write home about, but was a solid iced drink. Restrooms were located outside and the one I used was a bit nasty. Yea, it's a restroom, but let's mop the floor and clean the toilet once in a while, ok?

Cool vibe, great drinks. Don't know about the food. I'd go back.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

My go to spot for morning coffee, a breakfast burrito, place to meet friends for a casual cup of coffee, or to work from my laptop. I always get the spinach burrito - AND IT IS AMAZING! I often dream of it! Plus, they grind their own coffee beans, so your morning cup of joe is fresh to death. Always. 

The atmosphere is laid back! There are often cyclists there, or people just finishing up a workout. They have some tables inside which are great for waiting for your order or for plugging in and working remotely (or just doing a quick crossword from The Independent!). 

Outside they have a decent sized patio, dog friendly!
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The WORST food. I have no idea why there are good reviews about the food on here. Even the help was terrible. The guy behind the cash register seemed so out of it when asking the most simplest question. He kept turning around to read the menu.

Do NOT order food here. Otherwise, you'll get two cold pieces of processed cheddar slices slightly warm with some tuna and they'll call it a Tuna Melt. Or same thing without the tuna and they'll call it a grilled cheese. You don't believe me? Look at the pictures I attached.

Salads are so basic they taste like pre-made packaged salads you find at 7-Eleven.

What a rip off! Wasted $70+ AND still had to eat somewhere else!

At most this place should have 2.5/5 stars. I'm starting to lose faith in the validity of Yelp.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

The coffee is great, in fact my husband and I go there at least once a week. We live down the street which is also very convenient for us. However, the customer service has always been bad or at least towards us- for example, today, my husband asked if our smoothie and coffee were ready, only bc it was taking a little longer than usual- which to the girl basically told him she was too busy making drinks for "regulars" walking-in, like excuse me? Beyond disrespectful! As someone who pays for their beverages/ food we are your customers too and we should all be treated equally. Wether we spend money at your coffee shop daily, once a week, three times a week... the treatment should be the same. This is one of the reasons small business go out of business. Rude employees which they have many of make the difference of returning or not. It's unfortunate that their leadership/ management doesn't change that. Like I said, food & coffee, everything is delicious just wished their customer service was simply nice.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Great coffee! Great food! Great people watching! 

Hubby and I came here both days that we were in Santa Barbara. Since he went to school here, so he knows that this spot is a Santa Barbara favorite. I had an espresso drink that was delicious the first day, and a regular black coffee the second. Neither was disappointing. They are pretty speedy here, which is good because it gets line out the door busy,
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

OMG their zucchini and carrot muffin. YOU. MUST. TRY. IT. If I could describe it, tt's like the love child of a vanilla cake and carrot cake with some zucchinis thrown in there for good measure. Moist, delicious, and not too sweet. It's perfection. But like all things that are delicious, they run out of it super fast. It's apparently one of their most popular baked goods. I've been there at 10 am on a Monday before and they were sold out! 

As for their other baked goods, the mocha scone was alright. It was slightly wet for a scone and was way too sweet with its overdose of chocolate syrup and chips. The blueberry muffin tasted...very healthy. Not much to write home about. 

They've also got a large selection of coffee with refills costing $1. Their service is also fast and super nice. I love coming here to grab a bagel or a muffin and a cup of coffee to sit near one of their large windows and people watch. Makes for a very relaxing weekend morning.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Wow the attitude of the girl working today was abominable. Never going back here and would not recommend this place. Plus my coffee isn't good. Very disappointed
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Honestly, one of my favorite spots to get coffee and a light breakfast in Santa Barbara!

Due to the proximity from my house (and on a main thoroughfare) and the decent parking (hint: there are about 10 spaces in the back of the building), I normally make a stop here on the way to work in the mornings. Enough, in fact, that a few of the baristas know my order without me even having to say a word! Pretty cool.

Neat interior that I'm assuming was originally a gas station. Love the high ceilings and overall lofty vibe that the place gives off. There are always a crowd of locals in here, every time I come, so that's a good sign. The line does occasionally back up, though I feel that the cashier(s) make an effort to get it moving quickly.

I opt for an iced coffee when I do come and patronize this establishment. I've found that their coffee in particular is a lot less acidic than many other places in the area, which I (along with my digestive system) really appreciate. It's affordable for the portion, and promptly served.

During the rare weekend occasion where I have more time, I like coming here for coffee and a bagel, to be enjoyed on their expansive front patio. The food selection is vast with a variety of made-to-order sandwiches and breakfast goods. I enjoy ordering the lox bagel sandwich, and as you can see by my photo, is an honest work of art.

Thanks, Daily Grind staff, for the remarkable service and quality fare. I'll be back tomorrow.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Fast service, very friendly staff, and most importantly good coffee and food.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station
Really cute coffee spot in Santa Barbara. Decor was vintage- like and outdoor seating was cool. Ordered a cold brew that was kinda watered down but still good. Burrito was just ok.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I've been going here for over 10 years, and I have no complaints. As a kid, I would always get their smoothies and pastries, which are both great. The blueberry and raspberry muffins and scones are my favorite. Now, I either get a breakfast burrito or lox bagel sandwich. Both are very good. I think that DG has the best breakfast burritos in town. I've tried others, but I still crave the bacon burrito with their very tasty salsa. I usually get an iced coffee here as well- I recommend that if you're coming here for coffee especially in the summer.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

It gets two stars because they have some good smoothies and a nice patio but otherwise it's terrible. 

1) coffee is mediocre at best
2) espresso is mediocre
3) their cups are terrible. obviously you should bring your own cup but sometimes it doesn't work out that way and it's nice to have the backup of a decent disposable number. The styrofoam cups not only get hot but they are also flimsy and tend to fold up when they don't have a lid.
4) they have a decent Tea selection but the delivery is terrible. You get a teabag on a stick that wants to spill and their terrible cups make you want to burn yourself. You can't put a lid on the cup because of the stupid teabag+stick combo so end up squeezing the cup too tight and spilling scalding hot water on your hands while you try to get it to your table.
5) cash only. they have an ATM but the fee raises the cost of your drink to ridiculous levels.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

I'm a sucker for tasty, flavored, drip coffee. I just love a flavored cup that isn't bitter & doesn't require coffee mate or some other sugar laden faux creamer to sweeten it. 
Daily Grind helps me through my daily grind by providing a great flavored drip coffee; no unnatural sweetener necessary.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

Nice look and location, but...

Baristas/waitstaff are unfriendly. Tables sit dirty. They've blocked all the power outlets. The wifi is terrible.

This place is terrible. Go anywhere else. 

Even their place right up the street on De La Vina is better. But closes early.
The Daily Grind Coffee & Tea Station

If you want a dismal start to your morning, this is the place for you. If you want some punk kid working the register to give you attitude and make you feel belittled, this is the place for you. Worst customer service experience I have ever had at a coffee shop. 2 stars are only for the kind gentleman preparing the food in the back. The coffee is decent. I would try one of the many other coffee shops around town. 

To the owner, I would suggest finding a new person to run the register. The kid with the shaved sides of his hair in the front was:

a.) unwelcoming
b.) unable to multi-task effectively 
c.) just plain rude (or homophobic?) 

Kindly,

-A Santa Barbara local who will never be coming back.

I absolutely love the quirky vibe that the Daily Grind gives off. What I like about this location is that it is the same great Daily Grind with faster service and more parking spaces!!
The employees are also super friendly and always ask how your days going. Marina knows my order by heart and always makes it to perfection. Sometimes she has it ready before I even finish and never fails to smile and ask how my family is doing!
My order usually consists of a king kong with extra peanut butter. (The best peanut butter smoothie in santa barbara)

Finally I can't write a review with out mentioning how good the breakfast burrito is. It is really well priced and full of flavor. I've had a lot of breakfast burritos but none compare to the Daily Grind's burrito.

Good place for a quick cup of coffee or to linger over conversation. Nice lunch menu of salads and sandwiches  (counter service and brought to your table). They also make beautiful artisanal breads by the loaf, muffins and cookies.
I am so happy they opened a second location in my neighborhood, I love the coffee and all of their food items are really tasty.

Okay, I love your guys coffee and my wife and I go to your coffee shop on mission all the time.  But it's a bit disappointing that when driving home with 2 cups of coffee, just a couple of blocks away, always ends in a downpour of coffee all over my car.  I don't know who make your cups, but they definitely have a design flaw. The issues lies in the crease of the cup, on the rim where the fold is.  It seems to leak every time there's a slight movement.  The only reason I'm writing this post is because this has already happened several times, so I know it's not a fluke.  I would ask that you please revisit the design/distributor of your coffee cup.  Thank you.
Great place to sit down and grab some coffee. Mostly always busy so try to stop by not during rush hour to get the real experience!

They are truly amazing they have the greatest breakfast burritos in town. Ricky is the guy who helped me out he's very friendly and kind. I recommend this place if you are new in town. 

Thanks Ricky!

Came here on a Friday morning for breakfast. Tried the zucchini and citrus poppyseed muffins, which were super moist and so delicious. I had the breakfast burrito with spinach and feta. Big portion, simple, and yummy! Will definitely come back for more baked goods and coffee!
Ordered a regular coffee. It tasted burnt and the service was not that great. Good luck finding a parking spot. Don't think I'll return.
Really great coffees and breakfasts!! It is the best breakfast in the area hands down. Espresso drinks and lots of ways to make modifications so you are super happy with everything you order.

The Daily Grind is one of the best coffee spots in town. I love their Mexican coffee, both hot and iced. They have a wide variety of pastries and the muffins are delicious. Breakfast burritos are also legit and decently priced at about 6$--and the salsa that comes with the burrito is really good. The staff is always friendly and service is great. This location is small, but there's always parking available in their lot.

Good coffee shop, with plenty of seating. Mainly 2 person tables, it just lacks a lot of outlets if you're there to do work. 

Great amount of smoothies aside from good coffee and vibes. Plenty of parking and outdoor seating too. 

Refills are just a dollar for coffee. Check it out.

They were a mess. Management there is a nightmare. I typically go on saturdays and every time they have substituted avocado for no meat and no cheese, but for some reason this time I had to pay more. It's not the $1 difference but rather the concept of inconsistency and a lack of management and training. Please invest in some employee training...

I am not the only one... they spilled a latte on a customers foot and didn't apologize...
Yum!  Perfect combos and location and setting!  The bread is fresh and yummy. Minestrone soup delish.

Daily grind is awesome, especially the breakfast burritos! It's very reasonably priced and the food is delicious! The coffee is Pretty good to! It also has wifi and a parking lot which is a plus. Plus plenty of indoor as well as outdoor seating! I definetly recommend coming here :)
Sick breakfast burritos for a decent price the older daily grind makes them better with crispier bacon

Live in the bay area after leaving SB in 2011. Never leave an SB visit without a breakfast burrito and one pound of the vanilla macadamia nut coffee.
On point every time.

Sunday, November 12 around noon I came to this place trying to get a breakfast and I order a ham breakfast burrito and I was eating my burrito when I found a hair in the middle of the burrito this is disgusting I would never coming back to get something on this place a try to make me another one but I refuse

Breakfast burrito is like heaven from daily grind.  Must try for anyone in the area.  The avocado toast was good and tasty but nothing compares to the breakfast burrito. I am a repeat customer and it's always on point.

I love this place, I live right down the street and go every morning for coffee and many times breakfast. They are friendly and extremely efficient with the orders. Coffee is great many selections, breakfast burritos and bowls are delicious. Will stop in for lunch on my off days as well sometimes, the locals favorite sandwich is super good.
Love this place when I'm in SB. Employees are very friendly, and the coffee is great. The sandwiches are pretty good too!
Breakfast burritos are LIFE. Their Mexican coffee is everything. Service is great and timely. Sometimes parking is rough, but I don't even care, that bacon breakfast burrito is worth it.
The staff is not very friendly but the coffee and food are too good to stop coming here

I like supporting local businesses and have been meaning to try this place for a while.  I went today for the first, and last, time.  I ordered a coffee drink "for here".  It arrived in a plastic cup with lid and straw.  I said "oh, I ordered this for here."  Their response "I know - that's all we use."  They ONLY use singe-use, disposable cups.  With lids.  And straws.  I live by the philosophy that every dollar we spend is a vote for what we believe in.  So I will not be going back there.  Also, there were people smoking on the patio - another huge turn-off.  Management, take note.
At first I was disappointed that I didn't see the other juice options, but after tasting Super Veggie I am very pleased with my order. Tasty and refreshing.

I go to the Daily Grind on Mission and De La Vina once a week. Their iced coffee is perfect. My favorite in town. And their service is always excellent! Free wifi means I can get work done when I stop in. I only wish they had AC for the hot summer days!

Stopped in this morning and picked up the Spinach and Peach smoothie and a bacon breakfast burrito.  The smoothie was refreshing and the burrito was delicious.  Excellent salsa.  The staff was friendly and fast.  Can't wait to try the lunch menu!
Excellent coffee with organic option. Reasonably priced and you can sit inside or outside. I also got breakfast burrito that I really enjoyed. Worth a stop.

I come here about three times a week and you couldn't ask for a better way to start your day! The staff is friendly and they have the food to match! I can eat that breakfast burrito everyday of the week! Give this place a chance and u won't be disappointed
The Craft Draft nitro coffee is the best thing on the menu, and the peanut butter chocolate magic bar was good. I highly recommend and will be back for the Bona Fide craft draft
This is my favorite coffee shop in a town filled with every type of coffee shop imaginable. The food is a little on the pricey side, but never disappointing.

I come here almost every day. I know sometimes the workers have been there since before the sun came up,working doubles or working too many days in a row but they are always sweet. The coffee is never bitter. The muffins are always amazing.

OMG! One of my co-workers and I went here for some Mexican coffee and whoa!! I never had it before and was so glad that I tried it! I am hooked! This place is very cozy and upbeat. The service is fast and they always keep it clean here. There's also plenty of outside seating too. So many selections of coffee on the menu and for you to choose from. So much better than Starbucks! I would not start my day any other way now!!

Sunday, November 12 around noon I came to this place trying to get a breakfast and I order a ham breakfast burrito and I was eating my burrito when I found a hair in the middle of the burrito this is disgusting I would never coming back to get something on this place a try to make me another one but I refuse

Love this new (to me) location!! Great service and food,  perfect spot for students! 
Staff is friendly and attentive and the food comes out quickly :)
We will be back for sure!!

Great assortment of coffee and sweets! Friendly staff! But I have to agree with some other posts  that the food is a bit bland. I ordered bagel breakfast sandwich with ham and was disappointed! It was tasteless and the bagel was between soft and toasted... Interesting sensation... Anyhow... The coffee was great! Very flavorful... But I'll pass on the food next time...

This is my go to spot for coffee, breakfast & treats  when I'm in the area. The coffee selection may be slim but it's always fresh & tasty. Always get the breakfast burrito with avocado as a substitute for meat. There are a few employees that have been there long term that you can tell really care about the business & hoe it's run. However, the newbies always seem to need help with their customer service & people etiquette. One of the owners (Ruben) is usually there & I appreciate his efforts to go above & beyond. Born & raised in SB & even though there's a lot of competition, this is still my favorite coffee & breakfast spot.

Tried this place while on vacation in SB. Great place for coffee, bagels and breakfast burritos! They have a good selection of pour-your-own coffee along one wall and a huge menu of smoothies. Bagels are fresh and chewy, with just a touch of crispness. The spinach and feta burrito is very good, especially with the spicy orange dipping salsa. Friendly staff, and they have a nice patio outside for enjoying breakfast.

Highly recommend if you are staying in this part of town, and can walk there. Wish I had tried a breakfast burrito, they looked delicious and customer said they are amazing. We got hot fresh coffee, tea and great berry streusel muffins. Lots of clean comfy tables and the wall-to-wall windows make the inside warm and cheerful.  Friendly staff and lots of outdoor seats too. Will come again (soon I hope)

Mostly went for their sandwiches for lunch last summer when I worked near the de la vina location. They were fresh and really tasty. They also come with chips which I thought was really cool. The atmosphere is really welcoming and a nice vibe to hang out to.

The food was okay, kind of bland which is the basis for the four stars.   The coffee/espresso is good, not the best, but good.   

Despite this, the service is good and the environment is 5 stars.  This place reminds me of Berkeley, California but cleaner and nicer.   

The people all seem really nice and inviting and they have an impressive assortment of pastries (which we did not try).   

The purple haze smoothie was very good and flavorful.   But the burrito and tuna melt were not anything to brag about.   

I still recommend this place.
A local favorite. Great coffee, smoothies, sandwiches, pastries and more. The spinach feta breakfast burrito is my favorite. Love the atmosphere and outdoor seating. Staff is always very friendly.

Hands down the best breakfast burritos in town. I had a bacon burrito with egg, bacon, avo, light potatoes. Their homemade salsa rocks. Oh yeah, and don't even get me started on the oat milk latte!  The healthier option would be a burrito bowl (sans the tortilla) which is also the bomb.
Was on our way to SF and needed breakfast. I had the spinach burrito with the salsa. It was all made fresh even the salsa. It was delish! Service was great. Everyone was smiling and very friendly.

Rudest.Staff.Ever. I work in the service industry too I know first hand how hard it can be dealing with people all day but damn at least fake a smile. I live right up the street from this place but I walk an extra 10 blocks to go to the French Press because not only does the staffs' demeanor give you chills but the coffee isn't even good. The girls barely greet you when you come up to order and the men don't even acknowledge your existence. Don't even think about asking a question about a menu item unless you'd like a nice big eye roll and short  condescending answer. The food is ok if you catch them on a good day but the coffee consistently tastes burnt. I don't know who the owner/owners are but they need to teach some customers service and invest in better coffee or better barista training.
This is a go to for a breakfast burrito or bagel and coffee. Me and my roomate live a block away and have really grown to enjoy this place. We also hate Starbucks and love supporting local businesses

If you go to The Daily Grind, YOU MUST try the AVACADO TOAST! They the blend of avacado with sun-dried tomatoes and that balsamic glaze is absolutely to die for! I can't get enough! I am so spoiled to have my office just down the road from this amazing place!
The hot coffee here is pretty good but the iced coffee is terrible. Do yourself a favor and go to Handlebar right down the street.

The food is good, atmosphere is nice, great coffee!
Most of the staff is pleasant, except my sister and I had a really rude experience with one of the girls that works there. Brown hair brown eyes( not the girl with the blue streak) she was working Saturday morning. She was very rude to us and I saw her be extremely rude to other customers the entire time we were there, with a great place like this you should really value your customers and not treat them this way her behavior was not okay. I will not be coming back Saturday mornings to enjoy my bagel and coffee anymore.

The Daily Grind is one of the best coffee spots in town. I love their Mexican coffee, both hot and iced. They have a wide variety of pastries and the muffins are delicious. Breakfast burritos are also legit and decently priced at about 6$--and the salsa that comes with the burrito is really good. The staff is always friendly and service is great. This location is small, but there's always parking available in their lot. 

2018 update: breakfast burritos are now closer to $8 but still delicious.

I come here just about everyday and am never disappointed. The staff is always so friendly, and there is one girl, (with a nose ring) that is always giving people compliments. She's said she liked my bag, or my glasses etc, or my hair looked nice and I've heard her say nice things like that to others, and I think it's really sweet. Feel good environment and good people. Great place!
My husband and I ordered a Breve Cappuccino and Chai Latte, both we okay but not great.

I love daily grind. They have the best breakfast burritos with an amazing spicy salsa. The mini muffins at the de la vina & mission location strategically placed right by the register get me every time as an impulse splurge. Great selection of coffee and pastries. I also like that I can grab a wrap in the morning to take with me to work and have for lunch later that day. The line can get long but they are efficient and get through it quickly. Great local coffee shop, so glad it's right down the street from me!

I enjoy stopping and grabbing either the breakfast burrito or a pastry.  I had no idea there was two Daily Grinds on DeLaVina since I am from out of town.  Enjoyed the friendly staff and ambiance of the place. Definitely will be back

Decent food but TERRIBLE prices. Paid almost seven dollars for a kombucha which costs $3-4 anywhere else, but the sandwich I got was actually a pretty good deal. All in all I don't think I'll be back, but it will do if you're on a tight time schedule.
Great local hangout for breakfast, lunch and coffee.  Nice staff where all know my name.

Hands down the best breakfast burrito in town. I have gotten their chorizo breakfast burrito multiple times and I'm always satisfied! Other places I've been to, the chorizo leaves the burrito really greasy but not at The Daily Grind! The other great part about the burrito is THE SALSA!! So so yummy! Their ice blended mocha is delicious also!
Great service, super quick! Awesome spot to study or pick up lunch/breakfast. Favorite spot in town!

I had the chicken chipotle sandwich for lunch and it was epic! The sandwich was $8 and it was so big! Everything was fresh and the chicken was so juicy and tender! The corn tortillas served with it was a great touch! I would highly recommend this item for lunch or dinner! Enjoy!

Not a favorite but convenient.  Looks like an old Taco Bell restaurant   Seating and tables are old and not sturdy. 

Staff oS friendly.
Best breakfast burritos in town.  However be aware that there are two locations 9 blocks apart, so when you are calling in a to-go order, make sure you have the right one.

Great selection of coffee. Great selection of smoothies. Couple of bagel sandwich options which we ordered and enjoyed although the bagels themselves aren't the best but I am from NY and picky about my bagels. Friendly and efficient staff!
This is my favorite coffee shop. Nice variety, reasonable price, great coffee, and nice people work here!

Love this coffee shop! My go-to for coffee before work. Try the mocha with oat milk. Super super tasty! Marina and the rest of the crew are always helpful and friendly. Always leave with a smile on my face (and a delicious drink).

I had limited time to eat and went in for a quick lunch.  I was standing to the right of the cashier ready to order.  The cashier took a women next who clearly came in after me, and she even commented to him that I was there before her.  After he was done with her I told him I had been there first when he rudely replied, "You weren't in line, the line forms over there".  I said I didn't realize that and he said "well what do you want me to do about it?"  I then asked to speak to the manager, and what do you know he was the manager.  He was not at all apologetic but completely rude and argumentative, blaming me for not knowing where the line formed, even though I was the only one waiting to order when I entered the restaurant.  This is one of the worst customer service experiences I have ever had.  I hope they teach him some customer service skills because that interaction ruined my opinion of this business.
Loved the low key vibes here. Strong internet and great natural sunlight. I had the spinach egg wrap which was glorious.

This is my favorite coffee shop in Santa Barbara. Ricky and Marina know my order and are always so kind! My vanilla lattes are made perfectly every time and the burritos are the best in town! I can go here for breakfast and lunch, the BBQ chicken salad is addicting! Must go here!!!
Pleasant location and setting, but rude and unfriendly counter person.  Plenty of flies at outside tables.

*This review is for the upper De La Vina location*

DG is a great local coffee shop that doesn't mess around with the hipster bs you'll find down the street at Handlebar. The coffee is GOOD, the breakfast burritos are BIG, and the pastries are FRESH. I've heard they have great sandwiches and salads for lunch, but I've never tried myself. DG is my go-to cup o' joe in the upper De La Vina neighborhood. 

Just a couple of gripes: 

1. Service is quick, but smiles are hard to come by and there are no pleasantries. 
2. You'll sometimes find a slew of lukewarm coffees if you stop by for a late afternoon visit, so consider getting something made to order instead. 
3. Prices tend to be high. Ex. $4.50 for a Lg Arnold Palmer

Absolutely delicious Avocado Toast!!!!
Great breakfast or lunch and quick friendly service.
Favorite Oat Milk vanilla lattes. Best breakfast burritos.  Friendliest and most consistent coffee shop.

This is my favorite coffee place in Santa Barbara. The food is amazing and the service is even better. Shelby always helps me and she gives amazing customer service. She is very knowledgeable, attentive and cares about my experience every single time. Thank you Shelby, you are the best!!!!
Great coffee and food, people are always very friendly. Sadly the music they play is not very good, and I found that I couldn't even sit there to do any work because of it.
I walked here from my Airbnb for coffee several times. The selection is great and I was never disappointed. I wanted to try the food but was never hungry while there.

I'm going to echo several other complaints about the 'rude brunette' behind the counter (I found out her name is Marina according to my check.) How does this girl still work there?! Are the owners not reading their own Yelp reviews? She is beyond rude and nasty every time I go in. And I just order a simple coffee AND tip a couple bucks...nothing to be upset about. For the other reviewer that assumed this is 'Santa Barbara normal', I assure you it is not. I've been in this industry for 20+ years and she's one of the worst I've seen. You have to TRY to hate your job this much.  Honestly it's made me switch to Handlebar whenever possible.

place is ass, no salsa with chips? pathetic.. 
p.s the dude with the dyed hair had great customer service!

I swear I am here every Sunday morning. The lattes are fresh and the muffins are fluffy. You can't really go wrong from there. Try the zucchini carrot muffin. Trust me. I am obsessed.

Daily Grind has the absolute best breakfast burritos that SB has to offer, in my humble opinion, but remember that they stop making them after breakfast is done (I think it's at 11 but don't quote me on that. I just remember being really sad because it was 1 pm and I strolled in asking for one and was told no). 

The overall atmosphere is so relaxing. The vibes are very grungy but with a bit of de la vina charm. Oh, and if you happen to accidentally drive past this, no need to fret, there's another one just down the street!! 

Parking is beautiful, but it'll take a while to pull out of the lot. Or maybe that's just me. 

This is a sweet place to study, read a book, chat with a friend, dog watch, or watch the city just living through that, dare I say it, daily grind. A sweet gem of a coffee shop!
When I support a local business I am always encouraged to return when the employees are friendly and helpful. Unfortunately this time I won't be returning to this Daily Grind.

Horrible service and quality. I grew up going to the original Daily Grind on Mission and De La Vina, and this location is a complete disappointment. Don't waste your money or time. The cashier barely noticed we were there, paid not attention to us and once we paid didn't say "thank you" or "it'll be right out". She just turned right around and started laughing and messing around with her friends behind the counter. I paid $16 for 2 muffins and 2 Mochas - which tasted like they put zero mocha flavoring in.

If I didn't know better, I wouldn't think this location has any relation to the original location on Mission. Typically I actively avoid this location, but I was short on time and went against my better judgment.

I have always loved The Daily Grind, and have frequented the Mission and De La Vina location since 1999. Coffee, smoothies, breakfast burritos...all fresh and awesome, and I love the fast, friendly staff. However, due to the impossible parking, I started going to the upper De La Vina location shortly after it opened. Unfortunately, the staff at that location have never really been "on point"...generally unfriendly, unknowledgeable, burnt bagels, incorrect orders...but I kept going because they always managed to get my soy latte right (except for once, when they used whole milk, and then gave me an "oh, well" attitude) and the parking is better. Over the past several months, my visits have become less and less frequent due to the poor service and general crankiness.

Well, today was the last straw. I ordered an ollalaberry muffin, and when I finally got around to taking it out of the bag a couple hours later, it was moldy. I called them, and they guy who answered the phone insisted that they were baked fresh daily and that the ollalaberry "always looks like that". I informed him that I've never had one look like that before, and that it had big green patches all over it. Instead of offering to replace or refund, he offered me the manager's phone number; the number he gave me was to the other location, and when I tried to leave a message for Yolanda, the manager, her voicemail was full. I was unable to get through to anyone else using that number.

Why all this over a muffin? Because over the course of 15+ years I've dropped thousands of dollars in food and drink at the Mission location, and I hate to see a great place get bad reviews or lose business because of inept staff that could use some direct supervision and customer service training (and maybe some firing, too).

My advice? Skip them and deal with the parking at the other location.

Update: this is a few weeks overdue, but I went back to the main location twice after the muffin fiasco. The first time was fine, even though they made my latte wrong (whole milk instead of soy...wasn't the usual barista) but they offered to fix it, so no big deal. The second time I went, the guy behind the counter (Scott?) rang me up, and after swiping my card, said, "oh, you gave us a bad review", and said that he recognized me from my Yelp picture. I said, yes, I had given the OTHER location a bad review and explained why. He proceeded to lecture me (and I use that word because that's what it felt like) on the characteristics and coloration of the ollalaberry muffin, on why I was wrong, that it wasn't mold, and so on and so forth. 

Really? What kind of service is that? Instead of trying to make things better, the staff gives me a talking-to? I really didn't need this at 8 :15 in the morning(or ever), and his harangue (plus getting pinned in their parking lot by a trash truck) actually made me late for work.

You know what? I'm 52 years old, I've eaten (way) more than my fair share of ollalaberry muffins, I know what they look like, and I know what mold looks like. You know how this whole thing could have been avoided? By some decent customer service. When I called the first time, the employee who answered the phone should have offered to replace the item or refund my money. I haven't called the manager back, because to be honest I really don't need yet another person telling me that I don't know what mold looks like.
Great local coffee shop. I love their coffees and their pastries. I think their breakfast burritos are the best in town.

I have been going to the Daily Grind for years as I walk to work I stop and get a latte. I have a new puppy small breed 10 weeks old and they told me even though I had it in a carrying pack I needed to leave the puppy outside. No way. Daily grind used to be great but a little bit behind the times. I will not be giving them my business anymore.

By pure luck, I stumbled across the Daily Grind. One morning, as I was fueling up my car on my way to work, I realized I left my coffee on the kitchen counter. With a little time to spare before work I did a quick google search for coffee nearby. Daily Grind was open and the closest coffee shop nearby. The coffee was great and I knew I'd be back. Since then I've been back a few times and explored the menu a little further. If I could recommend one thing it would be the smoothies, they're pretty damn good. The King Kong is my personal favorite!

I love this place! It's tiny and kind of hidden, but that's what makes it a great weekend spot! I've never found it to be too crowded and they have a cute patio where you can bring your dogs and hangout with a group of friends while enjoying a cup of coffee and some delicious pastries as well as breakfast options!
I'd highly recommend their breakfast burritos- they're delicious and HUGE. You will definitely leave feeling full! The salsa they serve with the burritos is also amazing! If you're not in the mood for a burrito, they have some super yummy bagel sandwiches to choose from! If you've got a sweet tooth, none of there pastries disappoint either! Also, if you're not into coffee, they've got a yummy and decent sized selection of smoothies to fit your taste! 
The staff is friendly and the vibe is relaxed! If you're looking for a laxed but filling place for weekend brunch, this is a go to spot!

Love going to the daily grind for my morning coffee fix. On top of that they have great service, fast pace workers with great customer service and awesome food (the bacon breakfast burrito is my fav). Highly recommend to anyone who is visiting SB and wants a quick breakfast/lunch. Support local!

I like the daily grind but consistently when we've been helped by the brunette gal she's been so unpleasant and rude. It feels a bit racist because when she helps other people that are non Hispanic she is warm and friendly. She's rolled her eyes at us a few times. Makes me not want to go to the daily grind at all. 


The guy with dyed hair is awesome and friendly! He deserves 5 stars.

I try to come here often but they mess up on orders more often than they should. For example, I ordered one of the meat-free breakfast burritos and when I got home it was a sausage burrito. I'm vegetarian so I couldn't even eat it. The staff hospitality is average. Try Dune coffee or Hook & Press instead for better customer service.
