We drove over and decided what we wanted to get. Mimosas were def. the plan. I got some waffles and fruit. SO amazing. It hit the spot and didn't just sit in my stomach which I liked. 

By looking at the menu I was really digging what they offered. Next time I'm in the area I will for sure stop in.

And I LOVE that all the nutritional facts are on your receipt. I wish every place had that!
Food is awesome and can't beat the price. Smaller portions so you can mix and match and the service is good and fast. Good selection too

The food was good but the wait to order was ridiculous.

The menu ranges from salads to burgers and everything seemed fresh.

My burger was delicious and the staff were good.

Would love to give this place more stars but the waiting really bummed me out.

We were looking for a fairly quick, reasonably healthy dinner before a play downtown.  Well it was quick, and you might call it healthy since it was only cabbage, lettuce, a couple of slices of avocado, a few orange segments and maybe an ounce--to be fair, maybe 2 ounces--of seared ahi tuna.   But NO taste, NO flavor, and really not much to eat for a dinner. My husband's  sandwich and salad meal wasn't much better.

There are so many better places in Santa Barbara for a quick, healthy and TASTY meal that I don't see why some people seem to like this place.  We won't be back.
Came here for an affordable and really delicious breakfast. Service was friendly, food was great, quick and fresh. Tea and coffee were great quality also!
Wow. Underwhelming. Basically a Panera- it's fine but pretty ordinary for food in 2015! The interior is ordinary, too. Not worth a special trip.

Very easy location from mall. Great service and nice decor. Enjoyed the Root beer and black cherry soda. Hamburgers were great. BBQ chicken sandwich was delicious. Will definitely come back. Good Cucumber Mint Tea.

Great selection of salads and sandwiches! Definitely impressed with the service and the quality of the food...I ordered a sandwich and thai salad and it was almost too much food for one sitting.  Definitely coming back here again!
I have been eating silvergreens for five years. It's always good and consistent product. Staff is always nice as well. Love the soups! Easy take out for dinner :)
That does make me feel better. And what about the black nail polish? How does that not get in my food?

We were looking for some healthy dining options while visiting Santa Barbara and stumbled upon Silvergreens.  This place is great.  It has a varied menu that will satisfy both carnivores and vegetarians alike.  Everything is really fresh and tasty.  We ended up having dinner there our first night, smoothies our second, and lunch on the way out of town.  I had the edmame hummus sandwich on some of their delicious, fresh bread. It was very flavorful and filling.  I enjoyed it with their fresh seasonal fruit.  We had a side of fries and they were really good -- they were cut thin and sprinkled with seasoned salt and parsely.

We will definitely make this a regular dining spot when we are in Santa Barbara.

Love love LOVE this spot! Quickly yelped a lunch spot after the gym across the way. We had the vegetarian burger with salad and the Thai salad with chowder. Seriously amazing! Light, filling and delicious!

Greeted by super friendly staff, ordering was a breeze. The cashier was very friendly to my 9 year old daughter. The lemonade and the berrylicious lemonades were mouth wateringly delicious. My wife and I both got a Cheesy Pig. She with the french fries (yum!) and I with one of the delicious daily soups, which was chicken noodle. I mean reallllllly good. The hamburgers were absolutely delicious! Everything was fresh and local, including the fries. C'mon. You can't do better at above the price point. We did the Pair 2 and it was $9. The kids meal was $5 and included her drink. We will be back when we'r craving a fresh and delicious meal, that is for sure.

HOLY AMAZING. I love this place. Its huge, convenient, and healthy. They print your fat & calorie content right on the receipt which I personally find totally awesome and think every restaurant should be so clever and helpful. The whole menu looked bomb and our main man at the register was VERY helpful in narrowing it down to my delicious decision which was the seared ahi salad and chicken tortilla soup. Im sad I dont live in Santa Barbara, I'd probably eat here every day.

There are a ton of places to grab a bite in Santa Barbara.

We happened upon this place on our way to check out another place recommended by yelp for lunch. So sorry to the other place...

The menu boasts lots of healthy options. 

I tried a sandwich salad combo:

Mandarin crunch salad
Herb chicken sandwich
Strawberry lemonade 
Brookie (brownie and cookie combo)

Oh and chicken tortilla soup on the side boasted lots of chicken meat and black beans - I probably could have eaten the soup alone and been satisfied.

Food is good, service is good, ambience is contemporary and cute. 

I would recommend.

CJ

Smells good.  Looks good.   Price for what you actually get = poor.    Almost $30 for two salads that were largely constructed of iceberg lettuce.   Our cowboy salad was supposed to include jalapeño cheese and avocado.   Avocado was so small we could barely locate it.   Chicken was sinewy.  Another point that really hit us hard is the fact that if you decide to substitute chicken in place of Ahi, they still charge you the price of the Ahi, but also charge you for chicken ($4 extra for large salad).   I really have a hard time understanding why we still have to pay for Ahi when we aren't even asking for it in our salad.   If you substitute, I have no problem with paying a small surcharge, but don't make me pay for something that I'm not even eating.

The food was good, prices reasonable, and service friendly. I love that the food is healthful and still tasty. It's also great that Silvergreens lists out the nutritional info of the order on the receipt so that guests have full disclosure. I'd definitely go to this restaurant if they opened up a shop in the Bay Area.
I love this place, service is great, price of food is affordable, the food is tasty (yummmy), and healthy. I wish there was one in my city, I would eat here everyday.

My and I had an early dinner here. The food was pretty good, and the atmosphere was really nice and comfortable... I had the Mountain Climber which had just the right amount of spice. Nice balance! Wifey had the Crispy Cheeseburger, and the kids had grilled cheese sandwiches. Everyone enjoyed their meal. My Wife says they've recently changed their menu and it used to be better, but I thought it was decent for the price.
really love the friendly staff!! once you come in the restaurant, you're automatically greeted. on top of that you get great food for a great price!
Cheap food that is good for you. I had the crispy onion burger with two patties and it was great. I wish the serving size was bigger, but for the price and quality this place is excellent for lunch.
They have great servic, have great food and usually have plenty of spot to sit. Great place to have lunch, or spend an afternoon with family or friends.

I wish they would bring back their green fries (fried green beans)! But I guess it's not a healthy option.

This place is great for those who are counting calories but want a palpatable meal.  Their menu has so many options that you'll keep coming back.
Great restaurant delicious chicken sandwich wonderful to get it on Indy's six dollar burger week!

Veggie patty on a baked fresh daily by and a almond berry salad made a perfect meal.  The patty wasn't very flavorful but fresh, plant based and good for me! The salad was incredible with fresh strawberries and crisp greens with a great Erica portion of goat cheese.  Highly recommend this fasterant.

The 3 stars are for the service, the food was excellent.  I went to the downtown location for lunch today and it was the most uncomfortable experience.  I ordered from a very friendly lady who gave us great service, and that is where the great service ended.  We ordered and took a seat and then waited 25 minutes, no exaggeration, for our half of our sandwiches and our cups of soup.  Our receipt said 12:09 and at 12:35 we got our food.  The soup was room temperature, literally room temperature.  I have a feeling this happened because the woman who was running food to tables spilled an entire bowl of soup on a man's lap and literally could not care less.  Boiling hot soup all over one of the customers and she did not have any kind of urgency about the situation.  The customer who was covered in hot soup was not happy and made no bones about letting everyone know he was unhappy.  At no time did the woman who spilled on him go get the manager, or do anything to appease the situation.  The man ended up leaving he was so upset.  Then I hear the woman who spilled the soup talking about how "it wasn't her fault" to another table of customers and she dismissed his reaction.  Still waiting for our food and on our lunch break I started to stand up to see what the hold up was and our food came out by the same woman.  She offered no apology for the wait.  Luke warm soup, but a fantastic sandwich (I got the turkey, bacon, and avocado).  Two woman with children sat in our same section and got their food instantly much to my relief because their children were screaming and rolling around the booths.  Also the air-conditioning, or any kind of fan for air movement, was not on and it was uncomfortably hot.  The food was fantastic, that can't be stressed enough, super fresh ingredients and very well made.  The service of that woman really surprised me.  That man could have been seriously injured and at no point did she alert anyone.

Wow. Amazing service, very fast, friendly, and helpful. Food is incredibly solid, and a little mind-blowing considering the good price. Very satisfying meal overall, only made better by the fact that a portion of proceeds are donated to special needs organizations. Perfect for the socially conscious college student that doesn't want to sacrifice good food.

Soooooo good!!! I had the ahi tuna burger. The bread was delicious, fish was fresh and avocado topping was perfect. Cute little spot with fair prices. Needed a healthy meal after all the fatty meals on vacation besides the fries I added on this meal....delicious!!!! Def recommend.

I'm not sure if this place should still be calling itself Silvergreens since changing their menu. No more breakfast. No more pasta dishes. The display case that used to be full of goodies, isn't the same. The burgers are tasty. I do like the change in the soda brand. I just don't find myself going here as much anymore.

I thought I remembered coming here in college and thinking it was pretty delicious...? Our recent visit here, was not.  

I may have been expecting too much... but, I just felt that they were borderline "healthy" and really did NOT make a conscious effort to promote healthy living or portion control - no consideration.. especially for a place that's parading a "healthy/local/only the best ingredients" vibe. I was surprised to see all of (majority at the very least) their salads all had fried wontons in it and even when I went with the quinoa and kale salad with sesame oil it came with two GINORMOUS pieces of ciabatta garlic bread. WHY?!  There must have been 400 cal worth of quinoa, heavily dressed in sesame oil (250 cal?) .. very little kale and carrots and then with the heavily buttered garlic bread (500 cal?) that would have easily been 1200+ calories when I'm sure people are ordering this option on the menu to try to get something "healthy". Just rubbed me the wrong way and was not very good at all... but I guess this is a burger AND salad place... it's not sweetgreens which we've been spoiled by in LA.

yah!!  I love silvergreens and now they are downtown!  

They serve great tasting healthy food at a decent price.  I like how their receipts have trivia and the nutrition facts. 

Their pastas are only ok, I've tried the pesto chicken and it was sort of bland.  Today I had the ranch chicken sandwich on wheat and the garden salad with sesame dressing and it was great.  The wheat bread was super soft.  The croutons on the salad were crunchy, but not to the point of pain.  The cookie was on the greasy side and for 200 calories, I think I am going to try the fruit next time. 

This location is clean and conveniently located next to a parking lot but there is also ample street parking.  

Fast (but not in *that* sense of the word), healthy and yummy.  

Credit, cash all ok.  Lunch will run you about $10/per person.

This place is definitely worth visiting if you are shopping the day away in Santa Barbara.  The burgers were excellent, the french fries and ranch were delicious and the customer service was the best I have experienced in a long time.  I will most certainly come back here next time I am in Santa Barbara.

I kept hearing about this place, good and bad, so I finally tried it. I got a tuna melt because someone else's review here said it was good. It didn't taste like much of anything. Not fishy like tuna (which is good). But seriously, it didn't taste like anything. In fact, it really could have used some basic salt and pepper for flavor. I also had a wedge salad with balsamic. Again, not quite balanced right. I NEVER pepper my food but at this place, I wanted pepper. The crispy thai salad my husband had looked good and he said it was good, but the chicken was fried...hence crispy...which sort of defeats the purpose of making it seem like nutrition is important here. In fact, doesn't serving a cookie with my half & half also negate the impression that this place is health conscious? That alone won't turn me away, but food that doesn't taste good will. Between the lack of flavor and the 15 minute wait from the time I ordered to the time I got my food, I was not impressed and will not go back.

Every Cloud Really Does Have a 'Silver Greens' Lining 

If the recent rainy season has you running for cover, slip on into Silvergreens for a meal that is simply scrumptious! 

Though their prices will have you dishing out a few more dollars for a similar dining experience down the street, I can attest to Silvergreens' much hotter and fresher ingredients than their less costly competitors. 

I have now dined at Silvergreens twice and both times I enjoyed the appetizers and the ambiance immensely. I absolutely savored the Chicken Tortilla Soup and their colossal version of the Turkey Club which was thickly stacked with turkey, bean sprouts, tomatoes, lettuce, and bacon and comes complete with mayonnaise and mustard on the side. 

And not only that--Silvergreens REALLY DOES satisfy. From those hankering for a hamburger to those simply in search of soup and salad fare, "Silver's..." menu is chock full of everything from healthy "greens" to hearty beef and beyond. 

So, whether your wish is to stay green and lean or to bulk up by eating everything this eatery's menu mentions, you will doubtless be enchanted upon your exit.
it was very decent food. pice was fair just a little more than the usual dennies or ihop. food was good loved the burger

Awesome price, so many options, delicious, good portion, perfect for college students. Atmosphere is nice, the place is pretty big, never crowded. I've had almost everything on the menu and I don't have a favorite. I haven't tried the burgers but my dad has and he complained they were too small
wow!! amazing food great service and very fresh and healthy!! will come back .. i eat the quinoa salad and i loveeee it !!!
Fresh delicious food! Salads and sandwiches looked amazing! The ahi tuna salad had a generous amount of tuna and was very tasty.  Lots of patio seating!

Great place for a quick and healthy lunch/dinner. I saw an ad in our hotel guide book and decided to give them a try. I ordered their burger and my travel companion ordered a pasta dish. Both of us were quite satisfied with our plates and knowing how many calories we were consuming didn't leave us with a guilty conscience.If I lived in Santa Barbara (I'm in NorCal) I'd eat at this place quite often. It's very easy on the wallet and the dishes are pretty tasty, filling and not as expensive as other eateries in the area.
I love the quinoa and kale bowl and the edamame and hummus sandwich. Both are super delicious and I have a hard time ordering anything different, which I am sure everything is just as delicious.
Generally pretty good, but had a slightly disappointing crispy Thai chicken salad today. Not quite the value you'd get at south coast, at least as far as the salads go...

Anyone who rates this place below a 5 star; not sure what is your problem! This place is AWSOME! Food is great! It's Clean and Friendly!! What more do you want? And what a great location! 

LOVE THIS PLACE!!   YUM YUM!!!

One of my all time favorite places to pay money for food. You can order any of their burgers with a veggie burger (I usually just go for the classic Kyle), their salads are also dank, and if you're feeling fancy you can even get one of several yummy lemonades. And if you spend enough money here, their rewards program will give you a discount. THE BEST!!

I am a local and always love going to the SB Silvergreens. The food is good but the great thing is the people who work here. Always in a great mood and really make you feel welcome and wanting to come back for more. Will keep coming back.
Trying to eat healthy without breaking the bank? Go here! I love the soups mostly and the sandwiches are to die for. Calorie content and nutrition info prints on the receipt. Amazing!!!

Great place for healthy and tasty food served fast.  Reasonable prices, and serving format (you order at counter and pick up your own food) saves you on tips.  Staff is friendly and remembers you after only a few visits.  Also, they provide complete nutritional I for action for whatever it is you order right in your receipt...even if you mod your order from the standard way it is served.  I find this extremely helpful.  I wish more places would do it.

Milkshake turns la folks to this place ...fa sho la better than the rest ... Fa true it's better than la rest ... But no more improvising Kelis' hit song ... although they changed everything but the music once the chaos across the street... Hence... I'm very grateful as the chocolate covered strawberries are divine ... and the new menu ... Mm mm mmm

The chicken caesar salad was delicious as was the wheat roll that came with it.  My wife enjoyed her BBQ chicken salad as well.  It was an excellent meal near but away from the busy shops of the Paseo Nuevo Shopping Center on State street.  I would go back and try something else next time we visit Santa Barbara.

Brought a group of friends from L.A here, my first time since my original post; we had the breakfast burrito, waffles and the BBQ Chopped Chicken Salad.

They were all awesome.  This place has it covered, they're friendly and the food is healthy!

Feel free to bring your 'out of town' friends here anytime!

Enjoy
Delicious food! Yummy homemade bread. Great veggie burger! Very nice staff! Great price and wonderful cause.

Went here for a quick lunch with my mother while we were in town. The prices are more than reasonable and the food was delicious! I love that their portions are just right. I hate it when I can't finish what I have been given, but I did not have that issue here. I only had the ahi tuna salad which tasted great. I love their mission and definitely recommend if you're looking for a quick bite.

Meh, had high hopes but definitely was disappointed. We drove from Long Beach to Santa Barbara for a day trip and based on yelp reviews I thought we should have lunch here. We arrived at a time when they were serving both breakfast and lunch items so we got a little bit of both. 

The berry waffles were pretty unimpressive. Without the topping or syrup, the waffles tasted like cardboard. I also ordered the seared ahi salad. I'm not a big fan of sweet dressing and this one was drenched in sweetness. Guess that kind of ruined it for me. 
Looks like yelpers love this place but unfortunately, can't say that I would ever go back.

The food here is pretty damn good. Although, their fries are a little funky and everytime i get the ceaser salad the lettuce in it is all the hard light colored bottom pieces and it doesn't taste all that fresh. But anyways... the staff is SO FRIENDLY! It's a great place to go if you are on a time crunch!

$6 for a semi-deluxe burger and a beer.

Went at 6:30 for the deal and the place was packed! don't be dissuaded though, the wait was all of 10 mins until my food came.  I had the avocado, tomato, pesto burger and it hit the spot.

Next time i come here i'll be a little more adventurous because the food everyone else had looked amazing.

Enjoy

This is my go-to place when I need a spread for last minute staff lunch meetings (and planned too). The catering menu is so easy to order from and they have always been prompt at the pickup time. Everyone loves the quality of the sandwiches and cookies.  Fresh ingredients. Thank you for being you Silvergreens!

I've always loved Silvergreens but I had a vanilla milkshake for the first time today and they make THE BEST milkshake I've ever had.  I didn't want to keep drinking it because that meant it would be gone faster.  :)  THE BEST!!
Delicious food, awesome atmosphere and healthy yummy options!! Love all the orange inside too! We came here after our she is Beautiful run and it was perfect!
Great food, excellent service and friendly staff!  Will definitely visit often! Wonderful catering, chefs and more! Couldn't ask for better hospitality!

WOW. Just...wow. A totally unexpected little gem that I found through Yelp while searching for "vegetarian" Santa Barbara. True to my findings, there was plenty to eat for me as well as my omnivore girlfriend. They have soups, salads, burgers (black bean or angus beef), sandwiches, deserts, combos, and just about everything else.

First thing: upon walking in, it looks a bit like Corner Bakery or Panera's. You order at the counter, where all the menu items are clearly displayed and priced (there's also a little paper menu off to the left in the entry. My girlfriend was torn between getting the burger or the Thai chicken salad, but after I ordered the bean burger with avocado, sundried tomatoes, goat cheese, and pesto, she was drooling for something similar and ended up going with the original black bean burger. We got it 'combo' style, which came with our choice of sides (we both did fries) and a drink. The server was very nice, didn't give me a weird look about the black bean burger, and gave us our cups, receipts, etc. Everything about the ordering process was super welcoming and casual. It's not an elitist establishment catering to just locals, which is awesome as a traveler. :)

So the next best thing? Our receipt had the calories for our ENTIRE meal (including fries) on it! Mine was ~800 and my girlfriend's was ~750. Suuuuper awesome for those of us on the diet boat who are trying to make healthy but delicious decisions after a long day's hike on Anacapa Island. lol

We took a seat outside, but the place is HUGE on the inside, so plenty of seating is available. They even had a couple TVs on. AND free Wi-Fi, which is just...such an added bonus for me. Especially, again, as a traveler, I wish all places were this nice.

Now. About the FOOD. O.M.G. It was DELICIOUS!! Everything is made fresh, so it took maybe 15-20 mins to get it, but it was well worth the wait to enjoy Santa Barbara's beautiful weather and relax. They had given us a pager, so we got the food and scarfed it down. I literally licked my plate clean, but the portion sizes were huge! So I *could* have stopped after the first half of the sandwich. It was just so amazingly tasty that I didn't *want* to. hehe In fact, I would have finished my girlfriend's last few bites had I not been so unbelievably full.

The black bean burger is a tad spicy but not too overwhelmingly so. The only qualm I had about it was that it was mushy. However, I thought that would be a detriment to its flavor, and boy was I wrong. The avocado, goat cheese, tomatoes, and pesto sauce all complimented the flavors of the burger and just gave it a very good, flavorful taste. It's hard to describe. Oh, and the crunch of the spinach leaves? Just perfect! It was huge, but gods, I eat another again in an instant.

Cost-wise, well worth the money. It was $21 for two burger combos, so that seems normal to me. I'd pay about the same at Corner Bakery but I liked this experience and taste waaaay more.

One of my favorite places I've found so far in my travels! Will be coming here again the next time I go through Santa Barbara. Eat here and you won't be disappointed! :)

I was on my way to Los Angeles and was looking for a restaurant in St. Barbara. I came across Silvergreens on Yelp and straight away decided to try it. I went there quite early wanting to order the lunch menu, which was not served until 10.30 am. Even so, I decided to wait til 10.30, and the wait was WORTH IT!! I love their receipt too!! It shows how much cals/fat/sodium each dish has. I definitely recommend this restaurant!!

Silvergreens was definitely a great choice for a healthy meal. Right in the heart of downtown Santa Barbara with plenty of outdoor seating and wonderful service! The cashier recommended their oreo milkshake and it was just as good as he described. My mandarin crunch salad was delicious and giant, just wish I would have ordered a double order of chicken since my salad was so big just wish I would have had more protein. The mint iced tea is delicious, so many choices at this great establishment!

This place advertises as if their methods are superior to other burger joints. I don't see a reason to go here over another burger place in the area. I ordered the Klassic Kyle with grilled onions. The bun was actually quite good and is often a detail that is forgotten. It lives up to a true Brioche name. Of course a burger is enjoyed with fries and they were well below expectations. They say their fries are fresh, hand-cut, and double fried. My order seemed like the fries had been under heat lamps, sitting and waiting to be ordered. They did not taste fresh. We also ended up with smaller cuts of fries, the kind that usually ends up at the bottom of a frozen bag of fries. Overall, this restaurant seems like it's a lot of talk but not a lot to show for it.

I have eaten here a couple times now.  The food is excellent and I have always experienced excellent customer service.  For lunch one time I tried the tuna melt (awesome) and had a really good mint green tea.  Today I had a breakfast burrito.  The breakfast burrito was delicious.  It wasn't greasy and came in a wheat tortilla.  I loved it.

We went to Silvergreens because of the raving reviews on Yelp. But I am sad to say our experience was far less than wonderful.

Pros: Yes, the nutrition facts and trivia on the receipt were interesting and relevant - definitely a good idea. There was a couch like seating area in front of the menu so we could sit comfortably while we made our choice. They have what appears to be a good kid-friendly menu. They offer different options for side dishes and drinks (with a sandwich or burger) such as fruit salad, macaroni and cheese and for drinks (for an extra charge) a berry lemonade (+$1) or shake (+$2) . The french fries were fairly tasty.

Cons: The food was just plain not good. Granted I did not try the items that other people on Yelp have said were good. I had a cheeseburger, fruit salad, french fries, and a strawberry-peach Bellini. Outside of the fries, none of it was good. The burger was over cooked, dry, and bland. I could tell that right away from the first bite and quite frankly, I didn't seem like it would be tasty even had it been prepared well. The fruit salad was made of lots of tiny bits of fruit. Some of the bits were bland, others were somewhat tasty, but they were too small to get a big yummy bite of watermelon, cantaloupe, or pineapple. The Bellini was just plain bad - the flavor was not good and it tasted boozy even though after drinking it I felt no alcoholic effect. Service was ok, the cashier was very new, so we definitely can cut him slack, but none of his coworkers seemed interested in helping him even though he was clearly struggling to enter our order. The seating was not great in that the restaurant gets almost zero sun during the mid day hours which was a shame because it was a gorgeous day in SB.

Overall: Based on my experience, especially the non-tasty food, I do not recommend this restaurant. If you do go, don't get a burger or Bellini. I hope they either figure out how to make a decent burger or remove it from the menu.

I LOOOVVEEE SIILLVVEERRGGRREENNSS! love love love it! i just can't get enough. everytime i go...and i go often...i try something new and am amazed!

most recently i took my dad, mom and family friend who were visiting me in santa barbara. i ordered the "threesome" and got half the turkey sandwich, garden salad and a cup of their tortilla soup. that soup is to DIE FOR! its so freakin' delicious and nutritious.

my parents come up to visit me every once in a while from LA and they love going here and the NUTRITION INFO they print on your receipt! its so fun to see and find out what your eating. i feel like a more insightful customer and really appreciate that they do that. 

i love silvergreens and you will to! try it!
Great sandwiches.  We have had some of their pre-made sandwiches in delis around town at other locations and they don't compare to the freshly made ones at Silvergreens.  Yummy!!!

This is my absolutely favorite in Santa Barbara. I've never been to the IV location, but this one is fantastic. I've been eating here since they opened, and even though I live in Ventura, I always stop here when I'm in town. Food that feels good, both for the belly and the soul. Seared ahi salad and the burgers are to die for. Tomato basil soup, chocolate chip cookies..get extras.

me and silvergreens go waaay back.  back to 1998/1999 when they first opened in iv.  aaaahhh...the memories. :)

now that i'm all grown up and and moved out of iv, i was pleasantly surprised when i found out that silvergreens opened a second location in sb.  i come here to pick up lunch at least twice a week.  todd, one of the managers during the weekday afternoon shift, is always so friendly and has SUPERB customer service.  give that guy a raise!  

my hubby and i stopped by to grab a quick bite on christmas eve, not realizing that they were closing early.  in fact, they had already closed a few minutes before we got there.  todd was at the register and told us that they were closed.  as we were about to turn and leave, todd said that he would go ahead and take our order anyway. stoked.

my usual order is the blta with a cesar salad (or fries if i feel like living dangerously). their fries are yummy. oh, and so is the potato white cheddar soup...especially on a cold rainy day. the burgers are a hit or miss...i guess it depends on who's cooking that day. but when it's good, it's GOOD.

love love LOVE silvergreens!

ANY Burger & Beer for $6 after 3pm - we did this deal.  This is the BEST BURGER I've had in California.  Wish there was a Silvergreens in West LA.  Fresh options abound and yummy burgers are freshly made.  Excellent, Excellent Burger Spot!  And what a deal!

Food and staff are great. The health angle this place strive for is great to see. They even have Paleo Recommendations on their site, AWESOME. Just hoping the food is organic and raised with kindness. So, Not sure if it's Sustainable, Organic or Local. Probably not a cooperative of any sort and no sign of accepting alternative currencies. The search continues. :)

I loved the cucumber lemonade.  The rest off my meal was just too spicy hot.  I ordered the Santa Barbara bowl.  I took two bites and realized my bowl was filled with diced, hot, green chiles--ouch!  The heat from the chiles completely overpowered the rest of the flavors of the meal. I'm OK with zesty, but I don't like hot spicy.  It would really be helpful if they clearly labeled certain menu items as spicy, because I missed reading that when I skimmed the menu.  Another member of my party said the burger was bland.  This venue just didn't workout for us on this day.

The service was so mind boggling slow. Like I honestly could have probably gotten a full night of sleep, taken a plane to Japan, walked across the ocean, and taken a massive dump by the time they finished our group's food.

I'm very disappointed with my experience here. I tried it a previous time and loved it soooo much. I was so excited to come back and try it, I even brought friends that had never been before because I liked this place so much, so we hopped in the car and drove an hour to Santa Barbara to eat there. The place was not packed by any means however it took them 40 minutes to bring out the first plate. Then 10 minutes later, an employee came out to let me know they ran out of veggie patties - okay, that's totally fine, I'll live... But I don't understand how it took the cooks 40 minutes to figure out they were out of veggie patties. 

So I ordered the edamame hummus instead, okay life goes on....I'm chillin. (Spoiler alert: the sandwich was really sad, bland, and gross)

Then 10 minutes after that the same employee came up to our table and let my friend know that they can't "double up" his veggie burger because they only have one patty left. 

So she told me 10 minutes prior that there were none left and now magically one has appeared? Mind you, I placed my order a solid 5 minutes before my friend did. So why they started making his food before mine or how one veggie patty magically appeared for his? Idk I'm not a magician, I couldn't tell you. 

Silver Greens get your act together because I totally believe you can do better but this experience made me soooo sad.
Love this place, i come here every if weeks to get my favorite sale, The El Captian Salad, Really good salads. The workers are very friendly. Amazing menu, very healthy. Great place to come and eat.

Rating 4 stars because even though the burger is amazing with amazing prices, the chairs don't look like it's wiped as much. Burger is similar size from a $1 menu McDonald's burger. TV is off during opening hours unless it's supposed to be another menu screen. It's baseball season & right now it's the Fifa tournaments. Something to bring in for fans. But burger taste, price, & service is amazing.

Expensive for what you're getting if you order what you want instead of one of their deals like burger and a beer, and they're not much for extras...it runs about 15 bucks for nothing more than a soda (1.89), small cup of soup (3.79), and a sandwich (8.79) plopped on an otherwise empty plate...and they don't even have waitstaff. The taste is better than average but they could work on the presentation and quantities...I've left there still hungry but not wanting to shell out $4 for a small cup of soup. When I want to pay 150% of what I would at a comparable place, I like their turkey/bacon/avocado sandwich and white potato cheddar soup. (Pricing is pretty wonky when you compare that $15 for an a la carte meal with a cold sandwich and self-serve soda to $8 for a hot pepper jack bacon burger, a beer, and a side of fries.)

They have wireless internet and an ok place to work, which makes the cost easier to swallow when I'll be spending some time there. They print nutrition facts and a coupon on the receipt which is nice, though coupon is only good for a few days so it's practically useless. Will go back but only as a second or third choice.

Bottom Line:  This place wasn't bad but has a lot of unrealized potential

     We ordered a few sandwiches and drinks and sat outside and ate.  The sandwiches werent bad but the bread was kind of sad and the fries were barely warm and pretty soggy as if they have been sitting around for awhile.

   I liked this place over all but you can see how it could be much better on a good day - I think we were just there on an off day.  We will have to head back and give it another go

My family and I dined here on a relatively slow Wednesday afternoon. The location is a block away from the 'main street' of downtown, but wasn't difficult to find at all. Quiet because it was a weekday, but still filled enough that there was a pleasant buzz of conversation in the air. The menu was easy to read. We ordered the Klassic Kyle, Mountain Climber, some seasonal special that had avocados (and was delicious!!!) and the Kyle's Cobb salad in a large. 

The Pair It! option that adds a soup / salad / fries + drink was a fantastic choice, and we had more food than we knew what to do with by the end. The fries were crispy and just the right thickness. The burgers were a tad too thick to eat comfortably, but hey, I'm just digging for something vaguely critical to say. The salad was fresh and flavorful, and with the vinaigrette, was just right. 

The price is on par with what I was served. Excellent food, clean establishment, great service. I hope to be able to return soon!
Delicious food and huge selection. Pleasant atmosphere and bright interior. High quality and fast service. Very kind and friendly staff.

Horrible cashier service. Great food. I told Martin three times I wanted a drink. I asked for my cup after ordering and he gave me attitude saying he asked me three times and I said no. He then charged me for the drink. Also, when asked to split an order, please do so. We made it very clear while ordering. Shouldn't the customer always be right? Other service was great and food was awesome!

Fast service and good tasting salads. Ordered a full Turkey, Feta, and pomegranate. Fresh and delicious. Wife ordered a half-half meal soup and salad. She enjoyed her yellow split pea soup and farmer garden salad. Not from the area so really enjoy good food from a local place. Would stop here again.

I tried this place last week and I have been back almost every day since then. They have the best fresh food especially their salads! Their lemonade flavors are delicious. And they put love in their to go orders too. Definitely recommend this place.
Food you don't have to feel guilty about.  Favorites: pineapple and shrimp bowl, ahi salad, and their breakfast sandwiches and hash browns are so perfect for the morning.
Had the Cream of Broccoli soup. I liked this place because of the great deal of focus on health!

I ordered chicken tenders on my lunch break. When I arrived back at work I noticed my tenders were burned. I then realized I would not have time to make it back before my lunch was over. I then called and spoke with the manager Michelle. The manager was extremely polite and nice. I told her I was upset due to my chicken tenders being burnt and I was unable to return that day. Michelle went above and beyond asking me to text a picture so she could inform the staff of the mistake and make appropriate corrects so it would not happen again. Then on top of that, she offered me a meal on the house next time I returned. Then I ordered a Cesar salad and it was delicious as is everything offered on the menu.

Delicious and great prices. Every time you buy something, on your receipt you might get a free cookie or a discount off your food if you purchase something at a certain time. When I was a student in Santa Barbara, I ate here at least once a week (in reality I probably ate here at least three times a week). Only once in the whole time I went to Silvergreen's, I've dealt with an unfriendly staff member. Thankfully I never encountered them again but all the other staff I've encountered there are friendly and helpful. The fries are delicious and their sandwiches are superb. I've tried various sandwich shops in SB and Silvergreen's is still my favorite place to go for fresh (non-toasted) sandwiches.
If you want sort-of healthy food and want to make a quick stop, this place is alright. Nothing special, but the food was decent for the price.

Paired a California Club burger with the summer BBQ salad and it was the bomb. My GF had the Turkey Bacon Avocado sandwich with a shrimp and avocado sandwich and loved it. Their lemonades are also ridiculously good! Food was delivered by the time we found a place to sit. This place is truly a gem.

Came here today after visiting the zoo. wife yelped it and here we came.  ordered the pesto fucilli with chicken.  the pasta was very good as well as the chicken, although the chicken seemed a bit dry (probably cause its natural and not that hormone induced stuff)  !!

wife had the seared ahi tina salad, looked good and tasted better.  we also a side of their cheese fries; they came with a green tangy pestoish dip which I enjoyed.  the fries are mixed with some garlic and onion bits too (they also have ketchup bottles for you traditionalists).  

my lemonade tasted fresh and most welcome on this beautiful Santa Barbara day.  PS: eating outside is nice, buts cools your food a tad taster.  will definitely be back.

This place is great. The food was really good. I had the chicken club on a lettuce wrap with the jalapeño fries and it was delicious. My wife had the quinoa salad and enjoyed it as well and my kids had the kids burger and grilled cheese. The prices were very reasonable and a portion of the proceeds go to help local organizations that assist people with special needs! Love food with a cause. The fries are no joke. I got a whole jalapeño in one bite and it knocked me off my rocker for a few minutes. They have good lemonade too and the location is great. We will hopefully be back.

breaks my heart when a cherished eatery gets so bad. ever since the place got new owners and the menu changed it has been one badmeal after the other and finally i will not return. ijust ordered the mandarin salad with shrimp. the only thing edible was the shrimp. salad was super salty. the roll was soaked il oil.
We loved it. Our kids loved it. This is a new concept in fast food. Fresh interesting salads. Great organic burgers. A  simple selection of tasty wine. And a wall the kids can draw on - brilliant!

I really like the Santa Barbara location, love the mission and the purpose AND the food is good.
Well I have only had the tuna salad- AND it was really good.
The only reason I am giving it four stars and not 5 is because of my last time in.  It was odd, I called to place an order for pick up, and I was almost turned away because they wanted me to order through an app.  Now I consider myself very tech savvy and love the idea of app ordering (and I also am a part of their membership club so it's def a benefit too), however I was in such a rush and it just seemed as if this was bad customer service to turn me away.
I challenged the gentleman on the phone with 'you mean I am calling and you will not take my order' I said politely.  He obliged noting that he would do it this time- so kudos for him for turning the situation around, I just wished I didn't have to push.
I know I'll go back, just thought that situation could be better.
Also they accept Axxess- which means buy one, get one OR 10% off each time- so that is a bonus.
They have changed their concept / food /  Everything Tasty and good!

Had lunch here for the first time. Our fries were cold and my salad was okay. The burger and the bacon was great! Might try something else next time.... the place has a great atmosphere and it was really nice inside. Staff was also friendly and helpful.

Very pleasant, very fast service with fresh and tasty food. Lots of healthy, somewhat vegetarian-friendly options. We each got full portion salads; my husband's ahi salad was well-worth the price but I was surprised at how small and with minimal chicken (no good vegetarian protein options, meh), my Summer BBQ salad was for almost the same price. Dressings were made from scratch and savory. Lots of sandwich and side options that were all very tempting; however, mac 'n' cheese was sub-par; wouldn't recommend. Very flavorless cheese and the macaroni itself was overcooked and slightly mushy. 

Regardless, it was a refreshing, quaint but no-nonsense welcoming dinner spot in the heart of downtown Santa Barbara.

Healthy and delicious food for great price.
Definitely the place for casual but to eat.

I come to eat here about twice a month, mostly for lunch.  Every time the staff is super friendly and the food very good.  Not sure why some have had problems with food quality or server attitude - I never had any issues.  I usually sit outside on their great sidewalk patio.
Very good sandwiches. I tried the Tri tip sandwich & the green bean fries so good! Love the jalapeño ranch as well. I also like how they list nutrition details  on the receipt

New Location downtown for those who miss the IV hot spot. 

So most have their personal favorites from this place: Green Apple Salad, Chicken Tortilla Soup, the good 'ol half and half... whatever fills your fancy, Sivergreens will surely do it right. 

And to top off the greatness of the IV location, the DTSB location has gone green and gives you nutritional values, tips, and tricks on your reciept based on what you order. 

Go Rocha!

Stopped by Santa Barbara for daughter's UCSB orientation. Didn't expect this place to be this good. I thought places that serve burgers are usually not very good in food quality, but everything looked and tasted good. Great food and great service.
Good prices, great food. A laid back Burger joint were you can enjoy a good burger and remember that a part of the proceeds go to a good cause too.

Really good restaurant. One of the best in Santa Barbara. Hands-down they serve GREAT food!  It is very fresh. Plus, they gave a good cross section of choices. And, they have very reasonable prices. 

This restaurant has both indoor and outdoor seating. The tables and booths are well-spaced and the atmosphere (both inside and out) is open and airy. 

They serve both beer and wine. They have a nice selection of local wines and microbrewery brews, plus some very good non-alcohol based drinks. 

There is a couple of things to keep in mind about this restaurant, however. Depending on who's at the helm, taking orders, this can really effect your initial experience here. Some staff are very good, some not. Meaning some take a lot of time to do a simple job. I have experience both, so you may experience an unnecessary wait to order. The other thing to think about is that they just have one restroom for men and one for women. These restrooms are often occupied by the locals who sneak in though the side door to use it, so there may be a line. 

Overall, Silvergreens is one of SB's best casual dining experiences.

The food is savory and of course healthy!

Silvergreens has mastered the healthy eating concept!

You cant go wring with any selection!

I actually think this place is expensive due to the itemization of things such as french fries!  C'mon $3. (+)  for french fries that are small insubstantial pieces of fries!  The only thing it left me craving was real french fries!!  Food is "okay" but nothing that I will remotely remember.  This place is WAY overrated and really not that healthy if you look further into the menu items.  For myself and several other of my "foodie" friends and acquaintances I have talked with, this is another example of "expensive mediocrity" in Santa Barbara disguised to look inexpensive.
While camping out for sneakers for 2.5 days, I was referred to this spot by a fellow camper.  A bit pricey but the food was pretty good. Would most def take the wife & kids.

Good food. Had the classic burger with a veggie patty and the Mediterranean salad. I'd give both 4 stars as they were good, but not terribly innovative or something unique. Fries were yummy and service was really excellent.

If u r into healthy eating and knowing what u are putting in your mouth, this is the place for u. It was my first time, had a half Seared Ahi Tuna Salad with mint green iced tea. The half portion was just big enough to satisfy and not put me in a food coma after lunch. And the pricing was very satisfactory. Check it out!

The ceiling was leaking onto our food. the dressing for the ahi salad was not my favorite. My companions were also very disappointed in their selections, the turkey and the hummus sandwiches. The frozen yogurt was tasteless and runny. The price was right, but I will not be going back there.

Service was absolutely horrible, whole staff was unprofessional and took there job as a joke. The food took more thank 20 min to come out then they told me they didn't have fries so i had to wait for another ten minutes. Save your time and money and go somewhere else

My boyfriend and I went to Santa Barbara and were originally planning to eat at Opal on State Street for lunch, but were denied service because we happened to walk in at that odd time of the day between lunch and dinner, which was a bummer. After looking up a few nearby places on Yelp, we both agreed on Silvergreens, which was a few blocks of walking away.

I was a bit let down because I had my heart set on fine dining, but Silvergreens was a pleasant surprise. I was a little confused when we first walked in, having never been there before. I wasn't sure if it was restaurant-style or Panera-esque in that you order and pay at the counter and once it's made it's brought to you. It was the latter.

I wish I'd gotten the name of the guy who helped us because he was incredibly patient and friendly with us. The menu took a minute to decipher. The pricing is meant to be easy to understand, but with the various extra charges for customisation, it gets convoluted.

I ordered the Earth Burger (handmade organic veggie patty, crushed avocado, arugula, caramelized onions, sprouts, tomatoes, garlic aioli, wheat bun) coupled with a small Farmhouse Salad (field greens, tomatoes, cucumbers, carrots, croutons, garbanzo beans, sprouts, pepitas, dressing) for the $9 "Pair it!" promotion. BF ordered a large Kyle's Kobb salad (field greens, bleu cheese, hardwood smoked bacon, hardboiled egg, avocado, tomatoes, dressing, roll) with chicken ($9), Fire Fries (fries and crispy onions, pepperjack cheese, jalapeños, jalapeño ranch; $4.50), and a pint of 805 ($5).

The wait for food was about fifteen minutes. I didn't take a picture of my burger to post because I was starving by the time our food arrived and scarfed it down. I can confidently say that despite my hunger, the Earth Burger patty is hands down the best veggie patty I've ever eaten. I've been a vegetarian for more than half of my life and tried countless variations. I assumed that what I'd be getting would be a run-of-the-mill Garden Burger imitation. The menu had said it was a handmade patty, but so many places take liberties with their descriptions that I figured it would be the same old thing. Let me tell you, I've been thinking about that patty all week. I loved it, my boyfriend loved it. It was incredibly flavourful with a not-too-crumbly texture. Imagine a cartoon chef with a curly moustache kissing his fingertips... c'est magnifique!

My salad was nothing special. It needed more dressing, but the croutons were tasty. Boyfriend really liked his. You can see from my photo that they don't skimp on the fixins. The Fire Fries were awesome. I wish I could handle spicy stuff because I was taking baby dips of the dressing that came with it. Definitely eating here again next time I'm in SB. I wish them success so they can spread to other cities that are closer!

We found this eatery purely by chance.  The restaurant of choice was closed for lunch due to Solstice.  After frantically looking for plan B on Yelp, we were on our way to plan B when I saw the Silvergreens sign.  Glad we took a chance.  Everything was yummy - Edamame Hummus Plate, Orange Miso Shrimp & Avo Salad (generous amount of shrimp & avo), Chimichurri Tri-Tip Sandwich (gigantic), and Sparkling Cucumber Mint (refreshing drink).  An added bonus is outside seating for your furry kids.  Would eat here again in a heartbeat.

Usually have great experience here. But the manager on duty when I went this Tuesday night was dressed very unprofessionally (spaghetti strap BACKLESS flowy shirt). Sets a weird mood...not approachable or professional.
Awesome food, fresh and simply delicious!  From salads to burgers you can't go wrong with this place. Staff is very friendly and attentive! Will be back!

Pretty damn good.

Sandwiches are huge.  Pastas are small.  They are trying the health movement thing.  As such, they print out all your calorie/nutritional information for your order on your receipt.  May be good or bad.  

Open really late, which is great!

I always find myself on the opposite side of the State-Street "corridor" (where my gym happens to be). 

So you can only imagine how glad I was to be introduced to Silvergreens. 

The steak/avo was amazing, as was the burger, and the receipts even tell me my ACTUAL nutritional values for my order! 

If you are looking to eat "healthy" and still actually feel like you've "eaten" something, go to Silvergreens after your workout for a casual bite. You won't be sorry and you can even sit outside and people watch. 

PS: if you see a brindle french bulldog named Thizzelle sprint by and head for the mall, grab it. adorable photo opportunity AND the nice girl Thizzelle belongs to will be coming by shortly after.

Food poisoning in the making. I've have come here for years...since they have opened actually. Last time I was here they just didn't cook my red meat...it was fully RAW. Also, they took 15-20 minutes to give my my food, which was understandable as there was a long line. What is not okay is to serve RAW meat to your customers. You had 20 minutes to prep my meal...that tiny patty takes at most 3-4 minutes to cook. Also, at Kyle's Kitchen I always receive a good amount of avocado on my burger. Here...my avocado was so tiny I could barely see it on my bun...let alone taste it. Very disappointed, and now fear coming back to this establishment. Such a shame. Obviously, can't come back to Kyle's either, as it is the same business.
Delicious, natural food! I had the bacon and egg burger and it was amazing. The fries weren't the best, a little chewy? And the restrooms aren't that great. But other than that it was really good!
This is a great spot for a casual bite. High quality food made quickly, at an affordable price, with a superb finished look in a clean, fun atmosphere.
The burger and beer for $6 is a great deal. our burgers tasted like it was off the backyard grill.

I recently rediscovered this old favorite and was very impressed.  The mandarin crunch salad is great and I've returned twice to get the same dish.  My kid got the mac and cheese and I ate most of it....also good.

For a place that claims to be "healthy", I am completely disappointed with Silvergreens. Talk about "guilt-filled eating"!!! I go here thinking it is a healthy option, and upon getting my receipt, which prints out the nutrition facts, learn that my salad and smoothie end up at over 1200 calories and 40 grams of fat. OK...that was not my intention...
While I am not a health nut, the result of acknowledging what was in what I was eating led to much less enjoyment of the food. On top of that, the preparation was mediocre at best, the presentation was horrific, and the taste was borderline decent, with all "guilt" put aside. My recommendation, try out somewhere that really does care about what is in their food, rather than a place that thinks that saying they are healthy and printing out their nutrition makes them healthy. I guarantee you, with the numbers that rolled out on my meal, you could eat almost anywhere in town for the same caloric/fat/sodium intake...with a lot more satisfaction and a much better prepared meal.

Um. Wow. We just read a yelp review because we wanted a coffee shop with wifi, and then we saw this online. We went here and WOOOOOOW!!!! Okay honestly the best overall restaurant experience I have had in god knows how long. Awesome customer service, only $6 for a GOOOOOOD burger and a beer! What? And wifi? And it's cute inside too with christmas lights? And its green! It blows my mind. Oh, and I got coupons now too.

Stopped here for lunch with the family after doing some shopping in downtown. The lunch menu has plenty of favorites and some slightly more adventurous options. I had a bacon bleu cheeseburger in a lettuce wrap and it was juicy, flavorful, and the lettuce was correctly cut to make a nice wrap.

My companion had the 1/2 & 1/2 deal with soup and a 1/2 sandwich, both of which were tasty and fresh.

I would highly recommend this place for lunch!
Great service food was outstanding fresh baked cookies are the BOMB!!!  I come here every week and will continue coming
Loved this place while in Santa Barbara! Friendly people, great food and excellent prices.
Pretty good. The soda's taste pretty weird. It has a fast-food feel which is a turn off-- but otherwise the food was pretty good!
Fantastic burgers! I recommend the firefighter 100%!!! Great service and reasonable prices. Great scenery aswell!

Came to Santa Barbara on a whim and found this place on yelp. Glad we opted to eat here. This place is great and wish they had one locally. It was hard to narrow down our choices. I went with the seared ahi tuna salad and mac and cheese. The bf ordered the pesto chicken sandwich on sourdough w/ fries, plus he got a free chocolate chip cookie to go along with his meal. We completely engulfed everything! It was that good! No complaints at all. The prices are ok but worth every penny.

My experience was not that great, but I will start with the positives. The spot has a great location, great design, and a pretty relaxed atmosphere that matches the healthy cuisine offered. The staff was very friendly and helpful with my order. But the rest just wasn't delivered. I waited at least 30 minutes until one of our party members were told that the veggie burger they had ordered was out and that they had to order something else. I had also ordered the veggie burger but thought maybe my order was put in first. So another 10 minutes pass and the same employee tells me that the double veggie burger I had ordered could only be made with one patty because they were out. My long awaited veggie burger was hardly worth the wait, lacking in flavor and being a little below room temperature. Being a sous chef and long term employee in the food service industry, I understand that there's slip ups here and there. But there's some key standards that were not met here: consistency, communication, and food quality. I hope this review helps to avoid future experiences from being like mine was.
Good food great service. They have outdoor seating and lemonade a are good. Always come here when I'm working in Santa Barbara.

First time but definitely not my last. Menus is super easy to navigate! Outside and inside seating available. The cashier Blanca was super friendly giving multiple suggestions since I let her know it was my first time. Santa Barbara Tri tip sandwich super taste I got the full not the half. Strawberry smoothly was delicious. Over all really good good REAL FOOD!
This is one of my favorite places in SB. It's affordable with the the pick 2 $9.50 and beer $6 burger fries beer under $16 in SB. It's delicious! My wife loves the veggie burger!

Met up with some childhood chums in SB and we went here for dinner. None of us had been before, and we all liked it. I liked that there was something for everyone on the menu and it was helpful to be able to order at a counter and be able to pay for our own stuff instead of having to worry about having 5 of us try to split a check. I also loved that there was a lot of room to sit. We ended up having a back room all to ourselves, which was awesome since we had years of catching up to do! I wouldn't say the food blew my mind, but it was good, solid food and the atmosphere was great. We had a great time!

I have and always will be a huge fan of Silvergreens. From the moment I first moved to santa barbara (IV) for school, I was obsessed with their delicious sandwiches and soups and their very addictive garlic fries and orgasmic orange freeze drinks. When the downtown santa barbara location opened up I was overjoyed! Plus I have SB Axxess which is a buy one get one free meal. The customer service is amazing here and downtown it is always the same guys that are so friendly and cheerful. From the moment you walk in the door you are greeted with kindness and great suggestions. I enjoy ordering the "3 some" it is delicious and very feeling. 

They have the BEST potato cheddar soup EVER!!!!

this is just an update and response to the manager's reply.  We have come back, this past visit was our return.  so within 1 year, you've hired the wrong people clearly.  your portions have shrunk by about 1/3 the size on your meat servings, and prices are higher.  your portions all around were sad.  especially the crazy amount of money we were charged for a FEW pieces of barely ripe fruit.  over the years your food and portions and prices were amazing. now, frankly, they just suck.  with all of the amazing competition that is within sight and a brief walk from your doorstep, one would think you'ld have bettered your menu, portions and prices, but you went the opposite direction.  those types of actions are what lead to a business closing their doors.  I live VERY close by and have watched the amount  of customers decline.  There's a reason for that.  If we went to a restaurant on the basis of friendly staff and LOADS of room to sit, you would win....but no one does that.  Also, a suggestion, when you charge someone $3 for fresh fruit side, do not give them 3, 4 pieces of fruit in a sample cup....

Tried the basic Kyle burger: $5:50.  Great taste, good bun, nice fixins. It's as good as some 11$ burgers I've had. And BETTER... since it's just the size for a small lunch.  If you want more...buy 2.  I'll be back for more tasty burgers.

I love this place! On any other occasion this place would receive 5 stars from me but I made an order today that I wasn't completely satisfied with. I ordered the chipotle turkey sandwich and a side of fries to go. When I got home and went to eat the sandwich, the chipotle sauce was oozing out of the sides of the sandwich. It was so messy and I was so disappointed! I was literally wiping sauce off the sandwich.

This incidence won't keep me from coming back here, but I've noticed the owner (or manager) is really on top of the yelp reviews so hopefully this gets resolved with the cooks! 

Oh, and service is always on point too. They're so personable here!

Worst restaurant ever.  I had a kale and quinoa bowl that was so laden with too mush sesame oil I couldn't gag it down.  Way too salty.  They need to look at the salt content of their dishes.  I took 3 bites and had to ask for my money back

Popular local hang out. Healthy menu, usually pretty busy. My girlfriend loves the salads. The shakes, iced tea and cucumber drink are amazing. I think that the bread rolls are pretty and look delicious but they are actually extremely dry so I just look at them. I usually order the chicken sandwich but the chicken is cut very thin and also seems somewhat dry to me but I go because she likes it. Not a bad place just not a favorite

We stopped by for lunch and enjoyed out meal on the patio. I wasn't crazy about some of the food but it is a nice casual spot with plenty of indoor and outdoor seating, great service, and lots of food options. We had the seared ahi tuna salad ($10.50) which looks very popular on yelp and it was good. We also had the chimchurri tri-tip sandwich ($9.75) which was a great blend of flavors and the beef was flavorful but soft. However there are a lot of jalepanoes on it which made it spicy. This was probably my favorite dish although others may have preferred the ahi salad. We also tried the kale sesame quinoa. I was really disappointed with this dish, mainly because it was so darn greasy. I wanted something light and "healthy" and all of the ingredients are but the preparation totally killed it. We also tried the potato leak soup which was also very tasty. 

This is a casual spot. Order at the counter and they being the food out to you. Awesome staff. They brought our little one a cookie while we were outside and it totally made his day. 

Overall this is a good spot for lunch. Avoid the kale sesame quinoa. Aside from that, I would definitely recommend this place.

I'm an addict now. Anytime i pass by Santa Barbara i need to stop in. Everything is fresh and tastes fantastic. I have yet to taste the oh-so-mentioned-heavily breakfast burritos, but I will someday! It is quite pricey for what you get, however, the fact that everything is organic and fresh probably drives up the price. I love the caloric intake printed out on the receipt. Interesting piece of information there. I think if everyone did that, wow. Never mind - skip that part. A definite visit on any chance I happen to pass by.

Great place to stop for a quick bite. The food is good for what it is, and they have a nice selection of healthy items on the menu. It's clean and the staff is friendly. The one thing is they always seem to forget one thing, it's kind of uncanny. Every time I go one thing is missed. Either a cup for your drink, a cookie one ordered, or that extra bit of bread...you get the idea. Minor thing, but still.

Silvergreens is my favorite place to eat in Santa Barbara by far. The service is fast and the employees are friendly. My cashier even gave me a free drink!
I recommend the Seared Ahi Tuna Salad, I get it almost every time. It's fresh and the dressing is fantastic. For breakfast I suggest getting one of their breakfast burritos.
The atmosphere is uplifting and colorful and the food is healthy, the receipt even prints out the nutritional value of your meal for you and has coupons for nearby places on the back. Silvergreens is a definite go-to place around here.
Expected more based on Google/yelp reviews. Tahini salad was pretty bad, wish I would have sent it back actually. Good service, good portions. Open late.
Tasty food! Our food was ready in about 5 minutes. I ordered lemonade with my vegetable burger and it was delicious! Highly recommend the pair it deal

On one of the final days where meat was still a part of my regular dietary element, after a long stroll under the summer sun, enjoying a good old burger and an ice cold one was my one and only goal for the day.

Being a die hard yelp person, of course I would not step onto any premises before venting the place thoroughly. Kyle's kitchen got some great reviews, from locals, college students, and tourist alike. Okay, I guess I will have my hunger fulfilled right here. 

Lucky as I was, caught their afternoon happy hour. Sitting on the high chair, along the breathy outdoor patio, watching people walking by. That would make a good relaxing vacation happy, and then the meal came. It is just so appealing, the shoe string onion fries, the fresh green avocado. The whole combination brought a well formed smile to my sun kissed face. 

The food is yum.

Kudos to the next door nail salon lady, bright eyed and bushy tailed, standing by the side walk to welcome customers

My husband and I ate at Kyle's for lunch (our first time) during our travel to Santa Barbara. The staff was lovely and the food was really good. I ate the Thai salad with chicken with strawberry lemonade, and my husband ordered a burger, fries, and beer. The food was tasty and we enjoyed the atmosphere. We were happy to learn that Kyle's supports people with disabilities by helping them find meaningful work - brilliant! Great work, Kyle's! I wish we had one in Santa Cruz.

Looking for a place for lunch and we stumbled across this place.  Great food and clean restaurant!  I had the steak sandwich and it was very tasty.  Ingredients were fresh and the receipt with nutritional info was very helpful.  Will definitely come back when I'm in the area!

I absolutely LOVE this place!!
The price is very reasonable and the food was so good.
Their stubborn soda soft drinks are my favorite.
Especially the vanilla soda(hope that's what it's called) just tastes like butter beer in Hogwarts :D

Would definitely come back if I stop by Santa Babara.
Wish there's one in OC.

Not too happy with a recent visit.  I bought a gift card for Silvergreens downtown and they will not honor it at the IV location.  I was not told this when the card was purchased and I rarely go down town.  This policy shows a lack of care for customers.

I visited Silvergreens twice while on a road trip. Each time I tried a different breakfast burrito. On the first visit, I tried the mediterranean breakfast burrito. I enjoyed the pieces of feta that I normally never find in a breakfast burrito. The order included a small cup of fruit which was a good contrast though the burrito itself was fresh. On my second visit I tried the american breakfast burrito that also included the fruit cup. I was satiated with their breakfast offerings and look forward to trying more meals the next time I'm in Santa Barbara.

I chose to go to Silvergreens because I wanted to have a healthy option for lunch. However, I was a little horrified that for every single one of their salads, they use canola oil in the dressing. They don't even have the option of providing pure olive oil and vinegar as an alternative. 

The service is great, the food is very tasty, and they support local charities but if you've read about how terrible canola oil is for you, it is a bit surprising that a restaurant that claims to be a healthy choice, would use a product that is so dangerous to one's health.

Recently went back to silvergreens to order that amazing tuna burger only to see that they cut the portion of tuna steak in half! It's so tiny not it doesn't even fill out the bun. My friend got the basic burger and his beef patty was just as tiny. All break and lettuce now. So sad.
this place is good for some hot soup. Every soup day has its special soup. tomato basil is very good. and the tortilla soup is also great. the place is also worth going for some fresh cut salad.
Really disappointed paid 13 dollars for a simple salad with chicken and the chicken is the smallest piece they could possibly have
Bit into something hard in one of the burgers and broke two teeth. Would not recommend.

great place for a quick, healthy lunch!  My husband and I stopped by silvergreens and was happily surprised by the fresh tasting sandwiches and salads.

We left feeling satisfied without being weighed down.
Love the atmosphere in Kyle's Kitchen! There is a lot of options for seating and the food is amazing. We will definitely be coming back whenever we're in town!
Loved this place! High quality, healthy, tasty food at a very good price. Please come to northern california!!

The avocado chicken burger is soooo good!!! My only beef with Kyle's is that the portion of meat is too small. The slice of chicken on the burger is not only thin, but very small. The large salad is pricey, but not very filling. The flavor combinations are all good, so I'll be back. I just need to figure out how to get the best bang for my buck next time.
best chicken club sandwich omgg i really wish they had one of these places in OC i live too far away )-:

Foods always on point, service is always friendly and warm (they always remember me and my girlfriend when we come in) they have plenty of options to fit our diet...black bean burgers are bomb.com. Would recommend this place to anyone and everyone!

Don't overlook this place simply it's not on State Street. Their protein-greens-grain combo is top-knotch. Reasonably priced and clean and healthy food. Order at the front in a California-style restaurant with friendly staff . Yum. Yum.

The burger and beer special is a great deal though lately I have been addicted to the crispy bacon western sandwich, so good. The seared Ahi salad is also a favorite. All the employees are real nice and my girl and I always compare nutrition info found on their receipts; something fun to do while waiting for the food. Maybe I have been going there to long but I know the answers to all the riddles on the receipts.
Overall one of my favorite places in town to eat.

Silvergreen's quickly became a favorite of mine after I moved to Santa Barbara for school. It was immediately appealing to me because of the quick service, wholesome food, and reasonable prices.
The pastas are my favorite type of food there and I can recommend the sun-dried tomato and basil penne (though they're always adding new good choices so make sure to give the menu a good look!). The smoothies are a bit pricy in my opinion, but they are well worth it. All in all, Silvergreen's provides students and locals with a great option for a variety of HEALTHY, cheap and quick food.
Christy and I loving our Silvergreens... It's been a weekly ritual for over three years now!

Like many of the reviews here, I can confirm that the flavors are great.  They don't give you too much food; just enough to curb your hunger.  The wife loves the fact that they give a calorie count to every order.  That helps you to fully understand what you're placing into your body (that's helpful).  It's fairly priced for what you get (no big deals here).  All in all, I'd say that it's worth paying them a follow up visit to fully review their menu.
Disappointed! Ordered the Ahi Salad, lettuce was wilted, soggy, and browning.

This place should be called Golden Greens Cus they earned a gold medal in my book. Fuck Silver.  This place is awesome.  I went under protest and I had to eat some humble pie once the meal was done.

The food is delicious.  The portions are nice.  The ingredients are quasi-healthy and the price is right.  I will be back over and over again when I'm in town.   The two dinner meal deal is the way to go too!

I love the new Silvergreens!! 

The location is perfect (right next to shopping ;) ) The layout is awesome and very clean. I never feel guilty eating there because the receipt prints out all of the nutritional values about everything that I ordered!! The price is perfect especially in times like these.  You have to try the Seared Ahi Salad it's my absolute favorite!!!!

Good job on the new place I just wish I didn't live so far away I would go every day!!!!

Foods great (when you get the right order), pretty fast service (when they're not understaffed, rarely), and overall staff is usually pretty nice (when there not understaffed). SG use to be my go-to but not anymore. My last few visits have been dismal. Ordered 2 full size shrimp salads and a burger ($23) but ended up with a caesar side salad and a burger ($10) and a bunch of napkins! This happens too often and to think I need to check my order every time I do so is a bit unreasonable. Will be spending my money elsewhere.

The service at Silvergreens is incredible. Everyone is always happy and interested in delivering the best service possible. The meals come out fast and are tasty. It is also a plus to be able to see your nutrition facts on the receipt. I usually get a half and half (half sandwich and half salad or soup). I love how they have a free upgrade option daily for a specialty item! Great lunch spot!

Also has the best breakfast burrito in Santa Barbara!! Get the California Breakfast Burrito with Bacon. Perfect size, delicious salsa and on a wheat tortilla.

They now have happy hour too! It is every day and ALL day Saturday, hard to find an all day happy hour in Santa Barbara... and its all just $4!

Ahi Tuna salad was great. Also the turkey bacon avo sandwich was excellent. Their bread is pretty fresh.  The price was a bit high compared to other quick stops in the area, but the fresh ingredients somewhat justify the prices.  They are definitely going for the healthy crowd.  

Such a small thing, but the receipts were cool! They had the amount of calories that were in your order and broke down the complete nutritional value.  Pretty slick. 

I'd come here again for sure.
Good food, good prices,good atmosphere, and for a good cause  recommend double K burger, the piggy burger and the fresh lemonade

I highly recommend silvergreens for anyone of all ages. I had the ahi in my body burger with a small side salad of the shrimp and avocado salad. The salad was light, crisp, and full of flavor. Very aromatic and was lightly touched with a sweet olive oil aioli dressing. The ahi burger was cooked to perfectly. The top bun had an even coating of avacado; the ahi had sprouts, thinly sliced tomatoes, perfect amount of wasabi aioli, finishing it all of on a brioche bun that was to die for.

I used to eat here pretty often but they have messed up my order the last three times that I have came in. Today I ordered a breakfast burrito with avocado and no sour cream. They charged me for avocado and didn't add any and there was a ton of sour cream on my burrito.

Been coming here for years and actually made a special trip up to Santa Barbara once just to eat here. Both locations are great and the staff, especially at the downtown location are always helpful and friendly. Tried many of the sandwiches and all have been delicious as well as their ahi salad. The receipt is unique offering nutritional facts, health facts and coupons.

After eating on the road all week, it was great to have a healthy, fresh meal! I ordered a salad which was large, fresh and tasty. The staff was freindly and helpful,mas this was my first visit. The French fried green beans were really good, and at least seemed healthier than French fried potatoes. Probably not, though. I've walked past this place several times, I won't make that mistake again.

i would have to say i was very un-impressed with my meal first of all i got a burger and a side salad... i asked for ranch they gave me like a 1/2 teaspoon of ranch i asked for more and the guy gave me a dirty look like are you serious....  then the burger was nothing to brag about at all. and to top it off they charged over $11 for that meal and was completely not worth it what so ever... i would not recommend this place

I went to Kyle's Kitchen for the first time a couple days ago. It was so good I had to go back for more! Both times that I went, I ordered the 'Pair It' option with The Cheesy Pig and Fries + Beverage. The burger was great and the fries were so addicting! They were perfectly seasoned. When I am back in town, this will be the first place I go.

I wish we had one of these in the Bay Area! We made a visit to Silvergreens for a Sunday morning brunch. The whole premise is awesome: Everything is organic and delicious! Since it was about 11am, they were serving both breakfast AND lunch by then, and I was overwhelmed by all the possible deliciousness. I ultimately went with the Chicken Pesto MBT on honey wheat and a side of fruit. It wasn't huge, but it was packed full of flavor with the pesto and roasted red bell peppers. I took half of it on the road with me. The side of fruit looked super fresh was assembled before my eyes from various containers. I think that it's kept separate because they use the same pre-cut fruit to make their smoothies. The chocolate chip cookies looked really good, but I was trying to be good.
