Generally, their portions aren't massive, but they are enough to fill a person up. I like that there is plenty of indoor as well as outdoor patio seating. 

Service is quick and friendly. When the coffee had grounds in it, they made sure to wash out the carafe and brew a new pot. And even though it's a self-serve, self-bus restaurant, one of the staff members did come by to pick up plates and ask us how we found our meals. If I ever return, I will be sure to try out their breakfast sandwiches or burritos, many of which feature freshly sliced avocado!

They are the only restaurant I have ever been to that prints the nutritional information on your receipt! They even separated the nutritional information for the bread versus the sandwich because you get to choose the type of bread you want.

Silvergreens, please open a branch in the San Francisco Bay Area!

The food was great. What seemed like a small portion was filling.  I had the Mountain Climber burger and it was delicious. Even tried some of my GFs veggie burger which was amazing!  Great place highly recommend and reasonable prices.
healthy-ish food, but pretty dry and kind of bland sandwiches.

Just recently discovered Silvergreens, the food is awesome and fresh and the dishes are creative and filling.  Rachel, who worked the front counter when I ate there, was friendly and very patient with me. The smoothie I got was fresh and the breakfast is great! Now I know what all the fuss is about, I will definitely be eating here again in the future!

Great prices for the quality of food. 

Loved the  Feta, Turkey & Palmogranet salad... that was something special. . Chicken Tortilla soup was delicious also...
Chipotle Turkey was okay. .. couldn't really taste the Chipotle..

Burger was bomb! :)

And they give you receipt with calories that's genius

Salad was huge and delicious. Breakfast burrito was meh and seemed a little small. Hashbrown was a little scary looking. The table next to us sat unattended and dirty for the entire time we were there, probably 15 minutes.
Had dinner last night. Quick service, friendly employees.  Manager very very nice came to table and asked if we needed anything. Would recommend Silver Greens to everyone. Nice and clean.
This is a great place for having lunch. The salads are great, my kids had the cheeseburguer from the kids menu and they enjoyed it a lot. Good location and good service and a reasonable price.
Food is always good, staff is very friendly...great option for something on the healthier side...
Oh maan! I don't know where to start! You know what let me not even start! Eat just whatever you'll be amazed! Bon appetit :)

Any place in SB that you can get a tasty meal (beer included) for under $10 is enough to hoot and holler.  The caloric count down to the last ingredient is pretty cool even though I'm not a calorie counter.  

The food is decent.  Mostly bland, but nothing a little salt can't fix.  You can even have a threesome and no one will judge!  You can have it all and not get food envy.  For all you naughty cats out there, that's a half sandwich, half soup, and half salad.   

I can't say I'm a huge fan of the salads though.  Every time I've ordered one, the lettuce was a bit brown and wilted or the dressing just a little not-that-great but the shoestring fries and potato soup are always a delicious welcome addition to my mouth.

The food is food, fresh, and healthy. It's a bit pricey for a sandwich place, but they are a "green" restaurant with quality food.  I love the Nutricate receipt they give you with all the nutrition info.  My usual is the French Dip---delicious!

This place has a big menu with customizable options which is nice for diets that need to change things... Like me :]

The meal we pretty good but not incredible. It just didn't have a lot of character I guess... 

It's good if you want a lot of options but I'm pretty sure there are better places out there. 

Anyways I had the Thai chicken bowl (sub. Pasta for rice) and the bf had the steak bowl. They weren't so flavorful, colorful or amazing. 

Just ok. 

Service was mediocre. Everyone was rushed and tired... Meh.

This location was ok. I had half a sandwich and half of salad. I barely had any chicken in my sandwich,  more bread and arugala than anything and salad came with 4 poor tiny shrimp that I payed extra for to be added for cesar salad. Can't say I would recommend this place to friends or family.

Stopped by today from our drive from SLO to LA -and I remembered having lunch here a few times in the past so I thought it be a great stop to have a healthy and yet filling lunch. I forget how much I love this place!  Got the Great Greenie juice and a California Dreamin' breakfast burrito (Avo, scrambled eggs, fries and cheddar)- kind of amazing in every way, I mean, fries? Reminds me of my carne asada fries days in San Diego, and yet a graduated more distinguished version. Soo soo good. The place is always clean and the staff is always super friendly and accommodating. Family friendly, clean, quick and easy. A great casual spot for a quick lunch with quality and fresh ingredients. I'm a fan.

This is my go to spot in Santa Barbara! You not only feel their love for their mission but in there food as well. So many tasty burgers makes it hard to decide what to get. But once you choose an item from their menu, you will never regret your decision. Unless you picked a spicy one and your mouth is on fire.

Entire staff is awesome! Food is always brought out quickly so I can count on getting back to work on time during my lunch break. The patio has plenty of tables so there's always a place to sit outside. Orlando the manager is the best! Great lunch spot!

This place is really just strange. It boasts being a healthy place, but it doesn't really seem that healthy. My El Capitan salad came and the chicken was smothered in buffalo sauce. Weird for a 'taco' salad. I told them I didn't like it and they switched it out for the Thai Crispy salad, which was fine, it came with deep fried chicken (think tonkatsu) and drenched in deliciously sweet dressing. Yummy but not healthy. I would not recommend.

Today we tried Silvergreens while we passing through Santa Barbara. It was a good as the Yelp reviews mentioned. We would definitely come back. I had the Thai Chicken Salad and Fred had the Ahi Salad. Both had fresh ingredients accompanied by a freshly baked roll. The house made lemonade was nice and tart too. The only thing that would have made our experience better would be if the salad bowls had a more steady base so they wouldn't tip over as easily. Other than that it was fantastic!

Excellent food quality and freshness. Great menu variety. Filling serving sizes for the price, and always cheerful service.

Great place to pick up sandwiches before a big hike or day out.

Healthy? Not really. Fresh? Most likely. 

The fries were odd little half fries that are really salty and served in a cup. Am I supposed to drink them?  Also the salad was drowning in dressing as evidenced by the sad, limp,leftover leaves swimming in a pool at the bottom of the bowl. Advice to future diners...get the dressing on the side.

The sandwich was ok and yes, it tasted fresh, but for $12 I kind of expected more.

The gimmick is over, time to step it up with the food and presentation.

I am not a Santa Barbara local and I decided to try this place out for lunch. They had a terrific deal where you can get a burger and a beer for under $10. The burgers are very large and very very delicious. I had a burger with pesto, sprouts, and avocado. My girlfriend enjoyed a sun-dried tomato burger. Both tasted terrific. The fries that came with the burger were of the shoestring variety (a plus for me) and also had wonderful seasoning on them.

The coolest thing about the restaurant? The nutrition facts are printed on the receipt for you. The not-coolest thing? You get the receipt after you order. The receipt tells you Calories, Fat, Protein, and Carbs. Each receipt also comes with a tip for reducing your calorie load: substitute caesar salad for fries or have your burger lettuce wrapped instead of on the bun, etc.

Needless to say, the food was devoured and I was not disappointed! The staff was also very friendly and suggested both burgers, which were win-win. I also had questions about where to go out that night, and our waiter helped us out with that as well. What else can I say? If you're a local or a visitor, don't overlook this place if you're looking for lunch in Santa Barbara!

I started going to the IV location 12 years ago. Back then I was a regular. I really enjoyed it, now.... Not so much. It started many years ago when they raised the prices, then the quality started to suffer, now it's smaller portions. The food has always been decent, but there are a lot of really really good places in SB so I have trouble going to a place that is just OK. I miss the massive salads served out of huge bowls made in front of you chipotle style. I could ask for extra anything and not be charged. By then my meal was never over $6. Now....... Yea. Not going to happen.
Good fresh food.  Had a homemade burger on a fresh bun, soup, and a beer.  My kids had pasta and chicken fingers and they want to go back (they are on the picky side).

Food:  I ordered the cob salad, it came with bleu cheese, bacon, romaine lettuce and their house dressing.  The salad was pretty good, it's hard to make a salad that taste great.

Food rating: 4/5

Service:  The workers here are pretty friendly.

Service rating: 4/5

Price:  Expect to pay about $8-12

Overall:  Good place to grab some healthy greens.

Such an amazing fresh salad spot in Santa Barbara! Everything was great from the moment we walked in. 

Ordering is easy. They will guide you if you need help ordering food or drink. They're also cool with you adding things on to your salad like avocado, ect. 

The wine is all local (I think) and their beer is all California beer. Happy hour is from 3-6 I think, which has discount alcohol & apps. we had the sauvignon blanc & recommend it if u like a white wine. 

Sit outside for people watching! The weather is perfect too. 

Food wise - get the hummus as an app! Great sides! The bread it comes with is phenomenal. If your entree comes with bread, ask to sub it with the same  bread that comes with the hummus! I had the sesame ahi salad & it was so flavorful & had the perfect amount of dressing! The avocado & oranges & crunch were so perfect together. & the ahi tuna was great! Get that salad!!! My brother had the farmers salad and said it was great, a bit plain but he added quinoa and avo & loved it. 

Great choice in SB if you're looking for something quicker & healthy.

I liked this place.  They seem healthy, quick, affordable, and open later than many nearby places.  My seared ahi salad was good, though it had way too much dressing IMHO.  The sundried tomato pesto pasta was good too, and I enjoyed a Power Smoothie.  Portions were on the small side, but I'd still love to see one of these open in Palo Alto!

Si vous êtes sur la "1" et que vous vous arrêtez à Santa Barbara, je vous conseille de passer par ce restaurant. Nous sommes arrivés après midi et nous n'avons pas attendu pour le service. L'accueil est très bien et le personnel très sympa. Nous avons pris quatre plats différents et ceux-ci étaient tous très bons. Le restaurant propose des salades bien rafraîchissantes avec des produits frais et dans de belles proportions. La viande est elle aussi excellente. Et les prix de cet établissement sont très corrects. Suivant le temps et la chaleur, vous pouvez manger dedans ou dehors (bien agréable). En résumé, une escale à faire
Meh. Food wasn't amazing. Customer service wasn't great. It was just meh. I would try something else if you're in the area.
This place is so yummy!! Great salads and soup and great kids meals.  For $5 all 4 of my kids loved there food. And the cookie omg amazing! We will come here again for sure.

no freakin way! :*(

so lemme back up for a bit ... it's 2010, and my new year's resolution is very typical like most californians.... work out, have a 6pack before june, eat healthy, yadda, yadda yadda ....

you *SINCERELY* hope, if you're in santa barbara, that is, you may be very lucky to find a healthy eatery with nutritional facts printed along with your receipts, but where do you start drawing the line when the food isn't even tasty (i'm not vegan, but i have a few friends who are, and while most folks who never tried vegan food may "eww" aways, vegan food is quite tastyy! -- so, now, where was i?) and the salads aren't fresh and it ends up giving you a major tummiache, you know you definitely came to the wrong place .... 

sure, we ALL want to EAT SMART, and LIVE WELL ... 

but

this place is simply over rated ... whether you order a smoothie, sammie or a pasta dish, at least have some taste to your food, and work on customer service, esp the GMs!! 

to the GMs, guess it doesn't take a whole lot to become a GM @ silvergreens if you can smack a dab of strawberry doodles up your butt... mind as well save your $10-15 and save it on gas!

+1 nice enough to give an extra star for ATTEMPTING to be a healthy joint

The Tri-Tip Sandwich was absolutely delicious and big.  I ordered it with a side of BBQ sauce and it was the perfect pair. The meal wasn't too heavy and after I felt perfectly fine to continue with my day and didn't feel sluggish at all. 

The staff was friendly and very helpful With helping me decide what to choose as it was my first time! I will definitely return next time I'm in Santa Barbara!
Great service and clean establishment. Food tasted very good. However I got the worst food poisoning from here. 3 days in and I am still very sick.

It's nice that somebody's trying to do the healthy thing, and it's nice to have the nutritional info for what you actually ordered printed on the receipts. I tried a couple of pasta dishes, though, and they're very bland, even by the standards of low-cal food. It also seems like they have a ton in the kind-of-healthy category (and are running a lot into the 800-1200 calorie range, which isn't even that) but don't go very often into the real lows.

It's nice that they're counter service, and they give you the pagers in case you want some friendly vibration. The ambiance is great. They're very clean and they have nice tables on the inside and outside. They have bathrooms, too, unlike a lot of the small places in SoCal. They're pretty quick, too, or at least they were for the pasta. They have plenty of sandwiches, salads, and burgers (regular, veggie, or ahi) so I might update this if I have a chance to check those. The sundaes look amazing, too. (Why are there sundaes?)

I'd just beware the nutritional info sheet, because it has a way of giving numbers for half-items (which are not sold as half-items) and telling you in the footnotes. It's the sort of trick that you catch easily after going through enough places' nutritional info but it might fool your family or friends.

Amazing potato soup and tomato basil soup! The potato soup looks simple- not chunky with just a light brown color... but its FULL of flavor! Great healthy options, for a great price! This place is a must try!
Wow, what a great chain(two so far). This place makes unique eats that taste great. Any chance we can get one of these on University Ave. in Palo Alto. You'll make a mint.

Honestly I put off going here for soo long because I thought it was going to be another health nut flavorless SB restaurant and man was I wrong! Everything was delicious and the staff was so helpful in navigating me through the menu. I had the seared ahi tuna burger and it was so so so good! I never thought I'd like a burger without red meat and I can't wait To go back here to try the ahi tuna salad my sister ordered. So fresh and delicious! Also you have to get a soda, they're all organic with no high fructose corn syrup.

I was excited to go to the downtown location but it turned out to be completely different than the other two kitchens closer to Goleta.
I waited a long time to order, almost thought about leaving, then someone finally acknowledged me. I ordered the Rock Climber burger but then ended up throwing it in the trash disgusted.  
The burger was a bright pink inside and barely cooked.  There must have been two scoops of mayonnaise on it, because it tasted like a mayonnaise sandwich with the lettuce and tomatoes slipping out and making a mess.
The bun however, was fresh and tasty.
Great place to grab a quick meal from. Delicious, reasonably healthy and fast service. Favorite thing is their breakfast burritos.

I had compiled a list of gluten free vegetarian friendly restaurants to visit before our trip, and based on yelp and various blog reviews Silvergreens was toward the top of the list of restaurants to visit. Too bad for us as we apparently missed out on eating a good gluten free vegetarian lunch elsewhere.

I ordered the Sundried Tomato Pasta, and it was good. Not awesome, but I would order it again if I were to ever eat here again (which I won't).The problem was the gluten free Fettuccine Alfredo hubby ordered. The pasta was soft and tasteless and had an odd texture, and the sauce had a taste and texture closer to warm milk than to an Alfredo sauce. Because we were tired and hungry from the drive, we didn't bother to complain or return the order, we just threw it away. Hubby had two bites, I had one, and it wasn't even worth picking at. 

We had also ordered the tomato basil soup, which once again was good but not great. 

On the plus side, the restaurant was clean and the cashier knowledgeable about how the gluten free food was handled and very helpful. 

This may be a good place to eat for those without food allergies, but I could not recommend this to anyone with celiac or gluten sensitivities based on this one dish as it was so horrible. With so many good gluten free pasta options available, there is no excuse to serve soggy, limp pasta.

Healthy food for people who don't know what healthy is. If you've been to Native Foods, Tender Greens, or Urban Plates you know what I mean.

We were sadly disappointed. This place was a fast food joint disguised as a healthy cafe. We got the shrimp/pineapple bowl and the steak bowl. Terrible, overpriced. Felt like the rice was soaked in sugary teriyaki sauce. One whole piece of broccoli. The shrimp were NOT grilled. And bread on the side of a rice bowl? Really? That's healthy? I wish I had tried a salad instead but doubt we would stop here again for a second chance.
Great homemade "fast" food.  I love the healthy and tasty vegetarian "earth burger", get it with the hand cut fries and strawberry lemonade!  Yum!

I like the concept of this place. Its a healthy "fast food" idea that tries to be transparent with their nutritional value as to educate you on what you're eating/ordering.With your order, they print out all the calories, fats, etc. that your meal contributes.  In a way, you customize what you want on your sandwich, salad, burger. Everything tasted really healthy, there is no excess grease, oils, or salt. It was so healthy tasting that I wanted the fat back in my angus beef burger. Serving sizes are just right, and the prices are not bad. If you're looking for a healthy alternative this is a great place. If you're craving for greasy hamburger that hits the spot,  go to In n' Out.

My family and I frequented (weekly) Silvergreens. We loved the menu and  the "natural" sodas. We have been to Kyle's Kitchen since it has taken over a handful of times and noticed it gets worse with each visit. Although the menu is basically the same the quality of the food has gone down. They got rid of the natural soda machine and the restaurant is always dirty when we come in. It's such a disappointment. Definitely not a change for the better. We are going to have to find a new favorite spot.
Good food. Friendly service. Casual ambience. And the piece de resistance: nutritional information on your receipt. Excellence.

They emphasize local ingredients, healthy combinations with plenty of fruit and vegetables, and serve it up in an unassuming manner.  Another reviewer likened Silvergreens to Panera, and that is a very fair comparison.  You order at the counter and then get a pager when your food is ready at the counter.  Service is fast and you hardly have time to get a drink and find a seat before your food is ready.

The food is fresh and looks great.  I had the soup/salad combo -- the tomato basil soup had great flavor and the hummus on the Mediterranean salad was homemade.  My wife had a BLT sandwich and caesar and she liked both.  Kids had hamburgers and I was very jealous.  They smelled great and the fries were very crispy.

However, prepare to part with your money -- $9 for the half/half sandwich, soup, or salad or hamburger/fries.

I called and they said that they no longer accepted phone orders, which I've never heard a food establishment say before. I went online to order and ironically enough my clock had just changed to 8:20pm when I was about to start my order. Apparently they don't take orders AFTER 8:20pm. They don't close until 9pm and all I wanted was a simple salad, but nope. Very unfortunate.

Very tasty, fresh and healthy.  Love that the portion sizes are not an outrageous amount of food that is really more than you should comfortably eat.  One of the few places that have healthier kids menu options.  Their Sesame Kale and Quinoa bowl is my favorite, especially with the added Teriyaki shrimp.  mmmm 
I also just found out they have free wifi. I'm looking forward to heading here at non-peak times for some work/study time.

Great food at a great price. The menu is supposed to be relatively healthy and the food is delicious! Employees are extremely friendly and the atmosphere is relaxing.
Definitely going to keep this in mind when I'm out in Santa Barbara.

So I used to really like this place but it seems like it has changed things and not for the better. They used to have a order menu over the registers so you did not have to look through a printed one. Also they have now gone with the "swipe/square" type of register which asks for tip now and gotten rid of the pick it up yourself and bus items yourself feature. The food still seems good just the little extras things that I liked about it have been yanked.
Like the oatmeal raisin cookie. (Now mango)

I really like this place!  I could literally eat here every day and not get bored. There's quite the variety. Yes, the food tastes great!  Fresh and flavorful. And the service was extremely fast and friendly. 

It is not the traditional table service. You order upfront and the food is delivered to your table. But it felt like our food was delivered quicker than it took to decide what to eat.

And there's plenty of seating, both inside and on the outside patio area.

We had 2 vegetarians, 2 omnivores & 3 picky kids in our group & everyone found something they liked on the menu! And it tasted great & was healthy to boot! Woot woot! My only complaint is that it's a little pricey for what it is. But then again, it is super spendy Santa Barbara

It can be a challenge finding healthy, filling, vegetarian meals, but I had plenty to choose from at Silvergreens. The food was great, the prices were reasonable, bathroom was clean, service was good. All around, a fantastic option in Santa Barbara.

I was on my way to Long Beach from San Francisco and luckily stopped at Silvergreens for dinner.  I had the Klassic Kyle burger, tomato basil soup and shrimp avocado salad! The soup was slightly too salty for my taste buds, however, everything was bursting with freshness and delicious. This will be a pit stop MUST when I venture back to Santa Barbara.
One of the restaurants of the future. Everything is clean and transparent. You will have all the necessary information about your food in your receipt. Good happy hour deals. Good vegetarian options.

I don't normally do reviews but I think this had to be known. This place is overpriced.  Also, I got cold soup (twice at that) and when I asked them for a hot bowl of soup they heated it to scalding hot. It took me 15 mins to start eating it. My salad came with no dressing. And to top it off, my brother-in-law found a toothpick in his salad which could have been very dangerous. It wasn't until I brought this to their attention that they offered a $10 gift card. Definitely not coming back.

Both times I've been here I've been disappointed.

I walked down for the Kickin' Cowboy salad. Left with my salad only to discover it was missing the avocado and jalapenos. Super sad. Especially for the price. South Coast has better salads for less in my opinion.

Really nice place to stop on the way through Santa Barbara.  Pretty close to the highway.  Lots of parking.  Casual atmosphere.  Fresh tasting food.  The burgers are offered lettuce wrapped and it seems like they are very open to making substitutions.  Fries were very tasty too.  They taste double fried, nice and crispy!

Solid place for me and my kids to have comfort food!  
The Chapala Street location seems to be getting on their feet still - as compared to the Goleta location - but that is a mere observation.  
Cucumber Mint Lemonade!  
Veggie Burger!

The food here is average, at best. They have cheap prices, but the portions are small.

It's nice that it's a green restaurant, but if the food is not tasty, then I don't care.

They have internet, which is nice. And they offer 3 meals and a huge menu.

The staff is overly friendly. I'm pretty neutral about it but you might not be.
If you feel like a salad, then you should come here. I've been here twice and have enjoyed the salads both times.

I have been eating at this restaurant in Santa Barbara ; I have spent a little but I have also eaten very little. I Was with my family and  the children took  pieces of fried chicken but there were inedible by how much oil they had. I'd recommend to change fryer oil more often before putting nutritional information on the bill.
I'll not return again.
It was okay food. Salad had too much dressing. Fries were not crispy at all. Portions were nice but over all it wasn't worth it.

Save the jalapenos, guys !!

The "Kickin' Cowboy" salad is fantastic and spicy and full of flavor (DO add the chicken ...) but really requires only about HALF the jalapenos you usually put on it. Every time I get it, I LOVE it, but half those peppers go in the trash (and I generally like spicy food !) Save a few cents and reduce your weekly jalapeno order ... keep everything else the same. 

Love your ENTIRE restaurant and the burgers are also amazing. Can't go wrong at Kyle's.

Today I just ate the ahi tuna salad. Last time I was here i had half a turkey sandwich and ahi tuna salad.

For a casual joint that's pretty quick- I think the food is fantastic. It's healthy (I should have said no wonton crunch and roll- that's my bad lol) and very tasty. Everything taste fresh and made to order. I gave it a 5 for that reason. It's a casual joint that exceeded my expectations.

The turkey sandwich was awesome from the last time I was here. And I'm a picky and prissy eater. 

I read a comment about the bread roll being oily and salads being small- that is kinda contradicting lol wanting more food, but complaining about oily bread? The garlic roll tasted like they just baked it. I wonder if she ordered the half option- where you get 2 items combined as one. Just sounds bizarre. The salads I've had are quite large and filling. Maybe she should visit Europe where proportions are a lot smaller! 

If you're a healthy person and have family or friends who aren't so healthy - they also have burgers, fries, trip tip sandwiches etc

Also, they have kombucha on tap which is awesome _ kombucha is loaded with probiotics that's great for the digestive system.

Anyway- I highly recommend- they have indoor and lovely outdoor seating - the staff is also very polite and attentive
Happy eating

Great place to eat and stop with 5 kids and have a healthy meal. Prices are decent. Half and half sandwich with soup is just the right amount of food for a light meal. Kids meals are more then enough with a wide variety of choices.

Nothing special for vegetarians. Salad lettuce not particularly crisp. Dressing tastes like generic Italian. Edamam hummus sandwich also not great. Store bought sliced bread with some hummus and greens. Very nice service though. Lots of space and easy for kids.

Kyle's has quickly become one of my favorite places in the SB area! If you want good food and to feel good (as a portion of our purchase is donated to organizations supporting Autism and other disabilities) this is the place to be!

They have great and unique burgers (ahi in my body & bleu cheese) and yummy salads (garden or cob salad) for awesome prices! You can upgrade to larger portions if you're very hungry. Their fries are to die for and perfectly compliment the meal.

They also have lemonade that reminds me of the popular restaurant "lemonade" where there are adjuncts such as mint cucumber lemonade!

Overall, love the food, the vibes, and the potential to see Kyle once in a while!

Definitely drop by!

- Jess

Good but not craveable. I've been here a few times for take out and the service was fast and friendly. They have nice healthy options and include calorie info on their website. I've only tried the salads so my review may go up in time. The ahi salad is refreshing and has some nice flavors but they were skimpy on the amount of ahi. The ceaser salad was as basic as a ceaser could be. I've had a couple of their "cooler" drinks and they were refreshing and tasty. Overall I would say Silvergreens is a solid option for a pretty healthy quick meal but it's not a place I crave to go- it's more of a default.
I can't say enough good things about this place. Great menu and great staff. They finally have mustard.

Great place! We came here on a Saturday around 5:30pm. It's a very cute, modern-ish, casual restaurant right off of state street. You walk in, take a look at the huge and healthy menu, order, and then they call your number when your food is ready.

Hubby ordered the pesto burger, and I ordered the buffalo chicken sandwich. You can make it a "combo" with a side and a drink for a couple bucks more. I got french fries as my side and hubby got the mac n' cheese. After we ordered, we sank into one of their huge, comfortable booths and watched some show on the big screen tv. It was a nice way to end a long day of walking and hiking! 

When the food came, it was good. This place is all about "healthy" fare -- they even print out the calorie information on your receipt! Hubby said his burger was good, but it didn't have enough of the pesto "kick" he was expecting. I guess I could say the same for my sandwich, it was good, but I wish it had more of the buffalo sauce. My fries were excellent for healthy baked fries. Hubby's mac n' cheese was also very good.

We got to sit in their restaurant enjoying our meal for a long, long time and no one hassled us. I love that. It looks like this is a popular study spot for local students, too, cuz we saw a few with books and laptops. All in all, I recommend this place if you're looking for something healthy and casual near State street!

I am very much a sandwich person. I always get the BLT with Avacado. Never waiver, and Silvergreens always satisfies :) Also not a health nut, but if I were, it's nice knowing that everything on the menu is healthy. I stop at this restaurant at least 4 times a month, nice place to grab something to eat when I bike up to SB.
On a visit to Santa Barbara we decided to try Silvergreens. We all LOVED our food. They have fresh strawberries on their menu. They were sooooo yummy. Will definitely visit again.

stopped here for a quick lunch and got the Grilled Shrimp and Avocado salad.  It was sooo good!  I loved the good chunks of goat cheese.  I was able to get by using very little dressing.

The kids got a burger and chicken strips.  Both were also very good and flavorful.  

The restaurant was very clean and hip.  I would love to go back and try their other salads.  They all looked so good!  Too bad I don't live in the area.

Wow! Rarely would I expect five star service at a fast food style establishment but they did it!  We stopped here on the way home for a quick meal with our son. We both enjoyed the burgers (did the double meat for $1 more) and the hb enjoyed fries and myslef the pesto couscous.  The little guy loved all the choices and we liked the watermelon as a side vs fries! ! What took it above and beyond was the service, the cashier went out of his way to leave his post to help me get the door both times and the busers were great too. Hope we get one of these in thousand oaks soon!
Awesome fresh food, service, decor and location. Really enjoyed our breakfast burritos. Fruit smoothies awesome too.

The food is a 2.5, but the staff was nice so I'll round up to a 3. FYI, the Isla Vista location is much better. 

The steak bowl was such a disappointment. There was barely any meat in it (about 1/6 of what came in our tritip sandwich), which is ridiculous, since the bowl was the most expensive thing we ordered. 

Chicken burger was okay, though the meat was also skimpy here. I get that it's a slider/mini burger, but I expect the meat to actually cover most of the bun. 

Tritip sandwich wasn't bad. At least there was a decent amount of meat. 

Crispy Thai chicken salad was the best of the group, though it was dressed too heavily.

Love my SILVERGREENS. Always nice and willing to exchange you're meal if it isn't to you're liking. Once they gave me a chocolate chip cookie when I asked for a snicker doodle and when telling them about the mistake they smiled and got me two cookies to apologize. Very sweet. The food is always delicious and is consistent. The only bummer is the price and being a college student with not a lot of cash to spare is difficult to go all the time. I try and go as often as possible!

We stopped in on our way north to go camping. Had the manager behind the register. Super nice guy. Food was way better than we were expecting from a strip mall type spot. Really good chicken. They also donate a lot to charities which is pretty cool too. Wish one was closer to LA to give Hook Burger a run for their money.
Honestly love this place. Always clean, super healthy and good specials. I wish the portion sizes were bigger because I always leave just kinda full.
I love the place! It's big and has many seats. There are many choices we can make. I love both cheese hamburger and french fried, which are delicious! I like its stuff, too.

Good quality food. My daughter is a vegetarian and alway find good tasting food here. 

Atmosphere is casual but very clean. Has a room at the back which could be used for a group?

A number of big screen TVs.

Best Koba burger I have had.. Reasonably priced for that.

Lastly, they give you a receipt which shows the nutritional breakdown of your meal. Makes a great subject for eating as you compare who has eaten the most calories. 

Use your SBAXXESS card

Though I didn't avoid the ever-so-attractive Freshman 15, I was so lucky to have this place around during my college years. With so many healthful (and delicious) options, it's difficult to go anyplace else. 

My favorite part about Silvergreens: your order's invaluable (yet soul-crushing) health information found on your receipt, which includes the caloric content, fat, saturated fat, and other health variables. Just be prepared to see triple digits on those calories when ordering a burger with extra cheese.

...Not that I'd know anything about that, or anything.

Takeout lunch is yummy. Despite that they rarely get my order correct I leave a tip b/c employees are nice and quality ingredients. BUT- Check your order before u leave to make sure all of it is there, dressing frequently missing and they forget to add all the salad ingredients sometimes!!

Great food! Great quality of food! Great prices! Overall an excellent restaurant. Service was quick and kind. Me and my boyfriend got delicious, healthy burgers. He got a tuna burger that was much higher quality than expected and was cooked to perfection! Overall, nothing to complain about and would definitely recommend!

Really not worth it. I was kind of excited by the "all natural" idea, but the taste was definitely lacking, and the quality/price was really not that good. 
The bread for their sandwich tasted terrible (i'm French, I'm not kidding with bread lol), their pasta was tasteless, and the ambiance is really not that great. Anyways, there is really better place in Santa Barbara. I appreciated the effort of having affordable organic food, but they really have to work on the taste and freshness of their produces.

I am such a huge fan of this place and so happy that we were able to make it here finally. 

I've literally had this place book marked on my list for the past 3 times I've visited SB but never ended up going because I always got too attached to Lily's tacos ... haha but I'm sooo happy I came here! 

After a whole weekend of eating really bad food, I was ready for something refreshing. As it turns out, Silvergreens was all about that. They had everything from healthy smoothies to delicious salads and awesome soups. You can make your own sandwiches, make any substations or exchanges you want and everything gets printed on your receipt. Yes talk about keeping yourself honest re: the calories that you consume! 

My 527ish calories of their chicken tortilla soup and ahi tuna salad was just the perfect amount of food for me, cholesterol, fat and all! Highly recommended for people who are watching what they eat and counting calories since it is also very delicious as well.

LOVE IT!
I recently started counting calories and this place makes it easy. On your receipt they tell you the nutritional facts of your specific meal.  No looking through a chart and forgetting to add which dressing you got on your salad. It's all done before you even get the food.  If every restaurant did this, we could cure obesity. 
Beside that the food was delicious, I went with a half salad half sandwich combo. Turkey sandwich was well a turkey sandwich. 
Seared tuna salad with advocados and sesame ginger sauce was bomb! (and how often can you say that about a salad?)

I was driving on the 101 and wanted to stop in SB to have healthy food.  I found Silvergreens to be quick and healthy with a wide variety of menu options.  

I wish we had a Silvergreens in LBC, its quick like a take away chicken place crossed with super healthy food.  The receipt even has the calorie, protein and health food numbers similar to labeling of store products so you know what you are eating.  

I will be back again.

After having tried most of the menu it's safe to say that this places food is pretty much upgraded cafeteria food. Honestly if it wasn't for epic soups I wouldn't have ever kept trying this place. Salads are good too but burgers are very dull

First time coming here. We decided to go eat here for my boyfriend's late birthday dinner. I chose salad. My son and niece chose kid burger. My boyfriend chose double k burger. They all looks go good. The kid burger looks so delicious and great quality compare to other places. My boyfriend say it's so good and juicy. He will definitely want come back here next week. 
I love my salad. It's so delicious I got disappointed when I ate it all even though I'm full. That how delicious is it.

The service is great. Workers are so friendly . Felt a lot positive experience here. Love it.
If you want a classic, old school, greasy spoon breakfast where you sit at the counter, this is the place. Fun and delicious. Nothing pretentious.

I expected a lot more given the high reviews. 

Wasn't impressed by the selection. 

Had one bite of my salad before the fruit flies flew into it and wouldn't go away.

Then I looked down and saw a spider crawling on the front of my shirt. (Perils of eating outside on the patio, I guess.)

I finally ate half of my sandwich and some of the vegetable soup, but had to throw most of the salad away. In the end, I was still hungry and had wasted money on food I didn't eat.

Just got awful delivery from here through sbmenus.com. French fries cold and soggy and a chicken club sandwich that had a tiny piece of chicken that was like trying to eat rubber. Threw the whole thing out and ordered a pizza from Rusty's.

Just got lunch here. After we submitted our order and paid for it, a guy came 10 minutes later and told us they wouldn't serve the side salad because they didn't charge us for it. We actually didn't even notice but one would expect as a good practice to just give the side salad, especially when it's the restaurants mistake.... The guy was pretty persistent, which ruined the experience. Just a note to the manager, if he/she is reading this to train or explain simple customer service to the employees. Good experience means repeat customer. Now, we would never come back.

Admittedly I was a bit torn about how many stars to give Silvergreen's downtown. The food here is REALLY high quality and VERY affordable. They even have a happy hour deal where you can get a burger and beer for $6. My only criticism is the environment -- with white walls and metal furniture, top 40 on blast and TVS playing in every corner, the vibe here is fairly sterile.  This place is great for a healthy, cheap, solo lunch bite, not the best if you're looking for a relaxing meal with a date or group.

Just went here for the first time for dinner with the family. I got the Farmhouse salad which was pretty fresh which is the main reason I liked the place, and I got it with turkey and for a $3 side it seemed to be a very small portion-- not even 2 oz I would guess. I also got a tortilla soup which I didn't personally think tasted that great but my daughter did. My son and daughter got a chicken tortilla bowl and they thought it was just okay. My husband got the tritip sandwich and he thought it was pretty good and loved the bread. The bread that came on the side of my salad was DELISH! I am dieting so I couldn't eat more than two bites but it was fresh and flavorful. I would for sure come back. Service was also good.
Delicious and healthy salads, and options for people who don't necessarily want to eat a salad (hamburgers, sandwiches, etc). This is like Sweetgreen but better!
Great little lunch spot! Healthy, fast food for 2 people around $20 you can't beat that in Santa Barbara

This restaurant is just ok. Stopped here on our way through Santa Barbara on our way to Cambria - with so many other choices, I would go somewhere else next time. The Thai peanut salad was uninspired. The chicken was so dry and thin, it was almost like jerky. There was not any peanut flavoring in the salad at all - no peanuts in the salad and no peanut oil in the dressing. The chicken club was also just ok.  Very salty. The bun was good.

Perfect choice for a lunch! For just $9,50 you can make a combo of your choice - burger, salad, soup, drinks. I loved their tomato cream soup and chicken burger, my hubby had Ahi Tuna salad - everything was delicious! Great quality, nice service, affordable prices (especially, in comparison to all the other places in the center of SB)! thanks for making our one day trip to SB so nice!

We gave this place a try because of a Groupon offer.  Outcome: Just OK.  The atmosphere was a cold, upscale fast foodish feeling.  The fries were thin and hard, crispy, seasoned with fresh garlic and parsley, served in a regular coffee cup (what is that about?), and mostly cold by the time we got them.  The burger was overcooked but a healthy portion of meat.  My turkey, bacon and avocado sandwich was nice to look at, but a bit on the dry side.  The wheat bread it came on was delicious (I believe they bake it themselves), large, moist slices of bread with a crispy crust.  I ordered a strawberry milkshake, but was disappointed.  It came in a small plastic cup and it didn't have an ice cream richness, but rather frothy and thin and not containing that many strawberries.  

Overall, I probably would not come back, and I am glad the Groupon helped keep the cost down, since our meal  before the discount was over $31.
This pseudo healthy restaurant makes me wanna barf.  I saw the way they handle their food behind the scenes at their Isla Vista location and decided I would never eat there again.
Great place to eat healthy food!! Everything is fresh when you order it. Anything from sandwiches, salads to soups to breakfast burritos. Definitely recommend!
Amazing Earth Burger And the Santa Cruz Bowl,  very curteous staff and reasonably priced but should have more vegeterian options. Freshly squeezed cucumber mint lemonade was very refreshing.
I work at Paseo Nuevo mall and eat here every day, three times a day! They have everything and its all done so well! Great Food, great prices and wonderful service. Highly recommended
Good, clean food but if you walk in and there's a line longer than three people you're going to wait 25 minutes for sandwich :-/

This place has some great healthy eating choices, and the portion size is small. We tried the sun dried tomato pasta and the Thai pasta. We both preferred the Thai pasta as our favorite choice between the two. Their lemonade quenched our thirst, and their chocolate brownie cookie was soft and delicious!

The food was great!  Love the menu options- clean yet delicious eating!  I don't normally eat the bread but it was so good that after I tried it I had to finish it!  Fries were yummy too!  My BF and I both loved our choices - I had the ahi tuna sandwich and he had a chicken one.  Also nice outdoor seating area.  Lastly it's for a cause so can't lose!

Presentation 10. Taste 5. We had two things: pepper jack bacon burger and the chicken bacon western. The former had a bun that was dense like a dinner roll, patty charred to a crispy dry jerky. The latter had an equally dried out chicken (breast?) and a dusting of sauce that hinted at but didn't reach BBQ. Fries were cold and stale and to top that off, both cups had mostly the scrap left-over nubs of fries. It looked great but half of our sandwiches ended up in the segmented trash cans.

Good, solid place to catch a variety of foods. The table had the ahi tuna salad which was excellent.  The burgers are also very good. Very clean, casual place to eat! Natural, healthy food at a good price and fast...
Fantastic customer service. I just got a free cookie after chatting with the guy about their cookies!

While I was at UCSB, I really loved ordering from silvergreen's. They have an amazing combo and have fresh, healthy food options. I recently visited the downtown location to discover their bomb breakfast burrito! They have a few types, and I like them all. My favorite breakfast burrito in Santa Barbara because it isn't greasy.

I ate at Silvergreens for the first time when my friend was visiting me in Goleta. We had no idea where to go, but wanted something comforting and quick. We ended up here.  

My friend ordered the crispy onion cheeseburger, which she loved. She finished her entire plate. I had the pesto chicken fusilli minus the chicken sub avocado. It was yummy, and the bread that came along with the meal was crispy and buttery. 

BUT, the real winner here was the hand cut French fries. They were shoestring, seasoned wonderfully, and had the right amount of crunch to them. We both ordered our own side and absolutely loved every bite. My friend and I finished both with ease. If I could only eat one French fry again, I would choose these. 

Only downside, I originally wanted to order the fiesta veggie burger, but they were out. This would lead me to think the patties are pre made and frozen not made in store. Oh well, can't have it all I suppose.

Me and my friends were on a weekend trip in SB and one of my friend's PT patients had recommended her to try Silvergreens.  I already love any place that serves soup, sandwiches, and salads-- so I was very excited to try this place.  

I was very very hungover, so the best thing I knew would help would be soup. I ordered their potato cheddar soup, which was deeeelicous. I could definitely tell that it was homemade because of the grainy texture from the potatoes.  I also ordered their mac and cheese because I am a big fan of mac and cheese.  It wasnt as great as I had hoped because they use one of those whole grain pastas, and it wasnt texturally pleasing to me.  

I would definitely try this place out again next time I'm in SB.
I love this place!!! Delicious food, great selection, and the receipt comes with the complete nutrition value for everything ordered. Not only that, the staff is incredibly friendly and helpful.

Nice little dinner spot that won't break your bank. Can never go wrong with anything on the menu. I try to get something different every time I go, but I am a sucker for the turkey, bacon, avocado sandwich.
Delicious affordable unique dishes that don't make you feel guilty. Definitely the place to go when in Santa Barbara. Friendly  customer service too :)

I just moved here a couple weeks ago and this was my favorite place to grab food from when I got home from work...until I got the delicious sounding kale and strawberry salad with lemonade dressing. I actually quite like kale and was really excited to try it so I got it on my way home from work as take out. When I got home I had a couple of bites only to realize I'm pretty sure the kale had gone bad, I don't want to call it rotten, but I think it was pretty close. Really stinks cause this place was one of my faves but I literally couldn't even eat the salad :(
Best burger I've had in a really long time! You've got to try the Sun Dried Tomato and Avocado Burger with a Blue Moon as your side... magically delightful

WOW. Incredibly impressed with Silvergreens! Delicious food& coffee (healthy& organic), a great location, friendly staff, & good menu size. I don't live in the area, but I will DEFINITELY be visiting this restaurant again.

I really like this place. It's a fast food/sit down restaurant like The Habit with a greater influence on healthy choices.
I had a delicious Dried Tomato Avocado burger that was like around 500 calories and filled me up nicely.
Also, their Green Fries are great but a little fattening.
You know all of the nutrition information regarding your order because they clearly print it all right on the receipt.
Their coffee is of excellent quality and they apparently roast it with their own beans. (you fill it yourself so you get free refills basically) It's like 2bucks and waaay better than starbucks in my opinion. Really excellent quality.

The staff was reeaaally nice. Always with a smile and very helpful and informative. I had to take two big trays to our table and the nice lady helped bring one of them, which apparently isn't what they usually do.

I think I'll stop here every time I'm in SB.

Oh if only the service and management was as great as the food.  We waited on a Wed evening for a half hour for our food--not easy with a starving 11 year old!  Staff seems disorganized and generally uninformed about menu options.  They don't even know the hours they're open!  Was told to return the next morning at 7AM to get my Greenie drink--and they didn't open until 7:30AM.  Ugggg!
It's one my favorite places to come and enjoy a burger. They have a good selection of items on their menu. Friendly, quick staff! Next time ill try something different for sure!
Wonderful ahi tuna salad.  Also got the grilled shrimp bowl.  Delicious.  Loved the mint cucumber cooler.  Would definitely return for the good fresh food.
Yummy black bean avacado sundried tomato burger.

yummy, yummy, yummy . . . I like salad in my tummy.
Salads are fresh and flavorful.
The place in clean.
The people are friendly.
We could use you in San Diego ;)

Low key kinda obsessed with this place. The food is really good, healthy, fast, cheap, and creative. The location is great and the little outdoor patio is gorgeous. They have free wifi, an Axxess deal with discounts, and they give a good amount of their proceeds to charity. 

Honestly nothing not to like

I just moved here and can say Kyles has been my GO TO.  Extremely fresh and delicious organic food.  

Also, a extremely special story behind this restaurant.  Love supporting businesses like that.

If there were a whole foods for cafeterias this would be it. I'm not sure if everything is organic or not, but there is an impression of healthy nutritious food. I had the seared ahi salad and it was delicious. There were fresh slices of tuna and avocado and tons of crunchy greens. Everyone who helped with our order was pleasant and the manager was keen on double checking with our satisfaction. Our table was left a mess after we were done eating, but it's one of those places with a cleaning service.

I can't believe how much seating there is inside, it's rather impressive.

I literally eat here everyday. 

Affordable, healthy and it tastes good. Perfect for a snack fix or a full on meal, I usually get the "half and half" with a half seared ahi tuna salad and a cup of the homemade soup. 

They also have receipts that actually tell you exactly what you are eating, calories and all. Perfect for those watching their weight, or are just plain interested in what they are putting in their bodies. Basically amazing on all levels.

Was staying in Santa Barbara for the Memorial Day weekend and wanted something healthy. So you order at the counter and then they bring you your food to your table. My BF and I ordered the seared tuna salad and the pesto chicken sandwich. We sat outside since it was a really nice day. Food took slightly a little longer to arrive but the food was very good. The salad was definetely my favorite! It had seared tuna, sesame seeds, avocado, tortilla strips, and mandarin oranges with mixed greens. I usually don't like fruit in my salad but those mandarin oranges were so sweet and refreshing! The salad came with a sesame dressing, which went really well with the salad. The pesto sandwich was very good as well but was a little hard to eat because it was hard to fit into my mouth just to take a bite. I eventually just took off the top piece of the bread and ate the rest of the sandwich like that. If you want healthy and good food, this is a place to check out! They also have burgers and rice bowls too, which my friends said were pretty good as well.

Christy and I are back! Loving Silvergreens... we love our little weekly lunch dates here...today we are sharing a turkey bacon & avocado sandwich with stinky pig fries  and a bowl of tortilla soup Mmmm good!

It was around 8pm, and we were desperately searching for a reasonably priced place to eat dinner, and then a giant power outage happened throughout downtown Santa Barbara! We followed the light to a few streets over where the power was on, and continued our search for dinner. When we stumbled upon Silvergreens, we determined that it was just what we were looking for.

This place kind of reminds me of a mix between Veggie Grill (healthy foods) and Panera Bread (lots of bread and baked goods). The first thing I noticed about their menu was that they served half size options, and I appreciate that SO MUCH! I can rarely finish my food at restaurants with such large portion sizes, so I always get excited when these options are presented to me! I ordered a half of a turkey-bacon-avocado sandwich, which came with a cookie - I got a brookie (brownie-cookie). We also got a local strawberry lemonade. 

My sandwich was pretty great! Next time, I would probably ask for non-toasted bread, but that is just my preference.  There wasn't too much avocado on my sandwich, and I could barely tell that it was there. My brookie was SO delicious, so I'm glad I made that choice of cookie. It was very rich, and tasted like a dark chocolate cookie, so it wasn't overly sweet. The strawberry lemonade was amazing, the best I've ever had! If I was a local, I would eat here often.

We really wanted to like Silvergreens; it was well recommended and the service was attentive for an order-at-the-counter place.  However, as we reflected on our meal afterwards with the rest of our party, we finally all reluctantly admitted that we did not like our food., especially bread.  It was hard to find the meat on the French dip and what was there was tough. The bread was dry and crumbly on another sandwich. Etc etc  Maybe just a bad day for them, but it seemed more than just a miss on one dish.

We ordered a burger, tri tip sandwich and a side of fries. The burger was okay. The tri tip sandwich was bland. The fries were oily and soggy. The water cups and ketchup bottles were filthy. I wouldn't recommend going here

I was going to the Isla Vista location long before this opened.

The downtown location has just expanded on the concept, and you also don't have to deal with a throng of hung over college kids nursing hangovers and shame while you wait for your sandwich now.

The menu is large, so some stuff, naturally, is hit and miss, but I've never had a bad meal here and the employees are really nice.

A great spot for when you just can't figure out where you want to go to eat, especially for lunch.
We stop by for lunch and ordered a salad and chicken sandwish with drinks.  The food was healthy and tasty.  The crowds were mostly UCSB students.

I always feel good going to Silvergreens because the food is so good and I feel I'm supporting a wonderful cause.
The service is great; it's a fun restaurant.
The "Pair it" option is perfect-choose a salad and  a sandwich or burger.  It's the right amount of food and so yummy.
The salad I choose had nuts and shrimp; the burger, pesto and chicken.  Ah, it was devine.
This place never disappoints me, healthy menu.  You have to try the chicken pesto fusilli.
Better than the average place , great food and service with a nice atmosphere, one of the best burgers I've ever had

Great place for a quick breakfast. 

Dog friendly outdoor seating. Food came out pretty quick after we ordered.

The Gaucho Bacon Sandwich Combo - $4.50 + $3 - Very good bacon egg breakfast sandwich. The combo was a waste, I needed the coffee but the hash brown was meh. 

PJ Steak Burrito - $7.95 - Steak was very tender. You also get the normal breakfast burrito fillings. I never understand why they give you a small scoop of salsa with your big burrito. I had to go in and get more. 

Overall, good quick meal.

Hands down my go to place for breakfast burritos. They use awesome ingredients like very tasty cage-free eggs, Crushed avocado, and hand-cut seasoned French fries with bomb salsa! Highly recommend Silvergreens. Everyone that works there is awesome friendly!

Also, they a great 4 dollar happy hour menu! With Hoppy Poppy Beer on Tab!

We NEED more of these restaurants, specifically in the bay area!

This restaurant reminds me a 'little' bit of a Panera Bread type place.  They boast about natural and homemade from scratch food.  They have a wide selection of breakfast items, soups/salads/sandwiches as well as hot items like burgers.

I enjoyed their 'threesome' option which was half sandwich, half salad and a cup of soup.  This comes with a cookie but for a small upgrade I got a fruit cup.  The meal was fresh tasting!

I really enjoyed how the receipt prints with your nutritional breakdown of calories, fat, protein and fiber content.  More restaurants should make nutrition information this easy.

I would eat here all the time if I lived in the area!!!

Really! Come & check out the upgraded Silvergreens!! All natural & fresh food & drinks. At the same time your donating for many different special needs programs. Enjoyed the kale & strawberry salad & half chicken tortilla soup/half chicken ranch sandwich. Mm good!

Excellent food and great staff! 
We'rr in Santa Barbara on vacation and this is the only place we go to eat when we don't cook ourselfes. I absolutely love the salads, and my younger siblings love the burgers. Perfect place!

Good burgers. I had the regular Kyle's cheeseburger and added bacon, side of fries. Seasoning was good. Meat quality was good. Sat outside on the patio. Quiet for the 4th if July. Guess everyone was at the beach. Will definitely go back for another meal.

I really like this place even though I've only been once. I would definitely come back if it was closer to where I live. I got a breakfast burrito, it was super good and they printed the nutrition info on the back which rocks! Even though I was a little surprised at the calorie content it was definitely worth working out at the gym a little harder for. I love their menus it is so modern and nice in there. The staff was friendly and accommodated to our free burrito coupons without one annoyed look.  I also noticed they seemed to have a good happy hour. I will definitely be back.

Pretty good food with excellent service. 

The food itself is usually pretty decent. But it can range from decent to poor, sometimes with the exact same menu items. 

But who wants to eat "decent" food when you can eat great food at any number of other places nearby. I didn't find the nutritional information to be that impressive (other than the fact that you can SEE what you're getting.) Most places would end up having the same or similar nutritional count.  I appreciate the effort in helping people realize what they are eating, though.

In fairness, we've given this place a good shot. We've eaten hear at least five times. But I feel like my taste buds aren't picking up anything at all when I'm here.

Silvergreens is an excellent downtown option for a quick, healthy, light meal - stop by in the morning to get a breakfast burrito to go.  The food is light and fresh and you ALWAYS know what you're eating -- the calories of the items you ordered are listed right on the receipt for you.  The BEST attribute of this particular location is the service -- the employees are SO friendly and courteous.  I think the fellow I see in the mornings is named Chad -- he's a customer service superstar -- always asking about my day, never complaining about complicated orders, and setting an upbeat, can-do, example for everyone around him.  Note:  they DO take phone orders, so you can call ahead and have your food waiting to be picked up.  Another note:  their coffee is VERY strong.  Excellent, but very strong.

This place is great!   I stopped here on the "almost home" portion of a road trip and it was just what I needed.  I tend to eat pretty bad while on vacation and a change to something good for me was in order.  Silvergreens delivered the answer.

Healthy options, fresh ingredients and really tasty food.  They mark on the menu whether things are dairy free, gluten free or vegetarian and they serve real meat, cookies and beer.

I only wish I noticed the combination of burger, fries and beer for $10.

Instead I had the Honey Grilled Pineapple Shrimp bowl.  Delightful as it sounds.  It was tasty, filling, guilt free and the shrimp were a decent size.

*Note this review may be inflated by 1/2-1 star for nostalgia (I don't think that it is, but I can't be completely objective either).  Go Gauchos!

Ah salad - 4.5/5
Chicken tortilla soup - 5/5 
Chocolate shake  - 3/5

Definitely glad I stopped here omw to slo looking for a good and quick evening snack

Meh. I guess it was pretty good. The frozen yogurt was HUGE, but most definitely the best part. And it wasn't even that amazing. 
Also, there were way too many options. (pink lemonade or normal?? fries or salad or fruit? what dressing do you want? low-fat dressing or normal?)

Redemption.

The sandwich I had today was awesome and I only returned due to the free sandwich offer that I found in the Independent. 

I had the Turkey, bacon avo concoction while my buddy had the tri tip. Big sandwiches and very fresh tasting ingredients.  

So, Silvergreens. Thank you for the freebie and thank you for changing up your menu.

I will be back.

I love the sandwiches here and even more the chocolate chip cookie you get with it! I went with a few friends and we all really enjoyed our sandwiches and the service was fast! I definitely will be back.
could eat here every day! seriously, amazing food, really really nice people, good service, and a clean environment. organic ingredients for decent prices. love this place.

While Silvergreens caters to local students, and thus may not be a good atmosphere if you are not one, it has to be one of the best food deals anywhere. Very homestyle meals at a cheap price and quite a selection as well. Yes, can also be healthy.

I really wanted to love this place, with its healthy, locally sourced food ( or so they say), chill atmosphere and low prices.  The ceviche tacos were pretty good, although I found the ahi tuna salad a little bland. The warm cookie Sunday was a huge letdown. Cold, day old cookie made it hard to eat and messy since the cookie was hard and would fly everywhere when I tried to part it with my spoon to scoop up with a bite of ice cream. Maybe I'll give it another chance ...but do I really want to be disappointed again?  On the other hand, the service was great and very attentive, better than some places I've been in this college town.

Yeah, I'd totally be back here A LOT if I lived in the area.

After a 3 mile morning run, I wasn't going to waste that on fattening food (saving that for later). Grabbed the Pesto Caprese and Great Greenie smoothie. Both very good!

Give it a try for a healthy breakfast!

My first time here. I ordered the simplest thing on the menu. A small Caesar salad. They really blew it. If you don't mind it being so wet that you mainly taste water, I guess it was tolerable. The croutons were not great though, and the dressing was pretty hard to even taste because of all of the water involved. What else is there to say about a Caesar salad? The price was good and that's the one good point. Otherwise I would pass and look for someone who cared about the food they served. One other thing, the men's restroom was about two steps above a truckstop restroom. Yes, it was that nasty. In downtown Santa Barbara no less.

Silvergreeeeeens, how i miss you. Please build some here in LA. :[

After our weekend vacation from hell was coming to an end, we decided to grab some lunch before heading back home to LA. One of my friends had had it before in IV and said it was bomb, so we decided to give the one in Downtown a try. I was expecting it to be just another chain with mediocre food, but i was wronggg. :)
There was so much that looked good, it literally look me like 10 minutes to decide what i wanted. But finally i decided to just take a bite from each of my friends' orders and i just ordered a Farmers Market Salad & a bowl of clam chowder. All of the meals come with a drink and an option of either a cookie, a side salad, mac n cheese, or fresh fruit. I, being the health freak that i am, opted for the cookie (considering i already had a salad as part of my meal). And i also ordered a side of fries. It says that the soup&salad deal is supposed to be about $8.50, but somehow mine came out to almost $16, haha. Oh well. My clam chowder was delicious and exactly how i like it - super thick but not too many filler ingredients. Mmmm. And my salad was the perfect combination. Although i wish i asked for easy goat cheese. But i was realllly impressed with the quality of the ingredients. The farmers market salad lived up to the name and i felt like i was eating super freshly picked local ingredients. 
I tasted a bite or 2 from each of my friends' meals which consisted of the following:
Classic Turkey
Ahi Tuna Salad
Chicken Pesto MBT
and of course, their delicious fries.

They were all delicious and i could have easily ordered any of them and been really happy with my meal. Butttt in the end i'm glad i ordered my soup and salad. Their fries were kind of the star of the meal though, haha. Mmmmm, so good.

Next time i'm back in SB (which will be soon, unfortunately), i'm definitely going to pop back into Silvergreens. I really wanted to try one of their smoothies cuz they looked so good but i just had no room. Next time. :]
At least ONE good thing came out of our trip.

I'm normally not the type of person who writes review but I couldn't help myself in this case. I remember when this restaurant first opened up and I thought to myself what a great idea and the food is just what was needed in the DT area......and the truth is, I actually still fill this way. Since the opening up of its sister restaurant, Kyle's Kitchen, I've become even more fond of this place. Unfortunately the two times I have ordered Kyle's burgers from here, they have messed up my to go orders and of course you usually don't check your TO GO orders til you get where you're going and get ready to eat it. I don't believe in wasting food and if I took the burgers back they probably would have been thrown out so I ate them. Kiddos to Silvergreens for being there and the healthy food choices, but I give it two thumbs down on register comprehension when ordering Kyle's Kitchen Burgers.

The food is fine just don't use Santa Barbara Menu. The order took an hour and they got it wrong. I would advise to go in person to get the order correct. This is more about Santa Barbara Menus than Silvergreens. 

I had the chicken club and it was ok and the tortilla soup was good. The fries were also good. Salad looked fresh and abundant. Just don't get it delivered By Santa Barbara Menus.

Update: After thinking about it more I think giving 2 stars to Silvergreens was unfair. I'm upgrading to 4 stars as their quality of food is very good and worthy of a more positive rating. My disappointment was with Santa Barbara Menus for their inability to get the order correct and deliver in a timely manner.

Really Tasty, Really Healthy, Really Cheap and REALLY GOOD!

Got the half salad/half soup.  Tahini salad and a white cheddar soup.  SO GOOD.  Cookies are to die for.  This is a great place that has something for everybody.  If I lived here I would eat at Silvergreens everyday!

Silvergreens is the kind of place I like to have around.  I like knowing it's there.  It is missing a certain je ne sais quoi, something that would make me want to go there more often, but it's still a solid option.

The sandwiches are tasty.  The bread is notable.  I usually get the chicken tortilla soup, which is always good.  I've gone for breakfast once or twice.  The waffles are worth trying.  The people working there are remarkably friendly and seem to really enjoy their job, which is a bit unusual for a fast-casual eatery, and makes you feel good about coming there.

The other thing I like about it is that it's a basic, fairly cheap option that's open until 10pm, with plenty of seating.  At the end of a long day if I don't feel like cooking anything, I know I can stroll over to Silvergreens and get a solid meal for under $10.

I think the main missing factor for me is variety in the menu.  The sandwiches they have are good, but they're all basically the same type of thing.  They have a few pasta dishes that don't do much for me.  It'd be nice if they had a few more kinds of meals, like a bowl of hearty chili or a piece of fish or something.  But what Silvergreens does, it does fine --- it's not anything suprt gourmet, but it's solid.

In years past I used to eat at the one in Isla Vista, but since the downtown one opened that's been my main one, because I live nearby.  My impression is that the food quality has improved since I was in college and going to the IV one.

Oh my goodness where do I begin Kyle's kitchen is absolutely amazing the food is fresh healthy and farm to table style we were on a road trip and made a stop in Santa Barbara and found this café I only wish we had them where I live the service was great the food was impeccable what more can I say all-around great place!

Good real food for the price. Sandwiches and burgers were good and was very convince for a hungry group that did not want to wait for traditional sit down restaurant service. We loved the friendly staff, great causes promoted by the restaurant and our daughter loved the chalk board wall!

Came here for a quick bite and got the thai salad and a bowl of white bean chicken soup. The salad was pretty basic and the soup was lukewarm.  We went around noon and most of the tables had dirty dishes from the previous customers. I asked one of the servers if he can clear one of the table for us which he replied he would in a few minutes. He never came back. Fifteen minutes later, another server brought over our food and he didn't bother taking the dirty plates away!
Got half a sandwich and a cup of soup. Both were pretty good. Prepared quickly. The portions were kind of small. Staff just seemed like he hated his job. The cookies are always yummy!

Stopped in for a quick dinner that wouldn't make us feel bloated or unpleasantly full.  Staff was courteous, nice, and attentive.  My wife and I split the Cali Pesto burger and Seared Ahi Salad.  Burger + Beer special everyday after 3pm for $6.  Not the place to go if you want a killer greasy burger, but definitely solid.  Good bun and toppings, and the beef tasted "light".  The salad was very tasty, ahi and avocado were very pleasant.  Bonus it's a green restaurant!  Overall a very nice experience.  Wish we had one in SD!

This place would get 4 stars, if it wasn't for the price. I don't care where you're at or what city you're in, $25 for a half sandwich and a bacon pepperjack burger is a lot, just saying. However, the food was good, I have to admit. The strawberry lemonade was refreshing. The half sandwich was turkey, and it was good. For being a half sandwich, it was a pretty decent size. The bacon pepperjack burger was delicious also. It would appear that this place caters to a more health concious grouip, which is evidenced by the calorie in take you just ordered printed on the receipt lol. I'd never seen that. Even though I thinkit's a bit pricy, I'd go back sand recommend this place, simply because when one travels, you should indulge.

It's location is a good one. It's situated away from the busy shops of State Street, yet close enough to walk over to after you've enjoyed your meal. It kind of has small town charm to it, which is something I appreciate everywhere I go.
This is a great place!! The food is very tasty and healthy. I liked the breakfast burrito and belgian waffles. The prices are very reasonable, with great portion sizes. I love it!!

We've been here once or twice a week since they opened. You are not going to get better broccoli soup with so few calories anywhere - it tastes like cream of broccoli, and the buffalo gorgonzola chicken sandwich is fabulous. The Santa Barbara berry waffle is a large portion topped with whipped cream, strawberries, syrup and sometimes they paint the plate with raspberry syrup  - delicious -  and shockingly low in calories.  The fried green beans are unusual and quite good. Cheeseburgers, FF's, French dips,Thai chicken salad are all winners....honestly the only meal I wasn't crazy about was the tuna salad, but only because of a spice (dill? tarragon?) that didn't appeal to me. Everything else is wonderful, including the staff and managers. We always feel welcomed and appreciated. The prices are more than fair for the quality and portion sizes (use your SB Axxess card for an ongoing 10% discount), and its nice to know you are eating "healthy".  I am a big fan of this place. (Their IV store, unfortunately, doesn't seem to have the same high standards....the 2 meals I had there just weren't as good)

Great food and even better customer service. Today we arrived during a rush when they were pretty short staffed They forgot our order when it came up. It happens but when My wife asked about it they recooked the food and made it right. Definitely a family favorite for all good reasons.
The best servers, cashiers, chef and cooks around town. Always come in for their burgers and BBQ chicken summer salad!! Gah good smoothies too..and fig mountain beer on tap!!!

Excellent little avocado, turkey, and bacon sandwich. I love the fact that they give you the nutritional information on your receipt. And plus, even though it was an up-sell for coffee and tea, I really appreciated the guy behind the counter coming around to see if he could bus our table and ask if we wanted anything else. Seriously, how often to you get table service from places that take your order across the counter???

I went here with a friend the other evening. We wanted a fresh salad and thought Silvergreens would be just the place. Turns out we were way off! We ordered an arugula salad with romaine and quinoa. The romaine was brown in places and the salad overall was forgettable and bland. Truly we regretted choosing this restaurant...CPK is across the street. Now they have terrific salads. Also the wait staff has no personality. And it was a little after 7 (not closing time anytime soon) and one of the guys decided to mop the floors AS we were eating dinner. Dirty floor water ringing through the bucket. It smelled badly and I won't forget the visual. I couldn't help but wonder if he knew he wasn't supposed to be doing this while open for business but wanted to get his job done regardless of whom he grossed out...maybe get off work sooner?! Won't go back- that's for sure!

I was craving a burger and my friend suggested we check this place out. I was in luck because after 3pm they have any burger + beer (or other beverage) for $6. I got the sundried tomato & avocado burger and a lemonade. The burger had sundried tomato pesto, goat cheese, spinach, tomatoes and avocado on a honey wheat bun. The bun was light and a bit sweet, the toppings were all fresh, but I could have done without the goat cheese. It didn't really add much to it.
The fries were good, reminded me of in and out kinda.
It's counter service, but everyone I encountered was friendly.
As everyone else talks about in their reviews, the receipts print out with the nutritional facts for your meal. Kinda cool til you're reminded that a burger is half your fat and calories for the day!
Veggie patty was yummy. Mom had the Makin blue bacon and tortilla soup. All was tasty. Great price.

The 4 stars are for the service which was awesome because I didn't really care for my dish. I got the Thai noodle bowl (not the exact name, but it's the only of its kind on the menu). I once saw a review that said...don't go to an American spot looking for cultural type foods bad thats pretty right on advice. My daughter got the crispy chicken kids meal and it turns out they used the exact same chicken as in my Thai dish. Thumbs down for that. The staff was very pleasant and helpful. From the looks of everyone else's food....it seemed very fresh and good. My husband had the Chiptole turkey sandwich and while not a deli meat lover, he loved it. I would recommend and be back soon.

Kyle's Kitchen's philosophy of giving back to people with special needs just made our dinner that much more enjoyable. 
The stinky pig fries are incredible! Two of us had burgers and two of us had chicken burgers. Everyone was pleased. This place is not skimpy on the avocado on their burgers nor with the bacon or blue cheese on the fries. Next time I will be trying the veggie burger because it seems like this place takes pride in all that they serve.
