I also tried the watermelon mint lemonade and it was sweet and delicious! My husband enjoyed a cold beer while we sat outside enjoying the afternoon.
Their dessert menu with milk shakes and ice cream cookie concoctions looks fabulous; somehow I'll have to save room for dessert next time.

Just got back from Silvergreens and I can hardly contain myself!  I was majorly impressed with this place.  The menu is amazing... I'm on a healthy kick and hate being limited to tofu and quinoa.  There were so many spectacular choices... I decided on a Chopped BBQ salad.  My husband, who isn't on a healthy kick, opted for the Crispy Bacon Western Sandwich.  Upon getting our receipt, we found that the nutrition facts for our meals were printed out on our receipt (thanks to a new gizmo called Nutricate, which Silvergreens is first to use.)  When the food arrived, it was spectacular.  My husbands sandwich wasn't greasy, and looked amazing!  He enjoyed every bite of that thing... the side fries were also amazing (though I wish he would have tried the equally awesome looking green bean fries!)  I got the full salad, thinking the half would be too small and was blown away - it was truly the size of a small child.  I ended up needing a to go box, which I got from the amazingly friendly staff.  As we left, I said thanks to the gal who helped us... all three of the people working also said bye to us as well (which I normally may not have liked, however, they were all amazingly genuine!)  I simply can't wait to go back, which will most likely happen tomorrow, and the next day and the next.  They use all local ingredients when possible and do their part to be eco-friendly.  I am in LOOOOOOOOVE. 5 stars for this place.  I'd give them 10 if I could!

This place is awesome! I wish there was a Silvergreens near me! Everything looks so good! 

I had their cookie monster shake and chocolate banana waffles. Yummy and fresh! The shake was perfect consistency. I'm not down with thick shakes I can't even drink with a straw. Food took a while because my ticket got lost in the system though. :(

Also had some of their catered food on a lunch cruise. Hummus sandwich was a winner. I heard the meat ones were a bit on the dry side though. Hummus win. 

Their receipts have their own calorie count and other nutritional facts! Cool!

Sometimes this place is good. This time when I got my food...I got the tomatoes that I asked not to have and not much blue cheese or bacon of the stinky pig fries. But that's not why I'm writing this. My food was accompanied by a very long black hair that was obviously cooked into it by how hard I had to pull it get it out...after it broke into a second piece I couldn't take.  This was not what I was hoping for.
Amazing seared tuna salad. If I am ever in this area again I will definitely return. The eggrolls were delicious and the green fries were incredibly inventive.

We were driving up the coast and stopped in for breakfast. I found the listing after a quick search on Yelp and so glad I found it. 
The food is healthy and delicious, but can have the waffles if you want them. 
Loved that they put the nutrition info on the receipt! 
Great service and great food.

I really loved the food and the affordable prices at this place! I live in NJ and was in Santa Barbara for a couple of days. I wish Silvergreens had locations closer to home as I'm totally craving their Seared Ahi Salad....yumm!!!!

Really tasty salads and sandwiches.  I love it that the calorie count for everything is in the menu as well as on the receipt.  It really helps keep track of my calories for the day.  It's slightly more expensive than I wish it was...like $2-3 more than other places that have similar foods.

In October, 2012, I hosted a group of 26 nurses celebrating our 45th anniversary from nurses training. The group was in town for 5 days. The weather was perfect, the lodging extra nice and as we enjoyed many activities, among them was, having picnic box lunches delivered to the Old Mission Santa Barbara for an outdoor lunch before taking our tour. The picnic box lunches were truly perfect in taste, nutrition,  color, presentation and the price was great.  The staff at Silvergreens did a wonderful job from the start, in accommodating our orde,r and right on through the finish with delivery on-time, always presenting with their friendly, at--your-service and "can we take your group photo for you"  genuine interest.  I highly recommend Silvergreens for catering your events and BTW, not to mention, don't miss dining at their location downtown Santa Barbara, you will be delighted!

Like this restaurant alot. Good food, clean reaxed environment, happy , high energy staff, nice patio area, moderately priced. Did I mention good food? For what is it I give it a Great!  
Parking can sometimes be a problem, but thats to be expected-after all. It is Santa Barbara:)

UPDATE: 
I am updating my review based upon information I received back from the owner. 

The one time I visited Silvergreens, the employees all appeared to be unhappy and made no effort to welcome me or to show my patronage was welcome. I was told by the owner via PM that it wasn't that they were unhappy, so much as that they were focused on a private event they were attending after work and were just focused on doing what they had to do to close as quickly as possible. I can understand that. It was just unfortunate that it happened on my first visit, otherwise we probably would have laughed about it WITH the staff. Life happens. 

I was not greeted properly, and noticed the prominent tip screen, which he turned in my direction so that I preselect a tip before any service had been provided. I'm not a fan of this. I'd prefer to tip afterwards as an incentive to RECEIVE good service, but I can empathize with servers being stiffed on their tips. Most work hard and deserve better. 'Nuff said. Order placed, I sat myself. 

Although I was the only one there not already eating, it seemed like it took somewhat longer than you would expect for my food to arrive. No biggie - I wasn't running late for anything and I had time. 

My food arrived and without a word was set on my table, and then she left. Never asked how everything was or whether I needed anything, just NOTHING! Never came back again either, although I did see them all doing a LOT of cleaning. I looked around and saw them hustling to clean everything around them, including mopping the floors.

The food is pretty OK. I had the Ahi Tuna salad with drink and side for $15 and change. Not much tuna, but about what you'd expect for the price. It was the service that failed miserably. 

I've since read quite a few reviews and the replies from the owner. He is obviously passionate about the quality of the food they serve, and the way they are perceived. I *LIKE* people that are passionate about food and will try them again sometime. I hope I'm able to post a glowing review then.

Great little burger place doing great thing for children with special needs.   I had the blue cheese bacon burger and it was delicious.   The ice tea was also very good.  Definitely a favorite for the locals.  It was a bit crowded when we went ,  but the staff handled the crowd well.   We didn't wait long for our meal and it was hot off the grill.

8 of us drove down to Santa Barbara for a bachelorette weekend.  We used Yelp andfriend reviews to marrow down our choices.  Silvergrens came highly recommended by both.  We were definitely impressed by the combo options and nuitrition facts on the receipts . I had the grilled chicken and mozerella on honey wheat breat and the free upgraded Thai chicken salad.  The meal even comes with a freshly baked chocolate chip cookie.   Don't forget to check the back of the receipts for future coupons. If you want a healthy and fresh meal then this is the place to be.  Too bad we don't have a Silvergreens in San Francisco...I'd be a frequent customer!!

Great spot for lunch. There are a ton of options on the menu: salads, burgers, sandwiches, bowls, smoothies..just about anything you could want for lunch. The service was quick and friendly and the food was great. They throw the nutritional info on the receipt which is a nice touch.
I can't say it enough.. I'm addicted to the burger with white cheddar. My only criticism is to have mustard out like they do for the ketchup.

Oh, the traditional Thanksgiving table spread! The mild turkey with the tart cranberries and yadda yadda. Think its too cumbersome? Sure its American, but whats more American?

Taking everything and putting two slices of heavenly bread on it! That my friends is Silvergreen's Thanksgiving turkey sandwich. And its damn good.

The warmth and shiny feelings of Thanksgiving in one convenient bite. The pilgrims would be proud...
Love to be healthy but not deprive myself from delicious  food -this place is amazing! My new go to for a healthy lunch!

We are so glad we found this place. She wanted a Cobb Salad and I wanted a burger.  Well this place had lots of choices for each of us. I am sure we could come back and be happy, day after day. The salad was excellent and just the right size, with all the needed flavors. My burger was terrific and the fries were perfect. Just the right amount of crunch.  The ability to sit in or out is great. So sit out side and enjoy the parade in beautiful Santa Barbara.

Awesome service!  Swung by near closing time, but the staff was still super helpful and responsive.  Andres was really nice and gave us great tips on top choices.

The food is an amazing deal - for $10-12, getting a burger AND a hefty side salad is pretty unbelievable.  Tried the chicken avo burger and the ahi tuna salad.  Burger was pretty good, but the salad was exceptional for the price.  Fish tasted fresh, was seared nicely, and came with a pretty good Asian sesame dressing.  Ingredients in everything tasted fresh and high quality. Definitely a place worth checking out again.

Understated exterior and outside signage and it looks like fast food when you read the menus but I absolutely adore this place.  The food is fresh and clean and tasty.  Create your own salad was really a great touch, chicken parm pasta was awesome with a very light tasty red sauce,  western chicken sandwich delicious and the fruit popper (a fruit salad) was super fresh and sweet.  The best thing about this place is not the super-helpful staff or the comfortable interior but the detailed calorie lists on the back of the receipt!!!!  I love this feature!!  It keeps the restaurant honest (so they don't try to tempt you back by overloading the food with grease, salt, and sugar) and it helps me plan what I eat.  I wish we had a restaurant like this in the SF Bay area.

I had to give this place a try after reading all those stellar reviews

Chicken Pesto Sandwich- Just ok. Almost non-memorable. The sandwich was made  healthy, but was very bland in flavor. I had to use a lot of Sriracha sauce to get some taste outta that sandwich.

Potato soup-Good Flavor

Sparkling Cucumber Mint- Had the potential to be great, but fell short! Could have used more lemonade to take away that bitter taste!

Service-Great

Parking-Street Parking

I love their burger & booze special for $8 in the evenings, but I have never been all that impressed by Silvergreens. I like their tomato soup and that they have avocado as a burger option, but that's pretty much where my raving ends. It's not awful, but it's not awesome. The cleanliness isn't up to par with what I'd like to see from a food place. I saw fruit flies everywhere my last visit there. Gross.

5 Stars for the cause. I've got good vibes and service every time I've come to this place, and Kyle's Kitchen definitely lives up to casual dining expectations.

Cause is really good and for the price you get fairly good burgers and tasty Ahi salad.

Bread was probably their most inconsistent part, I've gotten great bread and sometime stale bread, but it's good today. You can't go wrong with any burger to be honest, though the Mountain Burger is my fav. Very nice place for a lunch break for work and stuff.

The food here is average, kinda bland and boring. We ordered the ahi salad (half) and it came with 3 small skinny strips of ahi. Our BLT had some weird mayo on it that tasted like cinnamon, so it ruined the sandwich. Ice tea tasted like chemicals. Our French fries were pretty good so that is why I gave it 2 stars.

My last visit to Silvergreens was the best yet. Maybe it's because I finally found my favorite item on the menu, the grilled shrimp and avocado salad. But it also had something to do with the customer service. They are always nice and efficient. But on this last visit, we had Bill help us and he was super nice. My husband and I will definitely move Silvergreens into our regular restaurant rotation (we eat out quite frequently). It's fresh, offers healthy options and the employees are friendly.

The hamburger here is excellent/good value (4.00+) but not as good as the hamburger across the street at Eureka--the most outstanding hamburger in the industry--(but the Eureka burger there is $10.00+ with fresh fries.) 

We also ordered the fresh hand cut fries ($3.00).  They were very very thin and too oily.   We only order non-frozen fresh cut fries where we go-few restaurants do it.  Wish they could cut them thicker here--I want to taste the potato--not the grease. They should not be any thinner than In and Out fresh cut fries and preferably a bit thicker.  Thicker is better!

No table service--you stand up to order, get a number, and they deliver to the table.

Staff is pleasant.

I like the rest of the menu--looks like a very very good value for this area.  We would return.

I stopped by Tuesday morning for a quick breakfast (place was basically empty). Ordered a Santa Barbara TBA and it ended up late (which I didn't notice, was studying) Someone, I'm assuming the manager, seemed to put a large priority in customer service, because I got a giftcard for another Santa Barbara TBA and got a side of fruit for the delay (fruit was delicious). Yay! Definitely coming back or at least going to the other Silvergreen's in IV more often. Noticed the employees seem to get along really well, and friendly with each other? Adds to the atmosphere (makes everything more tight-knit, friendly, local, etc.) which is a plus for me.
Don't come here for the after 3pm $6 burger deal. The burger was overcooked, dry and tasteless. If I had more ketchup, it may have tasted better. The beer was nice though.

I had 10$ set. Fries are a little bit weak taste and not warm enough. But I like this restaurant except that point. The wall of the restaurant is blackboard and everyone can write down something.  It's good to see:)
Great food, reasonably priced and health conscious. My complaint is they don't wear gloves when they prepare food. Icky- I think I got sick from this place. The other locations must be better.

The food is delicious and the best part is that everything is healthy! Portions aren't too big, but they are filling. The tomato soup is delicious =) The cashier was very nice and helpful, especially when it came to deciding what to get. It was my first time here with my friends, who are a bunch of a girls, and we all know how indecisive girls can be! Definitely a good brunch/lunch spot!

Delicious food, awesome atmosphere and healthy yummy options!! Love all the orange inside too! We came here after our she is Beautiful run and it was perfect! 

Update: 
We decided to come back to Kyle's kitchen... the second year in a row after our beautiful run! We've been back several other times too! It's seriously SO good & I love that dinning here gives back to children with special needs. The food was amazing and we tried the Cookie for the first time. OMG! Hot & fresh!!

Surprisingly delicious and flavorful burgers at a great price! I love that they support people with disabilities and give a little background on their story on the menu.  The service is great! Good luck finding parking. Be careful adding things to your order... they really get you with beer prices and other add ons. My Yerba tea was about $4.50 ! Yikes! I only hope most of that goes to charity then I'm ok with it.
Nice contemporary decor. The food was ok. I had a salad and sandwich. My husband had pasta but he found it tasted like cafeteria food.

I'm giving this place 3 stars only because of the wait to order. I practically lost the will to live. I'm not sure if they were low staffed or if the wait resulted from the people in front of us personalizing the menu to the T!! But it was worth the wait. I ordered the Seared Ahi Salad. It was delicious and came with a honey wheat roll. The ginger was refreshing after walking around for hours. I recommended this place for a healthy, fresh change during your vacay stay.

My daughter and I were on vacation in Santa Barbara and she chose this place for dinner. So good! I love that all the food is sustainable and healthy. The prices are great too. I looked on the website because I was hoping there was a Kyle's Kitchen in Nor Cal I wasn't aware of. I learned that the restaurant is named after a boy with special needs and the menu is all of his favorite foods. The restaurant donates to different special needs organizations. We need more of this. I wish them lots of success.

I ordered the Ahi Tuna Salad from Silvergreens and like that their receipt includes a breakdown of the nutritional value of the food you are about to consume.  This prompted me to not eat the roll that same with my salad.  The ahi was fresh and the salad had a good amount of avocado in it.  The sesame dressing was a perfect pairing.  It will run you about $12 with a drink.
Good healthful food reasonable prices.  Nothing too fancy.  Kind of like a Panera type deal with better food.  I had the Ahi sandwich which was pretty good.

I used to go there a lot like a few times a week but it's too bad that 
I moved to LA and there isn't silvergreens in LA!:(
I always get their ahi tuna salad & the strawberry lemonade. It's delish!!!

What's special about this place is that the service is awesome.
Everyone there is always so happy, nice, and friendly. This is one place
where I gotta stop by when I go back to SB!:)

Love this restaurant and their philosophy of giving back. Great service (they were very accommodating with my son's girlfriend's dietary restrictions). And a super value -- seriously, $5 sandwiches?? -- and delicious.  My kids devoured the stinky pig fries and said the milkshakes were "Awesome!".  I loved the veggie patty (add cheese...).  Highly recommended!!

Unbelievable good quality and prices
If this would be in my neighborhood in Los Angeles it would cost twice as much
Probably the best veggie hamburger I've ever had anywhere
Tasty chicken burger i had but holy cow i could barely find the little chunk of chicken in it! So much bread so little filling!! Next time i feel like eating a bun ill swing by.

The burger was excellent. The bun was so soft! My fries were lackluster, and the longest one was about an inch long, but I think maybe I just got the ones from the bottom of the fryer. They gave me extra garlic aïoli, free of charge so that was really cool. One of the bathrooms was out of order so there was a long line, but it's a really cool spot.

AMAZING RESTAURANT IN THE CENTER OF SANTA BARBARA!
Me and my friends were genuinely surprised by how good this restaurant was! The prices were GREAT, menu was extensive, food was truly tasty, staff was friendly, environment was chill and casual, restaurant's culture regarding solidarity towards children with needs was inspiring, among many other positive things.

I wish it were a chain and could eat there often; I definitely recommend it!!
Amazing Ahi Burger! Comfortable dining room (great music), good service, easy(ish) parking. I've never tried their drinks, but they have a 3-6 daily happy hour that could be fun.
Great hamburgers. I also enjoyed the fire fries! If you want a good burger, this is a great place.
So far all the burgers i've tasted are very delicious! Always come here for my burgers and wouldnt trade them. Best burgers in town !
This place has awesome food and friendly staff. I love the French dip and the cheesburger. I just wish they would have mustard. The hand cut french fries are awesom.
Great relaxed place to have a meal with the kids. also easy to find Keto friendly items.

Healthy food that taste good. I love their choc chip cookie as well and I'm a cookie connoisseur. The staff there is super friendly! El Capitan salad is muy bueno. Sometimes they are busy and you have to wait for your food to made but it's not fast food. I like to call in my order ahead of time and get it to go.

Went in for lunch, ordered Kickin' Cowboy salad, with no cheese, & replace the ranch with  sesame ginger dressing, and add seared ahi. The cash register dude understood and read me back my order, it was correct. When the salad came out, it was missing few of the toppings on it, I politely told them and they were ready to remake it. When the salad came out again, it was still missing one of the toppings. I didn't bother telling them, since I was on my lunch break. I enjoyed the salad had really good flavor. They should just make sure kitchen is actually reading the tickets and doing their work. Sort of disappointed since I barely come here to eat. More of a reason not to anymore.

Ahi salad and the classic kyle's 
Tasty, cheap,  excellent value
I enjoyed everything!!
We stopped here one our way up north the staff was so friendly we ordered the  makin  blue bacon burger it was so good juicy and the blue cheese was perfect

So after a wonderful weekend in Lompoc and Solvang for all the wine fun, we went into Santa Barbara to grab some lunch and walk around. 

I checked the yelp app to see whet was around the area to try out and came out with this place. So we parked in one of the many parking garages and walked it over. 

When you walk in you grab a menu and order your food and the register and then seat your self and they give you a number stand for your table to bring your food out to you. I ordered the western crispy chicken sandwich. It was a crispy chicken breast topped with BBQ sauce, bacon, and cheese on a ciabatta roll with lettuce and tomato!! So delicious!!! It came with a side of fruit and we ordered some fries. Sitting outside in the patio area just completed the great experience. The staff was very nice and informative.

Will definitely come back here if we are in Santa Barbara.

Pick Kyle's over eureka. Having been to both, definitely think Kyle edges out eureka.

$11 gets you burger fries and a drink.

Looks like 3-6 is a happy hour that saves you a couple bucks.

Parking is across the street and free if you're done in 75mins.

Tip: order Togo or online at Kyle's kitchen website. ( if you order on grub hub/ yelp app it's 50 cents more for each item). 
 
The first time we tried Kyle's Kitchen was at the Goleta location and we were not impressed. But after trying this location we actually enjoyed it. The double K was actually filling and they made my wife's fries soft, the way she likes it. I like how they use cheddar cheese on their burgers (most places like In-N-Out uses American). The double k felt like I was eating 2 double doubles at In-N-Out and both fries tasted similar-except Kyle's kitchen fries are better because they are a little fatter and more moist. Next time I may try out some shakes.

This restaurant used to be pretty good (mostly back when it was Silvergreens), but it's a disaster now. They have a board with seasonal specials, but never have the actual ingredients to make them, and don't bother telling you until after you order and they hand your order to you. For the third time now, I've ordered the buffalo fries and they gave us our order and said they're out of buffalo sauce. It's literally 1:30pm -- this has also happened less than a half hour after they've opened -- so it's not like it's the end of the day. And then they say they're not making anymore, sorry. How hard is it to tell a customer that when they order so they can not order the item if it isn't as advertised? It's not that hard. Or better yet, how about don't offer a seasonal item if you can't actually make it? On top of that, their homemade veggie burger is gross and super carb-heavy (do not order it if you're a type 1 diabetic!). I'd rather have an Impossible Burger from the many nearby places instead. I give up on this place.

As usual for Kyles Kitchen, we were not disappointed. Fair prices, great service, clean restaurant and most importantly, excellent burgers. The vegan burgers were a hit also. Always on our list when we are in SB.

My husband and I ate here before a show on state street. It was happy hour, 3-6pm, and found the place to be welcoming. We order two glasses of wine, burgers and sides. Everything tasted great! The wine was amazing and our bill with happy hour was only 33$!! The only thing that kept me from giving this 5 stars was that they kept playing Micheal Jackson every other song. It really put a damper to the atmosphere.

My family and I overall had an A+ experience here starting with the awesome service! We were helped by a young man name named Brian (very tall guy) who was super patient and helpful! Food was delicious and the beer was cold!

Terrible customer service. I got an Ahi salad to go. I got home and there was no dressing at all so it was a crappy dry salad with brown avocado chunks and a stale bread roll. I called to complain but they were unapologetic.

Salads are way over priced. I got the large kickin' cowboy for a total of $14.14. To add chicken it cost $3.50, I got 1 tiny piece of chicken sliced into 5 mini strips. The flavor was great, but for what you get, it should be 8 dollars max. It was not filling what so ever. 

South coast deli is still the best place in town- gigantic salad, tons of chicken for $9.50.

So many options, including vegetarian ones! AND they taste very good! The man who helped me was also extremely friendly - he struck up a quick conversation with me while I was paying. Another man also genuinely cared about how I was enjoying my meal. GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE! Best I've experienced in awhile.

They sell themselves to be better sourced fast food but it's just as thoughtlessly thrown together and the flavor is probably less. I got the earth burger and it was not good. Pretty sure it was a boca burger which i stay far away from. The fries were cold and when i told the kid that brought me my food he laughed. Really? That's how you respond instead of offering to bring hot ones? It's just frustrating to pay for sub par food and have the kids who just don't care working there. But i digress and that is a bigger issue as a whole. I will never go back and if your vegetarian i suggest that you stay away.

I'm always scared when I order delivery because If it's not done right you are a bit stuck.  This order came exactly as requested.  The tomato basil soup was delicious and while I was hesitant to order the kale salad and initially thought that there wasn't enough salad dressing, after tossing a few times it was really really tasty.  I had the kale and cranberry salad.  Healthy and yummy! I will order from them again when back in town for sure.

Found this place on our last night in town, wish we would've discovered it earlier. Split the ahi and chicken pesto burgers w/ fries and drink deal with the hubby. The food was so delicious, I didn't know I even liked arugula and the fries taste like In N Out. We ended up making 3 transactions cause I ordered a burger to go and couldn't leave without trying the ice cream. Staff was friendly and accommodating considering it was close to closing. Wonderful experience, amazing value, quality food, delicious ice cream.
Had dinner here tonight and it was great! the lemonade is delicious, service is friendly, lots of seating.
Chicken Caesar salad was very very fresh. Milkshakes were real and had actual fruit. Receipts also show total nutrition for you meal which is helpful. Vegetarian friendly and great food!

Thank goodness Silvergreens is one of the food delivery options serviced through Restaurant Connection since my hubby and I were exhausted from our long day, but didn't want to leave our hotel room (we were also recovering from our illness and starving).

We attempted to eat a pizza we brought back to our room at the recently now-closed restaurant located in the same building of the hotel we were staying at (Hotel Indigo), but it was so horrible, that we threw it away after a few bites in.  We were still starving, so I searched frantically on my phone's Yelp app for a decent restaurant that delivered in the area.

Fortunately, Restaurant Connection and Silvergreens fulfilled our simple requirements.  I ordered the tomato basil soup, mandarin crunch salad with chicken and my husband ordered the chicken alfredo pasta entrée.

Our dinner was delivered to our hotel room in a matter of 45 minutes and all three orders were delicious and full of flavor. I loved that my soup was still piping hot.  The salad had so many tasty ingredients and they put a generous serving of it in my above average salad.  I was really satisfied with our dinner that I nearly called the restaurant to tell them that, lol.

We enjoy quick getaways to Santa Barbara, so the next time we find ourselves back here, we will certainly grab a meal at Silvergreens since we were super happy with everything we've tried so far.
Solid yummy burgers, delicious fries (try the fire fries), soups and the best shakes in town.

I enjoy Kyle's for price. They have some good burger options. The patties are a little on the small side so "double up" if you enjoy some beef. I like the Mountain Climber spicy jalapeno burger option. They also have a decent (six) local beer selection on tap and serve wine by the glass. The kids really love the ice cream bar. Cones (1 2 or 3 scoops), ice cream sandwiches. shakes or sundaes. They have kids meals and a nice long happy hour 3-6pm. Happy hour offers $4.50 for all kids meals and beers on tap and burgers for $6.50. Parking is limited, but you can park for free across the street in the public parking lot (at the mall) 75 minutes. My only complaint would be the fries are consistently cold when they are served. Next time I'll try just asking for them to make sure they're hot.

Got the Ahi Tuna Salad and the Earth Burger! Soo good! The salad dressing and salad was my favorite. The burger was flavorful too but the patty was a but too squishy for my liking. But the food is good price for a filling meal. Also the proceeds go back to the community which is amazing

I wish I could give this place a -5 stars. For the amount of trouble it takes me to get an order on time and correct I am already turned off when I get my food oh. They finally got rid of Gianna, she was passive aggressive and wouldn't even greet you and bust everyone around while she just watched. But the new people seem to have no common sense and the cooks appear to run the show they make the order as they please and do whatever they want. I really don't know how this place stays in business honestly they need some type of customer service education On a weekly basis!

We had an excellent lunch of California club, rustic Tuscan and ahi in my body. All were fresh, warm and tasty - and cost less than dining at 5 Guys, for example.

Limited Gluten Free options, but one can order a burger in a lettuce wrap. French Fries are mot cooked in a dedicated fryer, so those with Celiac avoid fries.

If I could eat here every day, I would.

I got the Earth burger (veggie patty, sprouts, avocado, caramelized onions, tomato, and arugula on a wheat bun). BEST BURGER I've had in a while! The first thing that came out of my mouth after biting in to it was "ohmygod". The burger was stacked with ingredients, and for $5, I considered it a steal! The bun was SO soft and warm - I couldn't get enough of it. While a lot of other veggie patties are flavorless and dry, this one was well seasoned and you knew exactly what was in it (you can see the quinoa held together by chickpea mash). The caramelized onions also added to the amazing flavor of this burger. Even if you're not a vegetarian, you should give this burger a try! 

My boyfriend got the cheesy pig with a side of chicken noodle soup - all for $10! The soup was alright (good amount of chicken and not too salty), but the real star of the show was his burger. It had two pieces of bacon on top of a big slice of cheddar cheese. According to him, the bacon was cooked "juuust right - not too crunchy, not too soft". The brioche bun was crispy, light, and buttery without being overbearing. 

We both walked out of there feeling just the right level of fullness and very satisfied. I'm already counting down the days till I come back to Santa Barbara for another delicious meal at Silvergreen!

This is a really good spot to get a classic burger I like how they switch it up and make everything to your likings also I enjoyed the craft beer menu and also the many desserts they offer definitely a spot for any local that has lived in town and wants to try something new and off the edge

Great food at a green restaurant? You can't beat that! My friends and I discovered this place from an ad in our hotel's magazine. That quarter of a page looked delicious so we decided to check it out. The place wasn't hard to find and parking was a breeze even for a Saturday evening.

I had the half-size Ahi Tuna salad that was big enough to be called full-sized. It was super tastey and came with a wheat roll. My friends enjoyed their dishes as well. The place is very casual but well-decorated and branded. I truly appreciate the fact that they're a green restaurant and focus on healthy eating for its patrons. Highly recommended!
Food is good, employees are really nice. I've always been pleased by my experiences with Silvergreens

This was my first time to this place. I was excited to try since the reviews looked so good! I ordered the veggie burger which was luke warm upon arrival to my table. I'm not sure if it was cooked all the way through, I'm assuming so, however it was a mushy veggie burger. Terrible. The fries were cold as well, you can see the cheese in the picture was not even melted on the fries. Wow...I was extremely disappointed to say the least! My pitcher of beer was the only good thing....

To help sober up from our wine tastings we ended up at Silvergreens near State St. because i was in the mood for a classic juicy bacon cheeseburger. Too bad i didn't get one. We waited until 3pm for their burger and beer for $6 special which seemed like a good deal but maybe they have a secret why. The burger came out really fast, which surprised us, because the meat seem really cooked through for being made so fast. I have to wonder if these were burgers that missed the lunch crowd so they just pass them off with the beers hoping no one will notice.
This place is marvelous. Very reasonably priced and super fresh and imaginative. Love it
Best Burgers there! I had Kyle's Classic and it was delicious. The staff were nice and friendly.

I love the concept of giving back to special needs!!! Please keep that up and consider decoding dyslexia California!  Most of the food was great. I'm not happy about the grilled cheese for kids. My kid wouldn't eat it. I'd like for them to also have gluten free bread too. Ideally it would be nice to have feedback forms in the restaurants too. I would have preferred to fill out a form than leave feedback here. Overall good experience

This restaurant has awesome ideologies in terms of dishes but poor execution. My fries are rock solid every time I go with my boyfriend, dropping more than 30 dollars and my fries come out horrendous every time. Last time I went there was PLASTIC, I repeat A PIECE OF PLASTIC in my fries and I demanded new ones and never ever went back. I'm super sad because I did like this restaurant but the lack of cleanliness and no desire from the employees to clean up the tables and how they'd much rather leave flies to clean up the tables for them is making this place a sure bust.

This is by far the worst location of Kyle's we ordered through grubhub, the driver arrived at the restaurant and the staff told the driver it will be a while. The driver was there for 35 minutes with constant communication to myself and updating the ETA. He said that he knew this particular location is the worst when it comes to ticket times out of the three kyles. Please train your staff to be more efficient and ANSWER THE PHONE!!

We went here for dinner the other night and the food was good. However, the staff was playing very explicit songs. The songs continually sad the N word and B word. Which was pretty surprising to me since I have always seen kyle's kitchen as a place for families. I'm just happy it was toward the end of the night and there weren't any children in the restaurant.

First time to Kyle's Kitchen on Calle Real and was not disappointed. Rustic Tuscan Chicken was cooked perfectly and seasoning was spot on. And you can't beat homemade croutons on Farmhand salad. It will definitely be added to my lunch rotation. Thank you so much Marcos for my perfect lunch. Staff was on point and dining room looked clean

New on yelp and this is the first place that I want to review. Had bad experiences at isla vista location, but decided to give this one a chance because of a buddy's recommendation. He said "the service there is awesome," so I went and discovered that this location is WAY better than the iv. This location cares more about customer service. My order was taken by the asian girl that works there. Usually when i go to other places for food, they don't really care much to make conversation. but this gorgeous girl was really friendly, charming, and greeted me before i even walked through the door. the fact that she was so enthusiastic and cute made me not even care about the fact that i was spending more than i normally do on food. it is a little pricey, but i guess it makes sense since they use local and natural ingredients according to their web site. i ordered a half sandwich and salad. buffalo crispy chicken and mandarin chicken salad. both hella bomb. i ordered to go so when i was sitting down waiting, i observed the way everyone there works. the asian girl is so fast. she was running around the whole time doing both cashier, food handling, and bussing tables, and the mexican guy in the black shirt was really chill. he handed me my food and asked if i needed anything else, and i asked to add a few more cookies to my order and he didn't even charge me for it! every time i go to iv, everyone there looks like they hate their lives and the manager doesn't seem really friendly. i'm closer to the iv one, so i really wish their customer service was better. i think the asian girl that i met when i went here should go work there. i'd definitely show up there everyday if she was there! really sad that i didn't get her name lol. but anyway, this downtown location is awesome. wish they were open later though.

Place was pretty empty, placed two orders total of 4 burgers given number and went and sat down. 28 minutes later the first order came out WRONG, was quickly corrected however both burger and fries were brought even colder than room temp... About 12 minutes later 2nd order came out COMPLETELY SOMEONE ELSES ORDER. the guy slammed the receipt down and said THIS IS WHAT YOU ORDERED, however it wasn't even my order . I informed the KID the food was cold he snatched the burger out of my hand and shoved it in his mouth.... I was dumbfounded OH AND I WAS TOLD THERE WAS NO ONE IN CHARGE, THAT THE MANAGER NEVER COMES IN! 
I surely hope my visit was a fluke, but if 0 stars was an option, that is what I would have chosen

The ahi salad was super tasty and I love the tartness of their berry lemonade. I've ordered a chocolate milkshake through GrubHub before and I was disappointed to receive it extremely watery (not because it was slightly melted but because it was almost all milk) and practically vanilla--there was barely any taste of chocolate. Dining in has definitely been a much better experience in terms of food quality

Well we waited 50 minutes & they were not even that busy.  Too bad because our Burgers & fries obviously were sitting.    The burger patty heated the lettuce & tomato up so it was wilted & yucky & the fries were cold so they were soggy!
Disappointed!

First time here, I loved it. When I got there it there was not much ppl so I was able to place my order quick. Within 5-10 mins my order was brought out to me. Burger was delish, as well as the fries. I also bought a cookie and I devoured it within seconds lol. The atmosphere is very nice and it was super clean. I also noticed they help people who are facing challenges in life. For example, one of the employees was training a young man with Down syndrome on certain tasks. I thought that was awesome! 10/10 will be back for sure!

Been here twice in the last month. Delicious food and wonderful service. I love the fries...I could eat a few servings easily. Also love and support the concept behind this place. Will continue to come back and recommend it to others as well.
I am very disappointed! Bad service and messed up the order my burgers were cold and uncooked fries over all just bad food couldn't eat any! Second times this has happened will not be going back.

This place was excellent! We got three different burgers to go, and all were delicious. Loved their french fries and seasoning as well. Affordable prices, great menu selection, and nice staff. If you are craving a tasty burger and fries, I highly recommend this burger joint! Went to location in Santa Barbara and pick up was easy (ordered online in advance). Also loved their jalapeno ranch!

I would no go back...
Its not cleaned at all. Burger is fulllly cooked, dry, fries are dry. Not a place I would recommend to friends.
Great veggie burger.  Good service.  Setting outside in the beautiful weather is a plus at this location.

First time there I was the only customer that ordered food. The burger came out like a dry hockey puck and the fries were not even warm. They were hard, gross and greasy. Not sure what all the hype is about. I understand the whole premise behind the restaurant but that doesn't excuse them from being lazy and putting out subpar quality food. Also the girl who was working the cash register had no clue as to any of their menu items what it comes with the food. Management needs train their people and their Cooks.

Yummy grass fed beef burger on homemade bun. Free soda/tea refills. Outdoor patio socially distanced dining. Quick, friendly. Very satisfying burger! Healthy (as can be) Fries, I was eating a REAL potatoes. Crispy onions on burger adds nice gourmet crunch. Will be going back next time I am in Santa Barbara. Very good value for $. Thanks!!

Silvergreens is the best soup/salad/sandwich/pasta place in all of Santa Barbara! I think their standout items are the salads, but many of the other items are top notch as well, you cant go wrong. The burger/fries/beer special after 3pm makes other happy hour specials look pathetic, and they have a pretty tasty beer selection to top it off.
I will 100% be back!!! The two girls working tonight were so great!! My goofy friends and I will be back!

This place is perfect! Prices great! Food phenomenal!   

Spicy chicken avocado and fries! Definitely a must when in Santa Bárbara.
What can I say? Looking for a really good burger, fries and drinks with excellent service? Nothing fancy. Just really good.. Enjoy!

These guys were great, super friendly, communicative (I forgot to tell them what kind of meat I wanted on my burger so they called me!), and the food was really good! I got the arugula salad, I thought it would be good, but it was REALLY good! Clean place, cool decor and ambiance. HIGHLY recommend.
Kyle's Kitchen is one of my favorites and I dine there every time I visit Santa Barbara. Very friendly staff, great quality at a very reasonable price. I wish they come to Bay Area one day.
Affordable yummy eat options, fun atmosphere and get the cookie they recommend (snickerdoodle)! I'll go again...and bring a friend!

Kyles kitchen is probably the least guilty burger I love to eat! You can taste fresh ingredients, and there has never been a time where customer service lacked its standards. All of the employees treat you like their care about your order and the quality of their work! You can't go wrong with their food. If you not in the mood for a burger their salads are also filling and delicious.

While on a recent trip to Santa Barbara my wife and I ate at Silvergreens and the food was really good.  My wife had the Sesame Seared Ahi salad and I had the Turkey, Bacon Avocado sandwich with a side of fries.  Everything tasted great and the service was really good.  I also like that they strong focus on giving back to the community.  On our next trip to the area this will definitely be stop that we will hit for lunch.

Kyle's kitchen is the best! Every item on the menu is fire and the quality is even better. I like how you're always able to customize your food items and the food is always fresh. Never disappointed and probably one of the best food spots in Santa Barbara / Goleta! Thank you Kyle's Kitchen, much love!!!

3 stars because the food was good and not too soggy for delivery. Don't order online. We just ordered dinner and asked for grilled onions on a burger and double protein on a salad (didn't get either). I also wrote that I am allergic to peanuts, so hope they get that one right :)
Service was great, food came out fast, and the food was amazing! Definitely will be coming back next time i'm in SB!
It was really good. I really enjoyed my meal when I came to visit. This was my first time eating here and I will definitely come back when I visit Santa Barbara again :)

This review is in regards to a large delivery for a socially distanced event I was hosting. I ordered online well in advance and even called the next day to make sure everything came through on the order (of over $300). I had the delivery time scheduled for 30 minutes before I needed it just in case it was late. 
After 30 minutes past the delivery time we called and they said they weren't done yet and the person who was going to deliver it wasn't there either. We waited another 15 minutes then drove over ourselves to pick up the food. We got back and a bunch of the orders were wrong and one was missing. I had to drive back to get the missing order which was supposed to be vegetarian and they gave me a chicken sandwich.
Overall not great. So I left a message with someone to have the manager call. No return call. Emailed. Was not responded to. Left a one star review and suddenly got an email from them saying they were working to figure out what went wrong. That was a month ago and no one has followed up since. 
While I genuinely enjoy this food and in-restaurant eating or take away is great, I'm so disappointed in the handling of this huge catering order I have to give one star.
I love this place and i love the concept. I order a salad with fries on top, and they dont laugh. Both my boyfriend and i eat here all the time and its always great.
Kyle's Kitchen has personally reached out to me to rectify this situation. They handled it with very much empathy and understanding. I will definitely be giving them another try!

It was my first time in Santa Barbara, and I decided to stop here for a quick lunch. The menu was simple and not overwhelming so deciding on what I want wasn't too difficult. I wanted to get something healthy and light because I knew I was going to get ice cream later, so I went with the Thai Peanut salad. I got it as a side (which turned out to be huge) with my brother's burger. The salad actually was my favorite out of everything. I took a small bite of the burger, but it wasn't as good as my salad surprisingly. I loved how the salad was crispy from the peanuts and crispy wontons! Their lemonade was pretty good as well. I highly recommend coming to Kyle's Burger if you're in Santa Barbara!

After two visits at Kyle's Kitchen, they have yet to disappoint me with their burgers. When you bite into their burgers, the juice from the meat comes out and the brioche bun is perfectly crisped. Their mountain climber and firefighter burgers are must try! A great place for you to try if you're looking for a quick snack during your break.

This is a great place for a burger! My favorite thing - actually it was the first thing I ever ordered and I just haven't strayed since - is the Kyle Burger and the small Ahi salad. The burger has always been good and the Ahi salad is so good and fresh. I typically call in the order (easiest thing to do on the go for me) and the staff/service is always good and efficient. 
Also, supporting this business also supports a really great cause, which is a huge plus!
Really good quality food at super reasonable prices. It made me very happy to find a place like this you can go back to consistently. Veggie burger was great.

Food 4.5
With $11 I got a small salad and a whole burger! And it's delicious! And I didn't even mention they have many great choices!  5 stars is not only belong to expensive high-end restaurant :) 

Service 5
Great waiter! Patient and they serve you like they really care about you! 

Environment 5 
The location is so convenient :) love it

Yes, I love their food but every time I placed an order for delivery, they always missed an item. These was the second time. First, it was my soup. Now m, it's the seared ahi salad from paired-it. Which was I'm expecting to have it for my dinner aside from my burger. We're paying it right, but they don't fulfill your order. Then if you call them, they're going to tel you, oh we. Can't do it right now. Refund?
open for dine in indoors and outdoors, food was priced well, delicious, and service was quick! employees were super nice.  highly recommend!

Veggies burger was awful. Wasn't cooked through, and the burger build itself was both missing ingredients listed on the menu and particularly tasteless. Fries were very stale. But the weirdest of all, despite being one of two customers in the restaurant, it took 20 mins to get the meal?? Not sure what took 20 mins when the patty wasn't even cooked.

I sometimes come here with my sister and get drinks and food. I really like the Bacon and egg burger and the firefighter burger. Their drink selection is decent but I like the food more. I would recommend it.
Delicious food, yummy juicy chicken & the cheeseburgers are so good with so much flavor!  great service too! Even the prices are great!
Great food, we stopped off on our road trip up the coast and had the best lunch. Great staff and quality food for a great price. I hope to come back!

I love kyle's kitchen and what they stand for but the service I received today was really off putting. I am strictly vegan and asked the cashier if the veggie burger with side salad was ok to eat, she said yes. I was told that it in fact wasn't vegan when they brought my food to the table, which was upsetting because I would have just ordered something else if I knew in the first place that this meal wouldn't accommodate my dietary restrictions. I proceeded to eat my salad (which I had to pick croutons out of because cashier didn't notify me that none of the breads are vegan). I couldn't stomach eating this burger, and was put on the spot earlier to make a decision whether or not I'd eat it. I brought it back and asked nicely if maybe I could just get refunded because I was told this was vegan, it's not, and I wasn't planning on eating it, and the manager said no because it was already made :-( I hate wasting food, and again I would have just ordered something else if I knew. He gave me 25% off my meal which is better than nothing, but left a bad taste in my mouth because none of this was my fault. He finally offered to lettuce wrap my burger after all of this was said and done...I left feeling high maintenance and guilty for even coming in the first place. I have no problem with just ordering a salad at a burger place but I really wish the cashier was more knowledgeable, and the supervisor was more accommodating and friendly.
Delicious!  Great Prices!  Friendly Staff!  First time visit - party of 11 - very accommodating.  We tried many items off the menu. Each resin proclaimed their choice was the best.
Great food and outdoor dining! Very clean and bathrooms were open for customers inside.

I had Silvergreen's Chocolate Chip Banana Belgian Waffle. They were delicious and savory. I felt the waffle was too rich, so that's minus one star. The combination of maple syrup and powdered sugar with banana was really too much.

But there was free wifi which is always a plus.
Love the veggie burger!! The best veggie burger I've had in my life (and I've been a vegetarian for all 26 years of my life, so I've had a lot of veggie food haha)

i love finding healthy places when i travel out of town.  we came across this place because we saw the menu card at the hotel lobby. checked yelp reviews, the price and menu looked good so off we went.

it's not hard to find as it's right at the corner of a pretty busy street. the place was pretty crowded on a saturday afternoon when we arrived. there are lots of healthy options on the menu but we both went with the half & half combo for $8.29; i had the half chicken tortilla soup and half hummus delight on honey wheat with a side of mixed fruit, he had the half seared ahi salad and half hummus delight on french baquette with a side of "brookie" (its a brownie cookie). i love how the nutritional information of exactly what you ordered is printed right on your receipt! some people dont care for that type of information, but if you're trying to eat healthy, it's definitely great to know. btw, they charge more if you choose the "premium" salads.

there is ample seating throughout the restaurant (there are three different sections). TV's in each section which is kind of nice. they even have various ice teas available in addition to the regular soda machine. the food was pretty good, i was slightly disappointed with the hummus delight because the flavor of the big slab of mozzarella cheese overshadowed the thinly spread amount of hummus in the sandwich. the taste is good together but i think they could have put more hummus in the sandwich. my tortilla soup was "SOUPER"! (i know, corny)  my total calorie count for the entire lunch was 482. not too shabby.

i've read so much about their beer and burger happy hour that i will have to come back and try it next time i'm in town.

We were on vacation in SB and tried Kyles Kitchen and loved it!  So reasonably priced for what taste like gourmet burgers.  We got the Mountain Climber burger and Spicy Chicken Avo burger and both were amazing.  I usually prefer beef over chicken but man the chicken was so tender I think I might choose that if I could only have one!  My Husband and I shared the two burgers and both loved them!  Fries were delicious too!!!  This is a must try!!!
Had it delivered really quick delivery . Food was really good . Only issue soup didn't come with roll as pictured on menu . It looked good ! Was looking forward to it . Altogether good experience .
Good, fresh, and simple.  Great place to grab something light.   To make me feel even better about myself, the nutrition facts are printed on the receipt.  Nice!

I have gotten Kyle's Kitchen in the past and I have loved. I feel like since the pandemic has started their quality has decreased and their detail to order has diminished. I have doordashed with Kyle's Kitchen and they have forgotten my sides of dressing and drinks to the order. What upsets me more is they did not remove the tomato from the burger, I am not just able to simply remove the tomato because I am allergic. The tomato juice is now on the meat and lettuce which makes it impossible for me to eat the burger. Good food when made properly but quality is better if it's for dine in.

I still want to love kyles kitchen but recently when we have been receiving our orders messed up. This is like 5th time but I never say anything until now that I'm fed up. Also the they leave the patty super pink when asked well done. I hope this review is seen by someone in charge of kyles kitchen because my whole family and friends are kind of grossed out with the pink patties and the blue cheese when told not to put blue cheese.

They have great service here. My family and I always order for pick-up and the food is always ready in a reasonable amount of time and is delicious (especially the Seared Ahi Salad and the Western Crispy Chicken Sandwich). The portions are also a good size. This is my go-to place where I know the food will always be delicious.

Best burger in town, great fries, great crew.  Only ever gotten take-out here, though it seems like a nice family friendly vibe.  Their fries are always delicious and fresh. I've never gotten soggy fries!

If you are in a rush.. You may want to pre order your food. With that being said.. I got the firefighter burger with a Cobb salad. Salad was classic cob. The bacon seemed a bit better than usual. Salad was fresh. The sandwich was pretty good. It had the char - taste to it. Meat wasn't too salty and I found out. I got exactly what I paid for. I know I will be back.

This is THE go-to spot for a casual lunch away from the office! Such a great location downtown next to Paseo Nuevo. The food here never disappoints! Food is consistently good, and offer a wide selection of burger and salad style on their menu. My favorite combination is the Classic Kyle paired with fries and a fountain beverage! It's delicious, filling, and cheap! I love that they accept SB Axxess card and have a rewards program. 

Food: Other than their main burger, I recommend trying their "Rustic Tuscan" or "Earth Burger". Both are great alternatives to red meat. Favorite salad is either the "Thai Peanut" or "Classic Ceasar". Both are provided with ample toppings and just the right amount of dressing! Their buns are handmade and Oh, so delicious! Their fries are to die for, too! They melt in your mouth and it's hard not to eat them all....

Service is very friendly, quick, and amazing... food comes out very quickly with everything you need! Totally recommend this place to anyone looking for a casual lunch spot.
Ordered burgers and fries for take-out. The food is delicious and reasonably priced. The staff was friendly and efficient. Highly recommend!

Worst experience ever. Went in high hopes because such heard such amazing reviews about new chicken sandwiches. Ordered 3 chicken sandwiches, waited 20 minutes to be brought out chicken tenders on bread. No sauce and when asked for new dressings that came with was brought caesar dressing. Drink machine was not working, and offered no resolution. Spent $40 on dinner and was not offered any kind of refund or apology. Would not recommend.

Food: veggie burger and large Farmhouse salad with vinaigrette on the side. Everything tasted fresh and their homemade veggie patty was really soft, most and tasty. Given that we are new to PBD, this place was a hit for us. Even family we were visiting enjoyed their chicken club and hamburgers and salads. They also have a kids menu. 

Service: order at the counter inside and they bring the food to you. Friendly service. 

Dog friendly patio was a plus for us!!

Will definitely be back next time in the area!!

Called in advance about 30 mins before closing, was told by the employee on the phone that they could not take a phone order but I could come in and grab my item (bowl of soup) upon arriving they had apparently sold out of the soup hours before, this would not be a big deal but had driven 20 mins from an adjourning town(Carpinteria)l

Great spot for fresh food! I love the decor and the motto of this restaurant- eat real food! They make sure that their food is made with fresh and locally sourced items. Found street parking and then ordered at the front. Staff are knowledgeable about the menu and can help you decide on what to get. I ended up getting the orange miso shrimp avocado salad upon the suggestion of one of the staff. I didn't really like my dish though :/ I think what killed it for me was the orange miso dressing. It was super sugary and it felt like I wasn't eating anything healthy even though I was eating a lot of greens :( My other friends ordered a chimichurri tri-tip and a burger. They really liked their dish so I think I just made a bad choice. I would give this place another try the next time I'm in the area.

This is such a great place to eat, I am glad to see them doing well and now having this second location in Santa Barbara.
Service is wonderful, you instantly feel welcome, the vibe really in great.
Awesome menu, great selections, I love both their veggie burger as well as the ahi, the guys loved the burgers, salads were very fresh.
Portions are generous, prices very fair, especially for the area.
Food was made to order quickly and everything was as requested.
Wonderful addition to the area, perfect for families and an affordable but still delicious meal, highly recommended!

Fresh - the salads were good. I had the california chicken club it was good, the soup was ok tasted alittle like Campbell's soup. The firehouse was not fresh, it tasted reheated over all the food was good and reasonably priced,

Lunch visit.  I ordered the crispy chicken sandwich, which may be a new menu item. The fried chicken portion was too small for the bun size. The chicken had an overcooked interior, and the piece itself was too thin compared to say Chick-fil-A or Habit Grill.  Napkins were not brought out with food. Fries came out cold. Uncensored rap music in the backyard inappropriate for children.
This was my first time at Kyle's kitchen I came in from out of town and loved the service. The location was very clean and Mercedes was very friendly. I will Definitely be coming back.
I ordered a Earth burger. I asked for a chicken patty added. They didn't charge for it and delivered quickly. Above and beyond.

Great selection of fresh salads and and sandwiches.  Wonderful
Presentation and taste. Place has a Patio and dog friendly. Great value for what you get. Can't wait to go back when visiting the area.

I am leaving this review solely based on the service. I ordered a head and my order was ready, they were just waiting on fries. I have done this before and it takes 1 minute usually for them to get the fries and put it in the bag. I waited 20 minutes before I saw fries go up the pass, and then they sat there for another 10. I was about to say something when another person came to pick up their order. The staff informed her the order was ready and that they just needed to put the fries in her bag. They then proceed to give her the fries on the pass that I had been waiting for! I had to interject at this point ask the employee why she got the fries that I had been waiting for 30 minutes. The employee didn't have an answer and just said "oh". I almost cried because I felt the staff had forgotten I was there but I was standing at the counter waiting the entire time. This location needs more employees for dinner rush, because they give or so working there clearly could not handle it. I'm sorry to say this. Very disappointing.
It's was good!!!!! I had the burger with mushroom and BBQ and crispy onions. Mmmmmmmmmmm and their lemonade is so good. I had the berry one. When I'm back to SB , this is where I'll be going.

First time I ordered from here.  Ordered the spicy crispy chicken sandwich, the OG crispy chicken sandwich and the ahi burger with fries and drinks.  The chicken sandwiches and ahi burger were good.  The only disappointment was the fries.  The fries tasted stale and was luke warm. My daughter goes to school at UCSB and has ordered from the location in Goleta and it was always good.  This was the first ordering from the Santa Barbara location. I preordered the order before they opening at 11am and my pickup time was 11:45am - 12pm. I picked up the order at 11:40am.  Maybe I shouldn't  preorder if the fries are cooked too far in advance. 

I might try again when I return back to Santa Barbara. Hoping the next ti.w is a better experience.

Came here just before closing for a quick fix and must say that their burgers are tasty. My Wife & got the Fireman and it was tasty. Everything I expected out of a BBQ burger. Ny Classic Kyle was simple and hit the spot. The tomato basil soup really hit the spot for a cold night. With gooey cheese at the bottom and a warm garlic roll to complement. Definitely a no frills burger joint that satisfied my fix

A friend of mine introduced me to this place in May, back when restaurants were only doing take-outs. After that first visit I fell in love with the place. Everything about their burgers is just superb.

Currently I'm mostly working remotely due to covid, but the 1-2 days a week I do go in to Santa Barbara, I'm having lunch here every time.

I don't eat jalapeños. But....their Mountain Climber burger that includes jalapeños, jalapeño ranch, pepper jack cheese, crispy onion strings....just so tasty (and the only time I eat jalapeños). Their jalapeño ranch dressing is just the best, especially when also dipping fries in them.

Kyle's also has a "dinner pack" for 4 which you can take home and cook yourself, all for just $20. I did this a few weeks ago and it felt like my family was eating at Kyle's for just $5 a burger (includes all the fixin's and sides).

The other wonderful thing about Kyle's is that they are big into donating to special needs causes and charities. That means every time I eat here, I know I'm contributing a tiny part to making our community better.

Delicious food and awesome service. My family and I were driving up North to go camping and stopped here to eat. All 8 of us ordered different things from burgers to soup and we all thoroughly enjoyed our food. The employees were extremely nice and helpful, especially the man who I assume to be the manager. Would definitely come back again. As a bonus, both male cashiers and the manager were all really cute ;)

I came to Santa Barbara without Yelping a place to eat for lunch......Duh! What was I thinking or not thinking? 

As we shopping around Paseo Nuevo, I asked a local lady "where's a good place for lunch?" She immediately replied "Silvergreens!" Without hesitation, we crossed the street from the mall and came to a very local, casual restaurant which took your order from the counter and pick up your tray once your beeper goes off. 

We ordered the steak and avocado sandwich and the sesame seed ahi salad ($10.50). The sandwich was outstanding! It had full bites of steak and avocado. As for the salad, it was a winner with a generous amount of ahi. If you're diet conscious, they print the calorie count on the receipt.

They had plenty of seats inside and out. Try to eat outside by the sidewalk and enjoy the Santa Barbara ambiance.

I was getting something checked up and decided since kyle's kitchen was nearby + they released a new "krispy" chicken sandwich - I wanted to give it a try, especially since I saw their deal for the week at $5! I ordered online through their website which was easy, got to customize and use their promo code I found on Instagram. Placed it and drove for curbside delivery and done! Easy.

It was massive and their special is a good deal. I'd say even at their $7 regular price, it's a still a well priced chicken sandwich. Super crunchy, opted for some veggies like lettuce, tomato, and onion (you can also customize for avocado, bacon, or cheese - all which sound amazing) and their spicy aioli sauce. Juicy and fried well~ they use great quality chicken. 

It was delicious and reasonably priced - and I'd say at that value point, it's an awesome sandwich!

I recently visited this location and I will say it was the best experience I've ever had. I remember this location being a completely different restaurant but now that it is Kyle's kitchen I will be coming here often! The food was great and the staff was super helpful and super nice. The manager Mercedes introduced herself as I was speaking to my friends about the great food and service. She was Fantastic! Super nice and we had a great conversation about the restaurant. She truly takes pride in her store. We need to see more people like her in places of business!

Kyle's food is delicious! We ordered takeout/delivery a few weeks ago and had one issue that I gave honest feedback about. I received a timely response and order credit! We ordered again this week and everything was perfect! Food was fresh, warm, delicious, and order was accurate. Kyle's is special to us as they donate to causes near and dear to our hearts! We want them to continue to succeed!

We ordered a family meal at the start of Covid- it took forever and food was cold...we understand times were tough and it was a new experience having to shift to take out so no complaints at all!  Fast forward 7 months decided to try again. On line ordering was easy.  I ordered at 6:00- was told to pick up at 6:34.  At 7:00 my kid was still waiting in in the car being told the food would be out soon.  When food finally came, the order was incomplete- at 7:19 he was still waiting for missing items while our food gets cold. The only thing they said when I called the first time at 7:00 was "sorry our system isn't perfect and we're busy".  We live a mile away from the Chapala location- they kept my kid in the car for an hour. I called a second time because now the food is cold and still have an incomplete order. They did give me a full refund but next up my kids car ran out of gas because they kept him waiting so long with the car running he had plenty of gas to get there and back under normal circumstances.  I get this is not their fault but still...I had to go bail him out and get him gas.  90+ minutes after we were supposed to get our food I am having to reheat everything in the microwave and the ice cream is melted and all I have is a bad taste in my mouth! So disappointing- I would rather have my food hot and on time and pay for it rather than have to be a jerk to get them to do the right thing. Considering everything we went through and the lack of offering to compensate even a little the first time I called I will be hard pressed to ever go there again- horrible service!!

Earth burger! The burger I was served was not as pretty as the ones featured on the website but tasty nonetheless - including the housemade patty! 
T had the mountain climber and he really enjoyed it. Plus fries to share! 

The burgers are a really sweet deal. $6.50 and even cheaper if you come for happy hour! 

The food itself warrants 4 stars, but for the price? 5 stars. 

We didn't get any ice cream, but they also offer ice cream / ice cream sandwiches. The tomato basil soup sounded delicious as well.

I don't normally do reviews on restaurants but this food was spectacular I'm a vegetarian and I tried the earth burger with a milkshake let me just say it was very delicious!! Staff was super friendly and helpful! I don't remember the guys name but I think it started with a S. Turns out he was a vegetarian too! I'm a picky eater and this food was perfect  I will definitely be coming back definitely deserves a 5 star!!!

We visited Santa Barbara and were looking for a place to eat. I yelped it and Kyle's was highly recommended. Tbh, it wasn't my first pick but that's were we ended up. Anyway, we were very happy with Kyle's. I had the classic burger, fries and a lemonade. The lemonade was house made and delicious as was everything else. My party of 4 all enjoyed it. I highly recommend!

This branch of Kyle's Kitchen (formerly Silvergreens) is situated in a convenient spot very literally across the street from the Paseo Nuevo Mall. It's a good place for a quick bite serving up burgers, salads, and the like. 

My friend and I both had a salad, the Thai Peanut Salad and the Seared Ahi Salad. We got half orders wanting to keep things light but added grilled chicken which cost us an extra $2.50. In total the half salad cost us nearly $9. Keep in mind... the $5.50 base price for salads that they advertise does not come with meat except for the Seared Ahi Salad. I think that's a bit misleading really. Also, our salads were out so quickly that as we were tucking our wallets back into our purses after paying and eyeing where to sit, a server was trailing behind us with our salads ready.  There is no way that our chicken was cooked to order in under 5 minutes. Both salads were delicious, yes, but in no way was it worth what we paid. 

My friend also got their amazing peach ginger lemonade. This had the perfect amount of ginger without too much bite. It's a very refreshing take on lemonade and adds some interest. But again, being a specialty item, cost us a little more than the usual $2 for their beverages.

I have mixed feelings because I love supporting local businesses and Kyle's Kitchen even has their own awesome cause, and the food isn't bad at all. But the quality and portions here certainly has not lived up to their premium prices and I have to be real here. I don't really plan on coming back although I did enjoy my meal.

The only thing I really liked about this place was their burger. My girlfriend used to drag me here because she liked to be able to read how many calories are in each meal which somehow made here feel better about eating a sandwich. So when I got dragged I tried different things and came to actually really like the peper jack burger and a couple others. So we go back recently and the burgers are gone. They've been replaced with mini bit sized sliders that are 2/3 of the price but 1/3 of the content. You have to order like 3 to be full and they're just not the same anymore. NOt the same toppings or anything. If they bring back the burgers I'll pay them a visit again. Other than that the place is clean and the people are nice.
Nice restaurant and service is great. The burgers I got were cold. Maybe because I came by the end of the day.
My family and I came here a few times and it is a great place, the staff are kind and the food is amazing! They had a chalkboard area for the kids to draw and play I would definitely be coming again.

Good food. Terrible customer service. Employees were unfriendly and seemed completely annoyed that we were there. We ordered $50 of food, which included 2 kids meals, one of which we split between our two youngest kids. The kids meals came with a little piece of candy - so we asked the wait staff if they include a 3rd little candy since we were splitting the meal. They declined and insisted we pay for the candy. It may seem small, but they passed on the opportunity for them to extend great service. Won't be back.

If you're looking for a healthy alternative for breakfast, lunch, or dinner; this would be the place to check out! They have freshly made soups, salads, and sandwiches. For breakfast i've only tried The Gaucho with hickory smoked bacon, tillamook cheese, and cage-free eggs. It's a simple english muffin sandwich and not greasy at all like other fast food places. You can feel good about eating this to get your day started. Try the strawberry lemonade!

I had a half Turkey sandwich and my wife had a half Chicken. Both were excellent, and the  warm cookies were even more surprisingly good. Its a fast food atmosphere, but the food is worth it! And correspondingly reasonably priced. The receipts with the calories is a fun reminder too. My wife really enjoyed that. I would go back in a heartbeat.

Tonight the team was rocking it! I called to ask a question and ended up ordering and when I went to pick it up (sadly I didn't catch his name) he remembered my name. He was quick with managing orders, was friendly, and informed me it would take a few minutes as they were still finishing up on my order.  I appreciate this type of service.  Great customer service! Thank you
Tasteless frozen patty. Bread, lettuce, etc were good but meat was very low quality and lacked taste

This place is the bomb. The seared ahi salad is my absolute fav. They also give you a good sized portion. Grilled cheese & tomato soup for $9, uh deal!! Yum yum yum. They also have a really cool soda machine with their own brands of soda.
Really good burgers there! I love their fries too. Kyle's Kitchen is simple but I like it! And you can order online.

Pleasant &friendly staff,nice wide open environment plenty of space ,super welcoming good vibed location to come experience an explosion of flavor in every single bite,my wife and I came for miles to indulge in these A+ charbroiled angus burgers ,All around we'll be back and recommend this spot to anyone who respects their appetite for the best and their taste buds!

A good cause plus great food! Kyle's kitchen is named after the owners son Kyle who is special needs. Every month they donate  to different charities. This is just a plus since the food and ambiance is really inviting to both families/and everyone else. Inside... comfortable yet chique. Tons of seating and really nice staff. We got the fire fries, cowboy salad, chocolate malt crunch ice cream (they have pints to go! ) double K and everything came with warm butter rolls. It was delicious, and tasted fresh... warning fire fries and cowboy salad are FIRE don't let your two year old pick off them... oops. Will be back for sure.

My first experience with Silvergreens dates back to 2006, when I was a freshman at UCSB.

I was wandering around Isla Vista with some newfound friends from my dorm and being the secret fatty that I am, I had to scope out all the potential food establishments in my area.  Someone had recommended Silvergreens, and I immediately thought to myself, "ew." No joke, that was my first reaction. I didn't even hear my friend telling me that they had good sandwiches, which is unbelievable because I think I could eat a sandwich everyday for the rest of my life. 

After a couple years, I guess I decided to try it out and I definitely ordered the wrong things because my friend told me that I could make that sandwich myself for less than what I had paid for, BUT THE SOUP IS WHAT GOT ME.

I capitalized that phrase because I cannot emphasize how delicious their chicken tortilla soup is. If they only had one thing on their menu and it happened to be that soup, I'm pretty sure they would still be in business with no problem at all. It sounds preposterous, but the only piece of advice I can give you is to just try it for yourself.

Of course, there are other items on the menu that I have grown to love such as the ahi tuna salad, the turkey,bacon, and avocado sandwich, their french fries, their GREEN FRIES (thought I would hate this, but turned out to be pretty tasty), chicken tortilla soup, aaaaaaand that's about it. 

Since I work downtown, I frequent the downtown location a lot.  I also come to this location beause I avoid shitty IV and drunk college students like the plague. They have an outdoor seating area, a huge indoor seeating area, and a very nice staff.

This review is long overdue. My wife, daughter and I took a trip to Santa Barbara a few weeks back and Kyle's  Kitchen was defiantly a highlight of the trip. The service was professional, polite and punctual and the food was . So much so I could resist getting a second burger and going back the next day for another.
