Kyle's Kitchen left a great impression on us to the point when it came time to return home we had to stop by and grab one more for the road. Look forward to returning and trying out more of their menu. Highly suggest you do the same if you get a chance. Honestly, 5 stars is not enough, but hopefully this review will serve as the additional stars.

I ate here a while ago but I wanted to put in a review. I came in the summer time actually and they had very fresh burgers and the fries are to die for. They do have a lot of cheese in their burgers, so if you are lactose just be weary ahahaha. I know the workers said their ingredients have grass fed beef so you know its' food is quality. For the parking you do have to pay underneath or there is a short meter parking. It's a nice place outside the main shopping center too. I saw someone elses' comment so I hope they aren't closed, but I know they do have other locations.

Kyle's is a good spot. My kids enjoy a burger or their salads. 
Ordered a Ahi Salad for lunch. Was pretty good. 
My only tip would be have the dressing on the side.
Good food at a great price. Great homemade veggy Burger and fries! Love the vibe of the place as well

Food quality was ok. I stopped here for dinner on the way up to Pismo Beach. I was looking for a quick healthy meal before we hit the road again. The salad I got with strawberries was kind of soggy - I felt like I got the bottom of the bowl or something. It was pretty late when we ate there also, close to closing time. The service was also just OK. Staff was preoccupied with closing the restaurant down and didn't pay much attention to us. I like the string lights in the outdoor patio though.
I've been to the 2 location in Ventura county! This place is amazing! When I mean the food is fresh and delicious! Bring it to LA!! Burgers are awesome!!!! I only go out to Santa Barbara for Kyle's!

Kyle's Kitchen was recommended by a couple people for good burgers, so we had high expectations when visiting. When we received our meal we instantly noticed how small and thin the burger patty was. It was such a bummer because we got a lot of bun and filler while eating. Ratio was off, but flavors were good. Maybe we went on an off day because the pictures online look much bigger than what we got.

I hope the Owners see's this message.

I just read your sup & jus closed up and sorry .

I think a great idea is a salad & soup bar with all fresh organic veggies and homemade soups. 

It is very hard to find a good salad & soup in SB 

Thank you and good luck with your next adventure!!
Food was good, very filling burger and loved the bacon blue cheese ranch fries. Would have like a larger soda. Delivery by Grubhub was on time and food was still warm.

Ok so silvergreens taste pretty good but omg its so mother effing expensive like BOOOOOo. i do love their seared ahi salad and the tomato basil soup but i can only eat here if its a "treat yoself" kind of day cause i want the salad and the soup and that shit is like 15 dollars WAT IV WAT I AM POOOR COLLEGE STUDENT COME ONNN.

Doesn't this look like the epitome of a good time!
Life in Santa Barbara and a visit to Silvergreens one of our favorite eateries we've been enjoying since their beginning. It's our great little neighborhood hot spot.
Thank you Chris for always providing a great healthy meal as well as that warm welcoming comfortable environment to enjoy ourselves!
Paul & Christy

Salad and Burger mix is genius! The size of the dish was perfect and taste was amazing. Will come back! 
I recommend the Ahi Tuna Salad and Cheesy Pig Burger!

HORRIBLE customer service!  On Thursday 6/10/2021, I ordered 3 salads to take back to our hotel!  I forgot to ask for the dressings to be put on the side, not tossed into the salads.  I returned to the counter and asked, as we were going to make 1 more stop'. We didn't want soggy lettuce. The girls behind the counter started laughing about the request. They failed to put ANY dressings in our bag.  My bad for not checking it out before we left. I should of realized it was going to be a problem after so much rude laughter at a customer's request. Never go inside a restaurant with NO customers. First red flag!!!!  Luckily room service was kind enough to bring replacement dressing. Good customer service matters. NEVER going back to this Kyle's Kitchen.

Disappointed in their lack of vegan options, I was super looking forward to the veggie burger but the buns/croutons are not vegan friendly! I got the quinoa salad instead which was alright in terms of flavor. The lemonades were excellent and my friends enjoyed their food.

It is a very budget friendly spot to take and very spacious area for big groups! But I don't recommend for vegans unless there will be a vegan burger available in the future!

Loved my tri tip sandwich and chicken tortilla soup! Me and my boyfriend stopped here during a long road trip and it was really good. The guy at the register was very helpful and nice. They also had allot of healthy options to choose from. I'll definitely come back if I'm ever in the area again

Stopped for lunch on our way home from vacation. Food was delicious. I had a 1/2 turkey, avocado and bacon sandwich with 1/2 Cobb salad. Salad was fresh and crisp and the ranch dressing was great, not from a bottle. Enjoyed the turkey sandwich. Would go back again when driving through Santa Barbara again. Oh, tried the French fries. Loved them. Very generous with the portion size.

Just went here for the first time.  It's very conveniently located close to State St and Paseo Nuevo mall.

I ordered the Thai Peanut salad and it was really great.  Usually, those sorts of salads come with a thick peanut sauce, but this one was thin and light, just what I was hoping for.  The chicken complemented the salad very well.  The greens were perky and not wilted at all.  Overall, great salad.  Also, I usually don't like to mention price in these reviews, but I found the price to be more than reasonable, especially for the size of the normal sized salad which was quite large.
The best burgers and salads ( my fave is the Thai peanut with chicken) and the staff is always great!

My fiancé and I love the spot! Always great food at an affordable price. Last night we picked up the classic Kyles burger with an amazing Cobb salad as well as an Ahi salad! We are very happy that they are available for pick up during this quarantine. The food and all the locations are consistently great and you always know what to expect. We highly recommend!

Very disappointing.  I had been here a couple of years ago and remembered it as a place with salads and sandwiches. Came here with my family and it was a big let down.  We got the tri tip sandwich, chicken pesto sandwich, hummus sandwich a salad and a couple of orders of fries.   The fries were soggy and no one wanted them at the table - not good.  The hummus sandwich was ordinary - according to my vegan daughter.  The chicken sandwiches were way dry.  As for the tri tip - when we first had it served, there was so little meat we had to send it back.  It was cut into two halves one one half literally had almost no meat.  20 minutes later they brought out a new sandwich which had the right amount of meat.  However, the tri tip was very chewy, stringy and also a little dry.  And - it's not cheap either.   Not good.  Sorry to say I won't be back.

went here for brunch. they do have a goodly number of vegetarian items (think lots of cheese & eggs), but not much vegan love. NO TOFU. NO SOYMILK FOR COFFEE.  the only vegan breakfast item was oatmeal.  are you kidding me??? so, I went the lunch route.  the housemade veggie burger was tasty, I got sides of  salad & fruit which were lovely (hate sad & soggy fruits & veggie).  just wish they had tofu, tempeh, beans, etc etc etc.

A burger place to try when in the Santa Barbara area. They have some creative burgers which are very delicious! Quite the menu variety as well and a perfect place to dine out with the family on any day of the week. Have been a fan for years and finally choosing to leave a review!

Terrible customer service, tried to place a phone order 15 mins before close, and they refused to take my order. I asked if I were to walk in right now if they'd turn me away, as I'm only 2 mins away and it usually takes them 5-10 mins to prepare my orders. 

The guy on the phone lied to me and said they're basically out of food. Then tried to backpedal saying they're closing for Valentine's day. If your hours are only u til 7:45, change your hours.

Used to come here once a week, looks like they've lost my business, and I'd recommend not giving them yours either since they're dishonest.

Kyle's Kitchen is an unexpected gem in Santa Barbara. At first they look like some sort of chain restaurant like Eureka but no, they actually have really great quality fast food. 

We came during a Sunday and their daily deal was chicken sandwiches and I must say, I was pleasantly surprised at how delicious it was. I guess I wasn't expecting to have received such a quality crispy chicken sandwich given the sort of sub-par marketing and location. Needless to say, I have definitely come back and I am excited to try more things from their menu.

Had lunch here today and was pleasantly surprised. My husband mentioned this place to me before since he said he tried the Kyle Burger and liked it. Since we had to do some errands at Fedex (right beside it), we decided to have lunch here. I had the kale and caesar salad and Kyle Burger while my husband had tomato soup and Buffalo Chicken Sandwich. We were pleased with our orders and the serving was just right.

In their menu, you could create your perfect meal by selecting any 2 options for $13 (upgrades are available for an additional cost -just check the menu). They call this Pair It!
These are the options for Pair It!
1. Burger or chicken sandwich
2. Salad
3. Bowl of soup
4. Beverage

This place is clean and the interior is nice. We will definitely come back to this place especially if we have burger cravings!

I was disappointed that Silvergreens didn't have more vegan options.  It really harshes my mellow when restaurants that bill themselves as being vegetarian/vegan-friendly don't offer some kind of vegan protein source, like tofu.

Counter service.

We were staying at hotel nearby for work. Seven of us opted out of our hotel's continental breakfast for a "real breakfast". 
We passed on Joe's Café for a "healthier" option. Based on the existing Yelp reviews, I was hoping to really like this place

My friend and I shared the following:
$6.95 - Californian Breakfast Burrito (crushed avocado, hand-cut seasoned French fries, cheddar cheese, fresh salsa, chipotle sour cream, 2 scrambled cage-free eggs)
$6.95 - Mixed Berry Pancakes  (3 buttermilk pancakes topped with warm mixed berry sauce, powdered sugar and whipped cream)

I added bacon to the Californian burrito. The pancakes are apparently less than 600 calories and vegan. The person bringing out our food was unorganized and messed up on a couple of orders and didn't bring any forks. We had to ask her for an extra plate 3 times since she kept forgetting and forgot about our orange juice. 

So.. the breakfast burrito was a little bland. I'm glad I added bacon it in and it came with a side of salsa. Others also thought their food was bland. Moving onto the pancakes... gosh ours did not look like the picture on the menu. The mixed berry sauce was kind of sad and the syrup was very thick. The texture of the pancakes themselves weren't appetizing. I know it's vegan, but it was dry, crumbled apart and had no flavor. 

My other coworker got pancakes as well and thought the same thing. He just took a couple bites and left the rest. 

When we got back to the hotel, they ended up making some waffles to satisfy their cravings. HAHA. 

Overall, I like their healthier options, but disappointed with their breakfast.
The sandwiches at their lunch menu looked good though. (oh well)

200/100 Reviews for 2014

Wonderful place
Love the Tuscan Chicken. 
Food here  is so  affordable, fresh, lively, and simply delicious. 
Good vibes

Kyle's Kitchen has amazing fresh high-quality food. My fiance and I are both vegetarian and were super impressed with the garden burger. We split fries and kale salad as our sides. We also ordered fresh lemonade which was the perfect addition to our meal. On top of everything else, the food looked amazing and was also affordable. I am very impressed with Kyle's Kitchen. I will be coming back whenever I visit Santa Barbara!

Oh my do I LOVE Silvergreens! There are so many wonderful attributes to this restaurant that go beyond the food, that I'll start with them and then work my way to the taste buds. 

First, it's a great location. I haven't had much trouble with parking and I love the layout of the dining room. Plenty of tables and seats to accommodate their numerous clientele. 

Customer service is fantastic! The staff is super friendly and very knowledgeable about the menu. 

Another detail I love as a health conscious customer, is that the nutrition facts for your specific order are printed right their on your receipt so you know exactly what you are consuming. For example, I ordered my dressing on the side and my receipt reflected that. My salad was only 200 calories without the dressing! 

For the food, I had a grilled shrimp salad that was to die for. So flavorful! Ripe avocado, goat cheese, slivered almonds, mango and a mango dressing that was wonderful (and I used it sparingly). The salad was large and very filling considering how few calories I was consuming. 

I can't wait to try more of their healthy creations!

My wife chose this place for Mother's Day cause she had been there once before and she said it was pretty good. My wife and kids came up for the day to have lunch with my mother in law. We ordered and everything seemed ok. It was very quiet there so we got a nice table on the corner outside. After about 10 min of waiting 3 of the 5 meals showed up. Still no drinks. After another 8 minutes the 3 meals were done. We offered to wait but the drive up from oc made us all very hungry...and thirsty. Still - NO DRINKS. And I had a beer so that really would have been nice to have a beer on the patio after a long drive. So, finally the other 2 meals show up. I ask about the drinks and she says she will get them. After another 3 min of waiting I go in and see she is not getting our drinks. I then ask for a refund for the beer, pelegrino and fire fries - which never came either. The girl then says those were on the salad????!!! Wtf? They put the fire fries appetizer on the cowboy salad. My wife ended up eating them all mixed together. She was so hungry she just ate them. So, I completed my refund and walked out muttering what a crappy experience we just had. And it cost us 75 bucks. 
Go somewhere else. There are PLENTY of other choices within walking distance.

Oh and they didn't clear one table the entire time we were there. All kinds of wrappers and plates were left on 3 tables around us!! Nasty!!!

I must say though the management handled this with flying colors. I truly believe this was not reminiscent of what Kyles usually offers.

I found this place in Santa Barbara when looking for a lunch takeout place that was actually open (it seems that many restaurants close between 2-5 pm in downtown SB). 
For lunch I ordered the Klassic Kyle burger. At this time you call in an order or do it online, then drive up to the restaurant, park on the street, and they bring your order out to your car. 
The great: the taste was superb, even though it's not a huge burger. 
The lows: they didn't cut the burger after I asked them to, and the host brought it out w/out napkins, and left before I realized it.

On our Central California day trip, we came into Santa Barbara some ATM cash withdrawal and decided to stop on by here for some lunch.

You'll be running into lots of UCSB students eating while working on their laptops. But who cares, you're here for the grub!!

If you love BLTs like I do, definitely try it here, but they have the BAT: bacon avocado tomato. Oh so good!!!!! They overdo it with the bacon, but am I complaining?! Nope!

I love that you get cookie with any of their entrees. Perhaps not the most healthy option, but screw it! And the fries here: comes in a cup but more than enough to fill the tummy

Really good burgers, salads & strawberry lemonade. Friendly staff & they donate portion of sales to non profits that benefit special needs children. A great business with a big heart that you have to support! Maybe most popular restaurant in town supported by all demographics of the local community which shows that deep down America is one of most generous countries on earth.

Kyle's kitchen is awesome. The food is affordable and so delicious. There are a lot of different options and they all taste great. stick with their salads and burgers as those are truly the best tasting things they make. And yes they have vegan and vegetarian options. 

They also have a small ice cream section in the restaurant and I thought that was really neat. 

As I said the prices are great, the food is delicious and he restaurant is such a nice experience to eat in. We were very satisfied with our time here.

You don't want to end up at the ER eating uncooked chicken. If I could give a Zero star I would. My family and I were lovers of this place. We order often and even my boyfriend ordered constantly food from Kyle's for himself and his employees. Recently I got extremely sick eating a chicken sandwich and ending up going to the Doctor for extreme stomach pains due to uncooked meat. I kindly addressed this with the managers, though it took multiple attempts to reach anyone in charge. After expressing my experience, I was told to expect a call back and compensation for the bad experience, however I never received a call back from the manager I spoke to, or by anyone else. Since we really like this place, I decided to give them another try. I requested the meat to be well cooked to avoid another horrible experience, the manager made clear he knew who I was and the experience I had been through, however, he did not extend any courtesy only a smug and insincere assurance "oh yeah i know you you are....yeah, we fixed the problem". I am very disappointed of this place. 

This will be my last visit with Kyle's kitchen.

I really want to rate Kyle's higher but the customer service here is severely lacking. I'll provide three accounts of when this was the case. 

First a few years back, I was finishing up a night run and wanted to grab some dinner on the way back. I arrived 10 minutes before closing and the cashier said they were closed and not accepting orders. This is unacceptable, if you're open you're open. 

Second earlier this year, I called in an order for their burger and fries (expecting the Klassic Kyle). I picked up the burger and left and when I got home I found out it was a plain burger w nothing on it. 

Lastly earlier this week, I was walking by and decided I wanted to try their chicken sandwich. I walked in and was first in line, and was not even acknowledged for over five minutes and their were two cashiers working. I ended up just leaving without a "hey it'll be a few minutes" or anything. 

Super unfortunate because I like the food, just the service is always terrible.

This place has SO much promise...great location, really good service, lovely setting BUT the food is such low quality and negligent it is insulting. Santa Barbara has such a gorgeous abundant food supply but the Montecito coffee shop serves food that looks like it is from a prison cafeteria in a shitkicking town in the south. No imagination. No attention. Really a big fat waste of everything. An insult to the universe.

Great breakfasts.
Has a tendency to undercook the beans, they said that they are al dente'
Cracks me up!!
Al Dente' beans???
LMAO
Fantastic pancakes, and if you haven't tried the San Ysidro Poached for breakfast, you are missing out.

Fast service. Beautiful outside patio area for a view of the hills while you eat.

We came for breakfast. The menu is simple - don't expect anything fancy. They serve Peets drip coffee - not sure if they espresso coffee options here.

I had the pancake combo - I love a sweet and savory breakfast. Whatever butter they use is fantastic! Not too much food.

My boyfriend had the breakfast tacos. They were outstanding!

Had Sunday morning breakfast here after a long road trip.  The omlette was light and fluffy with no hint of grease and the vegetables were perfectly fresh. Light and crispy potatoes, wheat toast and freshly squeezed orange juice rounded out a perfect start to the day. Service is friendly and the atmosphere is  bright and cheerful - like being in someeone's spotless 1950's kitchen eating from their pretty guest dishes.

Came here for breakfast and got a seat outside. I ordered their San Ysidro Poached with fresh fruit and my husband got their Pancake Combo. The food portions aren't the biggest considering the price. But the food is very tasty! Not to mention their orange juice is freshly squeezed!!

This is hands down the best place in Montecito for breakfast or a casual lunch.  Tom's has that cool casual back-in-time vibe that means you will eat well and eat a lot.  Specials change daily, and the blueberry pancakes are out of this world.  When the weather is nice (and that is most days), grab a seat on the large patio and have fun watching celebs and former captains of industry scarf down their meals in shorts and flip-flops, then head across the street to Pierre La Fond for more good sightings (at prices that are about 10x Tom's).  Not five stars because the coffee never tastes the same no matter how often I go- it can be perfect, but sometimes it is less than fresh...
Great breakfast! I ordered with the pancakes with strawberries. The strawberries were fresh and the pancakes were perfect.

A delightful coffee shop - breakfast place - light eaterie - in a lovely, villagey area of Montecito. The place was spotless and the staff are friendly and helpful, especially if you are visiting the area. Breakfast is varied and tastes extremely fresh. The side portion of fruit is really delicious, large and literally just cut - not something  that was hanging around as yesterday's fruit salad. My friend and I loved our egg white omelettes and definitely left feeling full, but not in that regretful, 'why the helI did I eat all of that' kind of way. I highly recommend this great cafe for a hearty, healthy breakfast in a clean, friendly, quiet and calm environment if your staying in Santa Babs, or if you're looking to for a place to stop and refuel.

The Food and Hospitality of the staff is always warm and the food is always good. I have never been unhappy. Some of the negative comments of others make room for us regulars that have always supported our local hangouts. Go to Denny's next time.

This has been a family favorite for over 25 years. Bright and cheery with tables inside and outside for dining.  Fun place to meet people for breakfast or lunch this is a "locals" spot. Good coffee, Service with a smile - always! 

The food is always homemade and delicious with varied scrambles, pancakes, oatmeal, omelettes and other usual breakfast fare. This may sound strange, but I also love the dishware they use! It reminds me of my grandma's house. 

It is a bit pricey for breakfast. But the location and the ambience is worth it!

I meet good friends here several mornings a week for breakfast, and sometimes bring my family on weekends --- definitely a cozy, coffee shop feeling, especially on a rainy day --- I really like the egg-white, green veggy omelette.
Consistently good, high quality ingredients.  If you love the feeling of a real old fashion coffee shop this is your place.  Warm inside dining and a great patio with shade and sun!

The food here is fresh and tasty. The patty melt crazy good. Love the Greek scramble. The soups are all turkey broth based fresh every day.  Joyful and mellow atmosphere .....in Montecito!!!!!  If you need a stupid coffee beverage try to get a life.

I stumbled into this place looking for a coffee house to jump on Wifi and have lunch.  Greeted by Paul, he invited me in and asked if I wanted coffee.  I ordered cup of arugala soup with pine nuts made from scratch with a half of oven roasted turkey sandwich on wheat with fresh avocado and a side of homemade cranberrry salad.  Needless to say it was perfect.  The owner Debbie delivered the food.  I can't speak for the breakfast, which apparently Heather G didn't enjoy.  She obviously doesn't know how to use a cpu since she can not spell.  Maybe she would be better off going to Denny's, where the prices and food are better suited for her.  Fortunately there is no Denny's in Montecito.

Great and friendly service. Had a Turkey wrap and apple curry salad.  Nice proportions.  Really wanna try their breakfast!

Only complaint is pricey,  but to be expected with area.

Went in July with Covid still happening, the seating was outside with social distancing in place, awesome service from Danny. We ordered blueberry pancakes with the secret East Valley Dr. omelette that is not in the menu needless to say, it should be in the menu!

Thought this place would be really good.... Sorry to say but I was very disappointed! My family was visiting from out of town and wanted to to a LOCAL spot so I choose The Coffee Shop. I thought I had heard good things maybe I was wrong. The service was fine but not the food. My cousin was not able to eat half of what he ordered. The poached egg was more like hard boiled and the bacon was so DRY it tasted as if it were cooked in a microwave. All of our bacon was way over cooked. And the breakfast I choose was very dry as well. English muffin with poached eggs over done not runny at all like they should be. The French toast was good though!

Such an average overpriced turkey sandwich of the likes I've never had. Two slices on plain bread and a crappy side salad or romaine.m for $15.  Service was barely there as well, even without a crowd. Save your time and dollars and hit Via Vai across the street.

This old timers place seems to be over rated, with the reviews, and the local seniors.
I first walked in looking for and iced late and found a dated dinning room, only offering coffee and breakfast. I decided to come back and give it a chance considering the close proximity to work and home. We were disappointed.

I ordered the $11.00  huevos rancheros, the best part was the avocado on top. The ''salsa'' tasted like marinara sauce, and the beans on the side were bland. 

My Boyfriends French toast was plan white bread with fake maple syrup.

When we went to pay the check, we found out they don't except credit cards, so Adam had to run across the street to an ATM. When he came back and tried to pay the bill in cash, the server was too busy texting on his phone to notice.

On a positive note, the coffee was good. If you are looking for a place to have a basic breakfast: eggs, toast, bacon, this place may not be the worst.
Decades ago, this was THE place to get a killer hamburger and chocolate shake or an old fashioned tuna sandwich. Now?  I don't understand how anybody can rave about this place.

Montecito Coffee Shop delivers quality food and service every time. 

Breakfast  is lovely and they have an excellent selection to truly enjoy.

Lunch during the week except Sunday is traditionally delicious, fresh and well prepared. 

No problem bring the pets they will receive excellent service with fresh water and a nice place to sit down when experiencing the front patio dining area. 

Always good food with friendly local staff that make you feel welcome.

Don't hesitate, meet family and friends, they will enjoy it too!

I had a Greek Scramble, with spinach, tomato, onion, bacon, and feta. It was good, and everything was fresh. Serving sizes won't leave you stuffed but are still filling. Friendly service. Prices are a bit high, but considering the neighborhood it's to be expected.

The food was delicious and the service was great.  The wait staff were courteous and attentive.  I enjoyed the egg white scramble with spinach, onions, and tomatoes.  The meal came with fresh fruit and the bread of your choice. It was delicious.  Will go back to enjoy more.

Walked in, should have walked right back out. First thing the lady says when we walk in "Take a seat wherever you want... Oh, except for the table by the window, that one is always reserved for our beloved regulars and the gentlemen get very upset if it's taken"

Ummm... Thanks for the details, could have just said the table is reserved... The guys who came in and sat there looked like some old grumpy ass men, sat there reading their news paper and glared over at my fiancé and I every time our baby made a noise. My fiancé was super uncomfortable the whole time, the lady running the place gave extra special attention to her regulars, made sure they ate first even though we arrived before them, didn't strike a conversation with us until it was time for me to sign and give a tip... Didn't leave a good one.

Delicious sandwiches for the beach!

Our Airbnb happened to be just down the road from this cafe so our visit was based on convenience.

Instead of having to decide on a place for lunch we ordered a few sandwiches for our beach day. 

The deviled egg sandwiches were really good. I'm really picky when it comes to egg sandwiches because I make some great egg salad myself but these didn't disappoint. Each sandwich came with a pickle and chips. 

Perfect beach lunch!

It says it's a coffee shop but be warned: they don't actually have ALL types of coffee.

No espresso machine.  Which I expect when I see "Coffee Shop."

The owner hates children, Debbie, always has flys and no handicap bathrooms. Crew in the kitchen drink endless beers, and Debbie knows it and allows it! The owner is anti-Semitic she makes Jews and black people sit outside
Nice, clean and simple...great local destination haunt. Real friendly too!
This place is AWESOME!! We've never had a bad meal there and we go 1-2 times sweet Debbie, the owner is great!  Her chef makes fantastic soups and roasts a whole turkey everyday.

Great location, and if you're starving and stuck in the area, it's okay, but the food is mediocre, dated and nothing impressive.  Hard to believe a place like this can stay in business in this day an age, maybe 40 years ago it would be considered okay.  They also don't take credit cards, and WAY overcook the bacon.  Like eating at Denny's or a middle America coffee shop, but no comparison to a decent CA eatery...
The owner hates children, Debbie, always has flys and no handicap bathrooms. Crew in the kitchen drink endless beers, and Debbie knows it and allows it!

We came here with my sister and cousin. We ordered the Tuna Melt, the Italian Chicken and BBQ chicken. Tuna melt was super delicious, but not too sure about the Italian chicken or the BBQ chicken. They had great customer service though, very approachable and sweet staff.

This is a nice breakfast place. Seating is outside. Eating breakfast on the patio watching the world go by is one of my favorite things. It was a beautiful day in Montecito. We were seated promptly. The coffee is good. We split the Montecito omelette (honey ham and veggies), side of potatoes, and sourdough toast. Everything was represented well. The eggs were fluffy. The ham tasty. The potatoes tasted freshly made. Overall, the quality of ingredients was outstanding and the staff friendly. A good place.

Friendly, fast service once seated, I walk there on Sundays for breakfast. It is a laid back local haunt for people watching and comfort food. Great place to go if want to get out the house for a little while.

The food is outrageously priced!

$15.95 for some iceberg lettuce and a scoop of chicken salad on it. $3.00 for a glass of countrytime lemonade - straight from the powder mix!


The service was friendly.

This is a small, simple coffee shop, suitable for a cup of coffee or breakfast. It serves omelets, eggs & bacon, and oatmeal. The I didn't eat it, the San Ysidro Poach seems like the most interesting choice.

CASH ONLY

Peaceful spot to enjoy an afternoon. 

I came across this place while in the upper village. I was attending an event in the area and had about 30 minutes to kill. Coming here was the perfect idea. 

I was with a friend and we both ordered mimosas and pastries. Everything turned out well. Service was friendly and prompt. We opted to sit indoors and I enjoyed the elegant decor scheme. There's also a patio to my knowledge which would be ideal on a warm day. 

I reviewed the menu and noticed that the shop sells made-to-order sandwiches, all of which sounded amazing. The table nearest us had sandwiches in their order and they did look nice. Alas, the event we were attending was serving lunch so there wasn't a need for us to order a full meal. However, I'd certainly come back for a sandwich and a coffee the next time I found myself in that part of town!
Great brunch, super cute spot, outside seating was so awesome, food was good, endless mimosas, got hammered on a Sunday mid morn, what's not to love?!
Cool place for a date and watching sports with friends. Good drinks and food. I really enjoyed the Buffalo Burger.
Great food, but good god that was the slowest service I have EVER received.  Brunch took 2 hours.

Dined here three times now, and I can't think of any criticisms. 

Ever been winetasting up in the Napa/Sonoma area, and stopped off at one of the main street restaurants, and had that perfect salad, perfect sandwich in that perfect picturesque ideal location and you think, "this is my vision of what a wine country restaurant should be." I felt that applies at State and Fig. 

It's still common, approachable food, but really nicely done. Nothing modernist or molecular, you won't see folks in the kitchen tweezing microgreens onto nitro ice cream. More like a fried chicken sandwich, or an arugula salad made with ingredients you recognize, prepared well, plated well. 

It's my go-to place for bringing out of town guests now for a casual meal, when I want them to feel like they're whisked away to a special place in a paradise town where nothing bad ever happens. 

First visit: lunch with ladies. Highlights were the fried chicken sandwich (eat it quickly) and the porchetta sandwich special.

Second visit: visiting couple on a well-deserved vacation from their three children. The kind of vacation where the woman wanted to feel a little indulgent and spoiled. Bonus: she got all that, and the prices were good. This was the weekend brunch and the fried chicken over biscuits and gravy were the highlight. My favorite item there so far. You know how biscuits and gravy is normally like bricks and mortar in your stomach? These biscuits were soft and flaky, the gravy didn't feel heavy, the chicken was crisp, juicy and perfectly seasoned. I inhaled that dish, didn't feel like I had a food baby in my belly, felt great afterwards. Dish also comes with two eggs on top! It's $15 and so worth it.

Third visit: another guest, this one from another country, elderly, that I didn't know very well, but felt that State and Fig would be the right fit for him. I suggested he get the PBR: pork belly, caraway kraut, Gruyere, Russian dressing, griddled rye, $9.50. He admitted after that he thought the food was very good. 
What was especially notable about this visit was that we had very limited time to eat before another appointment, I mentioned to the people working there that we were in a bit of a rush, and they were totally *on it*. Lunch, midweek, for three people, in and out in 40 minutes. I was not expecting that, but man, spot on for exactly what we needed. 
My last detail is that I found out later that my guest was a freaking billionaire. He can have anything he wants, right? And I think he was expecting to be disappointed by this casual food. So when he made a point to say that he liked it, that meant a lot. 

State and Fig is also located in the prettiest arcade/alley in downtown. If the weather is nice, sitting outside is a treat.

I try to go here for lunch on the weekdays. Delicious sandwiches and wine options. I really like that they give you a side of their aioli with your sandwich and fries. Never have had a problem with getting a table quickly, and being able to go back to work on time.

I ate lunch here with a coworker last week. The food was really good. We both order the chicken panini & loved it. Garlic fries we tasty as could be.  

They did seem very short staffed though. One guy was running around doing everything. He didn't quite get our order right, but we survived. I'm not sure if this is usually the case or if someone had called out sick that day. So I plan on going back to find out. Hopefully I'll update this review with another star!
Wonderful food!  Charming ambiance (in La Arcadia Plaza).  The chef is the owner and the food is made with love.  Kid friendly.  Highly recommended!

Six of us (4 adults and 2 babies) came here based on the impressive 5 star rating on Yelp but we should have known it was too good to be true.  I am not sure if it was because they are new and still trying to figure things out but I have never had such bad service in my life.  We pretty much seated ourselves and we were given different menus, we found out later that half of them were the wrong menu.  We finally got someone to take our order and about 30 minutes later he came back asking one of us what we ordered because he couldn't read his writing, which obviously meant he didn't put it in yet.  It had been about an hour and we were getting cold sitting outside so we moved inside.  We asked to get the pancakes we had ordered for our babies as soon as possible because at this point they were becoming restless.  When the meal finally came (before the pancakes) 2 out of 3 orders were wrong and the 4th order didn't come.  The person that asked for no cheese had cheese and the person who asked for light aioli had what seemed like extra aioli but they just ate it anyway.  I had ordered a turkey burger (over an hour before) and it was only until everyone else's meals were served did they tell me they had run out of turkey.  We asked to speak to a manager at that point and there was only an "acting manager" there at the time.  She is the reason why I am giving this place two stars instead of one because of her effort in trying to rectify the situation.  She asked if I wanted something else to eat but at that point I had lost my appetite.  The food we did receive was oily and unappetizing from what I saw and the few bites I took off another plate.  In the end they brought us cookies and gave the babies treats and comped our meal which was nice but of course did not replace our lost time and bad experience.  If they want this new restaurant to succeed owners or an actual manager need to be there handling it or things like this happen.  All in all a bad experience but I do appreciate the effort the acting manager gave in the wake of such a terrible situation.

They were about to close in 45 min and they did not want to sit us because they were short staffed. Plus they looked at us like they did not want to service is because we were a bunch of Mexicans. Never coming to this place again.

This is one of my favorite lunch spots in Santa Barbara. The food is fantastic, the service is quick, and there are 2 wait staff that are absolutely amazing (1 male and 1 female).

I love their Caesar Salad because the dressing is very light, unlike the thick creamy dressing you would find at most other restaurants. Sometimes they serve it with salmon or scallops. If you are fortunate enough to go on a day where they are serving scallops definitely order them. They are savory and cooked just the right amount of time to disintegrate in your mouth. They smell fantastic (not fishy). 

They have another great arugula, fig, green apple salad; another one of my favorites. If you like garlic, try their spicy lemon chick peas. Wish they were baked instead of fried, but worth every calorie.

I've never been there for brunch on the weekends but have heard it is a must. I will definitely plan for that one of these weekends.

State and Fig!! 
Marisa and Patrick are just the sweetest. They are always so attentive and it's so nice to go into a small restaurant and meet the owners right there. Their staff is also so great and helpful. I loved them when they were Whale's Tale and I love them as State and Fig.

The food is just passable, but the ambiance is great. It's set in a little arcade just off to the side of State St. so it has that nice Spanish / adobe architecture feel about it, with the glazed tiles and water fountains. What makes this place great is if you're here chillin on a Sunday. get an entree and get the bottomless mimosa option. Not sure about the other servers, but if Ricardo's there he does those mimosas right.... mostly bubbly and just a touch of orange juice. The arcade has a nice breeze blowing through most of the time.

Best place to have a small event (about 30 people).  The food was delicious, the service very good, and the owners were very accommodating.  The loft area was perfect for our group, not isolated but away from the regular restaurant business. Everyone raved about the food and location. Our guests were given menu choices so everyone did not have to eat the same thing.  Salted caramel butterscotch pudding was dreamy!

HOLY DANG!!  This place is really GOOD.  I mean REALLY GOOD!

The fries are so simple yet sooooo amazing.  The flavor is just so pure.  Also, the burger is to die for.  I got the state burger, and it amazing.  I thought In-n-out had my favorite burger and fries, now I'm sad because it's nowhere nearly as good as this place.  I tried my dad's salad and it had so much flavor and was very fresh.

The wait staff is very VERY nice and attentive.  I can't remember when I had such a great experience last.

I beg you to please try this restaurant first.  They will win you over after 1 visit.

This was a really classy, sweet restaurant with kind staff & a really friendly hostess. There wasn't much of a wait, which was awesome, as my friend & I were very, very hungry.  I ordered a cheeseburger which tasted delicious but seemed to upset my stomach afterward... may have been a bit rich for me.

This is my new favorite restaurant in Santa Barbara. The food was amazing and the owner took our food allergies very seriously! Can't say enough good things about this place!

Pro tip: Call them before you go as they aren't always open during scheduled hour due to special events.
Awesome quiet place to grab a seriously delicious burger and some local beers! We stopped by on our vacation and very much enjoyed our dinner!
Food was flavorful and portioned well so as to fill us up but not make us groggy, service was perfect, and the atmosphere is well designed. Great place.

The food was good nothing too crazy! I wish there were a little more options on the menu and the service could've been a little better we came an hour before they closed and the waiter just seemed annoyed and like he wanted us out of there. He didn't really listen to what we were asking of him. Once the food came it was good my husband enjoyed his burger. I don't think I would go back next time I visit SB.
It's about time a place like this opened in Santa Barbara. Delicious food, great location, great service. Good wine selection. Can't wait to go back.

This goes into the top 3 worst dining experiences my wife and I have ever experienced.  The only positive I can say about the place is that the people working there were nice.  We ordered a few things and all were truly genuinely awful.  We ordered a cheese plate, which is pretty hard to screw up, but they succeeded.  The fontina cheese that we ordered was supposed to be a block.  However, they shredded it and formed it into a square.   It was bizarre and tasted absolutely awful.  We ordered brussel sprouts that were completely drenched in a heavy mustard dressing.  It was disgusting.  We had a salad that was edible unlike the two aforementioned items.  

We only were able to eat the salad that we ordered as the two other things were virtually inedible.  When the server saw that we barely touched the brussel sprouts or the "cheese plate" it would have been reasonable and appropriate for the server to offer to remove at least one of the items from our check and offer us something else, but she didn't.  

For the life of me, I just can't understand how this place has any positive reviews.  It strikes me as very suspicious.  Stay away from this terrible place.

Picked this place based on the yelp reviews. Great place! Had a very attentive and friendly server and the food was delicious! We had the house burger and the PBR. House burger was amazing. It is probably one of the best burgers I've ever had. Ever had the moment where you want to take your time to savor every bite, but can't stop scarfing it down and you are done in about 5 minutes? Yea, that happened.. (Don't you dare judge me!)  PBR sandwich was also great, as were the fries and chips.

5+ stars
Great for dates!
Excellent service, cool spot, charming ambience, delicious food, friendly staff. The best on State.

Fantastic outdoor seating, exceptional service, NO CORKAGE FEE!  and the dinner was great. The best burger in Santa Barbara that we've ever had.  The lobster bisque was silky smooth. Big chunks of lobster and not overly rich. Our  waitress was so nice and fun. Very knowledgeable about wine as well.

Got a really good salad, portion was great and it was delicious! Did not get the option of type of bread like the menu would have, so we were given biscuit, which ended up being delicious. Really nice vibe

My two friends and I decided to try this place. When we got here it was pretty empty, we asked to sit outside and they said they couldn't change a two person table to a three (just adding a chair) and so they added one to a table inside. When another of our friends came to meet us, we asked to move to a 4 person table or to bring a chair over to us and they said they couldn't. Their server took 30 min to ask if we were ready and take out order and then went to other tables checking up on them but somehow forgot about us and our drinks. Won't be coming back again.

Had the brunch menu to choose items from: the Fig Burger was decent, but the PBR Sandwich was great.  

The restaurant is does not have a storefront on State Street, as its address implies.  Look for it in the La Arcada Court.

Came for lunch and was really impressed by the food. We shared a seasonal arugula salad with dates,  apples, and parmesan cheese, and a pork tenderloin "reuben" style sandwich with brussel sprouts on the side (+$1 to sub one of their sides instead of fries). Everything was fresh and delicious, and prices were more than reasonable. Would definitely recommend!

Had a wonderful lunch here. Ordered the tomato and fresh mozz Panini with greens which was very tasty and fresh. Wonderful glass of pinot noir. Great service. Wonderful patio ambiance. Felt like a European café. The server was attentive and quick and our order came out quickly. Wonderful experience. Only reason not giving 5 stars is because the pour size of the wine was pretty skimpy.

We came here early on a Saturday morning, and there was barely anyone there. We were seated on the patio right away. The restaurant is located inside a little outdoor mall with some cute boutiques nearby. 
I love that this restaurant incorporates figs into many of the items! My favorite fruit!! I chose the figgin' french toast, which is a fig spread slathered between two pieced of french toast. They also offer bottomless mimosas for $15! 
Overall, the food was decent and we had a cute brunch here.

Pros:
Very good food
Nice establishment

Cons:
Antipasti could've been a little fresher
Server didn't inform us about specials or ask how we wanted our burgers done

This a great place to enjoy an amazing burger. It's located on a small and cute alley way with other restaurants, shops and a tasting room. 

Food: I had the kale soup which was so great. The Fig Burger was a perfect blend of sweet and was balanced well by the blue cheese. The fries were so good with chili flakes and parmesan cheese. I would highly recommend it!

Enjoy!
great lunch place in a nice shopping area but hard to find location of restaurant. I ordered the grilled chicken salad and kids got the yummy macaroni and cheese.

I'll add more later, but wow...delicious :).  I loved the chicken and biscuits and love the jalapeño flare added to the country gravy.  Not exactly a perfect pair with a pomegranate mimosa, but what is brunch without mimosas ;).

Service was a bit slow at first, but I forgot that the pace around Santa Barbara is a bit slower than LA.  Once we made eye contact with our server, he was right over.

Food service was quick and delicious...I will definitely be back :)

I have such a hard time deciding on where to dine for brunch in SB. So many good places to dine, such little time. State and Fig is part of my normal brunch rotation. I truly don't have a favorite between State and Fig, Jeanine's, Scarlett Begonia, Andersen's, Renaud's, The Shop, and Mesa Cafe so I have to rotate to get my fix. The figg'in french toast and the buttermilk fried chicken biscuit are two of my favorites. Love the location tucked away off of State. Close to all the action, but seems miles away.

A neat little place on the La Arcada along State Street. We had the mushroom panini and the turkey panini for lunch and they were both very well made. The outside seating is cute too. All in all, a great place.

When I was a student in SB and had an internship right around the corner from this place, it was great to always have lunch at State & Fig. Never too busy, they're quick, and they can easily give you separate checks. Their lunch prices are incredibly reasonable. My favorite was the caprese panini.

I went for breakfast one time and everyone loved what they ordered. Would definitely go back to try different things on their breakfast menu including mimosas!

The place itself is a fancy little spot. Our waitress was very friendly, and knowledgeable about our questions. I'm giving three stars because of our wait for our appetizers and entrées. After we ordered our appetizer we waited a good 25 minutes for them to come out. They were good though, and we waited yet another good 25 minutes for our entrees, not that good. I had the state burger, I think the cheese was a little on the bad side. I had stomach problems all night afterward

I love the food here. It's kind of a best kept secret. The arugula salad is to die for with figs and apples. Fantastic burgers. The clam chowder is over-the-top. Their polenta  is scrumptious. Service is excellent. It's in a beautiful courtyard setting with old world  Santa Barbara charm and elegance.  The chef is fantastic and comes out to talk to his guests which I love. Try this place!!
Best Salad I've had in a long time. Got the local grains salad, Kali Club and shared a cup of clam chowder. Iced tea was good. Much attention to detail. Great chowder. Reasonably priced for Downtown!
Delicious breakfast! The french toast with the fig cream cheese center was like a eating a pastry for breakfast. The short rib eggs benedict was to die for too! Great job guys!

Brunch!!

Always have the Fig Burger here, which is amazing, comes with blue cheese, bacon and fig jam, skinny fries with garlic mayo on the side are seriously good also. My wife is expecting and she craves the pancakes, which are delicious! 
Great warm and friendly staff makes this our favorite for weekend brunch!!

Cute spot in Downtown SB! It was exactly the kind of place I was looking for to have lunch and enjoy the good weather. The patio area was picturesque and the food was equally delicious. The food also came by fairly quickly. The rosemary and garlic fries are a must.

Four of us came and dined for dinner on the patio.  Food and service were stellar.  A hidden gem!
Starters:  Clam chowder.  Very good with plenty of clams.
                Calamari.  Generous portion.  Light and delicious. 
Mains:     Pork chop...oh so delicious w/brussel sprouts.
                Steak/frites...just the way he likes it!!
                Short ribs w/polenta....fall off the fork tender.
                 Ahi tuna special...out of this world.
We encourage you to patronize this lovely restaurant.  We certainly will!

Sally Spork reviews State & Fig

Atmosphere: Located in the beautiful and quaint La Arcada Plaza a bit of Europe in Santa Barbara. We sat outside on the patio on a Saturday evening. It was fiesta weekend and there was flamenco dance/music wafting from the courtyard: not too loud that we couldn't hear eachother/ but loud enough for us to enjoy. The owners have done a fabulous job of renovating from the past space: inside is spacious and comfortable and upscale but not stuffy. 

Service: We were seated quickly and ordered appetizers that came promptly out. The waitress was friendly and accomodating. 

Food/Drink: As I shared we just ordered appetizers as we were headed to hear a performance and did not have a lot of time. We ordered the Burata cheese and heirloom tomatoes with arugula. Fantastic! It was seasoned perfectlly with a light  dressing. As it doesn't come with bread, you might want to order some to eat with ut. We also ordered a kale and sausage (? I think) soup. It was piping hot and that is BIG for me. I can't tell you how many soups I order that is maybe very warm, but not hot. Thumbs up. Delicious. Came think grilled bread, perfect compliment. 

Summary: State & Fig is a wonderful addition to La Arcada. I'm looking forward to eating here and exploring the other appetizers and entrees. Two thumbs up from Sally Spork.

Pretty solid lunch and brunch spot. I really prefer their lunch, because it's reasonably priced and very high quality. The staff are also very nice and efficient with their service. You can't beat the patio seating. Brunch is great too, but there are lots of good brunch places in Santa Barbara. The cheap lunch during a weekday though?

I'm not from Santa Barbara, but I came here for my 25th birthday with a group of 12 people. I made a reservation a month in advanced. We got there and the table was ready. We did the bottomless mimosas brunch and our waitress never forgot to fill our mimosas up and check on us. I know how hard that could be on a busy Saturday but we received great service! We even split the bill in multiple ways but she was willing to accommodate. I would come back here again for sure!
The fig burger and fries was delicious. The service was friendly and fast, and the outside patio was a perfect environment for a Saturday lunch. Definitely give this place a try!

Enjoyed a late lunch with my family. Delicious! We all enjoyed our meals. I had a fig burger. If you like blue cheese, you'll love this sandwich. The combo of fig and blue cheese was tasty. We enjoyed our setting, too, and the service staff. My ice tea was never empty :)

This was my first time in Santa Barbara. I love it. The people, the wine, the food. Unreal. I came here for lunch and had a great meal and service.  I really wanted the burger but had something lighter. I vowed to come back for dinner. Since the next time they were open for dinner was later in the week I came back on
Wed. Really looking forward to it.  Unfortunately I had the bad luck to  be served by Doug D. He was inattentive and rude. The burger at the dinner hour was not good. May have been an off night. I told Doug and he immediately became defensive and asked if I complained at the time of service .  I indicated I could not because he never came back to our table to check on
us. If that was not bad enough  he chose to insult me and my guest. We ordered a bottle of wine but did not finish it.   When we asked to take the remainder with us. he chose to bring the corked bottle back in a paper bag and stated" here and you won't look like too much of a drunk". I was sober and can tell you I have never been talked to or treated like this in my life.  I truly don't believe the management would tolerate this if they knew about it. Thankfully there was another man there that was helpful since we never received service from Doug. I have been dining out across the U.S. and Europe for years and have NEVER been treated like this in my life  Truly unfortunate and unnecessary.
Great food at a decent price, but portions were small. Dog friendly and good service. We'd eat here again as long as we weren't real hungry. Very nice location.

My husband and I have spent 5 months in Santa Barbara over the past two winters. State and Fig is by far our FAVORITE restaurant. Jane is a close second. We have become connoisseurs of clam chowder in SB. State and Fig has the best clam chowder-- way better than Brophy's!  It's rich and creamy and chock full of tender clams. Every dish we have had there has been delicious and carefully prepared. The staff is always attentive. Sunday brunch is exceptionally good. Try the short ribs eggs Benedict with pesto hollandaise.  You won't find this melt-in-your mouth beef and egg dish elsewhere.

Ordered the BLTA. It was really nice. The Aioli was well done. The only let down was the fries. They were well cooked and crispy but it was obvious they had been fried in the same oil as fish which kind of killed the flavor for me.

Stopped by here for lunch today and sat outside. To start off this restaurant is in a great location and it was the perfect weather. Me and my friend shared the chicken sandwich and mac and cheese

The chicken sandwich was good but the mac and cheese was amazing. This is a fun place to sit outside eat some food and enjoy lovely Santa Barbara, I will defiantly be coming back here again, I want to try to breakfast!

When you go out to a restaurant and not only is the food delicious, but the service is exceptional, it makes for a remarkable evening. That's what we had at State & Fig.  Patrick the owner came out of the kitchen and greeted us, Richard was our waiter and engaged us as much as we wanted. The pork chop with Brussels sprouts was just right, also ordered the polenta, and it was perfect! Buratta toast, gnocchi, jumbo scallops with risotto were all perfectly balanced and cooked. Can't wait to come back with family or friends again. Thank you Patrick for putting a smile on my wife's face after her mom passed by providing a great meal with our family!
Delicious as always! Bottomless mimosas and a Fig burger! Husband had the lamb sandwich! Our favorite brunch in SB!
Delicious food in a cool spot. Some of the best we've had in the city. Loved the variety on their menu... so good!

Had the antipasti for three with roasted Brussel sprouts, tomatoes with feta cheese and blue cheese with dates. All three were great, but the Brussel sprouts were awesome! The atmosphere was superb. Take advantage of the outdoor seating! The restaurant was a little hard to find--- it's in the La Arcada between State Street and Fig. It's worth the extra effort to get there!

Excellent food. I came with my family. All 8 of us enjoyed the food. I had the pork chop. It was really tender. My sister had that too and normally would not touch the Brussel sprouts. But she ate everything. The short ribs was by far the best. It was tender and really tasty. Service was excellent too. It's a little pricey but the portions were big. Would recommend.

Nothing too impressive here. The food is your typical American fare. I had "the beast" sandwich and garlic fries. Fries were cut a bit too thin (not in the good way) and fried too much - kind of hard to bite into. My sandwich came with 1/4 of a pickle. I asked for more and the server gave an unpleasant look and came back 6 minutes later with 3/4 of a pickle. She didn't tell me that it was extra and we were charged $1.00 for it. The food wasn't horrible but nothing to write home about - $10.00 for a cold sandwich seems a bit pricey.
Wow.. Amazing garlic fries and burgers. I am a huge fan. Great service and atmosphere too!

My husband and I visit Santa Barbara frequently and are always looking for new places to try. We had lunch today at State & Fig and enjoyed it thoroughly. Today's menu included brunch. We sat inside as it was a bit chilly but the outside patio is beautiful. We will definitely opt for that next time. Tucked way back on State Street in a small plaza, State & Fig is easy to miss. But don't miss it! We had the Eggs Benedict served with roasted potatoes and seasonal fruit. The hollandaise was basil-flavored and very tasty. Clam chowder is made with smoked bacon and it not a super thick soup. It is served with a little packet of oyster crackers. I had the Fig burger. It was juicy, full of flavor served with fig jam, bacon, blue cheese, and caramelized onions. The burger came with crispy fries that were hot and perfectly salted. Service was quick. We both really enjoyed lunch.

Ate at State and Fig for dinner the last week. We ordered the Fig Toasts as a starter. It was beyond amazing and delicious. We also had a craving for something fried so we ordered the Parmesan truffle fries - delicious! I ordered the short ribs and my friend ordered the salmon. As a girl that rarely eats pork and beef, I assumed that the salmon would be tastier than my short ribs. Not the case at all. The short ribs were so delicious and tender. It was served with this very fine mashed potatoes and some mini-veggies. As for the salmon it was a bit over cooked. Frankly, I could make something better at home. My friend decided not eat her fish and ate some of my food instead. All in all, it was a decent experience and I would eat there again but I would not get the salmon.

Service was awful. My daughter sent her panini back because it was cold. Twenty minutes later it still wasn't back and the rest of us were done eating. We got the check and refused to pay for the panini. The staff could have cared less.

The service and the food are good.  But has the worst coffee that I've ever had!!!!!

Their coffee is almost like the water or they forgot to put the coffee in the machine and the water just came through the machine and wash out the remained coffee mark .....too bad!!

Would be a five star if not for last visit.

We get their soup here regularly. It's pricey but made well and delicious..

Their sandwich the PBR is pretty good. I enjoyed hat it actually has flavor, as some restaurant aren't very good at producing that.

Last time we came in and tried the fig burger. The burger was pretty good. The fries.... Were super over cooked they were harder than chips. We asked for new fries. Our serves said sure, and also said but this is how we always make them. This is why I am giving a 3 star rating. First no you don't, second its potatoes cook them less time and in less oil and voila! Normal fries. He brought us new fries that were normal, they didn't have much flavor, but at least we weren't breaking our teeth. Can't believe they will bring out what ever and serve it. Bad bad business.
We came here based on Yelp reviews. Did not disappoint. Food was amazing. We had Candied Apple Burger, Garlic Fries, BLTA, and Mac n Cheese. Oh and the clam chowder was yummy too!

Took a party of 2 adults and 4 kids/teens. Their service was good and staff was very friendly.  Great kids menu! My husband and neices had the State Burger and it was cooked the way they requested with a delicious balsamic salad! I had the Turkey Panini and it was made just right! Their avocados are delicious!

Went back for 4th time, two couples. Sunday lunch 1:30 today.  Place was full. Initial service was attentive, drinks arrived promptly, orders taken in a good amount of time. Then we waited for a bit for our dishes. It got to the point where I saw two tables receive their food, who had been seated after we had been. However the food was highly enjoyable as always. Three of the 4 of us cleaned our plates and the 4th had a few fries left. Pesto hollandaise on eggs benedict was a taste sensation I've never enjoyed before. Chips are made fresh, paper thin and dreamy. So if you have nowhere to be in a rush and want to simply enjoy each other's company over a nice meal, don't be worried if they look busy!

On a weekend away in Santa Barbara, it seems like there are a million restaurant options. We decided to try State & Fig based on some great yelp reviews and a mention in Los Angeles Magazine. It was a terrific pick! It's just off State Street in one of those little complexes, so it's quiet, but there's outdoor seating. The service was attentive and helpful. We decided to share a bunch of smaller items that all sounded amazing on the menu...and they were! We went with the Tasting Trio of Toasts. We had both pictured kinda smaller pieces of toast, like from a sliced baguette. These three toasts were quite large and covered with all sorts of tasty treats - fig jam and ricotta; tomato and burrata, goat cheese and squash. Each one of the three burst with flavor and deliciousness. We had some crispy Brussels sprouts, which were terrific - left us wanting more. Then the soft polenta with mushrooms etc, and finally also the toast with brie, roasted grapes, honey and fig...maybe two dishes with toast was a tad heavy on the carbs, but we couldn't help ourselves...every item was delicate. Even though there were lots of carbs, nothing felt heavy or left us overstuffed. Instead, it was "just right" and the start of a lovely evening. Highly recommend and look forward to going back!

Very disappointed!!! Will never be back again.

Service was slow. Food took forever to come when the place wasn't even busy. About 4 small tables with 2 maybe 3 people at them. So not busy. What took forever was a mystery. Food was burnt and jus plain nasty. They messed up on my girlfriends order then tried to fix it but that might have made it worse. Never came back to check up  on us. We were sitting outside on the patio. I had to go back inside to get the check because they never came back to check on us.

NO CORKAGE FEE!!!!!

Nice Location inside or out on patio

Very Good food. We had crispy sprout leaves, arugula salad and filet special.
All were great. 

The best thing is that in a city where most other restaurants try to gouge you with $25 corkage fees. Sate & Fig waives the corkage on the first bottle.

For that reason alone that you should support them.

The great food and location are a bonus.

JUST WOW.  Extraordinarily delightful. THE FOOD IS SO TASTY. I split the house eggs Benedict (only because they were out of the short rib benny speical) and the Fig n' Toast with my man. We both could not stop complementing the food while we devoured it. The flavors! The presentation! Someone in the kitchen is cooking with love here, and you can taste it for sure! This place will satisfy!!! Outdoor seating, we brought our pup and it was very mellow. It's off state street which is cool! Love me some Santa Barbara brunch. THANK YOU STATE & FIG.  JUST WOW.

My fiancé frequents State & Fig for lunch, and always raves about how delicious the food is. He has been wanting to try their dinner service for awhile, which is relatively new, so we went last night. WOW! It was so good. The restaurant itself has a nice ambience, it's warm, welcoming, and clean. We were seated right away and our server was helpful and attentive throughout the entire meal. 

They have a nice selection of beer and wine, with locals Firestone and Telegraph on tap. We began by sharing their take on a caprese salad, which had beautiful heirloom tomatoes, pesto, arugula, and the creamiest and most delicious burrata cheese I have ever had. Seriously, this stuff was good! My fiancé had the organic chicken with soft polenta. I had a bite and the skin was so tasty and crunchy, which was a nice contrast to the moist chicken. I had never tried soft polenta before, and it was like nothing else I've had and so good! I had the halibut - which was cooked to perfection - with a spicy red pepper soffrito and olive tapenade on top. It was bursting with flavor and I ate the entire plate. 

We decided to try their dessert, and we were having trouble deciding what to try. We decided upon the bread pudding, but to our surprise our waitress also brought us the budino pudding compliments of the chef! The bread pudding was to die for with a nice bourbon sauce, crispy edges, and dollop of vanilla bean ice cream. The budino pudding was a unique custard topped with a creamy caramel sauce with sea salt - very flavorful. 

Upon finishing the chef, who is also the owner, came by our table to ask us how our meal was. He explained that he sent over the budino because he found it too hard to choose between desserts himself, and he wanted us to try both. He was very friendly yet professional at the same time, and it was evident that he cares deeply about his restaurant and making people happy through food. As we paid our bill I saw him checking in with another table as well, who also seemed very happy with their meal. 

Overall this little gem in Santa Barbara's la arcada is definitely worth a visit - the food, the service, and the ambience were perfect and all for a very reasonable price. Go to State and Fig!
This place is very delicious. The pork belly sandwich is awesome and so is the SB burger.

Came here for a birthday dinner on Saturday night. Everything was so delicious--I ordered the fig burger and munched on calamari and the bacon Mac and cheese. My friends also enjoyed their meals, including the steak frites, pork chop and toasts. All the flavors mixed well and you could taste the high quality of the ingredients. The service was very good as well. Can't wait til I can come back to town to eat here again. Would highly recommend others to try!

I cannot express how much I love state & fig. They were more than accommodating for my friend's birthday brunch. The staff is wonderful and food is delicious as well as reasonably priced. Highly recommended!!
Came In for bottomless mimosas and brunch. Food was fantastic, service out of this world. Our server Larissa was a great help!
Cute spot for brunch and friend chicken sandwich is bomb! Lil but of a wait but this is a great lil spot! Good service, fast and food was yum!

I am not prone to hyperbole, especially when it comes to food. But man, I am so happy my friend stood me up today to give me the perfect excuse to finally eat at this place. 

Friends, strangers, food lovers--let me tell you this was seriously the best sandwich I've ever eaten. I had a special of the day, a lamb dip--wisely, because the other I wanted to choose was on the regular menu. Geez, I couldn't stick this sando in my face fast enough! The lamb was tender, the cheese gooey, the bread just soft enough so it was easy to eat. 

I was sad when I finished it, but happy because I finally knew how good State & Fig is! This will be at the top of my list of SB restos from now on.

Had a great brunch here with my husband! I ordered the short ribs eggs benedict and he ordered the fig and blue cheese burger. Both were delicious! I also had a mango mimosa which really hit the spot. Cant wait to go back and try all of the unique items on the menu

Rave! 
So love this place. Food is so good, atmosphere is really good, nice and quiet. Love it!  The pork chops are to freaking die for. Must have. The Fig burger is always a go to as well. Didn't have time to take pictures to post was way to hungry for that. But worth it!
Antipasti  substitution is a very nice option for just a dollar.

One of my favorite brunch spots in Santa Barbara. They open a little bit later than some of the surrounding restaurants, but I never mind waiting a bit because they are located pretty close to the beautiful Santa Barbara courthouse. I really love their breakfast burritos here. So good! Probably my favorite breakfast burrito! The service can be a little slow, but the food makes up for that :) Great mimosas as well!

Some great food here. Really like the flavor combinations in the entrées I've tried. Love the short ribs (but make sure you ask them not to add any salt). The crispy brussel sprout leaves and garbanzo beans are a fun way to start the meal. Very nice selection of wines by the glass and bottle. Don't be put off if the restaurant is empty - that seems to be typical. Just enjoy the quiet and the attention from the waiter.
Very solid lunch option in town. Very fresh food with lots of menu variety from salads to sandwiches to antipasti small dishes. Both indoor and outdoor seating. The service was very good as well.

Had a great lunch here.  The garlic fries are top notch.  Chicken panini and Med salad very good.  Service was very prompt and fast prep on our food although we did come after peak hours.  Definite recommend.
State and Fig quite possibly has the best burger I've ever had in my life.  The fig burger is absolutely delicious.  Enjoy

This place was just OKAY. I had the fig burger & my husband ate the Strip steak. My burger was okay, but nothing special. My french fries were cold & hard. My husband's steak was cooked as ordered, but bland tasting. The best part was the polenta appetizer and the wine. There are too many restaurants in Santa Barbara to go back to this one.
Loved this place. Great breakfast & brunch! Great service and located in a beautiful location.

I ordered a burger not expecting much. It was delicious! Probably one of the best burgers I've ever had. And I love burgers! The service here was great. They even have a goof selection of beer. Can't wait to get back here and have another!
Such a cute restaurant. Not being from the area we looked up a place to grab lunch, we were very happy with the food and service. Would highly recommend it!

Great food! We had the gnocchi with butternut squash and pork chop with bacon Mac n cheese and brussel sprouts. Everything was really good. May want to stay away from the burger, though. It's one of the cheaper meals, but no one in our party liked it.

Wonderfully private graduation dunner for 12. Service was extraordinary- patient, kind, thoughtful and timely. The atmosphere is peaceful and beautiful- it is like dining in Europe. The food was wonderful.

Amazing food! Just got take out cuz of the rain.  Had the pork  chop with Brussels sprouts was delicious.  Cooked to perfection as was the Mac and cheese.  Very friendly staff.  I can't wait to go back.
Went for Mother's Day Prix Fixe lunch and it was truly delicious.  My friends and I had a wonderful time, we would go ahead in a heartbeat.

I hope the restaurant owners read these reviews and consider the constructive criticism . 

This cute little café has been our go to place since they opened several years ago. We visit Santa Barbara on an almost monthly basis and always have lunch here. We take family members here for special occasions, etc. We really like the food here. The courtyard seating is so beautiful... The service here has always been fine... I have had them mess up an order, but it was no big deal and they would fix it. 
What has me a little bummed is that I have been noticing over the past year or so, the cleanliness of the place seems to be getting progressively worse each visit. The bathrooms and the hallway area behind the bar is getting really grimey. The bathroom is gross actually... They need to clean their toilet better... wipe down the door, the floor , etc. 
I take issue with the deteriorating bamboo mats on the patio tables. They are so sticky and have food stuck between the slats... REALLY? I do not want to place my silverware on them. Note: I am NOT a germaphobe or overly picky. Also, during our last visit we actually had to ask them to please change the white table cloth... it had someone elses mustard stain and food stuck to  it. For some reason they thought it was acceptable to reuse the same soiled tablecloth. My husband was kind of grossed out... 
This is a great restaurant... this is a management issue... I really hope they fix it.

After reading the reviews, I was definitely looking forward to going here while in Santa Barbara, but unfortunately it was a very mediocre experience.  First, we came in around lunch time, and they really did not know how to handle people who wanted to sit outside and were willing to wait.  We ended up just waiting patiently until the other prospective customers begrudgingly walked away out of frustration for the lack of a process.  When we were finally seated outside, the service was very slow.  It took a very long time to get out order in, much less drinks.  I am not giving them too bad of a rating because the food was fine.  Nothing to write home about, but it was good.  I had the fish tacos that were locally sourced.  The ambiance was nice and the location is prime in the city center courtyard walking area.  So, all in all, not a phenomenal experience by any stretch of the imagination, and probably would not recommend coming here unless their service improves.

Excellent food. Very creative menu and fresh ingredients. My only down note is that my salad was too small for the price. It was a side size with an entree price. Granted it was a lunch menu but still, $16 should get you a larger portion of the very delicious salad.

3.25/5 so composed

everything about it felt really well put together. i couldn't figure it out, but it was just a feeling i couldn't shake through lunch. we ordered towards the later end of the lunch hours, so it was just us inside the dining area. which was cool - it was open and airy and i enjoyed watching the staff banter a bit while our food was being prepared. 

i was pretty impressed with my order - braised short rib benedict! again, the plate was perfectly squared, and it distracted me from how much food there was. after finishing one side, i was already full. there was definitely enough short rib on there to stuff a full poboy, but it could have been more flavorful. the egg, though, was excellently poached. it had just the right egg white thickness around the yolk which burst perfectly with the slightest provocation. yum.

Just had a baby shower on the balcony of State & Fig and it was just perfect! Marisa the owner couldn't have been sweeter or easier to work with, the staff was professional and very helpful, the food was excellent and fairly priced, and the location was lovely.  I've eaten here once before and felt the same way as I did this time, love this place! I've had the Fig 'n Toast and the BLT and others at my table raved about the burger-all were impressed and happy with their food. 

Excellent restaurant that I will definitely be recommending to my friends!

Wow! We ordered the crispy garbanzo beans, brussel sprouts, kale sausage soup and clam chowder and everything exceeded our expectations! When we walked in the place didn't look like much but the food made the whole experience perfect.

We came for dinner on a Saturday night. Waited 30 min for outside table. Drinks were great. Food was great. Service was great. The toasts were so delicious. Warm Brie with apricots and roasted grapes was awesome. Gnocchi pasta special was also excellent. Yummy.

Absolutely love this place! Boyfriend and I tried it since several people recommended it - we're coming back next time we're in town!
