The Bello Benedict, Presidio and Figg'n Toast were all phenomenal; A huge plus was the excellent service. 

I will be definitely come back to experience this place again!
If I could give this restaurant a lower rating I would. Extremely rude, unaccommodating, insulting manager. Don't expect to be treated with kindness or respect.

Palazzio hosted our wedding dinner & IT WAS A 10. Ken ( the owner ) took special touches for our dinner. He even had a special menu with.....OUR PIC ON THE MENU! The food was a 10 & OMG! Sooooo much of it. We all had to take doggie bags. Thank You Ken & we will be back! Ed & Leonore Kessler
Fantastic view and quaint outdoor eating area, food was amazing too!

My husband and our one year old went here for brunch and I was less that impressed. Unfortunately I should have followed my instincts but all the great yelp reviews on State & Fig had me wanting to try it. 
When walking up to it we passed Jeannine's and it was packed! White cloth linens covered the tables outside and in, the people eating there looked so happy and it smelled great. 
So we kept walking looking for S&F, we found it right next door. We unfortunately saw naked outdoor metal tables with one family sitting outside alone. Inside it was dark and only 2 or 3 tables were taken. It was very quiet in there, and with our 1 year old I felt more comfortable outside. The tables weren't very clean, so I would have really appreciate a table cloth. There was a sign on the door that said something about a drought and water wasn't served (kind of cheap guys). Our waitress expressed that we would need to buy flat or sparkling water. So we ordered a sparkling water and a "fresh squeezed" orange juice. The OJ was not freshly squeezed, no way, and the lemon that was served with my water was also on the old side. 
We ordered the fig burger and asked for a substitution of provolone instead of the bleu cheese, and also the pork belly hash breakfast. The food came in a timely manner, not super fast but expected. Our waitress was a doll, she split our meals for us on separate plates because she knew we wanted to share them. 
Unfortunately the burger was smothered in bleu cheese, so much that we couldn't scrape it off with out the overpowering flavor ruining the burger. It looked pretty good too, but we both couldn't stand the taste of the cheese. I asked her to please take it back and she took it off the bill and just charged us for a side of fries. She was great about it, but it was a disappointment. I guess the cook missed that request. She did offer to make us a new one, but with the baby we didn't have time to wait for another entre. 
The hash was pretty good, not epic. Tasty eggs came with it and toast with a side of butter and jam. The jam dish was dirty too, it had some kind of fuzz all over the edge. I was not thrilled with the cleanliness all around, it just seemed like it wasn't a huge priority. The food was heavy, but we did order pork belly hash. The fruit that came with it was not super appealing either.  
Next time we come to SB for brunch we will check out Jeannine's next door or just go around the corner to The Anderson, were we know the food is epic! 
We did like the waitress though :)

This is a hidden gem in Santa Barbara. I came here for a double date and it was the perfect setting to chat, drink and eat great food. 
We started with the mussles special and then had 4 great entrees brought to the table. Everything was plated so well that I almost couldn't believe that we didn't pay more.
We ate the braised short rib, ricotta gnocci, steak special, and pork chop. Each dish was delicious, and the meat cooked perfect.
Our server was attentive and interactive making for an enjoyable dinner. I have been recommending this place non-stop!

Stopped here for lunch and was lucky to miss the heavy crowd about an hour earlier. Great selection, everything looked amazing, it was hard to choose! My boyfriend instantly went for the fig burger, with bacon, caramelized onions and blue cheese *drool* and garlic fries that had an amazing topping of roasted garlic and rosemary. I got the buttermilk fried chicken sandwich with slaw and chipotle aioli. Everything was so fresh, the food came out quick and we were very happy with the prices. We'll definitely be back to try the amazing brunch that we've heard so much about!!
Fantastic appetizers sautéed garbanzo beans. The beef rib with reduction in polenta is delishhhhhhh!

Service is great and very friendly. Patio is nice, gets sun but not too breezy. Price is average, not too cheap or pricey. 

Food was delicious. Had pork belly hash with butternut squash.. soooo good. Both times I've gone for brunch, I've gotten the pork belly hash.  

Coffee is decent but not amazing (only saying this since I've decided that handlebar coffee is the best in town and nothing else compares!) 

I wish they had cuter sugar options instead of normal sugar packets? That's not even really complaint though.. I guess I like this place!

Perfect place for breakfast/brunch. Waited 7 min to be seated, worth the wait. Fig cream cheese stuffed French toast was sweet and savory. The house Benedict was good as well. The home fries need improvement, taste like they've been frozen forever, but everything was well priced and filling

Horrible service. My friend and I arrived a few minutes before they opened for Sunday brunch. The group ahead of us was seated and attended to while my friend and I patiently waited at the table for nearly 20 minutes for someone to acknowledge us. A new group comes in and they were seated immediately. The waitress looks at my friend, ignores her, takes the order of the new group, and walks away. My friend spoke up and let the waitress know that we were waiting for over 20 minutes without being acknowledged by anyone. The waitress claims that she was distracted...mind you, there were only 3 groups (including us) in the entire restaurant, all of which were seated in the patio area. 
We definitively felt ostracized as we were the only Hispanic females in the restaurant and we were ignored.

Not impressed with the waiter but the food is damn good. We arrived before 4 tables. Had been waiting for our food for far too long. We asked the waiter to check on our order: and he responded, "the food will come out when it comes out." All the tables that came after us got their food!  Basically he forgot to put our order in. 

We were pretty pissed and giving the waiter the stink eye be of his rude comment. Few minutes later he came back to our table, apologized and offered us a bottle of wine. This is why they are getting 3 stars instead of 1. I felt like he made it up to us by letting us know it was his fault.  Our death stares turned into a much softer glares. 

When the food came out, it was good... Like Dayam ...it's good! We had the clam chowder with bacon, arugula with burrata salad, crispy Brussels sprouts, beet and goat cheese salad and the prawn truffle gnocchi. Mmmmmmmm

Yes I would definitely come back, I get that ppl make mistakes. I just didn't like the way he responded to us. He did redeem himself and luckily the food is delicious.

I've been here twice - the food is always pretty good. I had this polenta brunch item a while back and this weekend I had their Fig burger which was tasty and huge! I upgraded to one of their roasted beet sides for $1.5 or something more. 

But as others have stated - service is mediocre. It's not terrible, but it just feels...somewhat insincere and a little scattered. Doesn't ever feel that joyous.

I would come back because I like the food and the area is super cute but the ambience isn't wow.
This is a great place! Great brunch, very generous bottomless mimosa (and quality). Amazing atmosphere and above all customer service. A must if you are in the area. We will be back!

Yummy food, terrible service.

Came here for my friend's birthday with a party of 14.

We ordered the toast trio which was SO YUM. The fig toast and Mozz toast were my favorite.  The crispy Brussels sprouts were also TO DIE FOR.

I shared the papardelle and short ribs with a friend so we could get a taste of both and both were really tasty.

The service was terrible.  Everyone got their food except me and one other person - we ordered the short ribs.  It would have been fine except another guest at our table got the short ribs and he was already done eating by the time I got my food.

Unacceptable.  Food was being sent out to the tables outside while I watched people eat.  Great good but get it together.

Love this place. We had our son's wedding rehearsal dinner upstairs.  Marisa was a gen to work with and made everything seem so easy.
Food was fantastic and we all had a great time.  Can't wait to go back.

Wow. If you like a slightly European feel, this place is very nice.  The service was nice, the ambiance is really cool and the food is out of this world.  Go out of your way to have a meal there, you won't regret it.

The french toast with a fig cream inside was the best french toast I have ever had.

The bacon that went with it was high quality and delicious.

The coffee and cafe latte were both excellent.

My fiance' had chicken biscuits and gravy with potatoes, it was all most excellent.

We couldn't eat for the rest of the day because we were so content and well fed.

Ordered the State burger which had basil aioli, arugula, tomatoes and avocado. The burger was delicious and French fries were also very tasty. I paired with American lager on draft. My friends ordered paninis which looked equally delicious. We all enjoyed our meals.
I give this restaurant a 4 star due to the wait in receiving our drinks and food. Took 15 minutes to get drinks and 30 minutes to get our food. Seemed like they need another server in the patio.
Amazing breakfast brunch and lunch! A bit noisy inside due to the high ceilings. But you can sit outside and enjoy the pretty patio. Don't skip this place!

What a delightful find! My fiance and I stopped in for a quick lunch and was so glad we had picked this one out of the plentiful choices in the area. I had the PBR - pork belly sandwich with kraut and Russian dressing and I am still salivating over it - 3 days later. Can't wait to go back if I ever make it back to Santa Barbara again.
I was there last week for my fort try of this restaurant and the salad was excellent and the service was good.
Awesome spot!! Food is delicious and the husband and wife owners are amazingly sweet! The avocado toast with the frizzle egg is YUMMM!
Best breakfast burrito  in Santa Barbara and hands down the friendliest staff. .

I would give 10 stars if I could. Absolutely Fantastic. 
I had dinner here this evening with my wife and had a great time. We ordered the pork belly appetizer to share, I ordered the ribeye steak and my wife ordered the gnocchi. We also ordered the flourless chocolate cake. Everything was so good. The pricing is not bad at all either. We had the best waiter. I believe his name was Doug. 
We will definitely be visiting again.

There was quite a little train wreck in service outside today. I'm really not sure why - I suppose because a few tables sat down within a few minutes of one another. Maybe they were down a person? Whatever happened, it was definitely annoying.  We sat down and waited for someone to come by for 20 minutes. We knew that was a sign of things to come, but we had just hiked 6 miles and really needed to just have something to drink and eat. At one point hubby went inside to ask for water and wanted to carry it out...but they told him the server would bring it....and she never did. Ever. The server was apologetic and was very clear that it was a train wreck all around....but she was also ever-so-slightly-wacky so not sure she really grasped how annoying it all was. The food came and was fine. They did allow me to order the Cobb salad with an addition of grilled portobello (menu offers additions of chicken and turkey so I improvised seeing that they offered this as a sandwich selection). That was very good - although I don't recall diced red onion being part of any Cobb salad I've ever had before. Hubby's cluck (chicken) sandwich was just okay. I did really like the garlic fries...they were a bit better than other versions - nicely flavored.  Although the food was satisfying, don't really see the need to return.

The brunch menu seemed more lunch, but I ordered the green eggs and ham panini and my friend ordered the biscuits and fried chicken. I wanted to try the mac and cheese, but wanted something more like breakfast. The eggs were cooked perfectly and pesto yummy! However the potatoes were really blain, even w ketchup. The bottomless mimosas were delicious! Excellent and friendly service.

We can not say enough good things about this fabulous little restaurant.  The food was top notch and the service was wonderful. What a treat.  The chef truly puts his heart and sole into every meal.  My husband had the salmon and gnocchi and I had the polenta. The polenta was so flavorful with arugula, mushrooms and pesto I can't wait to go back so I can have it again!  My husband raved about his salmon and I must confess I stole a gnocchi and it was delicious.  I haven't had food this good in a long time.  If you want assembly line food don't come here but if you want a bounty of flavor and quality then definitely go to State & Fig!

This is one of Santa Barbara's best kept secrets.  We have eaten there multiple times, sampling much of the menu so we feel free to highly recommend this restaurant.  Excellent food at very fair prices.  A very special bonus is no corkage fee for wine.  Makes dinner there even more affordable.  Plus a very pleasant staff. What more could you want!

We happened upon this restaurant by accident and were drawn in by the creative menu and outdoor seating. What a lucky find!

Hope Ranch mussel special was outstanding, various small plates were amazing, truffle polenta?!!!  Out of this world. 

Our server Tracy was very friendly, gave us some great tips and made the meal special. Chef Patrick is clearly confident and working at top level with local ingredients. 

This place is a standout and not to be missed.

Excellent food. State & Fig is tucked away in a cool spot off of State St. The ambiance is unique and inviting. I ordered the fried chicken sandwich and it was great! My wife had one of the egg scrambled and it was great as well.

Great place to grab brunch on a Saturday morning! The ambience is really nice, especially when dining outside. 

The food itself is pretty good. I ordered the Breakfast Burger (~15) - great through the first half, but after that it gets heavy and the greasiness of the egg+bacon+patty combo becomes overwhelming. Needs more veggies I think! Overall 7/10! My friend ordered the Hash+Eggs Benedict+Salmon (~16), which was great! It was light and delicious - perfect for brunch. 9/10 for the hash. 

The service was fine, it took a while for us to get our bill, but our waitress took our order and brought out our food with surprising speed. 

Definitely would come back here to try more entrees!

If you live that brunch life (as most savvy people do these days), don't miss State & Fig. Santa Barbara doesn't lack in terms of options, but this is without a doubt one of the best places to whet your whistle and get your fix of staples and innovative brunch dishes. If you really want the best experience, make sure that you're served by Liz, as she's charming, vivacious, and takes care of you as if she was serving you in her home.

Do it.
incredibly awful and slow service. definitely not impressed nor would I recommend this to others.

Just ate there with our friends for lunch and ate outside in a lovely setting.
 The Cobb with chicken was excellent and I ordered the Panini with turkey/avocado, our friends ordered the Panini with chicken and the BLT.  The Ceasar salad was big and tasty and the salads with the sandwiches were perfect.  Everything was great EXCEPT the Panini  and the BLT breads were WAY TOO toasted and therefore dry and hard. and made eating the sandwich difficult and not as enjoyable as it could have been  Otherwise we would have given 5 stars. Hopefully, they will stop overtoasting their breads!

It was a great location with really good food. We went there for lunch, and I had the mushroom panini. I liked the way they cooked the mushrooms and peppers together so they blended well with the pesto. I highly recommend this place and it was a great start to our vacation.

I went in on a Friday night. We got seated fairly quickly but the waiter took an eternity to get to us. There's no free refills on soda which sucks. The food on the other hand was delicious! I had the State Burger and it was one of the better burgers I've had.

total hidden gem, but new so it won't be for long....menu is great and eclectic and appealing enough that you could have a tough time choosing, so I can see going back again soon to try more of the menu. The wait staff was friendly, and knowledgable
Fantastic brunch spot! Try the French toast or eggs Benedict. Patio is quite and sunny. Feels like vacation

A nice restaurant to grab breakfast, brunch, or lunch. We were there on a Sunday afternoon around 1Pm and they still serving breakfast and brunch. 
Food are fresh and delicious. We ordered figg'in toast and salmon salad. Portion size is decent, not too small nor ginormous. Out food tasted good. My toast was great, but I wish they do half order since I don't need to whole plate of toast to end up on my thighs the next day. The salmon salad was good too. The salmon was very moist and the salad came with a light vinaigrette. 
Service was good. Waiters are very friendly. Overall, we would eat here again the next time we visit.

On the corner of State Street and Figuoroa is a cute little bistro named State & Fig. Well, it's actually tucked into the shops, but needless to say it's a good find and a great brunch spot. 

Three amigas and I met up for a post-travel meal and bottomless mimosas. They serve brunch seven days a week, according to their website. The $18 bottomless mimosas is a great deal in theory, but they're made with $3 J. Roget Brut Champagne - a slight letdown. I def rec just ordering a nicer glass of sparkling from the menu if you're only going to drink a few glasses. 

The food menu is what made us happy. I had the $12 pesto mushroom omelette (you can get your choice of an egg scramble or omelette) made with crimini mushrooms, baby arugula, fontina cheese, basil pesto, toast, and fruit. I tend to say no to bread (well, lately) but so glad I didn't. Their house made jam paired with whipped butter - yumm, the best way to end my meal.

This is one of my favorite restaurants in Santa Barbara. I've had a few sandwiches, salads, and breakfast foods and they've all been great! Plus the prices are incredibly reasonable. Half the time I'm taking home half of my sandwich! Go here!

Stopped in based on Yelp reviews and the picture of their Mac n' Cheese.  Stayed for the Figg'n Toast (fig cream cheese stuffed French toast) and the PBR (crisp pork belly on rye).  Everything was delightful.  We ordered too much, we ate too much, but loved every bite.
Just had the Kali club and it was delicious. Can't wait to come back and try a burger. They look amazing.

LOVED this place! Great atmospere, fabulous food and cocktails :)
The food was so amazing, I like how they put fig in the pork sandwich and with presentation too! I will be back to this cafe for sure! I enjoyed our waiter, very professional and helpful in giving us tips for visiting Santa Barbara. Thank you, you big fan, Tina

The food was so flavorful and fresh. it has a cute outside area but the inside was also nice with air conditioning. To top it off the prices were totally reasonable and every person was genuinely smiling and happy to be there. We wished we could have everything on the menu too. The state burger was what I had and it was delicious.

this place is GREAT!  had the biscuits brunch meal and the Figg  & french toast.  this plc hs it all. good food, friendly service, and a great cafe style ambiance.  if ur in the area, chk this plc out...this will b my go 2 plc wen i travel out this way...GREAT JOB!!!!!

Super cute brunch place! Even though there was a hair on my dish....because the food was so good I will oversee that minor detail. 

Brunch is one of my favorite meals of the day. Although I try to avoid it because it could be deadly to your body! Came here with my two friends on a Sunday morning. It was so beautiful out, we decided to sit outside. The menu is pretty simple. Not many options to choose from, but the options they have available are actually difficult to choose between. I was stuck between the Figg'in Toast and the Lamb Panini. Thankfully my friend got the toast, while I, the lamb panini. 

BOY were they BOTH good! I wish I had the stomach capacity to have eaten both (fat status I know.) The Lamb Panini was so delish! The lamb was super moist, flavorful, and tender. Never really had lamb in a sandwich so it tasted pretty amazing. 

I fell in love with the freaking toast! Fig cream cheese? Didn't read appealing to me at first, but when my friend got it WOW. SO GOOD! It was sweet and there wasn't an overload of cream cheese or anything. 

Besides the good food! The restaurant itself is really cute and rustic. Love this place! Wish they had this in NorCal!

I planned a birthday weekend for my partner a couple weeks ago, heading down to Santa Barbara to hang out with friends at a few different spots around downtown.  State & Fig was the last spot on the agenda (well, actually, we had another place planned, but dinner was SO good, that we could barely walk afterwards... hah!)

I have to admit, I had another place planned for dinner, but it was someplace that I had been about a decade ago and it was COMPLETELY different (not for the better, unfortunately) than it was back then.  I had to do some on-the-fly planning, and I came across State & Fig, and it looked cute, upscale, and had a nice vibe to it, inside and out.  

I can't even begin to put into words what a perfect choice this place was.  At the time, I was in such a chaotic state of mind trying to find a good place for dinner in the few minutes that I had to decide... and I didn't even notice that State & Fig was close to closing time (I think we had about 45 minutes before they closed... but for a party of 8 people celebrating someone's birthday, you could imagine how long we were there)... but when I told our waiter (whose name I *WISH* I could remember, because he was absolutely wonderful, friendly, funny, nice, helpful, etc, etc) that we were celebrating a birthday, he did everything he could to make it a fantastic experience.  One of us was even going to sneak in a birthday cake, and he totally helped facilitate "the handoff".

There is so much to rave about when it comes to this place, I could go on and on and on... the ambiance, the service, and dear lord the food... all of us are still talking about how amazing the food was.  The "tasting trio" of toasts is to die for... same for the bur rata caprese, and the ricotta gnocchi was... again... to die for.  

I seriously can't wait to go back to Santa Barbara... 'cause I already know where I'm having dinner when I get there.  If you're looking for a nice place to eat with great service and amazing food... get your ass to State & Fig :D

This restaurant has a lovely setting with both indoor and outdoor seatings. The service, however, sucks. We came in on a Thursday afternoon and the restaurant was fairly empty. No one greeted us so we had to walk up to the counter. The girl didn't even look up at us, had her eyes on the register, and told us to sit anywhere. A few minutes later a waitress asked if we got menus and quickly threw them at us. 

I ordered garlic fries and a Caesar's salad. It was good but then again, how can these 2 go wrong? My friend ordered clam chowder and said it was good, but not memorable. Another friend ordered a panini and he seems to like it. One thing though, their potato chips are homemade and were extremely good!

I really wanted to like this restaurant because it's so cute but it didn't do it for me. Service needs to be fixed.

Fantastic experience! The restaurant is very nicely decorated and the location is great. And the food is absolutely delicious! I ordered the short rib benedict and WOW... So fresh, tasty, so good! Also loved the bottomless mimosa! The service was great!!! The environment was so nice, everybody was having a good time, the customers and the servers. I highly recommend it!!!

Came here for a light snack prior to wine tasting.  Was promptly sat and the service was excellent.  Loved the tapas that we had (3 for $11).  It was quite filling.  At the time, there were only 6 tapas selections on the board.  The rest of the menu was not tapas, but looked really good.  I'd go back to try all 6 tapas next time.

Tucked in the back of a plaza off of State street, outdoor seating (as well as indoor) and a good vibe all around.  They had a nice brunch menu however we all ordered from the regular menu.

The Toast with Burrata and tomatoes was amazing, very good, very fresh and you can tell local - quality ingredients.  

I had the Fig burger - NOT something I would normally try but the combo of fig jam, bacon and blue cheese was intriguing.  And it was great.  The burger was cooked perfectly and the combo of the fig, bacon and blue cheese worked.  My husband had the portobello panini and loved it.  My Dad had the BLT - also a hit.  

There are so many great places to eat in Santa Barbara - you can tell that State and Fig takes pride in their food.  It's local, fresh and well executed.  Also great selection - there is something for everyone (even my vegetarian husband).

I took a group here for work.  It was the perfect spot for a group/work dinner.  Everyone seemed to really enjoy their food.  I would definitely say this is a solid spot for dinner.  Tough to find, but worth the search!

Very nice lunch in a quiet spot just off State Street. Really crisp garlic fries made an excellent starter and the fig burger was excellent. My wife really enjoyed her California club sandwich as well. I would highly recommend this as a great lunch spot for anyone visiting Santa Barbara.

We have eaten here several times in the last few years. We eat lunch here every time we are in Santa Barbara. The BLTA is to die for, burgers have always been great and the staff is always friendly am courteous even when they are slammed!

First time trying this place and I thought it was pretty decent. I ordered the breakfast burrito with bacon and chorizo and it came with a side of fruits and a salad. The dressing that came with the salad was a little too strong so I definitely recommend only using a little at once. The burrito was great! Since I did order it with chorizo, it got a little bit messy since it was oily however the salad did a great job taking the aftertaste off. 

My boyfriend ordered something off the brunch specials menu. I forgot the actual name of it but I've attached a picture of how it looks like and it has the name biscuit included and it also had chicken. I tried his dish and was not really a fan of it. The sauce was thick which I did not care for and the eggs were runny which I liked but my bf didn't. His dish came with a side of fruits and potatoes which was amazing! The potatoes were roasted I think and came out to be perfectly crunchy and very well seasoned. 

We also ordered the bottomless mimosa and that was amazing as well! The overall ambiance of the restaurant was nice and the service was pretty great. Our server was on top of it and was always there to see if we needed anything else and made sure our drinks were always topped off. I would maybe come back again and would definitely try other items from the menu.

Went here for Sunday brunch because we were looking for bottomless mimosas. They had good champagne and ample refills and the option to get pomegranate or mango juice for $2 extra added to the $15 for bottomless mimosas. I thought the Pom mimosas were delish and the server wasn't stingy with the champagne. To eat we had the extremely delicious fig burger and the to die for arugula salad. So good. We had an excellent experience here and will definitely be back the next time we visit.

Great location in Downtown Santa Barbara. Parking lot is conveniently close. I went there on a Tuesday afternoon for lunch and it was fairly empty. Service was A+. Food is good but not extremely exciting. I had the grilled chicken ratatouille. Good food for a decent price, can't beat that.
This place is so under rated, and does a phenomenal lunch.  Their sandwiches are off the charts good, eat here you won't be disappointed.

The food was excellent but the service was not that great. I had ask for a straw three times :/ and I didn't see my server frequently. I'd definitively would come back, but they'd earn another star if the service was better.

Quaint location in La Arcada. We had the State Burger which was solid and The Fig burger who was over the top.  Who would have thought to put Bleu cheese and fig jam in a burger.  Friendly service and nice spot to have a meal sitting outside

Big fan of this place. Big fan!

My girlfriend and I were able to catch this place right as it opened and there was literally no one else there. I have tried going before but the wait has always been super long. Really luck to catch no wait this time.

First off, we got the bottomless mimosas and they poured the champagne HEAVY! THIS IS THE WAY IT SHOULD BE!!! When I order bottomless mimosas, I want a nice buzz when I leave so I can go shopping and buy silly things and not care until way later. They did a great job of helping me achieve this goal.

For entrees, my girlfriend ordered the fig french toast. It was so damn good. I really wanted to steal it from her and eat all of it but hey, I am a great boyfriend. I ordered the short rib eggs benedict and it was so damn good. The pesto sauce was a nice touch on a breakfast classic.

Come early and come often.

Excellent food. 
Fig Burger and House Burger: amazing burgers, the meat is one of the best hamburger meat. 
Shrimp Taco: Excellent
Benedict Eggs: Excellent
Really yummy brunch! Located in a nice quaint corner of state street. the fig toast was to die for.

This place is very inconsistent.  We have eaten there three times now on two trips to SB.  The first time was excellent:  we had a great kale and bean soup, an excellent burger, the crispy brussel sprouts, etc...all cooked to perfection and delivered with great service and a perfect wine recommendation.  We liked it so much we went back that same trip.  Only three nights later, however, the same soup was salty beyond belief (as if someone was trying to test the limits of NaCl solubility in water), although the rest of the food was good, as was the service.  On a recent trip. we tried this place again the first night in SB and had very slow service.  We waited over 45 min for burgers!  The waitress didn't even check with us during that time.  The burgers, a salad special, and the crispy garbonzo beans were good when they arrived, but the service was so slow that it irritated several in our party.

So, basically, if you hit this restaurant on the right night, you can get great food and service.  If you hit it on the wrong night, you might get poorly prepared food (eg. 5 molar salt in soup, LOL) or bad service.  If they could be consistent, they'd be a much better restaurant.  Not sure we'll go back next time we're in SB.

I arrived with my party of 7 and was told there was an hour wait. There had been an open table suitable for our party and we were the only party waiting. When another party came in, they were seated right away at that vacant table and had the same amount of people in their party. It is interesting that a fully white party was seated without a blink upon arrival and my party that has a diverse mix of people are still waiting for what is now an hour and 15 minutes. This place is racist. Don't eat here if you're not white.

Our go-to place for dinner or brunch in Santa Barbara. The burger with fig jam, blue cheese, arugula and bacon is outstanding. The fish dishes are always delicious. Be sure to ask for the garbanzo bean (chick pea) appetizer. It's not always on the menu but they will make it. Crispy, crunchy, garlicky, lemony deliciousness. I could eat an entire basket. Recently enjoyed a brunch special of avocado, tomatoes, bacon and a poached egg on grilled ciabatta with chimichurri sauce. Great combination of tastes. Lovely spot tucked away inside La Arcadia off State Street.

Wow, what an amazing meal I had the other night... A group of us went there for a birthday on a Wednesday night and sat upstairs, and they stayed open for us past closing (since our reservations were at 8:30 and they close at 9:30 most nights). 

Now let's get into the food: I was told to try the toast trio and so glad I did - three different types of "toast" to suit your tastebuds; sweet, savory, or decadent. Thick pieces of bread toasted with different assortments on top (squash, fig, burrata). Warm ricotta and mozzarella cheese is all I have to say. 
The antipasti roasted chickpeas were a nice little snack to go along with the toast because I walked in starving.
I ordered the steak frites medium, cooked to perfection, but subbed for the soft cheesy polenta instead of the Mac and cheese with bacon (luckily I got to sample the Mac&Chs and could have gone either way, both heavenly), served with broccolini.  Also sampled the Gnocchi which was out of this world! Unlike any gnocchi I have tried before, not super saucy but BIG on flavor and texture was divine. I wish I could have had two meals there, everything sounded epic.. I will be back VERY soon! Thank you!

We went to State & Fig for brunch and bottomless mimosas. The atmosphere was pleasant and our server was highly attentive and unlike other "bottomless mimosa" spots the server was great at keeping the mimosas bottomless. I ordered the caprese omelette which was very flavorful and light. 

Pomegranate flavored mimosa was the best bet, the orange juice used for the classic version tasted like Tang to me. They were very generous on the champ to juice ratio. 

Note: they won't seat you until your entire party is present.

Sunday brunch for my honey's birthday; bottomless mimosas and excellent service! This is definitely a hidden little spot that is worth the price. Wouldn't go back to Santa Barbara without visiting this place. Waitress was very friendly and extremely professional. Loved it!

Overall, good experience. Ordered the braised beef short ribs--it was super tender, but the sauce was a bit salty. The lamb chops were great. I also recommend the burrata toast! Took a bit for the food to come out.

While I was waiting outside for the restaurant to open, I saw the backery beside it boasting with people and the queu was pretty long. That's when I began setting the bar for state and fig pretty high. As we got in from the wet and rainy weather, the waiters offered the people infront of us the door next to the door. they rejected and took a seat somewhere else. The same happened to us. We started ordering a hot chocolate but unfortunately they didnt have any. In my opinion they couldnt even offer a basic drink. The waiter was very nice and suggested some of his favourite dishes (which is typical for the States and me as a German, got used to it already). We ordered the crispy chicken on a biscuit for the table, some turkey sandwich, eggs benedict and a serving of french toast. I must say, when it comes to food, this was just mindblowing! Every single dish was perfect in it's own way. garnished with fruits and vegetables that had just the right amount and color. I was impressed and definitely happy we waited for the restaurant to open and did not go to the other place beside it. Definitely recommendable!

What a cute location, it feels like you're transported to Europe. The food is excellent here, but if you go between lunch and dinner prepare to wait for the staff to change over. They do have bottomless mimosas until 3:15!!!

I called to ask if it was possible to make reservations for a large party on a Sunday. The young girl who answered said that for large parties they DO take reservations and took down all my info saying that I just needed to wait for a call back to confirm. Never got a call back so I called and was told the total opposite. Apparently they DON'T take reservations for large parties on a Sunday. So now I'm a day out from my event day and do not have a reservation like I thought. When I asked how/why I was given the wrong information this rude man on the phone just said I don't know. I will definitely never give this place my business.

We had the figg'n jam toast. We were told it was very sweet.  So true, and so good.  It's a French toast-like dish in which the bread is stuffed with a cream cheese/fig jam combo.  Delicious!  Scratch-made sausage on the side helped to counteract the sweetness. 
The only reason this isn't a 5-star review is that the server forgot our drinks.  Other than that, we had a great meal.

This review isn't about the food, because due to the AWFUL service we never got to even try their food. We walk in and no one is at the hostess stand. Meanwhile multiple servers walk by us and ignore us. Finally after standing around 10 minutes someone finally acknowledged us. They wrote our name and said they were clearing a table and we can sit. Well , no one cleared the table and they all moved with zero urgency. Finally after waiting an additional 10 minutes, we left and went next door where we were served right away and had great food.

Went for a late brunch last Sunday during our day trip to Santa Barbara. The hostess/waitress seated two parties who arrived just minutes ahead of us, and then asked us to wait just a few minutes while they cleared a table inside the restaurant for my party. I think the waitress forgot about us, even though we were standing a few feet away from the outdoor tables she was taking orders from... because it wasn't until 20 minutes later that a waiter who had noticed our growing discontent asked us if we wanted to be seated. We were led to a table that had been clearly empty but ready the whole time...

The food was pretty good. We had a hash plate and a sandwich that was made with their signature fig jam. I was so hungry that I enjoyed the meal, but I will probably go elsewhere next time I'm in the area.

This is the worst service I have ever experienced in a restaurant. When we arrived we had to wait for our entire party to arrive, which I completely understand. But when everyone was there no one helped us sit down and just told us we could sit at the table. Once sitting, no one helped us or came over to give us menus for 15 minutes so we had to grab our own. It took about 20 minutes before a waiter finally came over to get our drink orders. I ordered a cappuccino and everyone got their mimosas and coffee after 20 minutes. When I asked the waitress where my cappuccino was she gave me a rude and short remark. It took a total of 40 minutes to get a cappuccino!! I would maybe understand if they busy but they weren't, I could see the waitstaff standing around. Overall the service took way too long, and we ended up being there for 2.5 hours waiting for everything from drinks to food to the checks. The only reason I did not give 1 star is because the food was pretty good and the presentation was pretty. But the food does not make up for the worst service I have ever received, I will definitely not be returning.

A delicious  surprise. We drove up from Los Angeles to see Eddie Izzard at the Grenada. We were pressed for time as well- show started at 8pm. Think we rolled into state & fig at 7:15. Anyway I ordered the trout.  It was so delicious. And so we're the sides- it was a lot of food as well about 2 meals in one for me.  Boxed the rest to go.  Thanks. Will definitely stop in again.

I went here the other day for lunch with a friend. Love the location, the ambiance and food was super delicious!! Only issue I had was with the bill. I had ordered a sandwich and when I did the server asked if I wanted fries or a salad with it. I said a salad. When I received the bill I had an extra charge on there for it. I don't mind upgrading and getting something extra if it is something I want but the issue I had was not being notified it was extra. When I originally ordered it she never told me it would be an extra charge and when I asked her about it later she said  "yeah it is an upgrade". I was pretty frustrated and irritated about this. I was talking with a few friends and they also stated this has happened with them before. It's just the principle of it, being deceiving and not communicating with your customers if something will cost extra just to charge them more is not okay. Everything else about my experience here was great just please be clear if you will be charging extra for something in the future with your customers. :) Thank you :)

The food is fairly good, the owners are nice, but the service staff need more training in taking care of clients. Myself and my family were kept waiting without even a nod from the wait staff for longer than a fashionably late moment. I talked with the couple beside me who were from Santa Barbara and they said there menus were shoved in their face then didn't see their waiter for about 15 minutes.
The fig toast was amazing! The portions were very generous for being small plates and everything was delicious. Would definitely go back next time I'm in town.

Came here on Sunday around 1pm and it was quite slow. Our waitress was less than happy to serve us and I had to ask for things so many times. The food was okay. We all ordered burgers and was happy with what came out. I ordered the chunks chicken burger; the chicken was great but the slaw and sauce lacked any flavor. My other two friends ordered the BBQ burger and another I couldn't remember the name (sorry!) but they said it was so so. 

Parking: there's a structure right behind and it's free 75 mins. We were at the restaurant and walked around for an hour and it cost only $3. 

Price: it was a little more than we thought it was worth but the atmosphere was great. The service didn't match the place, our waitress was just spacey and focused more on tasks behind the bar than actually tending to her tables. We had to flag down other people to get even get a refill on our waters/ice teas. But she sure was on top of getting us our check! 

I wouldn't come here again, there's so many other good places to eat but it was nice to try this place once.

The Service: Our server, Doug, is so wonderful!! Very attentive service and very professional~ He is super knowledgeable about the menu. 

The Food:

Fig Toasts - Grilled crostoni, ricotta, fig jam, arugula, lemon EVOO (the crostoni crunchy outside & so soft inside! The fig jam is not overly sweet, it totally compliment the rocotta cheese. Wonderful appetizer!)

Tuscan Sausage & Kale Soup - Grilled bread (hearty soup, perfect for cold weather. Lots of ingredients inside the soup, every bite is full of surprises!)

Braised Short Ribs - Roasted carrots, soft polenta, arugula, pecorino, truffle essence (the short ribs totally melt in my mouth, super tender. The polenta is a little bit cheesy, love the texture!)

Great outdoor seating area.
Gourmet paninis for lunch menu. The mushroom panini and fennel sausage are delicious. The seasonal salad is excellent. The Brussel sprouts is average. Service is very prompt and courteous.

This restaurant is in La Arcada. We were in a group of 5, and got seated quickly. The service was not great, unfortunately. They were very busy, and we had to wait with empty glasses several times. The food was so-so, not many choices for a vegan. Overall, I'd give it a weak 2 stars. The poor service we got was definitely a bruise on the fig.

Everything was great, The Staff were PERFECT.

Some of the best service I have had.

The food is good, but just good. I don't mind spending $50-60 for an awesome meal for 2, but the food was tasty and delicious, but not memorable.
You need a bit of wow-factor for a 4-5 star.

Stopped by here while visiting SB for the day and it was great to see that they have an extensive brunch menu AND BOTTOMLESS MIMOSAS ($17/person) which pays itself off if you're planning to drink more than 2 mimosas. And they're strong! The ratio is definitely in favor of the champagne. 

I ordered the Figg'n toast because I wasn't in the mood for savory and it was so delicious! The addition of powdered sugar on top of the syrup and the fig and cream cheese made it a little excessive sweet but nothing my sweet tooth couldn't handle. Definitely recommend it! They also let me substitute my choice of meat with potatoes instead, which was great! This place is super cute, I wish it was warm enough for us to sit on the outdoor patio because it's located in such a neat alley way. 

My only complaint would be that they aren't super helpful in trying to get you a table right away. Granted, we were a group of seven and their tables are mostly for parties of 1-4 people but it looked like there was a table up stairs that just needed to be cleared but instead we were prompted to wait. 

Other than that! Come here if you want a delicious and boozy brunch!

Definitely the place to go to for bottomless mimosas on the weekends. My friends and I would literally stay there for hours during their bottomless mimosas.  But in order to get the bottomless deal, you must order food as well.  Which is probably for the best. 

When I went I got the Clucks sandwich, which I think they only serve on the weekends.  Oh my goodness, it was the bomb let me tell you.  It was a friend chicken sandwich with a spicy slaw, topped with an egg on a buttery bun.  It was a lot to handle but it definitely made my heart happy and hurt all at the same time.  

Great place to hangout with friends on a weekend, during the day or honestly whenever.

My folks and I were scoping out the menu when a whole group of diners waved us into the restaurant. 'Eat here! You won't be disappointed!' 

They were right! I had the burger. Caramelized onions, a fig jam, and bacon. I can't remember a better burger.

The staff were kind, responsive, and knowledgeable. Upon their recommendation, we tried the butterscotch  pudding. Salty sweet perfection.

Enjoy!!

First time here for lunch today. The meal was quite good. Had the ham panini. Very tasty! 

Gave 4 starts because service was a little slow. It was hard to get our waiters attention for things like refills of sodas, etc. The table next to us had the same challenge. 

Great location, though, to people watch!

Visited Santa Barbara for the day and decided on State & Fig due to the Yelp reviews. We sat outside as we had our pups with us and the patio is dog friendly. 
I got the Pesto Mushroom omelette (asked for no baby arugula) and my husband got the Kali Club. Both were plenty and delicious, with a fair price point. 
Really like the vibe of the restaurant and we enjoyed the super friendly service.

Came here for a late lunch.  Very good service and the salmon Benedict was very, very good. Good value for the quality of food.  
It may be a little hard to find since this is off State street but in a beautiful location with outside dining.

I just celebrated my birthday there with a few girlfriends and it was AMAZING! As others have stated, the bottomless mimosas are amazing. As is their salmon benedict and french toast amazingness for an incredible sweet treat at the end! Charming ambiance, awesome service, love this place (I am local) and can't wait to get back there ASAP!
Excellent dining experience! The outdoor seating is beautiful. The food was delicious - very detail oriented. The service was tremendous and very prompt. Our kids even loved it!

I went here for dinner and at first the waiter felt cold although very sophisticated which is something I don't see very often anymore. 
AMAZING service, checked on us just the right amount of times and was very polite. And the man waiting on us did warm up as the meal continued. 
This is a very nice place, the decor, the service, great place to take someone you want to impress. :)
The food was DELICIOUS!! We had the brie plate for an appetizer and the grapes that came out with it were warm :)
For a beer, 3 dinner meals, desert, and an appetizer it was $96 which isn't too bad considering how delicious it was. 
This isn't going to be for everybody, if you are into more casual dining go here for lunch. I was impressed !
I've got to confess there was a hair in my ice cream which hey, things happen! They maybe should pay more attention next time!

Food was amazing, service was not the best.  Walked in and wasn't greeted or acknowledged for a while till we got someone's attention.  Ladies were friendly though and our food came in a timely manner.  I got the brunch burger which was amazing but quite big.  Only thing about it that I didn't like was that it has Brie cheese and it dries up by the time you get it so it's not very melty.  Overall a very cute place with a nice ambiance

The absolute best restaurant I can  think of that I have been to!  The food is always exceptional and I love everything we have eaten there.  Patrick and Marisa are the sweetest and nicest people.  The rest of the staff is friendly and timely and very accommodating.  Our wedding reception was top notch and everyone was raving about the food.  And the prices for Santa Barbara cuisine were more than reasonable.  Please do not miss your opportunity to check out a very wonderful dining experience in Santa Barbara.

The food was very good! Ordered take out for work. Shared the basic burger and the fried chicken sandwich. Both were outstanding, loved the fried chicken sandwich. Location is right around the corner from my office so I will be ordering from here regularly. I am keeping it on my list for weekends to enjoy the brunch and bottomless mimosas!!

After I got engaged last year I immediately started tackling the big things like reception venue search and found State and Fig as a potential option. My brother's girlfriend helped me in the beginning get in contact with Patrick and discuss things like a tasting menu appointment and cost/event details. Before we visited State and Fig we had a few options on the table, but after meeting Patrick, his staff, and eating the AMAZING food we had no doubts that this was the spot to host our wedding reception at. Patrick and Tracy are two of the nicest most helpful people I have ever met! THE FOOD HERE IS AMAZING!! We planned the short ribs and gnocchi for our main courses for our wedding guests and EVERYONE at multiple times told me how delicious and amazing the food was. Even a couple days after I had guests texting me about how much they enjoyed their dinner and all the appetizers! Their brunch is so good. The fig and toast french toast is so delicious, I wish I could eat it every morning. This is definitely a spot we will always make time for when we are up in Santa Barbara.

My boyfriend and I drove up from LA.  We wanted to enjoy a fun and relaxing day trip to Santa Barbara.  Yelp's reviews for State & Fig were very good.  Enough of a reason to give it a try.  The restaurant is located in a very Euro style alleyway.  Nice ambiance.  We sat outside in their patio area with Donut.  That's a big bonus for a dog lover like myself.  However, it was a bit cold outside.  February in CA is always a little cool so bring an extra sweater.  There were no space heaters!  

The food was good but I wouldn't say great.  Portions were decent.  I had the pork and kale soup.  My boyfriend had a sandwich with salad.  

The service...  Meh...  Our server was friendly and took our order quickly but the wait for the food took much longer than normal.  About a 15 minute wait.  It was another 20 minutes for us to receive our check.  My boyfriend finally got up and approached the waitress to pay.  He went inside the restaurant.  Boo....  

Will I return on my next trip?  Probably not.  The wait was too much of a wait.

Finally just getting around to writing a review! 
My husband and I hosted our wedding rehearsal dinner here and everything was wonderful. From the start, Patrick, was super accommodating and helped us with our set menu. We had a very tight budget, but he made it work! The setting is super intimate and all of our friends and family enjoyed dinner. Definitely recommend for small parties. :)

Prior to yesterday's lunch visit, we had a wonderful experience at State and Fig. We had the worst experience yesterday; perhaps the waiter was new because we had the most horrible service in years. Didn't get our coffee drinks for over half an hour (we saw them on the counter just sitting there) and when they arrived, they were mildly warm. Lunch never did arrive. We waited for 50 minutes for our food and finally decided to leave. Hopefully the staff can get their act together and serve the food in a timely manner!!
Delicious bella benedict, pork belly sandwich and mushroom panini. Service was pretty good. Ambiance outside is was what made the experience memorable.

I'm 109% sure our waitress was hungover (or maybe just super tired?!) because she kept slurring her words, and she accidentally poured more champagne in our non-bottomless mimosas. I'm not complaining (of course) - just thought it was funny :) 

Anyways, this is a lovely little place for brunch with friends!

Came here around 11am for brunch on Easter Sunday! Outdoor seating was all taken up (the views are great & the shading is perfect), but there were a lot of open tables inside. We took a seat inside because we didn't want to wait. 

What we got: 
1) Bello Benedict - The only thing that made this dish unique was the pesto, which made everything incredibly delicious! I NEED this pesto recipe!
2) Pesto Mushroom Omelet - I had a bite of my friend's, and it was pretty solid! Again, the pesto saved the plate. Otherwise it would be pretty mediocre. 
3) MIMZ! (Mimosas). Pretty pricy considering ours had more OJ than champagne. But it was still good!

My friend is vegetarian, and she very much appreciates the many options they have for her! 

Service was friendly but incredibly slow considering there weren't even a lot of customers. There was a family of about 8-9 next to us that didn't get their food until we were about to leave (and they were seated before we were).

I was looking forward to eating here today with my family. It was closed so we had to dine at the Mexican restaurant which was a major disappointment. Next time how about update online that you will not open.

Came here as we were passing by Santa Barbara. It was Sunday around lunch time and the restaurant next door was packed. So we went to State & Fig and were seated outside right away. 
The patio area is not that big but it's nice and it is also dog friendly. If you don't like dogs then probably not a good idea to eat outside as most of the patrons had their dogs with them. 

I ordered a panini which came with fries and my bf ordered an omelet which came with breakfast potatoes. They had bottomless mimosas for $17, I couldn't partake because we were just passing through. 

Overall, the food was good, loved the ambiance and location, they also had great service. Taking off 1 star because the food wasn't that memorable and the patio area was cramped with dogs.
Came here for brunch and ordered the fig toast and the short rib Benny. Both were amazing!!!!

Where to begin...Patrick and team helped create the perfect rehearsal dinner and welcome drinks for our wedding weekend last month! From day one Patrick couldn't have been easier to work with, being flexible on entree choices and drinks. The food was PHENOMENAL (wish he could have done our wedding too) and the staff was so pleasant and kind, especially as a larger group than expected showed up for welcome beverages.

In one of our planning weekends we visited State and Fig for brunch and I had one of the best breakfast burritos in my life! You can't go wrong coming here for either meal, thank you Patrick and team!!

Loved it here. Delicious food and wonderful service. We got there around 7:15 pm on a Saturday, and there was no wait. We sat outside, which had a very lovely atmosphere since the restaurant is located in one of the cute  & romantic alleyways in Santa Barbara. I ordered the Duck, which was so good! The service was just excellent! Not once do I remember seeing my friends' champagne glasses empty. Even though we had the bottle on the table, the waiter always came around to ensure their glasses were full.

I thought the prices were moderate. The entrees were in their $20's, which I think is decent for this fancy restaurant compared to the other fancy ones in Downtown Santa Barbara.

Sad about this review. First off: the food was good. My wife got the breakfast burrito, I got a club with fried, and we both got some wine. It was Sunday at lunch time and they were busy, but not swarming. The problem was with the service. Took a very very long time. When it came out, I got the complete wrong sandwich and the wrong side. They replaced it after a bit, but then lagged in bringing me the requested condiments until I was half done. When the bill came out, I was surprised to see a sub charge for switching house made chips to house made fries. Sub charges are fine, I guess even though it was another dollar on top of a 12 dollar sandwich to change it from one type of fried potato to another type of fried potato. Anyway my gripe isn't with the charge alone, I was just taken aback that they included an extra charge when under similar circumstances, other restaurants would comp, discount, or offer something extra to make up for the poor service and incorrect order. Wish I didn't have a bad taste in my mouth because the place itself was nice and the food was good, but alas.

Awesome little spot tucked away in the little side street. Great menu, cool staff, amazing decor and patio seating. Great place to just hang out and have a nice glass of wine and people watch as you eat a relaxing meal.
Poor service. I was waiting for ages and the workers didn't bother to help me. Won't be going back

Excellent experience this evening.  Had 4 small plates, one entree and one dessert.  Everything was outstanding.  Each plate was  presented with great detail and had deep rich flavor. The wait staff was attentive and chef came to our table to chat.  I will come back again!
Jocelyn was lovely! She kept our glasses full and was very accommodating of our party. The food was great and was only outmatched by the service!
Love this place. Great food and service. They do a really good lunch. Salads are wonderful and the clam chowder is very good.

The customer service is terrible and always is. We've been a frequent there for months and this visit is the one that set me off. My girlfriend and I sat there for 10-15mins without any interaction. Not even water, so I kindly stacked the menus and left and don't plan on returning.

Nice small place. Atmosphere was nice. Service was really good. 

We started with the clam chowder...really good. Solid amount of clams. 

The entrees took a while and I did notice other tables who were seated after us were served first but we weren't in a huge rush. The server noticed this as well and came over to apologize for the delay. 

My son had the pork chop with Brussels sprouts and side of mac and cheese. Pork chop and bsprouts were really good (stole a few pieces). The mac and cheese were a little overwhelming for my son, but I thought it was good. You could tell it had a nice mix of cheeses.

I had the fig burger...good taste and prepared well. There was something that didn't sit well with me but I don't regret getting it.

great place for brunch, tucked away in the private and rustic la arvada in scenic sb. staff is great, food is better. come for bottomless mimosas and get sloshed. braised short rib benedict and fig burger are incredible.

I'd give them 20 stars if I could!  I'm in my early 60s and I'm not kidding when I say my meal at State & Fig is the best meal I have ever had in my entire life!  This was our first visit to State & Fig.  They have a really beautiful location in the La Arcata Plaza off State Street with plenty of outside seating ( much nicer outside than inside) - dog friendly too.  Our server Doug brought water for our dog as soon as we were seated.  The food was off the charts good!  Here's what we had:
Fig Toasts - grilled crostoni bread with fig jam, ricotta cheese with basil (I think), arugula and a lemon-infused olive oil.  I could have made a meal on just this!  5 plus stars
Herbed Chicken with fingerling potatoes and spinach in this buttery, garlic wine sauce.  Very rich and so good.  5 plus stars
Chef's Special of Pan Roasted Scottish Salmon and Shrimp over Cheese Gnocchi with tomatoes, asparagus (I don't even like asparagus, but I loved this) and this buttery, garlic pesto.  Best thing I have ever eaten!  20 stars!!!!
I want to go back and try everything on their menu and every Chef Special!  Our server Doug was perfect, even with his choice of a wine for me...a simple Rose from McIntyre Vineyards.  Perfect!

I was looking forward to trying this place but unfortunately it didn't live up to the expectations at all. The food was not good and the staff was rude and inconsiderate, you're better off going somewhere else.

My family and I had a great lunch here. I particularly appreciated the chef and waitress accommodating my husband's gluten allergy by cooking his meal on a separate pan. Everyone's dish was great (Patty melt house special, BBQ burger, House Eggs Benedict), the only dishes that weren't spectacular were the garlic fries (had too much rosemary) and the Pig and Fig panini, it was a bit too sweet for us. But thank you so much for the lovely service and lovely lunch overall.

My mom and I had such a wonderful experience here last weekend after seeing the Shen Yun show at the Granada. Though it was a little difficult to find, it was worth it! The setting is beautiful, with walls covered in ivy and stone walkways, it felt like we were in Europe! The inside architecture of the restaurant was lovely too. Our waiter was very friendly and took care of us more than I have experienced at any other restaurant. The food was to die for (especially the fig burger!). The pricing was surprisingly very do-able, though it was a high-end experience. I will definitely be coming here again the next time I am in Santa Barbara!! Thanks for a great experience!

A MUST if you come to Santa Barbara. It has the perfect brunch set up with outdoor seating, which I prefer over the cold and a little dreary indoor seating. The food is what truly sets State & Fig high on my list of favorite brunch places. The State Burger is a must. I've had a lot of burgers in Santa Barbara (yikes) but this one of my favorites. The basil aioli, perfectly cooked patty, and soft buttery bun just combines together so well! We also got the "figg'in toast" strong fig flavor and a unique dish for any sweet tooth. I'm glad my friend and I decided to split because I wouldn't have been able to enjoy the french toast as my only entry. 

Just note that they can get very busy and the wait can get to be 40 minutes depending on your luck. 
The only downside is that they're only wine and beer- meaning I didn't get my Bloody Mary- but overall one of the best brunch places in SB.

My friends and I had a bachelorette weekend ahead of us and the bride requested state & fig. I called in advance to make a reservation as we were a party of 8 but was told they do not take any reservations. The day of, I thought to call on our way to put our name down on the waiting list and was informed they cant do that but instead suggested I make a reservation, as it was a large party. I was extremely frustrated because they had just told me a few days before that they do not take reservations. I explained the situation and they quickly accommodated us. 

It was such a beautiful ambiance and service was amazing. Our server Tracey was so great and extremely friendly. She made our celebration that much better.

Our party was really happy about the food and bottomless mimosas. I would definitely recommend the tomato Panini! Though it was a rough start, I will definitely be returning here when I am in the area!

La Arcada Plaza is a cute alleyway that makes you feel you've left State Street for a different country. State & Fig is just another happily situated restaurant.

The interior is beautiful. My only criticism is that the tables along the front window are too close to each other. Despite the tables being empty, I couldn't pull my chair out without hitting the next table's chair. If the restaurant was full, it would have been awkward and uncomfortable. I understand trying to maximize seats, but I would remove one of the tables to avoid any customer discomfort.

We came for brunch. The service was super friendly and attentive. I ordered their brunch special of biscuits and gravy. It was really more of an Eggs Benedict as there was meat (fried chicken), eggs on top and gravy (in lieu of Hollandaise). Call it what you like, it was tasty!

The potatoes on the side were good. However, the cut fruit looked at tasted old. Not appetizing at all.

Went here for brunch with my girls when we were hungover from a night on the town. Amazing. Loved our server. Also they seemed like they counted out every single piece of fruit on your plate so you all have the same amount of each little fruit... how thoughtful. 10/10 recommend the Bats Benny Benedict. We got ours with well done poached eggs cause that's how we do. Also nice patio. dug into the food before we could take a picture so here's an after pic ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Tasty brunch spot with many selections of classic egg items (omelets, benedicts) as well as savory lunch plates and salads. I found the place to be pescetarian and vegetarian friendly. 

The boyfriend and I tried their Bello Benedict with portobello mushroom, arugula and basil pesto hollandaise, as well as their daily special of Prawn and Avocado Benedict. The Bello Benedict was our favorite - very savory and flavorful. The Prawn and Avocado Benedict was an interesting concept but (1) was surprisingly on the blander side and (2) we felt the individual ingredients tasted better on their own than when combined. Both of the Benedict's came with sides of fruit and potatoes. 

General pros: Good service, no wait to get seated for Saturday brunch at 11:30, and relatively big space with indoor and outdoor seating. 

Other feedback: Was hoping to spot a few more sweet brunch options such as their lemon ricotta pancake, but there was only one french toast item on the menu. Also, the Prawn and Avocado Benedict was good but slightly missed the mark in flavor and cohesiveness.

I hate that it has taken me this long to write a review since I was so impressed with this place from the very first bite!

I love everything about this bistro! It totally captures the essence that I love about Santa Barbara from the architecture, a downtown location, close to shopping, great service and the food is spectacular! 

I ordered the french toast with the fig spread and it was amazing! 

I've found my favorite brunch spot in SB here ... At the corner of State & Figueroa. I hope to be back soon for another weekend trip.

The atmosphere is terrific, the outdoor dining was very much like a restaurant in Europe. The food was delicious. We had the fig toast, clam chowder, crab cakes and baked Brie. The service was not good. The waitress disappeared for long stretches, including waiting for the check. But overall the food and atmosphere were so good it trumped the slow service.

My girlfriend and I stopped in here while out in downtown for a late brunch. About 1 PM. 

I got the steak and eggs. And it was horrible.

Firstly, the service was lacklustre. Our server clearly didn't give a crap about his job and insisted on being bro-y with me "Yeah man, I'll getcha that right away" - c'mon. 

The potatoes were stone cold and undercooked. The bread was also cold, and not buttered. Butter was provided but seeing as it was also cold as ice, it was impossible to spread. The fruit was gnarly looking, and had visibly been sitting around all day. The steak itself was half decent. 

I would never go back here, and would certainly not recommend this to anyone thinking of doing so.

1 star -The wait time was ridiculous. We waited over an hour and when I saw that the table was finally free, they still hadn't had it cleared. I had to ask a few times when it would be ready to seat us and the forgot I had my name down on the list.(we were the only ones on it for at least 30 mins)

5 star- The food is delicious! We ordered the short rib Benedict and the fish tacos. We want to come back and try so other things on the menu

Found this place through Yelp so I wanted to pay it forward! I searched "bottomless mimosas" and thats what we got! Unfortunately, they were not very strong but I had an OK buzz going through the course of our brunch. I had The Presidio scramble which was a delicious choice. The server was very attentive and my glass stayed full.

Really great atmosphere and the staff was great as well. 

We had a preset menu

A side salad, salmon and non flour chocolate cake. 

The salad had an amazing balsamic dressing that was very flavorful. 

The salmon was seasoned to perfection and vet tender and the broccoli was perfect. 

Wine list was great with some local wines that went very well with the food.

Oh man this place was delicious. After a mediocre dinner experience the night before, I was being a picky Polly about where to go the next day. But after seeing the delicious menu, the 4 1/2 star rating, and all of the mouth-watering pictures of food, I was sold on this spot.

I came here with my boyfriend and brother on a Saturday around 2. It was fairly crowded outside, but plenty of room inside. I ordered a non-fat latte to start (delicious!), and a Fig burger. The burger was melt in your mouth levels of deliciousness. Fresh, homemade bun, savory meat, fig jam, blue cheese, caramelized onions, and greens. Every bite was amazing. 

My boyfriend got the mac and cheese, which was equally amazing. Perfect amount of cheese to pasta ratio with amazing cheese flavors (Palazzio, take note). My brother got a State burger, didn't get to try that for myself but he said his was amazing too. 

Definitely stop here. My only regret is that I could only order one thing - I wanted everything on the menu!

Bottom line: just do it.
Solid food, great service, fun little off the beaten path location. Low key, good menu selection.

Terrible & rude service.  Walked out & I will never be back. Whoever the auburn female server was that was working inside this afternoon (2:00) needs a reality check.  I don't appreciate being rudely schooled in front of my daughter when I ask to move to an outside table once one opened up.  We hadn't sat inside 5 minutes.  No drinks had been ordered or arrived.  To throw such attitude toward us on a Sunday afternoon was ridiculous.  I stomached it until you schooled me and told me to move and go sit down (you pointed to a chair) while the other server needed to to clean the table outside.  You said it could take a while to "get around to it".  Zero teamwork. Zero customer care.  You were rude, condescending, and just plain unacceptably angry that you lost a table.  If you were my employee, I'd fire you.  We left and had a great lunch just around the corner at Savoy Cafe & Deli.

Wow....based on all the 4 & 5 start reviews, thought we'd give a try. It was the first time eating there and the restaurant  was not too busy buy the time we got there. I ordered a glass of merlot and I could tell just by the smell that it wasn't good and the sip I took just confirmed it. Tasted like it was the chef's old cooking wine. Horrid. I told the server and she was kind enough to open another bottle.  The new bottle was much better - but just not a good wine in general. Asked for a glass of water - which was not filtered and tasted worse than my tap water at home. I didn't order food but my sister had the short ribs which were very nicely presented. As she took a bite the look on her face told me this was not going to be one of her better meals. I took a taste of the short ribs which were nice and tender but most of it tasted like they were cooked with old rancid oil..the veggies as well. She had a few more bites and that was it. Our server was very nice and accommodating as my sister and her husband have certain foods they can't eat. I truly want our local establishments to do well, but quite honestly I don't know that I would take the chance of going back. I know my sister and her husband certainly won't. Hoping the manager will see this and look into these issues.
It was aright. It was pretty expensive and I guess I thought it would have been a better experience.

Food was pretty good. The burger and the garlic/rosemary fries were probably the best. But the service was really slow.

Took a long time to get anything, really, and it was like okay busy... but not busy enough to really warrant the speed of service. Plus they don't really have enough outdoor umbrellas. I know, I could sit inside, but it was so nice out!! I just didn't want the sun right in my face.. 

Would recommend if you'd like a nice tan

We asked for indoor seating and was told all were taken. We never saw more than a few people inside. I think we were put outside to appear busy when they weren't.
We ate outside with no heaters, other restaurants nearby had heaters, in the cool night. The kitchen was very slow and the food was spotty. Beet Salad, meh; broiled asparagus was very good. 
Very pricey for mediocre food.

Service....... horrible!!! I very much disliked this place. They were very inattentive from the get go. They came around for our initial drink order and then to get our food order and then went missing till we had to chase them down for our check. 
So first things first. I hate establishments that give you canned drinks. It just kills me. So of course the place is called State and Fig and I couldn't go here and not try the Fig Burger. So we ordered the Fig Burger with bacon on the side and the chicken panini. After about a 25 minute wait our food finally came. 
Well so we thought. He was halfway to the table and turns around. I can see the waiter being all frantic. So what had happened was that they forgot to put the bacon to the side. Because now he comes out with 3 plates with the bacon on the side. Burnt. And with bleu cheese. Ya they forgot about that. 
The food looked so good. Ummmm no!! First bite into it and all you could taste was burn. The burger was past well done and burned to a crisp. And then the bleu cheese in it just totally overpowered the whole burger. Honestly I always eat all my food. Even if it's bad and I don't like it I'll eat. I couldn't finish all my food unfortunately. It took them so long to bring out the order I wasn't ready to sit there and wait another 20 minutes. The side of greens I got with it were great. 
So my boyfriend had the chicken panini and his panini was bland and the chicken was dry. He got it with a side of Rosemary garlic fries. Those fries were soooooooo garlicky. Way over seasoned and so not made to eat. 
So after our miserable lunch we had to chase the waiter down to bring our check. We paid and left on our dandy way to never return again.

We hosted a "family and friends that are like family" UCSB graduation dinner here. We were a  multi-generational group of 25, with everyone from grandparents to kids under 10. And EVERYONE raved about the experience.
Patrick is the chef / owner, and made us feel important from our first email. The meal was a joy to plan, and he was the perfect mix of professional and caring. He waited until the week of the event to finalize the menu, since he is sourcing the best local seasonal ingredients. He was so accommodating, and addressed my concerns about meal timing and feeding picky kids. He truly understood that this was a special event.
THE FOOD! I had bites of just about everything on the menu, and it was all just delicious. Everyone was happy with their meals, and we were sharing and ordering more. It was a very fun food experience, and everyone was insisting that their dish was tried because it was just that good. 
I could not recommend the State & Fig more for your special occasions, and we are so grateful that we chose them to be part of ours. Thanks Patrick!!

Fantastic!!! Perfection! Loved it! 
We had our rehearsal dinner there last week for an out of town wedding (most guests coming from LA). From the start Patrick (owner / chef) was an absolute delight to work with! He was so accommodating to every request we had. We said we'd love a menu with an upscale Mexican food theme and he customized the most delicious meal ever... shrimp Veracruz, flat iron steak with sauces, empanadas, salad, rice etc.. It was fabulous. He was so detail oriented and took such pride in making a perfect meal exactly to our liking. 

We had a few conference calls (at his request) to make sure everything was exactly as we wanted (how the tables would be set-up, what the signs would say, how the custom menu would be written / printed for our guests, when the seating vs standing cocktail time would be, the exact wines, if we wanted toasts before or after the meal etc..). Patrick leaves no stone unturned! When you are fortunate enough to host an event at State & Fig you will be well taken care of.

Patrick - as well as his staff - were so friendly, professional and all around great the night of our dinner. We felt elated leaving and heading back to our hotel the evening before our wedding.

We bought out the entire restaurant for our event - and had about 40 people. It was a perfect size. It felt so intimate and wonderful the entire evening. There is an upstairs area so it can accommodate a larger number. We had looked at several different places, but most would've just put us in a corner or required a small fortune for a buy-out. State & Fig was affordable and perfect for our group. It was great to have it all to ourselves in a private setting for such a special dinner.
I highly recommend State & Fig / Patrick for any event!!!

I really enjoyed our little Sunday brunch that we had here.  Lot of families around later on in the morning, but it added a nice atmosphere.  The decor inside can make the place seem a bit moody, but the terrace is quaint and the servers were efficient and professional.  Also, this place is located in a cute little alleyway that perfectly showcases the slow, artistic side of Santa Barbara.  

I ordered the French toast with strawberries and port wine reduction.  
Drool.

I grew up in Santa Barbara. I worked at many restaurants in town. Knowing what the service industry is like.... I am always so chill. The service at the place does not have the flow and vibe deserving of Santa Barbara. One of the servers was a rude $&/;(. Her behavior was completely uncalled for and outta hand. The food was great but the service was so horrible and mean spirited that it ruined our excellent meal.
