Pastry perfection! Give me ALL the carbs if they're coming from Bree'osh. 

Drove up the coast from LA to Napa for our mini-moon in October and found this place as we were passing through and I'm glad we did. This bakery is so cute and was operating very safely and efficiently during covid. The croissants and morning buns were to die for and some of the best I've ever had. 

The breakfast sandwich was really nice with the highlight being the brioche bread of course! The star of the show though, was really the morning bun: perfectly flaky and fluffy with plenty of cinnamon sugar. 

I really wish we lived nearby so I could enjoy this place more. Next time we're in the area I will make it a point to stop by and fill up on all of the deliciousness.

We were exploring Montecito yesterday morning during our weeklong vacation in Santa Barbara and I remembered reading some good reviews of Bree'osh's French pastries.  We were looking to pick up a couple for upcoming easy brekkies in the Airbnb!

This morning, hubby and I shared a piece of chocolate rhubarb brioche pudding and an almond bostok brioche.

All I can say is YUM! And 2 big thumbs up :). Fresh, moist, and not too sweet- perfect for a light bfast with coffee/ tea.  Still tasted incredible day after.

Bree'..Oh my gosh, that was delicious! After viewing some great food pics for Bree'osh on Yelp, I bookmarked it and decided to give it whirl this morning. Little did I know, I was in for a wonderful treat and great start to my day. 

Bree'osh is tucked away in a popular strip mall on Montecito's Coast Village Road. It was formerly the home of Crush Cakes. The shop is quaint and inviting with four tables and two umbrellas outside, and two cozy booths with a small high-top bar and stools inside. 

There is a black chalk board on the wall scribed with a vast selection of fresh baked pastries, sandwiches and coffee drinks. 

I was greeted at the counter by a gorgeous, young woman with a lovely French accent who appears to be one of the owners based on a photograph from an article on Bree'osh framed on their wall. 

I explained to her that I was debating between the Bacon & Cheese Brioche and Almond Creme Brioche. She showed me both and described a few other items as well. I ordered the Almond Creme Brioche because it is a house specialty and paired it with a small cup of coffee from Handlebar Roasting Company. 

Based on aesthetics alone, I thought the brioche might be dry, but boy was I wrong. The outside of the brioche is baked to a crispy, golden perfection and topped with crunchy toasted almond slivers. It appears to be finished off with a light egg wash prior to baking so their is a beautiful shine to the bread. Just beneath the crusty exterior, are layers, upon layers of moist, flaky bread - almost like a croissant but slightly more dense. The Almond Creme Brioche is served cut in half with a house made "almond creme" sandwiched in the centered. This creme is like nothing I have ever tasted. I tend to associate the word creme with milky or butter based products. Bree'oshs' almond creme is nothing like that and does not appear to be made with any milk or cream at all. The texture is similar to what I imagine the love child of honey and apple sauce would be if they could have a baby. It's difficult for me to describe, but trust me, it's outstanding! 

I cannot wait to go back and try more varieties of brioche! It has been a few hours since I consumed my tasty treat and I am still full! Despite it's petite appearance, a brioche is actually quite filling and fairly priced around $4 and some change. 

I highly recommend Bree'osh. C'est magnifique!

Lovely small caffe that really catches the vibe of Montecito. Coffee is quite decent. Brunch/breakfast is tasty with a solid variety that is surprising for such a small place. Other than some simple and fun egg breakfasts, they have salads, sandwiches, and tartines. The options however don't overwhelm, they are just the right amount intended to satisfy the expectations of any Californian (Non-Californians can be satisfied too as long as they keep in mind that they are in Montecito).

Super tiny store with outdoor seating. Don't get me wrong the sandwich is pretty good but it's not what I was expected for some reason. Eggs were super soft, buttery and just velvet in your mouth. Super pleasant! 

I would probably go for the pastries next time just to give it a chance!

The people are always friendly and the food is your typical McD. The place is very clean with a large parking lot and even a place for people to play basketball. They have good coffee, but could be hotter at times.

Probably the best McDonalds in Santa Barbara. Generally very clean, the employees are the nicest, doesn't attract the weird crowds. In case any managers are reading this I would like to give props to Joshua, he was VERY polite, cracking jokes with us, apologized for a 5 minute wait time!
The McDonald's in Santa Barbara are some of the most expensive in the country and this one is certainly no exception.

Average at it's best. Employees want your money and then they kick you out. It's adequate food, adequate staff and adequate hygiene makes it an adequate restaurant. I see nothing special but being rushed by employees to order and eat. Sometimes a random homeless man eats inside and smells up the place.

Why have a television in a restaurant when they're picky about people lingering in their restaurant? I'm supposed to finish my food in 30 minutes? That's just weird and unusual for me. The atmosphere was better before and in todays' standards it's just bleh. 

Also the occasional cholo or chola will give you attitude when you order. My pro's are the proximity of this place, the fries are usually fresh and their modernized look but bummed that they have the authority to kick you out. I'm sure that law was placed to kick out the homeless, since I've never been kicked out. I just saw the sign posted.

I would recommend people eating here if they like McDonald's but if they're picky like me. They wouldn't return with high expectations.

Stopped by today for a sausage egg and cheese mcmuffin this evening. Friendly and quick service. It tasted good and the price is average for a breakfast sandwich. But i did get a stomach ache within a few hours..I'm assuming it was the sandwich I had from here.

Its the Mcdonalds for the homeless. The new upgrade its horrible! Its perfectly designed for the homeless to hangout and even to now ask for money inside! Benches like the dmv waiting area! I was a regular which will never come back again.

I had a get a free large drink  coupon off of the McDonald's app with ANY purchase. So I ordered a regular drink full price and was going to use the code to get the free large drink. When I tried to use my code, the employee had NO idea how to use it. After a few tries the manager came over and said I had to buy something else. But I told him free drink with ANY purchase and he said I had to buy something else. Terrible service but at least the cashier girl was really nice about it.

This is absolutely the slowest service on planet earth. I've been standing here for 40 min and I still don't have my food I only ordered 2 mcchickens. This is not even the first time, the last 2 times I've come in it's been a wait of over 30 min with no line. I'm  honestly never coming here again. I am warning everyone who thinks about coming here. Got a might kids meal for my daughter, asked for an extra side of fries instead of apple slices/yogurt, rude bitch with glasses said "it already comes with fries...apple slices or yogurt".. well shit guess I can't get extra fries then.
Don't let the name fool you! I was expecting a fine Scottish meal. They don't even know what haggis is

No drive thru.   I imagine that, this being California, a drive thru would have disturbed some sand flea.  So yah.... If you are in a rush avoid this McDonald's .


The interior is ok and be food tastes like... McDonald's so they did that right.   Just needs a drive thru
Okay who is the fat pile of cow dung that complained and made my large fries into small fries? I am a really skinny guy with a very fast metabolism I need those extra calories jerks

Place is a toilet. Overrun with homeless like the rest of Santa Barbara. On a road trip waiting in line behind homeless people trying to use the restroom. Getting propositioned/panhandled just tryin to per while in restaurant. I usually make a purchase of stop to use restroom, but gotta leave without even using the toilet cause the guy in there taking too long and sick of getting panhandled while in line. 1 star. Not many choices to select from at 10 pm on a Sunday night after a concert at the Bowl.  Sooooooo....it's McD's. I should've kept driving,  but a greasy burger just seemed like it'd hit the spot.  Red flags, baby! No drive through,  but eh no big deal. I place my order,  waited, waited,waited and as I was waiting a frkn cockroach comes a crawl'n onto the counter next to me! holy *&@!# ! Finally, got my order. Mc Ds in the city filled with trees. The Santa Barbara Mc Donald's was great. Super clean, freidnly staff and easy to get to. No drive thru though. But I thought it was a perfect road stop for our family.

This is the franchise location that piloted Herb Peterson's Egg McMuffin in the early 70s, initially without Corporate approval.

There is a nice tile mural made by school kids from the neighborhood Franklin School in one of the dining rooms.

However, I don't eat at Mickey D's or other fast food establishments due to the unhealthy additives in their food.

@ the birthplace of this iconic sandwich. Today, 10/6/2015 I was able to order an Egg McMuffin at 12:30pm and it was freshly made, hot and tasty. 

Plus my picture is still on the wall! Yes, I worked here as a kid, no bashing!

The bathrooms were disgusting especially the men's. They did not put sugar in our coffee like it said on the sticker. Trying to get there attention on where the napkins were took a few minutes to get them to realize like hey turn around customers are talking to you. Then she says there in the bag which there the same color. I said no there not especially when I checked to make sure the food was correct.
For such a nice town I was very disappointed in the service and cleanliness.
Bathroom had cum like substance all over the floor.  Provided a nice lil stop before going into the 154

Youd be hard pressed to find people more incompetent that at this location.  And they want $15 an hour when they can't master the basics?  Who does the training here? They should be fired. Asked for hot chocolate no wet crem! I brought it back for another one!
Person on charge just switched the lid

Stopped by to pick up lunch; great service, efficient, friendly & polite staff and the food was just right. Usually, I'm worried about the fries -please see my review of McD in Silver City, NM- but these were great! ;)

All in all, my visit was smooth, hassle- free and I got fed.

Thanks! :)
It's a really great location the place is clean with a nice and efficient staff the food is good I love the breakfast stuff it's great

Provender: the food is what you would expect.

Prices: typical McD's prices.

Parking: ample, they have a dedicated lot.

People: fun for all, but there is a homeless population that hangs out near/in front.

Perks: no drive thru, so you're going to have to eat in. But it's clean inside, and they have a lot of seating options, i.e., booths, stools, circular tables for two.
The ceo doesn't eat it why would you. The food is bad for you and it disgusting  so please don't eat McDonald's for your safety.

We stopped here to pick up a coffee and a quick bite.  Unfortunately the restaurant was under construction so the inside area was not very attractive.  One part of the restaurant was available for dining in and it was clean and comfortable.  The service was fast and the crew was friendly and happy to explain why things were all torn apart.

Every time I come here I get cold rubbery fries 

Also I don't like that large fries come in a bag the same size as small fries now.
I like mobile ordering the problem is it's never ready when I get there and I end up waiting for my drink order. The scary people hanging outside also don't make it feel very safe.

One of the saddest looking mcdonalds i seen and experienced, the cashier was nice but cleaned his station for a few minutes knowing i was ready to order and did not agknowledge me untik i fidgeted around. I ordered a large fries which came in a paper bag and were soggy, the girl that made them also dropped a few.  the drinks i got came with paper straws . Since i was travelling from Orange County where we use plastic straws,  this seemed odd to me, good for the environment but paper straws get soggy too quick. Overall, needs better customer service, better food quality and a better layout

This McDonald's doesn't have a drive through but it does have curb side pickup/drop off which is nice. The amount of vagrants camping outside blocking the door is a downside which makes staying in your car a better option. Order through the app. The employees for the most part know what they're doing with mobile orders & are friendly. Few times I had mistaken orders paid & the employee unable to figure it out but the manager sent a gift card for free sandwich. Thank you for that. Nothing wrong with this place seems like standard McDonald's. So it's understandable to be missing some items from time to time they should get a raise for the efforts since I doubt handling mentally ill or drug addicts is in their job description
Cold food even at peak hours and old dirty cup that looks like it was out of the trash can with small curly hair inside
I ordered 5 "EGG sausage Mcmuffin and they gave me 3 Sausage "Burned" Mcmuffin people are looking to have a good breakfast and you will give me shitty thing work, come on now!

I went to McDonald's on Milpas right now at 11:30 pm and first the cashier doesn't know they have a two Big Mac meal then he calls the manager and he does it but then I tell them I want it large and they say no only medium I tell them I just went earlier today and got it large and have probably thousands of times anyways I feel the manager was very rude and refused to give me a large meal so I went to another location and got my order like I ordered.

Also sometimes the employees fill the fries only like half way today I went for lunch and told the manager I wanted my fries full and he gave me attitude and didn't really put much fries to compensate for the lack of put in.
This was at the state street McDonalds
Yaniel was an exceptional employee. Helped me right away late at night. Super nice, fast and hard worker. Really appreciate him and made my experience much better.
I don't expect perfection from fast food but these people COMPLETELY fkd up my order and had no mercy/rolled their eyes. Just gross

I went to McDonalds once and I will never again, the food is terrible the service was slow. So, after I went I did research about the company. I do not like McDonalds because of how they treat their animals. They produce food in a fast, easy, and cheap way which is horrible for the animals and the environment. They put meat in their French Fries and advertised them as vegetarian. A researcher at Harvard Medical School dissection McNuggets, he discovered they had the same unhealthy fats as beef. Why was this? McDonalds cooked McNuggets in beef fat. If you advertise something as chicken or french fries, you have to tell people that they have beef in them. McDonald's are mistreating the animals. They can change. In-N-Out and Burgerville are the change in the fast food companies that we need. In-N-Out is family owned, the ground beef is fresh, the potatoes are peeled every day, the milkshakes are made of of real ice cream, and the pay is higher, managers get 3 times as much than other managers at fast food chains. As a result, they tend to stick around longer. This hasn't affected the quality of In-N-Out's food, the most expensive item on the menu is just $2.50. They make the highest amount of profit per restaurant of all fast food chains. Burgerville sells food that comes and goes with the seasons, all of it fresh. Fast food companies should make this change, and the world would become a better place. So I leave this as a hope that is a lesson for McDonalds as to keep up with the growing market, they have to provide TRUE and ALL facts, and they have to be environmentally friendly.

This is the average McDonald's with the same menu.

There is no drive through but they do have curbside pickup.

There are many shady looking people hanging outside of this location which makes a bit scary so I normally only use the curbside pickup. Staff is always nice and try to get the people to leave but there is also only so much they can do.

You know, it is McDonald's. The food is the same everywhere 

But I have to say, the are doing a great job with COVID-19. The are friendly and clear about their procedure. They have someone manning the drink station with your drink ready. They have someone cleaning the table when you finish. Most the places I have been just leave the tables dirty, so what is the point of everything else. 

The still have the practically useless paper straws, but rules like that why we eat in Goleta. 

Under the difficult circumstances, Kudos.

This is a really solid McDonald's location.

Hey, I know it's just McDonald's but for someone like me who absolutely loves Big Macs, McChickens, you name it...consistency is important. This location has hard working employees and the greatness starts at the top. I see active leadership by management to ensure a quality experience and these people treat their customers like family. 

The fries are usually quite fresh, which is amazing because you can taste the difference. No Drive-Thru but honestly there's hardly a wait-time and there is plenty of seating in this location. CNBC has returned to the television so it's always nice to sit by the TV and hear some of the locals chat about the market.

Important **cool** note about this place: There's a basketball court! The sign says you can ask for the ball at the counter but I wonder if that's true...

Mind you I order so my food is hot. But this experience was different. It felt like they really cared. And the food was hot on point and im really really happy. I know I know it's McDonalds and when your hungry u want hot food.. here everything was hot and perfect. Ty ladies I'm very happy and hope you have a great night.

Well it's a McDonald's what can you really say but the kids love it for breakfast and it was close to 6am so it was open. It's the least we can do after waking them up at 3am for a road trip. Cause according to the youngest one it was one delicious breakfast, not to my talking stomach it wasn't lol. Nah just kidding that only happens with Big Mac's now that I'm getting old lol. 

My sister got a sugared water, oops I mean a iced vanilla coffee yeah it was pretty bad a good thing we had our own espresso in the cooler to fix that. But at least the girls were happy and the food did come out quick. Crew at counter were nice and friendly.

Terrible customer service - highly recommend going next door to ampm when possible.

Avoid employee Jasmine @ 7/11 - scams

Been working in town. Always come here super nice employees.
Fast hard working workers.
Very busy store.
But today there was one employee and that employee worked the hardest.
I have ever seen anyone work .
The owner should staff the store better.

I have been coming to this 7-Eleven for the past 9 months since I've moved close to this particular store. I have been nothing but satisfied and welcomed by every employee. Tonight I was really displeased with the customer service of the late night employee, who informed me that his name was Ricardo. I tried to use the new rewards program app when Ricardo decided to tell me that I can only use it on one transaction, which clearing isn't the case considering I have had every other employee at this store, kindly scan my barcode in for me to earn rewards (kind of what the whole rewards system was put in place for). He told me to take it up with his manager, rudely describing himself in a very sarcastic and demeaning tone. It's the little things like that that have changed my whole outlook on going into this store that I go in every day. Now if I want to go in late night, I have to deal with a guy who clearly isn't too thrilled about his job or customers. 
I will be in to speak with the manager tomorrow morning and informing him/her of the incident and how I will not be returning or purchasing while that employee is there.
Sincerely disappointed and irritated
Very clean, great assortment and awesome staff! They always have a good assortment of fresh food items, and new items to snack on. Great store
Very nice clean new 7-Eleven. Has a good selection of items. Friendly helpful staff and there is a Subway in the same complex. Good addition to the neighborhood. Prefer it over the ampm.

Don't go here! 

I guess if a 7 eleven is getting a yelp review it's for only two reasons. They are terrible. 

Thought I could make a quick stop for something simple since this place was close. 

I will never be back. Employee was extremely rude and unhelpful. I was actually shocked at just how cold and ridiculous this experience was. I also could not imagine how she treats other customers based on this experience.
It is an okay seven eleven. It is new and clean so nice to stop in. The parking lot is small and not a very convenient corner but if you need the ATM or mini-mart items it serves the purpose.

If I can give a 0 star I would. The worst 7-11 ever. If you are East Asian, you know the standard. The place is supposed to open 24/7, when in fact the staff locked the door at 9pm. The woman staff is super rude. Don't come here.

The new young lady working there is terrible , doesn't know the functions of the register, constantly fumbling, always on the phone when I come in , I got in a little argument with her my last visit . Today she was having an argument with a young man over her confusion with the lotto machine , she told him (as he left arguing) it was his bad attititude towards her that escalates the situation, I bought my 1 water (since she can't ring up the sale price , I usually buy three) and quickly left .

First time in this store at state and mission, Clean and well organized, in and out in a flash.
Sunday early morning and staff was attentive.
Plenty off street parking at the time.

Wow!  A beautiful, new, bright & clean 7-Eleven on State St. at Mission St.

I stopped in to get some drinks.  I don't think I've ever been into such a new and clean 7-Eleven.  The hot food section looked so good and clean.  I'll probably stop in soon to try some.  

They have their own parking lot.

Employees were nice and friendly.

Mulligans is an awesome place. They have daily specials everyday. Wednesday Is my favorite burger with fixings, a side and beer for $11. It's amazing after a good twilight game of golf, and you get to check out the sunset as well.
One of the hidden gems of Santa Barbara.

I have eaten here on Sundays several times because friends of ours are regulars. While the setting is rather nice if you don't mind cigarette smoke (even when sitting in a non smoking area), the food is mediocre at best. Everything I've had is either over or under cooked, bland and definitely not worth the price charged. Servers are nice when you can get their attention.

I've only been here for Sunday breakfast/brunch, so can't comment on other times and menu items, but I would definitely not recommend this place based on my experiences.

I've been coming here for breakfast for 5+ years.  I always get the pecan waffle whether it's on the menu or not they make it for me.  The bacon, the butter and the syrup are all high quality.  Highly recommended.

Mulligan's catered our wedding on July 11th. We had the traditional SB menu of tri tip, chicken, beans, caesar salad and garlic bread. It was super delicious and we had lots of compliments on the catering. They brought tons of food and everything was presented well. The service people they had at the reception were also on top of clearing plates and filling glasses. 

Only thing I would recommend to change is to offer a tasting for the catering, so that you can choose your food options that way. We had to come to the restaurant as a customer and purchase the closest thing they offered on the menu to taste the food we chose.

I normally really like to eat here (hence the 4-star rating), however this past visit was not very pleasant. I ended up having to get our food out of the window after having it sit there for well over 5 minutes, if not 10. The waitress was not very attentive and would forget things that we had asked for. 

Like I mentioned, normally the service is good and the food tastes just as good if not better. This place has been a family favorite for many years.

I totally agree with Lydia, Mulligans overcharges and has the worst service anywhere in Santa Barbara. The servers (most of them are related) have the attitude that they are doing you a favor and they will get to you when they have time. i have waited at the counter to buy something while they talked about baby showers while I was waiting! They finally broke that up long enough to ask what I wanted and then proceeded to let me know that they were being nice when they gave me a cup of ice with my purchase. Now they have signs on the patio when you enter  that tell you not to sit at a table that has not been cleaned. So, why are there so many tables that have not been cleaned? Too busy talking amonst themselves to take care about their customers? Maybe its time for Santa Barbara City to find another restaurant for that spot.

Apparently I'm alone on this, but I love this place. I don't golf, however I do enjoy having a cocktail and wasting away a perfectly good afternoon at the neighborhood course. I have a half day on Mondays and this is my favorite destination after work for a late lunch/happy hour kick-off. Super relaxing, decent food, lovely view from the patio. It's like being on my front porch only better because people bring me food and drinks. There's even a cat that roams the patio.

They serve generous portions that are reasonably priced. The chicken taco salad is my favorite - real shredded chicken that has been cooked in a seasoned sauce. My boyfriend gets the club sandwich and it's served on yummy bread. Good onion rings, too. 

Good food, good service, relaxed environment - who wouldn't love this place.

It's a neighborhood place, full of regulars, and the food is consistent.  I particularly like breakfast and lunch; have not been there for dinner.   Not fancy, not gourmet, and the plates don't look like photos from a magazine, but the food is tasty, portions are generous, and they're cooperative about accommodating food allergies.

Very good restaurant if you want some homie, hearty American food. It is located in a somewhat isolated location, right next to the golf course. Luckily for us, you do not need to be a golf club member to eat here. We came here for dinner and sat outside, which gave us a lovely view of the golf course and some mountains in the distance. It was also more quiet outside. Once we went back inside to the Bar to exit, it was pretty loud. 

We ordered the daily specials: meatloaf and pork chops with a side of mash potatoes. These dishes also came with a salad or soup, and a side of vegetables (broccoli & carrots). Both entrees were tasty and filling. The prices were decent, around $13-$15 for the entrees we ordered. Service was also good.

That place is crap! I just djed a even there and the waitress and bartender were rude especially the bartender with the cheap red colored hair! As I was playing she rudely told me to turn it down and when one song played louder then the other she said loudly in front of everyone "don't fucking try me" I will never refer that place for a venue

Stopped in for breakfast and glad we did! The chili verde was the best I've had in town yet. Hubby had the chili verde omelet and I had the chili verde huevos rancheros. Both were huge portions with potatoes (hash browns or diced red potatoes) and beans (either refried or black beans). Nice table overlooking the green. Will definitely be back!!

Great tacos on Monday. Friendly service.
Sevy was good, I want to marry him. I hope he's gay.

Terrible service, and the buffet was cheap breakfast stuff to go with the prime rib for $22.99 each for Easter brunch for two. The ham was dried out. They included a $8.55 gratuity, a surprise we discovered on the bill. I will not visit this place ever again.
great breakfast, great value with a view of the golf course and I don't even golf.  It's a guys place with classic dishes and stiff drinks.

Mulligans chef, Mario, prepares the best Prime Rib in town!  Friday and Saturdays only.  Better than TeeOff, Chucks' and others who have a 'reputation' for prime rib. Salads are good, seasonal steamed veggies, baked potato, what more could you ask?
Good wines at competitive prices and I'm a happy camper.
The 'ambiance' is golf course but the VIEWS are better than nearly everyplace in SB! If you like the natural beauty and gentle ocean breeze that is prevalent, Mulligans is your place.

Stayed in Santa Barbara for Thanksgiving week and decided to come to Mulligan's for their Thanksgiving Buffet.  Turkey, ham, prime rib, mashed potatoes and gravy, pie, etc.  Really good.  The best part for us though was how nice everyone was.  Apparently they are family owned and from the second we walked in the door they were all making sure we were greeted and taken care of. Our waitress, (maybe a daughter?) was fantastic and super friendly.  They were really welcoming and made Thanksgiving dinner feel as homey as it could be considering we were at a restaurant.  My entire family was very happy with the buffet and would definitely come back again for Thanksgiving.  I think it was around $30 per person, which we felt was well worth it!

What horrible service today (Valerie). I sat at the bar, Valerie walked by me four times then I had to ask to order on her fifth time by. Then walked by me three more times after I had my CC out to pay, another waitress had to ring me up.

Good diner fare and service. My husband and I go here often. It's a folksy and friendly place. Although there is a small bar as you enter the restaurant, it is family friendly. Never seen any odd, inebriated behavior. Reasonably priced menu. Zucchini fries and Mexican plates are delicious. Sandwiches and burgers are good. And the salads are quite satisfying. Pies are a must order for dessert. Breakfast always nice! Check out dinner specials. Pass on fish selections--NO NO! Ambience and crowds are of the geriatric-kind but we don't discriminate.

Thanks to the helpful staff for the venue choice for my mother in laws memorial. Catering service was great and helpful. The food was warm and great tasting. Didn't know the venue existed and looking forward to trying out Breakfast and lunch menu in near future!
This is a little Santa Barbara secret, not only the food fantastic and the views of the golf course spectacular. The service staff are great a specially (Melinda)   This is a must try place.

We wanted a good meal with a baked potato and not wanting to deal with the parking hassle and one way streets around State st. So glad we found this place tho it was busy. We loved the liver and onions. Our waitress was very good too. Learned their owners will soon be opening the high sierra restaurant in the old Elephant bar in town so looking 4ward to trying it. The senior menu is a very nice touch too.
Mulligans has amazing food. Great prices and Great service and serves breakfast all day.
I love Mulligan's, the food is great as well as the atmosphere. Sevy is probably one of the best servers in SB, my boyfriend and I truly appreciates his service!

Since I don't golf, I had no idea this place existed until a friend introduced me to it recently.  The cafe is on the smaller side with tables in various niches, some outside bordering the golf course, some inside, some in a reserved banquet area.

The great thing is that they serve breakfast all day!  I had a California benedict with hash browns that was made just right and delicious.  Once you place your order, it comes out quickly.  But it takes a little longer before and after to place your order and get the check.  The atmosphere is more laid back, where no one is in a rush.

This place probably doesn't have as many reviews because the customers, at least when I was there for a weekday lunch, are an older demographic and less likely to use yelp.

Our women's group meets here once a month. You can't beat the view, and the food is reasonably priced and delicious. We really appreciate the staff because they're willing to give individual checks to each of us. We don't have to scramble to figure out who owes what at the end of the meal. Ample parking, a wide selection of good food, and beautiful scenery. What more could anyone want?
My family and I eat here often. Great view, good food, and nice waitstaff. Melinda is our favorite.

Mulligans is one of our favorites.   The food is terrific and the prices are so reasonable.   The view of the golf course is beautiful.   Melinda is our favorite waitress.  She always welcomes our family and provides the best friendly service.   She is wonderful with children.   Melinda makes us want to keep coming back!
Excellent service, fish and chips are exceptional . Love the blankets on the back of the chairs .

One of my favorite places for breakfast. Great menu selection. The machaca and eggs and their chili verde omelette are great. It's family owned and operated and that's one of the best things about it because they make you feel like part of the family every visit there.

We bring our family every Monday for taco night. We love the tacos and we love
Melinda, the waitress who always serves us. She has become like family!
Mulligans is an awesome place to grab a delicious sandwich or wrap. Always get the best service from Sevy- he is so attentive, never forgets anything and is hilarious!
Love this place. We visit Santa Barbara twice a year and always eat at Mulligans. Great food. Quick service and reasonable prices. I recommend the fish tacos.

5 stars for its category - one of Santa Barbara's best combinations of a comfortable setting overlooking the surrounding golf course, and a basic but tasty variety of menu options that are quite reasonably priced.

While Mulligan's is one of my favorite outdoor lunch spots, looking out over the city-owned golf course to the ocean, dinner time is another matter and one I'll pass on in the future. The staff who "bus" the tables disregard the loud clatter they make right next to diners and the wait staff cleans off tables with a foul-smelling spray product which then permeates the dining room.  I'll stick to lunch time, outdoors.

This cafe on the golf course doesn't seem like its such a great place.  Plastic chairs, plastic tables, and always empty... but my family and I eat here almost every weekend.  

They have a wide variety of food ranging from salads, to sandwiches, burgers, and breakfast.  Your typical all-american joint, but I highly highly recommend the chipotle chicken wrap.  Its delicious.  

My brother ordered the honey mustard chicken sandwich and it was HUGE.  It was so big that they used a knife as a toothpick, A KNIFE.  

Its a pretty good place if you want to enjoy scenery, peace and quiet, and decent food.

A new favorite!

We've recently decided this is one of our new dinner hangouts. The food is good and plentiful, the prices are good, and the service is excellent. 

The view can't be beat, unless you're dining at Goleta pier or overpaying for something at the Wharf. They have plenty of heaters and blankets to keep you warm if it's chilly or breezy out.

I especially love the "Jonathon's Special Burger," with jack cheese, mushrooms, avocado, and so many sprouts you just about need vice grips to squeeze the sandwich down to a biteable size. Good stuff.

Sunday brunch is packed, but overall it disappointed us. The buffet was half empty and cold, though the guy fixing fresh eggs and omelets was friendly and helpful. We've decided to leave Sundays to everyone else, we'll take the other six days instead.

Mulligans is a great family owned local business that I love supporting. Very reasonable prices and great menu specials throughout the week.They have a full bar and weekend brunch buffet with an omlette bar and various Mexican inspired dishes along with all the breakfast classics. Love sitting on their patio with a view of the golf course.

This is a family run restaurant with a warm, friendly atmosphere that sits on a golf course. What is not to love about Mulligan's bar an grill. Decided to tag along with friends to check out Mulligans and their 25th Anniversary celebration. So much fun. This is a family run restaurant and they have been at it for 25 years now. Even though I was not a regular they welcomed me with open arms. What a wonderful friendly restaurant. The food for the night was fiesta cuisine and everything was delicious. There was music, dancing, photo booth, prizes and fun. I will be back.

This is a family run restaurant with a warm, friendly atmosphere that sits on a golf course. What is not to love about Mulligan's bar and grill. Decided to tag along with friends to check out Mulligans and their 25th Anniversary celebration. So much fun. This is a family run restaurant and they have been at it for 25 years now. Even though I was not a regular they welcomed me with open arms. What a wonderful friendly restaurant. The food for the night was fiesta cuisine and everything was delicious. There was music, dancing, photo booth, prizes and fun. I will be back.

My wife Cathy and I had dinner today and we both had a great time
With great food and view of the golf course. We plan to go back again
And again

As the early dinner here. Free parking in lot. Cafe is located in golf park. No ice surroundings to eat with outdoor seating. Good: Enchiladas with rice and beans, chili relleno with rice and beans, fish and chips, liver and onions. Nice to have a little something before or after a round of golf. Very good service.

Mulligans is a Santa Barbara gem. Situated with beautiful indoor and outdoor views of the municipal golf course, they serve fabulous burgers, ribs, great salads etc. We had excellent, friendly service from Lani and our food was cooked to perfection by her husband Mario. Highly recommended. Can't wait to go back and try the all-you-can-eat beef ribs on a Thursday night!

Danielle and the staff at Mulligan's are so awesome.  We recently had a party in the banquet room for 70 guests.  Danielle and the staff were a joy to work with.  The venue was beautiful, the food was amazing and the service was excellent. We received may complements from our guests on how much they enjoyed the food and the service.  If you ever need a place to host an event i highly recommend contacting Danielle at Mulligan's Bar & Cafe.

We both ordered tri tip sandwiches for pick up, and the sandwiches were fabulous.  When my partner got there to pick up the order, he saw the pozole soup and it looked so good he ordered that as well.  And it was really good.  We will definitely return to Mulligans.  There were so many items on their menu that looked good.  Looking forward to trying some of them.

Terrible food+poor service=Mulligan's

The only good thing about the place is the lovely outdoor patio overlooking the golf course.

If you've made the unfortunate choice to go there, stay far away from the emaciated, cold chicken wings, the slop nachos, and the tepid, bland prime rib dinner. 

Three of us ordered these plus mediocre beer on tap and sangria.

The older blonde waitress provided indifferent service and took thirty minutes to bring our drinks in a half empty restaurant.

Since I had not eaten at Mulligan's for over a year, thought I might update my review. Ate there tonight with a party of seven. Food was good; everyone happy, from the Mexican combo plates with enchiladas, tacos to battered shrimp and salmon, fish and chips, it was all good, well served and reasonably priced. 
A portion of the restaurant is still closed off, perhaps for lack of staff, so you might want to make a reservation if you have a seating preference (terrace or inside).  Parking is ample, atmosphere relaxed and family-friendly. Notably, most entrees are available with Senior options at a savings...but, honestly, I still took home half the only-slightly smaller meal.

We had the best Mexican food there last night! Honestly such an underrated restaurant! Great service, great food, great views looking into the golf course, huge patio, heaters, and the busser was on top of his game keeping the restaurant tidy and  ready for the incoming patrons!

Ate at Mulligan's tonight, party of 10. Everyone was happy with their meals. From the Mexican Plate (with chili relleno), to fish and chips, Machacha, Ribs, pork chops, salmon special, and salads. All good at very reasonable prices. A nice warm evening, we ate on the patio overlooking the golf course. Very nice. 
Parking is easy, kids are welcome, service was good (a little extra tip for the complexities of ten orders on 8 tabs was in order), Sorry I didn't record the server's name. One more point; this is a long-time family-run business deserving of local support.

Mulligans is one of the best kept secrets in Santa Barbara. Most do not know about this place, unless they are a local, or a golfer. Anyone can eat there, and the food is great. I mostly go to Mulligan's for breakfast, as you can't go wrong with just about anything from the breakfast menu. The service is actually pretty good for a small golf course cafe. Tip: sit out on the patio and enjoy nice views of the greenbelt, and sometimes even the Pacific Ocean!

2/21/2020  12:15 pm
I went to lunch with my wife and we were pretty hungry!  We were greeted by a server who sat us down where we were able to see the golf putting greens and the people outside so it was a nice surrounding.  
Our server Melinda was very busy yet attentive and very pleasant.  My wife ordered a Chicken Salad and I had a medium breakfast of toast, two eggs, hash browns and two slices of crisp bacon.  We had water with our meals as we both need to drink more water.  Overall it was an excellent meal that certainly deserves my time to let others know just how good Mulligan's Cafe is and how well they treat you.   
Best Regards,
Steve P. & Claudia W.

We eat here all the time and the food, service, etc is great. Had dinner last Friday and ordered the prime rib, asked for medium and it was almost raw. Very disappointed, usually a great dinner but not last night!

This place is definitely for the over 60 -- and frankly more for the over 70 crowd. Went the other night, and there wasn't one person there that didn't remember the Eisenhower administration. Catering to their customers, the food was overcooked, bland, and simple. Some Mexican cuisine, greasy-spoon diner quality American eats, and a small bar.

They did have a large senior menu, however, so if you need to take Nana out for brunch, this would work. I, however, won't be coming back.
--------

I spent the last day or so thinking about this place, and as they were nice, I wanted to give them two stars, but the food was so bad, I couldn't go more than one. It was the sort of experience that had us going, "Geez, who picked THAT place?" for the whole of the following day. 

Best avoided.

Have visited Mulligans every year for 16 years during a golf tournament. 3 days we choose to eat at Mulligan's..  After this trip, we may not go back.  The slow service and attitudes of the staff were unacceptable. We missed not seeing the owners and it appears the kids who are left to run it just don't have the same level of attention.  At one point when we had to get up to ask for service to which we were greeted with "she's at the table that moved it" as if we were not standing right there. It was incredibly rude. We were with residents of SB, I can't imagine shaming patrons will benefit what once was a great restaurant with a friendly atmosphere.

I attended a catered function at Mulligans and it was lousy. The three available entrees were served at my table and no one was happy. I  had the chicken cordon bleu and my wife had the tri tip. We had a few bites and that was it. The service was good and so was the vibe but these dishes were bad. It appeared that our catered dining experience was separate from the "general population". So maybe the quantity affected the quality.
Not bothering to write a detailed review. Nothing special with the food here. Just annoyed with the rude waitress who, as we were paying, threw me a pen instead of handing it to me.

We've been coming here for years Happy Hour and Taco Monday. It's one of our favorite happy hour spots with a great patio and an amazing view. 

And of course the food is amazing. Taco Monday is where it's at FAT tacos for $2!! You can get soft or crispy shells. The crispy shells are fried there, none of these store bought stale shells. They're delicious!! And I believe you can order the tacos with chicken, ground beef, shredded beef and pork. All are delicious options. 

Also try their margaritas. They're awesome!! 

Recently we tried their Sunday Buffet while we had family in town. Mulligans did not disappoint!! We got there at 9:30 which seemed to be the perfect time to get there before a HUGE crowd of people showed up. For $16 with $10 bottomless mimosas and bloody Mary's, I can see why it was so popular!

Mulligans' brunch had all your typical buffet faire: waffles, pancakes, bacon, eggs, sausage, etc. BUT they also had menudo, posole, enchiladas, chorizo with eggs, Chile verde and even Chile Colorado!!! I was blown away!! 

And two thumbs up for Matt holding down the omelette station. Those were exquisite omelette!

Tried to support local business by ordering take out for Memorial Day weekend, only to be disappointed by the raw bread, not garlic as posted in their email  and leg piece not breast of chicken. We also ordered a piece of banana cream pie-which was tiny for the steep $5.99 price tag. They had plenty of time to prepare my order and yet still missed.

OK, Let's be completely honest!  If you visiting Santa Barbara looking for the perfect romantic dinner and you go to Yelp, you don't want some Yutz giving them five stars and tricking you into thinking that it is Santa Barbara's top tier.   Farm to table it is not!  Romantic?  Hardly!   But I like it!   More on that later.

I went golfing!   Way too funny.   Don't know how I got tricked into it but if you remember that show where Paris Hilton had to stick her arm up the butt of some cow, it was kind of like that.    I did see my next career though, Beverage cart girl, I can see myself doing that.   

Maybe Mulligan's was so good because I was coming off an experience that was so bad.    But I ordered a club sammy and a beer.    Well I ordered more than one beer-did you know that people bet when they golf?  If you suck it can be expensive.  I digress.  The sandwich was very good and the bacon was crispy.   They have a huge menu too so there is a lot of variety.  The people were super nice and the food came very quickly.  

I would go back.   To Mulligan's, not to golf.  It looks like it would be a great place to have a big party too!   Not expensive and they have a huge room that I bet is always available after the golfers leave.

Now, I wonder if I will get a discount when I am the drink-cart girl?

I came to Mulligans to have dinner and since it was such a nice day out. Well the lady at the front that worked there on 7/17/2020 was completely disrespectful to me and my partner and made me feel like I did not matter. I understand that a lot of rich folks show up here to play their rounds of golf  but that kind of treatment is unacceptable. I almost felt racially discriminated against. My partner and I walked off the premises without saying a word. We are disgusted. Never coming back here again  0 stars.

I am sorry to leave this review!
I had the crispy chicken tacos. I did not appreciate the dead lettuce! The food was extremely bland. I had to add jalapeños for flavor! 
My friend on the other hand, ordered the omelette. She said it was a 3/5.
Food arrived cold. Maybe that was a Dasher issue. The containers in which the food arrived, was flimsy, and falling apart.

We have enjoyed meals here often, this morning Mulligan's failed us, We were happy to see they were busy this morning, however, when we requested a table away from the walkways and crowded walk through to tables, we requested the table just outside of an open area, they refused to seat us there as the area was "closed".
Being longtime neighborhood customers with compromised immune systems we were disappointed that they would not accommodate us. It will be quite awhile before we return to eat at Mulligan's.

Mulligan's for breakfast/brunch is a nice venue with friendly and efficient staff, but they have one policy that I find off-putting:  They will not make a substitution without charging $1.50.  Not a lot of money, but charging extra for leaving the cheese OFF and adding spinach to my omelette is not customer-friendly.  I didn't ask for an addition - I asked for spinach instead of peppers, and held the cheese.  It would seem that this is a win-win.  Whatever their reason, they're shooting themselves in the foot when other, busier establishments are willing to accommodate.  We eat breakfast out often, and enjoy Farmer Boy, Cody's, Breakwater, and Chad's regularly.  ALL of them are happy to substitute without nickel-and-diming customers.

Love Mulligan's, we have used this restaurant for years. The food is always great and the price is very reasonable. The only issue that we have is that a group of 6 or more is on one check. In the future we will not eat with a group of 6 or more, it created a major issue last night on figuring out our bill between credit cards and cash. Sad that we will not meet our friends there for dinner in the future.

Went there with a group of 15 for Sunday brunch. We made a reservation but from the get-go the old waitress did not care about giving us decent service since she was going to get her mandatory 20% tip anyway. When asked where our table was, she nonchalantly pointed to a vague area and when asked to clarify, she just walked away. Instead of catering to us, she basically told us what to do. Someone wanted to order off the menu instead of eating their shitty brunch buffet and she gave the customer attitude like "You guys said you were all gonna eat buffet. I don't know if I can take that many separate orders. Maybe only if a couple people ordered off the menu." Umm...excuse me? We're the customers and you're telling us what we can or can't eat? If you can't handle that many orders then maybe you shouldn't be working at a restaurant. 

Food was less than spectacular. It was mostly Mexican food...which I wasn't expecting when I heard Sunday brunch..but whatever. The enchiladas were old and crusty....looked like its been sitting there since last Sunday brunch. Scrambled eggs were all broken into small pieces and the rice was dry. By the time I made it to my car in the parking lot, my stomach was already cramping from the bad food.

So...all that was fine and dandy until the check came. We made it easy on her by just splitting it equally on all the cards. We waited over 20 mins to hear back from her out in the cold because both of their outside furnaces by our table were broken (yea...get that shit fixed). She then brought all the cards back with the receipt for each transaction ready to sign. Some were charged more than others (even though we said split it EVENLY)...but the worst part was she overcharged each card by over a dollar (even though the tip was already included in the total). THEN she proceeded to tell us that 2 of the cards were declined and that she's gonna have to swipe ALL of our cards AGAIN. Wait...what? Why the hell did you bring back all the cards for us to sign then? She gave us some bullshit reason that because 2 cards were declined, she needed to cancel all the charges that already went through and redo it again because the charge needs to go through all at the same time. I proposed for her to just take off the orders for the 2 cards that got declined and swipe their cards on a different tab. She looked at me sternly...like pissed that I've outsmarted her and walked away. She came back 10 seconds later and was like "no, I'm really not allowed to do that. You guys are gonna have to come to the register and sort it out there because I don't have time to deal with you guys...I have other people to serve." At this point, I'm ready to say "eff you and eff this place" so I signed my receipt anyways and started to leave. Some people in our group called us back to sort it out....so I'm like fine, I'm talking to the manager then. Some nice guy in our group finally just decided to have the entire bill put on his card (one of the cards that was declined the first time but somehow miraculously went through the second time). I asked to see the manager and the owner happened to be standing right there. I complained about her awful service and the inefficiency of his cash register system. The waitress was like, "I explained to you very clearly how this had to be processed. You guys shoulda told me you wanted the check split from the beginning. All the other big groups that ever come in here do that for me." I'm sorry, I didn't know when I go eat at a restaurant I'm supposed to do the job of the waitress. The owner half defended her and claimed that he has 3 restaurants all running different systems and they were all like this. WTF? I've never heard of such a retarded system! And I've worked at restaurants with less technologically advanced credit card systems. He continued to talk my ear off when all I really wanted to do was say "hey you suck" and leave. But instead I was courteous and listened to his mouth diarrhea run for about 5 minutes as he tried to defend his restaurant and bad service. So screw you Mulligans and screw the old bat that's still serving in her 60's...you deserve each other. If I could rate this place negative stars I would. 

NEVER GO  TO MULLIGANS (especially in big groups). 

This is my first restaurant review ever...they ticked me off enough that it was necessary to warn people of this place!

EDIT: I just checked my bank account activity and it shows that they charged me $27.66 and charged me again for $20.75. I knew about the $20.75 because that was the receipt she gave me to sign but she never told me about a second charge for $27.66. That is sooooooo sketchy!

It's been rough all Winter to find restaurants that are doing the outside thing well, and Mulligan's is doing it as good as anyone. Seems very 2021 that I'm starting a restaurant review by talking about propane heaters, but such is Covid life. 

I've actually been here a few times in the last few years, and it's always been solid. Food is pretty good, servers are always friendly, menu has a variety of American classics and Mexican. I had the ribs the other night and they were well cooked - sauce was lacking some sweetness. They have a full bar and reasonable prices. And have I mentioned their heated patio?

Best breakfast here! The food is  high quality, and the portions are big. Mulligan's is one of my favorite breakfast/brunch places. I haven't had a negative experience any of the times I've gone. Would highly recommend!

When trying to find a seat at Mulligans we were searching for open tables as it's self seat when you notify a server. We notified a server and were looking for a nice table to sit at. We found one with place settings in which a server told us it was reserved and that we had to find another one in which my family politely said that we'd look around and began searching. The server then returned which she asserted if "we had a problem because we are being rude and had an attitude". We said we were okay. However the banter continued and we decided to leave after a terrible confrontation and asked for her manager. In which she claimed she was the manager which shocked us even more. Employees need to treat customers with respect even if they are managers. My family has never heard this in a restaurant setting before.
I love coming to Mulligans for breakfast and watching the golfers. Melinda is my usual waitress and she takes great care of me. Always has my coffee waiting for me!

I come here often and I have to say Melinda is my absolute favorite waitress. She practically has my order memorized! The food is wonderful. My favorite is the prime rib. Definitely would recommend you come here.
food gave me food poisoning and they don't listen to any requests who serves french toast without syrup

COVID REVIEW!

I have been golfing at the golf course and having a couple beers after the round for many years and it had always been fine.

Now they clearly do not give a damn about public health. They have the mask required to enter signs at the doors but NONE of the employees wear masks. I mentioned that it is the law and they said I didn't have to wear a mask if I didn't feel like it? Sorry but that is bull pucky. It is a small town and I am aware that the owners are Trumpers and they must not really give a damn if we ever get past this pandemic. If you do not want to go to a restaurant the is not following the public laws stay away from this place. On the other hand if you are a "Let's go Brandon" kinda person, you will feel right at home.

I will contact Public Health Dept. but I suspect there are a lot of places like this these days. I hope they are able to do something about it but not holding my breath (just wearing a good mask).

I think I just died and went to heaven. Breakfast at Mulligan's is the best. I have normally just grabbed a hotdog and a beer when golfing or passing by, but I finally had an opportunity enjoy a working breakfast this week and was blown away. 

The food was excellent. Simple and classic. But what really knocked my socks off was our waitress, Melinda. Melinda treated us like we have been dining at Mulligan's for years as opposed to being first-timers. She made a recommendation to my guest and made us both feel like big shots. 

If you ever are in the area for lunch or breakfast, I highly recommend Mulligan's. I can't wait to try Mulligan's for dinner... Melinda says she works Monday nights!

This is a local hidden treasure. You will not find tourists here. It is a casual golf course dining cafe. You can sit inside or on the patio overlooking the golf course. I am not even a frequent golfer, and I still enjoy this place. They have great omletes and breakfast is their strong point. Don't go here if you are in a hurry, the service is on the slow side. But golf course/valley views will keep you distracted in a good way.

We love Cat Therapy! We just celebrates my daughter's 8th Birthday there. She called it "the best birthday ever!" We had cake and played with all of the adorable cats and everyone had an amazing time. I would highly recommend Cat Therapy for a fun Birthday Party!

We really liked it here. The place isn't huge but it allows you to interact with the 25+ cats.  Super sweet and caring staff.  There was no kitty smells and comfortable for all.  They had people filing in and everyone was happy.

We look forward to going back.

As a girl who's had kitties around her entire life, but who's current landlord does not permit pets, this place is basically heaven. The cat room is a very clean, plush and comfortable space for both kitties and humans. Relaxing jazz music plays in the background, an aromatherapy mister gives off a light and pleasant scent and I sit on a fluffy pillow sipping a latte and petting a purring fuzzball. Bliss. Why go to a coffee shop when you could come here? All the kitties are available for adoption and I wish I could take one home, but since I can't I'll make a habit of coming here to support this unique business!

My wife and I had a great time interacting with the cats here.  Most were very mellow and just relaxed around us.  One was adopted while we were there.  Worth the visit if you want to lower your own blood pressure.
I was skeptical at first but had an absolutely wonderful time. And the best part is that all of the cats were available for adoption I totally recommend this for anyone who wants a smile.

Who would not love spending an hour in cat heaven, which is what the Cat Therapy Cafe is?  They have the most wonderful cats there and all are up for adoption so they are doing a marvelous service as well.  They must have chosen extra friendly, loving kitties as all were happy to have pets and attention.  My friend and I also enjoyed a latte and a juice drink while we lounged with the cats.  I might add as well that this is a lovely space for the kitties with big windows everywhere and lots of places to climb and hide in.  My friend and I left there elated for the rest of the day--hence, real cat therapy is happening and the cafe is aptly named.

While vacationing in Santa Barbara, my boyfriend and I came across Cat Therapy while wandering around the town. Intrigued, we went inside to find out more and see what exactly a cat cafe was. The girl who was working there was so welcoming, answering all of our questions happily and excitedly. You could tell she really loved her job. She told us how Cat Therapy was an adoption center for cats who had been rescued from kill shelters. They offered an hour play time with the cats and kittens, as well as organized events such as Happy Meow'r and Cat Yoga. We opted to sign up for Sunday Cat Yoga. The yoga class wasn't challenging, and would be considered more of a basic yoga class, but it was one of the most relaxing and fun yoga classes I've ever taken. The cats are free to roam around, so as we were doing our downward dogs and chatarungas (or should I say CAT-arungas), the kitties would run underneath you, rub against your arms and legs, and sniff at your curiously. A few of the kittens even fell asleep on top of the class goers during savasana, myself included. It was a truly happy and stressful hour and I would definitely recommend to any cat lover. One of the more unique things I've done in a long time!

Stuck in the area due to the mud slides.  This place is great.  The gal working is a sweetheart and the cats are great.  They have about 12 cats all different personalities.  Great way to spend my evening.

Love Cat Therapy! 

It's so great that the cats are taken in from the local shelter and are adoptable. It makes it that much more enjoyable of an experience. I think the cats would much rather be there than in a shelter setting, given the amount of attention they get and the overall coziness of the place. Also, they will give you a freebie if you come in for your birthday, which I thought was sweet.

Some improvements could be made: 
-More comfy furniture for the humans (maybe some couch chairs to lounge on?). 
-I would be more inclined to choose Cat Therapy as a hangout spot if coffee and treats were actually made and served there, rather than the employees having to go pick up food and drink items from a different cafe to bring back to you.
-When your 75 minutes is almost up, an employee will come remind you that it is time to leave soon, unless you would like to pay to stay longer. This is awkward and I feel could be done much better. It would be nice to have a clock in system set up to where the customers clock in when they arrive, clock out when they leave, and pay however much is due at the end.

I loved spending time at Cat Therapy. I mean, I got to play with cute cats for an hour, so that's enough to make me a satisfied customer, but Cat Therapy was run very well. It seemed like the space was organized to keep the cats comfortable. The color coded collars made it easy to identify how to approach all of their cats and tere were plenty of spaces for the cats to get privacy. The employees knew each cat well and were able to tell you more about any of them. 

Since the cats were up for adoption and getting socialized, this place seems like everyone wins. My only problem is that I didn't know about this place earlier, but I'm glad I saw their sign on State Street. I hope they stay for a long time.

What a cool concept! I'm a cat lover and so are my kids- I sometimes take them to shelters or cats sanctuary cause they love meeting new cats, but these places usually aren't too welcoming of those not here to adopt. The cat therapy, on the other hand, is filling this need: you pay a small entrance fee ($12 -20% with yelp check in) and you get to hang out with up to 25 cats! You can adopt if you want, or just spend a moment with cool cats! I love the idea that they save cats from euthanasia while socializing them- also a great way to see their personalities before deciding to adopt! Check them out!!

Fantastic, they're so polite and friendly here! We were given little bags of cat treats so that we'd have a way to approach the cats, and there are plenty of comfortable seats and cushions to get to know the kitties with! Toys are everywhere, and many of the cats respond well to them. Would heavily recommend

My bf and I were looking to find a kitty friend for our young cat and when I read about Cat Therapy in the Independent, it totally made sense. All the cats there come from local shelters and are adoptable. You get to meet all of the cats and observe their temperament while interacting with them to see if you find a match. The facility is clean and offer a comfortable environment for the cats. We indeed found our new family addition there at our initial visit and the staff made the adoption process very easy and seamless. They had the cat's health and vet profiles ready for us to review and went over tips on how to introduce our new kitty to our home. 

Cat Therapy is such a wonderful concept! I would absolutely recommend anyone that is looking for a cat to check this place out. We were able to glean from our experience that the staff truly care about having these cats find good, loving homes and I wish them continued success.

This is a magical place where you can meet and play with tons of different types of cats. I highly recommend it if you love cats, especially if you're missing your own while you're traveling or living abroad. 
My girlfriend and I just adopted our dream cat from a nearby shelter through Cat Therapy, and we are supremely happy about it. 
Thanks Cat Therapy!

Wonderful in every way. The hosts are warm and responsive. The kitties are amazingly trusting and interactive. The setting is comfortable and inviting. The coffee is yummy, and the other guests create a shared experience of wonder and delight. This place is relaxing, and fun. A great asset to the Santa Barbara community.
Unwind and play with adorable cats AND contribute to a great place that helps them get adopted? Win Win. Also get to know a kitty's personality in a comfy setting before considering adoption. Sweet!

This place is awesome! It's owned by a husband and wife who greet you as soon as you walk in and give you the run down. They have about 15 cats who are all available for adoption. They have had 22 adoptions since opening 2 months ago. A good number of the cats were sleeping but there were enough to go around. It's one of those places you have experience to get. Basically people are just hanging out and petting cats. Their collars are different colors which let you know their gender, if they are shy, and if they have been adopted. The cats are super friendly since they are used to being around people.

The environment is very clean, relaxed, and chill. It's only $12 on the weekends for 75 min, I think they definitely could charge more. We didn't get any food or drinks but you can order something when you check in and the staff will pick it up for you from the cafe next door. 

We didn't make a reservation ahead of time but I would recommend that you do. I'll definitely check it out again next time we are in town.

There were so many cute cats! The place's atmosphere is nice and comfortable. They had a bunch of different toys to play with the cats, which made it really fun. The staff were super friendly. Definitely cannot wait to go back!

Just went for the second time, and it's seriously fantastic. A wonderful business for such a good cause! It's a great relaxing environment for pet lovers who are unable to have cats at home, or students who need to de-stress.

The people who run the place are as sweet as can be. We went in today and accidentally messed up our reservation (completely our fault, miscommunication within the party) and when we realized we told one of the wonderful women working there. She was very understanding and helpful, and even apologetic despite it being 100% our fault! Really just the kindest people, I cannot recommend their business enough. I wish there were an easy way to tip them extra!

Cat Therapy is also exceptionally clean. I have some intense cat allergies but 75 minutes there isn't too overwhelming because the surfaces they use don't collect the cat hair or dander, and they are constantly filtering the air. It makes a world of difference, and I know I will be coming back again and again!

Absolutely AMAZING place, such a great and fun experience here. The girl working while I went was so so lovely and you could tell she was very happy working there, which is always refreshing. I'm not a huge cat person but was still open to this, and loved very bit of it!!! And the place surprisingly is pristinely clean and smells great, even though cute little kitties are roaming around. As we sat and played with all the cats, we were offered tea and coffee!! :) something I really really loved, it does cost money, hourly, to go inside and sit with the kits. They charge per visit, because they do not charge an adoption fee. So you come to a lovely, cozy space, are treated with care and friendliness, and if you happen to fall in love with one of that cats you get to take them home. SUCH a cool idea! Why aren't there more places like this???! Can't wait to come back the next time I'm visiting SB!

Calm place to hang out with kitties. Soft jazz music and strangers coming together for the love of kitties. Staff very personable and knowledgable. Organized with on-line reservations and set number of visitors for each time slot. Wonderful place for shelter/caged kitties to have freedom to roam and interact with people who give them affection. One very shy kitty was adopted while I was there. Her new people were able to recognize her qualities beyond shyness, maybe because she wasn't cowering in the corner of a cage at the shelter. It is a fantastic new idea to introduce the public to kitties who need homes. And if it isn't possible to take one home, it's a great way to spend time with different personalities of purring fur. I have three cats of my own, but I will go back again and recommend that others do the same. Thank you for providing this sanctuary in Santa Barbara.
Pure joy!!! Mary was so friendly and inviting, we felt like family by the time we left! Heather and Kelly
Great experience! Highly recommend to visit. They have a lot of cats. If you want to relax, it is great place...)

Purrrfect place to hang out and relax, especially if you are a cat lover like meowself. The cats were very friendly and social, there's lots of area for you to lounge with the animals, and the owners maintain a really clean yet cozy environment. Also love that they've partnered with Brasil Arts (we tried the iced coffee and one of the fruit juices, both yummy). Good vibes all around. Highly recommend booking a reservation!

Cat Therapy is the first cat café in Santa Barbara and it was well worth the wait! Catalina takes excellent care of the cats and engages with patrons to create a welcoming atmosphere. The café allows for ordering drinks and food from the nearby Brazil Arts Café, since they cannot make food in house. With 75 minutes per reservation slot, patrons get just enough time with the twelve cats - not too little, not too much. 

With an ever changing roster of cat tenants, Catalina is successfully executing the main goal of Cat Therapy - to get kitties out of shelters and into homes. We couldn't have asked for a better SB Cat Café experience!

Came here for my birthday and honestly had a blast! Super relaxing atmosphere and lots of very sweet cats. The staff are all very helpful and nice! My first cat cafe experience and it definitely has set the bar high! Can't wait to go again.

Best place ever!! I love these shelters which are figuring out new ways to get enough revenue in order to keep the doors open! The cats are so friendly and there's always at least one that wants pet, play, or food. And if you fall in love with one you can adopt it right away!

This was literally one of the cutest experiences of my life! I'm a Santa Barbara local and I'll definitely be back to Cat Therapy. It's an incredibly beautiful, clean and well, ADORABLE space!! If you like cats and you want to spend some time in a space that'll totally warm your soul, go here. Cat Therapy is a wonderful place and deserves all of the love and support it can get.

My husband and I came yesterday and had a wonderful time. I really love what you are doing for these sweet kitties. Each has their own personality and will have an opportunity to get comfortable with people. I hope more and more people come visit CTSB and consider adopting the beauties they meet. Thank you and we'll definitely be back!!!

My 19-year-old niece and her friend visited us in Santa Barbara for one week, and knowing that the girls loved cats, I reserved time for a visit, and I am so glad I did.  The girls were delighted with the cats, as was I!  They're so cute.  And they're all different, both in looks and temperament.  They're identified by sex (pink collars for girls and blue collars for boys), as well as by temperament (beige collars for shy, and purple collars for unpredictable).  We sat and played with them, using the toys that were strewn about, and we even fed them with the treats that were provided.  Some of the cats were so active and entertaining, and very amusing.  A truly different kind of experience, and we wished that we could have taken one (or more) of the cats home with us.  Since the cats are taken from a shelter and provided with so much attention and care, we felt really good about supporting this type of endeavor.  We will, no doubt, return and possibly even adopt one of the cats!
If I didn't live in Goleta, I would probably be there everyday. The place is so clean and the staff are sweet. I wish I could give more stars!

Awesome place! So wonderful to take some time and hang out with the prescious kitties. Our family is visiting from out of town and we had to leave our sweet kitties behind. Visiting Cat Therapy took the edge off missing ours. Great place!

Great people and great cats. We have a cat but I'm sure other people will say you don't have to be a cat person to have a fun time relaxing with a coffee and interacting with animals. Fun form of therapy and a great way to spend an afternoon. Also like it probably says elsewhere make sure to reserve a spot in advance to have the best time with it

I absolutely love this place for many reasons. One, it's INCREDIBLY CLEAN. Like, immaculate. It makes you feel comfortable to lounge around the floor with the cats, sit in the chairs without having to wipe anything down. A little thing, but I enjoyed it! Two, THE CATS OBVIOUSLY. Three, the workers are very sweet and they are very kind and definitely contribute to a very therapeutic and fun atmosphere.

I can't wait until they take in more cats and maybe let customers know where they can find toys and stuff for the kitties :) Other than that, a very affordable, very fun cat café :D

Awesome experience!!! I LOVED playing,  playing and cuddling the cats! This was totally worth$12 for the hour of puurrr-e (pure) enjoyment! 

Thank God they had cat tape roller brushes.  Why did I wear black?  LOL.

Be sure to dress prepared! 

All the cats we handle are very sweet and had been socialized really well.

After years of waiting, I finally was able to adopt a feline friend and we found our furrball at Cat Therapy! Catalina runs a wonderful business and was great showing us the different cats that fit the personalities we wanted. The staff really gets to know the cats and you can tell they really care about them. What I loved about the adopting from here is all the cats come from local shelters which was really important to me. Our kitty (re-named Toby) was well socialized when we brought him home and has been very open to bonding with his new humans. Would recommend this adoption process to anyone looking for a cat!
This place is paradise!!! The cats are very well mannered and they give them a purple color when they have quirks. Such a nice an welcoming place!

Just came here today with my boyfriend and I miss it already!! 

Made reservations through there easily accessible website! We arrived 10 minutes earlier prior to our reservations and was told the rules, ask if we would like any fruit bowls/drinks. After that we got to hang out with the kitties, and feed them kibble. 

Love the owners and staff, they are wonderful and so sweet. They are interactive and approachable. It was wonderful and fun. The cats are too cute and I wanted to adopt all of them. 

I hope that others will get to try this paw-sitive experience!!

What a great place! I didn't actually go inside as they were closed but I watched the cats from outside the window for about 15 minutes. We happened to run into this cat cafe as we were heading back to the car in the nearby parking lot. Two adorable cats came up to me by the door and were just the sweetest little things. 

The next day I stopped by again to sneak another peek at all the kitties. This time it was open but you do need to make a reservation before coming in. This keeps a surge of people from coming in and ensures they maintain a relaxed and comfortable environment for the cats. 

What an great concept! Lounge and play with cats while you linger over coffee, refreshing beverages and light bites. The cats get socialization and companionship and potential owners can play and interact with the kitties before adopting. Of course you can just come in to visit and spend some quality time with some cool feline friends. 

I will have to make a reservation next time I'm in SB. I've heard wonderful things about this place and I can't wait to visit.

Parents Beware

I don't usually do this but I want to let people know about our experience at this business. My pre-teen daughter and I have been here a few times because we love cats and want to support their humane treatment and adoptions. She is always 100% respectful with cats and their boundaries. Last time we were there I was bitten by a cat and though I was totally fine, I let the shop-keeper know. She seemed not to care at all as if it was a regular occurrence.
